右键点击这件物品会发出声音，与 Irritack 建立联系……
It's... Elphaba! Aledar might still be alive... Quick!
那是……Elphaba！Aledar 也许还活着……快！
You should use these body parts to enter the worm and find Aledar...
你应该用这些身体部位钻进蠕虫体内，找到 Aledar……
This is where Aledar was taken... Perhaps you can lure the worm somehow.
Aledar 就是在这里被带走的……也许你能想办法把蠕虫引出来。
The stomach acid seems to rise and fall consistently.
胃酸似乎在有规律地涨落。
Aledar must've fallen somewhere near the road too!
Aledar 一定也掉在路边附近的某处了！
Well, hello there, traveler. Don't think I've seen you in here before.
哎呀，你好啊，旅人。我好像没在店里见过你。
You took down Corkus' infamous factory? That's quite an accomplishment. I've heard many a tale of what those mechs could do.
你摧毁了 Corkus 那座臭名昭著的工厂？真了不起。那些机甲有多厉害，我可听过不少传闻。
Well, hello there, traveler! It's nice to see you around here again.
哎呀，你好啊，旅人！很高兴又在这里见到你。
You have to find a way of following them to the top!
你得想办法跟着他们到顶端去！
{u}, good news. I'm basically as recovered as I think I'll get.
{u}，好消息。我差不多已经恢复到极限了。
>and the hero shall blind the ancient seer. good luck.
>而英雄将蒙蔽古老的先知。祝你好运。
Alright, let's go. I'll tell you more about our journey on the way.
好，我们出发吧。路上我再跟你多说说这趟旅程。
与 Aledar 继续你们的旅程。
We should try to follow the path as closely as we can. You lead, I'll follow.
我们应该尽量沿着小路走。你带路，我跟着。
Good work. Seems that killing the king made the other creatures run off. We’re lucky about that-
干得好。看来杀了它们的王，其他怪物就跑了。我们运气不错——
Wait, {u}, what's going on? Are you alright?
等等，{u}，怎么回事？你还好吗？
Oh, no no no! I have a potion for this, where is it, where is it, aha! Here, drink!
噢，不不不不！我有治这个的药水，在哪、在哪，啊哈！来，喝下去！
One of those things must have infected your wounds... Everything in this area looks completely hazardous and sickening.
一定是那些东西感染了你的伤口……这一带的一切看起来都又危险又恶心。
I expected the worst, so I tried to bring anything and everything that might help. Let's keep moving.
我早就做了最坏的打算，所以能带的、可能派上用场的东西全都带上了。我们继续走吧。
Continue on the main path with Aledar.
与 Aledar 沿着主路继续前进。
I'm... I'm going to lead us for now. At least for a little...while... I can't have you g-getting-
我……接下来由我带路。至少一小……会儿……我不能让你受——
...urgh... I...sorry. I just... I need a moment.
……呃……我……抱歉。我只是……需要缓一下。
{u}, you just... you have to realize, I can't have you getting hurt.
I want to stress this... We NEED to get to the end of this path, together.
我要强调这一点……我们必须一起走到这条路的尽头。
Okay. I'm as good as I can get right now. Let's move.
好了。我现在只能恢复到这样了。走吧。
Ah? What... What just... Why do I...
啊？怎么……刚才怎么……为什么我会……
I'll be fine, I just...why did I feel so empty all of the sudden...?
我没事，我只是……为什么突然觉得整个人空了一块……？
A mysterious force pushes you back...
一股神秘的力量把你推了回去……
Oh no, I think something is coming... {u}! Fight it off, I don't think I can defend myself right now!
噢不，我觉得有东西来了……{u}！把它打退，我现在恐怕保护不了自己！
Defend Aledar from the Radiated Spiders.
保护 Aledar，击退辐射蜘蛛。
Huff... Not feeling totally better, but... At least I can still defend myself.
呼……还没完全好，不过……至少我还能保护自己。
My stomach is empty, I can't even vomit... Why do I still feel so dizzy? Maybe a potion will help...
我的胃都空了，想吐都吐不出来……为什么我还是这么晕？也许喝瓶药水会有用……
Urgh, pfft! My vomit tasted better than that coming up...
呃，呸！我吐出来的东西都比这个好喝……
Hah...that's the ticket. Which potion was this anyways... ...hair loss treatment? Why did THAT work?
哈……就是这个。这到底是哪瓶药水……生发药？为什么这个会有用？
Though, you saw what happened to that beast I attacked? Follow me.
话说回来，你看到我攻击的那头野兽怎么了吗？跟我来。
This, from what I recall of the mission statements, is referred to as a "Void Hole." It's a sort of portal.
照我记得的任务说明，这东西叫作“虚空洞”。算是一种传送门。
They connect to each other in odd ways, but we saw the beast come out of that one when I knocked it in, so...
它们彼此连接的方式很古怪，不过我把那头野兽打进去的时候，我们看到它从那个洞里出来，所以……
Watch. I'll come out the other side.
看好。我会从另一边出来。
Alright, good! It does connect up consistently, at least. You try now.
好，很好！至少它的连接是固定的。现在换你试试。
Continue on the trail with Aledar.
与 Aledar 沿着小路继续前进。
I bring this up because if we're seeing one, we'll be seeing more soon. You'll need to adjust yourself to the sight of them.
我提这个，是因为既然看到了一个，很快就会看到更多。你得习惯它们的样子。
We grossly underestimated the difficulties we would have here. And, by that, I mean myself, Elphie, and Lucio did...
我们严重低估了这里的难度。我是说，我、Elphie 和 Lucio 都低估了……
We were each unprepared and cocky. If it weren't for you, I'd be dead now, for what it's worth.
我们每个人都准备不足，又自以为是。不管怎么说，要不是有你，我现在已经死了。
I wasn't certain at first about you coming along, but you've more than shown you were the right one for the job.
一开始我还不确定该不该让你一起来，但你早就证明了你是这份工作的不二人选。
...I had to figure this map was outdated. This wall of spikes isn't listed on it, and the path goes through here!
……我早该想到这张地图过时了。这面尖刺墙上面根本没标，可小路就是从这里穿过去的！
I'll have to assume they're new...and if they're new, I might be able to bash through them.
我只能假设它们是新长出来的……如果是新的，我也许能撞开它们。
{u}, try throwing a spell at the same time! Let's crack through these things!
{u}，你同时放个法术！我们把这些东西打破！
...aagh... I... H-how are these so resilient...?
I'm an idiot... I nearly killed myself trying that. I nearly ruined the mission...
我真是个白痴……刚才那样差点把自己弄死。我差点毁了整个任务……
I'm sorry, but you'll have to go without me. I can't move another step for now.
抱歉，你只能自己去了。我现在一步都走不动了。
There's a lot of void holes around here, remember my warning... You can probably get past these spikes with one.
这附近有很多虚空洞，记住我的警告……你大概能用其中一个绕过这些尖刺。
If I'd been thinking I would have suggested it earlier... Once you're past, we'll...uh. We'll do something.
我要是有动脑子，早就该提议了……等你过去之后，我们就……呃。我们再想办法。
Just...be careful where you go. The void holes could lead anywhere. They might lead you someplace very, very dangerous, too dangerous even for you. I pray they won't...
只是……去哪里都要小心。虚空洞可能通往任何地方。它们也可能把你带到非常、非常危险的地方，危险到连你都应付不了。我祈祷不会……
There's a void hole right there to try out first. Get going, now. You have to do this.
那边就有一个虚空洞，先去试试。快去吧。这件事非你不可。
Use Void Holes to try and get behind the spike barrier
利用虚空洞，想办法绕到尖刺屏障后面
An explosion has occurred somewhere in the arena...
竞技场的某处发生了爆炸……
Find a way to help Aledar get to the other side of the spike barrier.
想办法帮 Aledar 到达尖刺屏障的另一边。
...wait, {u}? You got to the other side then...? Good...
I don't know what you did, but whatever it was, it's made cracks in the spikes that I can see from this side.
我不知道你做了什么，但不管是什么，尖刺上都出现裂缝了，我从这边都看得到。
I've got some of my energy back...let's try spellcasting again. If we do it at the same time, we might make some headway.
我恢复了一点力气……我们再施一次法吧。如果同时施放，也许能有点进展。
I won't crack my skull open on the spikes again though. Promise.
不过我不会再拿头去撞那些尖刺了。我保证。
You lead. I'll cast my spell as soon as I hear yours.
你带路。一听到你施法，我就马上施放我的法术。
Thank god it worked... That's our destination there, the Eldritch Outlook.
谢天谢地，成功了……那就是我们的目的地，邪异瞭望台。
Now comes the hardest part... Come along. I'll need you there for it.
接下来是最难的部分……跟我来。这件事需要你在场。
That blade there...it's made for sacrifice. See how that gate is shut?
那边那把刀……是用来献祭的。看到那扇门关着吗？
In order to open the doors to the Outlook, we need to sacrifice a powerful soul.
要打开通往瞭望台的门，我们必须献祭一个强大的灵魂。
We... we should have told you from the start. You and Lucio. Elphie and I, we knew. We knew this would be here.
我们……我们应该一开始就告诉你的。你和 Lucio 都不知道。我和 Elphie 知道。我们知道这里会有这个。
We didn't have... we didn't have a sacrifice in mind. We decided that it would be best decided once we reached that point. And I think- we both knew it would have to be one of us.
我们没有……我们心里并没有定下献祭的人选。我们决定等走到这一步再做决定。我想我们俩都知道，那会是我们其中一个。
...I think she would have insisted it be her. Even though both of us had something we would be le-...
……我想她一定会坚持由她来。尽管我们俩都有要留下的……
It doesn't matter now. It's just us left. And I've been mulling it over since we got to the town... you'll sacrifice me. I won't take no for an answer.
现在都不重要了。只剩下我们了。从我们到镇上开始，我就一直在想这件事……你来献祭我。我不接受拒绝。
I mean...look at the state I'm in, {u}! I'm on death's door already, and you've proven yourself far stronger than I am even at my best.
我是说……看看我现在这副样子，{u}！我已经一只脚踏进鬼门关了，而你早就证明了你比全盛时期的我还要强得多。
Here. You can take everything I had on me. My emeralds, and the key to the dungeon. I certainly won't be able to use them anymore.
拿去。我身上的东西你全都拿走吧。我的绿宝石，还有地牢的钥匙。我肯定再也用不上了。
Upon the top of the tower is... Well, something. We don't know for certain what it is, but it will prevent you from passing through.
塔顶上有……嗯，某个东西。我们不确定那是什么，但它会挡住你的去路。
You'll have to kill it to break the barrier. But...find other soldiers who can help you. It will be impossible to defeat alone.
你得杀了它才能打破屏障。不过……去找其他能帮你的士兵。单靠你一个人不可能打败它。
...no more putting it off, then. I'm bleeding out.
……那就别再拖了。我快流干血了。
Right click to grab the blade in the altar.
Now...strike me down. My soul will unlock the gate...
现在……杀了我。我的灵魂会打开那扇门……
You...can do this. I know y-you can.
你……做得到的。我知、知道你做得到。
那个在监、监视我们的怪物……
Talk to me when you are ready to go. But remember, we're on a mission. We won't be returning until it's finished.
准备好出发就告诉我。不过别忘了，我们身上有任务，完成之前不会回来。
Aledar probably wouldn't like it if you left.
你要是离开，Aledar 大概会不太高兴。
Kill {~} Upside Downer  to Destroy the Spikes
击杀 {~} 只 Upside Downer 来摧毁尖刺
It appears that green substance on the walls has bouncing properties.
墙上那些绿色的东西好像有弹性。
Looks like you're past the spikes. You can see the tower that was visible past them from here. Hopefully there is a way to break the spikes from this side nearby...
看来你已经越过尖刺了。从这里看得到刚才尖刺另一边的那座塔。希望附近有办法从这一侧破坏尖刺……
No matter how hard to try and pull the blade out, it does not budge...
不管怎么用力拔，那把刀都纹丝不动……
It appears the boulder that was once blocking the way is gone...
原本挡住去路的巨石似乎不见了……
...you were scared of those, once upon a time. What a difference time makes.
……曾几何时，你还很怕那些东西。时间带来的改变真大。
You can take that armor to an Item Identifier right there, and then you can wear it once identified.
你可以把那件盔甲拿给那边的物品鉴定师，鉴定完就能穿了。
This gate marks the Fruman Border- you must make sure you aren't spotted from this point onwards.
这道大门就是 Fruma 的边境——从这里开始，你必须确保自己不被发现。
Sounds like new recruits are walking down the path! You better find somewhere to hide before they spot you!
听起来有新兵正沿着小路走过来！你最好在被他们发现之前找个地方躲起来！
This is your chance, the gate's open! Follow the Caravan Driver!
机会来了，大门开了！跟上商队车夫！
...you need to escape. Strike while the commander is busy, and find a way out!
……你得逃出去。趁指挥官正忙的时候动手，找条路出去！
You have emptied {p} of soldiers. You must escape before someone discovers what has happened here. The only way out is forward.
你已经把 {p} 的士兵清空了。你必须在有人发现这里出了什么事之前逃走。唯一的出路就在前方。
What is this place? Such technology, you can hardly imagine how it was made.
这是什么地方？这种技术，你几乎无法想象它是怎么造出来的。
The caravan driver seems to have disappeared... maybe you can find something if you look in some of mechanized carriages?
商队车夫好像不见了……也许去那些机械化车厢里找找，会发现些什么？
{p}'s relations with Fruma exclusively consist of the generous batches of recruits sent to fight the corruption here in Wynn.
{p} 与 Fruma 的往来，就只有对方慷慨地一批批送来新兵，到 Wynn 这里对抗腐化。
They've shut you out. There's no way in from here... But what if you went back the way you first arrived?
他们把你挡在外面了。从这里进不去……但要是你沿着最初来时的路回去呢？
...Ah. I see. So I suppose...things must not have gone well. Have all the others returned?
……啊。我明白了。所以我想……事情大概不太顺利吧。其他人都回来了吗？
Is there anything I can do for you today?
今天有什么我能帮你的吗？
...something's prickling at the back of your mind. Weren't you asleep like this when you first arrived, too?
……你脑海深处隐隐有种刺痛感。你刚来的时候，不也是像这样睡着的吗？
Explore near where you originally arrived in Wynn.
在你最初抵达 Wynn 的地方附近探索。
Continue back down the path to Fruma.
沿着小路继续往回走向 Fruma。
This job is impossible!! Why am I even here?!
这份工作根本不可能完成！！我到底为什么会在这里？！
Ah! You're a soldier, right? Look, I- It's, it's just a really difficult time right now.
啊！你是士兵，对吧？听着，我——那个，现在真的是很困难的时候。
This, this whole situation is definitely above my paygrade! I don't know how I'm going to deal with this...
这、这整件事绝对超出我的职权范围了！我不知道该怎么处理……
Enough of that, I, ah, I suppose. What is it you need?
不说这个了，我，呃，我想。你需要什么？
Oh. Oh no. Ah, I, you see, that'll be a problem, I think. What do you even need to do at the border anyway?
噢。噢不。呃，我，你看，我想这会是个问题。你到底要去边境做什么？
I can't really imagine what you could need there, but, whatever it is, it'll need to wait! This Corkian drill won't work, and Paxon's stuck, and-
我实在想象不出你在那里能有什么事，但不管是什么，都得等等了！这台 Corkus 钻机不能用，Paxon 又被困住了，而且——
Look, I'm...I'm sorry for snapping at you. I'm trained for military operation, not for cave-in clearance, but no one else was available!
听着，我……我很抱歉对你发火。我受的是军事行动的训练，不是清理坍方的，可是没有别人能来了！
Even the demolitions expert I hired is stuck, so it's all just, it's all going wrong and I don't know what to do.
就连我请来的爆破专家都被困住了，所以一切都、一切都不顺，我也不知道该怎么办。
You see that new entrance over there? The expert, Paxon, has been in there for almost as long as I was trying this dud machine.
看到那边那个新的入口了吗？那位专家 Paxon 在里面待的时间，差不多跟我试这台废机器的时间一样久。
If you think you can do a job better than an expert, go ahead and talk with them, but I'm pretty sure you'll have to cancel whatever plans you had.
如果你觉得你能比专家做得更好，就去跟他们谈谈吧，不过我很确定你得取消原本的计划了。
Talk to the Demolition Mage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
If you really need to get to the border, your best bet is to talk to Paxon in the new cave entrance.
如果你真的得去边境，最好的办法是去新的洞穴入口找 Paxon 谈谈。
But, they're an expert, so I think your business will have to wait. Really, really sorry about all this!
不过，他们可是专家，所以我想你的事得先等等了。真的、真的很抱歉！
Oh no, not another one- I don't care what rank you are, what you're asking is impossible! Even for me, it-
哦不，又来一个——我不管你是什么军阶，你要求的事根本不可能！就算是我，也——
Wait, you aren't part of the... You're just a regular soldier. You're just trying to get through here, aren't you?
等等，你不是那个……你只是个普通士兵。你只是想从这里过去，对吧？
May as well give up now! Not happening. No way. You're wasting your time, and let me tell you exactly why.
你还是现在就放弃吧！不可能的。门都没有。你是在浪费时间，我来告诉你到底为什么。
You see that blue rock over there? It's a break point. If I could set off these explosives at it, it'd open a path.
看到那边那块蓝色石头了吗？那是个突破点。如果我能在那里引爆炸药，就能打开一条路。
They're gone. Hurry down the path!
他们走了。快顺着小路下去！
But apparently all these structures set up are so important that any of it being damaged, or MOVED, is unacceptable!
可是这里搭的这些建筑显然重要得不得了，任何一样被弄坏，或者被移动，都不可接受！
And to make sure I'm 'supervised' while the lieutenant is working on the drill, the detonator HAS to be here.
而且为了确保中尉在弄钻机的时候我有人“监督”，引爆器必须放在这里。
So I have to daisy-chain a limited amount of explosives all the way over to the stone, without blasting any structures!
所以我得用有限的炸药一路串联到那块石头，还不能炸到任何建筑！
I've been trying for hours and gotten absolutely nowhere! I'm one of the best in my field, even! It's ridiculous!!
我试了好几个小时，一点进展都没有！我在这一行可是数一数二的！太离谱了！！
If you feel like wasting your time, here's my stock of explosives. Feel free to try your hand at it, but you should really just go.
如果你想浪费时间，这是我的炸药存货。你尽管试试，不过你真的该走了。
Use the TNT to open up a path through the cave.
用 TNT 在洞穴里炸出一条路。
Still at it? What, do you need a reminder? I've got nothing better to do.
还在弄？怎么，要我再提醒你一次吗？反正我也没更好的事可做。
So the blue rock is soft enough to crack with the explosives. But the detonator's stuck here.
所以那块蓝色石头够软，炸药炸得裂。可是引爆器固定在这里。
So we need to use the TNT Placer to daisy-chain blasts from the detonator, without blasting any tents, crates, or walls.
所以我们得用 TNT 放置器从引爆器一路串联引爆，而且不能炸到任何帐篷、箱子或墙壁。
You can look at placed TNT to see its blast radius, as well.
你也可以看着放好的 TNT 查看它的爆炸范围。
But given how tight the squeeze between some of those structures is, there's just no way it's happening.
可是有些建筑之间的空隙窄成那样，根本不可能办到。
Like I said, you really should just mosey on back to the castle. If I can't get anywhere, I don't think you'll fare better.
就像我说的，你真的该慢慢晃回城堡去。连我都搞不定，我不认为你会比较好。
Halt! Where did you come from? There was a cave-in past here, wasn't there?
站住！你从哪里来的？这里过去不是塌方了吗？
A new path, huh? I didn't think you'd have things to be doing back here, though I won't say I'm ungrateful.
新的路，是吗？我没想到你还要回这后头来办事，不过我也不是不领情。
It even crushed the grook's nest there. I've been working off field rations for a few days. So where are you headed?
坍方连那边的 grook 巢都压垮了。我已经靠野战口粮撑了好几天。那么你要去哪里？
The border? I suppose if you're headed there, it must be important, official business. Although, it might have to wait.
边境？既然你要去那里，我想一定是重要的公务。不过，可能得等等了。
The bridge repair was something of a hackjob. It may not bear up your weight. Now that the cave-in's clear, we might be able to get it fixed proper...
那座桥修得很马虎。它可能撑不住你的重量。现在坍方清掉了，我们也许能把它好好修一修……
But that'll take time. I'd just as soon turn back- whatever business you have isn't worth your life, after all.
不过那需要时间。换作是我就直接回头了，毕竟不管你有什么事，都不值得赔上性命。
Say, I think I recognize you, actually. That's a rarity for this line of work.
说起来，我好像认得你。干这一行这种事很少见。
Are you sure that what you have to do is worth it? That bridge is awful rickety. Wouldn't want to lose you.
你确定你要做的事值得吗？那座桥摇摇晃晃的。可不想失去你。
Hey, you there! Come talk to me before you pass through.
嘿，你！过去之前先来跟我谈谈。
Hey, you! Come talk to me first, recruit!
嘿，你！先来跟我谈谈，新兵！
Coming or going, I'm under strict orders to intercept soldiers and make sure they're equipped before heading on.
不管是来是去，我都奉命拦下士兵，确保他们装备齐全才能继续前进。
No exceptions, not for any reason. Especially not since the cave-in across the river!
没有例外，不管什么理由都一样。尤其是河对岸坍方之后更是如此！
Nothing's more important than your life, and moving on without being suited up could cost you it!
没有什么比你的性命更重要，没穿好装备就往前走，可能会让你丢了命！
Well, let me take a look at it and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
好，让我看看这身行头合不合规定。
Well, let me take a look and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
好，让我看看这些装备合不合规定。
Hmm... Ah, yep, signs of wear all over... Armor not polished... Weapon looks liable to fall apart any second...
嗯……啊，没错，到处都是磨损的痕迹……盔甲没擦亮……武器看起来随时都会散架……
I'm surprised you made it ten feet out here with those rusty trinkets! This is no way to protect yourself!
真没想到你带着这些生锈的玩意还能走出十英尺！这样根本保护不了自己！
Look, there's a loot chest in the cave just there, so you need to head in and get yourself some proper equipment.
听着，那边的洞穴里有个战利品箱，你得进去给自己弄套像样的装备。
...that so, huh? Well, I think you should take a second look up ahead.
……是这样吗，嗯？好吧，我觉得你该再往前看一眼。
See? Now no more guff about levels- you either gear up properly, or you don't pass! I won't have you risking your life.
看到了吧？现在别再跟我扯什么等级了，要么把装备穿好，要么就别过去！我不会让你拿命冒险。
我是要往另一个方向走。
You can find good stuff in caves, like the one just next to me, so hop to it.
在洞穴里能找到好东西，就像我旁边这个，所以快去吧。
Like I said, coming or going. No matter what, you should gear up by looting the cave here before heading onwards.
就像我说的，不管是来是去。无论如何，继续前进之前，你都该先搜刮这里的洞穴把装备穿好。
Good stuff. There's a loot chest in that cave there, so you should find everything you need. Get to it!
很好。那边的洞穴里有个战利品箱，你需要的东西应该都找得到。去吧！
Explore the cave to find some loot.
Enter the cave and open the loot chest.
进入洞穴，打开战利品箱。
That looks like the stuff. You can take that armor to an Item Identifier right there, and then you can wear it once identified.
看起来就是那些了。你可以把那件盔甲拿给那边的物品鉴定师，鉴定完就能穿了。
Though, since you seem to be headed back to the border... I have to ask why. It's pretty unusual. Probably best you head back to {p}.
不过……既然你好像是要回边境……我得问问为什么。这很少见。你最好还是回 {p} 吧。
If other recruits see you coming the other way, they might get confused, or discouraged. Wouldn't want to risk that, right?
要是其他新兵看到你往反方向走，他们可能会困惑，或者泄气。我们可不想冒这个险，对吧？
Are you sure whatever you're doing is worth it? Maybe you should just head back to town.
你确定你在做的事值得吗？也许你该直接回镇上去。
Avoid the Fruman recruits on the path.
避开小路上的 Fruma 新兵。
...been recruiting Fruman soldiers for the war effort. Apparently things are really bad over there. Makes me nervous...
……一直在为战事招募 Fruma 的士兵。听说那边的情况真的很糟。让我有点紧张……
Walking corpses aren't anything I'm going to underestimate, but it can't be all doom and gloom, right?
行尸走肉可不是我会小看的东西，不过总不会全是坏消息吧？
I suppose we'll see once we pass through this gate. It marks the border... Deep breaths, deep breaths...
我想等我们过了这道门就知道了。这里就是边境……深呼吸，深呼吸……
...know anything about Wynn? I didn't get any debriefing.
……对 Wynn 有什么了解吗？我没听到任何简报。
I remember rumors... Something about a great hero. Name started with...an R?
我记得有些传闻……关于一位伟大的英雄。名字开头是……R？
We'll make it a point to ask as soon as we can. Information's key to fighting wars.
我们一有机会就去问问。情报是打仗的关键。
...rotten driver. I feel for the man, but he said he always hits that boulder. Sounds like his own fault to me.
……烂透了的车夫。我同情那个人，可他说他每次都会撞上那块大石头。在我听来是他自己的错。
I'm thinking about meals more than wheels. I feel like I haven't eaten in days. Hope the walk's short...
我现在想的是饭，不是车。我觉得我好几天没吃东西了。希望这段路不长……
Well, if he was a more competent driver you wouldn't have to walk so far on an empty stomach! Let's hurry so we can get you a feast, huh?
嗯，要是他是个更称职的车夫，你就不用空着肚子走这么远了！我们快点走，好让你吃顿大餐，嗯？
Wait, who's that? Why are they coming from the border??
等等，那是谁？他们为什么从边境那边过来？？
...and that's the last of them for today.
……今天的最后一批就是他们了。
Lot of pairs today. Eight more in the wings... But that's for tomorrow.
今天两两一组的真多。还有八个在后面等着……不过那是明天的事了。
Same darn boulder... Same darn line, too. Wonder if they'll let me shake it up one day. This is always a pain...
又是同一块该死的大石头……又是同一句该死的台词。不知道他们哪天会不会让我换个说法。每次都烦死了……
And that's that about that. And now, to be off...to the home I choose. And there's no troubles to follow me there.
就这样，没别的了。现在，出发……回我选择的家。没有烦恼会跟着我到那里。
探索 Fruma 大门的另一边。
Just couldn't take the hint, huh?
Bet you think you're slick. Didn't even notice me hang back to watch, huh? I wasn't born yesterday.
我打赌你觉得自己很机灵。连我留在后面盯着都没发现，是吧？我可不是昨天才出生的。
Listen, this isn't the first time something like this has happened- Y'know. Someone gets curious, retraces their steps.
听着，这种事不是第一次发生了，你懂的。总有人好奇，回头去找自己走过的路。
...I will make only one demand of you. Whatever happens...come back alive.
……我对你只有一个要求。不管发生什么……都要活着回来。
If you couldn't tell, this whole thing's meant to be a one way trip. The bridge, the cave-in, everyone trying to discourage you.
如果你还没看出来，这整趟本来就是单程的。那座桥、那场坍方、每个人都想劝退你。
It's not wise to be here- After all, you weren't the one out of your group of three that got permission to stay. Yeah, I heard about the tournament results.
来这里不是明智之举，毕竟你们三人一组里，获准留下的那个人不是你。对，我听说比赛结果了。
He's dead asleep. You could probably ring a church bell an inch above his head and he'd stay unconscious.
他睡得死死的。就算在他头顶一寸敲教堂的钟，他大概也醒不过来。
That looks like the stuff. See? That wasn't so hard. Alright, now!
看起来就是这东西。看吧？没那么难。好，现在！
So...you got two choices, buddy. We can let this slide between us. We can. You can go marching right back to {p} and my lips will be sealed.
所以……你有两个选择，老兄。这件事我们可以就当没发生过。真的可以。你可以走回 {p}，我会守口如瓶。
Alas, I am afraid my hands are quite tied here. There is little I can do- you recall what I said in the meeting.
唉，恐怕我在这件事上实在无能为力。我能做的很少——你还记得我在会议上说的话。
Or, you can live life dangerously and follow me on the train to {p}. Better make your choice quick, though- it's leaving soon.
或者，你可以冒险跟着我搭上前往 {p} 的列车。不过最好快点决定，车马上就要开了。
If I see you in the passenger cabin, well...that'll be that, and you'll just have to wait and see what comes of it.
要是我在乘客车厢里看到你，嗯……那就这样了，你只能等着看会有什么下场。
Join the Caravan Driver in the passenger car at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的乘客车厢与商队车夫会合。
Last chance to back out. This your choice?
这是最后一次反悔的机会了。你确定要这么选？
Well, you better get headed on the long walk back to {p} then.
嗯，那你最好赶紧上路吧，走回 {p} 可远着呢。
You know what they say about curiosity, and how it killed the cat. You the type to believe satisfaction'll bring it back?
你知道大家怎么说好奇心吧，好奇心会害死猫。你是那种相信满足了好奇心就能让猫复活的人吗？
Well, 'kittycat,' you didn't find the cream- just the hound dogs.
那么，“小猫咪”，你没找到奶油，只找到了猎犬。
Intruder to Fruma, you are under arrest! Now march!
闯入 Fruma 的人，你被捕了！快走！
You really thought the Driver was on your side, intruder? What a fool you are. We gave you every chance to quit this endeavor, but here you are. Let's go.
你真以为车夫站在你这边吗，闯入者？你真是个傻瓜。我们给了你每一个放弃的机会，可你还是来了。走吧。
指挥官！我们必须马上谈谈！
I have urgent news to report from the gate.
我有紧急消息要从大门那边报告。
If it is truly so urgent, let's speak.
如果真的这么紧急，我们就谈吧。
Soldiers! Keep the intruder still. I've every faith in you.
士兵们！看住闯入者。我完全信任你们。
Anythin' I can help you with?
Hm. Suppose there's no harm. But watch yourself, alright?
嗯。我想也无妨。不过你自己小心点，好吗？
This here's our home. I wouldn't take too kindly to you messin' anything up, understand?
这里是我们的家。你要是把什么东西弄乱了，我可不会客气，懂吗？
...doin' alright, all things considered. Weather's nice, I suppose. Festival comin' up.
……还过得去，考虑到各种情况的话。天气不错，我想。节日快到了。
But that ain't none of our business, really. If you didn't need anythin' else, I'll kindly ask you to take your leave.
不过那真的不关我们的事。如果你没别的事，我就客气地请你离开了。
Hm. Good. Have a nice day, now.
Hmm? And who may you be?
Hoh, oh well. Might I help you with something?
呵，哦，好吧。有什么我能帮你的吗？
Ah, completing some assorted metalworking projects. There always seems to be something to replace or maintain around here...
啊，在做些零零碎碎的金属加工活。这附近好像总有东西要换或要修……
Though, I certainly am no expert! But I can handle the tools well enough, and that is all that is needed for the task.
不过我可算不上专家！但工具我还用得来，而这份工作需要的也就这些。
Farewell, stranger! I hope that you will return home safely.
再见了，陌生人！希望你能平安回家。
You don't hear anything moving on the other side of the door.
你听不到门的另一边有任何动静。
Greetings, {u}. It is always an honour to have you in our halls.
你好，{u}。能在我们的殿堂里接待你，始终是我们的荣幸。
So, Tasim has stayed behind then. I'm to suppose you're worried for his safety, in amongst any other worries you might have.
这么说，Tasim 留下来了。我想，除了你可能有的其他忧虑之外，你也在担心他的安危吧。
Although you are not the first to wish to return to Fruma, I have not had any recruits who went to investigate come back satisfied. Or, in a scant few cases, at all.
你并不是第一个想回 Fruma 的人，但去调查的新兵之中，没有一个是满意而归的。还有极少数的人，根本没有回来。
I may only grant you access to the pass you took to first come here. Simply take the door and do what you must. I know not what you will find...
我只能准许你使用你当初来这里时走的那条通道。直接走那扇门，做你该做的事吧。我不知道你会发现什么……
I'd advise you be cautious. The Queen's correspondence has been...not unkind, but forceful- And considering the circumstances...
我劝你小心行事。女王的来信一直……并不失礼，但态度强硬——再考虑到眼下的情况……
The door to the pass between here and Fruma is down the hall, across from the fireplace. Come back alive- that is an order as King.
通往这里与 Fruma 之间那条通道的门，就在走廊尽头、壁炉对面。活着回来——这是国王的命令。
...ah. It's enchanted...that's odd, given what you've seen, but the guards are looking your way now. You probably shouldn't do that again.
……啊。它被施了魔法……考虑到你见过的那些，这倒是挺奇怪的，不过守卫们正往你这边看。你最好别再这么做了。
No one seems to know you're here.
似乎没有人知道你在这里。
The very sight of you offends me! Let this gust of wind relieve me of your presence. Take it as a warning- you are not welcome here!
光是看到你就让我不快！让这阵风把你从我眼前吹走吧。就当是警告——这里不欢迎你！
...rrgh! The tunnels! Once again, humans try so hard to spoil my fun... But do you really think you've evaded me?
……呃！那些隧道！人类又一次拼命坏我的兴致……但你真以为你躲得过我？
A dullard to the end, walking to your obliteration. I'm going to savor this delectable moment...it's been decades since I've rendered a human to dust!
蠢到最后一刻，自己走向毁灭。我要好好品味这美妙的时刻……我已经几十年没把人类化为尘土了！
A shard of the crystal seems to have remained behind. Maybe you can use this to escape!
水晶似乎留下了一块碎片。也许你能用它逃出去！
...fine. The defenses of my tower were absolute enough that I never needed to defend myself inside. I should have taken you seriously from the start.
……好吧。我这座塔的防御天衣无缝，我在里面从来不需要亲自防守。我一开始就该认真对待你。
HA! I still get the last laugh! Even at my most vulnerable, I've gracefully outwitted you! As if I would really surrender to a human.
哈！笑到最后的还是我！就算在我最脆弱的时候，我也优雅地智胜了你！我怎么可能真的向人类投降。
I'll just drain Norsten's vitality to refill my own if you attack! There's nothing you can do- can't jump after the gem, can't defeat me! It's hopeless for you!
你敢攻击，我就吸干 Norsten 的生命力来补充我自己！你什么也做不了——跳不到宝石那里，也打不过我！你没希望了！
There's the strange gem that Dramele threw away... You should take it with you, he said it would save Norsten.
那就是 Dramele 扔掉的奇怪宝石……你应该带上它，他说它能救 Norsten。
Although the strange beings are now gone, some parts of them were left behind. They look very unstable.
那些奇怪的生物虽然消失了，却留下了一些残骸。它们看起来非常不稳定。
Perhaps if you combine them in the right way you can cause an explosion and escape.
也许以正确的方式把它们组合起来，就能引发爆炸并逃出去。
Goal: Get {~} Explosive Power by combining the {~} different cores in the grid made of green particles.
目标: 在绿色粒子组成的网格中组合 {~2} 种不同的核心，获得 {~1} 点爆炸威力。
Each core gains and loses explosive power based on its position in the grid, and what cores it's touching. Each core touches the cores that are above, below and next to it.
每个核心的爆炸威力会根据它在网格中的位置、以及它接触到哪些核心而增减。每个核心都会接触到它上方、下方和左右相邻的核心。
Right Click a core to select it, then Right Click one of the {~} green spots in the grid to place it there.
右键选择一个核心，再右键点击网格中 {~} 个绿点之一，把核心放到那里。
Remember, you need to get {~} Explosive Power! If you need a hint, click on Hints and Rules and select "I want a hint."
记住，你需要获得 {~} 点爆炸威力！需要提示的话，点击“提示与规则”并选择“我想要提示”。

The Green Core begins with a lot of power, but loses power when touching some of the other cores, especially Orange. So you'll want it in a corner, where it's touching only {~} cores, and it shouldn't be touching Orange.
绿色核心一开始威力很高，但接触某些核心会损失威力，尤其是橙色核心。所以要把它放在角落，只接触 {~} 个核心，而且不要让它接触橙色核心。
That terrible wizard must have captured you in his spell when you did. It was terrible, it was- Such a hard look you had in your eyes...
你那时一定是被那个可怕的巫师用法术困住了。太可怕了，真的——你的眼神那么凶……
...I barely remember anything. Just...feelings of anger, and...disgust, I suppose, but... You wouldn't lie to me, Grand-Peli.
……我几乎什么都不记得了。只有……愤怒的感觉，还有……大概是厌恶吧，可是……Peli 爷爷，你不会骗我的。
...ugh. Disgusting. Utterly disgusting. I've had just about enough of your kind here. Humans...
……呃。恶心。简直恶心透顶。我受够你们这种人在这里晃了。人类……
Dreadfully drab, always getting in the way, wriggling through our province like worms! You're no heroes, you're pretenders!!
单调乏味，总是碍手碍脚，像虫子一样在我们行省里钻来钻去！你们才不是什么英雄，你们是冒牌货！！
Oh, you want through here? Well, I'm the gatekeeper. Let's call my toll...the abandonment of your ridiculous little heroics...and all your money besides. Sound fair?
噢，你想从这里过去？好啊，我是守门人。我来开个过路费……放弃你那可笑的英雄梦……外加你所有的钱。很公平吧？
Aha, Norsten my boy! We've been worried sick, it's been a week. What is it you're doing so far out into the canyon?
啊哈，Norsten 我的孩子！我们都担心死了，已经一个星期了。你跑到峡谷这么远的地方来干什么？
Wha- Who are you, and who gave you permission to use my toll road?! And can't you see I'm busy?
什——你是谁，谁准你走我的收费路了？！你没看到我正忙着吗？
Norsten?? Don't you recognize your own grandfather? What's that strange look in your eyes, what's this about a toll road?
Norsten？？你连自己的爷爷都认不出来了？你眼神怎么这么怪，还有什么收费路？
You're nothing to me at your age. I only care about what the young can do for me...and about the fee you're neglecting, you shriveled old fruit!
你这把年纪对我来说什么都不是。我只在乎年轻人能为我做什么……还有你想赖掉的过路费，你这颗干瘪的老果子！
What's gotten into you? Such a polite man, acting this way to your elders... Human, have you any idea what's-
你这是怎么了？你一向那么有礼貌，竟然这样对长辈……人类，你知不知道这是——
...oh no. Oh, say it isn't so, is that what's happening? Is it HIS fault?
……噢不。噢，千万别是真的，难道是那么回事？是他干的？
Up there, on the cliff- that tower! The scourge of the canyon...has he truly returned? Has he...taken my grandson?!
在那上面，悬崖上——那座塔！峡谷的祸害……他真的回来了？他……夺走了我的孙子？！
My reputation, even after all this time, still precedes me!! Indeed, old man, I have taken your grandson as my puppet!
这么多年过去了，我的名声还是走在我前面！！没错，老头，我把你孙子当成了我的傀儡！
What should I care about the facade? For a hundred and fifty years I've stolen the vitality of others to maintain my beauty, and your grandson will be no different.
我何必在乎伪装？一百五十年来，我一直偷取别人的活力来维持我的美貌，你孙子也不例外。
Miserable dastard!! Cold-water eel!! Human, you must help, you MUST! I beg you, please, seek the sorcerer and save my poor Norsten!!
可恶的恶棍！！冷水里的滑溜长虫！！人类，你一定要帮忙，一定要！我求求你，去找那个巫师，救救我可怜的 Norsten！！
The southwest mountains have a shortcut past the bandits, time is of the essence!
西南边的山里有条绕过强盗的捷径，时间紧迫！
A veritable army fell before my magic! The bandits pay their tribute to my grace and obey my orders! You're as mad as I am called if you think one human can get through.
一整支大军都倒在我的魔法之下！强盗们向我的风采进贡，听从我的命令！你要是以为一个人类就能闯过去，那你跟他们口中的我一样疯。
I'll leave you a corpse, a husk! A withered pile of dust- or perhaps I'll take YOU as a slave too, human! So what will it be? Run...or face me?
我会让你变成一具尸体，一副空壳！一堆枯萎的尘土——或者我也把你收作奴隶，人类！那么你选哪个？逃跑……还是面对我？
Go up the path to the wizard's tower, at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
沿着小路上去，前往 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的巫师之塔。
Hoho... The worm comes wriggling in, it seems. What a horrid thing you are. Mismatched armor, courage of a fool all over your face... Inelegant and UGLY!!
呵呵……看来虫子钻进来了。你真是个丑陋的东西。盔甲东拼西凑，满脸都是蠢货的勇气……不优雅又丑陋！！
At least the last ones to face me had some coordination, and the sense to hide themselves. Come further and you'll share their fate!!
至少上一批来对付我的人还懂得配合，也知道要躲起来。再往前走，你就会跟他们一样下场！！
You can never understand. The beauty of one like myself cannot be transient, it must be everlasting! I will never succumb to my mortality!
你永远不会懂。像我这样的美，不能是短暂的，必须是永恒的！我绝不会屈服于死亡！
As a matter of fact...you humans ARE good for one thing. Drab as you are, you're lively. So consider this an honor!
说真的……你们人类确实有一个用处。虽然单调，但你们很有活力。所以就当这是你的荣幸吧！
HAAAAAhahahaha!! Instead of destruction, I'll leave you trapped in this illusion, and chip away at your ugly mind until nothing remains. You'll join the rest who've prolonged my life!
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！！我不毁掉你，而是把你困在这个幻象里，一点一点削掉你那丑陋的心智，直到什么都不剩。你会加入那些替我延长寿命的人！
I'll take pleasure in peeling away your most formative memories first- W-wait, what's this giant blank spot? It's interfering with my spell...!!
我要先慢慢剥掉你最重要的那些记忆——等、等等，这一大片空白是怎么回事？它在干扰我的法术……！！
Ugh, barely any memories to remove, hardly any personality... How much of a dull gray slate are you...and how is that making this more difficult?!
呃，几乎没有记忆可以删，也几乎没有个性……你到底是块多么无聊的灰白石板……而且为什么这样反而更难搞？！
Run away and confront the wizard.
逃离，然后去找巫师对质。
You escaped?! ...hmph. I suppose that trick works better for binding a platoon than a person. When you only need to focus on what YOU see...rrgh.
你逃出来了？！……哼。我想那一招拿来困住一整队人比对付一个人有用。只需要专注于自己看到的东西时……呃啊。
Fine...you've forced my hand. I must sweep you aside, you so-called hero! Never darken my door again! Cease to exist!!
好吧……是你逼我的。我必须把你扫到一边，你这所谓的英雄！永远别再踏进我的门！消失吧！！
Ugh, what was it that raisin of a man said- Miserable runt?! Cold-water eel?! More fitting names for you than me!!
呃，那个葡萄干一样的老头是怎么说的——可恶的小矮子？！冷水里的滑溜长虫？！这些名字更适合你，而不是我！！
It's been so long since I've faced a threat, and now that you're here- RRGH! How could a HUMAN get the best of me?
我已经好久没遇到威胁了，而现在你来了——呃啊！一个人类怎么可能打败我？
Me, who holds control over every bandit in the canyon...! How dare you embarrass me so!
我，掌控着峡谷里每一个强盗的人……！你竟敢这样羞辱我！
Well, fine. You've got me dead to rights. I'll give up the blasted binding gem. Who knows if most of the bandits will return to normal, after so long...
好吧，行。你抓到我的把柄了。我交出那颗该死的束缚宝石。过了这么久，谁知道大部分强盗还能不能恢复正常……
...but Norsten? He'll barely be affected. Bring it to him and he'll be freed, loath as I am to let him go.
……不过 Norsten？他几乎不会受影响。把宝石带给他，他就会获得自由，虽然我很不情愿放他走。
Those souls are mine to control, you hear me? Mine to bind!! Mine to drain dry of vitality!! Mine to OWN!! HehehaHAAAAA!!
那些灵魂是我的，由我控制，听到了吗？由我束缚！！由我吸干活力！！归我所有！！嘿嘿哈哈哈哈哈！！
And if you jump in after it? You'll be truly trapped- a dimension of my own making, filled with volatile magical waste! You'll never be seen again!
如果你跟着跳进去？你就真的被困住了——那是我亲手打造的维度，里面满是不稳定的魔法废料！你再也不会被人看到了！
Find a way out of the strange dimension.
找路离开这个奇怪的维度。
H-how did you survive? How did you get OUT?! That pocket dimension has a one-way entrance!! I- You- I'LL DRAIN AWAY NORSTEN BEFORE YOUR VERY EYES!!
你、你怎么活下来的？你怎么出来的？！那个口袋维度只能进不能出！！我——你——我要当着你的面把 Norsten 吸干！！
The scourge is angry!! Human, quickly, for him to be this upset you must have found something! Save my grandson, please!!
祸害发火了！！人类，快，他气成这样，你一定找到了什么！拜托救救我的孙子！！
I'LL FLING YOU TO THE ENDS OF THE CANYON!! FILTHY HUMAN, LOWLY WORM NOT FIT TO BE DUST-
我要把你甩到峡谷的尽头！！肮脏的人类，连尘土都不配当的低贱虫子——
Aguh...w-where am I? My...my throat hurts...was I screaming?
呃……我、我在哪？我的……我的喉咙好痛……我刚才在尖叫吗？
Oh, my poor grandson...my little Norsten is back to us! Oh, joyous day!!
哦，我可怜的孙子……我的小 Norsten 回来了！哦，真是大喜的日子！！
Back to...did something happen? I remember coming this way after a thief...and then...
回来……发生什么事了吗？我记得我追一个小偷追到这边……然后……
But this human, this hero... They have bested the scourge of the canyon! They managed to save you from such evil!
可是这个人类，这位英雄……他们打败了峡谷的祸害！他们把你从那样的邪恶手里救了出来！
Thank you, human- Hm, what's all this money doing in my pockets? I didn't bring my pouch out with me to chase the thief, but...! So much money!
谢谢你，人类——嗯？我口袋里怎么有这么多钱？我追小偷的时候没带钱袋出来啊，可是……！这么多钱！
Ill-gotten gains from the scourge's sham of a toll-road scheme, no doubt. I think the human could put that money to fine use, what say you, my boy?
肯定是那个祸害靠假收费路骗来的不义之财。我想这位人类能好好利用这些钱，你说呢，我的孩子？
Of course! Here. And don't worry about the gate. It's supposed to be open for anyone, so use it as you like.
当然！给你。还有别担心那道门。它本来就应该对所有人开放，你想怎么用都行。
[Right Click] with the shard to change what is real and what is fake.
拿着碎片 [右键点击]，改变什么是真、什么是假。
What? Since when do I need to show papers to get in?
什么？什么时候开始进城要出示文件了？
...Yep. Silly me. Always forgetting my papers.
……对。瞧我这记性。老是忘带文件。
This looks to be a religious altar. It depicts some sort of moth or butterfly.
这看起来是一座宗教祭坛。上面描绘着某种飞蛾或蝴蝶。
Record #{~} - Eviction of family house has been completed.
记录 #{~} - 住宅驱逐行动已完成。
Operation took approximately {~} minutes. Guards will remain at the site for further preperations.
行动耗时约 {~} 分钟。守卫将留在现场进行后续准备。
No reports seem to mention you.
这些报告里似乎都没有提到你。
The festival travels through every part of Fruma, and Her Majesty travels with it.
庆典会巡游 Fruma 的每一个角落，女王陛下也随之同行。
There doesn't seem to be much of use in this book...
这本书里好像没什么有用的东西……
Some of the weapons radiate a weak magical energy.
其中几件武器散发着微弱的魔法能量。
It's a long way down... probably shouldn't jump.
You keep calling me cursed. What does it mean?
你一直说我是受诅者。那是什么意思？
What do you do around here?
What were you getting from Nixeph?
你去 Nixeph 是要拿什么？
Is this everyone? I thought the resistance would be bigger.
就这些人吗？我还以为抵抗组织的规模会更大。
你对 Zeph 有什么看法？
Did I do something? What's your problem with me?
我做了什么吗？你对我到底有什么意见？
The frog! The frog! *hic* I seen 'im! I did!
青蛙！那只青蛙！*嗝*我看见他了！真看见了！
Ech... You young'uns never believe it... Let me tell yer my story...
唉……你们这些年轻人就是不信……让我给你讲讲我的故事……
For donkey's years they've said that there's a big frog in the bog... And he eats people...

I think we're getting onto something! Let's keep going.
我觉得我们有眉目了！继续走吧。
Follow the clue: The airship commanders love what they hate.
跟着线索走: 飞艇指挥官们爱着他们所恨之物。
Hmmm... These crates are full of items. Maybe we could give some of them to the commanders?
嗯……这些箱子里装满了物品。也许我们可以拿一些给指挥官？
Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
一旦撕裂，便永远无法修复。
Oh, let's keep going! Where can we go with that lead?
哦，我们继续走吧！这条线索能带我们去哪？
Follow the clue: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
跟着线索走: 一旦撕裂，便永远无法修复。
Who's that on top of that platform?!
那个站在平台上面的是谁？！
The two of you have come real far for this, huh?
你们两个为了这个走了好远，是吧？
Well, I can give you the answer to the stout and beer question! But you won't enter the Market just with that.
嗯，黑啤和啤酒那个问题的答案我可以告诉你们！不过光靠这个是进不了黑市的。
You see, to enter the Market you'll need something to sell! And it won't be something you can exactly buy around here, if you get what I mean.
你们看，要进黑市，你们得有东西卖！而且可不是能在这附近随便买到的东西，懂我意思吧。
Exactly! Luckily for you, I'm in a good mood. There's an airship docked close by. We'll be able to take it and I can help you get an item.
没错！算你们走运，我今天心情好。附近停着一艘飞艇。我们可以把它开走，我能帮你们弄到一件货。
Uh... What do you think, {u}? I really need that passport, and well...you could get something out of this too, right?
呃……你觉得呢，{u}？我真的很需要那本护照，而且……你也能从中捞到点好处，对吧？
Protect me while I harvest the egg, soldier!
我取蛋的时候保护好我，士兵！
Great! Follow me, it's not far.
Wait! There are guards protecting the airship. Don't let them see you!
等等！有守卫在看守飞艇。别让他们看到你！
They're near the edge... Push them off.
他们站在边缘附近……把他们推下去。
Uhh... I'm sure they're fine, I'm sure that fall wasn't too big...
呃……我相信他们没事的，我相信那一下摔得不算太高……
Well, that's your only way inside! There are more guards up ahead. Take care of them without being seen, and we'll be in the clear!
好了，这是唯一进去的路！前面还有更多守卫。不被发现地解决他们，我们就安全了！
Well done! Let's get on the airship.
Did you just... Push them all...?
你刚才是……把他们全推下去了……？
Buckle up! We're heading to the {p}, there we'll be able to collect some dragonling eggs for you to sell at the Black Market!
系好安全带！我们要去 {p}，在那里可以收集一些幼龙蛋，让你们拿去黑市卖！
Travel with the Mechanic and Doan to the {p} to get the Dragonling Egg.
与机械师和 Doan 一起前往 {p} 取得幼龙蛋。
The island we're heading to is home to a Dragonling nest! They use it to lay their eggs, as it's quite a difficult place to access.
我们要去的岛上有个幼龙巢！那里很难抵达，所以它们会在那里产卵。
And those'll be worth a lot in the Black Market, right...?
那些蛋在黑市能卖很多钱，对吧……？
They sure will! Dragonling eggs are rare, and this island can only be accessed by airship... They're worth a fortune back at Letvus.
那当然！幼龙蛋很稀有，而且这座岛只有搭飞艇才去得了……在 Letvus 可是值一大笔钱。
Oh, there it is! I can see the island from here, buckle up. We've got some eggs to steal!
噢，就在那里！我从这里就看得到那座岛了，系好安全带。我们要去偷蛋了！
What's that?! Oh... It looks like we've got company...
那是什么？！哦……看来有不速之客……
Drat, the skyraiders are here! We can't let them get away with those eggs...
可恶，天空劫掠者来了！不能让他们带着那些蛋跑掉……
Well, if that's the case, then there's only one thing to do! Come on, follow me!
好吧，既然这样，那就只有一件事能做了！快，跟我来！
We can't get to the nest with so many pirates on the way, kill them!
路上有这么多海盗，我们到不了巢穴，杀了他们！
Alright, follow me! Let's go harvest that egg!
好，跟我来！去把那颗蛋弄到手！
Protect me while I harvest the egg, human!
我取蛋的时候保护好我，人类！
We're halfway there, just keep defending me!
已经完成一半了，继续保护我！
There we go! Let's get back to the airship, run!
搞定了！回飞艇上去，快跑！
Don't let them get away! Fire the cannons!!
Soldier, don't let them hit us! Attack the cannonballs using your weapon before they hit our airship to deflect them!
士兵，别让他们打中我们！在炮弹打中飞艇之前，用你的武器攻击它们把它们弹开！
We can't take more cannon shots... We're wasting our time, let's get going! We got bigger fish to fry!
我们挨不住更多炮击了……别浪费时间了，走吧！我们还有更大的鱼要抓！
That was close... Well then, let's head back to the airbase!
好险……那么，我们回航空基地吧！
Go back to the bar at the Blackbird Inn with Doan.
与 Doan 一起回到黑鸟旅店的酒吧。
The two of you have certainly proven yourselves today!
你们两个今天确实证明了自己！
So, I'll give you the password to enter the Black Market.
所以，我会告诉你们进入黑市的暗号。
Go back to the Barman at the Inn and tell him 'I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.'
回旅店找酒保，跟他说：“我不渴，我总是随身带着一瓶。”
That might just give you the chance you need to get in. Good luck!
这样你们也许就有机会进去了。祝你们好运！
Thank you for your help, sir... Let's go back to the bar, then.
谢谢你的帮忙，先生……那我们回酒吧吧。
Here we are again. Let's talk to the Barman.
我们又回来了。去跟酒保说话吧。
Um, sir? I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.
呃，先生？我不渴，我总是随身带着一瓶。
...Well, hey there... Would you like to buy some... potions?
Well, hello there! You like you could use some of my fine wares, yes!
哎呀，你好啊！看你的样子，正需要我这些上等好货，没错吧！
A dragonling egg? I'd pay {~} emeralds for it.
幼龙蛋？我愿意出 {~} 绿宝石买下它。
So that's our initial bid. Now we need to ask for a higher bid, remember? We can't always talk to the same merchant or they'll lose interest...
这就是我们的起价了。接下来得找人出更高的价，记得吗？我们不能老找同一个商人，不然他们会失去兴趣……
And we can't talk to more than {~} people for a raise or they might get angry.
而且我们最多只能找 {~} 个人加价，不然他们可能会生气。
Well! We really don't see many dragonling eggs around here, not at all!! I'll give you {~} emeralds for it, how does that sound?!
哎呀！这一带可真见不到几颗幼龙蛋，少得很！！我出 {~} 绿宝石买下它，怎么样？！
Fine! I'll raise my price to {~} emeralds. But if this egg isn't mine now? Don't bother coming back.
行！我把价格加到 {~} 绿宝石。但这颗蛋要是现在还不归我？那你就别再回来了。
Remember what the passport seller said? We shouldn't always talk to the same merchant... I think this one won't like another price raise. We should talk to the others.
还记得卖护照的那个人怎么说的吗？我们不该老找同一个商人……我看这一位不会乐意再加价了。我们去找其他人谈吧。
An egg, eh... I'd pay you... {~} emeralds, for it.
一颗蛋啊……我愿意付你……{~} 绿宝石。
Another price hike?! I'm not interested anymore. Scram.
又要加价？！我没兴趣了。滚。
Is that a dragonling egg I spot? For a rare item such as that, I would of course be willing to pay {~} emeralds for it!
我看到的那是幼龙蛋吗？这么稀有的东西，我当然愿意出 {~} 绿宝石买下它！
He appears to be rummaging through his documents.
他好像正在翻找他的文件。
We have to get to {~} emeralds in {~} bid increases. Let's try again!
我们得凑到 {~} 绿宝石，而且只能加价 {~} 次。再试一次吧！
You should try to increase the price with another merchant before going back to your previous one.
回头找上一个商人之前，你应该先找另一个商人加价。
Oh, you're bold, I'll give you that! Asking for another price increase?! Fine!! I'll raise my price to {~} emeralds!
哦，你胆子不小，这点我承认！还想再加价？！行！！我把价格加到 {~} 绿宝石！
I'll raise that price to... {~} emeralds.
我把价格加到……{~} 绿宝石。
...might not be my business to ask, but what's a human got business at a villager airship customs office for?
……也许轮不到我过问，不过一个人类跑到村民的飞艇海关办事处来干什么？
Talk only to the Black Market member in the end of the hallway and do not talk to anyone else.
只跟走廊尽头的黑市成员说话，别跟其他任何人交谈。
Enter the Black Market and talk to the Member at the end of the hallway.
进入黑市，与走廊尽头的成员交谈。
I've heard you've stolen some eggs from the Skyraiders. That's a bold move!
听说你们从天空劫掠者那里偷了一些蛋。真是大胆！
Two passports? I'd say that's around {~} emeralds. You can get that selling this egg on the market.
两本护照？我看大概要 {~} 绿宝石。在市场上卖掉这颗蛋就能凑到。
Let me fill you in how the market works. You'll get a low starting price for your egg, and then you'll have to go around the merchants asking for a higher bid.
让我跟你们说说这个市场怎么运作。你们的蛋一开始价格会很低，然后你们得到处找商人要求出更高的价。
Be careful, though, as you can only ask for {~} price increases.
不过要小心，你们只能要求加价 {~} 次。
You can try talking to different merchants, and see how much each increases the price of the egg.
你们可以试着跟不同的商人谈，看看每个人会把蛋的价格加多少。
Good luck, and do try not to get killed.
祝你们好运，尽量别被杀了。
Talk to the Merchants and try to get {~} emeralds to buy a passport.
与商人们交谈，想办法凑到 {~} 绿宝石买护照。
That's what we need, {u}. Sold! The egg is yours.
这就是我们需要的数目，{u}。成交！蛋归你了。
Here, you can have your emeralds.
Talk to the Black Market Member again.
So do you have the emeralds?
Hmm... This will do it. Here, your passports.
嗯……这样就行了。来，你们的护照。
Uhh.. {u}, I think you dropped your passport. Let me get it for yo-...
呃……{u}，我想你的护照掉了。我帮你捡——
Wait... That's MY passport?! It was in my pocket all along...
等等……这是我的护照？！它一直都在我口袋里……
Well, uhhh... I guess you can have some of these emeralds, then...
那个，呃……那这些绿宝石就分你一些吧……
For the safety of the citizens, these doors shall remain shut until the criminal is captured.
为了居民的安全，在抓到犯人之前，这些门都会保持关闭。
This is utterly inane. A full lockdown, over a petty theft... Are we not to help one another? To thieve is unnecessary.
这简直疯了。为了一件小偷小摸就全面封锁……我们不是该互相帮助吗？偷窃根本没有必要。
The plant has been disturbed- Looks like it was knocked over.
这株植物被动过——看起来是被撞倒的。
It's missing a few leaves- Many of them are scattered around the area.
少了几片叶子——很多都散落在这附近。
There seem to be some footprints leading away... It would probably be best to ask about the plant.
好像有一些脚印往外延伸……最好还是去问问这株植物的事。
I pray to the Light that you are able to help before the situation degrades further.
我向光明祈祷，希望你能在情况继续恶化之前帮上忙。
This book describes a potion of enhanced vision.
这本书描述了一种强化视觉的药水。
...why are so many of the pages ripped out?
……为什么这么多页都被撕掉了？
See me as I truly am- My name is Korben, and I mustn't be delayed further!
看清我的真面目吧——我叫 Korben，我不能再被耽搁了！
Maybe there's another way to the window...
也许还有别的路能通到那扇窗……
You should probably investigate the collapsed bridge to see where Korben went.
你应该去查看那座塌掉的桥，看看 Korben 去了哪里。
You may come and go as you wish to {p} Town. We shall open the doors for you.
你可以自由进出 {p} 镇。我们会为你开门。
Hey! Please come talk to me.
Have you ever heard the saying "Elves never die"- well it's true, or so I thought.
你听过「精灵不会死」这句话吗？那是真的——至少我以前是这么以为的。
Talk to the Elf Guard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Halt, traveler! Entry to {p} Town is forbidden at present.
站住，旅人！{p} 镇目前禁止进入。
There is a dangerous criminal on the loose in this valley.
这座山谷里有个危险的罪犯逍遥法外。
These doors shall remain closed until the criminal is captured.
在抓到罪犯之前，这些门都会一直关着。
See if anyone in {p} Valley knows what happened
看看 {p} 谷里有没有人知道发生了什么事
An outsider in our midst? Exciting to see. I have wished to share our magic with new people for a long while.
外人来到我们之中？真令人兴奋。我一直很想把我们的魔法分享给新的人。
However, I am...well, rather hungry. And I must tend to my garden here for the time being.
不过，我……嗯，相当饿。而且我暂时得照料这里的花园。
Have you heard the saying “You scratch my ears, I scratch yours”? People must help one another.
你听过“你挠我耳朵，我挠你耳朵”这句话吗？人与人之间应该互相帮助。
If you would be so kind as to bring me a loaf of fresh bread you may take my enchanted bucket.
如果你愿意好心给我带一条新鲜面包来，我的魔法桶就可以给你。
I saw you toil to bake this yourself. Frankly, that is above and beyond what I expected, so here is your exchange.
我看到你辛辛苦苦亲手烤了面包。说实话，这远远超出我的期望，所以这是给你的交换。
If you require help in the future with anything, do not be afraid to ask. If you put such effort for me, I shall give you the same.
以后有任何需要帮忙的地方，别怕开口。你为我付出这样的心力，我也会同样回报你。
Find a use for Damys' Bucket
为 Damys 的桶找个用途
The thieving is not the reason, from what I have heard. It is that the grove was jealously hidden due to the potency of the plants there.
据我所知，不是因为偷窃。而是因为那片林地里的植物药效太强，一直被刻意藏起来。
Tattytale, Iridesca, Subtraxerim... The Light only knows what else. It is impossible to reach without unusual means- And that is cause for grave concern.
Tattytale、Iridesca、Subtraxerim……天知道还有什么。不用特殊手段根本到不了那里——而这正是令人严重担忧的地方。
Find a way to grow the plant by the waterfall
想办法让瀑布旁的植物长大
Halt! This area is strictly off limits, especially for an outsider. Turn back now!
站住！这里严禁进入，外人更是不行。马上回头！
Aha, the outsider returns. Is there something troubling you?
啊哈，外人回来了。有什么烦心事吗？
...mmm. Unfortunate, that. I cannot help with this.
……嗯。真不巧。这件事我帮不上忙。
It is not a matter of secrecy or morals- I simply do not know what that leaf is from or what it may be capable of.
这无关保密或道德——我只是不知道那片叶子来自什么植物，也不知道它有什么作用。
I am no botanist- Simply a gardener. The mistake is understandable, if regrettable.
我不是植物学家——只是个园丁。搞错也情有可原，虽然很遗憾。
However, I was taught under a much more storied botanist who may have the answers you seek.
不过，我曾经跟一位更有名望的植物学家学习过，她也许有你要的答案。
Her name is Fiona- Her home is across the valley from here. Take the bridge across. She often stays inside studying.
她叫 Fiona——她家在山谷对面。过桥就到了。她常常待在屋里做研究。
She has forgotten more than I will ever hope to know about plants. If she cannot help you, I fear none can.
她忘掉的植物知识都比我这辈子能学到的还多。如果连她都帮不了你，恐怕就没人帮得了了。
Go to the botanist's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
This is outrageous! To think one of our own would stoop to such thievery and destruction!
太过分了！真没想到我们自己人会堕落到这样偷窃破坏！
Outsider, this is not the time to be asking me anything. My home has been ransacked!
外人，现在不是问我事情的时候。我家被洗劫了！
Mm? Damys sent you... You have leaves of Iridesca? Hm... Then perhaps we may be able to help one another.
嗯？Damys 叫你来的……你有 Iridesca 的叶子？嗯……那也许我们可以互相帮助。
They tore through my shelves and furniture searching, and scanned the pages as fervently once they found it.
他翻遍了我的书架和家具，找到之后又那么急切地翻看书页。
Afterwards, they threw the book into the back garden, and forced a carnivorous plant to grow and consume my notes!
后来，他把书扔进后花园，还硬让一株食肉植物长出来，把我的笔记吞掉了！
I assume when the desired information was found, they went into my garden, threw the book into the carnivorous plant and stormed off towards the lab.
我猜他找到想要的情报之后，就去了我的花园，把书扔进食肉植物里，然后气冲冲地往实验室去了。
I have researched the Iridesca bloom, and many other plants, for a long time. All my knowledge is stored in that book!
我研究 Iridesca 花和很多其他植物很久了。我所有的知识都记在那本书里！
Retrieve it for me, and I will share my knowledge with you.
帮我把它拿回来，我就把我的知识分享给你。
Kill the carnivorous plant and loot the book
杀死食肉植物，拿回那本书
...disgusting. I will have to hang the pages to dry later, but first, our exchange.
……恶心。书页我得之后再晾干，不过先来完成我们的交换。
Hmm... Herbstzeitlose... Death Whistle, no...where is Iridesca, again...?
嗯……Herbstzeitlose……死亡哨草，不对……Iridesca 在哪来着……？
Aha, there it is. The pages were sticking together. Iridesca leaves are potent in various ways and are very versatile in their use.
啊哈，在这里。书页都粘在一起了。Iridesca 叶子有多种强效作用，用途非常广泛。
They have an incredibly broad range of usage, from soothing joint pain or curing sickness to emetic effect and lethal poison, depending on what it is brewed with.
它们的用途极其广泛，从缓解关节疼痛、治疗疾病，到催吐和致命毒药，全看它跟什么一起调制。
Mm? The book thief also possesses Iridesca...? This... This is very troubling. There are few notes aside from mine on how to heal Iridesca poisoning.
嗯？偷书贼也有 Iridesca……？这……这非常令人不安。除了我的笔记之外，关于怎么治疗 Iridesca 中毒的记载少之又少。
They were headed in the direction of the potionmaker's guild. If they intend something wicked...
他朝药剂师公会的方向去了。如果他打算做什么坏事……
..you! You have been seeking me! I have seen you tracing my footsteps...
……你！你一直在找我！我看到你一路追着我的脚步……
I apologize for this... But what I do is a necessity!
对此我很抱歉……但我做的事是必要的！
I beg you, do not pursue me any further!
Outsider, I realize the circumstances appear damning, but you must stop!
外人，我知道现在的情况对我很不利，但你必须停下！
What I have done is needed, and if there were another path I would have taken it over this.
我做的事是必须的，如果有别的路可走，我一定不会选这条。
I must take my concoction to where it is needed!
我必须把我的药剂送到需要它的地方！
G R O W! (In High Gavellian)
长 大 吧！(高等 Gavel 语)
A damnable pace you have... I cannot let you stop me for a moment longer!
你的速度真是该死的快……我不能再让你拦我一刻！
It will be done soon, but I must reach my destination first!
很快就好了，但我得先赶到目的地！
Finally... I apologize for the delay. I needed to take strong measures to get this to you.
终于……抱歉耽搁了。为了把这个带给你，我不得不采取强硬手段。
Here, here... Drink, father. It will clear your throat.
来，来……喝吧，父亲。它会让你的喉咙舒服些。
...there. It is done. Now... Outsider... Hear me, please.
……好了。完成了。现在……外人……请听我说。
I am aware of exactly what I have done. Shredded Fiona’s research, disturbed the forbidden gardens, unsettled the hearts of many...
我很清楚自己做了什么。撕毁了 Fiona 的研究，惊扰了禁忌花园，让许多人心神不宁……
My father fell ill. A trek to {p}’s borders left him stricken with Kerasot poisoning. He was near death...
我父亲病倒了。去了一趟 {p} 的边境，他就中了 Kerasot 毒。他差点就死了……
{p}’s village is one of outcasts- to visit is, stupidly, forbidden. He would have been exiled, and that would have ensured his death with his affliction.
{p} 的村子是被放逐者的村子——去那里拜访是被禁止的，真是愚蠢。他会被放逐，而以他的病情，那就等于判了他死刑。
