...hmh! Can respect. Strong in mind if able to learn.
……哼！可以尊重。能学习，就是心智强。
Will stay for while in case Ressinter need medicine more.
会待一阵子，以防 Ressinter 还需要药。
Sorry to put human up to task sudden, but now more orc trust you.
抱歉突然让人类做事，但现在更多兽人信任你。
Since orc trust...maybe can talk to Arrai-Veretel now. Follow.
既然兽人信任……也许现在可以跟 Arrai-Veretel 谈。跟上。
No! Lomoster okay! Ressinter not okay- Wait. Ressinter sort of okay! Need rest still!
不！Lomoster 没事！Ressinter 有事——等等。Ressinter 算没事！还要休息！
But Lomoster at cannon when explode!
但大炮爆炸时 Lomoster 在旁边！
Lomoster wear armor. Armor took hurt, Lomoster okay!
Lomoster 穿盔甲。盔甲挡了伤，Lomoster 没事！
……嗯……好吧……等等，人类为什么在这？
Human heal Ressinter. See? Human good healer!
人类治好 Ressinter。看？人类是好医者！
I don't believe it. How did-
Gwuh, yes! Stop shouting! I- Whuh...
Ressinter 已经没事！Bitteliso 说谎？！
Wait, Ressinter okay? How did- HUMAN?! WHY HUMAN IN CAMP?!
等等，Ressinter 没事？怎么会——人类？！人类为什么在营地？！
Human heal Ressinter! Not know how, but human save Ressinter life!
人类治好 Ressinter！不知道怎么做到，但人类救了 Ressinter 的命！
Told Bitteliso. Human learning! Save life of orc, even though idiot Villager say kill.
跟 Bitteliso 说过。人类在学！救兽人的命，就算笨蛋村民说要杀。
...how. How. HOW! How human so good at healing?! Why human help?
……怎么。怎么。怎么！人类怎么这么会治？！人类为什么帮忙？
Can trust human. Human try unlearn bad villager teach.
可以信任人类。人类在试着忘掉坏村民教的。
...fine. Good human, not stupid human. Bitteliso sorry for beating. Here.
……好吧。好人类，不是蠢人类。Bitteliso 为打你道歉。给。
Shouldn't we get back to what we were doing?
我们不是该回去做刚才的事了吗？
...will stay in case Ressinter need help.
……会待着，以防 Ressinter 需要帮忙。
Ressinter not old man! No need sitter!
Ressinter 不是老头！不需要看护！
Not know that human actually good at heal! Very good! Healer, not hunter. More orc trust you now.
不知道人类真的会治！非常会！是医者，不是猎人。现在更多兽人信任你。
Since orc trust...maybe can talk to Arrai-Veretel now. Follow!
既然兽人信任……也许现在可以跟 Arrai-Veretel 谈。跟上！
Follow Zuett through the Orcish Fortress
跟着 Zuett 穿过兽人堡垒
No enter! Much camp see human heal, but still no trust human!
不准进！很多营地看到人类治疗，但还是不信任人类！
Ureietun! Human help save Ressinter life! Why no trust?
Ureietun！人类救了 Ressinter 的命！为什么不信任？
Human being led by you. Human led by villager too! Teach good thing, yes, but what if human just copying?
人类被你带着走。人类也被村民带着走！教好事，是，但要是人类只是在模仿呢？
Human can earn trust alone! Zuett, stay in Arrai-room.
人类可以自己赢得信任！Zuett，待在 Arrai 房间。
RRRRRGH! STUPID ZUETT! WAR HAPPEN FOR REASON! GO AWAY!
呃啊啊啊啊！蠢 ZUETT！战争发生有原因！走开！
...can trust human not kill. Human can walk around Centerworld. But human no see Arrai-Veretel!
……可以信任人类不会杀。人类可以在 Centerworld 走动。但人类不能见 Arrai-Veretel！
Ask various orcs if they need any help at the Orcish Fortress at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的兽人堡垒询问各个兽人是否需要帮忙。
Hm! Human, hunter, healer, halfwit soldier. Many things! Human also runner?
嗯！人类，猎人，医者，半吊子士兵。好多身份！人类也是跑者？
Peloros from Holehold. Camp home to messengers and runners. Have thing to deliver to Fruludir in green tower.
Peloros 来自 Holehold。那营地是信使和跑者的家。有东西要送给绿塔里的 Fruludir。
Then human run fast to green tower- deliver in {~} seconds! Or else come back. Not urgent delivery, so delay fine.
那人类快跑去绿塔——{~} 秒内送到！不然就回来。不是急件，晚点也没关系。
Will know human delivered in time. How? Human will see if run fast!
会知道人类有没有准时送到。怎么知道？人类跑得快就会看到！
RGH! Can understand just fine, just not speak as good! No mock us!
呃啊！听得懂，只是说不好！不准嘲笑我们！
Hm! Human have Peloros box. Peloros give human run training. Give here.
嗯！人类拿着 Peloros 的箱子。Peloros 给人类跑步训练。给我。
More than Zuett with human? Good sign. Maybe fighting stop soon.
跟人类一起的不只 Zuett？好兆头。也许很快就不打仗了。
Patience, human. Box full of signal flare. Will light one to show Peloros human got here in time.
耐心点，人类。箱子里装满信号烟火。会点一个，让 Peloros 知道人类准时到。
Saw the firework. Human did well, finishing single morning exercise!
看到烟火了。人类做得好，完成一次晨练！
Orc do much training to stay strong. Orc runners must be fast and not tire to become Marathon!
兽人要做很多训练才能保持强壮。兽人跑者一定要快、不会累，才能成为马拉松！
Here. Human take. Train harder. Maybe visit Holehold- also place for relax, not just run. Stamina good for all.
给。人类拿去。更努力训练。也许去 Holehold 看看——也是放松的地方，不只是跑步。耐力对大家都好。
Oh. Human who help Ressinter. You are strange. Not like other human at all.
噢。帮了 Ressinter 的人类。你很奇怪。一点都不像别的人类。
This? This food storage. Mostly for meats and roots. Though, large ritual happening soon.
这个？这是食物仓库。主要放肉和根茎。不过，很快会有大型仪式。
Festival with Earthpit. Will be coming soon- so stocking up food for that.
Earthpit 的节庆。快到了——所以在为那个储备食物。
...human look like want help. You...really are strange. I suppose...if you want help with food, could do some fishing.
……人类看起来想帮忙。你……真的很奇怪。我想……如果你想帮忙准备食物，可以去钓点鱼。
Won't ask human to do everything- just [{~} Carp Meat] enough to help. Though, could bring more if wanted.
不会要人类全包——只要够帮忙的 [{~} 鲤鱼肉]。不过，想多带也可以。
If want bring more than {~}, will accept more than {~}.
如果想带超过 {~} 条，超过 {~} 条也会收下。
Mhm, mhm. You are strange human, but not bad human. This enough meat.
嗯，嗯。你是奇怪的人类，但不是坏人类。这些肉够了。
Festival will still be long time away, but here. Since human help, you get reward. Only fair.
节庆还要很久，不过，给你。人类帮了忙，就该有报酬。这才公平。
Oh, you brought more fish than asked. Twice as much as asked!
哦，你带的鱼比要的多。是要的两倍！
You are good human. Strange, but not bad. Willing to put in extra effort.
你是好人类。奇怪，但不坏。愿意多出一份力。
Here- will also share some meat that won't be for festival. Other rewards too.
给——也分你一些不是节庆用的肉。还有别的报酬。
...that is...much fish. You heard me when I said five, right?
……这……好多鱼。你有听到我说五条吧？
Four times as much as fair share. Why human like this?
公平份量的四倍。人类为什么会这样？
Humans are supposed to be selfish. Listen to villager and kill orc. But you are not like that at all.
人类应该很自私。听村民的话去杀兽人。但你完全不是那样。
Then here- Will share extra meat. Not for festival, but still good. Other thing too. Thank you very much, human.
那给——分你额外的肉。不是节庆用的，但还是好肉。还有别的东西。非常谢谢你，人类。
Said five. You have thirty. I...how and why.
说五条。你有三十条。我……怎么会，为什么。
You just did work of six orc. You are...overachieving human. But that is not bad thing!
你刚做了六个兽人的工作。你是……超额完成的人类。但那不是坏事！
Here, then. This meat not for festival, but you deserve hearty meal for all effort!
那给。这肉不是节庆用的，但你付出这么多，值得吃顿丰盛的饭！
That much fish actually meet quota! Thank you so much, strange, kind human!
这么多鱼真的达到配额了！太谢谢你了，奇怪又善良的人类！
Human OFFERING help- Hmh! Very good human! Task simple. Southeast of fort, past ridge, Teiren old camp.
人类主动要帮忙——哼！非常好的人类！任务简单。堡垒东南边，过了山脊，是 Teiren 的旧营地。
Used to live, but left because Freelancer jump down from mountain. Forgot important thing there!
以前住那里，但因为 Freelancer 从山上跳下来就走了。忘了重要的东西在那！
Need stay here, make sure stupid Peloros no run into firepit. Has done before. So, you go get!
要留在这里，确保蠢 Peloros 不会跑进火坑。以前跑进去过。所以，你去拿！
Oi, oi! Y'oughta gimme 'at back right now, li'l lady!
喂，喂！你最好马上把那个还给我，小姑娘！
Absolutely NOT, you craven wind spirit! This belongs to me now!
绝对不要，你这懦弱的风灵！这现在是我的了！
Nonsense! This camp was built by those who respected the earth and its bounties. Now that its inhabitants have left, nature is free to reclaim it, as is right!
胡说八道！这营地是由尊重大地与其恩赐的人建的。现在住民都走了，大自然就可以把它收回来，这才是正理！
Aw yeah? Issat it? You're a peach, gal, but I'll clip those petals, you don't give it up right now!
噢是吗？就这样？你是个可人儿，姑娘，但你要是不马上交出来，我就剪了你的花瓣！
What a brutish lout you are, threatening an embodiment of nature! I won't give this up without a fight!
你这粗鲁的无赖，竟敢威胁大自然的化身！我不会不战而降的！
...hm? And who might you be? What brings a human to this disused place?
……嗯？你又是谁？什么风把一个人类吹到这个荒废的地方？
Oh no, you want this too?! I have claimed it for my own! Leave me be, go! Get out of here!
哦不，你也想要这个？！我已经宣告它是我的了！别来烦我，走！离开这里！
Shouldn'ta crossed me, doll! Remember who spreads your pollen next time, huh?! Now to just take this back up the mountain...
你不该惹我的，宝贝！下次记住是谁帮你传花粉的，嗯？！现在只要把这东西带回山上……
OI! Who's THIS joker now? You lookin' ta empty your wallet for me or something?
喂！这又是哪来的小丑？你是想把钱包倒空给我还是怎样？
What, you want this thing too?! It's mine, y'hear? MINE! You can't have it!
什么，你也想要这东西？！这是我的，听到没？我的！你拿不走！
Human! Was right to send out. Peloros fall over chair and almost burn! Did find thing? Very distinctive, only thing left at camp.
人类！派你去是对的。Peloros 从椅子上摔下来，差点烧起来！找到东西了吗？很有特色，营地只剩那一样东西。
Hmhm!! Yes! This what looking for! Very good human! Human deserve reward for be good human!
嗯嗯！！对！就是在找这个！非常好的人类！人类是好人类，应该有报酬！
Oh? Human not know what thing is? Want know?
哦？人类不知道这东西是什么？想知道？
Silly! If human not know what thing is, no tell! Can learn for self.
傻瓜！人类不知道是什么，就不告诉！可以自己去了解。
Hrrh! Human! You language dumb! Name smart, flow like water in Orc language, look like dungpile on paper in human language!
呃啊！人类！你们语言笨！名字很聪明，在兽人语里像水一样流畅，写成人类语言就像纸上一堆粪！
Say name! Look at spell, say name! Try!! TRY!!!
念名字！看拼法，念名字！试试看！！试试看！！！
GRRRH! Confusing name! Not confusing in orcish! Human say all wrong!
呃啊啊！乱七八糟的名字！在兽人语里根本不乱！人类全念错！
Hmh. That right, human. Willing to try at least. See how bad name look?
哼。对了，人类。至少愿意试。看到名字写出来多糟了吗？
Said "shoon-bur." Not even LOOK like that in human letter!
念作“顺-布”。用人类字母写出来根本不像！
Here. Needed show anger at stupid language, not show anger at human.
给。刚才是在气蠢语言，不是气人类。
Stupid stupid STUPID! Not at all say like spell! See stupid language now?!
蠢蠢蠢！跟拼法一点都不像！现在看到语言多蠢了吧？！
GAAAH!! No, no, no, no!!! Why need learn human language?!
啊啊啊！！不，不，不，不！！！为什么要学人类语言？！
NAME NOT JOE! WHAT KIND NAME JOE?! JOE STUPID NAME!!! AAAAHH!!
名字不是 JOE！JOE 是什么名字？！JOE 蠢名字！！！啊啊啊！！
呼……哈……人……人类！奇怪……奇怪的人类！
Rock stuck. Trying to lift- for train strength! No one able to lift rock.
石头卡住。在试着举起来——为了练力气！没人举得起来。
Yunelsu try throw rock into river! Have thrown other rock, not this one.
Yunelsu 想把石头丢进河里！丢过别的石头，这块没有。
Hmm...human magic strong, but rock still not moving.
嗯……人类魔法强，但石头还是不动。
Work together! Cast magic at rock, I try lift again! Ready!
一起来！对石头施魔法，我再试着举！准备！
Hrrgh... Hrrf. Must be...old earth rock.
呃……呼。一定是……古老的大地之石。
Been here very long time. Stuck here, rock where earth wants rock to be.
在这里很久很久了。卡在这里，石头待在大地要它待的地方。
Yunelsu find other rock then. Sometimes rock break, though.
那 Yunelsu 找别的石头。不过有时候石头会碎。
See? Many broken rock. Hear can be good for armor though. You take.
看？好多碎石头。听说拿来做盔甲不错。你拿去。
Oh! You! Saw Zuett dragging you to camp. And saw other thing.
哦！你！看到 Zuett 把你拖来营地。也看到别的事。
And you helped Ressinter! Will apologize later. Was my fault. Human seen Freelancers?
而且你帮了 Ressinter！之后会道歉。是我的错。人类见过 Freelancer 吗？
Freelancers think everything belong to them. Loiter around fortress a lot, try to jump in sometimes.
Freelancer 以为什么都是他们的。常在堡垒附近晃，有时候想跳进来。
Was trying to shoot flying one down, but cannon broke, and cannonball explode.
本来想把飞着的那个打下来，但大炮坏了，炮弹爆炸。
Now Ressinter okay, but still need repair cannon. Human feel like helping, will need [{~} Iron Ingots] to repair.
现在 Ressinter 没事了，但大炮还要修。人类想帮忙的话，修理需要 [{~} 铁锭]。
Long walk, but there iron in valley east of villager quarry. There also other villager there, with weapons. Not sure why.
路很远，但村民采石场东边的山谷有铁。那里也有别的村民，带着武器。不知道为什么。
Human being weirdly helpful. That good though! Make Lomoster job of shooting enemy easier.
人类热心得奇怪。不过那样好！让 Lomoster 打敌人的工作轻松点。
Here. Freelancer like steal metal and other thing too, have found a lot from shooting. Human can have.
给。Freelancer 喜欢偷金属跟别的东西，打下来找到很多。人类可以拿去。
Not good for repair cannon, but probably good for make other thing.
不适合修大炮，但大概适合做别的东西。
Her name, my name, sound same. Don't sound same in Orcish! But in YOUR language, sound same!
她的名字，我的名字，听起来一样。在兽人语里不一样！但在你们的语言里，听起来一样！
Grrmbl... Dumb Kreimu... Human have stalks?
嘟囔……笨 Kreimu……人类有茎秆吗？
Good. Can take these, then- Alraune girl have sometimes. Tasty, but not good medicine.
好。那可以拿这个——Alraune 女孩有时候有。好吃，但不是好药。
Durbeo might like, actually. Durbeo orc in food storage tower behind me. Maybe he want help too?
其实 Durbeo 可能会喜欢。Durbeo 是我后面食物仓库塔里的兽人。也许他也想要帮忙？
Oh, that human who healed Ressinter. Yes, I've heard of you already. News travels fast here.
哦，是那个治好 Ressinter 的人类。对，我已经听说你了。这里消息传得很快。
You have a weird face. Uh, a weird look on your face, I mean. What, not used to a more eloquent orc?
你的脸好奇怪。呃，我是说你脸上的表情很奇怪。怎么，不习惯说话比较流利的兽人？
I'm studying languages, is why. I haven't got everything known yet, so if you feel like helping, I could use it.
因为我在学语言。我还没全部学会，所以如果你愿意帮忙，我会很需要。
I used to have a very smart hobbit friend who lived nearby. They've left, but I want you to check their hobbit hole to see if they left behind any language books.
我以前有个很聪明的霍比特朋友住在附近。他们已经走了，但我想请你去他们的霍比特洞看看，有没有留下什么语言书。
It should be close to the blue tower on the hill. That should be easy, right?
应该就在山丘上的蓝塔附近。这应该很简单，对吧？
Oh, good, they did leave a book behind. This even completes the collection I have. I have the first, second, fourth, fifth, and sixth volumes of this.
哦，太好了，他们确实留下了一本书。这下我的收藏就齐了。这套书我有第一、第二、第四、第五和第六册。
Hopefully I can learn something new here. I still don't understand what all these weird "figures of speech" are supposed to mean...
希望能从里面学到新东西。我还是搞不懂那些奇怪的“修辞”到底是什么意思……
What does busting your hump mean? Or two shakes of a lamb tail? Well, anyway. You probably know, so me trying to guess is boring.
“拼了老命”是什么意思？还有“一眨眼的工夫”？嗯，算了。你大概知道，所以我自己瞎猜很无聊。
Here, then. That friend of mine wrote everything he came across down in some diaries, and he gave me them to keep, but I can't read them.
那么，给你。我那个朋友把遇到的一切都写进了几本日记，他把日记给我保管，但我没法读。
The pages are too flimsy- I'll rip them if I turn them. It's a good thing the book you gave me is bound with strong leather, but I still need to be careful not to ruin it...
纸太薄了——我一翻就会撕破。还好你给我的书是用结实的皮革装订的，不过我还是得小心别弄坏……
Well, maybe if you read what these have written in them you can learn some things yourself.
嗯，也许你读读里面写的东西，能自己学到些什么。
Huh. You again. That weird human who helped Ressinter. Something wrong?
嗯。又是你。那个帮了 Ressinter 的怪人类。有什么事吗？
Hm. Looking to help out still? What is it with you looking to be helpful? Have to say I'm not used to this. But, I can think of something.
嗯。还想帮忙？你怎么这么热心？说真的我不太习惯。不过，我想到一件事。
HEY! Any of you feel like playing a game?
Ugh, yeah! We're so BORED in here!
呃，想！我们在这里无聊死了！
Well, sure, but...even if you say this one isn't so scary, I know I don't wanna tell them my real name!
嗯，好啊，但是……就算你说这个没那么可怕，我也不想告诉他们我的真名！
Didn't we just eat a bunch of fruit though? We can use those as fake names!
我们不是刚吃了一堆水果吗？可以拿来当假名啊！
Okay then. Well, call me Mango then, weird human!
好吧。那叫我芒果吧，怪人类！
I just ate a bunch of blueberries, so I guess I'm Blueberry for now?
我刚吃了一堆蓝莓，所以我暂时就叫蓝莓吧？
Hey, I wouldn't mind being called Grapes by anyone, really!
嘿，其实谁叫我葡萄我都不介意！
Then I'm Peaches! So we're just doing a little hide and seek game?
那我就是桃子！所以我们就是玩个捉迷藏？
Yes. Just hide around the fort someplace. If the human doesn't find you, you win.
对。就在堡垒里找个地方躲起来。如果人类找不到你们，你们就赢了。
Well, that's kinda boring, so I'm gonna go find a really tough to reach spot!
嗯，那有点无聊，所以我要去找个特别难去的地方！
Well, there you go. I'll tell you how many you have left to find if you talk with me.
好了，就这样。来找我说话，我会告诉你还剩几个没找到。
...wow. You're good. I thought you might be able to see me up here, but I didn't think you'd be able to reach me!
……哇。你好厉害。我以为你可能看得到我在这上面，但没想到你上得来！
I don't really care about the fact you're human. As long as I get my entertainment I'm happy. Which kinda isn't so great, cause there isn't a lot here to tinker with.
我不在乎你是不是人类。只要有乐子我就开心。可惜这里没什么好玩的东西可以捣鼓。
Tinkernook is so much better about having machines and metals and things to experiment and build than here is.
Tinkernook 那边有机器、有金属、有东西可以实验和打造，比这里好太多了。
Anyways, you win, I lose, so I better get back to stick-in-the-mud Nunexetor. See ya!
总之，你赢了，我输了，我得回去找老古板 Nunexetor 了。拜拜！
NYACK! For such a big human you really know how to sneak up on someone!!
喵呀！你个子这么大，居然这么会偷偷摸到别人身后！！
Gah, I thought I was a goner for a second there... If Nunny says you're okay then I'll trust him, but that doesn't make you less intimidating!
呃，我刚才还以为我完蛋了……既然 Nunny 说你没问题，那我就相信他，但你还是一样吓人！
And, I guess out in the open like this, the other orcs wouldn't let you bully us, so...
而且，我想在这种开阔的地方，其他兽人也不会让你欺负我们，所以……
Suppose you're alright, maybe. But even still, you found me, so I lose. Unless you can't find everyone else!
我想你大概还行吧。不过就算这样，你找到我了，所以我输了。除非你找不到其他人！
I bet you'll NEVER find Mango, hahaah! She always takes these games SUPER seriously!
我打赌你永远找不到芒果，哈哈哈！她玩这种游戏可认真了！
Aw darn it. I guess it's pretty easy to see me up here.
啊，可恶。我想在这上面挺容易被看到的。
I mean, I knew that, but I thought you wouldn't think to climb the tower!
我是说，我知道啦，但我以为你不会想到要爬上塔！
Well, anyway...you really went and tried to heal Ressinter? That's pretty admirable!
嗯，总之……你真的跑去试着治疗 Ressinter？那真是令人佩服！
Aaaand then a human went and killed her, because I guess they got told to do so! At least you seem halfway decent.
然——后就有个人类跑来把她杀了，大概是有人叫他们那么做吧！至少你看起来还算正派。
Anyway, back to the quiet ol' grouch with me!
总之，我回那个安静的老顽固那里去啦！
Ack! Thought you wouldn't notice me behind the stairs!
啊！以为你不会注意到我躲在楼梯后面！
Ugh, you...you human types are scary up close. Is Nunexetor really sure you're not a bad guy?
呃，你……你们人类近看好可怕。Nunexetor 真的确定你不是坏人吗？
I mean, look at your armor! You, you look like you could splat me against the wall in a snap!
我是说，看看你的盔甲！你，你看起来一眨眼就能把我拍扁在墙上！
...I feel like I just gave you an idea and I'm not sticking around to find out! You win!
……我觉得我好像刚给了你一个点子，我可不要留下来看结果！你赢了！
Looks like the human wins. Guess I know how you managed to find that spineback boar.
看来人类赢了。我想我知道你是怎么找到那头刺背野猪的了。
There's no way you REALLY hunted one of those things. Those even give the orc hunters trouble!
你不可能真的猎到那种东西。连兽人猎人都很难对付它们！
Are you kidding me? Humans are terrifying, Blueberry! They've hunted way stronger stuff than some stupid pig!
你在开玩笑吗？人类超可怕的，蓝莓！他们猎过比蠢猪强多了的东西！
But, the game was fun, right?
That's all I wanted from you. Can go back to whatever it was you were doing now.
我对你们要的就这些。现在可以回去做你们刚才在做的事了。
Yes, finally! I don't have to spend time wondering if the human's gonna try and poke my eyes out!
耶，终于！我不用再担心那个人类会不会想戳我眼睛了！
Oh, quit being such a scaredy-baby. This one's nice!
噢，别再当胆小鬼了。这个人很好！
Good game, I guess! Back to being bored again.
算是场好比赛吧！又要开始无聊了。
What? You aren't even wearing those kinds of shoes.
什么？你穿的根本不是那种鞋。
Anyways, to the winner goes the spoils. Here, for entertaining them for a bit.
总之，战利品归胜者。给，谢谢你陪他们玩了一会儿。
They have me watch the goblins but I'm no good at having fun with them, so thanks I suppose.
他们让我看着这些哥布林，但我不擅长陪他们玩，所以我想还是谢谢你。
Ah, the weird human. Why you looking to be helpful?
啊，怪人类。你为什么想帮忙？
The cave outside the villager bridge, with the pond and arch by it. Go in, and there will be blue flowers.
村民桥外面的洞穴，旁边有池塘和石拱。进去，会有蓝色的花。
Get [{~} Terramarine Buds] so can make more dyes. Don't know why you helping, but won't turn down help either.
拿 [{~} 土海蓝花苞] 来，才能做更多染料。不知道你为什么帮忙，但也不会拒绝帮忙。
The weird human again? You all covered in blue powder. You found the flowers then!
又是怪人类？你全身都是蓝色粉末。那你找到花了！
Here. Will get that for you. The buds are enough for what need, but you can keep the dust.
给。帮你拿那个。花苞够用了，粉末你可以留着。
Little more, too. But, again- why you looking to be helpful? Don't understand. Humans kill orcs a lot.
再多给一点。不过，还是那句——你为什么想帮忙？不明白。人类杀了很多兽人。
You that weird human helping instead killing, right? Nunexetor and little goblins talking about you.
你是那个帮忙而不是杀戮的怪人类，对吧？Nunexetor 和小哥布林们在谈你。
Trying to make weapons and tools better. Training, but running out of grindstones. Etemitoro- that is me, my name... That how say it?
在试着把武器和工具弄得更好。在训练，但磨刀石快用完了。Etemitoro——那是我，我的名字……那样念对吗？
Weird human language. Anyway, know where good grindstone is- top of mountain east of fortress.
怪人类语言。总之，知道哪里有好磨刀石——堡垒东边的山顶。
There shortcut running through top by Ledant cave. Maybe dangerous, but not too much. Follow dead bushes on road and can get to top quickly.
Ledant 洞穴旁边有条近路通到山顶。也许有危险，但不会太危险。沿着路上的枯灌木走，就能很快到山顶。
May have something useful if bring me [Leaden Stone] for grind metal.
要是给我带来磨金属用的 [铅石]，可能会有好东西给你。
Look- human want help? Then get Etemitoro- that is me, my name... Get-
你看——人类想帮忙？那帮 Etemitoro——那是我，我的名字……拿——
Oh! You have [Leaden Stone]! Was focusing on work, didn't notice.
噢！你有 [铅石]！刚才在专心工作，没注意到。
Here. Human like green gem for money, right? Not good for smithing though.
给。人类喜欢绿色宝石当钱，对吧？不过不适合打铁。
Hm, healer human. Could swear, saw you walking around plains some time ago. What here for? Ressinter hurt again?
嗯，医者人类。敢发誓，前阵子看到你在平原上走。来这里做什么？Ressinter 又受伤了？
No? Well, am curious now. You try heal Ressinter...luck, maybe? Or did human really know what herbs do?
没有？嗯，现在好奇了。你试着治 Ressinter……是运气吗？还是人类真的知道草药有什么用？
Want review. Want see human medicine knowledge. Will ask questions, human give answer. Simple. Ready?
想考考。想看人类的医药知识。会问问题，人类回答。简单。准备好了？
Good! So, first question. Ginkgo Leaf. What Gingko Leaf good for?
好！那么，第一题。银杏叶。银杏叶有什么用？
Yes! Good. Gingko leaf help brain. Make feel better when stress, but make blood runny. Can be good for sometimes, but can be dangerous.
对！好。银杏叶对脑子好。压力大时让人舒服，但会让血变稀。有时候有用，但可能危险。
So, second question. Sweetgale. What Sweetgale good for?
那么，第二题。香杨梅。香杨梅有什么用？
Nope. Sweetgale not for helping with that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
不对。香杨梅不是用来帮这个的。嗯，也许人类治 Ressinter 是靠运气……想的话可以再试。
它能让调配的药剂变甜。
Here third question. Elderberry. Elderberry good for two thing. What Elderberry good for?
第三题。接骨木果。接骨木果有两种用处。接骨木果有什么用？
No, Elderberry not good for those. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
不对，接骨木果对那些没用。嗯，也许人类治 Ressinter 是靠运气……想的话可以再试。
It soothes pain and treats c
它能舒缓疼痛，还能治类似感冒的病。
Yes! Though, Elderberry also good for third thing. Can make good drink! Get drunk if ferment Elderberry, but that not medicine.
对！不过，接骨木果还有第三种用处。可以做好喝的饮料！接骨木果发酵会喝醉，但那不是药。
Last question for human. Feverfew. What Feverfew NOT help with?
给人类的最后一题。小白菊。小白菊对什么没帮助？
Feverfew very good for heal that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
小白菊治那个非常有效。嗯，也许人类治 Ressinter 是靠运气……想的话可以再试。
噗……哇哈哈哈哈！！！人、人类，好耶！我——哈哈！
That...correct! Not right, but correct! You...haha, you only help Ressinter through luck, right? Human not actually healer.
那个……答对了！不是正解，但答对了！你……哈哈，你帮 Ressinter 只是靠运气，对吧？人类根本不是医者。
Human have humor though! And human try hard to help. More than can say for most humans. Here then- try more heal, instead of be soldier.
不过人类有幽默感！而且人类很努力帮忙。比大部分人类强多了。那给——多试着治疗，别当士兵了。
World need more people to help other people. That human was willing to try mean many good thing.
世界需要更多愿意帮助别人的人。人类愿意尝试，代表很多好事。
It aids in sleep and soothes
它能助眠，还能舒缓炎症。
No. Gingko Leaf bad for that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
不对。银杏叶对那个不好。嗯，也许人类治 Ressinter 是靠运气……想的话可以再试。
Fine. Take your time. Will be here for while to make sure other healer okay.
好吧。慢慢来。会在这里待一阵子，确保另一个医者没事。
Human healer! Hello! This Onluk tower. Onluk tower two! Human help, so human welcome.
人类医者！你好！这是 Onluk 塔。Onluk 二号塔！人类帮过忙，所以欢迎人类。
Tower one call tower one cause Onluk build tower one! This not usual spot for Onluk.
一号塔叫一号塔，因为 Onluk 先盖一号塔！这里不是 Onluk 平常待的地方。
Usually at tower on small hill, across bridge. But because build tower by self, tower rickety.
平常在小山丘上的塔，过桥那边。不过因为是自己盖的，塔摇摇晃晃。
Human helpful. Human get sturdy wood for fix tower? {p} has sturdy wood. Forest has wood too, but more magical than sturdy.
人类会帮忙。人类去拿结实的木头修塔？{p} 有结实的木头。森林也有木头，但魔法多过结实。
Aha! Human have willow wood! Onluk fix tower now!
啊哈！人类有柳木！Onluk 现在修塔！
Will repair Onluk tower one! Come see after fix!
会修好 Onluk 一号塔！修好后来看！
TOWER ONE REPAIRED! Hrahaaah! Yes! Human very helpful!
一号塔修好了！呼啊哈！好耶！人类很会帮忙！
Should go and see! Climb tower, shoot crossbow at Freelancer!
该去看看！爬上塔，用十字弩射 Freelancer！
See? Onluk tower one much better than Onluk tower two! Cozy up here, and can see Fruludir tower too!
看？Onluk 一号塔比 Onluk 二号塔好多了！上面很舒服，还看得到 Fruludir 的塔！
Human very helpful. Healer and woodcutter! Repairer of tower- Well, human not repair tower. Helper of repairer of tower!
人类很会帮忙。医者兼樵夫！修塔的——嗯，人类没修塔。修塔者的帮手！
Here, for help repair Onluk tower one!
给，谢谢帮忙修 Onluk 一号塔！
Speak to Ureietun at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to gain access to the Chieftess' hut
与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Ureietun 交谈，获准进入女酋长的小屋
Human want talk Arrai-Veretel. In hut. Follow.
人类想跟 Arrai-Veretel 谈。在小屋里。跟上。
Arrai-Veretel! Human try help orc around fortress. Want talk.
Arrai-Veretel！人类在堡垒到处帮兽人。想谈。
Up to human now. Will not help more- choice is up to Arrai-Veretel.
现在看人类了。不会再帮——要看 Arrai-Veretel 决定。
Hmh. Zuett spoke about you. So you are human trying to end war?
哼。Zuett 说过你。所以你就是想结束战争的人类？
YOU! You human who kill Rai-Poxper! You human who attack other fort!
你！你就是杀了 Rai-Poxper 的人类！你就是攻击别的堡垒的人类！
Need talk with Zuett again. You follow. And you stay quiet. Understand?
要再跟 Zuett 谈。你跟上。而且你保持安静。明白？
Follow Arrai-Veretel into the meeting room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
跟着 Arrai-Veretel 进入 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的议事厅
ZUETT! You say human want peace. Do you know who human is?!
ZUETT！你说人类想要和平。你知道人类是谁吗？！
Whuh- This good human! Heal Ressinter-
呃——这是好人类！治好 Ressinter——
Human ALSO attack other fort! Many orcs dead because this human!
人类也攻击别的堡垒！很多兽人因为这个人类死了！
Human attack! Rai-Poxper take rightful toll for break cease-fire, but not war yet. Take magic axe from Villager city while magic power gone bad.
人类攻击！Rai-Poxper 因为停火被破坏而讨回应得的代价，但还不算战争。趁魔法力量失控时，从村民城市拿走魔法斧头。
Villager and human attack first, but attack orc for take rightful toll like orc attack first! And human kill Rai-Poxper!
村民和人类先攻击，却因为兽人讨回应得代价而攻击兽人，好像兽人先攻击！而且人类杀了 Rai-Poxper！
Then same human who kill Rai-Poxper come, kill bathing orc, break in fort, kill many Centerworld orc! Villager start, orc finish, villager no respect end!
然后杀了 Rai-Poxper 的同一个人类来了，杀了洗澡的兽人，闯进堡垒，杀了很多 Centerworld 兽人！村民开始，兽人结束，村民不尊重结束！
Yes, human tricked by Villager. But human still attack orc. Human still kill many orc! Human say want peace now?
对，人类被村民骗了，但人类还是攻击兽人。人类还是杀了很多兽人！人类现在说想要和平？
What human done? Hunt boar? Help healer? Done busywork for other orc? That not make up for life lost.
人类做了什么？猎野猪？帮医者？替别的兽人跑腿？那弥补不了失去的性命。
...Arrai-Veretel right. What human done good, not make up for that. But, human still trying. If one human try to stop, more human can try to stop.
……Arrai-Veretel 说得对。人类做的好事，弥补不了那些。但是，人类还在努力。如果一个人类试着停下，就会有更多人类试着停下。
Maybe. Maybe more orc be dead instead. Zuett, you cannot say what would happened. Wishful thinking, and I wish would happened too!
也许。也许会死更多兽人。Zuett，你没法说会发生什么。一厢情愿，我也希望那样会发生！
But with unfinished Wynnic, orc cannot talk well. YOU try learn language when idiot killing you! All sound stupid, and no time to learn for most!
但 Wynn 语没学完，兽人没法好好说话。你试试在笨蛋杀你的时候学语言！全都听起来很蠢，而且大部分人没时间学！
But human listen to Zuett, even if not sound smart. Arrai-Veretel not respect human. Justified, but still cause problem.
但人类听 Zuett 说，就算听起来不聪明。Arrai-Veretel 不尊重人类。有道理，但还是会惹麻烦。
Grrh. FINE! Zuett want peace so bad? Human want peace so bad? Human spilled much orc blood. Only way out of war, is through. We will battle.
呃。好吧！Zuett 这么想要和平？人类这么想要和平？人类流了很多兽人的血。离开战争的唯一方法，就是打过去。我们来决斗。
No tricks. No backup. Nothing but battle between human and myself. If human can fight in ritual arena and win, then will listen.
不耍花招。没有援兵。只有人类跟我之间的决斗。如果人类能在仪式竞技场打赢，就会听。
Try threaten us with iron corpse machine! So, battle will happen. Will prepare ritual and gather crowd. Prepare, human.
还想用钢铁尸体机器威胁我们！所以，决斗会进行。会准备仪式、召集观众。准备好，人类。
Defeat Arrai-Veretel in combat in the arena below the orcish meeting room.
在兽人议事厅下方的竞技场击败 Arrai-Veretel。
May the earth herself hear us... Though we do not speak as we once have...
愿大地之母倾听我们……尽管我们已不再如往昔那般言语……
We, as humble inhabitants of the land she has gifted us, pledge this show in honor of her.
我们，作为她所赐予之土地上谦卑的居民，谨以此战向她致敬。
May she be sated, grow healthy, and honor us in turn for this offering.
愿她得以满足，愈发丰饶，并以此献礼回报我们的敬意。
HMH! Human tough. Fine- Will take battle seriously now!
哼！人类很强硬。好——现在认真打！
For sake of those killed before me, I will not lose!
为了那些死在我之前的人，我不会输！
No, no! Arrai-Veretel hurt bad! Human try kill Arrai-Veretel!!
不，不！Arrai-Veretel 伤很重！人类想杀 Arrai-Veretel！！
AM FINE! Stupid, idiot! No interrupting while ritual fight!
我没事！蠢货，笨蛋！仪式决斗时不准打扰！
Human win. Hate to say, but human win. Not even try kill me.
人类赢了。不想承认，但人类赢了。甚至没想杀我。
Give time. Battle hard-fought- Need to wind down. Wait in meeting room. Will...discuss terms.
给点时间。决斗打得很辛苦——需要缓一缓。在议事厅等。会……谈条件。
Feel like insult to stop war we did not start. But, gave promise. Human strong. Still not make up for so much death...
停止一场不是我们开始的战争，感觉像是侮辱。但是，答应过了。人类很强。还是弥补不了那么多死亡……
But human trying. Really, really trying. Will admit, did not know about human killing all when saw... Still. If war ending, deaths also ending.
但人类在努力。真的，真的在努力。承认，看到时不知道人类杀了那么多……不过。如果战争结束，死亡也会结束。
Will stop attacking cities. Orcs still defend selves! Will not turn bellies for spears. Still not trust villagers- only give cease-fire.
会停止攻击城市。兽人还是会自卫！不会对着矛露出肚子。还是不信任村民——只给停火。
Will say- many orc hold grudge, in plains. Many orc probably still attack. If so, human also can defend self. But, human should avoid fight there.
要说——平原上很多兽人记仇。很多兽人大概还会攻击。如果那样，人类也可以自卫。但人类应该避免在那里打。
...if villager continue attack, will defend selves as before. Human, make sure villager know this.
……如果村民继续攻击，会跟以前一样自卫。人类，确保村民知道这点。
Mhm. Villager more stupid than human. Villager do many terrible thing. But endless war not help fix.
嗯。村民比人类更蠢。村民做了很多可怕的事。但无尽的战争修复不了。
So Zuett not naive. Some things...cannot...be...forgiven. Villager treading line close.
所以 Zuett 不天真。有些事……不能……被……原谅。村民在边缘试探。
Human seen earth rotting in north. Have to have, since took fort in rotting place. Forest used to be living thing. Now dying. Dead in north-east.
人类见过北边腐烂的大地。一定见过，因为在腐烂的地方夺了堡垒。森林以前是活的。现在在死去。东北边已经死了。
Start happening only few decades before Villager leave across ocean! Villager always run away from problem.
村民渡海离开前几十年才开始发生！村民总是逃避问题。
And villager create own problems. Can only mean villager hurt earth, and make her die, slow and sure. Many orc used to live there.
而且村民自己制造问题。只可能是村民伤害大地，让她慢慢地、确实地死去。以前很多兽人住在那里。
Even after villager move in, try kick orc out, many orc live there...then earth start to die. Has not come south- and we are south!
就算村民搬进来、想把兽人赶走，还是很多兽人住在那里……然后大地开始死去。还没蔓延到南边——而我们在南边！
But...that off-track. No more war. Give this to whatever villager need to see it.
但是……扯远了。不再打仗。把这个交给需要看的村民。
Show Captain Goruca the Cease-Fire Agreement.
把停火协议交给 Goruca 队长。
Human! You're back! That certainly took you a while. I suppose all things considered I shouldn't be surprised. Those orcs are tough.
人类！你回来了！还真是花了不少时间。考虑到种种情况，我想我不该意外。那些兽人很难缠。
What's this? You actually managed to get the brutes to sign a ceasefire?! I was expecting you to come back with a bloody prize, not a signature!
这是什么？你真的让那帮野蛮人签了停火协议？！我还以为你会带着血淋淋的战利品回来，而不是一个签名！
Still, this is good! The terms are a bit more airtight than I'd prefer, but I suppose as long as they're out of our hair anything will do.
不过，这是好事！条款比我希望的严密了点，但我想只要他们别来烦我们，怎样都行。
Hm? The orcs were talking about the decay up north? Not sure how that matters. It isn't like anyone knows what's causing it.
嗯？兽人在说北边的黯蚀？不知道那有什么关系。又没人知道那是什么造成的。
I mean, have you heard the rumors flying from {p}? Saying witches are cursing the land, hah! Well, that's besides the point.
我是说，你听说从 {p} 传出来的谣言了吗？说是女巫在诅咒这片土地，哈！嗯，那不是重点。
Here- your reward. I'd intended on giving you the mask so you could try and sneak in like one of them, but I...well, I forgot about it til you'd already left.
给——你的报酬。我本来打算给你这个面具，让你能扮成他们混进去，但我……嗯，我忘了，直到你已经出发了才想起来。
But I DID magically fortify it into a potent piece of gear instead! So it ought to serve you well. We thank you for your service, human!
不过我确实用魔法把它强化成了一件厉害的装备！所以应该对你很有用。感谢你的效力，人类！
...A CATAPULT! Since when did orcs have the knowhow to make a CATAPULT?!
……投石机！兽人是什么时候学会做投石机的？！
Nonono, you don't understand- a CATAPULT?! Seriously, I can't get over this! Orc catapult! What's the world coming to?!
不不不，你不懂——投石机？！说真的，我实在想不通！兽人投石机！这世界是怎么了？！
Obviously it seems we need some backup, soldier. Would you mind coming along to the medical tent with me?
显然，我们需要一些支援，士兵。你介意跟我去医疗帐篷一趟吗？
ORC CATAPULT! I'm telling you, Captain! They crushed our guard golems with huge honking boulders! What are we supposed to do against that?!
兽人投石机！我跟你说啊，队长！他们用超大的石头把我们的魔像砸扁了！我们要怎么对付那种东西？！
He's right, captain. After the golems were crushed, the orcs spilled out from the fortress. If we didn't retreat we would've been killed, with just the four of us.
他说得对，队长。魔像被砸烂之后，兽人就从堡垒里涌了出来。我们就四个人，要是不撤退，早就被杀了。
Human! Let me give you the lowdown. Since you helped us reclaim the outpost up north, the orcs have gotten much more aggressive.
人类！我跟你说说情况。自从你帮我们夺回北边的前哨站，兽人就变得凶狠多了。
And that's where you come in, soldier. We need you to go to the orc fortress and break through their line of defenses. Maybe if we show them we can equal their force, they'll listen, right?
这就是你出场的时候了，士兵。我们需要你去兽人堡垒，突破他们的防线。也许，如果让他们看到我们的武力不输他们，他们就会听了，对吧？
One against four... Human not beat even one. Ismikku! Hulve!
一打四……人类连一个都打不赢。Ismikku！Hulve！
Mmh. Get up. Human! Get up! See human breathing, you awake!
哼。起来。人类！起来！看到人类在喘气，你醒了！
Anyway. Why you here? Why now? Give me good reason. Because kill orcs for "peace"?
总之。你为什么来？为什么现在？给好理由。因为要为了“和平”杀兽人？
[!] An Elite Boar has been spotted. The hunt begins!
[!] 发现了一头 Elite Boar。狩猎开始！
[!] The Elite Boar can be identified by the particles above it's head.
[!] Elite Boar 可以从头上的粒子效果认出来。
[!] The boars will try to hide in the bushes around the hunting grounds.
[!] 野猪会试着躲进猎场四周的灌木丛里。
[!] Pay attention to what bush the Elite Boar is hiding in and give that bush a rustle with right-click to get the boars out of their hiding spots.
[!] 注意 Elite Boar 躲在哪丛灌木里，右键点击那丛灌木摇一摇，把野猪从藏身处赶出来。
...hm. ... ... ...can respect human strength. Can hunt spineback, mean strong.
……嗯……………可以尊重人类的力量。能猎刺背，代表强。
!! Ressinter only healer! Zuett want be healer, Creinu want be healer, but not!
！！Ressinter 是唯一的治疗师！Zuett 想当治疗师，Creinu 想当治疗师，但都不是！
Hm... HM!! Human, uh, human good healer! Heal own injury with medicine! Human will help!
唔……唔！！人类，呃，人类是好治疗师！自己受伤自己用药治好！人类会帮忙！
The book depicts a tall, vine-like plant with red buds.
书上画着一株高大的藤状植物，长着红色的花苞。
The illustration shows a body with splotchy red patches, and seems to depict pulped buds being applied to them.
插图画着一具布满红色斑块的身体，似乎在描绘把捣碎的花苞敷在上面。
There's a picture of fire on the skin...? Is it trying to say that sweetgale helps heal inflammation?
有一张图画着皮肤上的火……？这是想说香杨梅能治发炎吗？
Another diagram shows grubs on the body, and seems to show that applying the pulped buds kills the bugs? That's what the big red X over the grub implies...
另一张图画着身上长虫，看起来是说把捣碎的花苞涂上去可以杀虫？虫身上那个大红叉大概是这个意思……
The book depicts large groups of flowers in various colors, but primarily yellow.
书上画着成群的花，颜色各异，但以黄色为主。
Seems like yarrow can do a lot- there's a lot of disparate illustrations. One depicts a sneezing orc with two yarrow plants pointing at it, and the sneezing stopping.
蓍草好像能做不少事——图画得很杂。其中一张画着一只打喷嚏的兽人，两株蓍草指着它，然后喷嚏就停了。
A similar illustration shows an orc that appears to be having stomach cramps, if its hands being crossed over its stomach is any indication, with two yarrow plants pointed at it.
另一张类似的图画着一只兽人，两只手交叠在肚子上，看起来是肚子绞痛，旁边有两株蓍草指着它。
The third one shows an orc seemingly cut up, with red droplets coming off it. Again, two yarrow plants are pointed at it, and the next picture shows the cuts and droplets gone.
第三张画着一只好像被割伤的兽人，身上滴着红色的水滴。同样有两株蓍草指着它，下一张图里伤口和水滴都不见了。
The book depicts small, dainty flowers with white petals.
书上画着小巧精致、花瓣雪白的花。
There's a detailed picture of the plant, with arrows pointing to multiple different illustrated orcs each showing different things.
有一张植物的细部图，箭头指向好几只画出来的兽人，每一只表现的状况都不一样。

One orc is shown to be agitated, and then subsequently sleeping. Another is...shown with red patches on the skin, and fire next to it, which is replaced with water droplets in the next drawing. The red patches are gone.
一只兽人画得焦躁不安，接着就睡着了。另一只……皮肤上有红斑，旁边画着火，下一张图里火换成了水滴。红斑不见了。
The last one shows various cuts and gashes on a third orc that's emitting red droplets, and then smaller cuts without any red drops on the next depiction...
最后一张画着第三只兽人身上大小不一的伤口，渗出红色的水滴，接着下一张图里伤口变小，也没有红点了……
...but the next page is showing an orc with X's over its eyes, and arrows from multiple chamomile plants pointing to it. Does that mean too much chamomile is bad?
……但下一页画的是一只眼睛被打上叉的兽人，好几株洋甘菊用箭头指着它。这是说洋甘菊用太多不好吗？
The book depicts a shrub-like plant with white petals and buds.
书上画着一株灌木状的植物，有白色的花瓣和花苞。

It looks like this is good for healing a lot of things. The pictures show a sweating, feverish orc, one clutching its stomach, a female one clutching her stomach, and what can be assumed to be an orc with...a toothache?
看起来这个能治不少毛病。图上画着一只冒汗发烧的兽人、一只按着肚子的、一只按着肚子的雌兽人，还有一只大概是……牙痛的兽人？
Seems to imply that feverfew is good for dealing with all of those kinds of maladies.
看起来是在说小白菊对那些毛病都有用。
The bleeding seems to have slowed down a little bit, but the medicine orc is still badly injured. The balm must not have been effective. You'll have to make another one.
流血好像稍微慢了一点，但那只医药兽人还是伤得很重。药膏一定没有奏效。你得再做一份。
Not know much about medicine yet. Medicine give to you, last one- Was made before. Know this though.
对药还不太懂。给你的药，是最后一份——以前做的。不过这个知道。
Ressinter bleeding bad. Find herb good for bleeding. Won't need more than two herb of type, too.
Ressinter 流血流得很严重。找对止血好的草药。同一种草药也不会需要超过两株。
The book depicts broad, yellow-green leaves.
书上画着宽大的黄绿色叶子。
There's an image of an orc with red droplets coming off it, and an arrow with a picture of a gingko leaf pointing at it- the arrow is crossed out. That could mean multiple things.
有一张图画着一只身上滴着红点的兽人，一个带着银杏叶图案的箭头指着它——那个箭头被划掉了。那可能有好几种意思。
The next page shows a gingko leaf pointed at an illustration of a brain, and a similar arrow points from a frowning orc to a smiling one.
下一页画着一片银杏叶指向一颗脑的图，另一个类似的箭头从一只皱眉的兽人指向一只在笑的兽人。
So that means it's good for mood and mental health...and that it does something with bleeding, but you can't tell whether it would be good or bad for it.
所以这是说它对情绪和心神有好处……而且跟流血有关，但你看不出来是好还是坏。
The book depicts red-orange flowering stalks, almost like cattails.
书上画着橙红色的花穗，几乎像香蒲一样。
There's a large illustration of an orc with big purple blotches all over it, and next to it there's a similar illustration with orange splotches instead.
有一张大图画着一只全身布满大片紫色斑块的兽人，旁边还有一张类似的图，斑块换成了橙色。
That implies that ground-up pyrola goes on there...probably depicting bruises.
这是说把磨碎的鹿蹄草涂在那里……画的大概是淤青。
Similar orange splotches are shown applied to what is clearly a cut, and the next illustration over shows the same cut having become smaller.
类似的橙色斑点被涂在一道明显的伤口上，再往后一张图里，同一道伤口就变小了。
Then there's illustrations of what look like...veins? There's a lot of orcish script next to it, so you can't make heads or tails of what that much could mean.
接着有几张图画的好像是……血管？旁边写了一大堆兽人文字，所以那些到底是什么意思你完全看不出来。
The book depicts a short shrub covered in vibrant red berries on small stalks.
书上画着一株矮灌木，细茎上长满鲜红的浆果。
There are multiple illustrations of what look like sick orcs- sneezing and coughing shown in pictures.
有好几张图画的好像是生病的兽人——图上画着打喷嚏和咳嗽。
One illustration shows what looks to be an orc in great pain, and arrows pointing from the elderberries to those figures.
有一张图画着一只看起来痛得厉害的兽人，箭头从接骨木莓指向那些图形。
Your best guess is that elderberries are good for healing mild illnesses, and maybe for dulling pain.
你猜接骨木莓大概能治轻微的病，也许还能止痛。
The balm doesn't seem to have worked this time either. He's still bleeding badly. Maybe you can just...cover up all the cuts and hope for the best? Or maybe that's not a good idea.
这次药膏好像也没用。他还在大量流血。也许你可以直接……把伤口全盖起来，然后祈祷？又或者那不是个好主意。
Still no significant effect. The orc's breathing is getting shallower...
还是没有明显效果。那只兽人的呼吸越来越浅……
... Agreed. We should get back to our tasks though.
同意。不过我们该回去做自己的事了。
If she's worried about you just following orders, then if you go and help out some orcs on your own, Ureietun might change her mind.
如果她担心你只是在听命令，那你自己主动去帮帮兽人，Ureietun 或许会改变想法。
There are lots of orcs around. Asking them if they need help should be simple enough.
附近有很多兽人。去问他们需不需要帮忙应该不难。
Human stupid? I say no see Arrai-Veretel!
人类笨吗？我说了不能见 Arrai-Veretel！
Suppose that's that, then- Fruludir has his package. Time to go back to Peloros.
那就这样了——Fruludir 拿到他的包裹了。该回去找 Peloros 了。
Peloros train hard. Peloros work hard. Peloros work everyone hard, do everything hard.
Peloros 练得很拼。Peloros 做事很拼。Peloros 操每个人都很拼，什么都做得很拼。
Heard that Peloros thinking of making more race spot.
听说 Peloros 在想多弄几个赛跑的地点。
Maybe if war stop, then all orc can try run. Maybe human try run too.
也许战争停了，所有兽人就能试着跑。也许人类也可以来跑。
NO! Wrong! Say wrong, all wrong! Sound even stupider than normal!
不对！错！说错了，全错！听起来比平常还笨！
Want human try again! Feel pain of good name in stupid language! SAY NAME!
要人类再说一次！感受好名字被笨语言念出来的痛！说名字！
Supposed to learn human language for peace. Show orc good because big-nose grub say bad.
为了和平该学人类的语言。要让人看到兽人好，因为大鼻子虫说兽人坏。
Idiot villager get human before orc, so human greet orc with weapon and death!
笨村民比兽人先找上人类，所以人类拿武器和死亡来见兽人！
Now learn language but only in half, and name all stupid!
现在学语言只学一半，名字还全都取得很笨！
His breathing is steady...better let him sleep.
他的呼吸很平稳……还是让他睡吧。
Just need [{~} Carp Meat] from human. Could bring more if wanted, but will not force you.
只需要人类的 [{~} Carp Meat]。想多带也可以，但不会逼你。
All must work together to survive on earth. All have places, all have paths.
要在大地上活下来，所有人都得一起出力。所有人都有位置，所有人都有路。
Many just take and not give. Villager, bugs, other human... You are different.
很多人只拿不给。村民、虫子、其他人类……你不一样。
Still not understand why helping so much. It good, but was not expecting from human.
还是不懂为什么帮这么多。这是好事，但没想到人类会这样。
Can say, happy to be wrong about this.
可以说，这件事我很乐意自己是错的。
Well, it seems like just trying to lift it won't work. Maybe casting some spells at it will dislodge it? Try casting multiple spells in a row.
看来光用力抬是没用的。也许对它施几个法术能把它松开？试着连续施几个法术。
Human! Try move rock, use magic!
人类！试着搬石头，用魔法！
Human can't find iron? There some in valley east of villager quarry, around villager with weapons.
人类找不到铁？村民采石场东边的山谷里有一些，在拿武器的村民附近。
Maybe someplace closer. If so, not know where. Need [{~} Iron Ingots] total though.
也许有更近的地方。有的话，不知道在哪。不过总共需要 [{~} Iron Ingots]。
Grrmb. Dumb Kreimu. Stupid Wynn language...Gavel language...pfeh. Whatever language. Not orc language.
嘟囔。笨 Kreimu。蠢 Wynn 语言……Gavel 语言，呸。什么语言都好，反正不是兽人语。
Not just that- Learning to be medicine orc. She medicine orc too! Healer, brewer, herbalist, whatever. Too much same!
不只那样——在学当药师兽人。她也是药师兽人！医者、酿药师、草药师，随便。太多一样了！
Angry about it. Been distracting from training too. Human want help like help with Ressinter? Get Creinu- Crei...nu...not Kreimu...ingredient for medicine.
为这件事生气。也害训练分心。人类想像帮 Ressinter 那样帮忙？帮 Creinu——Crei……nu……不是 Kreimu，拿药材。
[{~} Leafy Stalk]. Need to learn how to make much medicine out of little herb. Easy?
[{~} 多叶茎秆]。要学怎么用一点点草药做出很多药。简单吧？
[{~}/{~}] Onluk [{~} Willow Planks] enough to make tower better, maybe. Willow strong wood! Can get?
[{~1}/{~2}] Onluk [{~3} Willow Planks] 也许就够把塔弄好。柳木是硬木！拿得到吗？
Human welcome in Onluk tower two, but Onluk tower one better. Not safe to be on without fix tower though.
人类可以来 Onluk 的二号塔，但一号塔比较好。不过塔没修好，站上去不安全。
If want go on Onluk tower one, bring [{~} Willow Planks] so Onluk can fix!
想上 Onluk 的一号塔，就带 [{~} Willow Planks] 来让 Onluk 修！
If bring up lots of arrow, maybe can shoot Freelancer. Like to run through sky. Cause problem for everyone, and Freelancer never actually die, just dissipate.
带很多箭上去，也许就能射 Freelancer。他们喜欢在天上跑。给每个人制造麻烦，而且 Freelancer 从来不会真的死，只会散掉。
Fun time sometimes! Though sometimes Freelancer shoot back. That how Onluk tower one broke.
有时候很好玩！不过有时候 Freelancer 会反击。Onluk 的一号塔就是那样坏掉的。
Must be some reason. Not sure if tired of fighting or some other reason, but if human feel like helping, can use some help.
一定有原因。不知道是打仗打累了还是别的原因，但如果人类想帮忙，可以帮点忙。
Running low on blue dyes. Have plenty of the other colors, but need blue. Know where to get them, too.
蓝色染料快用完了。别的颜色很多，但需要蓝色。也知道去哪里弄。
Can't find the cave? Is outside the villager bridge, with the pond and arch by it.
找不到洞穴？在村民桥外面，旁边有池子和拱门。
Get [{~} Terramarine Buds] so can make more dyes. Bright blue flowers, very dusty.
拿 [{~} Terramarine Buds] 回来就能做更多染料。亮蓝色的花，粉尘很多。
You unlearn villager stupidity, maybe? In the middle of unlearning? Perhaps a sign from the earth things will heal. Perhaps not. We will see.
也许你忘掉了村民的愚蠢？还是正在忘？也许是大地给的征兆，事情会好转。也许不是。走着瞧。
Mhm. Good! Sweetgale pulp make bugs avoid. Also make irritated skin soothe. Very good for bug bite.
嗯。好！香杨梅的浆能让虫子躲开。也能舒缓发炎的皮肤。治虫咬非常好。
Broken weapon parts not good alone, but still sharp. Can be used to make other weapons! Reuse good for earth- waste not!
断掉的武器零件单独没用，但还是很锋利。可以拿来做别的好武器！重复利用对大地好——不浪费！
What in the... HEY! Why's one of those big, scary humans in here?! Nunny, I thought you said we were gonna play a game!
搞什么……喂！为什么这里有个又大又可怕的人类？！Nunny，你不是说我们要玩游戏吗！
We are. This human isn't actually so bad. Care to introduce yourselves?
是要玩。这个人类其实没那么坏。要不要自我介绍一下？
Silly little goblins. Who goes and names themself after fruits?
傻傻的小哥布林。谁会拿水果给自己取名字啊？
Guess goblins are just sort of fickle like that. But again, you just have to find all four of them.
我想哥布林大概就是这么善变。不过话说回来，你就是得把四个都找出来。
None of them will have left the fortress, so it shouldn't take too long.
他们都不会离开堡垒，所以应该不会花太久。
I hear most humans are bullies. It's why Veltu over at the Trunkstump camp was training us to be tougher.
我听说大部分人类都是恶霸。所以 Trunkstump 营地的 Veltu 才会训练我们变得更强悍。
I lost, so I don't care about the game anymore. I saw Blueberry over by that one orc who keeps trying to lift that rock.
我输了，所以我不在乎这场游戏了。我看到 Blueberry 在那个一直想搬石头的兽人旁边。
Ack! I saw Grapes on the hanging flag! Don't hurt me!
啊！我看到 Grapes 在那面挂着的旗子上！不要打我！
Y'know, I probably shouldn't tell you this, but I could actually see Mango over in the other tower! She probably figured it was tough to get to.
你知道吗，这个我大概不该讲，但我其实看得到 Mango 在另一座塔上面！她大概觉得那里很难上去。
Uh... I wonder where Peaches went? I know he loves playing in the creeks at Waterway, so... Oh. I shouldn't spoil their spot.
呃……不知道 Peaches 跑去哪了？我知道他很爱在 Waterway 的小溪里玩，所以……哦。我不该把他们的藏身处说出来。
Yeah, I guess it wasn't as boring as I thought.
嗯，我想没有我以为的那么无聊。
Not much else to say. Was fun, I suppose.
没什么别的要说。我想，挺好玩的。
Hey! Human! Human who hunt spineback boar and help heal healer!
嘿！猎了刺背野猪、帮忙治好医者的人类！
Not stupid human who go around kill other orc! Good human! Can trust. So trust, will ask for small thing.
不是到处杀别的兽人的蠢人类！好人类！可以信任。既然信任，就请帮个小忙。
Oh, human forget. Teiren tell again! Southeast of fort, past ridge, Teiren old camp.

哎呀哎呀，看看你，竟然走到了我工厂的尽头。我没想到你能在生产线上活下来。我还以为你现在已经成了我们的一员。

我想就是这样了。是的，你见过的所有铁魔像确实都是在这里制造的，而你既然走到这里，就知道我们是怎么造它们的了。

是的，与血肉一同锻造的金属……无可匹敌的组合。当然，为了维持服从，必须压抑情感和记忆……

我们已经提前派了几名士兵去现场做准备。你们要先去 {p} 找 Cob 列兵，他会给你们补给。

我料到这次任务会有些危险，但我相信你们三个无论遇到什么都能应付。祝你们好运，士兵们！

These spiders won't stand a chance! Let's get going.
这些蜘蛛根本没有胜算！我们出发吧。
Speak to Private Cob in the Savannah at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to receive supplies.
去 Savannah 草原 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找 Cob 列兵领取补给。
'ey there, chaps! You lot must be the spider killin' force, eh?
嘿，伙计们！你们这帮人一定就是杀蜘蛛的部队吧，嗯？

就是我们！上将说你有补给要给我们？

没错！在我送你们出发之前，队长那边传来了点消息！
Buncha terrorised citizens been found right next to the bloomin' den! Trapped in a sticky old web, they were.
在该死的巢穴旁边发现了一群吓坏了的居民！被困在一张黏糊糊的旧网里。

头号任务是先把他们救出来，再去打巢穴。可是什么都穿不过那张网！

火不行，魔法也不行……什么都破不了。队长就想——嘿，何不试试岩浆？反正比火还烫。

重点是，除了你们的补给什么的，你们还得给队长带点岩浆过去。当然是用魔法封装好的！

好，听起来挺简单的。是多了点活，不过反正我们也要往那个方向走。

就是这股劲！想走最好的路去巢穴，就沿着那条有烧焦痕迹的路走。它会直接带你们找到队长！
Bring the supplies to Captain Enduyn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
把补给带给 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Enduyn 队长。

稍息，士兵们！你们就是 Aegis 叫我留意的那三位吧？跟 Cob 谈过了吗？

谈过了，我们带来了补给。还有……岩浆，我想是吧？

来，让我看看……如果我这样对它施个法术，那么……

对。你们来的路上可能注意到了，巢穴就在 {p} 的山脚下，那是一座休眠火山。

当然，这些只是传说。这座山真的能赐予那种魔法的可能性很小。不过……传说里也许有几分真实。

山里全是蜘蛛，比 {p} 还多。我们几次去侦察，都发现它们对闯入者极具敌意。

我猜，就像是在守护什么东西？

正是。所以，计划是这样的……一旦你们进山，蜘蛛很快就会想往里面移动来阻止你们。我需要你们其中一个留在这里跟我一起打退它们。
So two of us take on the volcano, and two stay behind. Got it! {u}, you should be part of the Mount Wynn group. But then, Tasim, which of us should go with them?
所以两个人去闯火山，两个人留下。明白！{u}，你应该在 Wynn 山那一组。那么，Tasim，我们俩谁跟他们去？
Why don't we let {u} decide? Which of us do you want to join you in the volcano?
不如让 {u} 决定？你想让我们哪一个跟你进火山？

好！那火山就交给我们了。队长、Tasim，可别死在外面啊！

好。那我们就杀穿山里的蜘蛛。上尉、Aledar，祝你们好运！
I need some more time to dec

那就再多想一会儿。但别拖太久——我们可不想让蜘蛛察觉我们在计划什么。
Decide who to bring with you into Mount Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 决定带谁一起进入 Wynn 山。
So, who do you want to join you to fight through Mount Wynn?
那么，你想让谁跟你一起杀穿 Wynn 山？
Enter Mount Wynn and reach the summit through the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
进入 Wynn 山，穿过 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的洞穴抵达山顶。
...Wow, it's hot in here! That makes sense, I guess, given what we're here for. Let's reach the top as quickly as we can.
……哇，这里面好热！想想我们来这里的目的，这也说得通。我们尽快爬到顶上去吧。
W-woah! You felt that too, right? What's going-
哇、哇！你也感觉到了吧？怎么回事——

刚……刚才好险。呼！真不敢相信我们毫发无伤地逃出来了。我觉得我们也快到山顶了。
Ack! We should have known it wouldn't be that easy. Alright, let's take down this spider and get what we came for!
呃！我们早该知道不会那么容易。好，我们干掉这只蜘蛛，拿到我们要的东西！
Well, there it is. We have what we need to burn through those webs!... I hope.
好，就是它了。我们有能烧穿那些网的东西了！……希望如此。

那只蜘蛛提到了女王……我想那就是我们在它们巢穴里要面对的对手了。
Alright, let's get back to Tasim and the captain!
好，我们回去找 Tasim 和队长吧！
...I can hear the spiders already. We'll need to fight through them if we want to reach the top. Let's get going, we don't want to take too long.
……我已经听到蜘蛛的声音了。要到山顶，我们得杀出一条路。走吧，别拖太久。
H-huh? That shaking, it's almost like-
What are those spiders doing!? {u}, come on, we need to move!
那些蜘蛛在干什么！？{u}，快，我们得走了！
...That was closer than it should have been. The spiders must be real desperate to protect whatever it is they have up here, huh? Let's keep going.
……刚才比预想的还要险。这些蜘蛛一定是拼了命在保护山上的某样东西，是吧？我们继续走。
It was a tough climb, but we made it... It's, uh, very hot up here. So- what was it we were looking for-
爬得很辛苦，不过我们到了……这里，呃，好热。那么——我们要找的是什么来着——
Of course it wouldn't be that easy... Alright, {u}, let's do what we came here for. Let's claim that magic, and burn through the webs!
当然不会那么容易……好，{u}，我们来完成我们的目的吧。夺下那股魔法，烧穿那些网！
I guess that's that taken care of. We'll be able to burn through that web and save the villagers!
看来这边解决了。我们可以烧穿那张网，救出村民了！
You heard the spider mention a queen, right? We'll probably have to defeat it in it's nest to stop the spiders, once and for all.
你也听到那只蜘蛛提到女王了吧？我们大概得在它的巢穴里打倒它，才能彻底阻止这些蜘蛛。

我们差不多该下山了。别让 Aledar 和队长等太久。
Return to Captain Enduyn with the flame at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
带着火焰回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Enduyn 队长那里。
We did! We fought off a spider at the summit, and claimed a magical flame.
找到了！我们在山顶打退了一只蜘蛛，拿到了一团魔法火焰。
Excellent! Now, give it here. Let's see if we can't get these villagers free... watch out, folks! It might get a little warm for a moment...
太好了！来，给我。我们来看看能不能把这些村民放出来……大家小心！可能会热一下……
Great work, soldiers. With these villagers out we can turn our focus to the main den.
干得好，士兵们。村民救出来了，我们可以把注意力转到主巢穴了。
If you're prepared, I don't see any reason to hold back. Good luck in there, soldiers! Let's stop this spider blight once and for all.
如果你们准备好了，我看没理由再犹豫。进去之后祝你们好运，士兵们！我们一劳永逸地终结这场蜘蛛之灾吧。
We'll do our best, Captain. Aledar, {u}, let's head down to the den entrance.
我们会尽力的，队长。Aledar、{u}，我们去巢穴入口吧。

找到了，是的。山顶有一只强大的蜘蛛，它一直在使用这团魔法火焰。
H-hah! F-freedom! No m-more c-creepy crawlies... Just me a-and my... mushrooms.
哈、哈！自、自由了！再也没、没有爬来爬去的恶心东西……只有我和我的……蘑菇。

我们做到了！我们杀了蜘蛛女王！{p} 再也不会受那个威胁了！

我们——我们做到了！刚才……真是惊心动魄。但我们最后成功了！

我想我们得自己想清楚。我知道我还是想帮忙守卫这个省份，但除此之外……我也不知道。

……是啊，好吧。嘿，我们都回 {p} 会合，好好庆祝一下吧！经历了这一切，我们值得。

听起来不错。{u}，我们在这里稍微休息一下，很快就回兵营跟你会合。

好，我们到了！任务成功，回到兵营。感觉有点……不真实，你懂吗？

我懂你的意思。不过，嗯，我们干得不错！我们让住在森林里的人更安全了。

没错！现在，我们庆祝吧！来，大家都来点 {p} 威士忌应应景。

……那么，你们两个接下来打算做什么？我想我会去找上将，看看能不能在哪里接个任务。

嗯。我一直在想……去研究更高深的粉末技术。要是我能弄懂它们的原理，也许我就能……做得更多。

是啊……嗯，我想我是在路上发现了更有意思的东西。进展如何我会告诉你们。

记得跟我们说说近况，Aledar。那么，{u}，你接下来想做什么？

去探索，是吧？好主意。这附近有很多值得一看的地方！

如果你需要一个目标，下一个可以去的地方是北边的 {p} {p}。等你到了 {~} 级也许可以去看看。

……嗯，我很高兴我们都能聚在这里。敬我们长久又充实的友谊！

我？嗯，我有一点小进展……不过还没什么大突破。我会继续努力的！

哦，你好，{u}。我大概不会在这里待太久——我被派去帮忙守卫南边的 {p}。

有机会的话，你该来看看！

俺把俺那张老航海图留在了俺的旧藏身处，它会告诉你到哪去找俺的老金子。

俺的旧藏身处就藏在咱们这了不起的地盘入口那个骷髅里，把那张图给俺拿来，小子！

抱歉，这些钱不够。魔法可不便宜！等你凑到 [{~} 绿宝石块] 再来，我们就会帮你。记得也要把 [{~} 张褪色的地图] 带上。

我们只希望那双靴子永远别再落到那个海盗手里，我们宁可它落到你手里。

与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] Pirate Cove 里的 Javier 对话

嘎，小子，你看起来是个了不起的冒险者。不过你的口袋大概没你想的那么鼓吧，嗯？

也许咱们可以做笔交易，小子，保证让咱俩都发大财！

你瞧，小子，俺的宝藏丢了好一阵子了，俺把它藏在一个叫 Sarnfic 的海上村子里，一个秘密房间里。

啊，可是小子。那个村子莫名其妙就消失了！就像什么黑魔法一样！俺对你发誓，俺绝没说谎！

所以你瞧，俺年纪大了，需要点俺那合法的金子撑过余生。

不过别担心，伙计，老 Javier 向来都留着后手。

那么，小子。你愿不愿意让自己发笔横财？很好。
Find Javier's map, hidden in the skull tomb at the entrance of the island
找到藏在岛屿入口骷髅墓穴里的 Javier 的地图

站住，小子！风告诉我们你在找藏宝图。啊，你可没那么容易拿到。

你瞧，我们这些鬼魂跟活着的时候一样贪。这事可没得商量。我们要你的钱，给了钱，我们才会打开通往地图的路。

一整组绿宝石就能满足我们。如果你有我们要的，就到这座墓的前面去。

祝你这趟小小的旅程顺利。只要把整条路找出来，你就不会有事……

啊，你真有本事，小子！真是太感谢了，现在咱们能看看俺的宝藏埋在哪儿了。
Hrmm, well, garr, blast it all

俺连俺自己的破地图都看不懂了，小子！你对它干了啥？拿你的铜板把墨水刮掉了？

别怕，小子。老 Javier 有个老朋友能帮忙解读这块破布。

去旧 {p}，那里有个叫 Dalben 的人能把俺的地图恢复原样。办好了，小子，把俺的宝藏带回来！

与 {p} 的 Dalben 谈谈修复地图的事

这是什么？一位旅人？我们能帮你什么？

啊，我明白了，你想探索海洋深处？可到底是为了什么？

这张地图……你是怎么弄到的？它被我们的人施过魔法。

唉，那地方是有来历的。很久以前，我们法师议会把那座城放逐了，为了藏起一个海盗藏在那里的宝物中那股可怕的力量。

一双靴子，用取自一处邪恶之地的石头炼成的黑色材料打造，蕴含着极其黑暗的魔法。不过我们不认为那个肮脏愚蠢的海盗知道自己找到了什么。

我必须说，我们议会很后悔为了一双靴子毁掉整个村子。可当时别无他法。

谁知道他为什么要留着那双靴子。如果他知道靴子的力量，我敢肯定他会拿去作恶。不过我们在你身上感觉不到邪恶，因此我们会协助你完成任务。
We hope that you will use the boots for good, despite the dark intentions. We will lift the enchantment once lain upon the charts, but it will cost you.
尽管靴子带着黑暗的意图，我们仍希望你能善用它。我们会解除当年施加在海图上的魔法，但你得付出代价。
Give me [{~} Emerald Blocks], that should cover the cost.
给我 [{~} 绿宝石块]，应该够付费用了。
Bring back [{~} Blocks of Emerald] to Dalben
把 [{~} 绿宝石块] 带回给 Dalben
Brilliant. That seems in order. Here you go.
太好了。看起来没问题。给你。
Well? What does it say? Go to that location! Find the treasure!
怎么样？上面写着什么？去那个地方！找到宝藏！
Explore the cave in the ocean, located at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Find [{~} Ocean Treasure] and bring it back to Javier in Pirate Cove
找到 [{~} 海洋宝藏]，带回给 Pirate Cove 的 Javier
Gnar, you did it lad! Ye brought back old Javiers gold! And as I promised, heres yer share of the loot.
哈，你办到了，小子！你把老 Javier 的金子带回来了！说好的，这是你那份战利品。
I threw in something extra for ye. It's an old key I salvaged a few years back, from the shipwreck of a legendary pirate.
俺还额外送你一样东西。是俺几年前从一位传奇海盗的沉船里捞出来的一把旧钥匙。
Who knows what it leads to? Maybe a treasure hoard, or maybe the ol' swashbuckler wanted to lead someone into a trap.
谁知道它能打开什么？也许是一堆宝藏，也许是那个老海盗想把谁引进陷阱。
Me bones are too old for a grand adventure like that, guess ye'll have to figure it out for yerself.
俺这把老骨头经不起那种大冒险了，看来你得自己去弄明白了。
Speak to Irlok in the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Welcome to Bantisu Temple, traveler. We guide lost souls onwards, be they wandering men to town or spirits unable to exit the canyon.
欢迎来到 Bantisu 寺，旅人。我们为迷失的灵魂指引方向，无论是在荒野徘徊、找不到城镇的人，还是离不开峡谷的亡魂。
However, recently our job has become much more difficult. The canyon shakes, and changes. Often, long-buried creatures are released as the walls shift.
然而最近，我们的工作变得困难多了。峡谷在震动、在变化。岩壁移动时，常常会放出埋藏已久的生物。
And unfortunately, the worst has come to pass, that one of these creatures is hostile. The Bantisu monks of old collapsed the entrance to its cave to seal it away...
很不幸，最糟的情况发生了——其中一只生物充满敌意。古时的 Bantisu 僧侣曾让它的洞穴入口坍塌，把它封印起来……
...but the rubble has shifted, and the cave is open once more. We were not strong enough to defeat it then, and we are not strong enough to defeat it now.
……可是碎石移动了，洞穴又打开了。当年我们不够强，打不倒它，现在我们也一样不够强。
Even trying to collapse the cave again has ended in failure, for the beast, Krolton, slays our mages and demolitionists in but an instant.
就连想再次让洞穴坍塌也失败了，因为那头野兽 Krolton 一眨眼就能杀光我们的法师和爆破手。
However, the word on the wind tells tales of humans doing the impossible as a matter of rote. Krolton must be dealt with before it leaves the cave- I beg your assistance!
不过，风中传来消息，说人类把不可能的事当家常便饭。必须在 Krolton 离开洞穴之前解决它——我恳求你帮忙！
We've no time to spare. I will prepare a short spell to bring you to the cave- Please, wait outside, and prepare yourself.
我们没有时间可以浪费。我会准备一个简短的法术，把你送到洞穴——请在外面等候，做好准备。
Seek out the creature in the mines at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的矿坑里寻找那只生物。
I apologize for the suddenness of this, but you must understand the urgency. We have no way of knowing when Krolton may emerge.
很抱歉这么突然，但你得明白事态紧急。我们根本无从得知 Krolton 什么时候可能会出来。
We will pray for your safety, and that your spirit will not become among those we must guide out of the canyon.
我们会为你的平安祈祷，也祈祷你的灵魂不会成为我们得引导出峡谷的其中一个。
Explore the strange realm and bargain with Death.
探索这个奇异的领域，与死神谈条件。
SO THAT IS YOUR FIRST INSTINCT? TO CLIMB THE VALLEY WALLS IN FRUITLESS SEARCH OF AN ESCAPE?
所以这就是你的第一反应？爬上山谷的岩壁，徒劳地寻找出路？
AMUSING. BUT THIS IS WHERE YOU MUST BE. TAKE ALL THE TIME YOU LIKE, THOUGH. I WILL WAIT FOR YOU TO COME TO MY MANOR.
真有趣。不过这里就是你该待的地方。慢慢来吧，我会在我的庄园等你过来。
SO MY MANSION IS DULL ENOUGH YOU'D RATHER GO ROCK CLIMBING?
所以我的宅邸无聊到你宁可去攀岩？
OR DID I SIMPLY SCARE YOU OFF SAYING SUCH SERIOUS THINGS?
还是我说了那么严肃的话，把你吓跑了？
NEVERTHELESS, YOU WILL BE BACK EVENTUALLY. THERE IS NOTHING FOR ANYONE OUT THERE.
不管怎样，你迟早会回来的。外面什么都没有，对谁都一样。
IT SEEMS I HAVE A NEW GUEST. WELCOME.
看来我有新客人了。欢迎。
MAKE YOURSELF COMFORTABLE. YOU'LL BE STAYING HERE FOR A WHILE.
别拘束。你会在这里待上一阵子。
NOTHING IS STOPPING YOU FROM TAKING A LOOK AROUND. DON'T TOUCH ANYTHING THOUGH. AND TAKE OFF YOUR SHOES AS YOU ENTER.
没什么能拦着你四处看看。不过什么都别碰。还有，进门请脱鞋。
WHEN YOU FEEL LIKE IT, COME TO MY OFFICE UPSTAIRS. WE HAVE A LENGTHY TALK TO HAVE.
等你想来了，就到楼上我的办公室。我们有很长的话要谈。
THIS IS WHERE I SERVE MEALS TO MY GUESTS. THEY GIVE SUCH GLOWING REVIEWS.
这里是我招待客人用餐的地方。他们的评价都好得不得了。
AFTER ALL, IT IS SAID ONE'S LAST MEAL IS THE SWEETEST, SO HAVING ANOTHER AFTER THAT IS SURELY TO DIE FOR. AH HA HA.
毕竟人家都说最后一餐最美味，那吃完最后一餐再来一顿，肯定好吃到要命。啊哈哈。
IF I HAD BOUGHT ANY FLOUR THIS MORNING, I WOULD HAVE OFFERED A BISCUIT FOR DYING. I'M TOLD I MAKE THE BEST CHOCOLATE CHIP ONES.
要是我今天早上带了面粉，就能请你吃块饼干，送你上路。听说我做的巧克力豆饼干是最好吃的。
BUT ALAS. WE WILL HAVE TO CONTENT OURSELVES WITH A LAST DRINK FOR THE DEPARTED INSTEAD. I'LL PUT THE KETTLE ON.
可惜啊。我们只能退而求其次，为逝者干最后一杯了。我去烧水。
THIS SECTION OF THE MANSION IS UNDERGOING RENOVATIONS. FOR THE TIME BEING, IT GOES EMPTY.
宅邸的这一区正在翻修。暂时空着。
SOULS DO LINGER HERE. LINGERING EVER LONGER THAN BEFORE. AND WITH SO MANY ARRIVING...
灵魂确实会在这里逗留。逗留得比以前还要久。而且来的又这么多……
IT IS, PERHAPS, A POINTLESS COMFORT TO GIVE. BUT I FEEL A GUEST ROOM WOULD BE APPRECIATED, UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES.
这也许是种没什么意义的安慰。但我觉得，在这种情况下，一间客房应该会受欢迎。
PERHAPS GROWING THINGS IN A PLACE LIKE THIS IS A FOOL'S ERRAND.
也许在这种地方种东西是白费力气。
IF IT IS, THEN I WILL MERRILY JINGLE MY BELLS AS I WATER THEM. IT IS FLEETING JOY TO CARE FOR THEM, BUT A JOY NONETHELESS.
就算是，我浇水的时候也会开开心心地摇响我的铃铛。照顾它们的快乐很短暂，但终究是快乐。
THESE ARE BUSHES. NOTHING YOU DON'T ALREADY KNOW.
这些是灌木。都是你早就知道的东西。
WELCOME TO MY LIBRARY. I FIND MY GUESTS ARE DRAWN TO HERE. PERHAPS IT IS BECAUSE KNOWLEDGE IS POWER, AS I HAVE BEEN TOLD.
欢迎来到我的图书馆。我发现我的客人都会被这里吸引。也许是因为，就像别人告诉我的，知识就是力量。
ALTHOUGH, GIVEN SO MANY OF MY BOOKS ARE WRITTEN IN DEAD LANGUAGES, THERE IS LITTLE POWER TO BE FOUND HERE.
不过，我这里有太多书是用死语言写的，所以在这里找不到多少力量。
BUT I WILL NEVER BEGRUDGE A GUEST A REPRIEVE, HOWEVER MOMENTARY. MORTALITY CAN BE A HARSH LESSON.
但我绝不会吝于让客人喘口气。不管多短暂。生死这一课可能很残酷。
IT SEEMS YOU REALLY WANTED TO KNOW WHAT WAS BEHIND THIS DOOR.
看来你真的很想知道这扇门后面是什么。
I GUESS YOU WILL GET WHAT YOU WANTED...
我想你会得到你想要的……
DO YOU REALLY THINK IT WAS WORTH YOUR TIME?
你真觉得这值得你花时间吗？
AH, I SEE YOU HAVE DISCOVERED THE HOURGLASSES. I SUPPOSE IT IS ONLY NATURAL THEY WOULD DRAW YOUR ATTENTION.
啊，看来你发现那些沙漏了。我想它们会吸引你的注意也是理所当然的。
EACH ONE MEASURES THE LIFE OF A BEING. WHEN ALL THE SAND REACHES THE BOTTOM, I RECEIVE A NEW GUEST.
每一个都在计量一个生命的寿命。当所有的沙都落到底部，我就会迎来一位新客人。
BUT A MEASURED LIFESPAN IS NOT A GUARANTEE. IT IS ONLY AN ESTIMATE. THE RATE OF THE HOURGLASS WILL SHIFT IN RESPONSE TO ANY NUMBER OF FACTORS.
但计量出来的寿命并不是保证。那只是个估计。沙漏的流速会因为各种因素而改变。
I AM SURE WE COULD FIND YOURS, IF WE SEARCHED HARD ENOUGH. BUT I FIND MOST VISITORS STRUGGLE TO GRAPPLE WITH SUCH A TANGIBLE DISPLAY.
我相信只要找得够仔细，我们也能找到你的那一个。不过我发现大多数访客都很难面对这么具体的呈现。
THIS ONE... IT IS SPECIAL. IT DISPLAYS SOMETHING FAR MORE IMPORTANT THAN INDIVIDUAL LIFESPANS.
这一个……很特别。它显示的东西，远比个人的寿命重要得多。
IT IS HERE TO MEASURE HOW MUCH TIME THE WORLD HAS LEFT.
它在这里计量的是这个世界还剩多少时间。
AS WITH THE OTHERS, IT IS MERELY AN ESTIMATE. IT HAS BEEN SLOWED AND HALTED IN THE PAST.
跟其他沙漏一样，它只是个估计。过去它曾经变慢，也曾经停下。
BUT I FEAR THE COMING END IS INEVITABLE. IT WAS SET IN MOTION LONG, LONG AGO, BY ACTORS BEYOND THE BOTH OF US.
但我担心即将到来的终结无可避免。它在很久、很久以前就被启动了，启动它的，是凌驾于你我之上的存在。
I KEEP IT AS A REMINDER. TO CHERISH WHAT STILL IS LEFT. BEFORE IT, TOO, IS LOST.
我留着它当作提醒，提醒自己珍惜还剩下的一切。在它们也消逝之前。
PLEASE REFRAIN FROM TOUCHING ANY OF MY JARS. I KEEP THINGS VERY DEAR TO ME IN THEM.
请不要碰我的任何一个罐子。里面装着对我来说非常珍贵的东西。
PARTICULARLY MY JAR OF SOIL. THAT IS A SOUVENIR FROM VERY, VERY LONG AGO.
尤其是我那罐泥土。那是很久、很久以前的纪念品。
I HAVE NO NEED FOR SLEEP. SO, MY BEDROOM NOW SERVES MERELY A SYMBOLIC PURPOSE.
我不需要睡觉。所以，我的卧室现在只剩象征意义。
SYMBOLIC OF WHAT, YOU ASK? MY LOVING MARRIAGE. JUST BECAUSE I DO NOT HAVE A HEART, IT DOES NOT MEAN I CANNOT LOVE.
象征什么，你问？我美满的婚姻。我没有心，不代表我不能爱。
"TIL DEATH DO US PART" IS FOR QUITTERS, I SAY. I WILL LOVE HER BEYOND THE END OF TIME ITSELF.
要我说，“至死不渝”是给半途而废的人说的。我会爱她，爱到时间本身的尽头之后。
THESE DAYS, THE CATS LAY CLAIM TO THE BED FOR THE MOST PART. AT LEAST SOMEONE IS GETTING USE OUT OF IT, IN THE END.
如今这张床大多被猫占据了。至少到头来还有人用得上它。
THIS IS THE DARK LORD, SNUGGLEBUNS. GREET HIM WITH RESPECT, WITH A PAT ON THE HEAD AND A SCRATCH UNDER THE CHIN.
这位是黑暗领主，抱抱团子。请恭敬地向他问好，摸摸他的头，再挠挠他的下巴。
HE IS A GUEST, MUCH LIKE YOURSELF. UNLIKE YOU, HOWEVER, HE HAS BEEN HERE A VERY LONG TIME.
他跟你一样是客人。不过跟你不同的是，他已经在这里待了非常久。
HE IS ONE OF THE MORE STUBBORN BEASTS I HAVE ENCOUNTERED ACROSS THESE EONS. YOU SEE, HE IS WAITING FOR SOMEONE TO CROSS OVER. MUCH LIKE MYSELF, HE CAN BE VERY PATIENT.
他是我这亿万年来遇过最固执的野兽之一。你看，他在等某个人跨过来。跟我一样，他可以非常有耐心。
TOO PATIENT FOR HIS OWN GOOD, PERHAPS.
...I DO NOT HAVE THE HEART TO TELL HIM THE TRUTH. AND SO, AS THE YEARS PASS, HIS CLAIM ON MY HOME CONTINUES TO GROW.
……我没有心——也狠不下心——告诉他真相。所以随着岁月流逝，他对我家的占领一直在扩大。
AND I ALLOW IT. I FIND HIS COMPANIONSHIP WORTH THE HASSLE.
而我由着他。我觉得有他作伴，这点麻烦很值得。
IT MAY NOT SEEM AS SUCH FROM YOUR PERSPECTIVE. BUT LIFE IS LIMITED. STILL, SOULS PASS THROUGH THE CYCLE, AND THE WORLD KEEPS ON SPINNING.
从你的角度看也许不是这样。但生命是有限的。即便如此，灵魂依旧会在轮回中流转，世界也会继续转动。
...THEY WERE NOT MEANT TO BE LOST. TO PASS BEYOND MY REACH, TO REACH AN END SOMEWHERE I CANNOT FIND THEM.
……它们本不该迷失。本不该越出我所及之处，在我找不到的地方走向终结。
AND YET, THROUGH MEANS BEYOND MY CONTROL, THEY DO. THEY HAVE. WITH EACH AND EVERY ONE, I LOSE A PIECE OF MYSELF. IRREVERSIBLY.
然而，通过我无法掌控的手段，它们确实迷失了。已经迷失了。每失去一个，我就失去自己的一部分。无法挽回。
AND THE CYCLE MUST KEEP SPINNING, LESSENED EVEN AS IT MAY BE. BUT I STILL REMEMBER THEM, EACH LIFE THAT THEY LIVED.
而轮回必须继续转动，即使它可能已经残缺。但我仍然记得它们，记得它们活过的每一段人生。
THIS ONE SHOULD BE FAMILIAR TO YOU.
FEW EVER HAVE THE CHANCE TO COME FACE TO FACE WITH A LIFE THEY THEMSELVES HAVE BROUGHT TO AN END. I WONDER HOW YOU FEEL NOW.
很少有人有机会跟亲手终结的生命面对面。不知道你现在是什么感受。
HE WAS ONCE A GOOD MAN. BUT SUCH IS THE TRAVESTY OF THAT WAR-RAVAGED PROVINCE, THAT IT TWISTS THE MIND AND SPIRIT IN SUCH A WAY.
他曾经是个好人。但那个饱受战火蹂躏的行省就是这么荒唐，会用那样的方式扭曲人的心智与灵魂。
I WILL NOT PASS JUDGEMENT ON YOUR ACTIONS. BUT PERHAPS DEATH WAS A KINDER FATE THAN THE TURMOIL HE WAS DROWNING IN.
我不会评判你的行为。但比起他深陷其中的那片混乱，也许死亡是更仁慈的命运。
EVEN HERE, FREED OF ITS INFLUENCE, HE STRUGGLES TO RELEASE THAT ANGER THAT GRIPPED HIM SO TIGHTLY. HE REFUSES TO MOVE ON.
即使在这里，摆脱了那股影响，他依然难以放下那份死死攫住他的愤怒。他不肯继续前行。
BUT HE WILL, EVENTUALLY. THEY ALL DO. IT IS ONLY A MATTER OF TIME.
但他终究会的。他们都会。只是时间问题。
HE IS NOT THE FIRST TO HAVE SUFFERED SUCH A FATE. THAT BLIGHT HAS TAKEN HOLD OF OH SO MANY OVER THE YEARS.
他不是第一个遭受这种命运的人。这些年来，那场祸害已经缠上了太多、太多人。
A MILLENNIUM IS A RAINDROP IN THE SEA COMPARED TO MY EXISTENCE. SO WHY HAVE THESE YEARS FELT SO MUCH LONGER THAN EVER BEFORE?
跟我的存在相比，一千年不过是沧海一滴。那为什么这些年感觉比以往任何时候都要漫长？
IT IS FORTUNATE THAT IT ONLY TARGETS THE BODY, AND ONLY ONCE ITS SPARK FLICKERS OUT.
幸好它只针对肉体，而且只在生命的火花熄灭之后。
WHAT IT DOES IS BAD ENOUGH ALREADY. IF IT WERE TO TAKE THE SOUL, AS WELL...
它做的事已经够糟了。要是连灵魂也夺走……
AH HA HA. I WOULD RATHER NOT DWELL ON THAT ANY LONGER. IT ISN'T AS IF I COULD DO SOMETHING ABOUT IT, ANYWAY.
啊哈哈。我还是别再想那件事了。反正我也无能为力。
WELCOME TO MY OFFICE. GO ON, TAKE A GUESS AT WHAT I DO HERE.
欢迎来到我的办公室。来，猜猜我在这里做什么。
...REALLY? NOTHING? PERHAPS I NEED SOME NEW MATERIAL.
……真的？没反应？也许我该想点新段子了。
PLEASE TAKE A SEAT. LET US REVIEW YOUR OPTIONS.
请坐。我们来看看你有哪些选择。
PERHAPS SITTING IN FRONT OF DEATH MAY SEEM AN ODD PLACE TO BE. I APOLOGIZE FOR ANY DISCOMFORT.
坐在死神面前，也许感觉是个奇怪的位置。如有任何不适，我深表歉意。
NOW, BEFORE WE BEGIN IN EARNEST. LIVING BEINGS ARE NOT SUBTLE ABOUT HAVING QUESTIONS. I AM SURE YOU HAVE THEM.
那么，在正式开始之前。活着的生物有问题时从来藏不住。我相信你一定有。
GO ON. ASK THEM NOW. I DO NOT WANT TO BE INTERRUPTED LATER.
问吧。现在就问。我不希望待会儿被打断。
FEEL FREE TO TAKE A MOMENT TO COME TO TERMS WITH YOUR MORTALITY, IF YOU NEED IT. I HAVE TIME.
如果需要的话，尽管花点时间接受自己终有一死的事实。我有的是时间。
MANY, MANY, MANY TIMES. AS HAS EVERY OTHER LIVING BEING.
很多、很多、很多次了。其他所有活着的生物也一样。
ONCE A LIFE REACHES AN END, THE SOUL PASSES THROUGH THE VEIL, CROSSING OVER INTO DEATH.
当生命走到尽头，灵魂便会穿过帷幕，跨入死亡。
HERE, THEY LINGER. MEMORIES FADE WITH TIME, AND THE SOUL IS REDUCED TO THE ESSENTIALS. PREPARED TO RETURN TO THE CYCLE.
在这里，它们会逗留。记忆随时间淡去，灵魂被简化到只剩本质。准备好回归轮回。
LIFE AND DEATH ARE NOT IN OPPOSITION, AS YOU MORTALS OFTEN ASSUME. THEY ARE TWO PARTS OF THE SAME WHOLE.
生与死并不像你们凡人常以为的那样对立。它们是同一个整体的两个部分。
YOU, THE ESSENCE AT THE CORE OF YOUR BEING, HAVE BEEN HERE MANY TIMES BEFORE. AND YOU WILL BE HERE MANY TIMES AGAIN.
你，也就是你存在核心的本质，以前来过这里很多次。以后也会再来很多次。
...OR, SO I WOULD HOPE. BUT I DIGRESS.
……至少，我是这么希望的。不过我扯远了。
IT IS DEATH. IT MAY BE HARD TO BELIEVE, I KNOW. AH HA HA. BUT I HAVE BEEN EXCEEDINGLY CLEAR, HAVEN'T I?
这里就是死亡。我知道，这可能很难相信。啊哈哈。不过我已经说得非常清楚了，不是吗？
BUT NOT EVERY SOUL WILL SEE IT THE SAME WAY. MOST LACK THE CAPACITY TO CONCEPTUALIZE IT AS ANYTHING MORE THAN A HAZE. A BLURRED STATE OF BEING.
但不是每个灵魂看到的都一样。大多数灵魂没有能力把它想象成比一团迷雾更多的东西。一种模糊的存在状态。
IT IS RARE THAT I MAY HOST A GUEST WITH THE CLARITY OF MIND AND THE WILLPOWER REMAINING TO SEE THIS PLACE FOR WHAT IT TRULY IS.
很少有客人还保有足够清醒的心智与意志力，能看清这地方的真面目。
HOWEVER FLEETINGLY, I DO ENJOY WHEN IT HAPPENS. IT IS WORTH CELEBRATING. NOW IF ONLY I HAD SOME SPIRITS TO SHARE. AH HA HA.
尽管转瞬即逝，我确实很享受这种时候。值得庆祝。要是我有点烈酒——或者说‘灵’酒——能跟你分享就好了。啊哈哈。
OH, IT CHANGES WITH THE TIMES. AND ACCORDING TO MY WHIMS.
哦，它会随着时代改变。也会随我高兴改变。
IT HAS PREVIOUSLY BEEN A TOWER, A CASTLE, A FOREST, A CAVERN... I WAS IN A VERY UNDERGROUND PHASE OF MY EXISTENCE BACK THEN.
它以前当过塔、城堡、森林、洞窟……那时候我正处于一个非常‘地下’的人生阶段。
FOR NOW, A MANOR SERVES ME WELL. I DO ADMIRE THE ARCHITECTURAL STYLE OF ITS TIME. VERY GOTHIC.
目前，一座庄园很合我意。我很欣赏那个时代的建筑风格。非常哥特。
CERTAINLY NOT. WHEREVER WOULD I FIND THE TIME?
当然不是。我哪来的时间？
FOR MOST SOULS, THERE IS LITTLE NEED TO INTERVENE. THEY WILL LINGER, BUT GIVEN TIME, THEY WILL FIND THEIR WAY FORWARD.
对大多数灵魂来说，几乎没有介入的必要。它们会逗留，但只要给它们时间，它们会自己找到前进的路。
BUT ON OCCASION, AN ARRIVAL WILL DRAW MY INTEREST. ONE WHICH DEMANDS A PROPER WELCOME.
但偶尔，会有某个到来的灵魂引起我的兴趣。一个值得好好迎接的灵魂。
THIS MEETING IN MY OFFICE IS NOT TRULY NECESSARY. THE PAPERWORK IS FOR SHOW. BUT I LIKE TO INDULGE, ON OCCASION.
在我办公室的这场会面其实并不必要。那些文书是做做样子。但我偶尔也喜欢放纵一下。
THAT SHOULD BE EVERYTHING, THEN. PERHAPS IF I GAVE YOU MORE TIME YOU COULD THINK OF MORE.
那应该就是全部了。也许我多给你一点时间，你还能想出更多。
BUT IT IS BEST WE GET ON WITH OUR DISCUSSION, I WOULD SAY.
但我认为我们最好继续谈正事。
LET US BEGIN WITH THE BASICS.
CAUSE OF DEATH: SLAIN BY THE HORROR KNOWN AS KROLTON. ANOTHER TO ADD TO THE TALLY.
死因: 被名为 Krolton 的恐怖之物所杀。又添一笔记录。
SWIFT AND UNAVOIDABLE. THERE IS NO SHAME IN LOSING TO SUCH A FOE. YOU ARE NOT THE FIRST, AND YOU WILL LIKELY NOT BE THE LAST.
迅速，而且无法避免。败给那样的敌人并不丢脸。你不是第一个，大概也不会是最后一个。
THOUGH PERHAPS I FIND MYSELF HOPING SOMEONE DOES MANAGE TO SUCCEED IN PUTTING AN END TO IT. IT HAS LIVED WELL BEYOND ITS MEANS, AND PROVES A NUISANCE EVERY TIME IT RE-EMERGES...
不过，也许我发现自己暗暗希望有人能成功终结它。它活得远远超出了它的限度，而且每次重新现身都是个麻烦……
BUT I DIGRESS. NEXT, LET US PERUSE YOUR LIFE'S RECORD. IT IS A FORMALITY, FOR THE MOST PART. ONLY APPLICABLE IF YOU WISH TO RETURN TO THE CYCLE.
不过我扯远了。接下来，我们来翻阅你的生平记录。这大部分只是形式。只有在你希望回归轮回时才适用。
SELFISHLY, HOWEVER, I WOULD URGE YOU TO LINGER A WHILE. IT HAS BEEN SOME TIME SINCE I HAVE HAD GUESTS. YOUR COMPANY WOULD NOT BE UNAPPRECIATED.
不过，我私心希望你能在这里多待一阵子。我已经有段时间没有客人了。你的陪伴不会不受欢迎。
...YOU HAVE TIME TO DECIDE. FOR NOW, WE MAY...
……你有时间决定。现在，我们可以……
HM. HOW VERY INTERESTING. THAT WOULD EXPLAIN SOME THINGS.
嗯。真是非常有意思。这就能解释一些事了。
SOMETHING HAS GONE WRONG. IT WOULD SEEM YOUR SPARK HAS PERSISTED EVEN THROUGH THE VEIL... EVEN THOUGH SUCH A THING SHOULD BE IMPOSSIBLE.
出了差错。看来你的火花即使穿过了帷幕依然存续……尽管这种事本该不可能发生。
IT HAS IMPRINTED ITSELF INTO YOUR VERY ESSENCE... HOW HAS THIS COME TO PASS? COULD IT HAVE BEEN...
它已经烙印进你的本质之中……怎么会变成这样？难道是……
AH. I SEE... THIS COMPLICATES MATTERS.
啊。我明白了……这让事情变复杂了。
I WOULD NOT WISH TO KEEP YOU HERE. IT WOULD NOT BE RIGHT. AND YET, I LACK THE MEANS TO RETURN YOU TO THE LIVING. SUCH AN ACT IS BEYOND MY OWN CAPABILITY.
我不想把你留在这里。那样不对。然而，我没有办法让你回到生者之中。那种事超出了我自己的能力。
WHAT TO DO, WHAT TO DO...
A THOUGHT OCCURS TO ME. THOUGH I LACK THE MEANS MYSELF, THERE IS AN OPTION YET OPEN TO US. A THREAD I MAY REACH OUT AND GRASP.
我想到一个办法。虽然我自己没有这个能力，但我们还有一个选项。一条我可以伸手抓住的线。
THE WRETCHED KROLTON. ITS SPARK IS STRONG, HAVING TAKEN SO MANY LIVES TO MAINTAIN IT. IF IT IS SLAIN, THAT STRENGTH WILL QUICKLY DISPERSE.
那可憎的 Krolton。它的火花很强，靠夺走无数生命才维持至今。一旦它被杀，那股力量很快就会散去。
BUT FOR ONE SHORT MOMENT, IT WILL BE WITHIN MY REACH. AND WITH IT, WE MAY REIGNITE YOUR OWN CRADLED SPARK.
但在那短短的一瞬间，它会落在我可及之处。借着它，我们也许能重新点燃你自己护着的那点火花。
...THIS IS NOT AN ACT I TAKE LIGHTLY. TO TWIST THE CYCLE IN SUCH A WAY... IT IS AGAINST MY VERY NATURE.
……这不是我会轻易做的事。以这种方式扭曲轮回……违背了我的本性。
BUT, SELFISHLY, I FIND MYSELF CARING LESS ABOUT SUCH THINGS AS OF LATE.
但是，出于私心，我发现自己最近越来越不在乎这种事了。
SO IT IS DECIDED. I WILL GRANT YOU PASSAGE BACK BEYOND THE VEIL, WHERE YOU WILL RETURN TO THE BODY YOU HAD LEFT BEHIND.
那就这么决定了。我会准许你穿回帷幕另一边，回到你留下的那具身体里。
THERE, WITH WHAT STRENGTH YOU HAVE, YOU WILL BRING AN END TO THAT HORROR. AND THROUGH THAT END, WE SHALL STAVE OFF YOUR OWN.
在那里，用你拥有的力量，终结那个恐怖之物。而借着它的终结，我们将推迟你自己的终结。
IT WILL TAKE SOME TIME TO PREPARE. IN THE MEANTIME, YOU MAY EXPLORE THE MANSION FURTHER.
准备需要一些时间。在这段时间里，你可以继续探索宅邸。
THERE IS A GAME I HAD SET UP, IN THE OTHER UPSTAIRS ROOM. IT WAS MEANT TO BE A SURPRISE FOR YOU, BUT SINCE YOU WILL BE LEAVING, I SUPPOSE WE MAY PUSH IT FORWARD.
楼上另一个房间里，我准备了一个游戏。本来是要给你的惊喜，不过既然你要离开了，我想我们可以提前。
YES? WHAT ELSE DO YOU NEED?
I SUPPOSE I HAVE GROWN TIRED OF STANDING BY.
我想我是厌倦了袖手旁观。
IT IS DIFFICULT, WATCHING THE WORLD'S FATE UNFOLD, UNABLE TO LIFT EVEN A SINGLE SKELETAL FINGER TO MAKE A DIFFERENCE.
看着世界的命运逐渐展开，却连一根骨头手指都抬不起来做点什么，是很难受的。
YOU DO NOT YET UNDERSTAND, I TAKE IT. FEW EVER WILL. IT IS SOMETHING FAR BEYOND ANY MORTAL'S CAPACITY TO COMPREHEND.
我想你还不明白。很少有人会明白。那远远超出任何凡人所能理解的范围。
I SUSPECT YOU WILL SOMEDAY. I DO NOT BELIEVE IN DESTINY. BUT PERHAPS THIS IS CLOSE ENOUGH.
我猜你总有一天会明白。我不相信命运。但也许这已经够接近了。
IN TRUTH, YOU ARE RATHER FORTUNATE. YOU HAVE FOUND YOURSELF IN THE EXACT SET OF CIRCUMSTANCES TO ALLOW ME TO INTERVENE.
说实话，你相当幸运。你正好处在让我能够介入的那一组情况里。
IT WOULD NOT BE RIGHT TO LET THE OPPORTUNITY PASS ME BY.
放过这个机会是不对的。
IN ANY OTHER CIRCUMSTANCE, I WOULD BE HAPPY TO OBLIGE. A LONG-TERM GUEST IS ALWAYS APPRECIATED IN THESE LONESOME TIMES.
在其他任何情况下，我都会很乐意答应。在这寂寞的时光里，长住的客人总是很受欢迎的。
BUT I CAN NOT. I WILL NOT.
...GO. DO NOT LINGER HERE ANY LONGER.
THE GAME IS IN THE OTHER UPSTAIRS ROOM, ON THE OTHER END OF THE MANSION. I THINK YOU WILL ENJOY IT.
游戏在楼上另一个房间，宅邸的另一头。我想你会喜欢的。
I CANNOT HELP BUT NOTICE YOU ARE STILL HERE. ARE YOU LOST? THE GAME IS READY FOR YOU IN THE OTHER UPSTAIRS ROOM, ON THE OTHER END OF THE MANSION.
我不禁注意到你还在这里。迷路了吗？游戏已经在楼上另一个房间为你准备好了，就在宅邸的另一头。
Find a way to exit the strange realm by looking around the mansion.
在宅邸里四处查看，找到离开这个奇异领域的方法。
WELL, I DID SAY YOU NEED TO BE SITTING ON THE COUCH. THE SCREEN TURNS OFF IF YOU MOVE TOO FAR AWAY. YOU'LL HAVE TO START OVER.
嗯，我确实说过你得坐在沙发上。离得太远屏幕就会关掉。你得重新开始了。
VERY IMPRESSIVE. HOWEVER, THAT WAS MERELY ROUND {~}, OUT OF {~}. EACH ONE WILL BE PROGRESSIVELY MORE DIFFICULT THAN THE LAST. READY?
非常了不起。不过，那仅仅是第 {~} 轮，共 {~} 轮。每一轮都会比上一轮更难。准备好了吗？
AH HA HA. THE LOOK ON YOUR FACE. PRICELESS. GIVEN HOW MY SKULL IS SOLID, MY GUESTS HAVE TO MEET MY FILL OF MAKING FACES FOR ME.
啊哈哈。你脸上那表情。千金难买。毕竟我的头骨是硬的，只能靠客人帮我过足做鬼脸的瘾。
SEEING AS YOU NEED TO LEAVE SOON, I HAVE ELECTED TO CUT THE QUIZ SHOW SHORT. FOR NOW. WE WILL PICK BACK UP WHERE WE LEFT OFF ONCE YOU INEVITABLY RETURN.
既然你很快就得离开，我决定把问答节目缩短。暂时先这样，等你不可避免地回来时，我们再从中断的地方继续。
...WAS IT ENJOYABLE? I HAD PUT A GREAT DEAL OF WORK INTO IT.
……好玩吗？我花了很多心思准备的。
I AM GLAD. I PUT A LOT OF TIME INTO ENSURING MY GUESTS ARE ENTERTAINED HERE.
那我就放心了。我花了很多时间确保我的客人在这里玩得开心。
I SEE. VERY WELL. YOUR FEEDBACK IS APPRECIATED. I WILL HAVE TO MAKE SOME REVISIONS.
我明白了。好吧。感谢你的意见。我得做些修改了。
THEN THAT IS ALL. IF ONLY YOU COULD STAY LONGER- I DO ENJOY ACTIVITIES WITH LUCID GUESTS. BOOK CLUBS, LITTLE PARADES... BUT IT WILL HAVE TO WAIT.
那就这样了。要是你能多待一会儿就好了——我很喜欢跟清醒的客人一起活动。读书会、小游行……不过只能等以后了。
NOW. THIS MANOR HASN'T GOT A BACK DOOR, SO I WILL NEED TO MAKE ONE FOR YOU TO EXIT. EXCUSE THE NOISE FOR A MOMENT, AND TAKE THE NEW EXIT ANY TIME YOU LIKE.
好了。这座庄园没有后门，所以我得给你开一个出口。请稍微忍耐一下噪音，随时都可以从新出口离开。
SO. THERE YOU GO, WALKING BACK INTO THE LONG DREAM OF LIFE.
那么，你就这样走回生命那场漫长的梦里了。
IT WAS A SHORT STAY. BUT, I DID ENJOY HAVING YOU HERE. I ALWAYS DO LIKE THE GUESTS WHO CAN SEE ME FOR WHAT I AM.
虽然停留得很短。但我确实很高兴有你来。我一向喜欢能看清我真面目的客人。
THE CIRCUMSTANCES HAVE NEVER ALIGNED FOR A GUEST TO LEAVE THIS WAY. TYPICALLY, THEY WILL MOVE ON AND EVENTUALLY RETURN TO THE CYCLE.
从来没有哪位客人碰上能以这种方式离开的时机。通常，他们会继续前行，最终回归轮回。
SO IN A WAY, THIS CANNOT BE CALLED A "GOODBYE." AH HA HA. NO, INSTEAD IT IS A "SEE YOU SOON."
所以某种意义上，这不能叫“再见”。啊哈哈。不，这应该叫“待会见”。
Defeat Krolton to earn your way back to the living.
击败 Krolton，赢得回到生者之中的机会。
...ONE LAST THING. YOU HAVE NOT YET ENTIRELY REINTEGRATED INTO YOUR BODY.
……最后一件事。你还没有完全回到你的身体里。
AS SUCH, FOR THE TIME BEING, MORTALITY IS MERELY A SUGGESTION. SO BE AS RECKLESS AS YOU WANT.
因此，暂时来说，死亡对你只是个建议。所以尽管放手去莽吧。
SO LONG AS THE HORROR DIES, NO MATTER THE CAUSE, IT WILL BE ENOUGH FOR OUR NEEDS. REMEMBER THAT.
只要那个恐怖之物死了，不管是怎么死的，都足以满足我们的需要。记住这一点。
AND THERE SHALL I DECLARE IT BE DONE. THE HORROR'S SPARK UNWOVEN.. AND YOU, BODY, SOUL, SPARK, KNITTED BACK TOGETHER. A NEW PATCH FOR THE TAPESTRY OF YOUR LIFE.
那么我在此宣告，一切已了结。恐怖之物的火花已被拆解……而你，身体、灵魂、火花，重新缝合为一。为你人生的挂毯补上一块新布。
IT WAS NICE TO SEE THIS PLACE IN PERSON AGAIN, EVEN IF I WAS ONLY VISITING FOR A MOMENT. BUT NOW I MUST RETURN TO MY OWN BUSINESS.
能再次亲眼看看这个地方真好，就算我只是来一会儿。但现在我得回去忙我自己的事了。
THIS MEANS FAREWELL, FOR THE TIME BEING. WHEN WE NEXT MEET, YOU WILL HAVE REACHED YOUR FINAL END.
这意味着暂时道别了。下次我们见面时，你就已经走到最终的终点了。
TIL THEN, TREASURE YOUR LIFE AS YOU LIVE IT TO THE FULLEST. I LOOK FORWARD TO SHARING STORIES OVER TEA, AH HA HA.
在那之前，好好珍惜你的人生，把它活得淋漓尽致。我期待着跟你边喝茶边分享故事，啊哈哈。
Take proof of Krolton's demise to Irlok at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
把 Krolton 已死的证据带给 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Irlok
Oh, thank goodness. You've returned- not free of wear, but certainly alive. Did you need to flee from Krolton, or is he...?

Bantisu 寺欠你一个大人情。来吧——这是一份相称的奖赏。

一件强大的 Bantisu 宝物，奖赏你打败了那头在远古时代肆虐的野兽。

一路平安，人类。无论让你获胜的是运气还是力量，我都祈祷它将来不会辜负你。
THIS BOOK IS SO BAD, EVEN THE LONG-WINDED AND PAINFUL DEATH OF SWEENEY S. GREENVILLE IS BETTER THAN THIS.
这本书烂到连 Sweeney S. Greenville 那漫长又痛苦的死法都比它好看。
I SHOULD THINK IT IS QUITE RUDE TO PLAY A HOST'S GAME WITHOUT HAVING SPOKEN TO THEM FIRST. PLEASE COME TO MY OFFICE.
我认为，没有先跟主人打过招呼就玩人家的游戏，相当无礼。请到我的办公室来。
OH, THE REMOTE CAN BE FIDDLY. YOU NEED TO BE SITTING ON THE COUCH FOR IT TO WORK.
哦，那支遥控器有点难搞。你得坐在沙发上它才管用。
YOU HAVE YOUR TASK, AND FOR THE MOMENT, YOU BEAR MY PITH. SLAY THE CANYON HORROR KROLTON, AND THEN I MAY BREAK THE RULES FOR YOU, JUST THIS ONCE.
你有你的任务，而此刻你承载着我的要旨。去杀掉峡谷的恐怖之物 Krolton，那么我或许会为你破例，就这一次。
You feel... alive again. Everything feels just as it did before you died.
你觉得……自己又活了。一切都和你死前一模一样。
Well, the job is done. You should tell Irlok the good news...
好了，事情办完了。你该把好消息告诉 Irlok……
You are truly an amazing warrior. Thank you for putting an end to Krolton.
你真是个了不起的战士。谢谢你终结了 Krolton。
...did all of that actually just happen?
...though, maybe you'll avoid mentioning your death. That would be weird.
……不过，你大概还是别提自己死过一回比较好。那样太奇怪了。
That orc ran towards the lake!! Get it, get it before it runs someplace else!!
那个兽人往湖那边跑了！！快追，快追啊，别让他又逃到别处去！！

与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 平原上的 Piere 交谈

向 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Jackson 侦探报告这次袭击
