However, there's a loophole in the ceasefire we had enacted with the Orcs. Theft isn't considered an act of aggression...
可是，我们跟兽人签的停火协议里有个漏洞。偷窃不算是侵略行为……
Searching the camps one by one will be far too slow, gah!! How am I going to fix this?!
一个个营地去搜太慢了，啊！！我到底要怎么解决这件事？！
Jackson is twiddling his thumbs off to the southeast. Just continue past my farm!
Jackson 正在东南边闲得发慌呢。过了我的农场继续走就是！
Poxper? That...hm. This could be bad. I've heard that name, and he's a fairly prolific Orc chief. You killed him, right?
Poxper？那……嗯。这可能不太妙。我听过这个名字，他是个相当有名的兽人酋长。你把他杀了，对吧？
Brr... It's a little bit cold out there, don't you think?
呼……外头有点冷，你不觉得吗？
Welcome back to our humble little town!
欢迎回到我们这座不起眼的小镇！
Talk to Tarod in {p}'s Forest at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 森林里的 Tarod 对话
You're one of those soldier types, right? My name is Tarod, and I could really use your assistance here.
你是当兵的，对吧？我叫 Tarod，我真的很需要你的帮助。
Years ago, I met a very powerful and legendary warrior by the name of Bob. Yes, that Bob.
多年前，我认识了一位非常强大的传奇战士，他叫 Bob。对，就是那个 Bob。
It's safe to say he was a very, well, admirable man. Him and I slowly became close friends over the years.
可以说他是个，嗯，非常令人敬佩的人。这些年来，我和他慢慢成了好朋友。
That is, until one night, he vanished without a trace. The accepted story is that he was murdered by a pack of ravenous wolves...
直到有一天晚上，他消失得无影无踪。大家公认的说法是他被一群饥饿的狼杀死了……
Now, I don't buy that story, but... look, the point here is that he's gone now, and I want to find out where the hell he ended up. That depressing zombie lumbering around {p} clearly isn't him.
我才不信那个说法，不过……听着，重点是他现在不在了，而我想弄清楚他到底去了哪里。在 {p} 附近晃来晃去的那个忧郁僵尸显然不是他。
I believe he died in this area, and I have been looking for his body for quite a while now, with... less than success.
我相信他死在这一带，我找他的遗体已经找了好一阵子了，结果……不太成功。
Rumors have spread that a tomb lies somewhere east of {p}, but I've never been able to find it. This is where I need you to help me out, yeah?
有传言说 {p} 东边某处有一座古墓，但我一直没能找到。这就需要你帮我了，好吗？
Do you think you could help me out here? Search around that area, and report back to me if you see anything noteworthy.
你觉得你能帮我吗？在那一带找找，看到值得注意的东西就回来告诉我。
I'd be eternally grateful if you could help me uncover my old friend's true story.
如果你能帮我揭开我老朋友的真实故事，我会永远感激你。
Report what you've found to Tarod at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
把你的发现报告给 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Tarod
Welcome back. Did you find anything worthwhile?
欢迎回来。找到什么有价值的东西了吗？
Oh? Yeah, that definitely sounds like the tomb! Were you able to see what's inside?
哦？对，那听起来肯定就是那座墓！你看得到里面有什么吗？
No? There's... a magical barrier? Great... just GREAT...
看不到？有……一道魔法屏障？好极了……简直太好了……
I have a feeling whoever made that tomb didn't want anyone attempting to get to him, but... Forget it, we have no other options. This is the only way we can place Bob's soul to rest for good.
我有种感觉，建那座墓的人不想让任何人去找他，不过……算了，我们别无选择。只有这样才能让 Bob 的灵魂永远安息。
Listen, I have a guy who can help us out. His name is Wedyf, a sorcerer type. If anyone could get rid of that barrier, it would be him.
听着，我认识一个能帮我们的人。他叫 Wedyf，是个术士之类的。如果有谁能除掉那道屏障，那就是他了。
He lives in {p}, a small town close to {p}. Go meet him, I'll wait for your return.
他住在 {p}，一个离 {p} 很近的小镇。去找他吧，我等你回来。
Talk to the sorcerer Wedyf in {p}.
与 {p} 的术士 Wedyf 对话。
Welcome traveler. Are you looking for something?
欢迎你，旅人。你在找什么吗？
Ooh, it has been a long time since I've released an undead...
哦，我已经很久没有释放过亡灵了……
The spirit of your dead friend must still be somewhere in this world. This is why we are unable to get close to his body. Soul magic works in mysterious ways.
你那位死去的朋友的灵魂一定还在这个世界的某处。所以我们才没法靠近他的遗体。灵魂魔法运作的方式很神秘。
Don't worry, I can do it. I've heard a little bit of Bob's story before. What a tragedy. His own infallible protection used against him...
别担心，我办得到。我听说过一点 Bob 的故事。真是悲剧。他自己那道万无一失的守护，反而被用来对付他……
...Anyways, there's no need to lament on the past. Now, we need two items. The first is something from Bob himself. The other is the last thing that made his blood drop.
……总之，不必感叹过去了。现在我们需要两样东西。第一样是 Bob 本人的东西。另一样是最后让他流血的东西。
Out past the other side of {p} there are two farm houses with an old cave inbetween then. An old florist used to live there, she has a rose that Bob had once cut himself on.
在 {p} 的另一边，有两栋农舍，中间夹着一个旧洞窟。以前有个老花匠住在那里，她有一朵 Bob 曾经割伤过自己的玫瑰。
I will warn you, though; she was corrupted some time ago. It may not be that easy to take the rose, so do be prepared.
不过我得警告你；她前阵子被腐化了。要拿到那朵玫瑰可能没那么容易，所以一定要做好准备。

Secondly... something of Bob's. I've heard rumors of a visage of him wandering around {p}, perhaps you can find something of use from it? Killing enemies in the {p} region may be worth your time, as well.
其次……Bob 的东西。我听说有个他的幻影在 {p} 附近游荡，也许你能从它身上找到有用的东西？在 {p} 地区击杀敌人也许也值得一试。
Bring me [{~} Rose] and [{~} Bob's Tear].
给我带来 [{~} 玫瑰] 和 [{~} Bob 的眼泪]。
Bring [{~} Bob's Tear] from {p} and [{~} Rose] from the house in the {p} forest around [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to Wedyf
把来自 {p} 的 [{~1} Bob 的眼泪]，以及 {p} 森林中 [{~3}, {~4}, -{~5}] 附近房子里的 [{~2} 玫瑰] 带给 Wedyf
Although... I might have forgot to tell you about something else too...
不过……我可能还忘了跟你说另一件事……
We also need a part of the soul of your dead friend.
我们还需要你那位死去的朋友的一部分灵魂。
This is something I unfortunately cannot do myself. There is a blacksmith close to {p} who does this kind of stuff.
可惜这件事我自己办不到。{p} 附近有个铁匠专门做这种事。
He can extract the soul from someone's weapon. Very useful in those situations. Go talk to him.
他能从一个人的武器里提取灵魂。在这种情况下非常有用。去跟他谈谈吧。
Bring me the soul, and I'll be able to remove the spell preventing you from entering the tomb.
把灵魂带来给我，我就能解除阻止你进入墓穴的法术。
Talk to the blacksmith in the small settlement southwest of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] about Bob's lost soul
到 {p} 西南边 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的小聚落，与铁匠谈谈 Bob 失落的灵魂
What can I do for ya?
Oh yes! I can extract the soul from weapons!
噢，对！我能从武器里提取灵魂！
Bring me the weapons of your friend, and I'll see if I can do something with it!
把你朋友的武器带来给我，我看看能不能处理！
Oh it's... those weapons. Well, if you know what you're doing...
哦，是……那些武器啊。好吧，如果你知道自己在做什么的话……
[{~} Depressing Stick], [{~} Depressing Spear], [{~} Depressing Bow] and [{~} Depressing Shears] will do the trick.
[{~} Depressing Stick]、[{~} Depressing Spear]、[{~} Depressing Bow] 和 [{~} Depressing Shears] 就行了。
Be careful with the weapons, you will only get [ONE] of each. If you lose one, you will have to ask around if anyone has a spare.
小心保管那些武器，每样你都只会拿到 [一件]。弄丢了的话，就得到处问问有没有人有多的。
Maybe someone will be selling one on the Trade Market in {p}, who knows.
说不定有人会在 {p} 的交易市场上卖，谁知道呢。
My apprentice over there has traveled around a lot, they might know where the items are, but I warn you, they are a little bit quirky.
那边我的学徒去过很多地方，他们也许知道那些东西在哪，不过我先提醒你，他们有点古怪。
Weapons of the depressed kind? Oh, of course, of course, I know of the set! Around {p}, I hear they are kept.
忧郁那一类的武器？噢，当然，当然，我知道那一套！听说就收在 {p} 附近。
An army of Linx you must clear, in a cave you shall find this spear!
清掉一整支 Linx 大军，洞窟里的长矛才归你身！
To a skilled archer you must go, best her in a lumberyard and you will have her bow!
去找一位神射手，伐木场里赢过她，弓就到你手！
On an altar, effervescence leers, complete the sacrifice and you will gain your shears...
祭坛之上，泡沫窥望，完成献祭，剪刀奉上……
In the forest, a house frozen in spikes thick, outsmart the contraption and be gifted a stick!
森林里一栋屋，冻在厚厚尖刺中，智胜那机关，棍子送你手中！
But beware, beware! Danger lies ahead, and will try to halt you in your stead!
不过当心，当心！前方危险重重，会想方设法把你拦停！
Bring [{~} Depressing Stick], [{~} Depressing Spear], [{~} Depressing Bow] and [{~} Depressing Shear] to the Blacksmith.
把 [{~} Depressing Stick]、[{~} Depressing Spear]、[{~} Depressing Bow] 和 [{~} Depressing Shear] 带给铁匠。
I've just been hangin' down here working on my teleportation device. The teleporters got partially frozen over, but I'm pretty damn sure they still work.
我一直待在这下面研究我的传送装置。传送器有一部分被冻住了，不过我非常确定它们还能用。
Hey, if you want to test it out, be my guest! You can use the teleporter core next to me to start it.
嘿，如果你想试试，请便！你可以用我旁边的传送核心来启动它。
Right click with it while on the center of the iced over teleporter chamber, and it will teleport you in a direction over to the next chamber.
站在冰封传送室的正中央，手持它点击右键，它就会把你往某个方向传送到下一个传送室。
It will then teleport you again in a direction {~} degrees clockwise, and it will keep doin' that forever.
然后它会再把你往顺时针转 {~} 度的方向传送，而且会一直这样传下去。
Some of the ice walls have holes in them, and I believe if you use the teleporter core correctly you will be able to make it to the other side where the gold platform is.
有些冰墙上有洞，我相信只要正确使用传送核心，你就能到达另一边的金色平台。
The core is unstable, though, and it will break if you run too far away. Keep that in mind, yeah?
不过核心不稳定，你跑太远它就会坏。记住这点，好吗？

Oh, and I left an old wand of mine down at the gold platform. The thing was very depressing, though, so it ain't too much of an issue. But hey, if you can get to it, it's all yours, bud, free of cost!
噢，还有，我在金色平台那里留了一根旧魔杖。那东西很让人忧郁，所以丢了也没什么大不了。不过嘿，如果你拿得到，就归你了，伙计，免费！
... Hi again. I see you got the weapons.
……又见面了。看来你拿到那些武器了。
These weapons emanate so much sadness... I'm sure you heard about Bob's story...
这些武器散发着好浓的悲伤……我相信你听说过 Bob 的故事了……
Here is the soul. It's a little bit crushed, but it can do the trick.
灵魂在这里。有点碎了，不过应该还管用。
Good luck on your quest. Bob was a great hero, anything to help him is good in my book.
祝你任务顺利。Bob 是位伟大的英雄，在我看来，任何帮他的事都是好事。
Bring back [{~} Bob's Crushed Soul] to Wedyf.
把 [{~} Bob 破碎的灵魂] 带回给 Wedyf。
I'm glad to see you again.
I only need a part of the soul, you can keep the rest.
我只需要一部分灵魂，剩下的你可以留着。
Give me a minute, I need to concentrate...
给我一分钟，我需要集中精神……
It is done. You should be able to enter the tomb now. Be careful.
完成了。你现在应该能进入墓穴了。小心点。
Find Bob's corpse in his tomb.
在墓穴里找到 Bob 的遗体。
Report back what you've seen to Tarod
回去向 Tarod 报告你看到的一切
You're back... Has he... has he finally been put to rest?
你回来了……他……他终于安息了吗？
It's... hard to hear, knowing that my old friend is really gone, this time, but... I'm happy he won't have to suffer on this war-torn world for another second.
这……很难接受，知道我的老朋友这次真的走了，但是……我很高兴他不必再在这个饱受战火摧残的世界上多受一秒的苦。

...I want you to have something. This is his old battle chesplate; he gave it to me a few days before he vanished. I think if he were still here, he'd want you to have this. Please, take good care of it for me...
……我想送你一样东西。这是他的旧战斗胸甲；他在消失前几天把它交给了我。我想如果他还在，他会希望你拥有它。请替我好好珍惜……
Out past the other side of {p}, near {p}, there are some arches in the mountains. An old florist lives in a house close by. She has a rose that Bob had once cut himself on.
在 {p} 的另一边，{p} 附近的山里有几座石拱。旁边的房子里住着一位老花匠，她有一朵 Bob 曾经割伤过自己的玫瑰。
Anyway, my apprentice over there has traveled around a lot, they might know where you can find the items for yourself, but I warn you, they are a little bit quirky.
总之，那边我的学徒去过很多地方，他们也许知道你能去哪里自己找到那些东西，不过我先提醒你，他们有点古怪。
Hi! My name is Batelu, I've been studying those strange symbols on the walls for quite a while now.
嗨！我叫 Batelu，我研究墙上那些奇怪的符号已经有好一阵子了。
I've learned a lot about Bob. Unfortunately, I do not think I am the person you are looking for.
我对 Bob 了解了不少。可惜，我想我不是你要找的人。
If you are looking for Bob's corpse, it's under the stairs in the icy chamber. Talk to me when you are level {~}, I've got some work for you.
如果你在找 Bob 的遗体，就在冰室的楼梯下面。等你到 {~} 级再来找我，我有些活要交给你。
Thank you for your help. I'm sure Bob thanks you too... wherever he is.
谢谢你的帮助。我相信 Bob 也在感谢你……不管他现在在哪里。
The door is locked, but there should be a key around here somewhere...
门锁着，不过这附近应该有钥匙才对……
Were it not for our teachings, I would not let you set even one singular toe upon this holy ground after what you did.
若不是我们的教义摆在那里，凭你做过的事，我连一根脚趾都不会让你踏上这片圣地。
Hey! Don't put that down there—
If you could go to {p} and see if Drucksh has the will, I would be forever in your debt, pal.
如果你能去 {p} 看看 Drucksh 手上有没有遗嘱，我会永远欠你一份人情，伙计。
嗯嗯呃……啊呜……还要……呃……更多……
There must be something around here that could make him talk...
这附近一定有什么东西能让他开口……
You may have forgotten already, but I unfortunately must inform you that your brother is indeed dead.
你可能已经忘了，但很遗憾，我必须告诉你，你哥哥确实已经死了。
As I already told you, your brother is dead and buried. It's not like—
我已经说过了，你哥哥已经死了，也下葬了。又不是说——
They've what!? Holy Bovine! It's even worse than I feared!
他们干了什么！？神圣的牛啊！比我担心的还要糟！
You find the will tucked into an inner pocket of Sayleros' brother's crumbling tunic.
你在 Sayleros 哥哥那件破烂外衣的内袋里找到了那份遗嘱。
The exit seems to be opening...
Please, take these as proof of my gratitude, pal. You really helped us out, in more ways than one.
请收下这些，当作我的谢意，伙计。你真的帮了我们大忙，而且不止一方面。
The obelisk does not react to your touch. [Req: {p} Trouble]
方尖碑对你的触碰毫无反应。[需求: {p} 风波]
前往 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Sayleros 交谈。
Oh, hello there, adventurer! I was just looking for someone like you! My name is Sayleros. I lived in {p} my whole life, but recently decided to move to {p}.
哦，你好啊，冒险者！我正在找像你这样的人！我叫 Sayleros。我一辈子都住在 {p}，不过最近决定搬去 {p}。
You see, my older brother just passed. I would have taken care of it, if only I weren't so busy with the move!
你看，我哥哥刚过世。要不是我忙着搬家，我早就亲自处理了！
I had to leave it all to my younger brother, Drucksh. He's still in {p}, but well, he's not the most reliable...
我只好把一切都交给我弟弟 Drucksh。他还在 {p}，不过，嗯，他不是最靠得住的人……
My older brother had amassed quite some wealth before he passed. He should have left us part of it in his will, only I don't exactly trust Drucksh to handle it...
我哥哥过世前攒了不少钱。他应该在遗嘱里给我们留了一部分，只是我不太放心让 Drucksh 来处理……
Drucksh shouldn't be hard to find, he usually spends his time in the bar in {p}. Just follow this road out of {p} to get there.
Drucksh 应该不难找，他平常都泡在 {p} 的酒吧里。沿着这条路走出 {p} 就到了。
Find Drucksh at the bar in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 {p} 的酒吧 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找到 Drucksh。
Thanks again for doing this, pal. Just follow this road out of {p} to get to {p}, Drucksh's usually at the bar there.
再次谢谢你帮这个忙，伙计。沿着这条路走出 {p} 就能到 {p}，Drucksh 通常都在那里的酒吧。
Aauuughh... s-something... mmmmgh... to... drink... aaaughh...
啊呜呃……喝、喝的……呃呃……给我……喝的……啊呃……
Find a way to make Drucksh tell you about the will.
想办法让 Drucksh 告诉你遗嘱的事。
Anythin' is possible. If ya have [{~} Emeralds] to spare, that is.
什么都有可能。前提是你有 [{~} 绿宝石] 可以花。
One {p} Whiskey, shipwrecked against the rocks, comin' right up.
一杯 {p} 威士忌，加冰触礁，马上来。
Hey, Drucksh. Hey, can you hear me? Hey!
This nice fella got ya a drink. A {p} Whiskey, yer favourite.
这位好心人请你喝一杯。{p} 威士忌，你最爱的。
Hey! They paid for yer drink, ya know. Ya could at least try to be courteous.
嘿！人家可是请你喝了酒的。你至少可以客气一点吧。
Oh, s-shut up. I c-can pay for my own drinks!
哦，闭、闭嘴。我自、自己付得起酒钱！
Well, call me if ya need anythin' else.
好吧，还需要什么就叫我。
Yeah, there ain't no will, pal. After brother died, those Bovemists came and picked 'im up.
是啊，根本没有什么遗嘱，伙计。哥哥死了之后，那些牛神信徒就来把他接走了。
Gave 'im a proper funeral and everything. Shame my dear, oh so dear brother couldn't attend. What kind of person can't be there for their own brother's funeral, y'know?
给他办了个像样的葬礼什么的。可惜我那亲爱的、噢那么亲爱的兄弟没能来参加。什么样的人会连自己兄弟的葬礼都不到场啊，你说是吧？
Well, I couldn't be there either, bein' here and all, but that's besides the point...
嗯，我也没去啦，毕竟我在这里嘛，不过那不是重点……
Anyway, the Bishop gave me a bit of money for my troubles and sent me on my merry way. Then, I ended up here, and haven't left since!
总之，主教给了我一点钱当辛苦费，就打发我走了。然后我就跑来这里，一直没离开过！
So, as I already told you... There ain't no will, pal! Forget it.
所以，就像我刚才说的……根本没有什么遗嘱，伙计！算了吧。
是 Sayleros 跟我说有的。
W-what? Sayleros told you about a will, a-and about money too, t-that brother left us?
什、什么？Sayleros 跟你说有遗嘱，还、还说哥哥给我们留了钱？
So then why did the Bishop...
S-stop! Hold your horses... That would mean...
等、等等！先别急……那就代表……
Hey, soldier! We're leaving, right now! W-we're gonna find that will!
嘿，士兵！我们走，马上走！我、我们去找那份遗嘱！
Speak to the Bishop Kaideus in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
前往 {p} 的 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Kaideus 主教交谈。
Yes, yes. A little more to the right! Hurry!
Hey! Priest man, guy, whatever! Where's my brother!
嘿！神父大人、老兄、随便啦！我哥哥在哪！
Oh, it's you. For your information, the proper term of address is your excellency.
噢，是你。告诉你，正确的称呼是“阁下”。
Y-yes, I know all that, y-your priestliness. But where's my brother? I want to see 'im.
是、是，这些我都知道，神、神父大人。可是我哥哥在哪？我想见他。
You! Talk some sense into your, um, friend here. We buried his brother in the crypt here some time ago.
你！劝劝你这位，呃，朋友。我们前阵子已经把他哥哥葬在这里的地穴了。
Now, please leave this peaceful house of worship, you're causing a ruckus. I have some quite important business to attend to, you see.
现在，请离开这座安宁的圣殿，你们太吵了。你看，我还有相当重要的事要处理。
Hey! I'm not leaving without my brother! No way, pal!
嘿！不带着我哥哥我是不会走的！门都没有，伙计！
Holy Bovine! It's even worse than I feared!
神圣的牛啊！比我担心的还要糟！
You, soldier! You better not stick your nose in this! It's not for the likes of you to mess with the affairs of the church!
你，士兵！你最好别插手！教会的事轮不到你这种人来管！
Now's our chance, pal! Go find my brother in the crypts! I-I'll stay behind, guarding the rear!
机会来了，伙计！去地穴找我哥哥！我、我留在后面断后！
Enter the crypt at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find Sayleros' Brother.
进入 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的墓穴，找到 Sayleros 的哥哥。
You better not stick your nose in this, soldier! It's not for the likes of you to mess with the affairs of the church!
你最好别插手，士兵！教会的事轮不到你这种人来管！
Don't ask me about anything! I just work here!
什么都别问我！我只是在这里干活的！
Open the door at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] using the Crypt Basement Key.
用 Crypt Basement Key 打开 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的门。
Open the door at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] using the Sealed Crypt Key.
用 Sealed Crypt Key 打开 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的门。
Bring back Sayleros' brother's will to [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
把 Sayleros 哥哥的遗嘱带回 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
As I've already told you a thousand times, I don't know what will you're talking about! Besides, I don't have the time for this!
我已经跟你说过一千遍了，我不知道你在说什么遗嘱！况且，我没时间陪你耗！
你、你回来了！找到他了吗？
I certainly hope you didn't use the usual methods of your sort...
我真心希望你没用你们那种人惯用的手段……
... B-brother! What are y-you doing here?
Drucksh! Likewise, what are you doing here?
Drucksh！我也想问，你怎么在这里？
W-well... I-I thought I'd take responsibility for our family for once...
那、那个……我、我想说这次我也该为我们家负点责任……
I thought I wouldn't live to see the day! Here I was, worried Drucksh wouldn't cooperate, but it seems like the two of you've got it all under control after all.
我还以为我这辈子都看不到这一天！我还在担心 Drucksh 不肯配合，结果看来你们两个早就把事情处理妥当了。
Under control!? This... This... renegade stormed into the crypts and k-k-killed your brother!
处理妥当！？这个……这个……叛徒闯进地穴，还杀、杀、杀了你们的哥哥！
He's our brother, your priestliness! Let us w-worry about 'im and you can worry about your great cow in the sky, or whatever it is.
他是我们的哥哥，神父大人！他的事让我、我们来操心，你去操心你那头天上的大母牛还是什么的吧。
That's right, your priestliness! Here, I'll take the will.
没错，神父大人！来，遗嘱我收下了。
Hey, brother, why don't we head to the ol' watering hole. For old brother's sake.
嘿，兄弟，我们去老地方喝一杯吧。为了老哥。
Well, i-if it's for his sake, then I c-can hardly refuse, can I?
嗯，如、如果是为了他，那我可就推、推辞不了了，对吧？
Hey soldier! That's quite the gear you're lugging around. Anything I can do for you?
嘿，士兵！你扛着的装备可真不少。有什么我能帮你的吗？
Oh, really? I don't think I've seen you before, but I'm not so good with faces, especially armoured ones! I'm new to Wynn, just came through on the caravan. The name's Alfe, and yours?
噢，是吗？我好像没见过你，不过我不太会认脸，尤其是穿着盔甲的脸！我刚来 Wynn，跟着商队过来的。我叫 Alfe，你呢？
{u}, huh? I think I've heard of you somewhere... Laen was regaling stories at the {p} bar, you helped them find some old book, yeah? And I think the Bishop mentioned...
{u}，是吧？我好像在哪听说过你……Laen 在 {p} 的酒吧里讲了一堆故事，你帮他们找到了一本旧书，对吧？而且我想主教也提过……
You! Back again to cause more mayhem, are we?
No need to be so hostile, your excellency! We were just discussing our time here in Wynn. {u} here even helped Laen find an old book of theirs, did you know that?
不用这么敌视嘛，阁下！我们只是在聊在 Wynn 的日子。{u} 还帮 Laen 找到了他们的一本旧书，你知道吗？
Hm... Well, you certainly are not, my young apprentice. That much is true...
嗯……好吧，你肯定不是，我年轻的学徒。这点倒是没错……
Right, {u}! We could really use your help here, isn't that right Kaideus?
对了，{u}！我们这里真的很需要你帮忙，对吧，Kaideus？
Another pair of hands on the task wouldn't hurt, you are right about that...
多一双手帮忙也没什么坏处，这点你说得对……
Fine! You may inspect the texts, but only if you are very, very careful.
好吧！你可以检查这些文献，但必须非常、非常小心。
Well, you see {u}! I've been in {p} for the past little while helping to protect the city. But after Kaideus here stumbled across a shelf of old records I came here to help sort and clean them.
嗯，你看，{u}！我之前在 {p} 待了一阵子，帮忙守卫城市。不过自从 Kaideus 发现了一架子的旧记录，我就来这里帮忙整理和清理。
They're positively ancient! It's all nonsense to me, but Laen says they must be over a thousand years old!
它们真的非常古老！我是完全看不懂，不过 Laen 说它们一定有一千多年的历史了！
You recruits are much to excitable, but she is right. Having dedicated my life to this cathedral, I have not been afforded the opportunity to see much of the world beyond these plains.
你们这些新兵太容易激动了，不过她说得对。我把一生都奉献给了这座大教堂，没有机会去看看这片平原以外的世界。
So, {u}, why don't you take a look? You've traveled quite a bit, perhaps even to the lands described within. I may not like your methods, but perhaps, just this once, they may prove useful.
所以，{u}，你何不看看？你去过不少地方，说不定还去过文献里描述的土地。我也许不喜欢你的做法，但也许就这一次，它们能派上用场。
Well then, what would you like to read?
There's only a razor-sharp rock here. Nothing particularly useful... yet.
这里只有一块锋利如刀的石头。没什么特别的用处……暂时还没有。
Great work! Looks like you won't turn out like those rich old {p} folk after all!
干得好！看来你终究不会变成那些有钱的 {p} 老家伙嘛！
Okay! That's step one complete. Now, the most important thing for any horse trainer - Feeding them of course.
好！第一步完成了。接下来是每个驯马师最重要的事，当然就是喂它们啦。
Well! Enough of that. Come with me!
They will keep improving and getting stronger as you keep them in their enclosure. Just, just make sure they are well fed!
只要把它们养在围栏里，它们就会不断成长、越来越强。只是，只是一定要把它们喂饱！
Let's get started then! Make sure to remember what I'm about to tell you.
那就开始吧！我接下来说的话一定要记住。
This here is a Feeder, which will be your best friend for raising these beauties.
这是喂食器，养大这些小可爱全靠它了。
Ah! Ah! No entry without a medal-
Did you have any more questions before I take my leave?
在我离开之前，你还有什么问题吗？
Then, let me tell you a story about losing your identity in the {p}. About burning your medallion.
那么，让我给你讲个故事，关于在 {p} 失去自我，关于烧掉你的徽章。
You pick up the medallion off the changeling's corpse.
你从易形者的尸体上捡起那枚徽章。
I'll be about! Just come find me if you need my assistance.
我就在附近！需要帮忙就来找我。
新任务开始: 燃尽的羁绊
The child might even become more powerful than the adults, who knows!
说不定这孩子会比大人还强呢，谁知道！
与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Abramod 交谈。
Halt, stranger! If you value your life, do not take another step forward.
站住，陌生人！如果你珍惜性命，就别再往前走一步。
I have nothing left to give you! Leave, you and your kindred!
我已经没有东西能给你了！走开，你和你的同类！
You're completely unscathed? You must be powerful indeed, no changeling could defeat you.
你毫发无伤？你一定真的很强大，没有哪个易形者打得过你。
Still though, I have nothing for you. I even lack a medallion to prove my own identity...
不过，我还是没有东西能给你。我连能证明自己身份的徽章都没有……
Ah, you have lost yours too? Kindred spirits we are, dead to our worlds!
啊，你的也丢了？原来我们是同类，在各自的世界里都已是死人！
Lost to my clan, dead to my family, assumed to be a brute beast of the worst sort... I am sure you can understand, being in the same state as myself?
被氏族遗弃，被家人当成死人，被当成最恶劣的野兽……你和我处境一样，一定能明白吧？

It is some small comfort to find one in the same situation as myself. I will not pry into you, I know the value of secrets as well as anyone. But please, will you allow me a measure of catharsis and lend an empathetic ear so I may tell my tale?
能遇到和我处境相同的人，也算是个小小的安慰。我不会打探你的事，我和任何人一样明白秘密的价值。但是，你能让我倾吐一下，好好听我讲讲我的故事吗？
You have returned! Now, are you willing to take a moment to listen to my tale?
你回来了！那么，你愿意花点时间听我讲故事吗？
The forest here is safe, I ought to return home.
这里的森林很安全，我该回家了。
Abramod... I want to come home now.
If you give me your medallion, I can be with you again.
如果你把你的徽章给我，我就能再跟你在一起了。
If you can't show me your medallion, how could I know you are really you?
如果你拿不出你的徽章，我怎么知道你真的是你？
There are creatures that take the shape of any man, and they want to kill us! It would be ignorant to not take it with you!
有些生物能变成任何人的样子，它们想杀了我们！不随身带着徽章就太无知了！
Give me your medallion. I can become one of you.
把你的徽章给我。我就能变成你们的一员。
You are not Lishvil. And judging by that, he disposed of his before you could get to it.
你不是 Lishvil。看样子，他在你拿到之前就把自己的毁掉了。
If it means you won't deceive my clan, I'll burn my medallion, like Lishvil did! You can kill me, but you will never be me!
如果这样你就骗不了我的氏族，那我就像 Lishvil 一样烧掉我的徽章！你可以杀了我，但你永远成不了我！
Hyup! There, if you want it so bad, go get it!
嘿呀！好了，你那么想要，就自己去拿吧！
That is my story. It is unfortunate it cannot have a happier ending, unless...
这就是我的故事。可惜没法有个更快乐的结局，除非……
I do know how to make a new medallion, but it is a difficult task. Collecting the materials required for it would be more dangerous for my frail body than fending for myself out here...
我知道怎么做新的徽章，但这件事很难。以我虚弱的身体，去收集需要的材料，比待在这里自己谋生还危险……
With you however, we might be able to gather them. If you prove yourself trustworthy, I could even help you make one as well. How does that sound?
不过有你的话，我们也许能收集齐。如果你证明自己值得信任，我甚至可以帮你也做一枚。你觉得怎么样？
First, we will need a wooden base for the medallion.
首先，我们需要一块木头当徽章的底座。
There's an old, lightning struck tree to the south that we traditionally go to.
南边有一棵被雷劈过的老树，我们传统上都去那里。
I will write the directions to it for you and meet you by it.
我会把去那里的路线写给你，我们在树旁边见。
Meet Abramod near the lightning struck tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 被雷劈过的树附近与 Abramod 会合。
This tree was struck by lightning many generations ago. And yet it has remained standing, even after death.
这棵树好几代以前被雷劈过。可它一直屹立不倒，就算死了也一样。
The bark from it has proven sturdy enough that it works well as a medallion's base.
事实证明，它的树皮够结实，很适合拿来当徽章的底座。
However it might be a bit, ah, difficult to reach. It is in part why I need your help.
不过它可能有点，呃，难拿到。这也是我需要你帮忙的原因之一。
I will... assist you in climbing the tree. On your way down, you will need to hit {~} of healthier branches so we have enough bark.
我会……帮你爬上树。在往下的途中，你要打中 {~} 根比较健康的树枝，我们才有足够的树皮。
I'll need to stay down here so I can collect the bark as it hits the ground.
我得待在下面，树皮掉到地上时好收集起来。
If you need time to get your bearings, I understand. Come back when you're ready!
如果你需要时间搞清楚方向，我能理解。准备好了再回来！
Looks like you didn't quite hit enough branches...
看来你打中的树枝不太够……
Remember, you need to hit {~} healthy branches.
记住，你要打中 {~} 根健康的树枝。
I understand. Talk to me again when you've caught your breath.
我明白。等你喘过气来再找我。
Good! This should be enough for the bases.
很好！这应该够做底座了。
Next we'll need to collect some resin to lacquer the medallion with.
接下来我们得收集一些树脂来给徽章上漆。
High in a mountain meadow to the east, a fern grows that excretes a resin that works well for the task.
东边高山草地上长着一种蕨类，它分泌的树脂很适合做这件事。
I'll write you some instructions on how to get there and see you once you arrive.
我会写一些去那里的说明给你，等你到了再见。
Meet Abramod in the mountain grove at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的山间林地与 Abramod 会合。
This meadow is home to a rare fern that we collect resin from to make our medallions.
这片草地上长着一种稀有的蕨类，我们会收集它的树脂来做徽章。
Do not go searching for it just yet though! It is also home to a poisonous fern that appears very similar to the one we need.
不过先别急着去找！这里也长着一种有毒的蕨类，看起来跟我们需要的那种非常像。
My eyes aren't so good anymore, so I'm going to need your help to tell them apart!
我的眼睛已经不太好了，所以需要你帮我分辨它们！
I'm going to toss the plants for you. You can pick them up by right-clicking them - even while they're still in the air!
我会把植物丢给你。右键就能捡起来——就算还在空中也行！
Place the greener, healthier looking plants to the side where I am now. And you'll need to burn the poisonous, more sickly looking plants on the other side.
把比较绿、看起来比较健康的植物放到我现在站的这一边。那些有毒、看起来比较病弱的植物，要拿到另一边烧掉。
We'll need {~} of the good ferns to extract enough resin. But make sure the poisonous ferns don't build up too much or it could be dangerous for you!
我们需要 {~} 株好的蕨类才能提取足够的树脂。不过要注意，别让有毒的蕨类堆太多，不然会对你有危险！
You'll only be able to pick up one at a time, so good luck!
你一次只能捡一株，祝你好运！
I understand. I'll be here whenever you are.
我明白。你准备好了我随时都在。
Looks like you didn't get enough!
There's only one final thing we need: knives to cut the bark with.
我们只差最后一样东西了：用来切树皮的刀。
Put that away, we don't need just any knife!
把那个收起来，我们要的可不是随便一把刀！
Tradition dictates we have to descend to a cave beneath this mountain where much of the fog of the {p} settles. Deep inside are stones we've used for generations in carving our medallions.
按照传统，我们得下到这座山底下的一个洞穴，{p} 的雾气大多沉积在那里。洞穴深处有我们世世代代用来雕刻徽章的石头。
I'll write down the directions for you again and meet you there.
我会再把路线写给你，我们在那里见。
Meet Abramod outside of the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的洞穴外与 Abramod 会合。
This cave here is where much of the mist pools. You can't tell from here, but it's very windy in there!
雾气大多聚集在这个洞穴里。从这里看不出来，但里面的风非常大！
At its end is an outcrop of rock with some of the sharpest stalagmites you've ever seen formed from those harsh winds.
洞穴尽头有一块突出的岩石，上面有被那些猛烈的风吹出来的、你见过最尖锐的石笋。
You'll need to head in and reach that outcrop. I'll try and call out to you if I see any bursts of wind heading your way, but you'll have to dodge them on your own!
你得进去到达那块岩石。如果我看到有阵风朝你吹去，我会尽量喊你，不过你得自己躲开！
If you get hit you'll be blown back, but try not to be blown back too far.
被风打中的话你会被吹回来，不过尽量别被吹得太远。
You can walk in once you're ready to start.
准备好开始了就走进去吧。
I'll meet you back at my campsite.
Thank you so much again for all the help you've granted me!
再次感谢你给我的所有帮助！
回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Abramod 营地。
We are going to make the medallion now, are we not?
我们现在要来做徽章了，对吧？
It looks like I marked out for you the spots on the medallion that have to be cut out.
看来我已经帮你在徽章上标出要切掉的地方了。
All you have to do is cut them. Easy.
你只要把它们切掉就行。很简单。
Good! I will drag the knife down. And you will push it in to cut!
很好！我来把刀往下拉。你负责把刀按进去切！
You're not ready!? Then get ready, quickly! We do not have time to waste.
你还没准备好！？那快点准备！我们没时间可以浪费。
Good! Good! Look at how beautiful it is!
很好！很好！看看它多漂亮！
The intricacy! The style! With this, I will be able to get into any clan I want!
这精细！这风格！有了它，我想进哪个氏族都行！
But... there is a loose end isn't there. Even if I can go anywhere I want... you will always know, won't you?
可是……还有个没收拾的尾巴，不是吗？就算我能去任何地方……你永远都会知道，对吧？
You are a danger that cannot be allowed to persist!
你是个不能留下的祸患！
What are you here for, eh kid? Get out. Get!
你来这儿干什么，嗯，小鬼？出去。快滚！
Yer back again, are ye? Yer ain' gettin' any of me gold, so move along!
你又回来啦？俺的金子你一个子儿都别想拿，快走快走！
Go fetch me [{~} Gold Chunks] from the end of the shaft and I'll tell ye where ye need to go next.
去帮俺从矿坑尽头把 [{~} 金块] 拿来，俺就告诉你下一步该去哪。
I am one of the Keepers in the great {p}. There we hoard secrets about the world.
我是伟大的 {p} 的守秘人之一。我们在那里收藏着关于这个世界的秘密。
I am here to investigate an old tale of the canyon. Does that interest you? I'm sure it does!
我来这里是为了调查峡谷里的一个古老传说。你有兴趣吗？我相信你一定有！
Legend has it that a ferocious beast lives among these cliffs. A dangerous bird that has survived for many years.
传说这些悬崖之间住着一头凶猛的野兽。一只存活了很多年的危险巨鸟。
I would love to seek the beast out, but it seems the natives here are too busy thieving each other to inform me of it.
我很想去找那头野兽，可是这里的原住民好像都忙着互相偷东西，没空告诉我。
I have heard of an old prospector nearby who has ventured throughout this mesa. He may have some information.
我听说附近有个老探矿人，他走遍了这片台地。他也许有些情报。
His name is Jankan and he lives east from {p}. Could you perhaps seek him out and ask him about this foul beast?
他叫 Jankan，住在 {p} 东边。你能不能去找他，问问这头恶兽的事？
If you help me, I'll let you use the elevators spread in the canyon. Well...
如果你帮我，我就让你使用峡谷里各处的升降机。嗯……
A strange hermit decided to take control of them, but I'm sure we can reason with him.
有个古怪的隐士决定霸占它们，不过我相信我们能跟他讲道理。
I hope you are able to find the beast, and if you do, could you bring me back [{~} Beast Egg] as evidence?
希望你能找到那头野兽，如果找到了，能不能带 [{~} 野兽蛋] 回来当证据？
Talk to Jankan east from {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
与 {p} 东边 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Jankan 对话。
Hello there, youngster! Ye must be the stranger folks 'been talkin' 'bout.
你好啊，年轻人！你一定就是大伙儿一直在说的那个陌生人。
If yer lookin fer gold, I can promise ye that there ain' any for you in this here mineshaft!
要是你来找金子，俺可以跟你保证，这矿井里没有你的份！
Oh.. Yer lookin fer a winged wilder beast? Are ye out of yer mind?

搭乘峡谷升降机上去找 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的隐士。

因为你迟早都会查出来，我也没有什么更体面的职业能拿来掩饰，而且不会被你很快揭穿。

在你正是要找犯罪之人的时候隐瞒我的犯罪本性，是不理智的。

如果我骗了你，而你发现了，你肯定会当成我还有更多东西要隐瞒的证据。

我现在唯一的目的，是说服你我没有想烧那个人偶。被揭穿是小偷的后果，我之后再处理。

当然没有，那跟我的整体目的背道而驰。

请注意，我不指望你在我这么说的时候相信我。你绝对应该当作我在对你说谎。

但我不会。你信任我，是我摆脱这团乱麻的最佳门票。

我怕。我不知道他们会对我做什么，也不想知道。
From what I was able to overhear between you and the organizer, it sounds like you're looking for a changeling.
从我偷听到你跟主办人的对话来看，你们好像在找一个易形者。

而看他们对一个易形者的人偶都那样，我完全不想知道要是他们真以为我是易形者会发生什么。
I'll take whatever punishment my thievery gets me and move on.
偷窃该受什么惩罚，我都认了，然后继续过日子。
Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Of course. I'll talk about whatever you want.
Yes. Being outside of a clan, there's no one particularly trustworthy in the {p}.
是的。在氏族以外，{p} 里没有什么特别值得信任的人。
With the changelings, even if I were to find a partner, I don't know how to make medallions and so could never be sure they weren't killed and replaced.
有易形者在，就算我找到伙伴，我也不知道怎么做徽章，所以永远没法确定对方没有被杀掉取代。

这样轻松多了，我向你保证。
Whoever I can. For the most part it's the clans, they can be shockingly lazy if you know where you're looking.
谁都偷。大多是偷氏族的，只要你知道往哪看，他们懒散得惊人。
I have stolen a bit from the military when their watch lapses, although that's obviously much harder to pull off.
军队松懈的时候我也偷过一点，不过那显然难得多。
Not personally, no. I've heard some rumors though.
亲眼见过的没有。不过听过一些传闻。
Hard to tell fact from fiction, but they certainly seem to be a nasty bunch.
很难分辨真假，不过他们看起来确实是一群可恶的家伙。
I wouldn't be surprised to hear one tried to break into the festival.
要是听说有一个想闯进庆典，我也不会意外。
Not directly, no. But of the three of us, I was the farthest from where the flame was kindled.
没有直接看到。不过我们三个人里，我离起火的地方最远。
I may have seen one of the other two suspects move, but I can't be positive about that.
我可能看到另外两个嫌疑人其中一个动了一下，但我不能确定。
If I had more information I would of course provide it.
如果我有更多情报，当然会提供。
Ah, have you decided to try and play confrontational?
啊，你决定要试试咄咄逼人了？

没关系，我再说一次，不是我做的。不管你信不信，那都是事实。
My fate lies entirely in your hands, so to speak. You don't have to engage in theatrics to intimidate me, you are exactly as scary as you were before.
可以说，我的命运完全掌握在你手里。你不必演戏来吓唬我，你跟之前一样吓人。
Find someone who might have been observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in.
找一个可能眼尖到看见 Cerisa 偷溜进来的人。
Nothing obviously dangerous, but I always keep in mind.
没有明显危险的，不过我一直都放在心上。

不过几个小时前我确实看到了很奇怪的事。在 {p} 的入口旁，好像有人翻过了栅栏。

可能是光线造成的错觉，但我好像看到他们换了衣服，还把什么东西塞到了桥底下。

不过那可能只是一个操心的老家长的胡言乱语啦！
Oh really? That's a shame, I thought I was stealthier than that.
噢真的吗？真可惜，我还以为自己更隐蔽一点。

不过我不确定这算不算真正的新发现，我已经跟你坦白过我是这样进来的了。

还有什么别的事想追究我吗？

是的，我换了衣服。我平常穿的衣服不适合庆典这种欢乐的气氛。

既然这样，谢谢你随时让我知道调查的进展。你对司法过程透明的坚持令人钦佩。
Search under the bridge around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for something Cerisa may have left behind.
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 附近的桥底下寻找 Cerisa 可能留下的东西。

Your investigation is quite impressive, I'll admit. I was not expecting anyone to find those, I must not have disposed of them properly.
我承认，你的调查相当了不起。我没想到会有人找到那些，一定是我没处理好。

不过你也有点运气好，不是吗。要是没人看到我偷溜进来，你永远也找不到。

我是个逃兵，几天前才从军队逃出来。我在这里停留只是暂时歇脚，能偷多少就偷多少，然后尽可能远地消失在 {p} 里。

不，我没有。我是个小偷，来庆典有一部分就是为了偷点小玩意儿。我跟你说的都不是谎话。

我承认有些你可能感兴趣的事我没告诉你，但那只是因为你从来没问过。

要是你问我是不是当过兵，我就会把你现在得到的所有情报都告诉你。

是的，某种程度上是。但你得明白，让你信任我并不是我脱身的唯一策略。

不提我逃兵的事是一场赌博。我得权衡你找到我逃兵证据的可能性，以及承认之后我可能面临的危险。

事后看来，我赌错了，但我不认为我的赌注不理智。

要是你调查得差一点，或者运气再差一点，这一把就能大赚一笔。

而我相信即使到了现在，你也是个足够公正的裁判，会只看事实。

那些证明我跟你在调查的事毫无关系的事实。

你可以。而如果你那样做，你就要为我的死负完全的个人责任。

如果你选择那样做，我希望我的脸在你余生的噩梦里阴魂不散。

I'll admit I struggle to express this in words, but you don't seem the type.
我承认我很难用言语表达，但你看起来不是那种人。
You couldn't really go through with something like that.

军队生活对我来说太压抑了。那么多直接命令，我除了服从什么都做不了。

而且太无聊了。我大部分时间都站着不动，警戒从来没出现过的威胁。

所以我走了。我祝他们一切顺利，也为无法如我所愿地效忠女王陛下向她道歉，但那段日子让我对整件事心生厌倦。
Oh, I see you're getting better at this.
噢，看来你越来越会问了。

是的，我离开的另一个原因是太残酷。我见不得血，也没准备好会看到那么多血。

当兵大部分时候都很乏味。乏味到让人麻木。但少数不乏味的时候，让我比世上任何事都更希望自己能无聊。
I'm not even sure the violence was wrong, I just cannot participate in it.
我甚至不确定那些暴力是错的，我只是没法参与其中。
Unpleasant life at home. There was nothing for me to stay behind for. The military seemed like my best way out.
家里的日子不好过。没什么值得我留下的。当兵看起来是我最好的出路。
I think I would make the same choice again, even knowing how it would end. There's no way I could stay there for much longer.
我想就算知道结局会怎样，我还是会做同样的选择。我不可能在那里再多待多久。
Let me look at that more closely.
No, I don't. The residue smells far more pungent than any drink I recognize.
不，我不认得。这残留物的气味比我认得的任何饮料都刺鼻得多。

如果你是在这里找到的，可以在庆典里四处问问，看看有没有别人认得。

嗯，我可以告诉你这肯定不是绿茶。其他的就不确定了。

嗯……我们俩都没看到有人带着闻起来像那样的东西进来。
It would have had to have already been in {p} or they would have had to have arrived even before us.
那东西要么早就在 {p} 里，要么就是他们比我们还早到。

破瓶子？看起来有点像我们装迷雾瓶用的瓶子，但味道完全不一样。
Whoa, that's super cool! I bet those pointy edges could hurt a changeling pretty bad...
哇，好酷！我打赌那些尖尖的边能把易形者伤得很惨……
Recognize it? No, but I wish I did!
认得？不认得，但我真希望我认得！
That smell... I don't recognize it, I'm afraid. It certainly doesn't smell safe!
那个味道……恐怕我不认得。闻起来肯定不安全！

我不认得。不过你能把它收起来吗？那味道好像让几只狐狸不太舒服。
It's vaguely familiar to me, but I'm sorry to say I can't place where from.
我觉得有点眼熟，但很抱歉，我想不起来是在哪里见过。

不管那是什么，我可没把它带来这里。
aUm, no, I don't think so.
Sorry if you were hoping I had.
要是你本来指望我见过，那就抱歉了。
There's not much distinctive about it though, except for that odor.
不过除了那股气味，它也没什么特别的。
No. And we're in the middle of a conversation, please don't interrupt us.
没有。而且我们正在聊天，请不要打断我们。
That bottle? Absolutely not, that smell is much more than what this old body could take.
那个瓶子？绝对不认得，那气味我这把老骨头可受不了。

不过他们给了我不少钱让我别说！
The only way I would is if I were to really be impressed by someone.
唯一能让我开口的办法，就是真的有人让我刮目相看。
Ha! I knew you couldn't do it.

别往心里去，谁都不能指望在狐狸赛跑上赢过我。

当然，如果你想再试一次，随时欢迎。只是得到同样的结果时别惊讶。

你赢了！？我——我——我从来没输过！

我根本不知道这怎么可能，你看起来就像随便乱挑的！

好吧，愿赌服输。你让我看了一场好戏，我就把我知道的告诉你。
It's really not that big of a deal, I'm not sure why they paid me to stay quiet about it.
其实没什么大不了的，我也不知道他们为什么要付钱让我保密。

比赛开始前我在研究狐狸的时候，看到几个 Kalkalrah 族的人带着那样的瓶子进来。
I thought they were just green tea, but clearly they're not!
我还以为只是绿茶，但显然不是！
I'm not positive where they are now, but I think I saw them head up the zipline to the second floor of {p}?
我不确定他们现在在哪，不过我好像看到他们坐滑索上了 {p} 的二楼？

还有，要是你哪天能教我你的赛跑技巧，我会非常感激的！

对那些把鼻子伸到不该伸的地方的人，不是每个人在庆典上都会松懈。

给我，让我仔细看看你刚才给他们看的东西。

啊——对，你知道那伙人的一些事，对吧？

你不必告诉我，你知道的我都知道，而且知道得更多。

我已经很多年没法在城里自由走动了，年纪把我困在家里。

但我还能坐着看底下忙碌的人们。我能看到他们以为没人在看的时候都在做什么。

这是一种力量。让我挂在这树冠上，还能保持脚踏实地的方式。

我看着你手忙脚乱地灭火，也看着那伙人在火点起来之后做了什么。

我看着那三个外人被押走看管。

不过，我听不到细节。我不知道具体情况。

告诉我你的嫌疑人做了什么、你发现了什么。然后，我就给你你要找的东西。

那就是一群说谎的外人。意料之中，可惜你不能说是他们全部一起干的。

至于那个小团体，我怀疑他们暗地里是庆典的保安。

我没看到是谁点的火，但火点起来没多久，他们其中一个就朝火扔了一个跟你手上那个一模一样的瓶子。

里面一定装满了燃料，因为瓶子砸中之后火势大了很多。

也许这样最好，只要不怕烧掉灌木丛，谁知道能烤出什么害虫来。

如果你愿意陪一个老太婆消遣，那你对我就没什么用处了。别挡着我的视线。

我的调查员回来了。现在，告诉我你知道些什么。

你看起来有心事，是什么？

啊，看来你的调查有成果了。

是的。如你所见，人们在庆典上往往会以平时不会有的方式放松警惕。

他们是确保任何不速之客都能被迅速处理的必要存在。

我想你大概说得对。然而，那无关紧要。

你会跟我说他们鲁莽，对别人很危险。我不否认，但我希望你从大局着眼。

只要我们有片刻松懈，就已经输掉了这场战争。我们的氏族和家庭一天之内就会被渗透。

他们的鲁莽防止了这种事。在最小的失误都会酿成灾难的情况下，鲁莽就成了必要。

想象一下，如果他们没有冒失地把那瓶燃料扔到已经点着的火上。

火不是他们放的，一定是别人想从中得利。
Their actions, while dangerous, prevented any fiends from exploiting the opportunity. We took it out of their control.
他们的行动虽然危险，却防止了任何恶徒利用这个机会。我们把局面从他们手中夺了回来。
Whatever risk their actions created was worth the price.
无论他们的行动带来什么风险，都值得这个代价。
Apologies for rambling, I assure you though that safety is our top concern. Whatever the price.
抱歉我说了这么多，不过我向你保证，安全是我们的首要考量。不惜任何代价。
Return to the festival organizer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or look into the suspects a bit more.
回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的庆典主办人那里，或再多调查一下嫌疑人。
You think you know who the changeling is?
你觉得你知道谁是易形者了？
You've dug into them all and have found something? Excellent.
你把他们全都查过一遍，发现了什么？太好了。
So, who do you think tried to burn down the wickerman?
那么，你认为是谁想烧掉柳条人？
Suspect {~}? Very well. I will take care of things from here.
嫌疑人 {~}？很好。接下来就交给我处理。

再次非常感谢你的帮忙。你在这件事上的协助让庆典得以成功举办，我怎么强调都不为过。

好好享受剩下的庆典，一定要看柳条人燃烧！我会在前排为你留个特别的座位，聊表谢意。
I understand your reticense to pick one. We don't have anything close to the information required to make a proper judgement.
我理解你不愿意选一个。我们手上的情报远远不足以做出正确的判断。

但你不能因此停下。我们没有闭上眼睛、假装什么都没发生的余裕。

拜托，根据你那必然不完整的调查，告诉我你认为是谁点的火。

那好吧。我很失望，但我能理解。
I will take care of things from this point forward.
从现在起，这件事交给我处理。
In thanks for saving the wickerman, there will be a seat saved for you when you are ready to watch it burn.
为了感谢你救下柳条人，等你准备好观看它燃烧时，会有一个座位为你保留。
Enjoy the rest of the festival.
好好享受剩下的庆典吧。
Keep looking then. Return here once you've made a decision.
那就继续调查吧。做好决定再回来这里。
You children of the {p} gather round
To gaze upon this relic from years past,
凝望这件来自往昔岁月的遗物，
This effigy, of ancient foes we fought—
这尊人偶，是我们曾经对抗的古老宿敌——
In memory, we will again ignite!
为了铭记，我们将再次将它点燃！
An ancient beast, rebuilt with plank and straw,
一头古老的野兽，以草木与稻秆重塑，
What once was flesh, reconstitute as wood;
昔日的血肉，如今化作木头重生；
All monsters, old and new, must meet their end—
一切怪物，无论新旧，都必须迎来终结——
All fiends must burn! Must broil and char and melt!
一切恶徒都必须焚烧！必须炙烤、焦黑、熔化！
Substance beside, all that remains persists...
形体之外，残存的一切依然留存……
...as blackened corpse, no threat there can exist!
……化作焦黑的尸骸，再不能构成威胁！
Oh, hi, I never got the chance to thank you.
哦，你好，我一直没机会谢谢你。
I'm not sure what happened after you left.
我不太清楚你走之后发生了什么。
The festival organizer came back and took Burick/Cerisa away with him.
庆典主办人回来，把 Burick/Cerisa 带走了。
I'm not sure what happened but, um, I don't think it was good.
我不知道发生了什么，不过，呃，我觉得不是好事。
So, thank you again. I wasn't really in the right mind enough to show it then.
所以，再次谢谢你。当时我脑子一团乱，没能好好表达。
I'll see how long I can hang around here, but the locals are beginning to glare at me a bit.
我会看看能在这附近待多久，不过当地人已经开始拿眼睛瞪我了。
I might try to head deeper into the woods, see if there's anything I can find.
我可能会试着往树林更深处去，看看能找到什么。
Or join the military? I don't think I'd be very good at it and I don't even think they'd accept me, but it might be worth a shot.
或者去参军？我觉得我不会很擅长，甚至不觉得他们会收我，但也许值得一试。
Otherwise, all I can do is try to live off of what I can find. I, uh, don't like my chances with that.
不然，我就只能靠找到的东西过活了。我，呃，不太看好自己的机会。
I am! I'm always a, uh, little nervous. But a lot less than I was.
我是！我一直都，呃，有点紧张。不过比那时候好多了。
It felt like the axe that had been pressed against my neck was lifted, thanks to you.
多亏了你，感觉就像压在我脖子上的斧头被拿开了。
There's still a lot of uncertainty, but I no longer feel like I'm scrambling like a rabbit in a cage.
还是有很多不确定，但我不再觉得自己像笼子里乱窜的兔子了。
I was still in a bit of a daze, so not really, sorry.
我那时候还有点恍惚，所以没怎么注意，抱歉。
She left pretty quick though, she must have been in a hurry to get somewhere
不过她走得很快，一定是急着去什么地方
Hello. Please try not to come too close.
We can talk from a distance.
我们可以隔着距离说话。
Apologies for the coolness, your help was appreciated.
抱歉这么冷淡，你的帮忙我很感激。
But I cannot be sure you are who you say you are.
但我无法确定你就是你说的那个人。
Since our run in at the festival, I have been laying lower than usual.
自从我们在庆典上碰面之后，我一直比平常更低调。
My life has not been much different than it usually is.
我的生活跟平时没什么两样。
It was a horrific mistake to even attend the festival.
去参加庆典本身就是个可怕的错误。
I allowed myself to be controlled by my own humanity; that is a mistake the {p} rarely lets off easily.
我让自己被人性左右了；在 {p}，这种错误很少能轻易了事。
I will not make the same mistake again. Loneliness will hurt, but trust will kill.
我不会再犯同样的错。寂寞会伤人，但信任会杀人。
Last I saw, they were still in {p}.
我最后一次看到的时候，他们还在 {p}。
They don't seem cut out for the life of a scavenger, if they can't find any other way to live outside a clan they'll be dead within the week.
他们看起来不是当拾荒者的料，要是找不到在氏族之外生活的其他办法，一个星期内就会没命。
Yes, while everyone else was watching the wickerman burn she rustled through as many abandoned stalls, bags, and houses as she could.
是的，趁大家都在看柳条人燃烧的时候，她把能翻的无人摊位、包包和房子都翻了个遍。
I left before she was finished, but this morning I saw a figure walking south out of {p}, carrying several large bags.
她还没翻完我就走了，不过今天早上我看到一个人影从 {p} 往南走，扛着好几个大包。
Wherever she's headed, she's prepared for a long trek.
不管她要去哪里，她都准备好走很远的路了。
The orc chiefs seem to hide in the camps with green flags - search the plains, and return once they're subdued!
那些兽人酋长好像躲在插着绿旗的营地里。去平原上搜一搜，把它们制服了再回来！
Did you hear about the requests from the Villagers we've gotten? They say these 'Orcs' and 'Goblins' are threatening their towns and cities.
你听说我们收到的村民请求了吗？他们说那些“兽人”和“哥布林”正在威胁他们的城镇。
Primitive, brutal things, apparently little better than the zombies we're used to, at least according to the {p} military.
据说是些原始又野蛮的东西，比我们平常对付的僵尸好不了多少，至少 {p} 军方是这么说的。
Our scouts have identified three 'chief' orcs in the area- Elisu, Ceifko, and Veltu. Though, strangely, Veltu is always surrounded by goblins...
我们的斥候在这一带找到了三个兽人“酋长”：Elisu、Ceifko 和 Veltu。不过奇怪的是，Veltu 身边总是围着哥布林……
Well, whatever the case, we're needed to defend {p} here. Can you handle the chiefs? They seem to hide in the camps with green flags - search the plains, and return once they're dealt with!
好了，不管怎样，这里需要我们守着 {p}。那些酋长你能对付吗？它们好像躲在插着绿旗的营地里。去平原上搜一搜，解决之后再回来！
That's...harsher than I intended, but it works... Not like the Villagers care if they're dead or alive, as long as they're dealt with. I have your share of the reward here.
这……比我预想的狠了点，不过也行……反正村民也不在乎它们是死是活，只要解决了就好。你那份奖励在我这儿。
You saw that the creatures in Gavel aren't akin to Wynnic fare while you were out, yes? They're a bit, ah... livelier than usual. Better get used to it.
你出去的时候发现了吧，Gavel 的生物跟 Wynn 那边的不太一样？它们有点，呃……比平常更有活力。最好早点习惯。
Talk to Captain Kymer outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
与 {p} 外 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Kymer 队长对话
Aha, another {p} soldier, eh? Well, a warm welcome to you.
啊哈，又一个 {p} 的士兵，是吧？好啊，热烈欢迎。
So, we figure if might makes right with them, then defeating their leaders should scare them into submission.
所以我们想，既然对它们来说拳头大就是道理，那打败它们的首领应该就能把它们吓得服服帖帖。
Find and kill Orc Chieftains Elisu, Veltu, and Ceifko in the camps around {p}- look for green flags
在 {p} 周围的营地找到并击杀兽人酋长 Elisu、Veltu 和 Ceifko——留意绿色旗帜
Report back to Captain Kymer once you have the three heads.
拿到三颗首级后，回去向 Kymer 队长报告。
Ah, the soldier from earlier! You're back, I see. Any luck defeating those- ...yeesh. Are those their heads?
啊，刚才那个士兵！看来你回来了。打败那些家伙的事顺利——……哎哟。那是它们的头？
This kind of surgical strike should help prevent an all-out war with the Orcs. Not sure we'd want a full-scale war to deal with in each province, hah!
这种精准打击应该能避免跟兽人全面开战。我们可不想每个行省都得打一场全面战争，哈！
The next major settlement is {p}, in the swamp up north, but I hear the swamp ogres are a lot tougher than the plains' fare. I'd stick around here and train up, first.
下一个大聚落是北边沼泽里的 {p}，不过我听说沼泽食人魔比平原上的家伙难对付多了。我会先留在这附近练练。
Have you taken care of Cluckles yet? If you can't find him, I hid him in my basement.
你料理好 Cluckles 了吗？要是找不到它，我把它藏在我的地下室了。
You need to be Farming Lv. {~} to start this Mini-Quest.
需要达到农耕等级 {~} 才能开始这个迷你任务。
You need to be Mining Lv. {~} to start this Mini-Quest.
你的采矿等级需要达到 {~} 级才能开始这个迷你任务。
You need to be Fishing Lv. {~} to start this Mini-Quest.
需要达到钓鱼等级 {~} 才能开始这个迷你任务。
Sometimes I wish animals could respawn... hey! What are you doing here? Go away!
有时候我真希望动物能重生……喂！你在这儿干嘛？走开！
Hey, you aren't a chicken! Wait, you're a human! You can help me! Maybe you are the guy who helped my brother Yahya, but who knows, you humans all look the same to me.
嘿，你不是鸡！等等，你是人类！你能帮我！说不定你就是帮过我兄弟 Yahya 的那个人，不过谁知道呢，你们人类在我看来都长一个样。
I really love my chickens, but there is one that I just cannot control...
我真的很爱我的鸡，可是有一只我怎么也管不住……
His name is Cluckles, he was given to me by a man named Bob before he went to war, but when Bob never came back, Cluckles got angry...
它叫 Cluckles，是一个叫 Bob 的人上战场前送给我的。可是 Bob 一直没回来，Cluckles 就发怒了……
He's really dangerous to keep on my lovely island, so I keep him in my basement...
把它留在我可爱的小岛上太危险了，所以我把它关在地下室……
I want to take care of him, but my wife says it's too dangerous. Where's my wife you say? Oh, I think she's around here eating some grain.
我想好好照顾它，可我老婆说太危险了。你问我老婆在哪？噢，我想她就在这附近吃谷子吧。
Anyway, I need you to go down there and... Take care of him for me. I would really appreciate it.
总之，我需要你下去……帮我把它料理好。我会非常感激的。
Bring back [{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather] to Nohno.
把 [{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather] 带回给 Nohno。
What is this?! His feather? What did you do to Cluckles?! I wanted you to take care of him, not kill him!
这是什么？！它的羽毛？你对 Cluckles 做了什么？！我是要你照顾它，不是要你杀了它！
You monster! Leave this place now, and keep that feather to remind you of your hideous crime!
你这个怪物！马上离开这里，留着那根羽毛，让它提醒你犯下的可怕罪行！
Talk to the Cook in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The King ordered me to bake cakes for all those new recruits!
国王命令我给所有新兵烤蛋糕！
Unfortunately, a Grook took my last cake, and I ran out of ingredients!
不幸的是，一只 Grook 拿走了我最后一个蛋糕，我的材料也用完了！
That's the Grook! Go chase it down and get my cake back!
就是那只 Grook！快去追，把我的蛋糕抢回来！
The Grook got away! Return to the Cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to figure out what to do.
Grook 跑掉了！回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的厨师那里，想想该怎么办。
What are you doing? Go after the Grook...
你在干什么？快去追那只 Grook……
Well, I guess you are going to have to help me find the ingredients and bake another...
好吧，看来你得帮我找材料，再烤一个……
There he is again! After him!
Find out where the Grook flew up to at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
找出 Grook 飞到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的哪里去了。
Find where the Grook flew up to at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找出 Grook 飞到了哪里
Return to the cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Use a Scroll to get there faster.
回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的厨师那里。用卷轴能更快到达。
Return to the cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] Use a Scroll to get there faster
回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找厨师，使用卷轴可以更快到达
I can't thank you enough! Here, take these emeralds and armour for all your trouble.
真是太感谢你了！来，收下这些绿宝石和护甲，辛苦你了。
You should explore around to become stronger. I hear there might be work to do in {p}.
你应该到处探索，让自己变强。我听说 {p} 可能有活要干。
I can't believe what is happening to me...
我简直不敢相信我遇上了这种事……
那么，你能帮上什么忙呢……
Wait! That's the Grook! Go chase it down and get my cake back!
等等！就是那只 Grook！快去追，把我的蛋糕抢回来！
{u}, good to see you again! Been a while, huh?
{u}，很高兴又见到你！有一阵子没见了吧？
We've got a major problem with this old fortress. It keeps spewing out all these damned slimes, and their proximity to {p} is causing issues.
这座老要塞出了个大问题。它不停地冒出一堆该死的史莱姆，而且离 {p} 太近，惹了不少麻烦。
You lean in close to read the riddle inscribed on the ancient stone...
你凑近去读刻在那块古老石碑上的谜语……
You seem to have fallen into an ancient ruin of some sort. Maybe the incantation is somewhere inside...
你好像掉进了某种古代遗迹里。那段咒文说不定就在里面某处……
The King sought the help of a shaman, Slykaar. Shamans use the life of sacrifices to inflict damage. Dark magic.
国王向一位萨满求助，他叫 Slykaar。萨满以献祭的生命来造成伤害。那是黑暗魔法。
Slykaar defended {p}. At an immense cost. Slykaar loved the attention and power. He controlled the city.
Slykaar 守住了 {p}，代价极其惨重。Slykaar 迷恋那份瞩目与权力，他掌控了整座城市。
{p} had suffered from the hordes and from the endless sacrifices of Slykaar for years.
多年来，{p} 既受尽了兽群之苦，也受尽了 Slykaar 无止尽献祭之苦。
Then... Bob appeared. The people of {p} instantly dropped their horrible shaman for the pure hero.
然后…… Bob 出现了。{p} 的人民立刻抛下了那个可怕的萨满，转而拥戴这位纯粹的英雄。
Slykaar, bitter and humiliated, sunk underground to restart his demonic experiments for an army.
Slykaar 又恨又辱，潜入地下，重新展开他那些恶魔实验，好为自己造一支军队。
It appears the mutant contained the key for that door.
看来那把门的钥匙就在那只变异体身上。
It's an old, dusty journal. It seems to be left open to a page. You begin to read it out of curiosity...
这是一本布满灰尘的旧日记，似乎被翻开停在某一页。你出于好奇读了起来……
...{p} is beginning to grow suspicious of me...some guy named Robert came into town...
……{p} 开始对我起疑了……有个叫 Robert 的家伙来到了镇上……
...I know they will banish me...he is too good...too nice...
……我知道他们会把我放逐……他太好了……太善良了……
...I must open a portal...make a dimension to become more powerful...
……我必须开启一道传送门……造出一个维度，让自己变得更强大……
...the books...I have prepared well for this...
……那些书……为了这一刻，我已经准备得很充分了……
...I will carve a hidden room...behind a visible wall...to create my world...my revenge...
……我要凿出一间密室……藏在一面看得见的墙后面……打造属于我的世界……我的复仇……
Go have fun while you can. It's not like you have much of a life to live, anyways.
趁还能玩就好好玩吧。反正你也没多少日子可活了。
You should head back to Lanu...
你该回去找 Lanu 了……
Ah, you're back. Find anything interesting? I've just been knocking back the occasional slime that pops up out of the cave.
啊，你回来了。找到什么有意思的了吗？我一直在这里收拾偶尔从洞里冒出来的史莱姆。
In {~} AP, {p} was on its knees. Hordes of undead were crippling the army and castle.
{~} AP 时，{p} 已被逼入绝境。成群的亡灵重创了军队与城堡。
Hey, soldier! Yeah, you! Got some spare time to lend a hand?
嘿，士兵！对，就是你！有空搭把手吗？
Soldiers are spending half their guard duty slicing the critters into sludge. Ideally we'd raid the cave, cut out the source, but...
士兵们站岗的时间有一半都花在把这些小东西剁成烂泥上。最好是突袭洞窟，把源头除掉，可是……
This place has some history. Nasty stuff. I'd prefer not to head in blind, so I've been checking for any clues to what we might find inside.
这地方有些历史。不好的历史。我不想瞎闯进去，所以一直在找线索，看看里面可能有什么。
Haven't found much... except this verse, 'scribed into the wall over there. Go on, check it out and let me know what you think.
没找到多少……只有那边墙上刻的这首诗。去看看，然后告诉我你怎么想。
Nonsense, if you ask me. Most likely kids from {p} messing about. But we haven't found anything else, so... if you've got any time, fancy checking it out for me?
要我说全是胡扯。多半是 {p} 的小孩在瞎闹。可我们也没找到别的，所以……如果你有空，能帮我去查查吗？
The first line is obviously talking about the Great Bridge, but I've no clue what the rest means. Head over there, take a look around, and tell me if you find anything interesting.
第一句显然说的是大桥，可剩下的意思我完全摸不着头脑。去那边四处看看，找到什么有意思的就告诉我。
Found anything interesting around the riddle yet? Do you need to hear it again?
在谜题附近找到什么有意思的了吗？要不要再听一遍？
Near a corrupted bridge, a ruin past its prime..
腐化的桥边，废墟早已凋残……
Lives a cursed sheep, with the color of lime...
住着一只受诅的羊，颜色像青柠一般……
Lead it down the trail, headed to the slime...
领它沿着小路，走向史莱姆那边……
Sacrifice its soul, in the blood and the grime.
献上它的灵魂，在鲜血与污秽之间。
Alrighty. Let me know what when you've got something then.
好嘞。那等你有发现了再跟我说。
Use the Mage's riddle to figure out where it leads
用法师的谜题找出它指向哪里
If you are heading towards the Great Bridge, be cautious in the plains around the jungle entrance.
如果你要去大桥，在丛林入口附近的平原上要小心。
I have received reports of a strange cursed sheep taking refuge in one of the more fortified ruins around there.
我收到报告，说有一只奇怪的受诅之羊躲在那一带比较坚固的废墟里。
As far as I know, it is trapped in the ruins by some jungle growth, though if it was cut down it might escape...
据我所知，它被丛林的植物困在废墟里了，不过要是把那些植物砍掉，它可能就会逃出来……
You find a tattered journal on the ground in front of this slimy cave. You skim through some of the pages...
你在这个黏糊糊的洞穴前，发现地上有一本破烂的日记。你随手翻了几页……
...this cave...for some reason it seems to erupt with fresh slime masses every minute...
……这个洞穴……不知为何，每分钟都像是会涌出新的史莱姆团块……
...the bottom...has a weird pit...maybe used to sacrifice something...
……最底下……有个怪异的坑……也许是用来献祭什么的……
...maybe...if you bring a mob there...by letting it follow you...you can do something...dark ...
……也许……如果你把某只怪物带过去……让它跟着你……你就能做点什么……黑暗的事 ……
Explore the temple for a way to break the barrier.
探索神殿，寻找打破屏障的方法。
Go to Slykaar's residence at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find out what is hidden there.
前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Slykaar 住所，查明那里藏着什么。
By order of the city of {p}, I am here to keep other citizens from entering this house.
奉 {p} 城之命，我在这里阻止其他市民进入这栋房子。
From past experiences, everyone who has entered this house has vanished from existence...
根据以往的经验，进过这栋房子的人全都凭空消失了……
I would advise not going inside unless you know what you are doing.
除非你知道自己在做什么，否则我劝你别进去。
Well, I guess you must know who I am.
好吧，我想你一定知道我是谁。
Welcome to my domain. I am the hero of {p}, Slykaar.
欢迎来到我的领域。我是 {p} 的英雄，Slykaar。
Well, I used to be. Banished by the very people who asked for my help. Pathetic.
嗯，曾经是。被当初求我帮忙的那群人放逐了。真可悲。
They couldn't give me a few peasants for their safety? Weak.
为了他们自己的安全，连几个农民都不肯给我？软弱。
I experimented my shamanism for many years underground to create the perfect mix of monster.
我在地下用我的萨满之术实验了很多年，想创造出完美的混合怪物。
Most ended in horrific slimes. Aggressive and powerful, but alas, just slimes.
大多数都成了可怕的史莱姆。凶猛又强大，可惜，终究只是史莱姆。
Then I found this place. A dark land. A dark god. A source of power.
然后我找到了这个地方。一片黑暗之地。一位黑暗之神。一个力量之源。
You mediocre wielders of magic have no idea what this world holds.

你们全都想成为那位英雄中的英雄，“Bob”，但真相是这样的。他迷失了。你们也迷失了。

找到并进入秘密牛族藏身处

那么！最近……怎么样，小伙伴？有——有什么纪念品吗？从深坑带回来的……？
Oh, you- Oh. Right! Okay. I don't- I don't quite understand why you would pretend to be a cow. But alright!
哦，你——哦。对！好吧。我不——我不太明白你为什么要装成牛。不过好吧！
So, uh... Human turned into a cow. Okay. How did you manage to get yourself stuck as a cow, anyway? I didn't think we had anything that could do that...
那么，呃……人类变成了牛。好。你到底是怎么让自己变成牛变不回来的？我不记得我们有什么东西能做到……
My machine. It's- It's not even supposed to do that! I designed it to turn exiles back into Wocs, how would it have...
我的机器。它——它根本不是用来做这个的！我设计它是为了把流放者变回 Woc，它怎么会……
Great. Of course it'd have that issue, and just when I thought I...
太好了。它当然会出这种问题，就在我以为我……
Right. Right. Alright. We can work with this! Let's just take you back to that machine, put you in it, and see if it turns you back to normal!
对。对。好吧。我们能处理！我们只要带你回那台机器，把你放进去，看看能不能让你恢复正常！
It'll work. Probably. I mean, I haven't ever tried it, so I can't really say for sure... Oh, yep, you're still here. Let's get moving.
会管用的。大概吧。我是说，我从来没试过，所以不敢说一定……噢，对，你还在这里。我们走吧。
Well, alright. Let's just- get you in my machine, I guess. It worked for the exiles, so maybe it will work for you...?
嗯，好吧。我想就——把你放进我的机器吧。它对流放者有用，所以也许对你也有用……？
...Don't look at me like that. Come on, let's get going.
So... How have you been? It's been a while since our adventure at {p}, hasn't it?
那么……你最近怎么样？自从我们在 {p} 的冒险之后已经过了好一阵子了，对吧？
Well, you've been turned into a cow... Obviously... But besides that!
嗯，你被变成了一头牛……显而易见……但除此之外呢！
Me? Well... heh. I've been doing pretty well, all things considered. We've been gathering exiles from all over the province! Set up a city to hold us all while we work towards...
我？嗯……嘿。考虑到种种情况，我过得还不错。我们一直在从全省各地召集流放者！为大家建了一座城市，同时努力朝着……
It's a long story. I can't tell you everything- not yet. But... All of us here, we don't belong here. We just want to go home.
说来话长。我没办法全告诉你——还不行。但是……我们这里的每一个人，都不属于这里。我们只是想回家。
And- and maybe if we can find our ship again, we'll be able to prove that we're not irredeemable. That whatever we went through- that it won't define us.
而且——而且如果我们能再找到我们的船，也许就能证明我们并非无可救药。证明不管我们经历过什么——都不会定义我们。
...Heh. Don't- don't worry about it too much. For now, this place is enough of a safe haven for us. It'll have to be enough until we succeed.
……嘿。别——别太在意。现在，这里对我们来说已经是足够的避风港了。在我们成功之前，也只能这样了。
We're so close. I can feel it. Just... Just a little while left to go.
我们已经很接近了。我感觉得到。只是……只差一点点了。
Anyway, uh... Here's the elevator! Just step on in, and we can head on up to the laboratory.
总之，呃……升降机到了！踏进去，我们就能上去实验室。
哞——哞哞哞？(我们旁边那扇大门是干什么用的？)
The- oh. Uh... It's nothing. Nothing to worry about.
那——噢。呃……没什么。没什么好担心的。
It just leads to... maintenance. Yep! Just- just maintenance. Nothing else.
那只是通往……维修区。对！就是——就是维修区。没别的。
Into the elevator now, come on! You need a key to get in anyway, and I definitely don't have one laying around!
快进升降机吧！反正要进去也需要钥匙，而我手边绝对没有！
...You're worrying me, friend. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator, let's get you back to normal.
……你让我有点担心，朋友。快，我们走吧。进升降机，让你恢复正常。
So... Have you done anything interesting recently? Besides- getting turned into a cow. Obviously.
那么……你最近有做什么有趣的事吗？除了——被变成牛之外。显而易见。
You're, uh... Probably wondering what this place is. Just a big city under some random guy's farm, right?
你，呃……大概在想这地方是什么吧。就是某个路人农场底下的一座大城市，对吧？
It's... heh. We've been trying to gather as many of our people as we can. We exiles have to stick together, after all.
这里……嘿。我们一直在尽可能召集我们的族人。毕竟我们这些流放者得团结在一起。
It's a long story. I'm not sure how much of it I really want to tell you, heh. Especially considering... Yeah.
说来话长。我不确定自己真的想告诉你多少，嘿。尤其是考虑到……嗯。
But. This place is a safe haven for us exiles. A place for us all to live until we achieve our goals.
但是。这里是我们流放者的避风港。一个让我们大家生活的地方，直到我们实现目标。
And- hey! You've seen our secrets now! May as well let it be a safe haven for you as well, right? Heh.
而且——嘿！你现在都看到我们的秘密了！干脆也让这里成为你的避风港吧，对吧？嘿。
Oh- the elevator. Here we are. Uh... Just head on in, little buddy? It'll take us up.
哦——升降机。我们到了。呃……进去吧，小伙伴？它会带我们上去。
...You're worrying me. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator, let's get you back to normal.
……你让我有点担心。快，我们走吧。进升降机，让你恢复正常。
Uh. Do you- do you understand what I'm saying?
呃。你——你听得懂我在说什么吗？
...This is stupid. I'm talking to a cow. Of course you can't...
……真蠢。我在跟一头牛说话。你当然听不……
Well I guess I could- talk at you. For a bit. If that's, heh, fine with you!
嗯，我想我可以——对着你说说话。一下下就好。如果你，嘿，不介意的话！
It's been tough, recently. Working towards a goal I know is important, but still feels... out of reach.
最近很辛苦。朝着一个我知道很重要的目标努力，却还是觉得……遥不可及。
And it doesn't seem like anybody else can see that! That this is important! They look at me like I'm going crazy, and-
而且好像没有其他人看得出来！看不出这有多重要！他们看我的眼神就像我疯了一样，而且——
I'm not. I know I'm not. We need to find the ship. If we don't, who knows what...
我没疯。我知道我没疯。我们必须找到那艘船。如果找不到，谁知道会……
Anyway! Here's the elevator! Just step on in, and we can head on up to the laboratory.
总之！升降机到了！踏进去，我们就能上去实验室。
Hrrgh- You're- you're not a cow?! Why would you... I just said all that, and you could...
呃啊——你——你不是牛？！你为什么要……我刚刚说了那么多，而你居然……
D-Don't worry about the door. It's... It's nothing. Maintenance. That- that's what it is.
别、别在意那扇门。那……那没什么。维修区。那——那就是它的用途。
Er... come on, into the elevator! You want to get back to normal, right? Besides, you'd need a key to get in there, and I don't know where you'd find one of those, haha!
呃……快，进升降机！你想恢复正常，对吧？况且，要进去那里需要钥匙，我可不知道你要去哪里找钥匙，哈哈！
...Moo. Yep. I agree. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator.
……哞。对。我同意。快，我们走吧。进升降机。
So... here we are. The lab!
Just... follow me, for now. The machine is this way.
There it is! If you step into the machine, real quick, it should... it should work!
就是它！只要你快点踏进机器，它应该……应该就会管用！
Look at you! As good as new!
Heh... Well, there you are! Good as new! I hope...
嘿……好了，你恢复了！跟新的一样！我希望……
And- to, uh, compensate you for... you know... Here! One liquid emerald. I feel terrible for how our reunion ended up going... I hope you won't hold it against me?
还有——为了，呃，补偿你……你知道的……来！一个液态绿宝石。我们的重逢变成这样，我真的很过意不去……希望你不会记恨我？
Uh... I really should get back to work. But- hey! Feel free to visit whenever you want! You'll be able to use the entrance at Ranol's farm.
呃……我真的该回去工作了。不过——嘿！随时欢迎来玩！你可以用 Ranol 农场的入口。
Maybe I can tell you more about what I've been up to! That'd be nice.
说不定我还能跟你多说说我最近在忙什么！那样挺好的。
There you are! Back to norm...-
{u}?! What are you- that was you the whole time?! Why didn't you tell me!
{u}？！你怎么——一直都是你？！你为什么不告诉我！
Oh gosh, this has been... An awful reunion. I can't believe I dropped you into the Pit...
哦天啊，这真是……糟透了的重逢。真不敢相信我把你扔进了深坑……
I'm so sorry for- for all of that. You should have told me! Oh...
那一切我真的很抱歉。你应该告诉我的！噢……
Okay, uh... Here, take this. As- as compensation for- for all of that.
好吧，呃……来，收下这个。作为——作为那一切的补偿。
I... I need to get back to work. But- uh, if you ever want, feel free to visit sometime? You'll be able to use the entrance at Ranol's farm.
我……我得回去工作了。不过——呃，如果你想的话，随时欢迎来玩？你可以用 Ranol 农场的入口。
Maybe I can tell you more about what I've been up to! Heh...
说不定我还能跟你多说说我最近在忙什么！嘿……
To get to the creeper cave, follow the western path and turn left at the pigman camps.
要去苦力怕洞窟，就沿着西边的小路走，在猪人营地那里左转。
You had a piece of skin? Well, you don't seem to have it now, so I can't say I believe you.
你拿到过一块皮？可你现在身上好像没有，所以我没法相信你。
I am Thomas, and I help manage the supplies for a village in the Pigman Ravine. Though, I have a bit of a problem...
我叫 Thomas，负责帮猪人峡谷里的一个村子管理物资。不过，我遇到了点麻烦……
We're running low on ravine grains, which is our main staple we use for our food.
我们的峡谷谷物快吃完了，那是我们做食物用的主粮。
The last time we entered, I heard an explosion from the top. I fear the pigmen are blowing up our grain supply with TNT...
上一次我们进去的时候，我听到上面传来爆炸声。我担心那些猪人在用 TNT 炸我们的谷物……
I came here to {p} to see if I could find help here, but I've had no luck. Until now, that is. Would you be willing to help?
我来 {p} 是想找人帮忙，可一直没找到。直到现在。你愿意帮忙吗？
You would? You're a life saver. I'll meet you at the village, just follow the path out of town and take the northern-most entrance to the ravines.
你愿意？你真是救命恩人。我们在村子里碰头，沿着小路出城，走峡谷最北边的入口就行。
I'll meet you at the village! Just follow the path out of town and take the northern-most entrance to the ravines.
我们村子见！沿着出城的路走，从最北边的入口进峡谷就行了。
Once you get there, keep to the right wall of the ravine and climb up the stairs to reach the entrance. Also, be careful in the tunnel, as the pigmen throw rocks as a weapon.
到了之后，沿着峡谷右侧的岩壁走，爬上楼梯就能到入口。还有，在隧道里要小心，猪人会拿石头当武器扔。
Oh, finally, someone has come to this hidden village!
噢，总算有人来到这个隐秘的村子了！
I am Thomas, and I help manage the supplies for this ravine village. Though, I have a bit of a problem...
我叫 Thomas，负责帮这个峡谷村子管理物资。不过，我遇到了点麻烦……
You appear to be much stronger than I am, so maybe you could get past the tunnel pigmen and eliminate the explosions at the top.
你看起来比我强多了，也许你能闯过隧道里的猪人，把上面的爆炸解决掉。
Just keep to the right wall of the ravine and climb up the stairs to reach the entrance. Also, be careful in the tunnel, as the pigmen throw rocks as a weapon.
沿着峡谷右侧的岩壁走，爬上楼梯就能到入口。还有，在隧道里要小心，猪人会拿石头当武器扔。
Enter the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and reach the top of the ravine
进入 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的隧道，到达峡谷顶端
Bring back the [Creeper Skin] to Thomas at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
把 [苦力怕皮] 带回给 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Thomas
I didn't expect you to fall out of the sky like that. Are you okay, or should I go get the potion merchant to heal you?
没想到你会那样从天上掉下来。你还好吗，要不要我去找药水商人来给你治疗？
You're fine? Oh, good to hear. Did you manage to get rid of the pigmen and their explosives?
你没事？噢，那就好。你把那些猪人和他们的炸药解决了吗？
A green creature? A "creeper"? No such thing exists in this world, especially with the pigmen all around!
绿色的生物？“苦力怕”？这世界上根本没有那种东西，更何况到处都是猪人！
Oh, you brought a piece of skin back. How odd, I've seen this skin before...
噢，你带回来一块皮。真奇怪，我以前见过这种皮……
There's a large cave over to the south. I tried to enter it, but I got ambushed by green creatures...
南边有个大洞窟。我试着进去过，结果被绿色的生物伏击了……
I thought I was just dreaming, but these "creepers" you talk about...they might live in that cave.
我还以为只是在做梦，可你说的这些“苦力怕”……它们可能就住在那个洞窟里。
I have an idea. I need to know for sure that they live there. A merchant can make you a mask with the skin and another material.
我有个主意。我得确定它们真的住在那里。商人可以用这块皮和另一种材料给你做个面具。
There's a Pigman Overlord that sometimes hangs in a cave nearby. If you can kill it, you can get a pigman hide strong enough to make the mask.
附近的洞窟里有时会有一个猪人霸主。如果你能杀掉它，就能拿到够结实的猪人皮革来做面具。
If you continue on the western path past the tunnel entrance, you should find a camp where the Overlord is located.
如果你沿着隧道入口过去的西边小路继续走，应该能找到猪人霸主所在的营地。
Go get the pigman hide, and then come back to me so I can tell you what to do next.
去把猪人皮革拿来，然后回来找我，我再告诉你下一步怎么做。
Retrieve [{~} Pigman Hide] from the Pigman Overlord near [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and return to Thomas
从 [-{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 附近的猪人霸主身上取得 [{~1} 猪人皮革]，然后回到 Thomas 那里
I see you have the hide. This skin will work perfectly for my plan.
看来你拿到皮革了。这块皮正好能用在我的计划上。
There is a Mask Merchant in this village. He can make you a mask with the two materials I have.
这个村子里有个面具商人。他可以用我手上这两种材料给你做个面具。
With the mask, you can put it on and go undetected into the cave with these "creepers". Only then will we know the truth.
戴上面具，你就能不被发现地进入那个有“苦力怕”的洞窟。只有那样我们才能知道真相。
Also, if you somehow lose the mask, the merchant can make you another one if you bring him another piece of skin and hide.
还有，如果你不小心弄丢了面具，只要再带一块皮和一块皮革给商人，他就能再给你做一个。
Here are the materials. Be careful out there. Who knows what those green monsters could do to you...
材料在这里。出去之后小心点。谁知道那些绿色怪物会对你做什么……
Buy the creeper mask from the merchant and enter the creeper hideout at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
向商人购买苦力怕面具，进入 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的苦力怕藏身处
Bring Thomas [{~} Creeper Powder] to prove him creepers exist in Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
把 [{~} 苦力怕粉末] 带给 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Thomas，证明 Wynn 真的有苦力怕
So, what was in the cave? Were there really creepers in there?
所以，洞窟里有什么？里面真的有苦力怕吗？
What's this? It smells like gunpowder...but more earthy. And this came from the cave?
这是什么？闻起来像火药……但土味更重。这是从那个洞窟里拿来的？
This powder is definitely not native to this area. It has to have come from those creepers.
这种粉末绝对不是这一带原产的。一定是从那些苦力怕身上来的。
I guess for now we'll leave them at peace. If they do exist, they don't need to be hunted down to extinction.
我想目前还是别去打扰它们吧。如果它们真的存在，也没必要把它们赶尽杀绝。
Besides, if they are composed of gunpowder, they could easily blow this ravine to pieces.
而且，如果它们是由火药组成的，轻轻松松就能把这座峡谷炸成碎片。
Thank you for your help. I guess you deserve some sort of reward, considering you helped solve the ravine's big mystery.
谢谢你的帮忙。你帮忙解开了峡谷的大谜团，我想你应该得到点奖励。
Feel free to come back to our village any time. By then our food supply should be stable.
随时欢迎回我们村子来。到那时我们的粮食供应应该就稳定了。
Ah, it's good to see you again, pal! I apologize for not inviting you to the celebrations, but you seemed rather busy!
啊，真高兴又见到你，朋友！很抱歉庆祝的时候没邀请你，不过你那时看起来挺忙的！
Oh, it's you! Aaaagghh... Thank you for what you did for us, it's... mmhhhgg... really appreciated...
哦，是你！啊啊啊……谢谢你为我们做的一切，真的……嗯嗯……非常感激……
Anyone! Can anyone- oh, hello. You look strong enough to be able to help me.
有人吗！有没有人——哦，你好。你看起来够强，能帮我。
We usually get it ourselves, but recently an angry group of pigmen took over the tunnel to the top of the ravine, where the grain grows.
平常我们都自己去采，可是最近有一群愤怒的猪人占领了通往峡谷顶端的隧道，谷物就长在那上面。
Have you been to the creeper cave? Just follow the western path and turn left at the pigman camps.
你去过苦力怕洞窟了吗？沿着西边的小路走，在猪人营地那里左转就是了。
Thanks again for your help. Now we can truly say creepers exist here in the ravines.
再次谢谢你的帮忙。现在我们终于可以说，这片峡谷里真的有苦力怕了。
Oh, a visitor? Interesting. I thought I only knew about this cave, considering I was called crazy by my master.
哦，有访客？真有意思。我还以为只有我知道这个洞窟，毕竟我师父都说我疯了。
Hey. Don't just run head first!
Wha- You think those oats over there look fine?! Pff. Yeah, right.
什——你觉得那边的燕麦看起来还行？！呸。是啊，才怪。
They were growing pretty slow this year, all my crops, and then some salesman wanders into town with a "Miracle Cure" fertilizer.
今年我的庄稼全都长得很慢，然后就有个推销员带着什么“奇迹妙方”肥料进了镇子。
Just to prove that ridiculous phony Doubiss is a fraud- Here. I see some roots over here. Watch this, and you tell me if this is a "miracle!"
为了证明那个荒唐的冒牌货 Doubiss 是个骗子——来。我看到这边有些根。看好了，告诉我这是不是“奇迹”！
Here we go, here comes the big phenomenal growth that he promised me!
来了来了，他跟我保证的惊人生长要来了！
That Doubiss won't budge for my refund. I spent...so many emeralds...on this tripe! So that's where YOU come in.
那个 Doubiss 死活不肯给我退款。我花了……好多绿宝石……买这种垃圾！所以这就轮到你了。
He's in the blue and gray tent by the bank. I don't care how you do it, but get my money back and we'll split it half-and-half, deal?
他在银行旁边那顶蓝灰色的帐篷里。我不管你用什么办法，把我的钱要回来，我们对半分，成交？
Since he obviously ain't gonna be listenin' to me anytime soon, lemme tell you what the issue is with my fertilizer...
既然他显然不会听我说，那我来告诉你我的肥料有什么问题……
All the other farmers are usin' it right now, and look at their fields! Heck, I think the only reason these crops ain't dead is because of my product!
其他农夫现在都在用，你看看他们的田！见鬼，这些庄稼到现在还没死，全靠我的产品！
Y'know why? Next time ya pass a farm, take a good whiff o' the water, maybe a sip or two if you can manage. It'll be smelly and bitter.
知道为什么吗？下次你经过农场，好好闻闻那里的水，能的话再喝一两口。又臭又苦。
The crops, when I got here, were lookin' pathetic as ya get. I ain't a gamblin' man, but I'd be willing ta bet something's up with the water here.
我刚来的时候，庄稼的样子惨得不能再惨。我不是赌徒，但我敢打赌这里的水有问题。
The smell gets worse the closer ya get to the crypts in town, and while I ain't a native Oluxer, I've heard enough to know the wellspring is in the cave near there.
越靠近镇上的墓穴，臭味就越重，虽然我不是 Olux 本地人，但我听到的足够让我知道水源就在那附近的洞里。
It'll prob'ly be best fer everyone if ya took a looksee. Maybe if ya find some evidence, ya can show that crazy farmer, have 'im quit pesterin' me, eh?
你去看一看，对大家可能都好。说不定你找到证据，拿给那个疯农夫看，他就不会再来烦我了，嗯？
The cave is on the little hill, next to the crypt. Careful ya don't go trippin' over a gravestone, now!
洞窟在墓穴旁边的一座小山丘上。小心别被墓碑绊倒了！
The buggers stick to the mountain caves. They don't come down this far usually...s'pose there's an exception fer everything.
那些小鬼平常都待在山洞里。通常不会下到这么低的地方……我想凡事都有例外吧。
...mhm, mhm...you went into the well cave...and found...what, slimes?! Why would the SLIMES be there?
……嗯嗯，嗯嗯……你进了那口井的洞……然后发现了什么，史莱姆？！史莱姆怎么会在那里？
I wouldn't believe you if you weren't...well, uh...covered in the stuff. But that's definitely rancid.
要不是你……呃，全身都沾满了那东西，我才不会信你。不过那绝对是臭掉了。
So...that means that I've been...oh dear lord I'm an idiot.
所以……那就是说我一直……老天啊我真是个白痴。
Just...do me a favor and use that money to buy some good soap and wash up. I'm thankful and all, but you stink to high heaven!
只是……帮我个忙，拿那些钱去买块好肥皂洗干净。我是很感激啦，可你臭得熏天！
Trinkets for sale! Come buy yourself some cheap trinkets here!
小玩意儿出售！过来这边挑几件便宜的小玩意儿吧！
Ah, a customer! Welcome to my store of wares and trinkets!
啊，客人！欢迎光临我的杂货小玩意儿铺！
Is there anything that sticks out to you? Anything you'd like to purchase?
有没有哪一件特别吸引你？有想买的吗？
... The clock? That old piece of j-
... Yes, of course! Truly, this antique clock is very valuable! I'm sure you could find someone who would buy it for a high price!
……是的，当然！这座古董钟真的非常有价值！我相信你一定找得到愿意出高价买下它的人！
Taking a look at this clock... It's obviously broken. And yet, you can still hear a ticking sound coming from it...
你端详着这座钟……它显然是坏的。然而，你还是能听见从里面传出来的滴答声……
I can sell it to you for [{~} Emerald Blocks]. Truly an excellent price for such a... great item.
我可以用 [{~} 绿宝石块] 卖给你。以这么……了不起的东西来说，真是个超值的价钱。
... Well, you don't have to decide now, of course! Feel free to come back when you've made your decision!
……嗯，当然，你不用现在就决定！等你想好了随时回来！
呃啊……那个没用的、撒谎的、骗人的、偷东西的……啊啊啊！
You! Help me out over here! You aren't doing anything important right now, and this is urgent!
你！过来帮我一下！你现在又没在干什么正事，而这件事很急！
I got a few questions for you, see? Question one: D'you think crops are supposed to look like THIS?
我有几个问题要问你，懂吗？第一个问题: 你觉得庄稼应该长成这副鬼样子吗？
Look at them. I don't think there's a way for 'em to look any more sorry than this.
你看看它们。我不觉得它们还能比这更惨了。
If that's the case, go grab a scythe and try harvesting those Oats yourself!!
要是你这么觉得，就去拿把镰刀，自己收收那些燕麦试试！！
Go on, do it! I dare you! See how good they really are!!
去啊，动手啊！我赌你不敢！看看它们到底有多好！！
在 Anast 周围收集 [{~} 燕麦]。
See? What'd I tell ya? Rotten to the roots! Nothing here is ANY good!!
看吧？我怎么跟你说的？连根都烂了！这里没有一样是好的！！
I shoulda known it was too good to be true, but he said everyone else tried it too, so I bought some and tried to salvage this mess.
我早该知道天下没有这么好的事，可他说其他人也都用了，所以我就买了点，想挽救这烂摊子。
And here we are- me out half my savings and my fields as smelly and dead as an actual CORPSE!
结果呢——我的积蓄没了一半，田里又臭又死，跟一具真的尸体一样！
WOW, INCREDIBLE! AMAZING! It's almost like this is actual poison or something!!
哇，太不可思议了！太神奇了！简直跟真的毒药一样！！
Find Doubiss the salesman in {p} near the bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 {p} 银行附近 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找到推销员 Doubiss。
Ah, good day to ya! What is it ye be needin' from ol' Doubiss' stock?
啊，日安啊！你想从老 Doubiss 的货里找点什么？
Oh. Oh, goodie. That idiot farmer's sendin' ya to get his money back, ain't he? Sweet baby bovine, this is ridiculous...
噢。噢，好极了。那个白痴农夫派你来要他的钱，是吧？我的小圣牛啊，这太荒唐了……
Nothing! My fertilizer really does work! He probl'ly exaggerated how good I said it'd work, too! What'd he say, twice, three times the growth? More?
什么问题都没有！我的肥料真的有用！他八成还夸大了我说的效果！他怎么说的，两倍、三倍的生长？还是更多？
Search the aquifer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the problem with the water.
搜索 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的地下水层，找出水的问题。
And boy am I glad I bring me water in bottles. This stuff's rancid, full a' swamp slimes. No idea why they're here, though.
天哪，还好我喝的水都是瓶装的。这东西臭死了，满是沼泽史莱姆。不过不知道它们为什么会在这里。
's no wonder that Anast's crops ain't growin'. This is right under his farm! But we got some clear proof now, ain't we?
难怪 Anast 的庄稼长不起来。这里就在他的农场正下方！不过我们现在有确凿的证据了，对吧？
Howzabout ya take care o' this? I ain't a fighter, but if ya mulch these slimes the water oughta clear up, I figure.
你来处理这个怎么样？我不会打架，不过我想如果你把这些史莱姆剁碎，水应该就会变清。
Kill the slimes in the aquifer and bring back [Polluted Slime] to Anast.
杀死地下水层里的史莱姆，把 [被污染的史莱姆] 带回给 Anast。
Pyyyyeww! Yeesh, kid! You smell worse than a pig's sty! What the heck happened to you, where've you been?!
呕呕呕！天哪，小鬼！你比猪圈还臭！你到底怎么了，去哪里了？！
Ugh, eww! I don't want any of this sludge! I demand an explanation, now!!
呃，恶！我才不要这些烂泥！马上给我解释清楚！！
I guess I owe you some thanks anyway for trying to clear the sludge out. Suppose this year's harvest is just a bust.
不管怎样，你想帮忙清掉那些烂泥，我还是欠你一声谢谢。我想今年的收成就这样泡汤了。
Can't sell what little I have, so I figure you can take it, and a bit of cash too, since you basically did an exterminator's job.
我手上这点东西也卖不出去，所以你就拿去吧，再加一点钱，毕竟你基本上干了灭虫工的活。
Oi, bucko! Took my advice, eh? I figured I'd join ye, 'n see fer myself what was goin' on.
喂，小子！听了我的建议，嗯？我想着跟你一块儿来，亲眼看看到底怎么回事。
Well, glad I can start sellin' again without him shoutin' "Fraud! Con! Cheat!" in the distance! Thanks fer that, mate.
嘿，这下我总算能重新开张，不用再听他在远处大喊“诈骗！骗局！骗子！”了！多谢啦，伙计。
The little cave on the hill, by the crypts? That's the one leadin' to the water table under here.
山丘上墓穴旁边那个小洞窟？就是那个通到这底下地下水层的洞。
Check in there if ya feel up to some investigation, bucko. That farmer'll prob'ly want ta see it ta believe it when ya find somethin'.
要是你有兴致调查一番，就进去看看吧，小子。等你找到点什么，那个农夫八成得亲眼看到才肯信。
{#} Dexterity's a bit of a tricky one. The more of it you've got, the higher the likelihood is that your attacks will deal double damage. Neat, right?
{#} 灵巧比较微妙一点。你的灵巧越高，攻击打出双倍伤害的几率就越大。不错吧？
{#} Intelligence is for the spellcasters, it lowers the cost to cast spells and increases your max amount of mana.
{#} 智力是给施法者用的，它能降低施放法术的消耗，还能提高你的法力上限。
前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与农夫 Cevalus 交谈
Ah, looks like a fresh recruit! Did you see my posting? Good, good.
啊，看起来是个新兵！你看到我贴的告示了吗？很好，很好。
You see, my dear father-in-law recently passed, and I had to bury him hastily out back. Couldn't get a priest here in time to bury him all properly...
是这样的，我亲爱的岳父最近过世了，我只好匆匆忙忙把他埋在屋后。没来得及请牧师来好好安葬他……
Unfortunately, it so happens that my wedding ring might have slipped off as I was putting him to rest...
不幸的是，我在让他入土为安的时候，结婚戒指可能刚好滑掉了……
I need you to go back there and, well, recover the ring.
我需要你去后面，嗯，把戒指找回来。
It's nothing I couldn't handle myself, of course, but the wife already suspects something, and with her dear father passing so recently...
当然，这种事我自己也办得到，可是我老婆已经起疑了，而且她亲爱的父亲才刚过世……
Well, you see the situation I'm in? Help a poor fellow out, just go and grab that [Muddy Shovel] over there, and then come back to me.
嗯，你明白我的处境了吧？帮帮我这可怜人，去把那边那把 [沾满泥的铲子] 拿来，然后回来找我。
The [Muddy Shovel] is just over there. I'd really appreciate the help, recruit.
[沾满泥的铲子] 就在那边。你帮我这个忙，我会非常感激的，新兵。
You've got the shovel? Great! You've got some sturdy armour and a weapon too, I presume?
铲子拿到了？太好了！我猜你也有结实的护甲和武器吧？
Good, good. Better safe than sorry... As I always say! Always, ha ha...
很好，很好。小心驶得万年船……我一向这么说！一向，哈哈……
Oh, no reason really! Just making sure, ha ha... Should be perfectly safe back there, perfectly safe.
哦，其实也没什么原因！只是确认一下，哈哈……后面应该非常安全，非常安全。
Well, they're Skill Points! You gain them as you level up, then you can assign them to get bonuses in combat. Look, I'm no soldier, but even I know you really should be using them...
嗯，就是属性点啊！升级的时候会获得，然后可以分配它们来获得战斗加成。听着，我不是士兵，但连我都知道你真的应该用掉它们……
You get it, or do you want me to tell you what they are?
你懂了吗，还是要我跟你说说它们是什么？
is your best bet if you're struggling with staying alive. Decreases the damage you take, 's about all.
如果你总是活不下来，它是你最好的选择。减少你受到的伤害，大概就是这样。
Agility, now that one is for the risktakers. The more you have, the likelier you are to dodge incoming attacks, negating most of their damage.
敏捷嘛，那是给爱冒险的人的。点得越多，你就越有可能闪避来袭的攻击，抵消掉大部分伤害。
Best part is, you can combine them however you want, no matter your class or style of fighting.
最棒的是，不管你是什么职业、什么战斗风格，都可以随意搭配。
Just open your compass to assign your Skill Points. Then, when you're ready, head in there and get my ring.
打开你的罗盘就能分配属性点。然后，等你准备好了，就进去把我的戒指拿来。
Go on then, soldier! Show us the might of {p}'s army! Uh, I mean... get me that ring!
去吧，士兵！让我们见识 {p} 军队的威力！呃，我是说……帮我把戒指拿来！
What's going on in there, soldier? Have you found the ring yet?
里面怎么样了，士兵？找到戒指了吗？
You really should hurry, before... nevermind! Just find the ring and get out of there!
你真的得快点，免得……算了！找到戒指就赶快出来！
Holy Bovine! It's... it's... he's back! Kill it, quickly!
神圣的牛啊！那……那……他回来了！快杀了它！
You did it! Come back here now, so I can finally get my ring back.
你成功了！快回来，好让我终于能拿回我的戒指。
Goodness, that was a little more exciting than I anticipated, hmph. Still, good work! I'm glad we were able to get rid of that monster...
天哪，这比我预想的刺激了一点，哼。不过，干得好！我很高兴我们能除掉那个怪物……
I mean... poor father-in-law! I don't know how I'll explain this to the wife...
我是说……可怜的岳父！我不知道该怎么跟老婆解释……
I'll take the ring now, it's rather precious to me...
戒指我现在就拿走了，它对我来说挺珍贵的……
Anyhow, take this well-deserved reward for the, well, actions you took today. Perhaps, if you keep it up, you could even become a hero like Ragnar one day.
总之，拿着这份奖励吧，是你今天，嗯，这番作为应得的。说不定你继续努力下去，有一天还能成为像 Ragnar 那样的英雄。
Hello there, stranger. Was there something you wanted to speak to me about?
你好，陌生人。你有什么事想跟我说吗？
I should be angry but... I can't pretend to be surprised. He's always been such a forgetful oaf.
我应该生气的，可是……我也没法假装惊讶。他一向是个健忘的傻大个。
But, it explains a lot... He's been acting weird lately, ever since dad passed. That must've been what happened, so thank you for telling me.
不过，这就说得通了……自从爸爸过世，他最近就一直怪怪的。一定就是这么回事，谢谢你告诉我。
That's right. The one and only, ha ha...
We're just simple farmers, trying to get by. We were taking care of my dad until... well... yeah...
我们只是普通的农民，努力过日子。我们一直在照顾我爸爸，直到……嗯……唉……
