Thank you... It all happened so suddenly. On the day I left for {p}, dad was as healthy as ever, but when I came back he was already buried. The sickness must have come so fast...
谢谢你……一切都发生得太突然了。我去 {p} 的那天，爸爸还跟平常一样健康，可等我回来，他已经被埋了。病一定来得很快……
But at his age, I'm not surprised... It's just regrettable that we couldn't get a priest out here in time, dad was such a pious man.
不过以他的年纪，我也不意外……只是可惜我们没能及时请牧师来，爸爸是那么虔诚的人。
Dad... Above all, he was kind and always generous. He left us this entire farm. And very pious too, a true believer. Maybe that's why he lived so long...
爸爸……最重要的是，他很善良，一向慷慨。他把整座农场都留给了我们。而且非常虔诚，是个真正的信徒。也许这就是他能活那么久的原因……
Oh, dear... If I don't stop, I'm gonna start crying again.
哦，天哪……再说下去，我又要哭了。
You've used your Skill Points too, right? They could come in handy, should something happen.
你也把属性点分配好了吧？万一出了什么事，它们会派上用场。
There's five of them.  Strength,  Dexterity,  Intelligence,  Defence, and  Agility, each with different bonuses.
一共有五项。力量、灵巧、智力、防御和敏捷，各有不同的加成。
Why are you asking me that?
Now to see if you can find that ring Cevalus mentioned...
接下来看看你能不能找到 Cevalus 说的那枚戒指……
You manage to pry the ring off the monster's finger...
你费了点劲，把戒指从怪物的手指上撬了下来……
{#} Strength is handy if you're having a tough time taking down enemies. It makes your attacks hit harder, simple as.
{#} 力量在你打不动敌人的时候很有用。它能让你的攻击更痛，就这么简单。
Hello! Hmm, armour, weapon, look of grim despair... You must be from the Wynn province!
你好！嗯，护甲，武器，一脸阴郁绝望……你一定是从 Wynn 行省来的！
My name is Voer, and I'm an exotic plant merchant. I sell all kinds of, uh, perfectly legal goods to the magicians of Gavel.
我叫 Voer，是个珍奇植物商人。我卖各种，呃，完全合法的货物给 Gavel 的魔法师。
Lately, this Decay has been making business rather tough. The magical plants that used to grow here are dying.
最近黯蚀让生意变得很难做。以前长在这里的魔法植物正在枯死。
The need for magic has never been as big as it is now, and without supplies, the magicians of the swamp simply cannot operate!
现在对魔法的需求空前地大，没有补给，沼泽的魔法师根本没法干活！
It is a rather rare plant with all sorts of mystical properties, so much so that it can animate objects around it!
这是一种相当稀有的植物，有各种神秘的特性，甚至能让周围的物体动起来！
Look for the highest mountain in the swamp south-east from here. The Decay hasn't reached the peaks yet, you see!
去找这里东南方沼泽里最高的那座山。你看，黯蚀还没蔓延到山顶！
Find the mountain at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and a way up on it.
Go to the top of the mountain and get {~} Black Whistle Leaf.
爬到山顶，拿到 {~} 片黑哨草叶。
Return to Voer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with [{~} Death Whistle Leaf].
You've no idea what you even have done, do you? Your thoughtless actions will cost lives!
你根本不知道自己做了什么，对吧？你那不经大脑的举动会害死人的！
Uhm... Excuse me? What do you want, elf girl? We're in the middle of a deal here?
呃……你说什么？你想干嘛，精灵丫头？我们正在谈生意呢？
You sold Pink Pelulite! Have you forgotten its enraging properties? Or shall I read from that herbology book you "found" in my camp?
你卖了粉色 Pelulite！你忘了它会让人暴怒的特性吗？还是要我念念你在我营地里“捡到”的那本草药学之书？
You can't even say for certain. This kind of carelessness has no place! If you refuse to exercise the proper thought and caution, then those around you suffer.
你连这都说不准。这种粗心大意是不能容忍的！如果你不肯好好思考、小心谨慎，受苦的就是你身边的人。
Aaah, this is a disaster! Human, please, Pink Pelulite acts quickly and intensely... Follow the pink trail on the ground, the flowers shed their petals. Get it back before something bad happens!
啊啊，这下糟了！人类，拜托，粉色 Pelulite 发作又快又猛……跟着地上粉色的痕迹走，那种花会掉花瓣。在出事之前把它拿回来！
Follow the path of residue to the buyer’s cave.
顺着残留的痕迹找到买家的洞窟。
Ah, um, come back later please! Something strange is happening!
啊，呃，请晚点再来！有奇怪的事情发生了！
My body is a bit, um, not-in-my-control right now! I'd rather not hurt anyone!
我的身体现在有点，呃，不受我控制！我不想伤到任何人！
Remove the flower from the woman in the cave.
从洞窟里的女人身上拿走那朵花。
And what of the woman who bought it? Was she...?
那个买花的女人呢？她是不是……？
I need Death Whistle in particular. It's not as deadly as it sounds, I promise- the name's just archaic, if I recall right from that- er, my book.
我特别需要死亡哨草。我保证，它没有听起来那么致命——这名字只是比较古老，如果我没记错那本——呃，我的书的话。
Wait, wh-what? A Pink PELULITE!? I sold that woman a Pink PELUTE for her luck charms! How dare- wait...wait, Pink Pelute has rounder petals... Oh no.
等、什么？粉色 PELULITE！？我卖给那个女人的是粉色 PELUTE，给她做幸运符用的！你怎么敢——等等……等等，粉色 Pelute 的花瓣比较圆……哦不。
I must...make a difficult choice, and leave this job to you. I've other things to tend to, though it pains me to leave a life in another's hands. Remember this, villager!
我必须……做个艰难的决定，把这件事交给你。我还有别的事要处理，虽然把一条性命交到别人手上让我很难受。记住这一点，村民！
You're back, I see...and you're shedding petals! You got the Pink Pelulite back?
看来你回来了……你身上还在掉花瓣！你把粉色 Pelulite 拿回来了？
Oh, thank goodness! You got there in time. She's a regular of mine- and a bit of a looker, too. That Lari was right, to some extent, at least...
哦，谢天谢地！你及时赶到了。她是我的老主顾——长得还挺好看的。那个 Lari 说得对，至少有一部分是对的……
I did take her book, and I should be more careful in the future, regarding this...but I can't just quit selling these herbs.
我确实拿了她的书，以后在这方面我也该更小心……但我不能就这样不卖草药了。
I need an income, and the swamp isn't exactly the most resource rich region here! Especially not any more.
我得有收入，而沼泽可不是这一带资源最丰富的地方！现在更不是了。
And how dare she just walk away like that! It's a good thing you were around, human, otherwise...well, I'd rather not think about it.
而且她怎么能就那样一走了之！幸好有你在，人类，不然……唉，我都不敢想。
Regardless, you've helped me greatly. Got me my supplies and saved the life of a regular of mine, so I've got a gift for you!
不管怎样，你帮了我大忙。帮我拿到了货，还救了我一个老主顾的命，所以我有份礼物给你！
I'll offer you a sampler of my stock. Everything in here is pre-primed to be safe for brewing, so there won't be any mishaps like today!
我送你一份样品。这里每样东西都预先处理过，酿造起来很安全，不会再出今天这种岔子了！
I've got to sharpen up these old eyes of mine. Can't make a mistake like that again.
我这双老眼睛得放亮点了。不能再犯那种错了。
Still, that Lari girl... I have to wonder what her problem is.
不过话说回来，那个 Lari 姑娘……我真想知道她到底有什么毛病。
I know humans aren't renowned for their memory, but do hurry, yes? What you need is written down in your content book!
我知道人类的记性向来不怎么样，不过还是请你快一点，好吗？你需要的东西都写在你的内容手册里了！
Whatever that odd feeling was, it's over now. And there's Asher's shovel! Better return this to him.
不管刚才那种奇怪的感觉是什么，现在都过去了。那是 Asher 的铲子！最好拿去还给他。
Whenever you're ready to save Asher, step through the rift.
准备好去救 Asher 的时候，就穿过裂隙吧。
与 {p} 附近 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Asher 交谈。
Well well well, look who decided to come back with their tail between their legs.
哟哟哟，看看是谁夹着尾巴回来了。
Two weeks now and you still haven't found it? Ugh, I can't believe I ever trusted you with such a simple task.
都两个星期了你还没找到？呃，真不敢相信我居然会把这么简单的事交给你。
Who am I? WHAT DO YOU MEAN WHO AM I? You offered to help find my shovel, and I've been waiting two weeks!
我是谁？什么叫我是谁？你说要帮我找铲子，我都等了两个星期了！
Forget about your payment. Unless you either pay me back or get my shovel right now!
报酬你就别想了。除非你马上把钱还我，或者马上把我的铲子拿来！
My shovel? That's why I sent you out in the first place! It's somewhere in {p}. I lost it while following a trail of flowers.
我的铲子？我一开始就是为这个才派你出去的！它就在 {p} 的某个地方。我跟着一路的花走，结果把它弄丢了。
I think it was south west of the large ruined gate. Now go get it!
我记得是在那座倒塌的大门西南边。快去找！
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 附近找到 Asher 的铲子
Well hello there, stranger! Welcome to {p}! Always nice to see a new face around here.
哎呀你好啊，陌生人！欢迎来到 {p}！这里能看到新面孔总是件好事。
Mad at you? Why would I be mad at you? We've never met.
生你的气？我干嘛生你的气？我们又没见过。
I know this a bit forward, but I need to ask for your help with-
我知道这有点冒昧，不过我想请你帮忙——
Wait, is that-? It is! You've found my shovel! I recognize those markings anywhere.
等等，那是——？真的是！你找到我的铲子了！那些记号我在哪都认得出来。
But why is it so rusty? Ah, no matter. Give that to me and I'll head inside to get you a nice reward.
不过怎么锈成这样？啊，算了。把它给我，我进去给你拿份好奖励。
Thank you. Now, about that reward-
Oh dear, there he goes again. Poor fool ignored my warnings and touched that shovel.
哎呀，他又来了。可怜的傻瓜不听我的警告，碰了那把铲子。
He's gone and got himself stuck in a loop.
他把自己困进循环里了。
Head inside, soldier, and I'll explain what's happening here.
进屋吧，士兵，我来解释这里发生了什么事。
Without Asher, his house has vanished from time.
没有了 Asher，他的房子也从时间里消失了。
Let me explain why Asher disappeared...
让我解释一下 Asher 为什么会消失……
{p} was built many years ago by a long-lost civilization.
{p} 是很多年前由一个早已失落的文明建造的。
They had odd powers. They ended up distorting time itself.
他们拥有奇特的力量。最后连时间本身都被他们扭曲了。
The tools they used to make these structures are imbued with their power.
他们用来建造这些建筑的工具，都蕴含着他们的力量。
Asher found one of these tools: the shovel.
Asher 找到了其中一件工具: 那把铲子。
The shovel is tethering its time of influence to today. It keeps sending Asher back.
那把铲子把它影响的时间牵连到了今天。它不断把 Asher 送回去。
The issue is, Asher died in the past. This creates a paradox.
问题是，Asher 在过去死了。这就造成了悖论。
We can save him if I send you back to prevent his death. Go through this rift to join him in the past.
如果我把你送回过去阻止他死去，就能救他。穿过这道裂隙，到过去去找他吧。
Find a way to save Asher from his death.
想办法让 Asher 免于一死。
Usually this place is filled with workers.
平常这里都挤满了工人。
But no one's here. And this place is clearly not done.
可是一个人都没有。而且这地方明显还没盖完。
Whatever the case, I should probably find my shovel.
不管怎样，我大概得先找到我的铲子。
If I were a shovel, where would I be?
如果我是一把铲子，我会在哪呢？
This place... There's so much going on but no one here.
这地方……到处都在施工，却一个人都没有。
What I don't understand, though, is why this place looks brand new.
不过我不明白的是，这地方为什么看起来全是新的。
This place looks like it's just being built!
这地方看起来像是才刚开始盖！
This must be something to do with the valley's magic. Wouldn't be the first time.
一定跟山谷的魔法有关。又不是第一次了。
In fact, whenever I hold that shovel, this kind of stuff seems to happen.
说真的，每次我拿着那把铲子，好像就会发生这种事。
Maybe it's sent me way back. Back to the construction of this place.
也许它把我送回了很久以前。回到这地方刚开始建造的时候。
Then why is no one here?
那为什么这里一个人都没有？
Woah, that tree looks like it might fall over!
哇，那棵树看起来快倒了！
Uhf! How do they have a cannon? These guys must be super advanced.
呜哇！他们怎么会有大炮？这些人肯定特别先进。
I think I'm close now. I can just feel that shovel close by.
我觉得我快找到了。我感觉得到那把铲子就在附近。
My my, a crushing defeat to be sure. You'll have to find a way to stop that.
哎呀呀，这下可真是被压得粉碎。你得想办法阻止这件事。
Go back through the rift and make sure Asher doesn't become a pancake this time.
回到裂隙里，这次别让 Asher 被压成肉饼。
Well that was quite the explosive end to our friend there. There must be a way to prevent that.
嗯，我们这位朋友的结局可真是轰轰烈烈。一定有办法阻止的。
Head back in there. This time with less explosions.
Oh, so close on that try. Who could've guessed that was how our friend met his end?
噢，这次就差一点。谁想得到我们这位朋友是这样死的呢？
I'm sure you'll nail it this time. Not sure how you will stop a cosmic event, though.
我相信你这次一定能搞定。不过我不确定你要怎么阻止一场宇宙事件就是了。
Oh there it is! My shovel!
I'm surprised it took me back this far this time.
真没想到这次它把我送回这么久以前。
Well, time to head on back-
Asher, you remember when I allowed you to live in the valley, I told you not to touch any odd objects.
Asher，你还记得我让你住进山谷的时候，我告诉过你别碰任何奇怪的东西吧。
You got yourself stuck hundreds of years ago. If it wasn't for this guard, you'd be removed from existence.
你把自己困在了几百年前。要不是这位守卫，你早就从世上被抹除了。
Oh... So that's where I am. I am so sorry Martyn. Please don't kick me out of the valley.
噢……原来我在那里。真的很抱歉，Martyn。求你别把我赶出山谷。
I know time travel can be tempting. But it's far more dangerous than you can ever understand.
我知道时间旅行很诱人。但它远比你能理解的还要危险得多。
The valley is banned for most citizens. I watch over this timeline because of poor souls like Asher.
山谷对大多数居民都是禁地。正是因为有 Asher 这样的可怜人，我才守着这条时间线。
How did you get these powers? Are you even human?
你是怎么得到这些力量的？你到底是不是人类？
Oh you know. I've read a book or two in my time.
哦，你知道的。我这辈子也读过一两本书。
{u}, I'm sorry I got you dragged into this. I wish I could have done it myself.
{u}，很抱歉把你卷进这件事。我也希望能自己来。
I probably could have gotten myself out...
我大概自己也能脱身吧……
You died in the past. Multiple times.
你在过去死了。还不止一次。
Yes. In some surprising ways too.
对。有些死法还挺出人意料的。
{u}, I'm sure we will meet again... in time.
{u}，我相信我们会再见的……迟早而已。
I don't understand Martyn. He seems to know everything about the past. Here, come closer, I want to whisper something.
我搞不懂 Martyn。他好像对过去的事无所不知。来，靠近点，我想跟你说句悄悄话。
I think he might have known Bob. I saw some letters in his house.
我觉得他可能认识 Bob。我在他家里看到了几封信。
Weird, right? Bob was a hard guy to know.
很奇怪，对吧？Bob 可是个很难让人摸透的家伙。
Anyway, take this. It's the least I can do to pay you for saving me.
总之，这个给你。你救了我，这是我起码能做的报答。
A bunch of stupid mechs came here and just started ransacking!
一群蠢机甲跑来这里就开始乱翻乱抢！
Looks like a bunch of despermechs. That's what we call junk mechs, trying to survive.
看起来像是一群绝境机甲。我们都这么叫那些为了生存挣扎的废铁机甲。
I count three different mech marks. Looks like they split up once they got their parts.
我数到三种不同的机甲痕迹。看来它们拿到零件之后就分头跑了。
You got to help me here, I'm no warrior. Look they've dropped crates on their escape. Follow them and bring me back evidence that you destroyed them and I shall reward you.
你一定要帮帮我，我可不是战士。你看，它们逃跑时掉了箱子。跟着痕迹找过去，把你摧毁它们的证据带回来，我就给你奖励。
Three trails, three thieving despermechs. Be careful, they aren't to be underestimated.
三条痕迹，三台偷东西的绝境机甲。小心点，可别小看它们。
Locate the {~} mechs by following the trails of tools, return to Phinas with evidence that you destroyed the mechs.
顺着工具的痕迹找到那 {~} 台机甲，把摧毁机甲的证据带回给 Phinas。
You Wynn folk sure know your fights.
你们 Wynn 人真的很会打。
You found all three? Let's take a look. Hmm....
三台都找到了？我来看看。嗯……
Wait. These aren't Despermechs.. The factory fell over two years ago. These are brand new. Handmade.
等等。这些不是绝境机甲……工厂两年多前就倒了。这些是全新的。手工做的。
Would you look at that! Their code!
你看看这个！它们的代码！
Here, have them back. Take a close look at the names of these parts.
来，还给你。仔细看看这些零件的名字。
Find out where to go by looking at the pieces of junk.
看看那些废铁零件，找出该去哪里。
What are these? I have nothing to do with them!
这些是什么？跟我没关系！
Ahh.. Well, now that I think of it, writing my location on these parts was a bit stupid.
啊……好吧，现在想想，把我的地址写在这些零件上是有点蠢。
Those mechs were my creation. Corkus can still live with machines.
那些机甲是我做的。Corkus 还是能跟机器共存的。
The factory was a disaster. That's what happens when a machine controls a machine.
那家工厂是一场灾难。让机器控制机器就会变成那样。
I am living proof that humans can control them. Make use of them.
我就是活生生的证据，证明人类能控制它们。好好利用它们。
The metal shortage has made it difficult to make my machines... Not to mention the new laws..
金属短缺让我很难造机器……更别提那些新法律了……
If you want to turn me in, fine. You'll find all the evidence you need under my pillow.
如果你想告发我，那就去吧。你需要的所有证据都在我的枕头底下。
检测到陌生人……安全系统已启动。
I'm sorry it ended up like this, you should've just ignored that old man.
很抱歉最后变成这样，你当初就该别理那个老头。
I was made to be angry. I can't stop myself...
我被造出来就是为了愤怒。我控制不住自己……
Did you find the source of those odd handmade mechs?
你找到那些奇怪的手工机甲是从哪来的了吗？
Nettik? The Light House owner? It's not overly surprising.
Nettik？灯塔的主人？这倒不怎么意外。
She always did complain about the mech ban.
她一直在抱怨机甲禁令。
You see, many of the Corkian people rely on their machines. Have done for years.
你看，很多 Corkus 人都依赖他们的机器。好多年了都是这样。
So when the factory fell and the new laws were introduced, people's lives changed..
所以工厂倒了、新法律出来之后，大家的生活都变了……
People don't like change. Anyway, I can't thank you enough. Have this for your troubles.
人们不喜欢改变。总之，真是太感谢你了。这个给你，辛苦了。
Request additional orders from L.H. Defend.
向 L.H. Defend 请求追加指令。
Tools acquired, delivered to L.H. Additional orders received.
工具已获取，已送交 L.H.。已收到追加指令。
检测到入侵者。伪装失效。进入防御。
Strategic mission accomplished. Mechanical parts: procured.
战略任务完成。机械零件: 已获取。
Look in the content book if you forgot what to do.
忘了要做什么的话，翻翻内容手册。
I wrote down your task there.
我把你的任务写在那儿了。
What in the world are you doing here!? Get out immediately.
你到底在这儿干什么！？立刻出去。
I mean, welcome! Nothing suspicious here at all.
我是说，欢迎！这儿一点可疑的地方都没有。
Report back to Phinas after destroying the mech
摧毁机甲后回去向 Phinas 报告
任务线开始: 矮人与 Dogun
The report suggests that the two species would compete for space.
报告指出，这两个种族会争夺生存空间。
"Public opinion is firmly against removal of the natives..."
Find out what's happening at the theatre.
查明剧院里发生了什么事。
Interesting to see a Human wanting to see a Dwarven play!
真有意思，居然有人类想看矮人的戏！
The only play we're performing is the annual Victory Festival.
我们唯一上演的戏是一年一度的胜利节。
The entry cost is [{~} Emerald Block]
入场费是 [{~} 绿宝石块]
Just take a seat and enjoy the show.
找个位子坐下，好好欣赏演出吧。
Wait, is that- Hey, {u}! It's so good to see you!
等等，那是——嘿，{u}！见到你真好！
Hello, to the people of Gavel, glad to see so many here!
Gavel 的各位好，很高兴看到这么多人来！
I hope you'll enjoy the play and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
希望各位会喜欢这出戏，也希望它能让大家学到很多。我是今晚的旁白。
I hope you'll enjoy the play, and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
希望各位会喜欢这出戏，也希望它能让大家学到很多。我是今晚的旁白。
Pheeeew. I think we outran the villagers.
呼——。我想我们甩掉村民了。
I think we are safe here in the mountains. Oh look. Shiny ores. This is like a gold mine.
我想我们在这山里很安全。哦你看。闪亮的矿石。这简直就像金矿。
These nice minerals are very nice, let us start digging.
这些很好的矿物非常好，我们开始挖吧。
I am a dangerous monster and I will not let you mine these diamonds. We are the Doguns, and we will kill you!!
我是危险的怪物，我不会让你们挖这些钻石。我们是 Dogun，我们要杀了你们！！
Graoaoro. I will eat you all for my afternoon demon luncheon.
嗷嗷嗷。我要把你们全吃了，当我下午的恶魔午餐。
哞哈哈哈哈！滚开，小矮人们。
啊啊啊。我要死了……要死了！
MOAHAHAHA. WE WILL KILL ALL OF YOU.
哞哈哈哈。我们要杀光你们。
We need to forge better weapons so we can fight back.
我们得打造更好的武器才能反击。
Good idea! We will use our intelligence to slay the demons.
好主意！我们要用我们的智慧屠杀恶魔。
YOU CANNOT BEAT US, WE CAN SUMMON DRAGONS WITH OUR MAGIC.
你们打不过我们的，我们能用魔法召唤巨龙。
Dragons are no match for us?? CHARGE!
巨龙根本不是我们的对手？？冲啊！
We have won. Hooray. And now we have established a great citadel, {p}!
我们赢了。万岁。现在我们建立了一座伟大的城堡，{p}！
The dwarven intellect beat the sheer power of the demons magic.
矮人的智慧打败了恶魔纯粹的魔法力量。
I hope you enjoyed the show, and learned something new today!
希望各位喜欢这场演出，今天也学到了新东西！
We are continuing the celebration at the old Demon City. Follow the red banners outside {p} to get there.
我们会在旧恶魔城继续庆祝。沿着 {p} 外面的红色旗帜就能到那里。
Ugh, that was awful. Don't believe anything you see here, human. History is written by the victors.
呃，真是糟透了。别相信你在这里看到的任何东西，人类。历史是胜利者写的。
Welcome one and all! Dwarven brothers and sisters, guests and visitors!
欢迎各位！矮人兄弟姐妹们，宾客与访客们！
Welcome, one and all! Dwarven brothers and sisters, guests and visitors!
欢迎各位！矮人兄弟姐妹们，还有各位来宾与访客！
Axelus! You are under arrest for high treason!
The cover crumbles a touch at your grip when you open it up. How old is this?
你一翻开，封面就在手里微微碎裂。这东西到底有多老了？
If I could draw your attention to the wooden stage in the north, we can begin.
请大家把注意力转向北边的木制舞台，我们就可以开始了。
Welcome to the annual festival where we celebrate victory over the foul demons...The Doguns!
欢迎来到一年一度、庆祝战胜邪恶恶魔的节日……Dogun！
Now, if I can get you to turn around to face the bonfire, we've prepared a lovely firecasting show for you all while we prepare!
现在，请大家转过身面向营火，我们准备期间，为各位安排了一场精彩的火焰施法表演！
Wow, I didn't know Dwarves could learn such magic! Beats the heck out of firecrackers!
哇，我不知道矮人也能学会这种魔法！比鞭炮强多了！
Magnificent! Thank you very much to our fire casters. Now, ladies and gents, your attention to the main stage please!
太精彩了！非常感谢我们的火焰施法者。现在，女士们先生们，请把注意力转向主舞台！
For the last {~} years we have captured renegade Doguns that escaped the war, and this year is no exception!
过去 {~} 年来，我们一直在抓捕战后逃窜的叛逆 Dogun，今年也不例外！
We shall now entomb the foul demon to join the ranks of the other Doguns on display.
现在，我们将封存这个邪恶的恶魔，让它加入其他展示中的 Dogun 行列。
Note its magical might, its aggressive nature, its intense heat, and its fierce appearance.
请注意它的魔法力量、它凶暴的本性、它炽烈的高温，还有它狰狞的外表。
All no match for the ingenuity and comeradery of the Dwarven nations!
但这些全都比不上矮人各国的聪明才智与同袍情谊！
M-Monsters... You all...are the demons here...
怪、怪物……你们……才是这里的恶魔……
Every year, every year, every single YEAR you do this. You all need to open your god-blessed eyes for once!
每年，每年，每一年你们都这样做。你们全都该睁开你们那双受神祝福的眼睛看看了！
Do you all really believe everything they tell you? Do you all just lap it up like dogs?!
他们告诉你们的每件事你们真的都相信吗？你们就像狗一样全都舔下去吗？！
Our side won the war, but does that really mean we were in the right? I'll tell you right now, it doesn't!
我们这一方赢了战争，但那真的代表我们是对的吗？我现在就告诉你们，不是！
We all see it- The Doguns have feelings, family and thoughts, just like anyone else here!
我们都看得出来——Dogun 跟这里的每个人一样，有感情、有家人、有思想！
You are encasing live Doguns for entertainment. Public execution! This twisted display is more demonic than they ever could dream to be!
你们为了娱乐把活生生的 Dogun 封起来。这是公开处刑！这种扭曲的展示，比他们做梦都想不到的还要邪恶！
Guards! Get this propaganda spewing half pint to the Molten Core Prison, north side.
守卫！把这个满嘴宣传的小矮子带去北边的熔核监狱。
Come along, sir. Let's not make more of a scene.
跟我走吧，先生。我们别再闹得更难看了。
Why would Axelus say something so blatantly wrong?
Axelus 为什么要说这种明显错误的话？
What was he talking about? That was all nonsense!
他到底在说什么？全是胡说八道！
Are they really taking him to the Molten Core? You've heard the horror stories about there, right?
他们真的要把他带去熔核监狱？你听过那里的恐怖故事吧？
Well, the expression 'no hope blows from the north' came from there, since it's on the north side...
嗯，“北风吹来无希望”这句话就是从那里来的，因为它在北边……
Apologies, all. I shall provide us all with a quick way back to {p} on the floor here. We hope you enjoyed the show, despite the interruption!
抱歉了，各位。我会在这边的地上为大家提供一条快速回 {p} 的路。尽管有这段插曲，希望大家还是喜欢这场演出！
Find out more about the hysterical dwarf in {p}'s prison.
到 {p} 的监狱，进一步了解那个歇斯底里的矮人。
I see I got your attention. Interested in the truth.
看来我引起你的注意了。对真相感兴趣。
I'm no conspiracy nut. The Dwarves have been lied to for hundreds of years about the war.
我不是阴谋论疯子。几百年来，矮人一直被关于那场战争的谎言蒙骗。
I have seen the truth. But my word isn't enough, is it? Seeing is believing, after all.
我看过真相。但光凭我的话还不够，对吧？毕竟眼见为实。
Hopefully I will see you soon, {u}.
Pick up Axelus' note and head to the location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
捡起 Axelus 的纸条，前往 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的地点。
Well, now you have read what I read. The truth...or the lie.
好了，现在你读到了我读过的东西。真相……或者谎言。
My people are tyrants and conquerors...but they are also good. The people have been brainwashed.
我的族人是暴君和征服者……但他们也是善良的。人民被洗脑了。
Many things are about to happen. If you want to know more, come to house number {~} in {p}. I'll be waiting.
很多事就要发生了。如果你想知道更多，就来 {p} 的 {~} 号房子。我会等你。
Talk to Axelus in the Coalition Base.
在联盟基地与 Axelus 交谈。
Ah, you made it. Come and meet Korzim
We...are those who...want peace. I am son...of the Dogun Chief... I have...been banished.
我们……是那些……想要和平的人。我是……Dogun 族长的儿子……我已经……被放逐了。
The coalition is a small group of believers in the truth. The Doguns aren't demons, and the Dwarves aren't all brainwashed.
联盟是一小群相信真相的人。Dogun 不是恶魔，矮人也不是全都被洗脑了。
But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won’t tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
不过我们当然只能躲起来生活。Dogun 容不下矮人，而矮人会追捕叛徒和“恶魔”。
But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won't tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
但我们当然只能躲起来过日子。Dogun 容不下矮人，而矮人在追捕叛徒和“恶魔”。
We would...melt the beds...they sleep in... After all...we are...molten rock.
我们会……把他们睡的床……融掉……毕竟……我们是……熔岩。
This hideout was created by the Doguns in minutes, when it would have taken us days!
这个藏身处是 Dogun 几分钟就挖好的，换成我们得花上好几天！
It's a control panel. It's futile to figure out how it works, perhaps brute force is necessary.
这是一块控制面板。想弄懂它怎么运作是白费力气，或许只能硬来了。
Right now, we're trying to convince the public. But it's proving difficult, if not impossible.
我们现在正试着说服大众。但事实证明这很难，甚至根本不可能。
It isn't {~} years ago. We have the technology and supply chains to live here peacefully, but they just won't listen!
现在已经不是 {~} 年前了。我们有技术和补给链，能在这里和平生活，可他们就是不听！
We have...a plan... To win over...my people...that is.
我们有……一个计划……要赢得……我族人的……支持。
Korzim has told us that dragon bone is sacred to his people. We had to make some connections, but we have a way to get it now.
Korzim 告诉我们，龙骨对他的族人来说是神圣的。我们得打通一些关系，不过现在已经有办法弄到了。
If you want, you could come with us. We can explain more of the situation later. Exit's through the back.
如果你愿意，可以跟我们一起去。之后我们再多跟你解释情况。出口在后面。
Follow the group on the mission.
The others...are just up ahead. I'll let you through...our tunnel.
其他人……就在前面。我让你……穿过我们的隧道。
We use.. earth and.. fire.. elements. It is slow... like us.. but powerful.
我们使用……土和……火……元素。它很慢……像我们一样……但很强大。
We use...earth and...fire...elements. It is slow...like us...but powerful.
我们用……土和……火……元素。它很慢……跟我们一样……但很强大。
We don't forbid...you humans to be here, but please leave... We don't want any...unwanted dwarves here.
我们不禁止……你们人类待在这里，但请离开……我们这里不欢迎……不请自来的矮人。
We got this drill all the way from Corkus. Axelus had to pay a king's ransom to buy it, but this ought to work!
我们这台钻机是大老远从 Corkus 弄来的。Axelus 花了一大笔钱才买到，不过这应该管用！
AAAAGH! Idiot Corkus swindlers! Damn it all! How many emeralds did we waste?!
啊啊啊啊！Corkus 那些白痴骗子！该死！我们到底浪费了多少绿宝石？！
Ugh, do you have any experience with machines? You might have some idea of how in the hell to fix this hunk of junk.
呃，你有操作机器的经验吗？也许你知道到底该怎么修好这堆破铜烂铁。
Fantastic, {u}! We got the bone! Couldn't have done it without you.
太棒了，{u}！我们拿到骨头了！没有你我们办不到。
You can take it back to the coalition base. Barden and I will need to pack up before we join you.
你可以先把它带回联盟基地。我和 Barden 得先收拾东西再过去找你。
Just knock on the black block in front of the cave we arrived in.
敲一敲我们来时那个洞穴前面的黑色方块就行。
Head back to the Coalition Base through the tunnel.
穿过隧道回到联盟基地。
Dragon bone is one of the hardest substances in all the provinces. It's extremely rare.
龙骨是所有行省里最坚硬的物质之一。极为稀有。
We're going to present this to the Dogun chief as tribute. We need to tidy it up.
我们要把它当作贡品献给 Dogun 族长。得先把它整理干净。
Could you get [{~} Repair Kit] from the eastern part of the base?
你能去基地东边拿 [{~} 修理包] 吗？
Retrieve the [Repair Kit] in the eastern part of the base.
到基地东边取回 [修理包]。
There are voices behind this wall, and the trail ends here.
这面墙后面有人声，而且线索到这里就断了。
We have no vaults here. Must be traitors... The King really wants to see Axelus.
我们这里没有金库。一定是叛徒……国王很想见到 Axelus。
Stand back! I'll ready the charges...
No, no, ignore the repair kit! There's no time to worry about that!
不，不，别管修理包了！没时间顾那个了！
Our position has been compromised, they blew our doors wide open! We have to evacuate immediately.
我们的位置暴露了，他们把我们的门炸开了！我们必须马上撤离。
We've never been caught like this before, they never knew we really had Doguns on our side.
我们从来没被这样逮到过，他们从来不知道我们真的有 Dogun 站在我们这边。
We need to get to safety right now! The least explored area is the Upper Heights.
我们现在得马上去安全的地方！最少人探索过的区域是上高地。
Everyone, out! Now! They won't follow through the rough terrain!
所有人，出去！马上！他们不会穿过崎岖的地形追上来的！
Find your way up to the Dogun Village through the tunnel.
穿过隧道，找到通往 Dogun 村的路。
We'll stay around here, we aren't welcome in the village.
我们会留在这附近，村子不欢迎我们。
You are free to enter the village but we will stay back and wait until the coast is clear. Keep going.
你可以自由进入村子，不过我们会留在后面，等确定安全再说。继续走吧。
What is...that on the...cliff to the south?
南边……那座悬崖上……是什么东西？
What is... that on the... cliff to the south?
南边……悬崖上的……那是什么？
Hey, aren't those...Doguns?! A whole settlement...
嘿，那些不是……Dogun 吗？！一整个聚落……
They've been gathering forces! We must inform {p} immediately!
他们一直在集结兵力！我们必须马上通知 {p}！
Human. Come talk to me... Now.
人类。过来跟我谈谈……马上。
Human... That Dwarf, he saw us...
人类……那个矮人，他看到我们了……
They will... destroy us... If he reports... back to {p}.
他们会……消灭我们……如果他回去……报告 {p}。
We need to...prepare our defenses. We need all the...help we can get.
我们必须……准备防御。我们需要……所有能得到的帮助。
If you want a ticket you'll have to pay me [{~} Emerald Block].
想要票的话，你得付我 [{~} 绿宝石块]。
...oh Lord, this must be why! D-Doguns?!
Several rumours are suggested to be propagated amongst the population.
建议在民众之间散布若干谣言。
He is consorting with the enemy! Axelus, they've tainted your soul!
他在跟敌人勾结！Axelus，他们玷污了你的灵魂！
They will...destroy us... If he reports...back to {p}.
他们会……消灭我们……如果他回报……给 {p}。
"Any war could result in rioting in {p} and other established colonies."
“任何战争都可能在 {p} 及其他既有殖民地引发暴乱。”
We need to... prepare our defenses. We need all the... help we can get.
我们需要……准备防御。我们需要所有……能得到的帮助。
Wait... What are...you holding? Dragon bone...? Just what we need...
等等……你拿着……什么？龙骨……？正是我们需要的……
Human...if you promise to help us...I will grant you access to...our secret elevators... You can get up and...down the heights with those.
人类……如果你答应帮助我们……我就允许你使用……我们的秘密升降机……你可以用它们在高地……上下移动。
Please return to...us when you reach level {~}. Take this...badge so the...others recognize you...as an ally. One of the elevators is...to the south.
等你到了 {~} 级……请回到……我们这里。收下这枚……徽章，这样……其他人就会认出你……是盟友。其中一座升降机……在南边。
Ugh, that was horrible.. Like I said before, this war was a genocide. Don't believe any of the lies they try and feed you.
唉，那真是糟透了……我之前就说过，这场战争是一场种族灭绝。他们想灌给你的那些谎话，一句都别信。
Make your way to the Dogun festival at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] by following the red banners outside {p}.
顺着 {p} 外面的红色旗帜，前往 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Dogun 庆典。
Looks like Axelus dropped a note...? Doesn't seem like anyone else noticed.
Axelus 好像掉了一张字条……？看来没有别人注意到。
Seems like Axelus had more to say. Since no one else picked up the note, you may as well seek him out.
Axelus 似乎还有话要说。既然没有别人捡起那张字条，不如去找他吧。
Find out more about the hysterical dwarf in {p}'s prison at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 监狱，进一步了解那个歇斯底里的矮人
You came at the right time, {u}. It's good to see you're still interested in what's really going on here..
你来得正好，{u}。很高兴看到你还在意这里真正发生的事……
I've told you this already, but you have to know that it really is true. The Dwarves have been lied to for so long about the war.
这话我已经说过了，但你得知道那真的是事实。关于这场战争，矮人被骗了太久。
..But I think it's best if you see it for yourself. Relying on my word alone won't be enough to grasp the full extent of this dilemma.
……不过我想你最好亲眼看一次。光听我说，是没法明白这场困局有多深的。
It seems like Axelus slipped another note into your pocket.
Axelus 好像又往你口袋里塞了一张字条。
That gate must be the entrance to the Library that Axelus mentioned, but it looks locked tight. Could anything in the area open it up?
那道门一定就是 Axelus 说的图书馆入口，但看起来锁得死死的。这附近会不会有什么能打开它？
It's an extremely old book. The pages are torn, yellowed, and dusty.
这是一本极为古老的书。书页破损、发黄，蒙着灰。
"Top Secret"? The words are faded and hard to make out.
“最高机密”？字迹已经褪色，很难辨认。
It seems to be a report written at the start of the Dogun war.
看起来是一份在 Dogun 战争初期写下的报告。
"The natives occupy {~} of the habitable land in the heights..."
“原住民占据了高地上可居住土地的 {~}……”
Several pages are dedicated to the Doguns personalities, traits and powers.
有好几页专门写 Dogun 的性情、特征与能力。
"Clearance is needed if Dwarves are going to form a colony..."
“若矮人要在此建立殖民地，必须先清场……”
According to the report, the land was once rich with minerals and materials.
报告里写着，这片土地曾经矿产与资源丰饶。
This page appears to have been ripped out and crudely reattached.
这一页似乎被撕下过，又粗暴地粘了回去。
"A program of public profiling of the natives is recommended..."
“建议对原住民实施公开侧写计划……”
There are detailed instructions on producing propaganda against the Doguns.
里面详述了如何制作针对 Dogun 的宣传。
"...recommend they are referred to as demons, as inherent fear will take hold..."
“……建议称他们为恶魔，人心固有的恐惧便会生根……”
The report details propaganda at all levels of society, particularly at educational centers.
这份报告详述了社会各个层级的宣传手法，尤其是教育机构。
"Once public opinion is sufficiently hostile, establishment of colonies will be achievable..."
“一旦民意足够敌视，建立殖民地便指日可待……”
The report goes on to detail the total dominance of {p} and the importance of propaganda continuation.
报告接着详述 {p} 的全面支配，以及持续宣传的重要性。
Now do you see? Everything that I told you about when we rescued those flerisi was indeed true...
现在你明白了吧？我们救出那些 Flerisi 时我跟你说的一切，确实都是真的……
Search for house number {~} in {p} like Axelus said.
照 Axelus 说的，在 {p} 里找出 {~} 号房子。
To repair the mechanical core, select a colour and connect the clay with the same coloured glass block by clicking the iron blocks with the Rewiring Tool.
要修复机械核心，先选一个颜色，再用重新接线工具点击铁块，把黏土和同色的玻璃块接起来。
Head back to the coalition through the tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
穿过 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的隧道回到联盟那里。
The king has sent for you personally.
If you don't come with us we wi-
你要是不跟我们走，我们就——
Entomb these Doguns, and slay their Dwarven thralls!
把这些 Dogun 活埋，再把他们的矮人奴仆一并斩了！
But...bring them...the dragon bone...as a gift. If they accept it...they might accept us.
不过……带着……那根龙骨……当作礼物。要是他们愿意收下……说不定也愿意接纳我们。
We need to solve...this conflict somehow. Please...help us.
我们得想办法……解决这场冲突。求你……帮帮我们。
The Royal Guards escort you and Axelus out of the palace.
皇家守卫把你和 Axelus 押出了宫殿。
Aval...would have us...leave the Heights... But we...would not survive...in large numbers.
Aval……希望我们……离开高地……但我们……大批迁徙的话……活不下去。
Return to the Dogun village with a Dogun Badge of Trust and talk to the leader of the town
带着 Dogun 信任徽章回到 Dogun 村，与村子的首领交谈
You are so young...to be fighting...a war so old. Still...it is appreciated.
你如此年轻……却要投身……一场如此古老的战争。即便如此……我们心怀感激。
Why...would we trust... Why...would we trust... you...of all Dwarves?
为什么……我们要相信……为什么……我们要相信……偏偏是你这个矮人？
The war...to you, it would be...ages ago. But...when one has lived for...{~} years...
那场战争……对你而言……已是很久以前。但是……当一个人活了……{~} 年……
We have...few options. We need to discuss...the few we have...available.
我们的……选择不多。我们得商量一下……仅有的……那几条路。
I am sorry...to welcome you all...in such troubled times.
很抱歉……要在这样艰难的时刻……欢迎各位。
We thought...we could hide in safety... But there is...no place left to hide.
我们原以为……能安全地躲起来……但已经……无处可躲了。
Aval... would have us... leave the Heights... But we... would not survive.
Aval……希望我们……离开高地……但我们……活不下去。
We must...evacuate the settlement...immediately. They...are coming...again.
我们必须……立刻……撤离聚落。他们……又要来了。
[New Quest Started: Dwarves and Doguns Part II]
[新任务开始: 矮人与 Dogun 第二部]
Please! You all know me, I'm not with the side of the government. Hear me out, we can fix this!
拜托！你们都认识我，我不是政府那边的人。听我说，我们能解决这件事！
Stop! I have been hiding from the Dwarves just as much as anyone here, they've been after me too!
住手！我跟这里的每个人一样一直在躲着矮人，他们也在追捕我！
Why... would we... trust you... of all Dwarves?
为什么……我们要……相信你……偏偏是你这个矮人？
How...could you even help? They...won't listen to you.
你……又能怎么帮忙？他们……不会听你的。
I know all the war strategies and weapon cache locations.
我知道所有的作战策略和武器储藏点的位置。
Treason...against your own kind...? How will you...manage this?
背叛……你自己的族人……？你要……怎么做到？
The human and I will sneak into the armoury and sabotage their equipment. Korzim will help you Doguns evacuate someplace safer.
我和这个人类潜入军械库，破坏他们的装备。Korzim 会帮你们 Dogun 撤到更安全的地方。
I am...yet wary of you...but we will...follow your plan...Dwarf. Korzim...lead us...to safety.
我……仍然信不过你……但我们会……照你的计划做……矮人。Korzim……带我们……去安全的地方。
{u}, follow the southern road from {p}, towards the {p} entrance. I'll be waiting there for you near the armoury.
{u}，从 {p} 沿着南边的路走，前往 {p} 的入口。我会在军械库附近等你。
在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Axelus 会合。
Shh! Get behind here, and look towards the armoury doors.
嘘！躲到这后面来，看着军械库的门。
We need to sneak in when they aren't looking, got it? But we need to be fast.
我们得趁他们不注意的时候溜进去，懂吗？但动作要快。
If they close that door, we'll only have one option left, and it's a huge risk. Those Dwarven gates are almost unbreakable.
如果他们关上那扇门，我们就只剩一个办法了，而且风险极大。那些矮人的大门几乎坚不可摧。
Alright boys, let's close this up and head to base B.
好了伙计们，把这里关上，去 B 基地。
Aaah! Charge them! HEY, STOP RIGHT THERE, SOLDIERS!
啊啊！冲上去！嘿，给我站住，士兵们！
Defeat the {p} Guards outside the armory.
击败军械库外的 {p} 守卫。
It's the traitor! Capture them, now! There's only one reason they would be near the armoury!
是那个叛徒！马上抓住他们！他们出现在军械库附近只可能有一个原因！
Is that all of them? We're out of danger, at least, but they still shut the door, damn it!
都解决了吗？至少我们脱离危险了，可他们还是把门关上了，该死！
Gah, all that for nothing! You're not too banged up, are you?
啊，全白忙了！你没伤得太重吧？
Well, I said there's another way, but it's not a guarantee. Hurry, follow me.
嗯，我说过还有另一个办法，但不保证行得通。快，跟我来。
Urgh, damn it. They almost never bother to close this door, and now of all times...
呃，该死。他们几乎从来懒得关这扇门，偏偏这个时候……
There's nothing for it. They'll be sending reinforcements soon, we need a way through here.
没办法了。他们很快就会派援兵来，我们得想办法从这里过去。
Those black bricks look breakable...but that won't solve the door, will it?
那些黑砖看起来能打破……但这解决不了门的问题，对吧？
Find a way to break through the black bricks outside the wooden door.
想办法打破木门外的黑砖。
Alright, let's destroy these machines! You see the two cannons?
好，我们来毁掉这些机器！你看到那两门大炮了吗？
If you use rocks as ammo, you'll destroy the machine it's aiming at, but if you use tnt, it'll selfdestruct. Good luck
如果你用石头当弹药，就会摧毁它瞄准的机器，但如果你用 TNT，它就会自爆。祝你好运
Follow Axelus deeper into {p} and destroy the power source of the city, the {p} Power Core.
跟着 Axelus 深入 {p}，摧毁城市的能源来源——{p} 能源核心。
Nice work! That will slow them down. We're not done yet, we need to pay the king a visit. Let's head further into {p}.
干得好！这能拖慢他们。我们还没完，得去拜访国王。我们继续深入 {p}。
Hurry! Through here, to the power core!
快！穿过这里，去能源核心！
This is a geothermal power core. If we can disrupt it, it should slow them down.
这是个地热能源核心。如果我们能干扰它，应该就能拖慢他们。
The hypocrites used Dogun magic to make this... It's lucky, honestly. I know how to work it.
那群伪君子用 Dogun 的魔法造了这个……说实话，这倒是走运。我知道怎么操作它。
...hell, they already rallied?! That's the army!
……见鬼，他们已经集结了？！是军队！
That sounds like an entire battalion!! How did they know I was going after this?
听起来像是整整一个营！！他们怎么知道我要来搞这个？
Dogun magic is slow! Keep me defended, this'll take awhile!
Dogun 的魔法很慢！保护好我，这得花点时间！
Grr, this is harder than I thought!
Ah! Don't let them get too close!
I hate that you're having to fight my people, but I wouldn't be asking for help if it weren't needed.
我很不愿意让你跟我的族人战斗，但如果不是真的需要，我也不会找你帮忙。
Hm...the slums should be behind this wall here. We'll lose them there.
嗯……贫民窟应该就在这面墙后面。我们在那里能甩掉他们。
The power's down, but...that cannon should do to get us through. You know how to operate it, right?
能源断了，不过……那门大炮应该能帮我们打通。你知道怎么操作吧？
Dwarvern society isn't as great as they make it out to be. The poorest are hidden away.
矮人社会没有他们说的那么美好。最穷的人都被藏起来了。
The coalition has helped these people through some hard times, we can trust them.
联盟帮这些人度过了一些难关，我们可以信任他们。
There's a reason I brought us here. The sewer system is connected to the royal palace. All the way to the kings bathroom.
我带我们来这里是有原因的。下水道系统连着王宫。一路通到国王的浴室。
We need to find a way to ignite this explosive. Can you take a look around?
我们得想办法点燃这个炸药。你能四处看看吗？
Find a way to enter the sewer system.
想办法进入下水道系统。
If we can convince the king that it’s not worth the fight, he may back down.
如果我们能说服国王这场仗不值得打，他也许会让步。
I'm a little ashamed to admit I know my way round the sewers by now.
我有点不好意思承认，我现在对下水道已经熟门熟路了。
You have to understand.. The people truly think the Doguns are evil incarnate. But the king knows better.
你得明白……人民真的以为 Dogun 是邪恶的化身。但国王心里清楚。
Enter the Royal Palace through the sewer pipe and find the king.
从下水道管道进入王宫，找到国王。
Don't let the guards catch you. Stay out of sight, got it?
别让守卫抓到你。躲好别被看到，懂吗？
Sneak past the guards and talk to the Dwarven King.
偷偷溜过守卫，与矮人国王交谈。
I can't say I'm surprised, Axelus. Guards, let them be.
我并不意外，Axelus。守卫，放他们走。
You know why I'm here, father. We haven't got any more chances to stop this.
你知道我为什么来，父亲。我们已经没有别的机会阻止这一切了。
Axelus, you know why we have to maintain the lie. Think about the people, how they would react.
Axelus，你知道我们为什么必须维持这个谎言。想想人民，想想他们会有什么反应。
We can not be responsible for the lies of our ancestors! This is ridiculous and you know it!
我们不能为祖先的谎言负责！这太荒唐了，你自己也知道！
Axelus, if the people found out, everything would descend to chaos. There would be riots, revolutions!
Axelus，如果人民发现了，一切都会陷入混乱。会有暴动，会有革命！
If you hadn't turned traitor and gone gallivanting off with the Doguns, you would be in a better position to convince me.
要是你没有叛变、跟 Dogun 四处游荡，你现在会更有立场说服我。
As it is now, you are too little and too late. The war has already begun.
照现在这样，你太弱小，也太迟了。战争已经开始了。
The armoury that a certain someone decided to sabotage won't make any difference.
某人决定破坏的那座军械库改变不了什么。
You will commit genocide so you don't have to face the consequences of your lies?
你要进行种族灭绝，就为了不去面对你那些谎言的后果？
I will be the hero of our nation, and my name will forever be remembered as the King who brought peace.
我会成为我们国家的英雄，我的名字会作为带来和平的国王被永远铭记。
I have nothing left to say to you. See yourselves out behind the throne. I'll let you use the trading tunnel to {p} in the southern caves, if you just step back and let me handle things.
我跟你没什么好说的了。从王座后面自己出去吧。只要你们退后让我处理，我就让你们使用南边洞穴里通往 {p} 的贸易隧道。
I'm not giving up on this. I'm going back in, I know he can be reasoned with!
我不会放弃的。我要回去，我知道他听得进道理！
Give this letter to Korzim in the Dogun village when you reach level {~}.
等你到了 {~} 级，把这封信交给 Dogun 村的 Korzim。
I'm going to have one last talk with my father.
我要跟我父亲进行最后一次谈话。
You shouldn't enter this place yet!
你现在还不该进这个地方！
The {p} Power Core has been disrupted!
Follow Axelus deeper into {p} and destroy the power source of the city.
跟着 Axelus 深入 {p}，摧毁这座城市的动力来源。
Leave the Royal Palace at the end of the palace.
Leave now and I won't send the Dwarven army on you. You don't want to get hunted like the Doguns, do you?
现在就走，我就不派矮人军队追杀你。你也不想像 Dogun 那样被追捕吧？
And Axelus, leave the city. You are no longer my son.
还有 Axelus，离开这座城。你不再是我的儿子了。
{u}...I take back my statement. They have already begun... There cannot be reasoning.
{u}……我收回我的话。他们已经开始了……没有讲道理的余地了。
A door slamming open is heard in the distance...
远处传来一声门被猛然撞开的声响……
Return to the Dogun Village with the letter and speak to Korzim.
带着信回到 Dogun 村，与 Korzim 交谈。
We...have an issue. A dire one... Where is...Axelus at a time...like this?
我们……有麻烦了。很严重的麻烦……在这种时候……Axelus 去哪了？
Oh... From Axelus, then...? He could not find...a stone? That...does not bode well.
噢……那么是 Axelus 给的……？他找不到……石头？那……可不是好兆头。
He is trying to...reason with the Dwarven King? There is...no one else...then. You... You will have to...help.
他在试着……跟矮人国王讲道理？那……就没有别人了。你……你得……帮忙。
The chieftain is...desperate. He has enacted a...terrible plan. They are planning on summoning Garaheth.
酋长……走投无路了。他启动了一个……可怕的计划。他们打算召唤 Garaheth。
If they succeed...we all die. Dwarves... Doguns... Possibly even Villagers...and then... Humans as well.
他们若成功……我们都会死。矮人……Dogun……或许连村民……然后……人类也一样。
Garaheth is a...horrible demon. We used to worship him...thousands of years ago.
Garaheth 是个……可怕的恶魔。我们曾经……在几千年前崇拜过他。
I only overheard parts... But enough to be certain. They are preparing...to the south. At a disused...ritual site.
我只偷听到一部分……但足以确定。他们正在……南边准备。在一个废弃的……仪式场地。
Meet me there... Do not just attack. We may be able to...resolve it peacefully. I will wait...by the staircase.
在那里跟我会合……不要直接动手。我们也许能……和平解决。我会在……楼梯旁等你。
Investigate the structure to the south.
We shall take the east tower... Hide there...and watch.
我们去东边的塔……躲在那里……观察。
Interrupting...at this point will have...disastrous consequences. We must let them continue...and pray they fail.
这个时候打断……会造成……灾难性的后果。我们只能让他们继续……祈祷他们失败。
Reach into the darkness...and grasp the hand of Garaheth to purge the intruders...
伸入黑暗……握住 Garaheth 之手，清除入侵者……
This is a worst-case scenario... Meet me in {p}. We will talk more there...
这是最坏的情况……到 {p} 跟我会合。我们到那里再详谈……
Hoho...! Over here...fine traveler! Join me at the gates!
呵呵……！这边……尊贵的旅人！到城门这里来找我！
This dwarf voice is...horrible on my throat...but it is an effective disguise...is it not?
这矮人的嗓音……对我的喉咙真是折磨……不过这伪装……挺有效的……不是吗？
We are headed to...a blacksmith in town. Follow me...
我们要去……镇上的一个铁匠那里。跟我来……
...Korzim...what in the name of all that is holy is that disguise?
……Korzim……以一切神圣之名，你这是什么伪装？
I'm flabbergasted you fooled anyone with that thing! How did you stop the beard from burning?
你竟然能用那玩意骗过别人，我简直惊呆了！你是怎么让胡子不烧起来的？
But, erm...more importantly, who's the bucko in the fancy armour there?
不过，呃……更重要的是，那边穿着华丽盔甲的家伙是谁？
An ally...of the coalition. No time...Edula. Doguns... summoning... Garaheth.
一个盟友……联盟的。没时间了……Edula。Dogun……在召唤……Garaheth。
So...so it's really down to that low, then. Burning your own house down to kill the rats.
所以……所以真的到了这个地步了。为了杀老鼠，把自己的房子都烧了。
Good thing we've got this prepared. One fallout will prevent the next. Soldier, I've got a list of materials we need!
还好我们早有准备。一场灾难能防住下一场。士兵，我这里有一张我们需要的材料清单！
You will need [{~} Fire Webs] . The Heatscar Spiders under the town make them, there's a cave right by the entrance arch.
你需要 [{~} 火焰蛛丝]。镇子底下的热疤蜘蛛会吐这种丝，入口拱门旁边就有个洞窟。
Then, [{~} Magmatic Crystals] from the {p} mines. I'd get them myself, but...I'm banned from there since the rubber mallet incident.
然后，从 {p} 矿坑拿 [{~} 岩浆水晶]。我本来可以自己去拿，可是……自从橡胶锤事件之后我就被禁止进去了。
Lastly, [{~} Crystallized Lava]. The closest source is in the lava lake just outside {p}. There's a protruding crater in the lake.
最后，[{~} 结晶熔岩]。最近的来源在 {p} 外面的熔岩湖里。湖里有个突起的火山口。
Bring back [{~} Fire Webs], [{~} Magmatic Crystals], and [{~} Crystallized lava].
带回 [{~} 火焰蛛丝]、[{~} 岩浆水晶] 和 [{~} 结晶熔岩]。
The crystal formation... It is definitely here.
I will clear the lava... On my signal, move. And do not stop.
我来清开熔岩……等我信号，就走。而且别停。
Mhm, looks like everything's in order. Now, for a short explanation.
嗯嗯，看起来都没问题。现在，简单解释一下。
These materials go into crafting a special charm. It will allow you to resist demon fire.
这些材料是用来打造一种特殊护符的。它能让你抵挡恶魔之火。
We need to account for if they finish the summoning, so this'll help keep you safe if you end up having to square off with Garaheth.
我们得考虑到他们完成召唤的可能，所以万一你得跟 Garaheth 正面交锋，这能帮你保住性命。
You will need to craft it yourself, so its magic will bond to you. I've got a station just for it.
你得亲手打造它，这样它的魔法才会跟你结合。我有一个专门的工作台。
Right-click the crafting table in the back and put it together.
右键点击后面的工作台，把它组装起来。
Craft the amulet in the crafting table.
We must... visit... Sanba... the enchanter.
Go to the enchanter and enchant the amulet.
前往附魔师那里给护符附魔。
Erm...Korzim, what on earth are you doing here? It's not safe for you!
呃……Korzim，你到底在这里干什么？这里对你不安全！
Wait, that amulet...oh no, really? Okay, I know what's going on.
等等，那个护符……哦不，真的吗？好，我知道是怎么回事了。
We're going to need to give this a little extra kick if you're going to use this for what I think you are.
如果你们要拿它去做我想的那件事，我们得给它再加点料。
A pinch of fire scarab tail, splash of sulphur, exactly three ounces of old brimstone...!
一撮火甲虫尾巴，一点硫磺，刚好三盎司的陈年硫磺石……！
Infunde hoc monile, alta intra monte. Magia!
Infunde hoc monile, alta intra monte. Magia!
Meet me in the back, we can't talk out here. You never know who's listening...
到后面来找我，在这里不能谈。你永远不知道谁在偷听……
Enter the storage room in the enchanter's house.
进入附魔师家的储藏室。
Supposing you're here to help, Soldier. Garaheth's being summoned if you're getting this...
我想你是来帮忙的吧，士兵。如果你拿到这个，就代表 Garaheth 正在被召唤……
Axelus prepped a contingency plan for this, but having to put it in action is surreal. Let me fill you in.
Axelus 为这种情况准备了应急计划，可真到了要执行的时候，还是觉得很不真实。我来给你讲讲。
That dragon skeleton lying in the Heights belonged to an Ice Drake. Centuries ago, it was used in the Dogun wars.
躺在高地的那具龙骨属于一头冰亚龙。几百年前，它在 Dogun 战争中被派上用场。
It had incredibly potent magic, particularly in its icy breath. The area it hit is still frozen to this day, and shows no signs of thaw.
它拥有极其强大的魔法，尤其是它冰冷的吐息。被它击中的地方至今仍然冰封，丝毫没有解冻的迹象。
According to Axelus' stories, its breath travelled through the tunnels and coalesced someplace deep within...
根据 Axelus 的说法，它的吐息穿过隧道，在深处某个地方凝聚了起来……
...becoming True Ice, a potent mixture of sheer cold and magic energy. That's what we will need to combat Garaheth.'
……变成了真冰，一种极寒与魔法能量的强效混合物。那就是我们对付 Garaheth 需要的东西。
If you bring me [{~} True Ice] I can make a staff capable of harnessing it...and we can freeze Garaheth in its tracks.
如果你给我带来 [{~} True Ice]，我就能做一根能驾驭它的法杖……然后我们就能把 Garaheth 冻在原地。
If you bring me [{~} True Ice] I can make a staff capable of harnessing it...and we can freeze Garahath in its tracks.
只要你带 [{~} True Ice] 回来，我就能做出一根能驾驭它的法杖……我们就能把 Garaheth 原地冻住。
Me and my husband will support the coalition as long as we live.
只要我们还活着，我和我丈夫都会支持联盟。
Head north to the Freezing Heights and make your way to the top, now! We've got no time at all!
往北去 Freezing Heights，爬到最上面，快！我们一点时间都没有了！
Travel to the frozen heights and find {~} True Ice.
前往 Freezing Heights，找到 {~} 块真冰。
{u}... This... This used to be...a Dogun town. The Dwarves rendered it barren.
{u}……这里……这里以前是……一个 Dogun 小镇。矮人把它变成了荒地。
They used the Drake... They chained it up and...forced it to attack. We had to kill it...
他们利用了那头冰亚龙……他们用锁链锁住它……逼它攻击。我们只好杀了它……
It...froze my town...as it died. I was there...{~} years ago.
它……在死去时……冻住了我的小镇。我当时就在……{~} 年前。
I know the way... into the caves.
The True Ice...is deep inside. I will struggle to...stay warm here.
真冰……在很深的地方。在这里我很难……保持温暖。
I will try to run through...as quickly as possible. The ice is...painful.
我会尽量……快速跑过去。这冰……好痛。
We must... move fast... or... we will both.... freeze.
必须……快走……否则……我俩都……冻住。
Maybe... I am... hotter than... I thought... do you.. Hear that?
也许……我比……我想的……还热……你……听到了吗？
Oh no... I think... It's... COLLAPSING.
My... feet are... solid... Keep... running.
This is it... The thing that... Killed my families... [{~} True Ice].
就是它……那个……杀死我族人的东西……[{~} True Ice]。
Return to the enchanter with the True Ice.
带着真冰回到附魔师那里。
Impressive, you two. Must've been tough to get that...doubly so for Korzim.
厉害，你们俩。拿到那个一定很辛苦……对 Korzim 来说更是加倍辛苦。
Impressive, you two. Must have been tough to get that...doubly so for Korzim.
你们两个真行。那东西肯定不好拿……对 Korzim 来说更是加倍艰难。
Here is the staff, {u}. Keep it safe, and don't you go dying on us.
法杖在这里，{u}。好好保管，可别死了。
My husband and I will round up the coalition and get them to act now. We need to get going before-
我和我丈夫会召集联盟，让他们马上行动。我们得赶紧出发，免得——
...that's the barracks door. That's the barracks door!!
……那是兵营的门。那是兵营的门！！
Men! We have to meet for briefing on the surface, the war is due any hour now! Move faster!
弟兄们！我们得到地面上集合听简报，战争随时都会开始！快点！
They're already going?! We're out of time! Korzim is waiting for you just upstairs when you reach level {~}. Go train! NOW!
他们已经出发了？！我们没时间了！等你到了 {~} 级，Korzim 就在楼上等你。去练级！马上！
Return to the Dogun village with the letter and speak to Korzim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
带着那封信回到 Dogun 村，到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Korzim 交谈。
Korzim reads the message on the tablet silently. His expression is inscrutable.
Korzim 默默读完石板上的信息。他的表情让人看不出端倪。
Travel to {p} and meet Korzim at the entrance at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
前往 {p}，到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的入口与 Korzim 会面。
Good job collecting the tools needed to destroy the demon.
干得好，摧毁恶魔所需的工具都凑齐了。
Go to the enchanter and enchant the amulet at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Travel through the Freezing Heights and get [{~} True Ice].
穿越 Freezing Heights，拿到 [{~} True Ice]。
The ice has trapped you. Try again.
你被冰困住了。再试一次。
If you're having trouble finding the crater, look for the reddest rocks in amongst the others in the lake. They should lead you to it.
如果你找不到那个火山口，就在湖里的石头之中找最红的那些。它们应该会带你过去。
Quiet. Dwarven whelp...you have failed... We will not go quietly. AWAKEN.
闭嘴。矮人小崽子……你失败了……我们不会束手就擒。苏醒吧。
{u}... Do you have...the staff? And the amulet...?
Return to Korzim on the second floor of the enchanter in {p} with the Amulet of Fire Resistance and the Staff of True Ice.
带着抗火护符和真冰法杖，回到 {p} 附魔师二楼的 Korzim 那里。
The war is starting... and Axelus... He has not returned.
战争要开始了……而 Axelus……他还没回来。
We can not go... Not without him. Find him... And bring him to the... Dogun village.
我们不能去……没有他不行。找到他……带他到……Dogun 村。
I can not leave. The guard...it is on high alert. He was last at {p}...yes?
我不能离开。守卫……处于高度戒备。他最后出现在 {p}……对吧？
Head to {p} and look for Axelus.
The first group has already started their climb, let's hurry.
第一批人已经开始往上爬了，我们快点。
Hey! Everyone, the king has someone in the cage! It's been years since we used it!
嘿！大家快看，国王把人关进笼子里了！那笼子好多年没用过了！
Wait, that's Axelus up there!! The king locked up his son?! What in the world?
等等，上面那个是 Axelus！！国王把自己的儿子关起来了？！这到底是怎么回事？
I heard he was consorting with demons, but that can't possibly be true, can it?
我听说他跟恶魔勾结，不过那不可能是真的吧？
For the last time, they are not demons!! Gods, I've been telling you this whole time! Not even my father will listen to reason!
我最后说一次，他们不是恶魔！！天哪，我从头到尾一直在跟你们说！连我父亲都不肯讲道理！
If I don't get freed we're doomed, you hear me?! We won't survive another war! As your prince I demand to be freed!
如果我不被放出去，我们就完了，听到了吗？！我们撑不过另一场战争！我以王子的身份命令你们放我出去！
Listen, the statues are climbable and there's a control panel for the lava siphons near them! Now help me so we all don't die!
听着，那些雕像可以爬，雕像旁边有熔岩虹吸管的控制面板！现在帮帮我，免得我们全都死掉！
Free Axelus and escape the city.
Wait, that human just defaced the hero's monument!! Are they working with the demons too?
等等，那个人类刚刚毁了英雄纪念碑！！他们也是跟恶魔一伙的吗？
{u}! I didn't think you'd be back, but we need to leave, now! Meet me outside!
{u}！我没想到你会回来，不过我们得马上离开！在外面跟我会合！
{u}! Over here, to the right! By the cannon! I'm commandeering this thing.
{u}！这边，右边！大炮旁边！这东西我征用了。
We need to get up to the Doguns before the Dwarves begin their assault, or before the Doguns take their last resort.
我们得在矮人发动进攻之前，或是 Dogun 采取最后手段之前，赶到 Dogun 那里。
Get in the cannon, now! You've got your armour, you might end up charred and covered in soot but you'll be fine!
快进大炮！你有护甲，可能会被烧焦、沾满煤灰，但你不会有事的！
Don't tell anyone we shot ourselves out of a cannon, I'll never live it down. Now come on, to the Dogun village, hurry!
别告诉任何人我们是用大炮把自己射出去的，不然我这辈子都抬不起头。好了，快，去 Dogun 村！
If the Doguns are taking their last resort and summoning Garaheth, then we've got two sides to stop at once...basically, the odds are astronomically against us.
如果 Dogun 正在采取最后手段召唤 Garaheth，那我们就得同时阻止两边……说白了，我们的胜算低得离谱。
That means you do what you need to do, no matter what. Understood? If we can stop this madness then the casualties won't have died for nothing! Now move!
这代表你该做什么就做什么，不管怎样。明白吗？如果我们能阻止这场疯狂，那些牺牲就不会白费！现在快走！
Reach the portal and stop Garaheth.
I can't believe this... That bone was part of the ritual?! Agh, how could we have been so STUPID! You're all lucky we prepared for this!!
真不敢相信……那根骨头是仪式的一部分？！啊，我们怎么会这么蠢！还好我们为此做了准备，你们都走运了！！
You need to get inside him. He's still chained! The amulet will protect you from the heat! Freeze him from the inside out!!
你得进到他体内。他还被锁着！护符会保护你不被烫伤！从里面把他冻住！！
Find all {~} organs and destroy them.
找到全部 {~} 个器官并摧毁它们。
Leave Garaheth and exit his realm.
离开 Garaheth，走出他的领域。
EVERYONE, STOP THIS! RIGHT NOW!! IT'S OVER!!
所有人，住手！马上！！结束了！！
Open your eyes for once in your lives!! You see that?! Behind me! THAT was going to be the end result!
这辈子就睁开眼睛看一次吧！！你们看到了吗？！我身后！那本来就会是最后的结局！
Garaheth would have killed every one of us, damn it! Are you that short-sighted that you can't see this?!
Garaheth 会杀光我们每一个人，该死！你们难道短视到连这都看不出来吗？！
Everyone here is to blame, except the human who helped stop this! The Doguns were already exiled, they wouldn't have hurt anyone!
这里的每一个人都有责任，除了帮忙阻止这一切的人类！Dogun 早就被放逐了，他们不会伤害任何人！
But we couldn't just let ANYTHING be! You always need more glory, more, more, MORE! Don't you, Draani? I'm ashamed to be your lineage!
可我们就是什么都放不下！你永远需要更多的荣耀，更多，更多，更多！对吧，Draani？身为你的血脉让我感到羞耻！
And you, Doguns! I...I pitied you. You were wronged, but you resort to this? You'd doom the world over to spite the Dwarves? Is that it?!
还有你们，Dogun！我……我同情过你们。你们被冤枉了，可你们竟然采取这种手段？为了报复矮人，你们要毁灭整个世界？就是这样吗？！
Whelp. You do not understand. To be persecuted...and see your people tortured...hunted.
小崽子。你不懂。被迫害……看着你的族人被折磨……被猎杀。
You all deserve it! You attacked our ancestors for sport! Eye for an eye, have you heard of it? It's only fair!
你们活该！你们拿我们的祖先取乐！以牙还牙，听过没有？这才叫公平！
Imbeciles...your stories are not true. We... We lived through the war. You took everything...and suffered none.
蠢货……你们的故事不是真的。我们……我们亲历过那场战争。你们夺走了一切……却什么苦都没受。
I've been trying to tell BOTH of you that the monarchy has been spreading lies for centuries! One bad king doesn't mean the whole species is a loss!
我一直想告诉你们双方，王室几百年来一直在散播谎言！一个坏国王不代表整个种族都没救了！
Shut your mouth. Even now...you trample on the bones of our god... You have taken everything from us...
闭上你的嘴。即使到了现在……你们还在践踏我们神明的骸骨……你们夺走了我们的一切……
This earth is stained by you. We...we shall burn you...and scatter your ash to the wind.
这片土地被你们玷污了。我们……我们要烧死你们……把你们的骨灰撒向风中。
DON'T YOU DARE! STOP, RIGHT NOW!
You would... You would kill a savior...?
你们竟然……你们竟然会杀死一位救命恩人……？
No, no! No no no, this can't be happening! H-Hang on, we'll save you, I...I'll do something, I...
不，不！不不不，这不可能！撑、撑住，我们会救你的，我……我会想办法，我……
Y-You DEMONS! MONSTERS! I'll avenge you, Axelus, j-just give me time-
你、你们这些恶魔！怪物！我会替你报仇的，Axelus，只、只要给我时间——
AGH, SHUT UP! SHUT...ack... Q-Quiet. Listen to one damn word from my mouth, Draani... For once in your miserable life
啊，闭嘴！闭……呃……安、安静。就听我说一句该死的话吧，Draani……你那悲惨的一生就听这一次
Tell. The. TRUTH!! G-gaagh...you know that's th...the only way to stop this. Swallow your pride, you...old fool...
说。出。真相！！呃、呃啊……你知道那是……唯一能阻止这一切的办法。放下你的骄傲吧，你这……老糊涂……
I...I... Axelus... He...he called me Draani...why did...?
我……我……Axelus……他……他叫我 Draani……为什么……？
Men, stand down. This... This war is over! I will not have one more life lost! Touch the Doguns and I'll personally behead you!
所有人，停手。这……这场战争结束了！我不会再让任何一条生命逝去！谁敢碰 Dogun，我就亲手砍了他的头！
Chief, I...I ask of you but an hour of your time. If you are willing to negotiate...
酋长，我……我只求你给我一个小时。如果你愿意谈判……
Speak with the King of {p} and the Dogun Chieftain.
与 {p} 国王和 Dogun 酋长交谈。
Ah, you've arrived. I...actually remember you from earlier. So you and...
啊，你来了。我……其实记得之前见过你。所以你和……
...you knew my son. Were helping him try to put an end to this, before everything was too far gone. Heh...apologies, for that.
……你认识我儿子。在一切无法挽回之前，你一直在帮他想办法结束这一切。呵……为此，我很抱歉。
Paku and I have had a long discussion about the wisdom of youth over the old. You all were right. I needed to swallow my pride.
Paku 和我长谈了一番，谈的是年轻人比老人更有智慧。你们都是对的。我需要放下我的骄傲。
We agreed upon a peace treaty... A new city... The Dwarves will aid us in building it.
我们达成了和平条约……一座新城……矮人会帮我们建造。
All hostilities...will end. My people will...be free to roam the caverns. It has been...too long.
所有敌对……都会结束。我的族人……将能自由地在洞穴中漫游。已经……太久了。
And the entombed Doguns at Courag will be reconstituted, as well, supposing that is a possibility.
而被封存在 Courag 的 Dogun 也会被复原，如果有可能的话。
Every king, since my so-far-great grandfather, Draani Thunderwill, has battled with their morality over the lies told to my people.
自从我那不知隔了多少代的先祖 Draani Thunderwill 以来，每一位国王都为向我的人民撒谎一事而在良心上挣扎。
It ends here, with the name Draani VIII. It will take time, but the bloodshed has proven things must begin to change now.
这一切就到此为止，止于 Draani 八世这个名字。这需要时间，但这场流血已经证明，改变必须从现在开始。
You and the coalition have saved the Heights, and Gavel. In {p}, you will find a stall to trade valuable minerals. You will be granted special Dwarven privileges to purchase it now.
你和联盟拯救了高地，也拯救了 Gavel。在 {p}，你会找到一个交易珍贵矿物的摊位。你将获得矮人的特别许可，现在就能在那里购买。
Though that is...almost certainly not enough a reward for everything you have done...sincerely. Thank you, Wynn soldier.
虽然对于你所做的一切，这……几乎肯定算不上足够的回报……真心地。谢谢你，Wynn 的士兵。
Return to Korzim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] on the second floor of the enchanter in {p} with the Amulet of Fire and the Staff of Ice.
带着 Amulet of Fire 和 Staff of Ice，回到 {p} 附魔师二楼 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找 Korzim
Reach the ritual colosseum and prevent Garaheth from being summoned
抵达仪式竞技场，阻止 Garaheth 被召唤
Freeze any vital point of Garaheth you can find!
找到 Garaheth 身上任何要害就冻住他！
We...we have nothing left... We could have...taken them with us... Now they will...will... You...!
我们……我们什么都不剩了……我们本来可以……把他们一起带走的……现在他们会……会……你……！
I left a very precious journal inside of this mansion, a hell within walls. It was my great grandfather's!
我把一本非常珍贵的日记忘在这座宅邸里了，这里简直是四面墙围起来的地狱。那是我曾祖父的！
与 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Leucsaa 对话
Let's see here... mother's old vase... check!
我看看……母亲的旧花瓶……有了！
Dining room table... got it here, check!
Finally, the journal. It's out here somewhere, I assume. I'll look around.
最后是日记。我想应该就在外面哪里吧。我找找看。
Hold on, what? The journal! I must have forgotten it inside the mansion!
等等，什么？日记！我一定是把它忘在宅邸里了！
You there! Would you mind doing me a deed?
那边的你！能帮我个忙吗？
The mansion was designed by a Corkian architect, and I was scammed into buying it.
这座宅邸是一位 Corkus 建筑师设计的，我是被骗才买下它的。
If you step inside the mansion just for a few moments, you'll understand why the sellers had to trick someone into investing in their god forsaken real estate!
你只要进去待上一小会儿，就会明白卖家为什么非得骗人来买他们这块鬼地方了！
Navigating from room to room is nearly impossible, the rooms move around. I've only been in the mansion for a week and I'm already packing my bags and moving to {p}.
在房间之间走动几乎不可能，房间会自己移动。我才住了一个星期，就已经在打包行李准备搬去 {p} 了。
Navigate the mansion to the room holding the journal
在宅邸里找路，前往放着日记的房间
The journal! You outsmarted the mansion!
日记！你智胜了这座宅邸！
I must thank you, that journal was priceless to my family.
我得谢谢你，那本日记对我家来说是无价之宝。
Let this be a life lesson to you. Never buy a house from a Corkian architect.
就当是给你的人生教训吧。千万别买 Corkus 建筑师盖的房子。
Third Division - Guarding Sovereign Soosu's mansion.
第三分队：守卫 Soosu 统领的宅邸。
The painting has a note attached to it.
这幅画上附着一张纸条。
Attend the meeting to prepare for the plan in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的钢羽参加会议，为计划做准备。
I trust everyone has taken the time to process last night's announcement? I will let Syndra take over shortly, but first, I would like to thank each and every one of you.
我相信大家都花时间消化昨晚的宣布了吧？我等一下会让 Syndra 接手，但首先，我想感谢在座的每一位。
I won't mince words. This is dangerous work. What we are planning puts us at great risk. But this is what it takes to change Fruma, to put an end to the crown's oppression!
我就直说了。这是危险的工作。我们计划的事会让我们身陷险境。但要改变 Fruma、终结王室的压迫，就得这么做！
We will kill a God! And we will all be free. Now, Syndra?
我们要杀死一位神！然后我们都将获得自由。好了，Syndra？
Thank you, Quill. To begin, allow me to give each group their assignment.
谢谢你，Quill。首先，我来分配各组的任务。
Mora and Yuman, you will be infiltrating the guards' outpost in {p} to retrieve their schedules. Get in, note down the formations, and get out.
Mora 和 Yuman，你们负责潜入 {p} 的守卫哨所，取得他们的排班表。进去，记下部署，然后出来。
Mora, you're familiar with military structure, and Yuman knows his way around {p}. I expect you two should be able to make it work.
Mora，你熟悉军队的编制，而 Yuman 对 {p} 很熟。我想你们两个应该能搞定。
Understood. However, I have a few concerns with the overall plans... I'll speak with you later.
明白。不过，我对整体计划有些顾虑……之后再跟你谈。
Yusanu and Sui, you'll be constructing explosives that we can use as distractions during the festival to draw guards away from the main stage.
Yusanu 和 Sui，你们负责制作炸药，在庆典期间用来声东击西，把守卫从主舞台引开。
I trust Yusanu knows what he's doing, so Sui, you'll be acting as an assistant.
我相信 Yusanu 知道自己在做什么，所以 Sui，你来当助手。
Works for me. I might already have some blueprints lying around somewhere...
我没问题。我这里说不定已经有些设计图丢在哪了……
Zeph and Rex, I want you to scout the city rooftops for potential spots where Rex and Yulie can provide aerial support... in case it's necessary.
Zeph 和 Rex，我要你们去侦察城里的屋顶，找出 Rex 和 Yulie 能提供空中支援的位置……以防万一需要。
Yeah, I c- c- can do that.
Quill and Yulie, you two know your way around the city. I'll need you to scout out potential escape routes from the city... again, in case things go badly.
Quill 和 Yulie，你们两个熟悉这座城市。我需要你们侦察出城的逃生路线……同样，以防情况不妙。
Ah, that should be a breeze.
...yes. I think I have a few places in mind already.
……好。我心里已经有几个地方了。
Finally. {u}, I want you to be adaptable. Help out wherever it's needed - I'm sure your skills will come in handy.
最后。{u}，我要你随机应变。哪里需要就去帮哪里——我相信你的本事会派上用场。
Hey, if you're helping out wherever, you should come with me and Mora! Guard positions would be handy to know before finding escape routes.
嘿，既然你哪里都帮，那就跟我和 Mora 一起吧！找逃生路线之前先知道守卫的位置会很有用。
I was about to suggest the same thing. Then let us adjourn this meeting. Good luck, everyone.
我正想这么建议。那就散会吧。祝大家好运。
Hum. {u} and Yuman, let us go discuss our plans then.
嗯。{u} 和 Yuman，那我们来商量一下计划吧。
Meet up with Mora and Yuman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Mora 和 Yuman 会合。
Alright, guys! So, any plans? What're we cooking with here?
好了，各位！所以，有什么计划？我们手上有什么招？
Hey, man, everything good? I'm uh, not that horrible to work with, am I? Haha.
嘿，老兄，你还好吧？我，呃，没那么难合作吧？哈哈。
Ah! My apologies. No, it is not you... I simply do not like Syndra's plan.
啊！抱歉。不，不是因为你……我只是不喜欢 Syndra 的计划。
You must understand, I would trust her with my life... but that is precisely the issue. She will do anything to avoid putting us in danger.
你要明白，我愿意把性命托付给她……但问题正在于此。她会不惜一切避免让我们陷入危险。
She treats us as her own children, but she is only a decade older than I am! She would put herself through all the suffering in the world, if only to avoid letting us help where it is most needed!
她把我们当成自己的孩子，可她只比我大十岁！她宁愿自己承受世上所有的苦，也不肯让我们在最需要的地方帮忙！
She is willing to take the fall if the plan goes awry. But, this time... this time, I will not back off. I am not allowing her to put herself through that danger alone.
如果计划出了差错，她愿意一个人扛下。但是，这一次……这一次，我不会退让。我不会让她独自面对那种危险。
Yeesh. Didn't think you guys were that messy! I think I get it though.
哎哟。没想到你们之间这么复杂！不过我想我懂。
My bros... they mean well, yeah, but they never ask for help. They're always trying to do everything themselves, and... and it drives me nuts!
我哥哥们……他们是好意，没错，但他们从不开口求助。他们总想什么事都自己扛，然后……然后快把我逼疯了！
Like, man, just let me do something!! Anything!! It's so frustrating.
就是说，天啊，让我做点什么吧！！什么都行！！真的很让人火大。
Ha! I did not think we had this in common. Well then... perhaps we can both prove ourselves to our families, eh?
哈！没想到我们有这个共同点。那么……也许我们都能向家人证明自己，嗯？
Yeah!! I like the sound of that!!
Okay, well, I know where the guards' outpost is in {p}. Let's just go to it and take it from there!
好，我知道 {p} 的守卫哨所在哪。我们直接过去，到了再说！
Ha, settle down a little. I think we need to be a bit more prepared than that. But, yes, time is of the essence, so let us head there first. I will attempt to think of a plan on the way.
哈，冷静点。我想我们得准备得比那更充分。不过，没错，时间紧迫，所以我们先过去吧。我会在路上想个计划。
Whatever, man! Too much planning often spoils the results... but, sure! Let's meet outside the tallest building in {p}. First tunnel to the right leads there!
随便啦，老兄！计划太多往往会坏事……不过，好吧！我们在 {p} 最高的建筑外面碰头。右边第一条隧道通往那里！
Meet up with Yuman and Mora in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 与 Yuman 和 Mora 会合。
Good grief, this town's a mess. How does anyone live here?
天哪，这座城真是乱七八糟。怎么会有人住在这里？
Eh, ya get used to it. Here, follow me.
嗯，住久了就习惯了。来，跟我走。
See, {p} utilizes all the space it has... stacking things atop each other. For example, this so-called "skyscraper" is mainly an apartment building!
你看，{p} 把所有空间都用上了……把东西一层层往上叠。比如说，这栋所谓的“摩天楼”主要是公寓楼！
Then... what exactly are we doing here?
那……我们到底来这里做什么？
I said mainly, man. The top floors serve as the offices for the local commander and constables. That's also why we've got to climb this staircase!
我说的是主要啦，老兄。顶楼是当地指挥官和警备兵的办公室。所以我们才得爬这道楼梯！
Hope you guys are in shape!
Uh... we're on a mission, right? Trying to prove ourselves? Schedules are up there, so...
呃……我们在执行任务，对吧？要证明自己？排班表就在上面，所以……
We cannot just... walk in there and grab the schedules! You do realize that, right? {u} and I are wanted by the crown! Even showing ourselves here at all is a risk.
我们不能就这样……走进去拿排班表！你明白吧？{u} 和我都被王室通缉！光是在这里露面就已经很冒险了。
Hey man, these soldiers see hundreds of people every day! If you don't give 'em a reason to pay attention, your faces won't stick out at all.
嘿老兄，这些士兵每天看几百个人！只要你不给他们注意你的理由，你们的脸根本不会显眼。
Yuman, we were going to make a plan before rushing in. Did you forget about that?
Yuman，我们本来要先定好计划再冲进去。你忘了吗？
Riiight. Right. Sorry, I got excited. I am right, though - it wouldn't be hard for me to just talk us through this!
对……对。抱歉，我太兴奋了。不过我说得没错，靠我这张嘴带我们混过去并不难！
This furnace seems to power the big crane...
这座熔炉似乎是那台大型起重机的动力来源……
Riiight. Right. Sorry, I got excited. I am right though - it wouldn't be hard for me to just talk us through this!
对——对。抱歉，我太兴奋了。不过我说得没错——要靠嘴把我们混过去一点都不难！
Sigh... here, I have a better plan. Let us take some guard uniforms and put them on, and reach the schedules that way. We'll stand out even less, then.
唉……听着，我有个更好的计划。我们去拿几套守卫制服穿上，用这种方式拿到排班表。这样我们就更不显眼了。
Ohh. A sneak mission! That's good. They should definitely have some spare uniforms in the tower... *and*, it should be pretty empty this time of day. Everyone's out patrolling.
哦哦。潜入任务！不错。塔里肯定有备用制服……而且，这个时段那里应该挺空的。大家都出去巡逻了。
So, good plan, man! I like it! Let's get to it!
所以，好计划，老兄！我喜欢！开工吧！
Find guard uniforms inside of the guard tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的守卫塔里找到守卫制服。
See? I told you, nobody's here!
Ha. I suppose I should have faith in your knowledge. My apologies.
哈。我想我应该相信你的判断。抱歉。
...ah, is that really all? I thought they would be harder to find.
……啊，就这样？我还以为会更难找。
With how many guards have to come through here every day for uniform exchanges, this is just the easiest way. More efficient having it out here.
每天有那么多守卫要来这里换制服，这是最方便的办法。放在外面比较有效率。
Oh, you are just going for it... I see. {u}, let's wait outside until he's done.
哦，你就直接换啊……好吧。{u}，我们到外面等他换好。
Well? Thoughts? How do I look?
怎么样？有什么想法？我看起来如何？
Like an average Roughworks soldier, I suppose.
我想，就像个普通的 Roughworks 士兵吧。
不知道 Zeph 会怎么想……
Ah- haha, uh, n- nothin! Your turn!
啊——哈哈，呃，没、没什么！换你了！
This uniform is so... uncomfortable. And to think, I nearly signed up for this...
这制服真是……不舒服。想想看，我差点就加入这行了……
Yeah, you'd think they'd complain about it more! But nah, they're all... stoic.
是啊，你会以为他们会多抱怨几句！但没有，他们全都……一声不吭。
Yes... well, {u}, it's your turn. Hurry, please. Someone could come up here at any time.
是啊……好了，{u}，换你了。请快点。随时可能有人上来。
Find the guard schedules inside the guard tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的守卫塔里找到守卫排班表。
Very well. Let us get this over with.

呃、嗯，好啊。我正、正要去那边。
