我、我现在没办法休息。我得、得练习。
All things considered, I am excited to find out how my explosives will perform.
综合来看，我很期待看看我的炸药表现如何。
I hope Yus' tech doesn't let me down...
希望 Yus 的技术不会让我失望……
I have a really bad feeling about tomorrow. Syndra better know what she's doing.
我对明天有很不好的预感。Syndra 最好知道自己在做什么。
Resistance will always come with a cost. I just hope the cost isn't too great.
反抗总要付出代价。我只希望代价不会太大。
Meet up with Syndra for your duel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Syndra 会合进行决斗。
We don't know what tomorrow will hold. We might succeed without any issues - and I really, truly hope that'll be the case.
我们不知道明天会怎样。也许我们会顺利成功——我真的、真心希望会是那样。
However... We need to be ready for anything. That's why I want to challenge you.
不过……我们必须做好应对一切的准备。所以我才要挑战你。
Of everyone here, you and I are the closest to the power level of a Sovereign. If we can each hold our own in this duel... we might stand a chance.
在所有人之中，你和我的实力最接近统领。如果我们都能在这场决斗中撑住……也许我们还有机会。
As I said, I won't be holding back. I expect you to do the same.
就像我说的，我不会手下留情。我希望你也一样。
... I haven't told you the most important part of my plan yet, have I?
……我还没告诉过你我计划里最重要的部分，对吧？
I've said that I'll deal the final blow on Her Majesty. In order to do that... I will use my blessing from above, and kill her in one strike.
我说过我会对女王陛下给出致命一击。为了做到这点……我会动用上头赐给我的那份祝福，一击杀死她。
I'll let everyone else know tomorrow morning... But do you understand why I need this duel? I... I need to be certain I can do it.
我明早会告诉其他人……但你明白我为什么需要这场决斗吗？我……我需要确定我做得到。
Alright. When you're ready, speak to me again, and we shall proceed.
好。准备好了就再跟我说话，我们就开始。
Alright. Let the best soldier win!
Truthfully, I didn't expect to be able to best you. You've been able to hone your skills and train your magic far more than I ever could have.
说实话，我没指望能赢你。你磨练技巧、锻炼魔法的机会，比我以往能有的多太多了。
So many years... and the solution was right in front of me. But I didn't know to look!
这么多年……答案就在我眼前。但我却不知道该去看！
...it doesn't matter now. We've come this far already. We'll have to work with what we have.
……现在都不重要了。我们已经走到这一步。只能用手上有的东西了。
Listen... there is one other reason I asked for this. I have... something of a hard truth I need to share, and I need you to keep it to yourself.
听着……我要这场决斗还有另一个原因。我有……一个残酷的事实要告诉你，而且需要你替我保密。
There is a significant chance I will fail to land the initial strike. If that happens... I will not make it out of that confrontation alive.
我很有可能没办法命中第一击。如果发生那种情况……我不会活着离开那场对峙。
A battle with Her Majesty is no fight at all. How could it be? Could any one person make a dent in such overwhelming strength?
跟女王陛下交手根本算不上战斗。怎么可能算？单凭一个人，怎么可能撼动那种压倒性的力量？
This pile of trash has a strong stench of alcohol and other... unpleasantries.
这堆垃圾散发着浓烈的酒味，还有其他……令人不快的气味。
This must be the underwater route Yulie was talking about...
这一定就是 Yulie 说的水下通道……
Second Division - Stationed by the gate to the {p}. Low risk - will assist in case of commotion.
第二分队——驻守在通往 {p} 的大门旁。低风险——发生骚乱时前往支援。
- Tip! Hover over a piece and it will tell you its shape.
- 提示！把鼠标悬停在拼块上，就会显示它的形状。
... So I must do this alone. If anyone must take the fall, it *will* be me.
……所以我必须独自去做。如果非得有人承担后果，那“一定”是我。
Because there is no other choice! Because if I am forced to bear yet another year without her by my side, then... then... then I think my spark would finally go out.
因为别无选择！因为如果我被迫再熬过一年没有她在身边的日子，那……那……那我想我心中的火花终究会熄灭。
I suppose I may as well tell you. An anger without context must seem strange to an outside observer.
我想我还是告诉你吧。一股没头没尾的怒火，在旁观者眼里一定很奇怪。
I was once in the military, as you know. But I was no mere soldier, no... I'd risen so far as to approach Her Majesty's inner circle. One of her Wings.
你知道的，我以前从军。但我可不是普通的士兵，不……我一路升到接近女王陛下的核心圈子。她的羽翼之一。
You know, that was the year after Sovereign Selium died. The position for Sovereign of the {p} had opened up. If things had gone differently, could I have...?
你知道吗，那是 Selium 统领死后的第二年。{p} 统领的位置空了出来。如果当时事情走向不同，我会不会……？
Maybe that's why she did it. She was always sending me on difficult assignments, but...
也许那就是她那么做的原因。她总是派给我困难的任务，但是……
This time, I was ordered to deal with several cursed ones in the Roughworks. Capture if possible, but... well, they wouldn't always come quietly.
这一次，我奉命去处理 Roughworks 的几个受诅者。能活捉就活捉，但是……嗯，他们不一定会乖乖就范。
I'd done this before, of course. So I wouldn't have thought much of it, except... except, one of the names I received... I recognized it. Of course I recognized it.
这种事我当然以前也做过。所以我本来不会多想，只是……只是，我收到的名单里有一个名字……我认得。我当然认得。
I refused! Of course I did - I was asked to kill the love of my life!!
我拒绝了！我当然拒绝了——他们要我杀掉我这辈子的挚爱！！
She wasn't even cursed. And here and now, we understand the truth of that label... but back then, it was a shock! A normal, working citizen...
她根本不是受诅者。而现在我们明白那个标签的真相了……但在当时，那让我震惊不已！一个普通的、在工作的百姓……
I was brought back to the citadel. As I stood before Her Majesty, she told me it was a test. A TEST!! A test of my loyalty to the crown.
我被带回城塞。当我站在女王陛下面前时，她告诉我那是一场测试。一场测试！！一场对王室忠诚度的测试。
Disgraced, I had my rank and status removed. I was disposed of, sent to the {p}, forbidden from ever leaving.
我蒙受耻辱，被剥夺了军衔与地位。我被丢弃，送到 {p}，永远不准离开。
Disgraced, I had my rank and status removed. I was disposed of, sent to {p}, forbidden from ever leaving.
我名誉扫地，被剥夺了军衔和地位。我被打发掉，送到 {p}，永远不准离开。
Of course he knew! Offered condolences and helped get me back up once he became Sovereign.
他当然知道！还表达了慰问，在他成为统领后帮我重新站起来。
He gave me an assignment. To infiltrate the local resistance groups, and keep an eye on them. If I did that... I could restore my honour.
他给了我一项任务。潜入当地的反抗团体，盯着他们。如果我做到了……就能恢复我的名誉。
Ironically, it's thanks to him that we're here right now. But I can't ever forgive him for standing by and letting the crown keep me trapped there.
讽刺的是，多亏了他，我们现在才会在这里。但我永远无法原谅他袖手旁观，任由王室把我困在那里。
... But he isn't important. Not really. It's who he serves.
……但他不重要。其实不重要。重要的是他效忠的人。
Her Majesty... I need her to die. I need to do it myself. Only then, can I finally be at peace...
女王陛下……我需要她死。我需要亲手杀了她。只有那样，我才能终于得到安宁……
{u}. If I don't survive... I need you to do something for me.
{u}。如果我没能活下来……我需要你替我做一件事。
Keep my children safe. They're all I have left.
保护好我的孩子们。他们是我仅剩的一切了。
... Try and get some rest. We have a massive challenge ahead of us tomorrow.
……试着去休息一下。明天我们面前有一场巨大的挑战。
I did. When I first got into contact with Quill, I asked him to find her.
是的。我刚跟 Quill 联系上的时候，就请他去找她了。
And... he did. But... she didn't recognize him. She didn't... remember me.
而……他找到了。但是……她没认出他。她没……记得我。
Ha... knowing she was still alive past that wall, but that I could never see here again, and that she didn't even... remember me...?
哈……知道她还活在那道墙后面，但我再也见不到她，而她甚至不……记得我……？
I tried sending her letters, with Quill's help. I don't know if any of them ever reached her.
我试着在 Quill 的帮助下寄信给她。我不知道有没有任何一封送到她手上。
It doesn't matter now. It's been... {~} years. Nearly half of my whole life. So long as she's safe... that's all that matters.
那些现在都不重要了。已经……{~} 年了。几乎是我半辈子。只要她平安……那就够了。
And if we succeed tomorrow... then...
而如果我们明天成功了……那……
Then... maybe we can finally be at peace. Together.
那……也许我们终于能得到安宁。一起。
It was... during a larger assignment. I'd risen through the ranks of the military at a rapid pace, becoming a Wing only three years after joining.
那是……在一项较大的任务期间。我在军中晋升得很快，入伍才三年就成了羽翼的一员。
In {~} IA, Her Majesty was looking into more long-term solutions for managing the {p}. She requested a team of Wings most suited to the task, and I was selected for it.
IA {~} 年，女王陛下在寻找管理 {p} 的长期方案。她要求组一支最适任的羽翼小队，而我被选中了。
We worked to establish a more centralized management structure... I ended up taking charge, and was later promoted to Captain.
我们致力于建立一套更集中的管理结构……最后由我负责，之后还升为队长。
But one of my first ideas was to go undercover and work at the factories, for a time. I believed I would be able to get a better insight into the situation that way.
但我最早的想法之一，是暂时卧底到工厂工作。我相信那样能更深入了解实际情况。
I wasn't supposed to get attached. It was just a job, and I'd be visiting many factories...
我本不该产生感情的。那只是一份工作，而且我要去很多家工厂……
But I did. And it was the best mistake of my life.
但我还是动了情。那是我这辈子犯过最美好的错误。
Even after I moved on, and throughout the whole three years of that assignment, I continued meeting up with her.
即使我换了地方，在那项任务整整三年里，我都一直跟她见面。
...even after the assignment ended, and I was recalled to the Citadel... even after I was inducted into the Gendarme... I continued meeting up with her.
……即使任务结束、我被召回城塞……即使我被编入宪兵队……我依然跟她见面。
I... never told her what I really was. I thought it would be safe, for both of us... ha. And how did that turn out...?
我……从来没告诉她我真正的身份。我以为那样对我们两个都安全……哈。结果又怎么样呢……？
Syndra's about to give her final speech before the festival. Come on, let's get going.
Syndra 要在庆典前做最后的演讲了。快点，我们走。
Listen to Syndra's last speech before the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 聆听 Syndra 在庆典前的最后演讲。
Today is the day we set our plan into motion. In a few hours, the festival will begin... and that's when we'll strike!
今天就是我们把计划付诸行动的日子。再过几个小时，庆典就会开始……那就是我们出手的时候！
I'll now be handing out assignments. They're different from yesterday's pairings, as they're focused on what we need *during* the festival.
现在我来分配任务。这跟昨天的分组不同，因为这是针对我们在庆典“期间”需要做的事。
Zeph and Yuman, you're in charge of placing and detonating the explosives. Yusanu will show you where they are.
Zeph 和 Yuman，你们负责放置并引爆炸药。Yusanu 会告诉你们炸药在哪。
Rex and Yulie, you're aerial support. Take your positions on the buildings we scouted out yesterday. Provide support for everyone else as needed.
Rex 和 Yulie，你们负责空中支援。到我们昨天侦察过的建筑上就位。视需要为其他人提供支援。
Sui, Yusanu, and {u}. I want you three to stay put on a roof nearby. Once the Queen is dead, chaos is going to break out.
Sui、Yusanu，还有 {u}。我要你们三个待在附近的一个屋顶上。女王一死，场面就会大乱。
I need you three to help calm down the people, and to help fight off any soldiers that oppose us.
我需要你们三个帮忙安抚民众，并帮忙击退任何与我们作对的士兵。
Quill will remain here with the rest of the Steel Feather, and will prepare for the aftermath.
Quill 会跟钢羽其他人留在这里，为善后做准备。
I'm no good in a fight, I fear. I'd only slow you down on the battlefield.
恐怕我不擅长战斗。在战场上我只会拖慢你们。
Mora will be lurking in the crowd, and will help me if necessary.
Mora 会潜伏在人群中，必要时协助我。
Finally... I'll be stationed on a building above Her Majesty. When the time is right, I will strike her down!
最后……我会待在女王陛下上方的一栋建筑上。时机一到，我就会击倒她！
I hope you're all ready to make history. This won't be easy... but I believe we can pull through.
希望你们都准备好创造历史了。这不会容易……但我相信我们能挺过去。
I cannot ensure everyone's safety. It is likely civilians will be injured, and some of us may be hurt as well... or... worse.
我无法保证每个人的安全。很可能会有平民受伤，我们之中也可能有人受伤……甚至……更糟。
Resistance and revolution comes at a cost. We need to accept that. I... pray it will not come to that, though.
反抗与革命都有代价。我们必须接受这一点。不过，我……祈祷不会走到那一步。
Some of you are scared, nervous. You're right to be. This is dangerous, and risky... but know that I am so, so proud of each and every one of you here today.
你们有些人很害怕、很紧张。这是理所当然的。这很危险、很冒险……但要知道，今天在这里的每一个人，我都非常、非常为你们骄傲。
We will change Fruma for the better! We will tear down the crown's tyrannical rule, and we will free the people!!
我们会让 Fruma 变得更好！我们会推翻王室的暴政，我们会解放人民！！
Alright! Let us get to work! Find your teams, and meet up at your designated positions at the festival.
好了！开工吧！找到你们的队伍，到庆典上各自的指定位置会合。
Meet up with your group at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and discuss before heading to the festival.
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与你的小组会合，在前往庆典前讨论一下。
Yeah. Got an extra battery as well.
带了。还多带了一块电池。
Perfect. I left charges for you at each spot so when we get to {p} we can pick our positions.
太好了。我在每个点都给你留了充能，所以等我们到 {p} 就能挑位置。
Rex, I've never seen a better shot. You won't miss.
Rex，我从没见过比你更准的射手。你不会射偏的。
Thank you, Yulie. I wish you the best of luck out there.
谢谢你，Yulie。祝你在外面一切顺利。
Syndra m- marked out some good spots for us, huh?
Syndra 帮我、我们标了些不错的位置，对吧？
She did. I'll make sure we stay out of danger! I know my way around those alleyways.
是啊。我会确保我们远离危险！那些小巷我很熟。
Thank you... But I d- don't need a babysitter! I'll be f- fine.
谢谢你……不过我不、不需要保姆！我会没、没事的。
I know you can handle yourself. But seriously, Zeph. I'm not playing around.
我知道你能照顾好自己。但说真的，Zeph。我不是在开玩笑。
I need you to be safe. We can't afford to get caught here.
我需要你平安。我们不能在这里被抓。
I've never s- seen you this serious before...
我从没、没见过你这么认真……
I'm just nervous. I've never done anything like this before.
我只是紧张。我从来没做过这种事。
Good thing I h- have then, p- pr- princess.
还好我、我做过，公、公、公主。
Hi... are you two, um, ready?
嗨……你们两个，嗯，准备好了吗？
I... ha, I'm not sure! It's... a lot, isn't it?
我……哈，我不确定！这……太多了，对吧？
I've been worrying about this new Sovereign... Tasim. {u}, I know you... know him.
我一直在担心那位新统领……Tasim。{u}，我知道你……认识他。
It's... it's like Rex said the other day. The Sovereigns aren't our friends. If he joined the crown, then... I'm not sure we can trust him to do the right thing.
这……这就像 Rex 前几天说的。统领不是我们的朋友。如果他投靠了王室，那……我不确定我们能相信他会做对的事。
We can't just... sit around worrying about what could happen. We need to, um, stay focused.
我们不能就……坐在这里担心可能发生的事。我们得，嗯，保持专注。
Syndra trusts us! We need to have faith in her plan.
Syndra 信任我们！我们得相信她的计划。
Yeah... you're right. Let's take our positions then.
嗯……你说得对。那我们就位吧。
The map says we're supposed to be stationed on top of a building...
地图上说我们应该待在一栋建筑的顶上……
Head to your designated spot at the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 你在庆典上的指定位置。
So... this is our spot, then?
所以……这里就是我们的位置了？
I think so, if I read the map correctly...
我想是，如果我地图没看错……
... It feels weird. Just, um, standing by. Like... like we're not really, um, doing anything to, to help.
……感觉好奇怪。就，嗯，在旁边待命。好像……好像我们没有真的，嗯，在帮、帮上什么忙。
A bit... yeah. But like Syndra said, we'll be needed to help in the aftermath. Even if we're not really doing anything until then...
有一点……对。不过就像 Syndra 说的，善后的时候会需要我们帮忙。就算在那之前我们其实没做什么……
What's wrong? Something caught your eye?
怎么了？有什么东西引起你的注意吗？
Oh, uh... just- it is the festival day, right? The city looks exactly the same as it did when we, um, arrived. No festivities? No stalls, no attractions?
哦，呃……就是——今天是庆典日，对吧？城市看起来跟我们，嗯，刚到的时候一模一样。没有庆祝活动？没有摊位，没有游乐设施？
Oh! Hahaha, you people have attractions in Auburn?
哦！哈哈哈，你们在 Auburn 还有游乐设施啊？
Um... yeah! Isn't that... the point of the festival?
嗯……对啊！那不就是……庆典的意义吗？
Maybe for you. Here... well, nobody has the time for any of that. The point, for most residents, is having a day off from work.
对你们来说也许是。在这里……嗯，没人有时间搞那些。对大多数居民来说，重点是能放一天假。
Oh! That's... nice, I guess. A little sad, though, that that's why, ha, people get excited about it...?
哦！那……挺好的，我想。不过有点难过，那竟然是，哈，大家期待它的原因……？
Yeah, a bit. That's the Roughworks for you, though.
是啊，有一点。不过 Roughworks 就是这样。
Working for the crown is complicated? Helping them oppress to people of Fruma is complicated?!
替王室工作很复杂？帮他们压迫 Fruma 的人民很复杂？！
Yes! I'd explain it to you, but we don't have time for it now- {u}, you need to listen to me-
对！我很想跟你解释，但我们现在没时间——{u}，你得听我说——
Sigh. You didn't need to do that. I'm not... being forced into anything, I'm just-
唉。你不必那样做。我不是……被逼着做任何事，我只是——
So you chose to work for the crown? Why?!
所以你是自己选择替王室工作的？为什么？！
I... have my reasons, trust me. Look, there's no time to explain right now- {u}, you need to listen to me-
我……有我的理由，相信我。听着，现在没时间解释——{u}，你得听我说——
Sui, what are you doing?! You're just going to draw more attention towards us.
Sui，你在做什么？！你这样只会让我们更引人注意。
If you would just let me finish... I'm here to warn you. Your group is compromised- I don't know how, exactly, but we know what you're planning to do today.
你们能不能让我把话说完……我是来警告你们的。你们的组织暴露了——我不知道确切是怎么暴露的，但我们知道你们今天打算做什么。
It is. You need to call it off, or else-
是真的。你们得取消，否则——
... Because we're still friends, at the end of the day. I don't want you to get hurt.
……因为说到底，我们还是朋友。我不想看到你受伤。
If only you hadn't been hiding... well, it doesn't matter now. We're out of time. If you're still safe after this, then... I'll find a way to reach out to you.
要是你没有躲起来……算了，现在都不重要了。我们没时间了。如果这之后你还平安，那……我会想办法联系你。
There's... something bigger than Fruma at stake.
有……比 Fruma 更重大的事攸关成败。
It doesn't matter. Not now, at least-
那不重要。至少现在不重要——
Of course it matters! There's real people getting hurt by the crown, and you think it doesn't matter?!
当然重要！有真真切切的人正在被王室伤害，而你觉得那不重要？！
That's not what I said. I... we don't have time for this. {u}, you have to-
我不是那个意思。我……我们没时间说这个。{u}，你必须——
I asked you not to. I don't need saving.
我叫你别这么做的。我不需要人拯救。
You being here, it's... making things harder things harder than they need to be.

但是 Zeph……他一直把自己孤立起来。他和 Sui 都是！
Sigh... it's hard. Whenever I talk to him, he tries to put on his regular happy persona, but...
唉……很难。每次我跟他说话，他都努力摆出平常那副开心的样子，但是……
I don't know. Obviously things have changed - I don't think you get out of - ha, what was it, weeks? - of imprisonment unaffected.
我不知道。显然事情已经变了——我不觉得被关了——哈，多久来着，几个星期？——还能毫发无伤地出来。
...he's resilient. Sui too. We'll be able to work past this. It's just... going to take time.
……他很坚强。Sui 也是。我们能挺过去的。只是……需要时间。
Still workshopping it! I have a couple of different ideas, but...
还在琢磨！我有几个不同的想法，但是……
Well, it's hard to know which will work without knowing what the Canopy has. Too many different things to consider.
嗯，不知道树冠会有什么，很难判断哪个行得通。要考虑的东西太多了。
When we join up with them, I'm hoping I can fill in the gaps. And... I guess, get their opinions on it, too.
等我们跟他们会合，我希望能把缺的部分补上。还有……我想，也听听他们的意见。
So- all that to say, I've got nothing for you! For now. I'll tell you later, okay?
所以——说了这么多，就是我现在没什么能告诉你的！暂时。之后再跟你说，好吗？
I... don't know what to do. I really, really don't.
我……不知道该怎么办。真的、真的不知道。
We've... ugh, we've all lost people. Lots of Leaves got arrested for... this or that, over the years. It sucked, but... it happened.
我们……唉，我们都失去过人。这些年来，很多风中之叶的人因为……这样那样的事被抓。很难受，但是……事情就是发生了。
...it's never been this bad before. Never anyone this close. I mean... sigh. Syndra and Mora. Gods.
……从来没这么糟过。从来没有这么亲近的人。我是说……唉。Syndra 和 Mora。天啊。
I want to help her get through this, but... she's closing herself off. And... we're still not home free just yet.
我想帮她走出来，但是……她把自己封闭起来了。而且……我们也还没真正脱离危险。
...when it's over. When it's over. Everything will be okay when it's over.
……等结束了。等结束了。等一切结束，就都会好起来的。
I'm r-ready to see my old friends again... I miss Kaio.
我准、准备好再见到老朋友们了……我想念 Kaio。
Was there s-something on your mind?
Ah... I... I don't want to lie to you.
So... I'm not d-doing great. Everytime I... I close my eyes I s-see that... face. The S-sovereign...
所以……我不、不太好。每次我……我闭上眼睛就会看、看到那张……脸。那个统、统领……
Everytime I close my e-eyes I feel all that pain. All of it! All the m-memories!
每次我闭上眼、眼睛，就会感觉到那些痛苦。全部！所有的回、回忆！
I was... okay with it all e-ending there.
我曾经……觉得就那样结、结束也无所谓。
I know that i-it's over. I know Gikyo is dead but... their ghost still h-haunts me.
我知道一、一切都结束了。我知道 Gikyo 已经死了，但是……他们的阴魂还是缠、缠着我。
I think it's a s-solid plan.
我觉得是个靠、靠谱的计划。
I j-just wonder how many from the Leaves in the Wind are willing to a-actually come all the way here.
我只、只是在想，风中之叶里有多少人愿意真、真的大老远跑来这里。
Well, here we are. The dam really is something to behold, isn't it...
好，我们到了。这座水坝真是壮观，对吧……
I- I always d..did wonder what it'd b- b- be like to... to t...take this elevator...
我——我一直都很好……好奇搭、搭、搭这座升……升降机会是什么感觉……
Well, you'll finally get your chance. Come on, let's just fight already.
嗯，你终于有机会了。走吧，赶快开打。
What? We can't rush this? The longer we wait, the more suspicious they'll get.
什么？我们不能急？我们等得越久，他们就越起疑。
Defeat the soldiers defending the elevator at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Careful! Looks like they've got backup!
H...how many p- people can they fit in th- th- that elevator?!
那……那座升降机到底塞得下多少人啊？！
You're the insurgents everyone is on the lookout for! MEN, TO ARMS! CAPTURE THEM!
你们就是大家在通缉的叛乱分子！弟兄们，拿起武器！抓住他们！
Talk to the group again at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Sigh. Whatever. Let's go... get our people.
唉。随便。我们走吧……去接我们的人。
Sui, are you INSANE?! You almost got SHOT!
Sui，你疯了吗？！你差点就被射中了！
You turned your back when there were enemies still around!! What do you think would have happened if we weren't here?
周围还有敌人，你就转过身去了！！你觉得要是我们不在这里会发生什么事？
Shot. If you were lucky, somewhere that wouldn't have killed - but after what they saw, would they have really taken that risk?!
中箭。运气好的话，射在不会致命的地方——但看到他们刚才看到的，他们真的会冒那个险吗？！
Sui, stop being so reckless. You're... you're strong, I get that, but... that doesn't mean you're invincible.
Sui，别再这么鲁莽了。你……你很强，我知道，但是……那不代表你刀枪不入。
S...Sui, we don't w- want to l- lo- lose you too...
S……Sui，我们不、不想连、连你也失去……
But if I'm not good enough, if I'm not f-fast enough, then- then- then I'll lose you, and- and I can't, I can't do that again, I-
可是如果我不够好，如果我不够快，那——那——那我就会失去你们，而——而我不能，我不能再经历一次，我——
You don't need to prove yourself. You've always been good enough for us.
你不需要证明自己。对我们来说，你一直都够好了。
Whatever that- that Sovereign said to you, to make you think everything's that's happened to us is your fault? It's not true!
不管那——那个统领跟你说了什么，让你觉得发生在我们身上的一切都是你的错？那不是真的！
Sui. Sui. Mora's death is not your fault!! We can blame the crown, blame the Sovereigns- hell, blame me for leaving him there!!!
Sui。Sui。Mora 的死不是你的错！！我们可以怪王室，怪那些统领——见鬼，怪我把他丢在那里都行！！！

但保护他不是你的责任。保护我们也不是。我们是一个团队——一个家，而且……而且我不想看到你像 Syndra 那样把自己烧成灰烬。
R...Rex is r- right, Sui. We can... f- fi- fight together, sh...shore up each o- oth... each other's w...weaknesses.
R……Rex 说得对，Sui。我们可以……一、一起战斗，互……互相弥补彼、彼……彼此的弱……弱点。
...b- but we should pr...probably get going, Sui, b- before more backup sh...shows up.
……可、可是我们大……大概该走了，Sui，趁、趁更多援兵还没……还没来。
Sigh. Zeph's right. You guys hurry to the Leaves, while we have the chance. {u} and I will prepare for your return.
唉。Zeph 说得对。趁还有机会，你们快去找风中之叶。我和 {u} 会为你们回来做准备。
Y... yeah. You're right, we should go too. Come on, let's meet at the Canopy's cave.
对……对。你说得对，我们也该走了。走吧，我们在树冠会的洞穴碰头。
A little. But... I don't know how else to get through to her.
有一点。但是……我不知道还能怎么让她听进去。
It's so... frustrating! Seeing her taking on all of Syndra's worst traits! I- I know what to look out for, this time, but...
真是……让人火大！看着她染上 Syndra 所有最糟的特质！我——我这次知道该留意什么，但是……
...but I still don't know what to do.
Ha. Maybe I should apply my own advice to myself...
哈。也许我该把自己的建议用在自己身上……
We should get moving too. Come on, let's meet at the Canopy's cave.
我们也该动身了。走吧，我们在树冠会的洞穴碰头。
Travel to the {p} and find the Canopy in their new hideout at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
前往 {p}，在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的新藏身处找到树冠会。
Oh, good grief. Look more closely, foxes - these are familiar faces! Or rather, familiar face, I should say - welcome back to the Canopy, {u}! And who might this be?
哦，真是的。看清楚点，狐狸们——这些是熟面孔！或者应该说，是一张熟面孔——欢迎回到树冠会，{u}！这位是？
...you're Captain Rurie, right? Sui told us about you.
……你是 Rurie 队长，对吧？Sui 跟我们提过你。
Did she! Then that must mean you are one of the dear captured friends - no no, don't tell me, I can figure it out... Rex, I assume?
是吗！那你一定就是那几位被抓的朋友之一——不不，别告诉我，我猜得出来……我猜是 Rex？

嗯……好，我是很想让你们进来，但那样 Fuhue 可能会因为我没遵守她那一大堆规程而要我的脑袋……那可不行……
Ugh, just let them in, Rurie. We've been breaking initiation protocols left and right already, I can't be bothered enforcing them anymore.
呃，让他们进来吧，Rurie。我们已经到处在打破入会规程了，我懒得再执行了。
Well, would you look at that! Lucky you! Come on in, come on in. Our numbers have grown since last you were here, {u} - many more friendly faces hanging about!
哎呀，你们看看！你们真走运！快进来，快进来。{u}，从你上次来到现在，我们的人数增加了——多了好多友善的面孔！
{u}, Rex!! Man, it's good to see you guys!!
Yuman?! What're you doing here? I thought they had you locked up in-
Yuman？！你怎么在这里？我以为他们把你关在——
In Deraj Prison, yup. Everything they say about it is true- and, and more! They get you workin' in the mines, if you're not... eh, y'know. Disappeared.
关在 Deraj 监狱，没错。关于那里的传闻全是真的——而且，还更糟！只要你还没……呃，你懂的。被消失，他们就会逼你去矿坑干活。
Lucky us, these Canopy guys showed up and broke us out! There were explosions, and growing plants, and crashing waves, and- and-
我们真走运，这些树冠会的人出现了，把我们救了出来！有爆炸，有植物疯长，有巨浪拍打，还——还有——
And then the feathery birds showed up outta nowhere, like- nothing there, then poof, cloud of smoke, and there they are- and they got us outta there!
然后那些羽毛鸟人不知道从哪冒出来，就像——本来什么都没有，然后砰，一团烟，他们就在那里——然后把我们弄出去了！
I'm sorry... Rurie. You all... successfully broke into Gravity's Monolith?! And got people out?!
不好意思……Rurie。你们……成功闯进了引力巨石？！还把人救出来了？！
Ah, it wasn't so tough once we had the plans of their inner workings! Floorplans, guard rotations... the works.
啊，一旦拿到了他们内部运作的图，那就没那么难了！平面图、守卫轮班……全都有。
That Warden's a deadly foe, but he sticks to an incredibly firm schedule - out like a light once it turns {~} PM! Of course, the prison goes into lockdown, but we've got our ways around it.
那个典狱长是个致命的对手，但他的作息非常死板——一到晚上 {~} 点就睡得像熄了灯！当然，监狱会进入封锁，但我们有办法绕过去。
Right you are Cileon, right you are... well, we'll have time to discuss the details later! I must return to my owls, there's much left to do!
说得对，Cileon，说得对……好了，细节之后再谈！我得回我的猫头鹰那边了，还有很多事要做！
Is, uh... is Zeph alright? I overheard a couple of things about what you two went through, so...
那个，呃……Zeph 还好吗？我偷听到一些你们两个经历的事，所以……
He's alright. He and Sui will be here later, so you can ask him about it yourself.
他没事。他和 Sui 晚点会到，所以你可以自己问他。
Oh! Oh, ha, uh, alright- sure, that sounds good, yep.
哦！哦，哈，呃，好——好啊，听起来不错，嗯。
I'm gonna... get back to my bro up there. Talk to ya more later!
我要……回上面找我哥们了。晚点再聊！
I should talk to the Canopy's leader, get started on some planning. Come by when you're done talking with everyone, okay?
我该去找树冠会的领袖谈谈，开始做些规划。你跟大家都聊完了就过来，好吗？
Your friend has entered the hideout already, please make yourself at home.
你的朋友已经进藏身处了，请自便。
Ah, {u}. I'm glad to see you are well.
啊，{u}。很高兴看到你安然无恙。
These have been... a difficult few weeks. For all of us, I gather. We have... been informed of our losses.
这几个星期……很不好过。我想对我们所有人来说都是。我们……已经得知我们失去了谁。
I still can't believe we let her talk us into... into all of that!
我还是不敢相信我们居然让她说服我们去……去做那一切！
Yulie, let's not speak ill of the dead. We cannot change the past. We can only move forward.
Yulie，别说死者的坏话。我们改变不了过去。我们只能向前走。
...I, too, regret not standing my ground. For her sake, if nothing else.
……我也后悔没有坚持立场。就算只是为了她好。
Sigh... her grief and rage consumed her, in the end, and I did little to stop it. I- ahh- my back...
唉……最后，她的悲痛和愤怒吞噬了她，而我几乎没做什么去阻止。我——啊——我的腰……
Quill, you need to rest. Sit down for a while, please.
Quill，你得休息。坐下来歇一会儿吧，拜托。
No, no... I'm fine, Yulie. We have work to do, after all.
不，不……我没事，Yulie。毕竟我们还有工作要做。
Well, the guards at the prison didn't really care much about who was physically fit to work or not. They just... work you 'tll you're dead, I guess!
嗯，监狱的守卫根本不在乎谁身体撑不撑得住干活。他们就是……把你往死里用吧，我想！
Harsh treatment, certainly... but I suppose it is no different than the Roughworks, at its core. Only... less obscured.
确实是严酷的对待……但我想，本质上跟 Roughworks 没什么不同。只是……少了遮掩。
{u}, Yusanu told us that he only made it through because of you and Sui. So... thank you. For protecting my little brother when I couldn't.
{u}，Yusanu 跟我们说，他能活下来全靠你和 Sui。所以……谢谢你。在我没办法的时候，保护了我的弟弟。
Yes... thanks to yours and Sui's magic, I hear...
是啊……我听说是多亏了你和 Sui 的魔法……
From the Steel Feather? The Canopy has quarters built deeper in these caverns. Anyone uninterested in fighting is staying there, for the time being.
钢羽的人？树冠会在这些洞穴更深处盖了住处。不想参与战斗的人暂时都住在那里。
...those we could find, at least. There are many we are still missing, unfortunately. I pray they are still alive.
……至少是我们找得到的那些。可惜还有很多人下落不明。我祈祷他们还活着。
Perhaps when this is all over, we will be able to locate the rest... I can only hope so.
也许等这一切结束，我们就能找到其余的人……我只能这么希望。
...so, look, if we try to charge these in this specific order-
……所以，你看，如果我们试着按这个特定顺序充能——

不，等等。你的序列在这里连续给雷充能了两次，应该只充一次。充能太多的话——
-and it'll destabilize, right. Thanks for double checking my work, Fuhue.
——就会失稳，对。谢谢你帮我复查，Fuhue。
...oh, {u}??? I- I completely didn't... notice you were here...
……哦，{u}？？？我——我完全没……注意到你在这里……
Yeesh. You've gotta fix your lack of awareness, bro. Anyone could sneak up on you while you're hyper focused in on something!
哎哟。你真该改改你这迟钝的毛病，哥。你专心搞东西的时候，谁都能偷偷摸到你身后！
Ugh, yeah, yeah, you keep telling me- if you're not going to be helpful, stop hovering!
呃，对啦对啦，你一直这么说——你要是帮不上忙，就别在旁边转来转去！
Nah. I wanna see the cool stuff happen when you get it working! Don't want to miss the fireworks or any-
才不要。我想看你搞定之后发生的酷东西！可不想错过烟火什么的——

回答你的问题，{u}，Yusanu 认为他对共鸣编织器的运作方式有了一个可行的理论。
Yeah, but a working theory doesn't mean a whole lot if I can't get results...
对，不过要是得不出结果，可行的理论也没多大意义……

你看，这五个符文——它们几乎完全对应树冠会符咒用的那几个。火、水、土、气、雷。

可以给它们充能来启动——单独一个也许只是简单的一次爆发，但如果串在一起……就能得到更复杂的东西。
Resonance... resonance, resonance, resonance... Soosu was always saying there was something she could not see with her blessing. Intangible, not of the elements...
共鸣……共鸣，共鸣，共鸣……Soosu 以前总说，有某种东西是她用祝福也看不见的。无形的，不属于元素……
Maybe... if we could find it, we could use the Weaver to... to visualize it. Bind it in place, so we can see it...
也许……如果我们能找到它，就能用编织器来……让它显形。把它固定住，这样我们就能看到它……
...yeah, none of that made any sense to me. Explain it with easier words?
……对，这些我一句都听不懂。能用简单点的话解释吗？
Okay, sure, just for you. Invisible thing in the air. With device, we make it visible.
好，行，就为了你。空气里有看不见的东西。用装置，我们让它看得见。
Oh! Why didn't ya start with that!
哦！你干嘛不一开始就这么说！
Ahem. Will we try the updated chain?
咳咳。我们要试试更新后的串联吗？
Right, right... got distracted. Thanks, Yuman.
I... I don't know, but... I think it's working! Fuhue, we did it!
我……我不知道，但是……我觉得成功了！Fuhue，我们成功了！
Maybe if I touch it, something will...
And what, exactly, is this doing here? A blight that permeates the air... concerning. I'll have to speak to Master Azael.
那么，这东西到底为什么会在这里？一种弥漫在空气中的灾祸……令人担忧。我得跟 Azael 师父谈谈。
Well, uh... now that it is here, can we do anything with it? Like... charge the glyphs to manipulate it?
那个，呃……既然它都在这里了，我们能拿它做什么吗？比如……给符文充能来操控它？
M... maybe. I'll have to do some thinking. But for now, it'd probably be best to... get rid of it. If I hit all five at once, it should...
也……也许吧。我得想一想。不过现在，最好还是……先把它弄掉。如果我同时击中五个，应该就……
...there. Gods. Why did the Queen need this thing in the first place...?
……好了。天啊。女王当初到底为什么需要这东西……？
...yeah, sure, why not. Later. I guess I've got to clean up here anyway.
……好啊，行，为什么不。之后吧。反正我也得在这里收拾。
Seeing as... is that Rex over there? Oh, good. Well, seeing as she's plotting with Azael, I should get ready for that.
既然……那边是 Rex 吗？哦，太好了。嗯，既然她在跟 Azael 谋划，我也该准备一下了。
Yuman, could you help me out? Since you've been annoying me all day.
Yuman，能帮我一下吗？反正你烦了我一整天。
I've been looking forward to seeing you again, {u}. That is your real name, right?
我一直很期待再见到你，{u}。那是你的真名，对吧？
It feels like it's been ages since we last spoke. As you can probably guess, a lot has changed for me since then.
感觉我们上次说话已经是很久以前的事了。你大概猜得到，从那之后我变了很多。
After we took out Commander Ferreo, there was nowhere for me to go, but I knew I needed to leave the {p} and head somewhere I wouldn't be recognized.
我们打倒 Ferreo 指挥官之后，我无处可去，但我知道我得离开 {p}，去一个没人认得我的地方。

I couldn't risk taking the train, so sneaking into the {p} at night was my only option. I had no idea what could be waiting for me there, but I had to go quickly, before they would start looking for me.
我不敢冒险坐火车，所以趁夜偷偷溜进 {p} 是我唯一的选择。我完全不知道那里会有什么在等我，但我得赶快走，趁他们还没开始找我。
I took the easternmost exit out of the {p}, and by some miracle, snuck through to the {p} after quietly taking out a guard.
我走了 {p} 最东边的出口，然后奇迹般地悄悄解决了一个守卫，溜进了 {p}。
From there, I blindly stumbled across the region, terrified of what would find me. I was eventually knocked out by a Canopy scout, who took me into their hideout to be questioned.
从那里开始，我在那片地区跌跌撞撞地乱走，害怕会被什么东西找到。最后我被一个树冠会的斥候打晕，带进他们的藏身处接受审问。

才不要。我不会破坏惊喜的。你就等着看吧，我的王子。
Hmph. After that last attack from the crown, it feels like you're getting just a touch too close to my kill count, Cileon!
哼。经过王室上一次的攻击，我觉得你的击杀数实在有点太接近我了，Cileon！
Cileon! My goodness, how rude of you! My thing has always been being the lethal sneaky assassin, lurking in the shadows...
Cileon！我的天，你怎么这么没礼貌！我的招牌一直都是潜伏在暗处、偷偷摸摸的致命刺客……
No no no, but it is true, my dear friend! Well, perhaps not the sneaky part... but the rest remains intact!
不不不，但那是真的，我亲爱的朋友！嗯，也许偷偷摸摸那部分不是……但其他部分都没错！
Hm? Oh, Cileon? Yes, it's quite simple once you get to know them. With just a little bit of squinting, the meaning becomes perfectly clear!
嗯？哦，Cileon 吗？是的，熟悉之后就很简单了。只要稍微眯一下眼，意思就一清二楚了！
Ah, we have expanded quite a bit, haven't we? And in such short order too! Fuhue's protocols are in shambles right now!
啊，我们扩张了不少，对吧？而且时间还这么短！Fuhue 的规程现在已经七零八落了！
But perhaps it's nice to let them fall by the wayside, for a time. We've met plenty of new friendly faces who would have never stood a chance otherwise!
不过，也许暂时把它们放一边也不错。我们结识了很多新的友善面孔，要不是这样，他们根本没机会！
So all's well that ends well, I suppose. Besides, with these plans of ours, any additional help is appreciated, yes?
所以我想，结果好就一切都好。再说，有了我们这些计划，多一分帮助都值得感激，对吧？
Oh, quiet, you. You know just as well as I that we have a few days left! I don't need to be ready just yet, do I?
哦，你安静点。你跟我一样清楚我们还有几天！我现在还不需要准备好，对吧？
But I suppose I'm ready for the coming challenge. I can't remember the last time I felt so excited for a mission to come! Goodness, what a rush.
不过我想我已经准备好迎接即将到来的挑战了。我都不记得上次对一个任务这么兴奋是什么时候了！天哪，真是刺激。
Ha! Gravity's Monolith, that little old thing? Simple and easy work... And, excuse me, you did NOT save me! I was perfectly capable of getting out of that situation myself, thank you!
哈！引力巨石，那个小玩意儿？简单轻松的活……还有，不好意思，你才没有救我！我自己完全有能力脱身，谢谢你！
I simply... ehm... wanted you to do something for once! Yes, silly Cileon, always on the... the back lines.
我只是……呃……想让你也做点事！对，傻 Cileon，老是待在……后排。
Oh, don't look at me like that! Yes, yes, fine, I appreciate your help and support as always Cileon. Will that do?
哦，别那样看着我！好，好，行，我一如往常地感激你的帮助和支持，Cileon。这样行了吧？
I did say this path'd only end in tragedy. Saw it comin' from a mile away.
我就说过这条路只会以悲剧收场。老远就看出来了。
'Course, that don't make it any easier. No, it just makes it hurt more the last time you see 'em.
当然，那也不会让事情好过一点。不，只会让你最后一次见到他们的时候更痛。
Synny... I knew she was linin' up to burn herself to ash. Hoped the kids could keep her goin', but. Well, y'know how it goes.
Synny……我知道她正一步步把自己烧成灰烬。本来希望那些孩子能让她撑下去，但。唉，你也知道事情会怎么发展。
But Mora... now that'n hurts. Wasn't destined for nothin', should've had a long life lined up ahead of him.
但 Mora……那个才真的痛。他什么宿命都没背负，本该有一段长长的人生在前头。
It's a damn shame. Always is. Always will be.
真是该死的可惜。一直都是。永远都会是。
Maybe you folks'll finally sort things through this time 'round. That'd sure be a nice surprise
也许你们这回终于能把事情理顺。那倒会是个不错的惊喜
Ah... well, so it goes, so it goes. It'd be nice to be proven wrong, for once.
啊……唉，就是这样，就是这样。难得被证明我错了，也挺好的。
You've got more folks to talk to, don't you? No need to waster your time on an old, bitter man like me.
你还有别人要谈，不是吗？没必要把时间浪费在我这个满腹牢骚的老头子身上。
These past few days, we have all been hard at work, preparing for our assault on the crown!
这几天，我们都在努力为攻打王室做准备！
Tomorrow, the final Festival of the rotation will begin in full. As such, today, we must make our final preparations, lay out the plans, and get into positions.
明天，这一轮的最后一场庆典就要正式开始。因此，今天我们必须完成最后的准备、把计划摊开来，并各就各位。
And, so... allow us to unveil Operation Godslayer!
那么……容我们揭晓——“弑神行动”！
We're splitting up into four groups, each with their own goals.
我们分成四组，每组各有各的目标。
Group {~}! The strike team that'll assault the front gates, distracting the crown's forces from our real attack coming from below!
第 {~} 组！突击队，负责攻打正门，把王室的兵力从我们来自地下的真正攻击引开！
We need to avoid putting ourselves at risk, as much as possible, while still drawing the army's attention.
我们要尽可能避免让自己陷入危险，同时还要吸引军队的注意。
I'll be leading the group, and I'm taking Sui, Zeph, and Cileon with me.
这组由我带领，Sui、Zeph 和 Cileon 跟我一起。
My turn, then? Gourp {~}, we're taking the citadel's {p} by force! Through those neverending tunnels within the plateau, we'll strike where they least expect it!
轮到我了？第 {~} 组，我们要用武力拿下城塞的 {p}！穿过高原里那些没完没了的隧道，在他们最意想不到的地方出击！
We'll be taking most of our forces - Fuhue, Yuman, Yulie, as well as the rest of the Canopy.
我们会带上大部分的兵力——Fuhue、Yuman、Yulie，还有树冠会的其他人。
Ah, I'll be handling our third group. We will be responsible for communications and intelligence. Once the second group completes their objective, we will join them.
啊，第三组由我负责。我们负责联络与情报。第二组完成目标之后，我们会跟他们会合。
Yusanu, you are with me. And Captain Rurie, I will need your two best owls.
Yusanu，你跟我一起。还有 Rurie 队长，我需要你手下最好的两只猫头鹰。
And, lastly... {u}. Our fourth and final group. You, alone, will enter the citadel, with the aim of receiving an audience with the Queen.
最后……{u}。我们的第四组，也是最后一组。你将独自进入城塞，目标是获得面见女王的机会。
Our plan hinges on your success... we need her, and as many Sovereigns as possible, distracted until our operation is completed.
我们的计划全靠你能否成功……我们需要她，还有尽可能多的统领，在我们的行动完成之前都被牵制住。
Once word of {u}'s capture reaches us, we will strike. We will assault the gates, and we will take control of a sector of the citadel!
一旦得到 {u} 被捕的消息，我们就会出击。我们会攻打城门，拿下城塞的一个区！
For now, we will split up. Groups {~} and {~} will travel to {p}, and stay the night in preparation for tomorrow.
现在，我们分头行动。第 {~} 组和第 {~} 组前往 {p}，在那里过夜，为明天做准备。
{u}, we'll have to stop by the Blossom of Blades, too... We, um, need to see if we can get them to play their part.
{u}，我们也得去一趟刃之花会……我们，嗯，得看看能不能让他们尽一份力。
Very well. That will be all! May fortune favour us on this coming day, and see us victorious in the end!
很好。就这样了！愿好运在即将到来的这一天眷顾我们，让我们最终获得胜利！
Meet Sui at the newspaper shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的报刊店与 Sui 会合。
I should inform you that if you are to fail, the rest of our operation will fall apart as well.
我应该告诉你，如果你失败了，我们其余的行动也会跟着瓦解。
So, don't mess up. No pressure.
所以，别搞砸。我可没给你压力。
Sigh... another day I'm not on the front lines. Maybe Sui was right...
唉……又一天不在前线。也许 Sui 说得对……
... Whatever. I know I'm not the best fighter. So... I guess I'll do what I can from here.
……随便吧。我知道我不是最会打的。所以……我想我就在这里尽我所能吧。
Man, I can't wait to get out there and kick some soldier ass!
老兄，我等不及要出去痛扁那些士兵了！
Ugh, can't tomorrow be here already? I'm sick of waiting around!
呃，明天就不能快点到吗？我等烦了！
Uh... yeah? I can't stay stuck here in this little cave for the rest of my life! I got things to do, places to be!
呃……对啊？我可不能一辈子困在这个小洞里！我有事要做，有地方要去！
HUH!!! Pfft- uh- erm- huh- you-... how'd you, uh... know...?
Goodness, back off to {p}, are you? I'm very happy not to be joining you, thank you very much.
天哪，又要回 {p} 了，是吗？我很高兴不用跟你们一起去，真是谢谢了。
But best of luck to you regardless! Find a good way to sneak Cileon in, eh?
不过还是祝你们好运！想个好办法把 Cileon 偷偷带进去，嗯？
Well, as we will not be seeing each other until this concludes...
好了，既然在这件事结束之前我们不会再见面……
Good luck. We will have an owl shadowing you, so we will know when to proceed.
祝你好运。我们会派一只猫头鹰暗中跟着你，这样我们就知道什么时候行动。
This is... quite the task you've signed yourself up for, isn't it?
你给自己揽下的这项任务……真是不简单，不是吗？
To think... you- aah- you're from beyond the province's walls. You have no stake in this conflict, and yet...
想想看……你——啊——你来自行省的城墙之外。你在这场冲突中没有任何利害关系，却还是……
...well. We will forever be in your debt, if all goes to plan. I pray your mission will succeed.
……好吧。如果一切照计划进行，我们会永远欠你一份情。我祈祷你的任务会成功。
Hello again- You really do just keep catching me at the worst times.
又见面了——你还真是每次都挑我最不方便的时候来。
The shop is all closed up for the night. Though, out of curiosity, did you happen to catch today's edition?
店已经打烊了。不过，出于好奇，你看了今天的报纸吗？
I- oh dear! That's not formal conduct at all-
我——哦，天哪！这一点都不合规矩——
Ugh, we don't have time for this. Get out of the way.
呃，我们没时间耗在这。让开。
-nothing to do with the news, I just wanted to ask if I could change my codename? Turns out my aunt just had a daughter named Heather, and-
——跟新闻无关，我只是想问能不能换个代号？原来我阿姨刚生了个女儿，取名叫 Heather，然后——
Ah, put a pin that for a second? You two, latecomers? Water Grass, Shadow Bush, we have guidelines for these meetings-
啊，那个先等一下好吗？你们两个，迟到的？水草、暗影灌木，我们的会议是有规矩的——
No, Crim, you put a sock in it! These two are banned from the Blossom!
不，Crim，你给我闭嘴！这两个人已经被刃之花会除名了！
These two were caught fighting Crown soldiers and openly resisting arrest nearby House Thalas! They're putting our whole operation at risk just being here!
这两个人被看到在 Thalas 家族附近跟王室士兵打斗，还公然拒捕！光是他们在这里，就让我们整个行动陷入危险！
It's just like Toxic Thistle! They went gallivanting off who knows where, talking about much the same, and here we are in the same position- It can't happen again!
这跟剧毒蓟一模一样！他跑到天知道哪里去了，讲的也是差不多这一套，结果我们现在落到同样的处境——不能再发生了！
Th-They- I was right?! Camellia, I was-
他、他们——我说对了？！山茶，我说——
Hush!! Hush, you're already on thin ice- Uh, wow! Really?
嘘！！嘘，你已经在危险边缘了——呃，哇！真的吗？
Excuse me?! Without us here, spreading the truth and keeping up with the times, the Resistance would-
你说什么？！要不是有我们在这里传播真相、紧跟时事，反抗军早就——
We'd never even heard of you before we got here. You've been doing nothing!
我们来这里之前根本没听说过你们。你们什么都没做！
We were planning on asking you for help... but I guess that's out the window!
我们本来打算来请你们帮忙的……不过看来那是没指望了！
And at least we've got people that can do more than just... complain in a talentless editorial!!!
而且至少我们的人能做的不只是……在一篇毫无水平的社论里发牢骚！！！
...you know what? I thought Dusk might've been overreacting before, but after that? Yeah. You're not wanted here! Get out!
……你们知道吗？我之前还觉得黄昏可能反应过度了，但听到刚才那句？没错。这里不欢迎你们！出去！
Openly flouting the Crown is a risk we can't take. Dusk Garden is right. I support the vote.
公然藐视王室是我们冒不起的风险。黄昏庭园说得对。我支持这次表决。
They were late, too. That's important.
So, you rabblerousers- For defying the Crown in such an unsafe way and jeopardizing our important work-
那么，你们这两个惹事的——因为以如此不安全的方式对抗王室、危及我们的重要工作——
And for being late, you're hereby banned from the Blossom of Blades! Any objections?
还有迟到，你们即日起被刃之花会除名！有异议吗？
Fine. Fine! We'll come up with something else, then!!
好。好！那我们就另想办法！！
Talk to Sui outside the newspaper shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的报刊店外面与 Sui 交谈。
I don't know what I expected... ugh!! I just thought maybe, they could...
我也不知道我在期待什么……呃！！我只是以为，也许，他们能……
Whatever. Rex was right, after all. They're not worth-
随便。Rex 终究是对的。他们不值得——
Aaah, sorrysorrysorry! I couldn't stop in time, I-
啊啊，对不起对不起对不起！我停不下来，我——
No, nononono, that's not what- Sorry, sorry!! That was an accident, I promise!
不，不不不不，不是那样——对不起，对不起！！那是意外，我保证！
Ugf...y-yeah. Sorry, I just, I had to catch up to you, I got running, and-
呃……对、对。对不起，我只是，我得追上你们，我一跑起来，然后——
Look, I... A-anything. I want to help. Please, please let me help!
听着，我……什、什么都行。我想帮忙。拜托，拜托让我帮忙！
...really? You didn't stand up for us at the meeting, but...
……真的吗？你在会议上都没帮我们说话，可是……
What's different with you? Why do you want to help, when- when nobody else will!!
你有什么不一样？为什么你想帮忙，明明——明明没有其他人愿意！！
...I... It's... Look, when I stumbled onto them, the Blossom, I thought- I always thought it'd be...more than...that.
……我……这……听着，当我偶然发现他们，发现刃之花会的时候，我以为——我一直以为它会……不只是……那样。
{p} gets a lot of news. You can't escape the gossip, the rumors. And, I've always wanted to try and help people. I'm not blind that...that I have it easy here.
{p} 的消息很多。你躲不开那些八卦、那些传言。而且，我一直都想试着帮助别人。我不是看不出……看不出我在这里过得很轻松。
I want to do something, for people who aren't so lucky, but- But- I'm aware, that's all I am! I, I'm not smart, I'm not strong, I'm not sneaky, or, or anything!
我想为那些没那么幸运的人做点什么，可是——可是——我只是知道而已，我就只有这样！我，我不聪明，我不强，我不会偷偷摸摸，什么，什么都不会！
I thought that, that maybe, the Blossom would give me some kind of...direction. Teach me, point me at something I could do, or handle, but-
我以为，以为也许，刃之花会能给我某种……方向。教我，给我指一件我能做、能应付的事，可是——
It's just...more news! Hearing that it's even worse than I knew! And they're all in the same boat- They don't know what to do, and they're too scared to let anyone try!
那只是……更多的新闻！只是听说情况比我知道的还糟！而他们全都一样——他们不知道该做什么，又害怕到不敢让任何人去尝试！
I can barely sleep, or, or keep food down, or get through the day without getting completely derailed thinking about other people suffering and how I'm not doing anything to stop it!
我几乎睡不着，或，或吃不下东西，每天一想到别人在受苦、而我什么都没做去阻止，就整个人乱了套！
If you interrupt I'm not gonna be able to keep talking please shut up til I'm done.
你要是打断我我就说不下去了拜托闭嘴等我说完。
All I've got is showing up. Being here. But that's not enough, that's not...anything! It's more than most people do, sure, but what does that matter to, to, to...
我能做的就只有出现。人在这里。可是那不够，那根本……算不了什么！当然比大多数人做得多，可是那对，对，对……又有什么意义……
To some...Agricultural District man who can't feed himself? Or some Auburn family that gets broken up cause their mom accidentally badmouths the Queen and gets jailed?
对某个……吃不饱饭的农业区男人？或是某个 Auburn 家庭，只因为妈妈不小心说了女王的坏话被关进牢里，一家人就此拆散？
But you! You're getting out there, you're taking the risks! You've got plans, and direction, and, and I've got to do something or else I'll go crazy!
可是你们！你们在外面，你们在冒险！你们有计划、有方向，而，而我一定得做点什么，不然我会疯掉！
So...please. Tell me...tell me what I can do. Let me be useful, for once in my stupid freaking life, instead of sitting here like a depressed lump in the lap of luxury.
所以……拜托。告诉我……告诉我我能做什么。让我这该死的人生有一次派上用场，而不是像个郁闷的肉团一样窝在这里享福。
...I had no idea this was such a burden on you, Rose. I knew you were worried, but...I didn't realize how much.
……我完全不知道这对你是这么沉重的负担，玫瑰。我知道你在担心，但是……没想到有这么严重。
It...it's... It's been like this for years. I don't know how much more I can handle, and I feel so selfish for saying that, when I'm...here.
这……这已经……好几年都是这样了。我不知道我还能承受多少，而且说这种话让我觉得自己好自私，明明我人在……这里。
Well... um. We- we have big plans, and... with your ties to the papers, maybe we can make it happen.
嗯……那个。我们——我们有很大的计划，而……有了你跟报纸的关系，也许我们能办到。
We're going to kill Sovereign Majin, and topple the Queen's hold on Fruma.
我们要杀了 Majin 统领，并推翻女王对 Fruma 的统治。
So- so we need you to spread the word. Do whatever you can to make it big news, and... and get everyone here in an uproar about it at the festival tomorrow.
所——所以我们需要你把消息传出去。尽你所能把它弄成大新闻，然后……然后在明天庆典上让这里的所有人都骚动起来。
We, um. We need that distraction to pull it off. So... are you up for it?
我们，嗯。我们需要那个声东击西才能成功。所以……你愿意吗？
...Rose. I think we can do this. I have a printing press at home.
……玫瑰。我觉得我们做得到。我家里有台印刷机。
You're...C-Camellia, you're actually with me this time?
你……山、山茶，你这次真的要跟我一起？
Yeah. I've been saying "next time for sure" enough. It's time to put my money where my mouth is.
对。“下次一定”这句话我已经说够多了。是时候说到做到了。
We'll...we'll make calling cards. Spread them around. You're good with words, and art- you can handle the design.
我们……我们来做名片。到处散发。你文笔好，又会画——设计交给你。
And you'll...f-finally, we'll... I can actually... Thank you! Both of you! You can...definitely count on us!
而你会……终、终于，我们要……我真的能……谢谢你们！谢谢你们两个！你们……绝对可以信任我们！
I'm... glad there's still people willing to help. Even here.
我……很高兴还有人愿意帮忙。就算在这里也有。
We should, um, get some rest. Before tomorrow. Come on, let's get back to the hotel.
我们该，嗯，去休息了。在明天之前。走吧，我们回旅馆。
Get a night's sleep before the Festival day in the hotel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在庆典当天之前，到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的旅馆睡一晚。
You are no longer welcome in this establishment.
Turn yourself in at the gates at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
You... you're {u}. The most wanted terrorist in the province.
你……你是 {u}。全行省头号通缉的恐怖分子。
Soldiers! Don't let down you guard.
Doesn't matter. {u}, you are under arrest for terrorism and multiple counts of first degree murder!
不重要。{u}，你因恐怖主义与多项一级谋杀罪被捕！
Sovereigns. We meet here today to discuss this ongoing headache which has persisted for far too long.
统领们。我们今天聚在这里，是为了讨论这个拖了太久、令人头痛的问题。
And why has it persisted, I wonder? Perhaps, could it be-
那它为什么会拖这么久呢，我很好奇？也许，会不会是——
Don't even start, Thalas. In fact, let me begin the summation! The simplest form of the problem is that we don't have our full numbers devoted to a solution!
别想开口，Thalas。其实，让我先来做个总结！把问题化到最简形式，就是我们没有把全部人手投入到解法上！
I fought the Cursed nearly to a standstill, and my power's only increased since then! I can divide them out if you plug me into the equation again.

还有你，Thalas！一场导览！你有这么多连分贝都压不下来的力量和本事，却一点都不用，你这因式骗子？！

说真的，我明白你是新来的，但跟上好吗？我们其他人可没时间也没耐心等你……啊，进入状况。

探索你的牢房。要返回，请前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。

你知道吗，你并不特别。人民确实很擅长搞这种幼稚的闹剧。但一次又一次的事实证明，没有什么是我埋葬不了的。

令人失望的结果……但也不算完全出乎意料。我本来就不认为你会这么快改变立场。

那么，你所做的一切，真的只是浪费我的时间。而这一点，恐怕我无法容忍。

诸位统领！陛下！那些恐怖分子……他们对城塞城门发动了攻击！

二号统领，我希望你把我们这个麻烦处理掉。

Zhiraok 统领，Tasim 统领。我希望你们两个跟我一起出席庆典。

……这真的是你选择坚守立场的地方吗？

你真幸运。看来牌一直落在对你有利的那边。

别得意忘形。我还在考虑。

Explore the new mirror realm. To return go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
探索新的镜中领域。要返回，请前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
And another. Different actions, different decisions, yet the results remain conclusive. Mirrored, in all the ways which matter.
又一个。不同的行动，不同的决定，结果却依然一致。在一切重要的方面，如出一辙。
Do you see? Do you see it now? The futility? The nigh-inevitability of the coming end?
你看到了吗？你现在看到了吗？那份徒劳？那近乎无可避免的终结？
The Dawn, the Piercing Radiance, the Light which casts judgement from above. Blinding all who dare stand in its way.
黎明、刺目光辉、自上方降下审判的光明。让所有胆敢挡路的人目盲。
It plays at divinity, claims benevolence... but its nature is no different from the Shade. It will discard the pieces on the board once they no longer serve a purpose.
它装作神圣，自称仁慈……但它的本性与暗影并无不同。一旦棋子不再有用，它就会将其抛弃。
Removing one actor is not enough. Removing both is near-impossible. What option does that leave?
除掉一方是不够的。两方都除掉又近乎不可能。那还剩下什么选择？
And here, the final bitter truth. You claim to care for our province? For the people living within?
而在这里，是最后一个苦涩的真相。你声称关心我们的行省？关心住在其中的人民？
Then look upon this final outcome... and do not turn your gaze.
那就看着这最后的结局……不要移开目光。
Through inaction, this is where the future leads. Dawn or Dusk, it matters not - all will fall to ruin.
若是无所作为，未来就会走向这里。黎明或黄昏，都无所谓——一切都将化为废墟。
If not Her, who would tip the scales?
若不是她，还有谁能扭转天平？
...How long has it been, now? Years and years and years... all of it erased, destroyed, and still I remain.
……已经过了多久了？好多好多年……一切都被抹去、被摧毁，而我依然还在。
It was the only choice I could have made, then. Anyone else would have done the same.
那是我当时唯一能做的选择。换作任何人都会这么做。
Even now, knowing what I do... would I have followed through? Would I have still...?
即使现在，知道了我所知道的一切……我还会贯彻到底吗？我还会……？
I should not expect answers from ghosts. If it's all to be forgotten... so be it. They're my mistakes to bear.
我不该指望从鬼魂那里得到答案。如果这一切终将被遗忘……那就这样吧。那是我该背负的错误。
...ah. I see now my error. Very clever, traversing the shards and reaching though the fractured web into my own past.
……啊。我现在明白我的失误了。真聪明，穿越碎片，穿过破碎的网触及我自己的过去。
But you are not entitled to this intrusion. And you will receive nothing more.
但你无权这样闯入。你不会再得到更多了。
A satisfactory showing. Perhaps you will manage to surprise me, after all.
表现令人满意。也许你终究会让我惊讶。
Then I will leave the rest to fate. Either you live, or you die. Both outcomes will resolve favorably.
那剩下的我就交给命运了。你要么活，要么死。两种结果都会有利地收场。
If you are so desperate to change this province... prove it.
如果你那么迫切想改变这个行省……那就证明给我看。
Escape from Her Majesty's royal palace. To return go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
逃出女王陛下的皇宫。要返回，请前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
Talk to Rurie outside the palace at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的皇宫外与 Rurie 交谈。
No time to stay and chat! Come with me.
Follow Rurie to the safe zone at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
跟着 Rurie 前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的安全区。
...phew! Finally, some time to breathe. "Lightly defended" is perhaps an understatement... though, that's just {p} for you!
……呼！终于有空喘口气了。说“守备较松”大概是太轻描淡写了……不过，{p} 就是这样！
Ah... goodness. We're used to battling regional guards, or constables - perhaps a wing at most, rarely? But they simply do not compare to these gendarme.
啊……天哪。我们习惯对付地区守卫或警备兵——顶多偶尔遇到一个羽翼？但他们根本比不上这些宪兵。
We have... learned that the hard way. Three casualties. Two foxes, and one owl.
我们……付出了惨痛的代价才明白这点。三人阵亡。两只狐狸，一只猫头鹰。
Preparations are in order for burial rights, but we are still deep in the operation! No time to grieve just yet.
葬礼的准备正在进行，但我们还深陷行动之中！还没时间哀悼。
They knew the risks, as do we all. Joining the Canopy - properly, mind you, not like you did - comes with a willingness to die for the cause, if necessary.
他们清楚风险，我们所有人都清楚。加入树冠会——正式加入，注意，不是像你那样——就代表必要时愿意为理念而死。
...but enough about that! You live! Standing before me, in one piece and not entirely disintegrated! I take it all went well on your end?
……不过那个说够了！你还活着！站在我面前，完完整整，而且没有被彻底分解！我猜你那边一切顺利？
Excellent! You know, you were beginning to worry us a little. You were in there quite a while longer than we expected.
太好了！你知道吗，你让我们开始有点担心了。你在里面待的时间比我们预期的久得多。
However well enough it was, it would seem it was plenty good enough for our needs! So, I suppose we can write this one off as a success.
不管顺利到什么程度，看来都足够满足我们的需要了！所以，我想我们可以把这次算作成功。
Well, it could always be worse! As I mentioned- disintegration was one such proposed outcome... Fuhue really does have the strangest ideas about "fun."
嗯，情况总有可能更糟！就像我说的——被分解就是其中一个设想过的结果……Fuhue 对“有趣”的想法真是奇怪得很。
Hm... well, I would think "not really" would mean "rotting in prison for all of time," but I suppose we have different definitions.
嗯……好吧，我本来以为“不太算”的意思是“永远在牢里烂掉”，不过我想我们对这个词的定义不太一样。
In any case - welcome to the market square? Quite a lovely place, isn't it?
总之——欢迎来到市集广场？挺漂亮的地方，不是吗？
We, ah... are holding some residents captive, in the hopes the crown will be less likely to go on a full offense! What with all the high-standing citizens around.
我们，啊……扣留了一些居民，希望王室会有所顾忌，不敢轻易发动全面进攻！毕竟周围都是些地位显赫的市民。
Not to worry, though, we do not plan on hurting innocent people! Physically, at least - emotionally could not be helped, given the whole... holding hostage thing.
不过别担心，我们不打算伤害无辜的人！至少身体上不会——情感上就没办法了，毕竟是……扣留人质这回事。
You'll be happy to hear we recently received word from our owls that the gates assault group has returned to {p}! We'll be working to get them in here soon.
你会很高兴听到，我们刚从猫头鹰那里收到消息，城门突击队已经回到 {p} 了！我们会尽快把他们接进来。
What else, what else... owls are stationed on a rotation to defend the walls and keep watch. Foxes are ready to defend the front gates at a moment's notice.
还有什么，还有什么……猫头鹰轮班守卫城墙、负责警戒。狐狸随时准备防守正门。
If you'd like a detailed schedule, you'll have to find Fuhue - it's too much information to keep hold of, personally!
如果你想要详细的排班表，就得去找 Fuhue——那么多信息我个人可记不住！
Speaking of, the others would surely be glad to hear you're safe! Go on and tell them, would you?
说到这个，其他人一定会很高兴听到你平安无事！去告诉他们吧，好吗？
Get an update on how things went on their end.
Well, go on! Find the others and tell them you're safe, would you?
好了，去吧！去找其他人，告诉他们你平安无事，好吗？
We need to get a plan established, and fast. Time is running out.
我们得订出计划，而且要快。时间不多了。
Yeah? Can't say that's surprising, since... y'know. Dealing with the Queen.
是吗？这也不奇怪，毕竟……你懂的。要应付的是女王。
As for me... I got to join one of the Fox units. We're defending the zone from assaults from the crown!
至于我……我加入了一支狐狸小队。我们在防守这个区，抵挡王室的攻击！
It... feels good. Finally getting to get my hands dirty, and make a difference. Yulie never would've let me do something like this before.
感觉……很好。终于能亲自动手、改变点什么了。Yulie 以前绝对不会让我做这种事。
...I don't think I'd have had the courage for it, if it wasn't for Zeph.
……要不是因为 Zeph，我大概也不会有这个勇气。
Like... I dunno. He barely even hesitated back in the Roughworks, before jumping in to help a random woman he didn't even know!!
就是……我也说不清。他在 Roughworks 的时候几乎没有犹豫，就冲上去帮一个他根本不认识的陌生女人！！
And... I want to be like that, y'know! Confident enough to do that sorta thing.
而……我也想变成那样，你懂吧！有足够的自信去做那种事。
...don't, uh, tell him I said all that though!! Ha. It's a little embarrassing to actually say out loud.
……别，呃，别跟他说我说了这些！！哈。真的说出口有点难为情。
You're gonna head over to him and the others soon though, right? Tell him... uh... something. That I hope he's okay? I dunno, I'll come up with something.
你很快就会去找他和其他人，对吧？帮我跟他说……呃……点什么。说我希望他没事？我也不知道，我会想出点什么的。
Hey, have you talked to Azael yet? He's in the command center they've set up in the bank.
嘿，你跟 Azael 谈过了吗？他在他们设在银行里的指挥中心。
Oh, {u}, you're alright! That's a relief.
哦，{u}，你没事！真是松了口气。
I'd ask you for more details... but somehow I've ended up with responsibilities here. Sigh.
我是很想问你更多细节……不过不知怎么的，我在这里被分到了一堆责任。唉。
I've been trying to help Fuhue keep the owl units on schedule... but, DAMN!
我一直在帮 Fuhue 让猫头鹰小队按排班执行……可是，该死！
Why is everything so precise?! The current squad needs to switch out at... exactly {~}:{~}! Why?! Who needs this level of specificity?!
为什么一切都这么精确？！现在这一队必须在……正好 {~}:{~} 换班！为什么？！谁需要精确到这种程度？！
...have you talked to Azael and Quill yet? I think they were waiting for news about you, in the bank.
……你跟 Azael 和 Quill 谈过了吗？我想他们在银行里等你的消息。
Oh, not now. UGH! Where did those deers put today's evening rations?!
哦，现在别来。呃！那些鹿把今天的晚餐口粮放到哪去了？！
Hm? No. Simply stating an observation.
嗯？不是。只是陈述一个观察结果。
Either way. I had the deers bring rations and quipment with us, but in the chaos it seems they have not followed my established sorting system! Everything is a mess.
总之。我让鹿队把口粮和装备带过来，但混乱之中他们似乎没遵守我定好的分类系统！一切都乱七八糟。
And now not only do I need to maintain schedules for the foxes and owls, because Rurie is a mess, but I also have to find where our supplies are!
而现在我不只要维持狐狸队和猫头鹰队的排班，因为 Rurie 一团糟，还得找出我们的物资在哪！
At least Yulie has offered to help keep track of the owls' movements. That's one less thing to worry about.
至少 Yulie 主动帮忙追踪猫头鹰队的动向。少一件要操心的事。
I need to get back to finding tonight's food supplies. Maybe you can go be useful elsewhere?
我得回去找今晚的食物补给了。也许你可以去别的地方帮点忙？
... You could try telling Master Azael you're alive. He'll be in the command station in the bank.
……你可以去告诉 Azael 师父你还活着。他会在银行里的指挥站。
Y'know, it's nice to finally get a break from guarding for a bit! I've been at it for hours...
你知道吗，终于能暂时不用站岗，真不错！我已经守了好几个小时了……
Sigh... it's nearly time for the next unit rotation. Talk to you later.
唉……快到下一次小队轮换的时间了。之后再聊。
Talk to the leaders in the bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的银行与领导者们交谈。
……而我们还没收到任何来自 {p} 的消息？
Not yet, I am afraid. The festival will be starting within an hour or so, though...
恐怕还没有。不过，庆典再过一个小时左右就要开始了……
Ah, how wonderful! You have survived. That makes three of four teams now accounted for.
啊，太好了！你活下来了。这样四个小组里已经有三组确认平安了。
Yes... it would seem the owls are struggling to get ahold of group {~}.
是啊……看来猫头鹰很难联系上第 {~} 组。
We did, shortly after the attack. But since then, owls have been struggling to make contact. They should have arrived at the hotel, but...
攻击发生后不久我们联系过。但从那之后，猫头鹰就一直很难联络上他们。他们应该已经到旅馆了，但是……
I'm starting to worry... I know we don't have instant communication, but even still, it's been a while...
我开始担心了……我知道我们没办法即时通讯，但就算这样，也已经过了好一阵子了……
Hmm. Military activity has increased drastically ever since we took control. We know the owls are struggling to move from here to {p}.
嗯。自从我们取得控制以来，军队的活动大幅增加。我们知道猫头鹰很难从这里移动到 {p}。
It could be something, or it could very well be nothing. There is little we can do but wait.
可能有事，也很可能什么事都没有。除了等待，我们能做的很少。
Master Azael! Oh, ah, and others- news have arrived from the owls!
Azael 师父！哦，啊，还有各位——猫头鹰带消息回来了！
Bad, I fear. There's quite the commotion in {p} - the streets are crawling with soldiers, and the people of the city have been gathered on the festival grounds.
恐怕是坏消息。{p} 那边乱成一团——街上满是士兵，城里的百姓都被集中到庆典场地上了。
Ahead of schedule... do we know which Sovereigns are present?
比预定的早……我们知道有哪些统领在场吗？
Thalas, naturally. And likely the Queen as well, given the circumstances.
Thalas，这是当然的。考虑到情况，女王很可能也在。
Damn it... we need to get people to {p}! Our- our friends, they're-
该死……我们得派人去 {p}！我们的——我们的朋友，他们——
Yes, we must, but I cannot afford to leave my position here... and I don't believe we can spare any of our fighters...
是的，我们必须派人，但我不能离开我在这里的岗位……而且我不认为我们能抽出任何战士……
Ah! Yes, that will do. Come, I'll show you the way out of the citadel.
啊！对，那样就行。来，我带你出城塞。
{u}... good luck. We- aah- we cannot afford to lose any more of our people. Get them back to us safely...
{u}……祝你好运。我们——啊——我们不能再失去任何人了。把他们平安带回来……
Use this tunnel - it'll bring you near the entrance of the citadel. When you're done, use it from the other side to get back to us...
走这条隧道——它会带你到城塞入口附近。事情办完后，再从另一边走这条隧道回来找我们……
...though, ah, take care not to let any of the crown's soldiers follow you through? I'm not sure we can afford the stress!
……不过，啊，小心别让任何王室士兵跟着你过来？我不确定我们承受得了那种压力！
We're nearing the end, just got to stick the landing. Now, go get 'em!
我们快到终点了，只差最后稳稳落地。好了，去把他们救回来吧！
The upturn of necromantic practices ended in {~} AP, with the outlawing of the technique. Defiling the dead and preventing their spirits from moving on...
死灵术的盛行在 {~} AP 随着该技术被禁止而告终。亵渎死者，阻止他们的灵魂安息……
It is best to not add too much to the tea, for too many conflicting tastes will leave it muddled and foul-tasting. Three ingredients is a fine benchmark.
茶里最好不要加太多东西，味道冲突太多只会让它浑浊难喝。三种配料是个不错的标准。
与 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Miyagi 师父对话。
Oh hohoho! So a human has found their way to my humble dojo? Intriguing! I am called Sensei Miyagi. I welcome you.
噢呵呵呵！竟然有人类找到了我这简陋的道场？有意思！我叫 Miyagi 师父。欢迎你。
This dojo, I have dedicated to honing skills in all of the arts- from martial prowess and mental acuity, to craftsmanship and artistry.
这座道场，我致力于在此磨练各门技艺——从武艺的高超与心智的敏锐，到手艺与艺术。
Many have come- traveled from all corners of the earth to this humble one's dojo to train themselves and grow stronger. I am to presume you are the same?
许多人从天涯海角远道而来，到老朽这简陋的道场修炼自己、变得更强。我想你也是一样吧？
Although, while I have enjoyed my life's work here, I cannot deny I am getting on in years. I seek a successor, a master of many skills to take my place.
不过，虽然我很享受在这里毕生的事业，但我不得不承认自己年纪大了。我在寻找一位继承人，一位精通多门技艺的大师来接替我。
To the one who should master the arts, I would bequeath the Master's Gi, a symbol of resolute skill. Of course, do not feel pressured to take over for me, hoho!
对于精通诸艺之人，我会传授大师道服，那是坚定技艺的象征。当然，不必觉得非得接替我不可，呵呵！
As long as I may teach others and bring them to new heights, I am satisfied. Whether your aim be merely to sharpen your skills or to allow me to retire, you are welcomed.
只要能教导他人、带他们登上新的高度，我就心满意足了。不管你只是想磨练技艺，还是想让我退休，我都欢迎。
When you are ready to begin, purify yourself in the waters of the spring behind the dojo, and I will guide you to your first challenge.
{c1}准备好开始的时候，就去{c2}道场后面的泉水{c1}里净身，我会引导你前往第一项挑战。
Jump down the water pit to begin the challenges.
Ascend the Lufar Room in the physical strength challenge.
在体能挑战中登上 Lufar 室。
Here we are then- The Lufar Room. Here tests your agility! Even these old bones can scale this room in short order- how shall you fare?
那么，我们到了——Lufar 室。这里考验你的敏捷！连我这把老骨头都能很快爬上这个房间——你表现会如何呢？
Fight your way through the Fiata Room in the combat challenge.
在战斗挑战中一路打穿 Fiata 室。
I recognize your skill, and you have passed the challenge of the Lufar Room! Hoho, but the next challenge has defeated many an apprentice.
我认可你的本领，你通过了 Lufar 室的挑战！呵呵，不过下一项挑战可打败过不少学徒。
Now, comes the Fiata Room! Here, your combat prowess shall be put to the test. Martial skill comes easily to me...but what of your own?
接下来是 Fiata 室！在这里，你的战斗本领将受到考验。武艺对我来说易如反掌……那你呢？
Solve the puzzle of sight in the Cliste Room in the sight challenge.
在视觉挑战中解开 Cliste 室的视觉谜题。
Next, however, is not a challenge of physical skill, but of observation and logical reasoning, in this- the Cliste Room. Here, a puzzle awaits.
不过接下来不是体能的挑战，而是观察与逻辑推理的挑战，就在这里——Cliste 室。这里有一道谜题在等着你。
You must discern the path in order to bring the red block to the gold block. Simple in theory...complex in practice, as are many things.
你必须找出路径，把红色方块推到金色方块那里。理论上很简单……实际上很复杂，许多事都是如此。
Remember this as you work- Change your perspective, and the reality changes.
解题时记住这句话——换个角度看，现实也会随之改变。
And there, I recognize your mental acuity! You have passed the Cliste Room. You are doing quite well, but many have gotten to this point and had a single point stymie them.
好，我认可你心智的敏锐！你通过了 Cliste 室。你表现得相当好，不过很多人走到这一步，却被一个关卡难住了。
Welcome then, to the last challenge I offer you, held within the Sitheach Room and cavern.
那么欢迎来到我给你的最后一项挑战，就在 Sitheach 室与洞窟之中。
Your task here, is to become tranquil, and at peace with nature. What that entails... I leave up to you.
你在这里的任务，是让心境平静，与自然和谐共处。具体该怎么做……就交给你自己了。
There are many paths to tranquility. Whatever you choose, you will know when you have reached the point of success.
通往平静的道路有很多。不管你选择哪一条，到了成功的那一刻，你自然会知道。
Exit the Sitheach cave through the tunnel near the temple.
从神殿附近的隧道离开 Sitheach 洞窟。
I see it now. The troubled heart you came here with is troubled no longer. I recognize your mastery of the Sitheach Room.
我看出来了。你带来的那颗烦扰的心已经不再烦扰。我认可你对 Sitheach 室的精通。
Oh hoho... It is just like a human to do what cannot be done. That is each challenge of my humble dojo, completed!
噢呵呵……人类就是这样，偏要做到做不到的事。我这简陋道场的每一项挑战，你都完成了！
So! While I did advise you not to feel pressured of it, I am curious, young master. Do you wish to take my place here, so I may sit these old bones down?
那么！虽然我劝过你不必有压力，但我还是好奇，年轻的大师。你愿意接替我在这里的位置，让我这把老骨头歇一歇吗？
...Ah, of course not. Despite your mastery, this is merely a single step on your journey. Needn't worry, I understand completely.

To meditate is to remove all distractions, and to peacefully introspect- to be at one with yourself and anchor yourself to the moment, or merely to relax.
冥想就是排除一切杂念，平静地内省——与自己合一、把自己系在当下，或者只是单纯放松。
It is highly recommended for anyone experiencing stress or a clouded mind. Here will be detailed the basic steps for practicing meditation.
感到压力或心绪混乱的人，都非常推荐一试。以下详述冥想的基本步骤。
First, find a quiet, comfortable place. Someplace that you feel safe in, and where you will not be interrupted by outside influences.
首先，找一个安静舒适的地方。让你觉得安全、不会被外界打扰的地方。
If you are first beginning, set an hourglass or clock alarm for a short time. Ten or fifteen minutes will do. Even short sessions can help.
若是初学，把沙漏或钟表的闹铃设短一点。十到十五分钟就够了。短短一次也有帮助。
Next, sit down. The traditional position is to sit cross-legged with hands in the lap, but so long as you are comfortable, any position works.
接着坐下。传统坐姿是盘腿而坐、双手放在腿上，但只要你觉得舒服，任何姿势都可以。
Once you have found a comfortable spot, close your eyes and breathe deeply. Breathe in deeply, hold for a few seconds, breathe out, and hold for the same amount.
找到舒适的位置后，闭上眼深呼吸。深深吸气、屏住几秒、吐气，再屏住同样长的时间。
Focus on the sensation of your breathing, and on only the sensation of your breathing. If your mind wanders, do not fret- simply return your attention to your breath.
专注于呼吸的感觉，而且只专注于呼吸的感觉。思绪飘走也别急——把注意力拉回到呼吸上就好。
When you feel ready to rise, or when your time ends, slowly open your eyes and notice your environment- the sights and sounds, and the feeling of your body.
当你觉得可以起身，或时间到了，慢慢睁开眼睛，留意周围——看见的、听见的，还有身体的感觉。
Although there are more complex and involved methods of meditation, they are not necessary- Now that you have read this, try it yourself whenever you have a spare moment.
虽然还有更复杂繁琐的冥想法，但那些并非必要——读完这段之后，只要有空就自己试试看。
...this seems promising. Carefully, you settle down and close your eyes.

When fighting unarmed or with weapons such as knuckles, katars, or gauntlets, one's stance is paramount in fighting an opponent.
空手搏击，或使用指虎、卡塔短刃、铁护手这类武器时，架势是对敌的首要关键。
The way one is positioned can ground the body, allowing for blows to be taken with less consequence, or allow one to be light enough to evade attack.
身体摆放的方式可以让人沉稳扎地，挨打时伤害更轻；也可以让人轻盈到足以闪开攻击。
All combat must of course be learned through rigorous training- One cannot expect to become an expert simply by reading. Here are a handful of basic stances to practice.
所有的战斗技艺当然都得靠严苛的训练才能学成——光靠阅读是当不了高手的。以下是几个值得练的基本架势。
The Forward Stance has the legs placed broadly apart, the back leg outstretched fully and the body upright. This is a firm stance to steady oneself.
前屈架势是双腿大幅张开，后腿完全伸直、身体挺立。这是稳住自己的扎实架势。
The Back Stance has one foot in front of the other, with the back foot facing to the side and one's weight on the back leg. For evading attacks to the top of the body.
后屈架势是一脚在前一脚在后，后脚朝侧、重心落在后腿。用来闪避上半身的攻击。
The Cat Stance also has weight on the back foot, with legs bent and held close together and the front foot resting on the heel. This allows easy preparation for strong front kicks.
猫足架势同样把重心放在后脚，双膝弯曲、双腿并拢，前脚以脚跟着地。这让人很容易备好一记强力前踢。
The Crane Stance has one leg raised, the foot level with the other knee. Also used in preparation for kicking, as well as dodging a sweeping attack by the enemy.
鹤立架势是抬起一腿，脚掌与另一侧膝盖齐高。同样用于备踢，也用来躲开敌人的扫击。
Many a venerable mage has made their mark on history. There is a reason their names are repeated- we can learn much from what they have demonstrated.

To brew tea is a simple, meditative process that in itself has deep intricacies. We shall draw upon its heritage now.
泡茶是一件简单而近乎冥想的事，本身却有极深的讲究。现在就来谈谈它的传承。
Fresh, clean water is required. Bring it to a soft boil in a pot or cauldron, and then mix in herbs and ingredients to taste..
需要新鲜干净的水。在锅或釜中煮到微滚，再按口味拌入草药与材料……
Harvesting ingredients freshly can add extra depth to the tea, although you can make fine tea from any ingredients, so long as they are not rotten.
现采的材料能给茶更多层次，不过只要材料没坏，什么材料都能泡出好茶。
Common ingredients include sugar, lemongrass, ginger root, chamomile, and lavender. Each has their own purpose for tea.
常见的材料有糖、香茅、姜根、洋甘菊和薰衣草。每一样在茶里都有自己的用处。
Sugar helps sweeten the bitterness of some brews, and balances the flavors to be mild. However, too much will leave the brew sickly and tacky.
糖能柔化某些茶的苦味，把风味调得平和。但放太多，茶就会甜得发腻又黏口。
Chamomile adds a pleasantly sweet, floral taste to a brew. The delicate flavor helps the body and mind relax- it is oft used as a sleep aid.
洋甘菊能为茶饮增添宜人的甜味和花香。细腻的风味有助于身心放松——常被用来助眠。
The unique tang of lemongrass is lauded as signature for green tea. The mild, lightly-minty flavor is a perfect base for which to create a relaxing brew.
香茅那股独特的清香被誉为绿茶的招牌。那种温和、带一点薄荷感的风味，是泡一杯放松好茶的完美基底。
Although Ginger Root is bitingly bitter and inevitably overpowers other ingredients, it has potent medicinal effects which may help invigorate the sick.
姜根虽然辛苦刺口，难免压过其他材料，但它药效强劲，或许有助于让病人恢复活力。
Lavender is similarly relaxing, but must be the focus of the brew. It must be steeped for a long while, and is severely bitter, which causes it to drown out other ingredients.

For instance, caring for houseplants is a simple task. You can grow them from seeds or get them pre-bought, and caring for gardens is an easy way to relax, while also giving you a place to relax.
举例来说，照料室内盆栽就很简单。可以从种子种起，也可以买现成的；打理花园是轻松的放松方式，同时也给了你一处能放松的地方。
You can turn any room into a garden simply by getting planter pots, but for those who can't devote enough time to that, you could try caring for a bonsai tree instead.

They just need water, sunlight, and care by using garden shears to carefully cut the limbs of the tree. Shaping it like this is artful in itself, and has spiritual significance as well.
它只需要水、阳光，以及用园艺剪细心修去枝条的照料。像这样修出形状本身就是一门艺术，也带有精神上的意义。
It requires focus in the moment, but not much time at all, meaning that you can simply set aside short time and be done. It also helps clean the air in the house as well!
它需要当下的专注，但其实花不了多少时间——也就是抽一小段空就能做完。而且还能帮家里净化空气！
Another easy way to relax is to set up a stone garden. You don't need a large amount of space to have one- even a small box will do. Fill it with gravel and smooth stones.

与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 靠近 {p} 出口的 Enzan 对话。
Talk to Enzan close to the exit of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 靠近 {p} 出口的 Enzan 对话
I see you want to venture into the wilderness!
看来你想去荒野闯一闯！
My name is Enzan, and I am now a retired knight. I've spent most of my life fighting for {p}'s army, just like you.
我叫 Enzan，现在是个退役骑士。我这辈子大部分时间都在为 {p} 的军队作战，就跟你一样。
I know how hard it must be to be a recruit at this time, so I've got something that could help you! Well, I don't have it, but my brother does!
我知道这个时候当新兵有多辛苦，所以我有样东西能帮到你！嗯，东西不在我这儿，在我兄弟那儿！
Follow this road, he's just past the item identifier, you can't miss him. Just head to the big set of stairs, past the item identifier.
沿着这条路走，他就在物品鉴定师过去一点，你不会错过的。往那段大楼梯走，过了物品鉴定师就是。
Tell him I sent you! He can be such a jerk to strangers sometimes, especially when he's focused on his stairs...
告诉他是我叫你去的！他有时候对陌生人很不客气，尤其是在专心研究他的楼梯的时候……
Find Enzan's brother near the Item Identifier on the {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 {p} [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的物品鉴定师附近找到 Enzan 的兄弟。
Excuse me? Can't you see I'm busy?
干什么？没看到我很忙吗？
Oh, my brother? Sorry, I didn't know.
哦，我兄弟叫你来的？抱歉，我不知道。
Why yes, I actually have something that could help you...
是啊，我确实有样东西能帮到你……
But before I give it to you, why don't you help me with something first?
不过给你之前，你何不先帮我一个忙？
You see, there's a special kind of mushroom that grows in this cave. I hear it has certain... energizing properties.
你看，这个洞窟里长着一种特别的蘑菇。听说它有某种……提神的功效。
If you can bring me [{~} Energy Mushroom], I'll help you out. Enter the cave down the stairs, and bring me that mushroom!
如果你能给我带来 [{~} 能量蘑菇]，我就帮你。从楼梯下去进入洞窟，把那个蘑菇带给我！
Descend into the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring [{~} Energy Mushroom] to Therck
下到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的洞窟，把 [{~} 能量蘑菇] 带给 Therck
It's a very good ring for someone starting out like you. There's just one small issue...
对你这样刚起步的人来说，这是枚很好的戒指。只是有个小问题……
To wear it, you must help my friend back in {p}. He's been pestering me for days about needing help.
要戴上它，你得去帮我在 {p} 的朋友。他已经缠着我好几天说需要帮忙了。
You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger. Well, see you around, {u} .
等你变强一点，就到那里来找我吧。好了，回头见，{u}。
Ah, you're back. Do you have the mushroom?
啊，你回来了。蘑菇拿到了吗？
Excellent... Now I might finally be able to climb these stairs...
太好了……这下我也许终于能爬上这些楼梯了……
Who knows, maybe there's a treasure or something up there?
谁知道呢，也许上面有宝藏之类的？
Take this ring. It's an accessory item. You can identify it at the nearby Item Identifier.
收下这枚戒指。这是一件饰品，你可以去附近的物品鉴定师那里鉴定。
They're dead. Looks like one of them got hit by the cannonball.
他们死了。看来其中一个是被炮弹击中的。
With most of the mercenaries gone, you should be able to enter their hideout now.
大部分佣兵都解决了，你现在应该能进他们的藏身处了。
Aaah what am I gonna do what am I gonna do what am I gonna do what am I gonna doooo! There's no way I can solve this...
啊啊啊我该怎么办我该怎么办我该怎么办我该怎么办啊啊！我根本解决不了……
Wh- HUMAN! No, no, no! I don't need a demolitions service! The airship downing over my house has done that enough- Hey, wait!
什——人类！不，不，不！我不需要拆迁服务！飞艇砸在我家上面已经拆得够彻底了——嘿，等等！
You all are a reckless lot, aren't you?! You can run through some burning wreckage, right? That isn't above your paygrade, right?! RIGHT?!
你们这些人都很鲁莽，对吧？！你能冲过燃烧的残骸吧？这不算超出你的薪水范围吧？！对吧？！
Go through my house to the wreckage! Find any survivors you can! They might...I don't know! I don't know if they'll help but it's all I can think of right now!
穿过我家到残骸那里去！能找到多少幸存者就找多少！他们也许……我不知道！我不知道他们帮不帮得上忙，但我现在只想得到这个！
Scale the house and search the fallen airship for survivors
爬上房子，搜索坠毁的飞艇寻找幸存者
Okay Bricot, your house is a loss, but...don't panic... Don't panic. Please tell me the crew is-
好了 Bricot，你的房子没救了，但是……别慌……别慌。请告诉我机组人员都——
...urgh. I didn't want that sentence to end with DEAD! Aaagh, this is a disaster!!
……呃。我可不想这句话以“死了”结尾！啊啊啊，这下糟透了！！
My farm's ruined, there's no good help- Hey, don't give me that look, I know what happened with Tolem!
我的农场毁了，也找不到靠谱的帮手——嘿，别那样看我，我知道 Tolem 那边发生了什么！
...wait, that smell...that's sulphur. The airship engines don't use sulphur!
……等等，这个味道……是硫磺。飞艇引擎不用硫磺！
Gah, it didn't BREAK down, it got SHOT down!! Isn't the government going to DO something about all these mercenary groups?!
啊，它不是坏掉的，是被击落的！！政府难道不打算对这些佣兵团做点什么吗？！
Wait, what am I saying, there's a human here. Okay, new favor- go to the mercenary camp to the south there and do us ALL a favor, huh? Do what you do best!
等等，我在说什么，这里就有个人类。好，新的请求——去南边那个佣兵营地，帮我们所有人一个忙，行吗？做你最擅长的事！
You've broken through sturdier barricades before. A spell will knock it down easily.
更结实的路障你都闯过。一发法术就能轻松把它轰倒。
Round up, fellas! There's an uninvited guest barging in!
集合，伙计们！有个不速之客闯进来了！
...figures that you lot would be able to crack our defenses, huh? Alright, out with it. What do you want?
……果然你们这种人能突破我们的防御，是吧？好吧，说吧。你想要什么？
...Oh, is that all? Somehow, for someone who chopped through my men like a knife through paper I'd have expected more of a demand.
……噢，就这样？你砍我的手下就跟刀切纸一样，我还以为你会提出更大的要求。
We were hired by an anonymous benefactor to shoot down the airship. Frankly, it was a ridiculous job- could've been done far cleaner.
我们受一位匿名金主雇用去击落那艘飞艇。老实说，这活荒唐透了——明明可以干得干净得多。
The fellow wanted the mail being transported. Said we could take anything else that was left in the ship. But shooting it down only put everything at risk!
那家伙想要飞艇运送的邮件。说船上剩下的其他东西我们都可以拿走。可是把它打下来只会让所有东西都陷入危险！
All the cargo, all the correspondence, it could've easily gone up in flames. I don't think the fellow was thinking straight- they just really wanted that airship downed.
所有货物，所有信件，都很容易烧成灰。我觉得那家伙脑子不太清醒——他们就是非常想把那艘飞艇打下来。
Didn't even notice the great big hole in the sack they put the letters in. There's stray papers all over the ground. We have confidentiality with them, but...
连他们装信的袋子上有个大洞都没注意到。地上到处都是散落的纸张。我们跟他们有保密协议，不过……
At the same time, I've got my money, and they're an utter fool. If you want to catch them, follow the papers on the ground. I certainly won't stop you.
但同时，我已经拿到钱了，而他们是个十足的蠢货。如果你想抓他们，就跟着地上的纸走。我肯定不会拦你。
Follow the trail of papers to the bandit's house.
跟着纸张的痕迹找到强盗的房子。
Find the envelope in the cellar and return it to the sender.
在地窖里找到信封，把它还给寄件人。
Oh, dang. Almost had it that time. Maybe the flux is out of sorts- Yes, of course! Need more Squirmle Residue to deal with that...
噢，可恶。这次差一点就成了。也许是助熔剂出了问题——对，当然！得多加点 Squirmle 残渣来处理……
Quick, hand me the pliers! ...what? Yes, I know you aren't my assistant, but you've got two strong arms! Blessings of babylon! Pliers are easy to hand over, right?
快，把钳子递给我！……什么？对，我知道你不是我的助手，可你有两条强壮的胳膊！巴比伦保佑！递个钳子很简单吧？
Uh, buddy? This is a paper. Yes, there's writing on it, I see that, but what does that have to do with stabilizing the flux? Come on, think!
呃，伙计？这是张纸。对，上面有字，我看到了，可这跟稳定助熔剂有什么关系？拜托，动动脑子！
...wait a second, this is my handwriting. Hey, this was supposed to be in {p} two days ago! How in harbledee did you get this?
……等一下，这是我的笔迹。嘿，这个两天前就该到 {p} 了！你到底是怎么拿到的？
The ship got shot down? That's no good. Could probably...wait, the Squirmle Residue would be perfect for this! A gel-based reinforcer, the cannonballs would bounce right off!
船被击落了？那可不妙。也许可以……等等，Squirmle 残渣正好适合这个！凝胶状的加固剂，炮弹打上去会直接弹开！
Wait, focus on what's in front of you, Gawrick... The spell scroll isn't there...so. Hmm... Well, not to sound like a conspiracy theorist, but it might just be the work of the airliners.
等等，专注眼前的事，Gawrick……法术卷轴不在里面……所以。嗯……好吧，我不想听起来像个阴谋论者，但这可能是航空公司干的。
It's a longshot, though. That scroll detailed a spell that allowed for unlimited teleportation. It could really compete with the airliner business on convenience alone!
不过这只是瞎猜。那张卷轴记载着一种可以无限传送的法术。光是方便这一点，就足以跟航空业竞争了！
At the same time, though... The airship representatives control the ships. It's in the job description. Why would they shoot down the ship instead of just filching the mail?
可同时……飞艇代表管着那些船。那是他们的职责。他们为什么要把船打下来，而不是直接偷走邮件？
Well, it's a place to start! Why not talk with the airship representatives? They've got an office behind the customs desk in the airbase.
好吧，总得从哪里开始！何不去找飞艇代表谈谈？他们的办公室在航空基地海关柜台后面。
It wouldn't make a whole lot of sense if they were behind it, so I'd just as soon scratch it off the list. Now watch in amazement while I instantly teleport you to the office!
如果真是他们干的也说不太通，所以我巴不得把他们从名单上划掉。现在，惊叹吧，我要瞬间把你传送到办公室！
Juuuust as soon as I grab the pliers...er, oops! Hand slipped! Um, hands and feet INSIDE the dimensional bridge please!
只要我先拿一下钳子……呃，哎呀！手滑了！呃，请把手脚都放在维度桥里面！
Find the representative's office in the airship base at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的飞艇基地找到代表的办公室
No, it's been a while since Ernold's shown his face. He's in his office- said to not have anyone bother him.
不，Ernold 已经好一阵子没露面了。他在他的办公室里——说不准任何人打扰他。
So, you're out of luck. You'll probably not catch him today. Especially since he looked so frantic- when he gets like that...whoof.
所以你运气不好。你今天大概见不到他了。尤其他看起来那么慌乱——他一那样……呼。
And, please don't try and sneak in and bother him either. I got my ears boxed last time someone got by me.
还有，请不要想偷偷溜进去打扰他。上次有人从我这里溜过去，我被他狠狠骂了一顿。
Find a way to enter the representative's office.
想办法进入代表的办公室。
STUPID! SCROLL! LET GO OF MY HAND!
Why is this activated just by shaking it?! And why's it covered in this sticky residue?!
为什么一摇就会启动？！还有为什么上面沾满了这种黏糊糊的残渣？！
Wait, it- it's you! Garni! Help me out! This maniac's spell scroll is forcing me to teleport!!
等等，是——是你！Garni！帮帮我！这个疯子的法术卷轴逼得我一直传送！！
I can't grab the scroll without getting zipped away! You have to catch me and grab the scroll!!
我一抓卷轴就会被弹走！你得抓住我，把卷轴拿走！！
PLEASE! I've been stuck like this for five hours! Grab the scroll off me! I promise a pay rise if you do!!
拜托！我已经这样卡了五个小时了！把卷轴从我身上拿走！你拿到我保证给你加薪！！
GWEH! You almost got it! But it's even worse now! Once more! Grab the scroll off of me!!
咕！你差一点就拿到了！但现在更糟了！再来一次！把卷轴从我身上拿走！！
Urp...hrk...guhh. Th-thank you, SO much, Garni-
呕……呃……呜。谢、谢谢你，太谢谢你了，Garni——
Wait! You aren't the office manager! How did a human get in here?!
等等！你不是办公室经理！人类是怎么进来的？！
...oh, perfect. I've been rumbled, I see. Fine- at least let me say my piece here, alright? I had good reason for this!
……噢，好极了。看来我被识破了。好吧——至少让我把话说完，行吗？我这么做是有充分理由的！
For one thing, Gawrick's a damned maniac! This is clearly a danger- he's too erratic to trust his inventions!
首先，Gawrick 是个该死的疯子！这显然很危险——他太反复无常了，他的发明根本信不得！
For another, this was supposed to be a scroll of teleportation with no drawbacks whatsoever. Supposed to be, being the key words.
其次，这本来应该是一张毫无副作用的传送卷轴。关键词是“本来应该”。
Do you have any idea what that would do to the airship industry? It's a nice thought surely, but think about how many people work in this airbase alone!
你知道那会对飞艇业造成什么影响吗？想法当然很好，可你想想光是这个航空基地就有多少人在工作！
There'd be thousands jobless! I told him not to mail that scroll over, and I thought he'd listened! Then I heard him bragging in the street, and...well, I panicked.
会有成千上万的人失业！我叫他别把那张卷轴寄过来，我还以为他听进去了！结果我听到他在街上炫耀，然后……嗯，我慌了。

I'll admit, hiring the mercenaries to shoot down the ship was hasty of me. But that scroll can NOT be made into a public commodity! Even if it's stable, which is ISN'T, it could ruin peoples' livelihoods!
我承认，雇那些佣兵去击落飞艇是我太草率了。但那张卷轴绝对不能变成公开的商品！就算它是稳定的——而它并不稳定——也可能毁掉很多人的生计！

I'll relinquish it to you- I can tell you're expecting it. Maybe he'll listen to you...oh, what am I saying. Gawrick only ever listens to those voices in his head- or whatever drives his damned insanity.
我把它交给你吧——看得出来你就是来要它的。也许他会听你的……噢，我在说什么。Gawrick 只听他脑子里那些声音的——或者不管是什么驱使着他那该死的疯狂。
