So how about we give him a taste of his own medicine, and get hold of that journal he keeps? I'm sure that’ll dig up some dirt on him.
所以我们让他尝尝自己的苦头，把他那本日记弄到手怎么样？我敢肯定能从里面挖出他的黑料。
And by "we", we mean you. You'll have to sneak through the mansion and avoid guards.
我们说的“我们”，指的是你。你得偷偷穿过宅邸，避开守卫。
He keeps his journal in the highest room. Might need to distract some guards too. It's the biggest mansion in {p}, can't miss it.
他把日记放在最高的房间里。可能还得引开几个守卫。那是 {p} 最大的宅邸，不会找错的。
Sneak into the highest room of the {p} Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Arh, there's the thief I saw a-sneakin' round the Mansion! Get them!
啊，就是我看到在宅邸附近鬼鬼祟祟的那个小偷！抓住他！
Yer know you could get kicked out of the army fer this.
你知道你可能会因为这个被踢出军队吧。
Heh, guess yer the real thing. Hop in, lets get out of ‘ere.
呵，看来你是玩真的。上车，我们离开这里。
That journal is more valuable than any gem, you'll be able to get in fer sure.
那本日记比任何宝石都值钱，你肯定进得去。
Bring the journal from the {p} Mansion to the Vault Guard to enter the hideout.
把 {p} 宅邸的日记带给金库守卫，进入藏身处。
Oh, this is quite the password, "soldier". I think this will do nicely, on you go.
噢，这可真是个好暗号，“士兵”。我想这就行了，进去吧。
Look for the sceptre within the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的强盗藏身处里寻找权杖。
Right, then, you lot. Give me your reports.
Gold relieved from Mesa travellers last week counted just over {~} bars.
上周从台地旅人那里“收”来的金子，清点下来刚过 {~} 条。
We're working on exposing that blasted {p} Mayor with a stolen journal. {p} should be back under Creden Tibus control within the week.
我们正在用偷来的日记揭发那个该死的 {p} 镇长。一周之内，{p} 就会回到 Creden Tibus 的掌控之下。
Well... someone's been hanging around the old tomb. An archaeologist, looks like. I reckon she's lookin' for the sceptre.
嗯……有人一直在那座古墓附近转悠。看起来是个考古学家。我估计她在找那根权杖。
Ah... that sceptre's too valuable for us to lose. Maybe we pay 'er a visit, persuade her to... stop lookin'.
啊……那根权杖太值钱了，我们不能丢。也许我们该去拜访她，说服她……别再找了。
Right you are, boss. Good thing no one will think to look for it in that broken cart by the river, ey?!
您说得对，老大。还好没人会想到去河边那辆破车里找，是吧？！
Shut it, you fool! What did I just say? Anyway, I'll decide what to do with this archaeologist. Dismissed!
闭嘴，你这蠢货！我刚才说什么来着？总之，这个考古学家怎么处理由我决定。解散！
We might be bandits, but we’re not stupid. That sceptre is left better off alone.
我们也许是强盗，但我们可不笨。那根权杖最好别去碰。
Return to the tomb and give Junes the sceptre at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
回到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的古墓，把权杖交给 Junes。
Ah, {u}. I couldn't help myself - I simply had to see the tomb up close.
啊，{u}。我忍不住了——我就是得近距离看看这座古墓。
You have no idea how tempted I am to go inside, but I doubt I'd make it out alive.
你不知道我有多想进去，不过我怀疑我没法活着出来。
You... you found the sceptre? Oh! This is incredible! I can't believe it!
你……你找到权杖了？哦！这太不可思议了！真不敢相信！
This artifact, it witnessed the rise and fall of the Empire, thousands of years ago. And you've just been... holding it, without gloves...
这件文物见证了几千年前帝国的兴衰。而你就这样……拿着它，连手套都没戴……
Under the circumstances, I think I can let that slide. But the things I could learn from studying it...
考虑到情况特殊，我想这点可以不计较。不过研究它能学到的东西……
There are nasty legends of what it holds. Silverfish, skeletons... even Prince Hashr himself. Make sure to gear up!
关于里面有什么，有很多可怕的传说。蠹虫、骷髅……甚至是 Hashr 王子本人。一定要把装备准备好！
I have little to offer you for your help, but please accept these emeralds, and a fossil bone I found around here.
我没什么能报答你的，不过请收下这些绿宝石，还有我在这附近找到的一块化石骨头。
If you want some of my special brews, elixirs, and potions, go do business with my assistant.
想要我特调的药剂、灵药和药水的话，就去找我的助手买吧。
你已经收集过这份证据了。
This should be enough evidence. You should report back to Colonel Gailard.
证据应该够了。你该回去向 Gailard 上校报告。
Wait... I've got an idea... Alright, listen up soldier! There's a lil' town North of here named {p}, yeah? There's a healer person there that can help us out.
等等……我有个主意……好，听好了，士兵！这里北边有个叫 {p} 的小镇，对吧？那里有个医者能帮我们。
They're holed up inside of some important well in the center of the town. There's a password ya need to hop into that place, though...
他们窝在镇中心一口重要的井里。不过要进那地方得有暗号……
...Corrupted... lava springs...? You realize how stupid that sounds, yeah? Well, I completely believe you.
……腐化的……熔岩泉……？你知道这听起来有多蠢吧？好吧，我完全相信你。
Now, you have somewhere to be, right? Right. Go and report back to the Colonel, soldier. Tell him I said hi, by the way.
好了，你还有地方要去，对吧？对。回去向上校报告吧，士兵。对了，替我问声好。
You can feel your body heat adjusting as the potion courses through your body...
药水流遍你全身，你能感觉到体温正在调整……
Ye're a good ally, soldier! And a great help to the army, at that!
你是个好战友，士兵！而且还是军队的一大助力！
Oh, good, good! I bet'cha you're a {p} soldier, aren't ya? Listen up, soldier! I've got a task here that 'ye can help out with.
噢，好，好！我敢打赌你是 {p} 的士兵，对吧？听好了，士兵！我这里有个任务，你能帮上忙。
Ya see that lava spring right there? It just went and popped up out of nowhere! The brass is real concerned about it, mhm?
看到那边那口熔岩泉了吗？它就这么莫名其妙冒出来了！上头对这件事非常担心，嗯？
They've been yappin' about it bein' related to the Corruption, and 'ye can bet that that means trouble. BAD trouble.
他们一直嚷嚷说这跟腐化有关，你可以打包票，那就代表麻烦。大麻烦。
Now, this here Savannah has always had some Corruption lurkin' about, but not to the point where it can do this! It won't be safe around here if we don't do somethin' about it!
这片稀树草原一直都有些腐化潜伏着，但从来没到能搞出这种事的地步！我们要是不想想办法，这一带就不安全了！
Anyways, high command ain't gonna provide support for this until they know there's actual Corruption, so we've gotta find some evidence around the springs, understand?
总之，最高指挥部在确认真的有腐化之前是不会派支援的，所以我们得在泉水周围找点证据，明白吗？
Take a look around the springs, soldier! Find me some damn evidence around here! [{~} Pieces of Evidence] should be enough! Now, get movin'!
去泉水周围看看，士兵！给我找点该死的证据来！[{~} 份证据] 应该就够了！好了，快行动！
Look for three pieces of corrupted evidence around the Lava Spring at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的熔岩泉周围寻找三份腐化证据
Go back to Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
回到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Gailard 上校那里
Alright, good! Ya found some evidence, let me take a look at that!
好，很好！你找到证据了，让我看看！
Oh... This is bad... very, VERY bad...
哦……这下糟了……非常、非常糟……
This here is some physical corruption. If it's gettin' onto the surface, then 'ye can bet one of those weeds is spreadin' underground, right beneath the springs...
这是实体的腐化。它要是都冒到地表来了，那底下八成有一株那种杂草在蔓延，就在泉水正下方……
If ya could get underneath the spring, 'ye could probably sever whatever damn root is causing this, but... the heat would be sure to fry your skin off...
如果你能到泉水底下，大概就能把惹出这事的那条该死的根砍断，可是……那热度肯定会把你的皮烤掉……
Don't have much to go on, but I'm pretty damn sure the password is Bob, or something. After the hero himself.
我知道的不多，不过我非常确定暗号是 Bob 之类的。取自那位英雄本人。
Right, ye're headin' there to find a potion that can keep ya weak little hide safe from the heat, understand? Here, let me write down the location in that book of yours.
好，你要去那里找一种能保护你那身脆弱小皮囊不被烫伤的药水，明白吗？来，我把地点写在你那本书里。
Talk to Gregor outside the {p} well at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
与 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 水井外的 Gregor 对话
Hey, hey hey hey! Darling, what do you think you're doing? You can't just waltz in here without telling me the password!
嘿，嘿嘿嘿嘿！亲爱的，你以为你在干什么？不跟我说暗号可不能就这样大摇大摆地进去！
Hmm... Your face... confidence... it gleans with confidence... yet... you still haven't spoken to me since you arrived...
嗯……你的脸……自信……闪耀着自信……可是……你来了之后一句话都还没跟我说……
Could it be... you know that the password is penguin eggs, but you're just too shy to talk? Yeah... yeah, that's gotta be it!
难道……你知道暗号是企鹅蛋，只是太害羞了不敢开口？对……对，一定是这样！
You've convinced me, little mute darling... You can enter the well. Go on, now!
你说服我了，亲爱的小哑巴……你可以进井了。去吧！
Enter the {p} well and talk to the healer at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
G'day to you, friend. How can I help you?
你好啊，朋友。有什么能帮你的？
Hm? The Colonel sent you? what for?
嗯？上校派你来的？为了什么？
Right, you said lava, sooo... You need a heat resistance potion, yes?
好，你说是熔岩，所以……你需要一瓶耐热药水，对吧？
Welp, you're in luck, kinda... I have a potion that can resist the heat of lava, but the brew will not let you swim in lava.
嗯，你算是走运……我有一种能抵挡熔岩热度的药水，不过喝了它也没法在熔岩里游泳。
Oh that works, you just need to enter a borehole that goes through the lava? Perfect
噢，那就行了，你只是要进一个穿过熔岩的钻孔？太好了
Anyways, if you ever need any more special brews, my assistant will be happy to sell some at a very affordable price.
总之，如果你以后还需要什么特制药水，我的助手很乐意用非常实惠的价格卖给你。
Report back to Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
回去向 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Gailard 上校报告
Report! Ya got the potion yet, soldier? Good, drink it if ya haven't already!
报告！拿到药水了吗，士兵？很好，还没喝的话就喝下去！
Right, that's what I like to hear! Now, LOOK TO THE LEFT SOLDIER! There is a borehole out there we dug to try and hit the source of this weed.
对，这才是我想听的！好了，往左边看，士兵！那边有个钻孔，是我们为了挖到这杂草的源头挖的。
We found a pretty damn hot cave lying underneath the surface! If ya jumped into the borehole, 'ye could probably find the source of the Corruption and stop it.
我们在地表底下发现了一个热得要命的洞窟！如果你跳进钻孔，大概就能找到腐化的源头，把它阻止下来。
Now, the roots and spikes of Corruption are very sturdy, but we ain't never seen something like lava burstin' out of the ground.
腐化的根和尖刺是很坚固，但我们从来没见过有熔岩从地里喷出来这种事。
Had a small chat with the brass, earlier. They got a hunch that there's a heart to the Corruption that's pumpin' out all the lava!
刚才跟上头聊了几句。他们有预感，腐化有个心脏，所有熔岩都是从那里泵出来的！
That's gotta be our ticket, yeah? If 'ye destroy that, ya should be able to stop the spread of the lava! Now, get movin'! Head into the borehole, soldier!
那肯定就是我们的突破口，对吧？如果你把它摧毁，应该就能阻止熔岩蔓延！好了，快行动！进钻孔去，士兵！
Drink the Potion of Obsidian Skin, then enter the lava spring through the borehole at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and look for a corrupted heart
喝下黑曜石皮肤药水，然后从 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的钻孔进入熔岩泉，寻找腐化之心
Tell Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] that you destroyed the heart
告诉 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Gailard 上校你已经摧毁了心脏
Hah! I knew ya'd give me results! Ye're pretty damn reliable, soldier! Here, take this for your trouble!
哈！我就知道你会给我带来成果！你真是太可靠了，士兵！来，这个给你，辛苦了！
与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Burtur 交谈
Ah, one of you adventurin' types, huh? We see a lot of you around here... Going in and out as you please. Must be a nice life.
啊，你是那种冒险家，是吧？我们这里常看到你们这种人……想来就来，想走就走。日子一定过得很舒服。
Though, if you could spare some time, the town could use you-
不过，如果你能抽出点时间，镇上正需要你——
Wait, already?! It's only been a day since last! How insatiable are they...?
等等，又来了？！上次才过了一天！它们到底有多贪得无厌……？
THE UNDEAD HAVE OVERWHELMED THE GOLEMS! EVERY CITIZEN FOR THEMSELVES!!
不死生物攻破魔像防线了！所有市民自求多福！！
This is what I was talking about! We need your help with this! You Wynn folk are good at killing zombies, right?!
我说的就是这个！这件事需要你帮忙！你们 Wynn 人很会杀僵尸，对吧？！
We need help with this! Defend the town with us!
我们需要帮忙！跟我们一起保卫镇子！
The horde's retreating, but we have one citizen dead! Regroup at the square and prepare the pyres!
尸群在撤退，但有一位市民死了！到广场集合，准备火葬柴堆！
Check in with Burtur about the attack at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找 Burtur 了解这次袭击
Phew. That was a smaller horde, thankfully... Still, good thing you were there. That could have been worse.
呼。幸好这次的尸群比较小……不过，还好有你在。本来可能会更糟。
Still, c'mon now... We have to burn the bodies. Can't leave the job half-done.
不过，来吧……我们得把尸体烧掉。活不能只干一半。
It's a bit sacrilegious, but necessary to do right now- otherwise they just keep coming back, like they do across the ridge in Kander.
这有点亵渎，但现在必须这么做——不然它们就会一直回来，就像山脊另一边的 Kander 那样。
Since we don't live in a reeking, pockmarked plain, we have to burn the bodies so any dead don't turn right around against us.
既然我们住的不是什么臭气熏天、坑坑洼洼的平原，就得把尸体烧掉，免得死人转身来对付我们。
Say your goodbyes, all. Irahe will be missed. Step away from the pyre!
大家道别吧。我们会想念 Irahe 的。离柴堆远一点！
Some conspiracy theorists think that the Lazarus Pit is the issue. It's an urban legend, a well of water that can revive the dead.
有些阴谋论者认为问题出在 Lazarus 之坑。那是个都市传说，一口能让死人复活的水井。
Supposing that it's real, it would make some sense, at least- If it started feeding into the river or water tables, then we'd get the current goings-on.
假设它是真的，那至少说得通——如果它开始流进河里或地下水，就会发生现在这种事。
Of course, no one knows where it is, since it's just rumors, but there's supposedly an "Order" of pit-keepers. Conveniently long dead, and buried in that small graveyard just north of here.
当然，没人知道它在哪，因为那只是传闻，不过据说有个守坑人的“教团”。很巧的是，他们早就死了，就埋在这里北边那个小墓地里。
I'll stay back at the town square, in case the undead attack again. Give me a shout if you find something you aren't sure about.
我会留在镇广场，以防不死生物再次袭击。如果你找到拿不准的东西，就喊我一声。
Have you checked out that small graveyard north of here yet? Remember, you're looking for any clues about that Lazarus Pit "Order."
你去这里北边那个小墓地看过了吗？记住，你要找的是关于 Lazarus 之坑“教团”的线索。
Find the body of the Order's mage in {p}'s graveyard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 墓地找到教团法师的遗体
Locate the chapel mentioned by the talisman, or return to Burtur for assistance.
找到护符上提到的礼拜堂，或者回去找 Burtur 寻求帮助。
Any luck searching out that chapel yet? The coordinates ought to be in your content book, right?
找到那座礼拜堂了吗？坐标应该在你的内容手册里了，对吧？
Investigate the Order's chapel northwest of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
调查 {p} 西北边 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的教团礼拜堂
Solve the crypt's riddle to 'bring the water of life anew' to the graves.
解开墓穴的谜题，为坟墓“重新带来生命之水”。
Perhaps you could use this water to revive some of the graves around the crypt...
也许你可以用这水让墓穴周围的一些坟墓复苏……
Revive the people in the tombs with the Lazarus Water and complete their tasks.
用 Lazarus 之水复活墓中的人，完成他们的委托。
Ugh. And who put YOU in charge of waking me up? Where's Gwendolyn, my maid? Incompetents- she was supposed to be buried with me too!
呃。是谁让你来叫醒我的？我的女仆 Gwendolyn 呢？一群废物——她本来应该跟我一起下葬的！
What, you want to enter the crypt? Well, prove you're better than the funeral directors and do something right! The Ghastly Ghouls around here won't stop SCREAMING!
什么，你想进墓穴？那就证明你比那些殡葬人员强，把一件事办好！这附近的骇人食尸鬼吵个没完！
I want them gone! Get rid of, say, {~} Ghastly Ghouls. Then perhaps I'll give you the time of day, you strange, small-nosed lookyloo!
我要它们消失！除掉，比如说，{~} 只骇人食尸鬼。到时候我也许会搭理你，你这个奇怪的小鼻子看热闹的！
Agh! Stop sneaking up on me! Have you killed those {~} Ghastly Ghouls I asked you to, yet?
啊！别偷偷摸摸靠近我！我叫你杀的那 {~} 只骇人食尸鬼杀完了没？
击杀 {~} 只骇人食尸鬼
Ah, my favorite little weird-small-nosed-person! The graveyard is so lovely when it's quiet- you really did do a good job!
啊，我最喜欢的奇怪小鼻子人！墓地安静下来真是太美了——你干得真不错！
As important as I am, you must still check with the other graves, though you certainly have my blessing to enter.
虽然我这么重要，你还是得去问问其他坟墓，不过你当然已经得到我进入的祝福了。
My goodness! Ah, it feels good to stretch these old bones. It's not easy being cooped up in a coffin, you know.
天哪！啊，能伸展一下这把老骨头真舒服。你知道吗，一直闷在棺材里可不容易。
You want to get into the crypt? I suppose I could give you a hand... figuratively, I mean. Still, need to see if you can be trusted and all...
你想进墓穴？我想我可以帮你一把……我是说比喻上的。不过，还是得先看看你值不值得信任……
Oh, right! My dear husband gave me the most beautiful wedding band, but it became lost when I carked it. Some rude shadowy thing- See if anyone ever marries THEM!
噢，对了！我亲爱的丈夫送了我一枚最美的结婚戒指，可是我翘辫子的时候弄丢了。是个没礼貌的影子东西——看以后有谁会娶它！
Bring it back, could you? I died around that old lich's tower to the east. Do that, and I'll be happy to give you my blessing!
能帮我拿回来吗？我死在东边那座老巫妖塔附近。办好了，我很乐意给你我的祝福！
Bring my wedding band back, could you? I died around that old lich's tower to the east. Do that, and I'll be happy to give you my blessing!
能帮我把结婚戒指拿回来吗？我死在东边那座老巫妖塔附近。办好了，我很乐意给你我的祝福！
找到 Pigglesworth 爵士的结婚戒指
Oh, you found it! Wonderful! Just pop it on that fingerbone right there... Ah, it fits even better on the other hand!
哦，你找到了！太好了！把它套在那根指骨上就行……啊，戴在另一只手上更合适！
I oughta deck you for waking me up!! Don't you realize it's RUDE to re-animate the long-dead corpse of a murderer when he's trying to get his beauty death?!
我真该揍你一顿，竟敢把我吵醒！！你难道不知道，在一个杀人犯睡他的美容死觉时，把他那早就死透的尸体复活是很没礼貌的吗？！
Greetings! Thank goodness, that dreary old tomb was simply awful. No furniture, no natural light, not even a lick of paint! So drab, the whole thing.

找到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Lazarus 之坑入口

告诉 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Burtur 你已经堵住了 Lazarus 之坑

我求求你，请找到我的儿子。我不太清楚他在哪里，但他肯定被带到丛林很深的地方去了……

求、求求你，灵魂，放我走吧！部落的人一定急坏了——

他对我期望太高了！我讨厌政治，我想成为像 Tisaun 那样伟大的雇佣兵，去保护那些没办法保护自己的人！

可以麻烦你告诉 Yavlis 我想要自由吗？如果你愿意，我会很感激。
