哦，嘿，陌生人。想聊聊？好啊，我想这能帮忙打发点时间。
The name's Malic, nice to meet you. I'm guessing you'll be taking the train to the same place as me? To {p}?
我叫 Malic，很高兴认识你。我猜你要搭车去的地方跟我一样？去 {p}？
I'm pretty excited about it. Around these parts, people never really get the opportunity to travel the Queen's Line. Too expensive for us, typically.
我挺兴奋的。在这一带，人们几乎没有机会坐女王线。对我们来说通常太贵了。
It's always been a dream of mine to see what other parts of Fruma are like, though, so I... well, I saved up for a long time.
不过我一直梦想着看看 Fruma 其他地方是什么样子，所以我……嗯，我存了很久的钱。
Don't really know what the {p}'ll be like... I can't wait to find out. If it's anything like its Sovereign, it should be pretty great.
不太知道 {p} 会是什么样子……我等不及要去看看了。如果那里跟它的统领一样，应该会很棒。
Heh. Enough yammering from me, though. You probably have your own stuff you wanna talk about, right?
嘿。不过我也唠叨够了。你大概也有自己想聊的事吧，对吧？
Anything else you wanna talk about?
又见面了！有什么要说的吗？
Enough of this, though, or I'll get too excited. Anything else you wanna talk about?
不过聊到这就好，不然我会太兴奋。还有什么想聊的吗？
Sigh. Anything else you wanna talk about?
Oh, shoot. The train's here. I'll catch you later, I guess?
哦，糟了。火车来了。我想之后再聊？
...Wow... Fascinating... I wonder what the cat symbolizes...
……哇……真有意思……不知道那只猫象征着什么……
Oh, hi! Are you from around here? My name's Maddison, I'm a tourist from Aelumia.
哦，嗨！你是本地人吗？我叫 Maddison，是从 Aelumia 来的游客。
I've been travelling the Queen's Line all around Fruma to see what the rest of the province is like! It's been a fun time so far! ...Well, mostly...
我一直在坐女王线环游 Fruma，想看看行省其他地方长什么样子！到目前为止都很好玩！……嗯，大部分时候吧……
This region has been... It's not quite what I expected. There's quite a unique culture here, though! Check out the cool wall art! You never see that back home!
这个地区……跟我想的不太一样。不过这里的文化很独特！你看那些很酷的墙上涂鸦！家乡那边根本看不到！
I'm really looking forward to seeing what makes {p} different- that's where I'm headed next. So far, everywhere has been really unique!
我真的很期待看看 {p} 有什么不同——那是我的下一站。到目前为止，每个地方都很独特！
I'm just sad I'll miss their festival... The one here went... bad.
只可惜我会错过他们的庆典……这里的那场……办砸了。
...Anyway, is there anything you'd like to talk about?
Oh, well... Anything else you'd like to discuss?
哦，嗯……还有什么想讨论的吗？
Roughworks? Oh, right, that's what the people there call it. To me, it's the {p}.
Roughworks？哦，对，那里的人都这么叫它。对我来说，它是 {p}。
I always imagined it being a bit... cleaner. Maybe the people there are just used to it being messy, though?
我一直以为那里会……干净一点。不过也许那里的人只是习惯了乱糟糟的？
A lot of the people I tried talking to were, well, not very nice. They didn't seem to like tourists all that much...
我试着搭话的很多人都，嗯，不太友善。他们好像不怎么喜欢游客……
Overall, it was... probably been the low point of my trip. I think it's just not for me, really. But there were some parts I liked!
整体来说，那里……大概是我这趟旅行的低谷。我想那里就是不适合我吧。不过也有一些我喜欢的地方！
I already mentioned the pretty murals, but there was a bunch of other cool stuff, too. Did you know the people there fight to resolve disputes?
我已经提过那些漂亮的壁画了，不过还有很多别的酷东西。你知道那里的人会用打架来解决纠纷吗？
...Or, wait. You would, since you're from here, right? Or... no, you're dressed pretty different. Where are you from?
……还是说，等等。你应该知道吧，既然你是本地人？还是……不对，你穿得很不一样。你是从哪里来的？
{p}'s beautiful. I've lived there my whole life, it's my home, it's precious to me.
{p} 很美。我在那里住了一辈子，那是我的家，对我来说很珍贵。
It's just... When you've lived somewhere for that long, it starts to feel... small. Samey. Especially when you're boxed in by those towering city walls.
只是……在一个地方住得太久，就会开始觉得……很小。千篇一律。尤其是被那些高耸的城墙围着的时候。
Don't get me wrong, I'm proud to live in the Queen's royal city, but... I needed something new. A change of pace. That's why I decided to go on this trip!
别误会，我很自豪能住在女王的王城里，但是……我需要一些新鲜的东西。换换节奏。所以我才决定来这趟旅行！
I'm lucky enough to be the daughter of one of the University's best-paid professors, so I was able to afford such a privilege. Those tickets aren't cheap...
我很幸运，是大学里薪水最高的教授之一的女儿，所以才负担得起这种特权。那些票可不便宜……
...Anyway, sorry, that was a bit of a tangent. Overall, Aelumia's great if you enjoy the city life, it just... gets boring, eventually.
……总之，抱歉，扯得有点远了。整体来说，如果你喜欢城市生活，Aelumia 很棒，只是……久了会腻。
So far, the trip's been pretty great! It's been really refreshing to see how different each region of Fruma is!
到目前为止，旅行都很棒！看到 Fruma 每个地区都这么不同，真的让人耳目一新！
I've only been to the {p} and {p}, though. Both have been enlightening, in their own ways.
不过我只去过 {p} 和 {p}。两个地方都各自给了我一些启发。
The {p} may be the most beautiful place I've ever seen... Not that that's saying much. The landscapes were incredible, and oh, the flowers!
{p} 可能是我见过最美的地方……虽然这也说明不了什么。风景太不可思议了，还有哦，那些花！
The {p}? It's... I guess I've come to learn that some people live by different standards to me, which is... interesting.
{p}？那里……我想我学到了，有些人的生活标准跟我不一样，这……挺有意思的。
I'm a little sad the trip's coming to an end after the next stop... Fruma is so big, yet so small, isn't it?
下一站之后旅行就要结束了，我有点难过……Fruma 这么大，却又这么小，不是吗？
I hear people used to live in the {p} and the Penitence District, but they were moved out. I wish I could go back in time and experience their culture, too.
我听说以前有人住在 {p} 和 Penitence District，但他们被迁走了。真希望我能回到过去，也体验一下他们的文化。
I think this might be the stop I'm most excited for!
我想这可能是我最期待的一站！
My dad teaches biology, and he's been all over the place studying the province's wildlife. His travels honestly inspired me to go on this journey.
我爸爸教生物学，他为了研究行省的野生动物跑遍了各地。老实说，他的旅行启发了我踏上这趟旅程。
Growing up, he told me stories of his trips... {p} was always the place that stood out the most, of the ones he described.
我小时候，他跟我讲他旅行的故事……在他描述过的地方里，{p} 一直是最突出的。
It sounds like nothing you'd ever see anywhere else. Golden leaves, beautiful traditional architecture, and the kindest people...
那听起来跟你在别处能看到的完全不一样。金色的树叶、美丽的传统建筑，还有最亲切的人……
Needless to say, I've dreamed of going there my whole life. Of course, I also dreamed of going everywhere else, too. But Auburn most of all.
不用说，我这辈子都梦想着去那里。当然，我也梦想着去其他所有地方。但最想去的就是 Auburn。
Ah, them. I've not really spoken to either.
啊，他们啊。我跟他们俩都没怎么说过话。
I tried talking to the one with the funny shirt, but they didn't seem much for conversation.
我试着跟穿那件滑稽衬衫的人搭话，但对方好像不太想聊。
The other guy? He seems to be from around here, and, well...
另一个人？他好像是本地人，而且，嗯……
...I don't have anything against the people of this District, but their attitudes differ from mine, and...
……我对这个区的人没有意见，但他们的态度跟我不一样，而且……
...I'm just a little tired of being berated by them for coming here, okay?
……我只是有点受够了因为来这里而被他们数落，好吗？
Oh! The train's here! ...Uh, Guess I should catch you later?
哦！火车来了！……呃，我想之后再聊？
You want to talk? Sigh, fine. Fine, I guess.
你想聊？唉，好吧。好吧，我想。
Ugh. Well, see, I'm from {p}. I... don't like it there. So I wanted to see what the Industrial Distict was like.
呃。嗯，是这样，我是 {p} 人。我……不喜欢那里。所以我想看看工业区是什么样子。
Having been here yourself, I'm sure you understand well how that turned out. Now, I'm heading home.
你自己也来过这里，我相信你很清楚结果怎么样。现在，我要回家了。
Really, at this point, I don't know if anywhere in this province is worth seeing. It must all be like this.
说真的，到了这个地步，我不知道这个行省还有哪里值得看。肯定全都是这副样子。
...But enough about me. What do you want to say?
……不过我的事就不说了。你想说什么？
Sorry about that, I got... Madder, than expected... Anything else you'd like to discuss?
抱歉，我……比预期的还火大……还有什么想讨论的吗？
I chose the {p} because it was the cheapest ticket... I had to exchange so many materials for those weird emeralds they use here.
我选 {p} 是因为票最便宜……我得拿好多材料去换这里用的那些奇怪的绿宝石。
I had high expectations, thought seeing another part of the province might restore my hopes... It didn't.
我本来期望很高，以为看看行省的其他地方也许能让我重燃希望……结果没有。
I didn't even want to witness whatever mess the Festival there was going to end up being. It couldn't possibly compensate for missing the one back home.
那里的庆典最后会搞成什么烂摊子，我连看都不想看。反正再怎么样，也弥补不了错过家乡那场的遗憾。
I'm just heading home. I guess I'll have to just... learn to like Auburn. Ugh...
我只是要回家了。我想我只能……学着喜欢 Auburn 了。呃……
This shirt? Ugh... I forgot about this stupid shirt.
这件衬衫？呃……我都忘了这件蠢衬衫了。
On the way here, some guy came up to me and begged on his knees for me to buy his shirt. It was hard to refuse... I felt bad...
来这里的路上，有个家伙跑来跪着求我买他的衬衫。很难拒绝……我于心不忍……
I guess "TC" stands for {p} City. For the record, I do NOT love {p} City.
我猜“TC”是 {p} City 的意思吧。我要声明，我一点也不爱 {p} City。
In fact, this shirt doesn't even hold any value to me as a souvenier. I don't want to remember this trip.
事实上，这件衬衫对我来说连纪念品的价值都没有。我不想记得这趟旅行。
I'm going to have to destroy it, or perhaps trade it for something. I never want to see it again.
我得把它毁掉，或者拿去换点什么。我再也不想看到它了。
It feels like we're living in squalor for no reason! You always hear these wonderful stories about other regions, like that the {p} have beautiful, huge lakes.
感觉我们毫无理由地活在脏乱之中！你总是听到关于其他地区的美好故事，像是 {p} 有美丽的大湖。
If that's even true, why can't we get some of that water? Why must we put up with the pathetic trickle we get from the dam?
如果那是真的，为什么我们不能分到一点水？为什么我们得忍受水坝那点可怜的涓涓细流？
And yet, everyone back home is just so... Okay??? With it??? They think the government couldn't wrong them. They build shrines to the Queen in their homes!
可是家乡的每个人都……对此毫无意见？？？他们以为政府不可能亏待他们。他们还在家里给女王盖神龛！
It's just so... Frustrating!!! Why can't they see things the way I do??? The region itself is mostly fine, it's the people I can't stand!
真是……让人火大！！！他们为什么不能像我一样看清事情？？？这个地区本身大致还行，我受不了的是那里的人！
I don't even believe those stories anymore though... I think everywhere is just awful in its own way.
不过我现在连那些故事都不信了……我觉得每个地方都各有各的糟糕。
We were always sold this idea of the {p} as this beautiful place where proud workers labored for the Queen amidst beautiful crop fields... You've seen it, haven't you?
我们一直被灌输 {p} 是个美丽的地方，自豪的工人在美丽的农田间为女王辛勤劳作……你亲眼看过了，不是吗？
I bet everywhere is just as bad. I just don't know what to think of anything anymore. It all feels like a lie. But maybe I'm just asking for too much, I don't know...
我敢说每个地方都一样糟。我已经不知道该怎么看待任何事了。一切都感觉像个谎言。不过也许只是我要求太多了，我不知道……
Other people? The girl tried talking to me, but she left me alone when she realized I didn't want to talk.
其他人？那个女孩试着跟我说话，发现我不想聊就让我自己待着了。
And that other guy? I didn't notice him until just now.
至于另一个人？我刚才才注意到他。
...Train's here. Stop talking to me, please...
……火车来了。请别再跟我说话了……
Hey... Didn't I just ask you to not cause trouble? Could you stop that, please?
喂……我不是刚叫你别惹麻烦吗？能不能停下来，拜托？
Listen. I don't feel like calling the guards over, okay? I'm asking you to please stop.
听着。我不想把守卫叫过来，好吗？我是在拜托你停下来。
You're really annoying everyone here, including me. Thanks.
你真的让这里每个人都很烦，包括我。谢了。
Sigh... Whatever, it's not like they're paying me enough to care...
唉……随便吧，他们付我的钱又没多到让我在乎……
Step aside, citizens. We're here on important business.
让一让，市民们。我们有要事在身。
The general of the Constables Division..? I wonder what's going on...
警备部队的将军……？不知道发生了什么事……
Keep your nose out of our matters, citizen. Our activities will have no impact on your trip.
别管我们的事，市民。我们的行动不会影响你的旅程。
Hey! What's the holdup? All aboard! Come on!
喂！在拖什么？全员上车！快点！
Hello passenger! I hope that the subway experience has been to your liking.
你好，乘客！希望这趟地铁之旅让您满意。
I am Telati, the attendant for your journey today. I am sorry I did not say hello when verifying your stamp, I was a little, uh, shocked by how many people were taking the train today.
我是 Telati，今天这趟旅程的乘务员。很抱歉刚才检查您的章时没打招呼，我有点，呃，被今天坐车的人数吓到了。
We don't get passengers often, to be honest with you, so to have even this many... That was a surprise. Not to mention General Levi being here, too.
老实跟您说，我们平常乘客不多，所以有这么多人……真是意外。更别提 Levi 将军也在车上。
Anyway, we should be arriving in {p} in an hour or two. Until then, feel free to talk with your fellow passengers, or take a nap.
总之，我们大约一两个小时后会抵达 {p}。在那之前，您可以随意跟其他乘客聊天，或者小睡一下。
I hope you have a good trip! And, if there's any issues, do not be afraid to speak with me.
祝您旅途愉快！如果有任何问题，请别客气来找我。
Explore the train. Return to your seat at [-{~}, {~}, {~}] when done.
探索列车。结束后回到 [-{~}, {~}, {~}] 的座位。
Oh, hello there, passenger. Is something the matter?
哦，您好，乘客。有什么问题吗？
...You just want to chat? You know what, sure, it could be a nice break from my busywork.
……您只是想聊聊？好啊，也可以让我从杂务中喘口气。
As I told you before, my name's Telati. I'm... the only staffer on the train today. Besides the driver, Cusef, but he's busy, well, driving.
我之前说过，我叫 Telati。今天车上……只有我一个工作人员。除了司机 Cusef，不过他正忙着，嗯，开车。
That means I'm the only person here to attend our many passengers today. Again, we don't usually get this many.
也就是说，今天只有我一个人照顾这么多乘客。再说一次，我们平常没这么多人。
It's... It's okay though. Everyone seems fairly content. Besides that Cemor guy, at least.
这……这还好啦。大家似乎都挺满意的。至少除了那个 Cemor 以外。
Enough about that though. What would you like to talk about?
不过那个就不说了。您想聊什么？
Anything wrong? Or do you just want to chat?
有什么问题吗？还是只是想聊聊？
...It's okay. I can handle it... Anything else to say?
……没关系。我应付得来……还有什么要说的吗？
...Perhaps I shouldn't have let that slip... Uhm... Anything else to say...?
……也许我不该说漏嘴的……嗯……还有什么要说的吗……？
There aren't many of us, really. Each train usually has only {~} staffers- a driver and {~} attendants.
我们人不多，真的。每班车通常只有 {~} 名工作人员——一名司机和 {~} 名乘务员。
The team for this particular train is Cusef the driver, plus Zathie and I.
这班车的团队是司机 Cusef，加上 Zathie 和我。
This is typically enough, as the trains aren't very busy. Frankly, I don't know why they bother having this many carriages.
这通常就够了，因为车上不太忙。坦白说，我不知道他们为什么要挂这么多节车厢。
It's usually only Aelumians and Highlanders who can afford trips, and, well... Most of those guys don't seem interested in seeing other regions.
通常只有 Aelumia 人和高地人负担得起旅行，而，嗯……那些人大多对看看其他地区没什么兴趣。
This time of year is actually the exception, since the Festivals are on. But, having spoken to a few passengers, none seem to be travelling for that at all.
每年这个时候其实是例外，因为有各地的庆典。不过跟几位乘客聊过之后，好像没有一个是为了庆典而旅行的。
For today's trip to have so many people - and such a diverse set too - is an anomaly. It's... unfortunate timing, too, since Zathie's on break.
今天这趟有这么多人——而且还这么多样——真是反常。时机也……不巧，因为 Zathie 在休假。
We were dealing with all the expected extra traffic from the Auburn Festival being on, and she burnt herself preparing a meal, so she got a couple days off.
我们之前一直在应付 Auburn 庆典带来的额外客流，她做饭时烫伤了自己，所以放了几天假。
I thought it'd be fine since the Auburn Festival's wrapped up, but... I guess there's still a lot of interest in going there?
我以为 Auburn 庆典结束了应该就没事，但是……看来还是有很多人想去那里？
Ah, my home. It may surprise you, but I'm from the Roughw- er- {p}.
啊，我的家乡。您可能会意外，我是 Roughw——呃——{p} 人。
I'm lucky to have a job such as this, living where I do. The conditions aboard the train are heavenly compared to where my neighbors work.
住在我住的地方，能有这样的工作算我幸运。跟我邻居们工作的地方比起来，车上的环境简直是天堂。
...I do wonder why they can't share this quality of life. I suppose there must be a reason for it; I trust Her Majesty's judgement.
……我确实会想，为什么他们不能共享这种生活品质。我想一定有原因吧；我相信女王陛下的判断。
Ah, him. Yes, he's the Highlander sat in the dining carriage.
啊，他啊。是的，就是坐在餐车里那位高地人。
He seems... needy. No- maybe that's just selfish of me to say.
他似乎……很难伺候。不——也许那样说是我太自私了。
He keeps asking me to prepare him some specific meal, and... listen. The customer is always right, and all, but...
他一直要我帮他做某道特定的菜，而且……您听我说。顾客永远是对的，诸如此类，但是……
I'm not the chef on this train. That's Zathie. I'm scared of messing up the recipe, and also just generally dislike cooking.
我不是这班车的厨师。那是 Zathie。我怕把食谱搞砸，而且我本来就不喜欢做饭。
So... I'm hanging out here as far away from him as possible, hoping he just... forgets about it.
所以……我就尽量待在离他最远的地方，希望他就这样……忘了这件事。
Sigh... Maybe that's immoral of me, I don't know.
唉……也许我这样不道德，我不知道。
The train's like a second home to me. Maybe more of a home to me than my real home...
列车就像我的第二个家。对我来说，也许比我真正的家更像家……
It's the most comfortable place I've ever been. I love it here.
这是我待过最舒服的地方。我爱这里。
Getting to travel all over Fruma for free is such a privilege, too, I've seen some beautiful stations...
能免费在 Fruma 各地旅行也是一种特权，我见过一些很美的车站……
Yes, just stations. They never let me go beyond. But there's some gorgeous sights to see from there alone up in {p} or at {p}.
对，只有车站。他们从不让我出站。不过光是从 {p} 或 {p} 的车站看出去，就有一些绝美的景色。
...I've only been to {p} a couple of times. It's military-only and they typically use their own trains to travel there...
……我只去过 {p} 几次。那里只准军方人员进入，他们通常搭自己的列车过去……
...But sometimes, there are urgent matters that require the use of civilian trains. Today seems to be one such instance of this.
……但有时候，会有需要动用民用列车的紧急事务。今天似乎就是这种情况。
Oh! I'm so sorry! I must've forgotten to give you that.
哦！真是非常抱歉！我一定是忘了给您那个。
I- I was in such a hurry to accomodate everyone, it must have slipped my mind... I sincerely apologize.
我——我急着招呼每个人，一定是忘了……我诚心向您道歉。
Oh, alright then. Have a good trip!
I TOLD you, idiot, ya need to wear Aelumia purple! Since we're not assigned to the Roughworks anymore!
我就跟你说了，笨蛋，你得穿 Aelumia 紫！因为我们已经不负责 Roughworks 了！
Lighten up, Maury. At least I used the right colour for my sword's hilt.
放轻松，Maury。至少我剑柄的颜色用对了。
NO, Harvin, that is NOT GOOD ENOUGH. We're already on thin ice after the sewage incident.
不对，Harvin，那“还不够”。污水那件事之后我们已经在薄冰上了。
Bein' assigned to the General is a BIG DEAL! We can't screw it up, or we're OUT.
被派去保护将军可是件大事！我们不能搞砸，不然就完蛋了。
I still think the sewage incident was way overblown, but whatever.
我到现在还是觉得污水那件事被过度渲染了，不过随便啦。
I agree, but that's not the p- Oh, hey there, citizen.
我同意，但那不是重——哦，嘿，市民。
Drop the act, Maury. They were there for like half the argument.
别装了，Maury。他们大概听了半场吵架了。
WHAT? Why didn't ya tell me???
Ech... Whatever. You. Whaddaya ya want. You wanna chat? Got a problem to report? What's goin' on.
呃……随便。你。你想干嘛。想聊天？有问题要报告？怎么回事。
Got anythin' else you wanna say?
...We're movin' on before he says any more. Ask about somethin' else.
……趁他说出更多之前我们换个话题。问点别的吧。
Me too, bud, me too... Ah, right. You. Anythin' else to say?
我也是，老弟，我也是……啊，对。你。还有别的要说吗？
That ain't fer your ears, kid.
We're guarding General Levi on her trip to {p}, where she'll be helping investigate some kind of bre-
我们在护送 Levi 将军去 {p}，她要去协助调查某种入——
HARVIN, NO. She told us NOT to tell anyone what's goin' on. And this door's thin, what if she hears us?
HARVIN，别说。她叫我们“不准”告诉任何人发生了什么事。而且这扇门很薄，要是她听到了怎么办？
I do wonder what happened though. She said it's really bad there, ton of soldiers dead supposedly, plus a Comman-
不过我确实很好奇发生了什么。她说那里情况真的很糟，据说死了一大堆士兵，还有一位指挥——
Every division of the Guard has a General leading it; she's ours.
卫队的每个部队都有一位将军领导；她是我们的将军。
We were just mindin' our business, roughin' up some... miscreants, and then she comes along an' drags us into bein' her guards for this whole shabang.
我们本来只是做自己的事，教训一些……不法之徒，然后她就过来把我们拖去当她这一整趟的护卫。
...Between you an' us... I don't think she woulda made us come along had she not been in a hurry...
……我们私下说……我觉得要不是她赶时间，她不会带我们来的……
Yeah, more likely, she would have just fired us on the spot.
对，更有可能她会当场开除我们。
SHHH. What if she overhears? Don't give 'er any ideas.
嘘。要是她听到了怎么办？别给她出主意。
Stories? What am I, yer mother at bedtime? Why would I tell you sto-
故事？我是什么，睡前讲故事的老妈吗？我干嘛要跟你讲故——
We could tell them about the time we were assigned to {p}!
我们可以跟他们讲我们被派去 {p} 那次的事！
Ohhh, yeah! I love that story. Great thinkin', Harvin.
哦哦，对！我超爱那个故事。想得好，Harvin。
So basically, there's this guy who comes up to us, an' he's all like "ooh i'm from house blahblah you must respect me..."
基本上就是，有个家伙跑过来找我们，一副“哦我是某某家族的你们必须尊敬我……”的样子。
Us, bein' from the Roughworks, don' give a damn about any 'a that. So he gets mad when we laugh in 'is face.
我们是 Roughworks 出身，才不管那一套。所以我们当着他的面笑出来，他就气坏了。
...accidentally knocks over a stall and gets himself totally covered in dyes!
……不小心撞翻了一个摊子，搞得自己浑身都是染料！
YEAH, haha, his fancy clothes were ruined! It was awesome.
对，哈哈，他那身华丽的衣服全毁了！太精彩了。
Sadly, I think he actually had some influence, cause we've not been assigned to {p} since...
可惜我觉得他真的有点影响力，因为从那之后我们就再也没被派去 {p}……
Man, the {p} were beautiful, wish I could see them again.
天啊，{p} 真美，真希望能再去看看。
The sewage incident is not to be spoken of.
We are NOT tellin' you about that, kid.
我们“不会”告诉你那件事的，小鬼。
Then go away, kid. We have important things to do.
那就走开，小鬼。我们有要事要办。
...You again? Was it not clear enough that I wanted to be left alone?
……又是你？我想一个人静静，表达得还不够清楚吗？
Having been there yourself, I'm sure you understand well how that turned out. Now, I'm heading home.
你自己也去过那里，我相信你很清楚结果怎么样。现在，我要回家了。
Really, at this point, I don't know if anywhere in this province is worth seeing. It must all be like that.
说真的，到了这个地步，我不知道这个行省还有哪里值得看。肯定全都是那副样子。
...But enough about me. What do you want to say?
……不过我的事就不说了。你想说什么？
What do you want to say?
...I have a lot of thinking to do, basically. It would be easier to do that if you left me alone...
……基本上，我有很多事要想。你让我一个人待着会比较容易……
It's the same experience as before, just... different.
跟之前的体验一样，只是……不一样了。
The first time, I was amazed... It's so comfortable and nice... I was so excited to see what awaited me in {p}...
第一次的时候，我很惊叹……这么舒服、这么好……我那么期待去看看 {p} 有什么在等着我……
Now? It all just feels like a facade. I can't enjoy it the same way.
现在？一切都只像是一层假象。我没办法再用同样的心情享受了。
Oh, yeah, they're here, I guess.
I don't really care, as long as they don't find some way to make my trip even worse...
我不太在乎，只要他们别想办法让我的旅程变得更糟……
They're agents of the Queen, and I don't really know what to think of that anymore. I can't tell if she hoards all the wealth for herself, or if she tells us everything's good just to make us happy.
他们是替女王办事的人，而我已经不知道该怎么看待这件事了。我分不清她是把所有财富都据为己有，还是只是告诉我们一切都好来让我们开心。
Oh, hey again, friend. Nice to see ya!
哦，嘿，又见面了，朋友。很高兴见到你！
The train's pretty nice, isn't it? If a bit... empty.
这列车挺不错的，对吧？就是有点……空。
I do wonder what was going on with the military presence... It's not every day that you see a General, after all.
我确实很好奇军方在搞什么……毕竟可不是每天都能看到将军的。
Oh, hey, stranger. Looking for a chat? Sure, it'll help kill some time on the ride, I guess.
哦，嘿，陌生人。想聊聊？好啊，我想这能帮忙打发车上的时间。
The name's Malic, nice to meet you. I'm guessing you'll be going to the same stop as me? To {p}?
我叫 Malic，很高兴认识你。我猜你要去的站跟我一样？去 {p}？
I'm pretty excited about it. In the Roughworks, people never really get the opportunity to travel the Queen's Line. Too expensive for us, typically.
我挺兴奋的。在 Roughworks，人们几乎没有机会坐女王线。对我们来说通常太贵了。
Heh. Enough yammering from me, though. You probably have your own stuff you wanna talk about, right?
嘿。不过我也唠叨够了。你大概也有自己想聊的事吧，对吧？
...Anyway, what do you want to talk about?
It's, uh, a lot different to the trains back home. Nicer.
这个，呃，跟家乡的火车很不一样。好多了。
See, I commute to work on the Industrial Sector Loop, for which I am fortunate enough to have a free pass.
你看，我上下班坐的是工业区环线，运气好，有一张免费通行证。
The trains there are... not like this. The seats are uncomfortable, it's usually packed with people, and it's never as clean.
那里的火车……不是这样的。座位不舒服，通常挤满了人，而且从来没这么干净。
Why... Why are ours different? Why can't this quality be afforded to us..?
为什么……为什么我们的不一样？为什么我们就享受不到这种品质……？
I'm very curious about their "important matters," it's highly unusual for them to travel with this amount of urgency.
我对他们的“要事”非常好奇，他们这么急着出行非常罕见。
Typically, the military travel on their own trains, for safety and security. But for someone so important- the General of the Constables Division- to use a civilian train...
通常军方为了安全保密，都搭自己的列车。但像警备部队的将军这么重要的人物——却搭民用列车……
...the Constables Division... I'm... not fond of them, to be honest. I'm sure you've seen, but they patrol all over the Roughworks, and they're just... such bullies.
……警备部队……说实话，我……不太喜欢他们。我相信你也看到了，他们在整个 Roughworks 巡逻，而他们就是……一群恶霸。
They're always going around, roughing up people for not paying their rent, or stepping even slightly out of line...
他们总是到处跑，只要有人没付房租，或者稍微越矩一点，就把人揍一顿……
I know the General said her activities wouldn't impact the trip, but... I'm not convinced. I hope it'll be okay.
我知道将军说她的行动不会影响旅程，但是……我不太相信。希望一切顺利。
I've not spoken to anyone else on the train, but maybe I should. Could hear some interesting things about their regions.
我还没跟车上其他人说过话，不过也许我该去聊聊。说不定能听到一些他们地区的趣事。
Besides the attendant, Telati, I seem to be the only Roughworker here. To be expected, of course, since none of us can usually afford such a privilege.
除了乘务员 Telati，我好像是这里唯一的 Roughworks 人。这也难怪，毕竟我们通常负担不起这种特权。
Hm. I'll think about socializing in a little bit. But for now, I'm pretty comfortable, honestly.
嗯。社交的事我等一下再想。不过现在，说实话我挺舒服的。
Oh, hello. Looking for a conversation to pass some time? Sure thing.
哦，你好。想找人聊天打发时间？没问题。
My name is Demma, and I'm a student from the Aelumia University.
我叫 Demma，是 Aelumia 大学的学生。
I'm travelling to Auburn for my study project... I can't wait!
我要去 Auburn 做研究项目……真等不及了！
See, I'm from the Blossom House. We study biology, and one of the highlights of the course is getting to travel and do fieldwork.
你看，我是繁花学院的。我们研究生物学，而这门课最精彩的部分之一就是能出去做野外考察。
I'm conducting a study of Fruma's snails- they've always fascinated me... They come in so many different shapes and sizes...
我在研究 Fruma 的蜗牛——它们一直让我着迷……形状大小五花八门……
Auburn forest has some of the greatest... I can't wait to see a Gigastropod in person!
Auburn 森林里有一些最了不起的……我真等不及要亲眼看到 Gigastropod！
Goodness, I must stop myself before I bore you with one of my rants. I do that all too often. What do you actually want to talk about?
天哪，我得打住，免得我又滔滔不绝把你闷坏了。我太常这样了。你到底想聊什么？
...Let's move on. Anything else to discuss?
……我们换个话题吧。还有别的要讨论吗？
...Ah, sorry, I'm trailing off into tangents. Let's change topics.
……啊，抱歉，我又扯远了。我们换个话题吧。
Gah! I need to stop going into tangents. Sorry. Let's change topics.
呃！我得别再扯远了。抱歉。我们换个话题吧。
...Let's just... Move on to another subject.
Have you not heard of it? It's the most prestigious educational institution in the province!
你没听说过吗？那是全行省最负盛名的教育机构！
For those who like learning, it's the best place in the world to be... We've got a huge library with books on just about any topic you can think of!
对喜欢学习的人来说，那是世界上最好的地方……我们有一座巨大的图书馆，几乎任何你想得到的主题都有书！
You can only really study one set of topics at a time though, sadly, unless you're super dedicated.
不过可惜，一次只能真正修一组学科，除非你特别用功。
It's split into {~} different houses- Order, Crystal, Blossom, and Star- each with their own handful of subjects. I'm in Blossom, as previously stated.
它分成 {~} 个学院——秩序、水晶、繁花、星辰——每个学院各有自己的几门学科。我在繁花，刚才说过了。
I chose Blossom for the biology, specifically. We also study history and fashion, but I care less about those.
我选繁花就是为了生物学。我们也学历史和时尚，不过那些我没那么在乎。
Almost no-one has ever taken two courses at once. The only exception I can think of is Sovereign Majin, who studied in Order and Star.
几乎没有人同时修过两个学院的课程。我唯一想得到的例外是 Majin 统领，他在秩序和星辰都读过。
He really can back up his big talk, huh...
他说大话还真有本钱，嗯……
Honestly, I could care less about the culture there... It's cool and all, and learning the history of it has been fun, but...
说实话，那里的文化我倒不太在乎……很酷啦，学它的历史也挺有趣，但是……
The fauna is what I'm really interested in seeing! There's so many fascinating creatures in the region!
我真正想看的是那里的动物！那个地区有好多迷人的生物！
Snails aside, I've read so many interesting things about the region's wildlife. Elk that mimic trees, Beetles that hide amongst leaves, even fox-sized bats!
除了蜗牛，我还读过好多关于那个地区野生动物的有趣资料。会模仿树木的麋鹿、藏在树叶间的甲虫，甚至还有狐狸那么大的蝙蝠！
It's been a joy reading about it, but it'll be even more amazing to see in person!
读这些已经很开心了，亲眼看到一定会更棒！
You know, I'd love to go on a field study to the {p} too, someday. My teacher, Professor Pestal, has been there a couple times.
你知道吗，我也很想有一天去 {p} 做野外考察。我的老师 Pestal 教授去过那里几次。
Apparently, it's so dangerous in there that you need to be constantly guarded by military professionals... But it would be so cool! I'd love to see a Kivaraptor in person!
听说那里危险到你得全程有军方人员护卫……但那一定特别酷！我好想亲眼看到 Kivaraptor！
From a young age, I've always loved animals, so joining Blossom House at the university just made sense.
我从小就一直很爱动物，所以进大学选繁花学院是很自然的事。
I grew up in {p}, so I've not seen much wildlife besides the limited amount that live in the city, plus some from travelling zoos.
我在 {p} 长大，所以除了城里那少少几种动物，还有巡回动物园里的，没见过多少野生动物。
It's been wonderful having the opportunity to go out and see more of it in person. We already did a field study in the {p}, which was amazing.
能有机会出去亲眼多看看，真的太棒了。我们已经在 {p} 做过一次田野研究，太精彩了。
Professor Pestal - my teacher - has been all over the place studying the province's fauna. I'd love to be like him someday.
Pestal 教授——我的老师——为了研究行省的动物跑遍了各地。我希望有一天能像他一样。
Hey... On that note, see that girl sat over there? That's actually his daughter, Maddison. It's crazy running into her here.
嘿……说到这个，看到坐在那边的女孩了吗？她其实是他的女儿，Maddison。在这里碰到她真是太巧了。
I've spoken to her before- she's nice. Very curious, always wanted to explore the province, looks like she's finally gotten her wis-
我之前跟她说过话——她人很好。很有好奇心，一直想探索这个行省，看来她终于实现了心——
Oh, do NOT get me started on snails. I've always loved those little guys. They're so cute, and so interesting!
哦，千万“别”让我开始讲蜗牛。我一直都很爱那些小家伙。它们好可爱，又好有趣！
Did you know that they're not bugs as commonly ascribed, but rather, more related to aquatic creatures?
你知道吗，它们不是一般人以为的虫子，而是跟水生生物关系更近？
It's really fascinating! They're also so different to creatures as we tend to understand them.
真的很迷人！它们跟我们平常理解的生物也差好多。
They're hermaphrodites, which means that any two snails can breed! And, they-
它们是雌雄同体，也就是说任意两只蜗牛都能繁殖！而且，它们——
Actually, maybe that's not an appropriate topic of conversation. Well, okay, I can think of something else...
其实，也许这不是适合聊的话题。嗯，好，我可以想点别的……
Did you know they have thousands of little teeth? They also can't hear!
你知道它们有成千上万颗小牙齿吗？而且它们听不见！
Yet, despite these differences, they like, understand us! They show signs of enjoying human contact!
可是，尽管有这些差异，它们好像，能理解我们！它们会表现出喜欢跟人接触的迹象！
There's also so many different species of snail, like the one I'm studying, the Gigastropod!!!
而且蜗牛的种类也特别多，像我在研究的这种，Gigastropod！！！
Did you know that Gigastropod shells are tougher than concrete? You can stand on them and the creature will be fine!
你知道 Gigastropod 的壳比混凝土还硬吗？你可以站在上面，那个生物也不会有事！
...Though, I don't advise doing that- it's probably really scary for the poor snail.
……不过我不建议那么做——对那可怜的蜗牛来说大概很可怕。
Apparently, back in the horrible Great Auburn Flood - you know - the one that kickstarted the New Age...
听说，在当年那场可怕的 Auburn 大洪水——你知道的——就是开启新纪元的那场……
...People survived by clinging onto the Gigastropods, because despite their hardy shells, they're also bouyant!
……人们靠攀着 Gigastropod 活了下来，因为它们的壳虽然坚硬，却也能浮在水上！
Speaking of the dam, isn't it fascinating that Gigastropods are so closely related to the Murex Mollusc despite the sheer cliff between them?
说到水坝，Gigastropod 跟 Murex Mollusc 的亲缘关系这么近，中间却隔着一道陡峭的悬崖，是不是很迷人？
Don't stand on Murex Molluscs though, they're toxic! Plus, their shells aren't as strong.
不过别站在 Murex Mollusc 上面，它们有毒！而且它们的壳没那么硬。
Did you know that their slime-
OH, GOODNESS! I'm so sorry! I... I got carried away.
哦，天哪！真是非常抱歉！我……我太投入了。
I've got a really bad habit of just... infodumping. I'm so sorry.
我有个很坏的习惯，就是会……一股脑倒一堆知识出来。真的很抱歉。
Gosh, we're going to arrive in {p} soon... It's quite exciting, isn't it?
天哪，我们很快就要到 {p} 了……挺令人兴奋的，对吧？
I do wonder what was going on with the military activity back in the station... It was cool to see, but...
我确实很好奇车站那边的军方是在做什么……看起来挺酷的，但是……
I just hope it doesn't ruin our trip, somehow...
我只希望那不会不知怎么地毁了我们的旅行……
...Anyway, is there anything you'd like to talk about?
The train's really cool to ride around on. The spectacle of it hasn't worn off on me, and this is my third time experiencing it!
坐这列车真的很酷。它的新鲜感一直没退，而这已经是我第三次坐了！
In this area, I'm noticing a bunch of murals in the tunnels... It's fun to watch them, I just wish I could catch the details better.
在这一段，我注意到隧道里有好多壁画……看着很有趣，只可惜看不清细节。
Can you imagine how beautiful it would be if the train was on the surface instead of underground? You'd get some amazing views of the province, I bet...
你能想象如果列车是在地面上而不是地下，会有多美吗？我敢说一定能看到行省很壮观的景色……
I do wonder why the train only runs underground. Safety, maybe?
我确实很好奇为什么列车只在地下行驶。也许是为了安全？
Having grown up in Aelumia, I'm pretty familiar with the Guard's upper ranks. There's military parades all the time, you know!
我在 Aelumia 长大，对卫队的高层挺熟的。那里一天到晚都有阅兵，你知道吗！
That scary lady we saw back there? That was General Levi, the leader of the Constables Division.
我们刚才看到的那位吓人的女士？那是 Levi 将军，警备部队的领袖。
She took on the role a few years ago, when the previous General, General Daimyo, stepped down. She's pretty cool, it was a nice surprise seeing her here!
几年前前任将军 Daimyo 将军卸任时，她接任了这个职位。她很酷，在这里看到她真是个惊喜！
I do wonder what calls for such urgency though... Usually, she has her Commanders handle most things. For her to need to handle something personally, and on a civilian train...
不过我确实很好奇是什么事这么紧急……她通常都让手下的指挥官处理大部分事情。需要她亲自处理，而且还搭民用列车……
...Well, she did ask that we stay out of it, so I guess I shouldn't get too curious.
……嗯，她确实叫我们别插手，所以我想我不该太好奇。
I talked to a few people when I first boarded, but now I'm just going to relax. I'll probably talk to more people later when I get bored.
我刚上车的时候跟几个人聊过，不过现在我只想放松一下。等无聊了大概会再去跟更多人聊。
The first person I tried talking to was the attendant, Telati, but he seemed... stressed, so I just let him be.
我第一个试着搭话的是乘务员 Telati，不过他好像……压力很大，所以我就没打扰他。
Then... See her over there? The girl with the glasses? That's Demma, one of my dad's students. We spoke for a bit, it was nice to see her!
然后……看到那边那位了吗？戴眼镜的女孩？那是 Demma，我爸爸的学生之一。我们聊了一会儿，见到她真好！

最后，我试着跟餐车里那位衣着讲究的人搭话，但是……他说他的书正读到精彩的地方，所以我就没打扰他。

他已经又喊又哭好一阵子了。希望下面一切都好。
Ah finally! One of the air pipes has shattered, we need to patch it up ASAP!
啊，总算来了！有一根空气管道碎了，我们得尽快把它补好！
Quick, head into the room behind me and line up the white glass with the blue blocks. I'll control things from here!
快，进我后面的房间，把白色玻璃对准蓝色方块。我在这里控制！
Take a nap in the resting room.
Oh wow, thanks for the help! You should head up to the resting room and take a nap before we arrive at the first island.
噢哇，谢谢你帮忙！在我们抵达第一座岛之前，你该去休息室睡一觉。
Talk to the captain outside of the submarine.
在潜艇外面与船长交谈。
We have encountered out first island, {~}m down. Crew members, climb up the ladder and search the island for the crystal.
我们遇到了第一座岛，深度 {~} 米。各位船员，爬上梯子去岛上寻找水晶。
We've arrived at the next void island.
我们抵达下一座虚空岛屿了。
The void islands are really different from Gavel... Or are we still even in Gavel?
虚空岛屿跟 Gavel 真的很不一样……还是说我们其实已经不在 Gavel 了？
Anyway, let's explore the island, look for the crystal, and return to {p}!
总之，我们来探索这座岛，找到水晶，然后回 {p} 吧！
Explore the island and look for the crystal.
Return to the submarine and continue your journey.
回到潜艇，继续你的旅程。
Oh my, what are these creatures!?
They are attacking the windshield in the front room, it looks like it's about to break any moment!
它们在攻击前舱的挡风玻璃，看起来随时都会碎掉！
Quick, you! Come to the cockpit and press on the window to scare them off!
快，你！到驾驶舱来按住窗户，把它们吓跑！
This is not good, the creatures destroyed part of the windshield.
情况不妙，那些生物把挡风玻璃弄坏了一部分。
We can't continue much longer with a broken windshield, we'll have to repair it at another island.
挡风玻璃坏了，我们撑不了多久，得到另一座岛上修理。
Ynnos said the void has pockets of toxic gas... Go take a nap, I'll wake you up when we're there.
Ynnos 说虚空里有一团团的毒气……去睡一觉吧，到了我再叫醒你。
Meet up with the captain outside the submarine.
Attention crew. We have arrived at the second island, {~}m down. We cannot progress without making some emergency repairs.
各位船员请注意。我们抵达了第二座岛，深度 {~} 米。不进行紧急修理的话，我们无法继续前进。
Crew, please disembark and search resources to help repair the ship. We need glass and some kind of glue.
各位船员，请下船寻找能帮忙修船的材料。我们需要玻璃和某种胶。
The void creatures did heavy damage to our craft, we need to repair the submarine.
虚空生物对我们的船造成了严重损伤，我们得修好潜艇。
I'm not sure what we'll find here, but we'll need some glue and glass...
我不确定在这里能找到什么，但我们需要一些胶和玻璃……
I doubt we'll find those exact things, so get resourceful!
我想我们不太可能找到一模一样的东西，所以随机应变吧！
Bring me [{~} Sand Substitutes] and [{~} Glue Substitutes], that should be enough.
给我 [{~} 沙子替代品] 和 [{~} 胶水替代品]，应该就够了。
Find [{~} Sand] and [{~} Glue] on the void island.
在虚空岛屿上找到 [{~} 沙子] 和 [{~} 胶水]。
Ech! What is this stuff? Well, this should do the trick.
呃！这是什么玩意？嗯，这应该能用。
The mechanic and I will start repairing. It'll take a while, so enter the submarine and rest up.
机械师和我要开始修理了。这会花点时间，所以进潜艇里休息吧。
We'll continue the trip when we've repaired the ship.
等船修好了我们就继续航行。
This is the mechanic, requesting urgent assistance in the basement!
我是机械师，底舱需要紧急支援！
Toxic gas has leaked in through the submarine's vents, someone will have to manually close them.
毒气从潜艇的通风口漏进来了，得有人手动把它们关上。
I'll control things from here, someone get down to the lowest level and close those vents!
我在这里控制，快派人下到最底层去关通风口！
Attention crew. We have arrived at the next island {~}m down.
各位船员请注意。我们抵达了下一座岛，深度 {~} 米。
Disembark and start the search for the crystal.
Let's hope it's here... I don't know how much more void my body can handle.
希望它就在这里……我不知道我的身体还能承受多少虚空。
Look out! {u}, we'll build a bridge to the other island whilst you defend us from the mobs!
小心！{u}，我们来搭一座通往另一座岛的桥，你负责挡住怪物！
Keep fighting! We're almost halfway to the other side!
继续战斗！我们快搭到一半了！
Return to the submarine and continue the journey.
We didn't find the crystal here either. Maybe it just fell in the void?
这里也没找到水晶。也许它直接掉进虚空里了？
No, it must have hit an island. The scientist said he detected a collision.
不，它一定撞到了某座岛。科学家说他检测到了撞击。
The ropes are snapping! Quick! Abandon ship!
一个……人类呜呜呜！？在虚空里？
Someone dropped a boooook about you people! Warriors! Workers!
有人掉下来一本关于你们的书呜呜！战士！工人！
Ah. Yoooou want to know about this place?
啊。你呜呜想了解这个地方？
Well... We were once Villagers. I think we still are, a bit.
嗯……我们以前是村民。我想我们多少还算是吧。
For some reason, {~} years agoooo. The sky islands ruptured.
不知道为什么，{~} 年前呜呜呜。天空群岛碎裂了。
Some stayed. Others fell. We somehow survived the fall into the vooooid.
有些留了下来。其他的掉了下去。我们不知怎么的在坠入虚空呜呜时活了下来。
How we have lived for so long, I doooo not know. But one thing we know for sure. The void provides.
我们是怎么活了这么久的，我呜呜也不知道。但有一件事我们很确定。虚空会供给一切。
We are stuck here now. The void has forever changed our physiology.
我们现在被困在这里了。虚空永远改变了我们的身体。
The crystal yoooou are looking for fell on this island. But...
你呜呜在找的水晶掉在了这座岛上。可是……
We need it. It will aid us for years.
我们需要它。它能帮我们撑好多年。
We have very limited resources here. That's why a power source like this is soooo valuable.
我们这里的资源非常有限。所以像这样的能源才会这么呜呜珍贵。
If you go to the east, you will find Rontaid, our chief scientist. He'll know what to doooo.
如果你往东走，就会找到我们的首席科学家 Rontaid。他会知道该怎么办呜呜。
Talk to Rontaid outside the town at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的镇外与 Rontaid 交谈。
Well, looks like the book we found wasn't fiction after all!
嗯，看来我们找到的那本书终究不是虚构的！
This crystal is going toooo be our saviour. I was trying to create one of my own, you know.
这块水晶将会呜呜成为我们的救星。你知道吗，我本来想自己造一块。
I think I have the formula, but we don't have what we need to make it.
我想我已经有配方了，可是我们没有造它需要的材料。
Instead of taking this crystal back, why don't I exchange it for the recipe?
与其让你把这块水晶带回去，不如我用配方跟你换？
That way, you can make however many crystals youuuu want, and we can keep this one.
这样你呜呜想造多少块水晶都行，而我们也能留下这一块。
Here's the recipe, give it to a scientist or someone a bit...smarter than yourself. No offense.
配方给你，拿去给科学家或是比你……聪明一点的人吧。无意冒犯。
A platform was lowered from the surface a while ago at your crash site, as well. If youuuu wish to return, follow this path, I made a shortcut.
对了，前阵子地面上也往你们坠毁的地方放下来一座平台。如果你呜呜想回去，就沿着这条路走，我开了一条捷径。
Return to the crash site by following the road.
沿着道路回到坠毁地点。
Return to the scientist and tell him the news.
回到科学家那里，告诉他这个消息。
You survived! Where is everyone else?
I knew some must have died... But all of them?
我知道一定会有人死……可是全部？
Well... At least I don't have to pay them! Hah!
嗯……至少我不用付他们钱了！哈！
...That was heartless of me, I'm sorry. The rope we used was too weak to hold you down there.
……我这话太没良心了，对不起。我们用的绳子太弱，撑不住下到那么深的你们。
My calculations didn't account for the void's physics, it seems.
看来我的计算没有考虑到虚空的物理法则。
At least we got you back in one piece. You can tell us what happened.
至少你完好无损地回来了。你可以告诉我们发生了什么事。
Well I'll be damned. I'll start sending post down there! We can work together.
哎呀，真是见鬼了。我要开始往下面寄信了！我们可以合作。
Better to keep everything that happened here a secret. I don't want to lose what little funding I have. This recipe is genius! Here, take this, as well as your money.
这里发生的一切最好保密。我可不想失去我仅剩的那点资金。这配方真是天才！来，这个也拿去，还有你的酬劳。
It looks like everyone already went inside the submarine.
看来大家都已经进潜艇里了。
对讲机噼啪作响，传出了声音……
Looks like you managed to fix the pipe! You should tell the mechanic.
看来你修好管道了！你该去告诉机械师。
Who would've thought that the crystal fell that far...
谁想得到那块水晶会掉得那么深……
But after all, there's still a lot ahead of us!
不过话说回来，我们前面的路还长着呢！
Have you looked around for the island for the crystal yet?
你在岛上找过水晶了吗？
If you haven't found anything, jump back in the submarine and I'll take us down to the next one.
如果什么都没找到，就跳回潜艇里，我带大家下潜到下一座岛。
I've been hearing a lot of strange sounds...
我一直听到很多奇怪的声音……
Pfft. I would've done a better job saving the windshield.
哼。换我来的话，挡风玻璃肯定保得更好。
Too bad I was in another room.
可惜我当时在别的舱室。
Oh no, this isn't good. The windshield is destroyed...
噢不，这下不妙了。挡风玻璃被毁了……
I thought this trip was going to be easy.
我还以为这趟会很轻松。
This sand must've fallen from the sky islands, but why is it red?
这些沙子一定是从天空群岛上掉下来的，可为什么是红色的？
It smells really...sterile? Does this mean I have to work...?
闻起来好……无菌？这是不是代表我得干活了……？
We need this crystal. Go see Rontaid on the eastern part of the island, he can figure something out.
我们需要这块水晶。去岛的东边找 Rontaid，他能想出办法。
I hope you make use of our science.
希望你能好好利用我们的科学。
We don't want another village to fall down here... I'm not sure we could provide for even more people.
我们不希望再有另一个村子掉到这里来……我不确定我们能不能养活更多的人。
Looks like the backup team have lowered a crane down to the island, this is your way out!
看来后援小队已经把一台起重机放到岛上了，这就是你的出路！
I'm working on a replacement for the crystal now...
我现在正在做水晶的替代品……
These void villagers are rather smart, but their handwriting is utterly atrocious.
这些虚空村民挺聪明的，可他们的字迹实在是糟糕透顶。
The crystal you're looking for is purple, not blue.
你要找的水晶是紫色的，不是蓝色的。
You probably could've seen that from the other side.
你大概从另一边就能看到了。
Wait Viola, this is our chance! This stranger sure seems like they could tackle anything, even evil hermit crabs! We could just ask them to see if these rumours are true!
等等，Viola，这是我们的机会！这位陌生人看起来什么都对付得了，就算是邪恶的寄居蟹也不在话下！我们可以直接请对方去查查这些传闻是不是真的！
I don't know, you guys, all these rumours seem a little far-fetched. What next? Will he suddenly turn out to be some mad scientist?
我不知道，你们俩，这些传闻好像有点离谱。接下来呢？他突然变成一个疯狂科学家？
Let's go, I'll take you to the exit so that I don't waste your time any longer!
走吧，我带你去出口，免得再浪费你的时间！
So you must be thinking, how have you never met a fine fellow such as myself until now? To be quite honest, you must have just been terribly unlucky, I used to travel the world, you know!
所以你一定在想，怎么到现在才遇见我这样的好人？说实话，那一定是你运气太差了，你知道吗，我以前可是周游世界的！
Oh the places I've been were wonderful! From the depths of the jungle to the lesser depths of the jungle to even my back garden, I've done my fair share of exploring, if I do say so myself!
噢，我去过的地方都太美妙了！从丛林深处，到丛林没那么深的地方，甚至到我家后花园，要我说，我可是探索过不少地方！
You are the first normal person I've seen recently, {u}. I went out recently and was met with some very rude remarks by some very rude townsfolk!
你是我最近见过的第一个正常人，{u}。我前阵子出门，结果被一些很没礼貌的镇民说了一些很没礼貌的话！
The last time I visited the town it was all empty too, but I could feel people were hiding in their homes, even on such a lovely day as then. There was no one even there to hide from! Strange people.
上次我去镇上的时候也是空荡荡的，但我感觉得到大家都躲在家里，就算那天天气那么好也一样。根本没什么好躲的！怪人。
Here we are, the library! I could spend years in here, but who has time for that? I could talk about books for hours too! Here's one right now.
到了，图书馆！我可以在这里待上好几年，可谁有那个时间呢？我聊书也能聊上好几个小时！现在就有一本。
The ground is shaking... I thought that was supposed to happen later! Come back friend, I can't do this alone!
地面在震动……我还以为那应该晚点才发生！回来，朋友，我一个人办不到！
If you remember, we were talking about keeping the door shut when suddenly something heavy fell off a shelf hitting you square in the head!
你还记得的话，我们刚才在说要顶住门，结果突然有个重东西从架子上掉下来，正好砸中你的头！
During the shaking, some of my machines broke apart, but we could use these to build something capable of dropping something heavier on your head for the second time.
震动的时候，我有些机器坏掉了，不过我们可以用这些零件造个东西，能把更重的东西第二次砸到你头上。

Surely by that logic everything has to go well, you know. Now let me explain how we can do this. First, choose what part you want to use to make our machine, then choose were you want it to go and face.
照这个逻辑，一切肯定都会顺利的，你懂吧。现在我来解释怎么做。首先，选你要用来造机器的零件，然后选它要放在哪、朝哪个方向。
Quick, head through the large door and stop the cause of all that shaking!
快，穿过那扇大门，阻止这场震动的源头！
I don't know about you, Todd, but I feel we should make them our new honorary club member for finding such amazing things!
我不知道你怎么想，Todd，但我觉得我们应该让他们当我们俱乐部的荣誉会员，因为他们发现了这么了不起的事！
Ignore Viola, she's acting up today, probably because you've got the spotlight this time. However, I agree with Prentiss.
别理 Viola，她今天在闹别扭，大概是因为这次风头被你抢走了。不过，我同意 Prentiss。
Welcome you to the club, new member! Here is your shiny new badge that you can parade around town to show off how cool you are to others with style.
欢迎你加入俱乐部，新会员！这是你闪亮的新徽章，你可以戴着它在镇上神气地走来走去，让大家看看你有多酷。
You tell the group of kids your experiences of strange creatures, even stranger men as well as a hazy memory about... a coconut?
你向那群孩子讲述了你遇到的奇怪生物、更奇怪的人，还有一段模糊的记忆……关于一个椰子？
Speak with the {p} children in the treehouse.
与树屋里的 {p} 孩子们交谈。
Did ye two hear about some guy wandering around town? I've heard strange rumours about him...
你们俩听说有个家伙在镇上到处晃吗？我听到一些关于他的怪传闻……
Of course I have, he's the talk of the town! I heard he only brushes his teeth once a day and that he enjoys books about gardening!
当然听说了，全镇都在讲他！我听说他一天只刷一次牙，还喜欢看园艺书！
Oh shush you, we're not living inside some storybook! Besides, if he *was* a mad scientist, wouldn't he be trying to take over the city like all mad scientists in stories do?
噢，你闭嘴，我们又不是活在故事书里！再说，如果他*真的*是疯狂科学家，不是应该像故事里所有疯狂科学家那样想占领城市吗？
To me that doesn't sound all that strange compared to these other things I've been hearing, anyway... Something about labs and a "hermit".
反正在我看来，跟我听到的其他事比起来，那也没那么奇怪……好像跟什么实验室和“隐士”有关。
I think that's a type of crab or something. Adults are right old weirdos sometimes.
我觉得那应该是某种螃蟹吧。大人有时候真是怪人。
Hey, a stranger! How long have you been listening to us? Didn't your mom teach you any manners?
嘿，有陌生人！你偷听我们多久了？你妈妈没教过你礼貌吗？
Ignore my friends over there, they're always like that, but what Prentiss said was true. This might be our only chance to really know who this mystery man really is!
别理那边我的朋友们，他们一直都那样，不过 Prentiss 说得对。这可能是我们唯一能真正弄清楚那个神秘人是谁的机会！
It might be a good idea to look at that weird house next to those spooky ruins south-east of the city. We found this key you could try out, but if you lose it there are some spares in our base.
也许可以去看看城市东南边那片阴森废墟旁边的怪房子。我们找到了这把钥匙，你可以试试，要是弄丢了，我们基地里还有备用的。
Find the hidden door next to the gate near the Undergrowth Ruins outside {p}
在 {p} 外的灌木废墟附近，找到大门旁边的暗门
Find a way inside the house at [-{~},-{~}]
想办法进入 [-{~},-{~}] 的房子
Explore the hidden lab in search of information
探索隐秘的实验室，寻找情报
Hello stranger! Welcome to my humble wooden abode. Comfy, isn't it? I bet you'd like a cup of this coff-
你好啊，陌生人！欢迎来到我简朴的木屋。很舒服吧？我敢打赌你想来一杯这咖——
Oh yes, I am the affable Ariodo, friendly neighbourhood neighbour. What do you need me for?
哦对，我就是和蔼可亲的 Ariodo，友善的邻里好邻居。你找我有什么事？
Kidnappings? Poaching? Not brushing my teeth?! Who is this lowly person you're talking about... they don't seem like a nice fellow such as myself.
绑架？偷猎？不刷牙？！你说的是哪个卑鄙的家伙……听起来可不像我这样的好人。
This is the room you came from. I call it the "Vivarium", creative name I came up with, right? It keeps my pets that aren't quite ready.
这就是你刚才进来的房间。我叫它“饲育室”，这名字很有创意吧？里面养着我那些还没准备好的宠物。
Ready for what? Well that would ruin the surprise, wouldn't it? Can't have anyone finding out before the big event!
准备好做什么？那样就没惊喜了，不是吗？大事发生之前可不能让任何人发现！
Let us go now, time is precious.
I'm just a normal guy, so why can't anyone appreciate me for once? I'm sure you do, right?
我只是个普通人，为什么就没人能欣赏我一次呢？我相信你会的，对吧？

This is 'The Long-Winded and Painful Death of Sweeney S. Greenville' and I must say it is a hidden gem among books! One day it just suddenly appeared in here so I couldn't resist reading it. So it starts off with Sweeney S. Greenville...
这本是《Sweeney S. Greenville 冗长又痛苦的死亡》，我得说这是书中的遗珠！有一天它突然就出现在这里，我忍不住就读了。故事开头是 Sweeney S. Greenville……
We're here now! Take the exit right in front of you, don't mind the corridor to the right, it's only decoration!
我们到了！走你正前方的出口，别管右边的走廊，那只是装饰！

Maybe you can come back some day for a tea or coffee and a long talk about books, since I noticed you were very interested in my long-winded review! Have fun out there and don't forget, I'm always here for you!
也许你哪天可以回来喝杯茶或咖啡，好好聊聊书，我看得出来你对我那篇冗长的书评很感兴趣！出去玩得开心，别忘了，我永远在这里等你！
Build a machine to hit your head and get back to normal
造一台机器砸你的头，让你恢复正常
Help me keep this door shut, or else my surprise will be ruined!
帮我把这扇门顶住，不然我的惊喜就要被毁了！
Just keep to the sides, it's safer that way.
靠边站就好，那样比较安全。
Just stay here for one more momen...
Oh my, a ghost? Wait, is this just you, my trusty friend, playing a prank on me? No? Well that certainly is a problem!
天哪，鬼？等等，是你吗，我可靠的朋友，在跟我恶作剧？不是？那可真是个问题！
I think I heard something about fighting fire with fire, so I think I have a way to get you back! You are a bit too heavy for me, so we need to think of a workaround.
我好像听过以火攻火的说法，所以我想我有办法让你回来！你对我来说太重了，所以我们得想个变通的办法。
The [Cart] can carry the coconut from one end of the platform to another for a few tiles, while the [Fan] can push the coconut even further.
[推车] 可以把椰子从平台的一端运到另一端，走上几格；[风扇] 则能把椰子推得更远。

还有其他消息！据说有人看到 Majin 统领这个星期六跟一个陌生男子在一起。他们在散步，不过我们都知道那代表什么。
-up for you next time, Rose- Ah. That- I heard that was just a new servant. Nothing too important.
——下次换你，玫瑰——啊。那个——我听说那只是个新来的仆人。没什么大不了的。

嗯，反正我还是会登在《Majin 月刊》上。说不定能炒出个丑闻！……大概不行，不过谁知道呢。
Um... I actually had a question about Sovereign Majin.
呃……其实我有个关于 Majin 统领的问题。

哦，当然！我一直在关注他，所以你可以把我当成 Majin 百事通，呃……小姐……你的代号是什么来着？

哦，我的……代……号……呃。对。是——水草。那是我的名字。

……好吧。那……那不太符合我们的命名规则，不过——你知道吗，随便啦。你的问题是什么？

我……呃，我听说他从 {p} 带走了一些囚犯。
Ah! You spoiled my juicy scoop for tomorrow's edition! Yes, the rumour is true.
啊！你把我明天那期的独家爆料剧透了！对，传言是真的。

据说他把那些囚犯带到了他东边的城堡。根据另一个传言，城堡底下有座地牢。说得通——独裁者怎么会没有关异见者的地牢？
R-really? What else do you know?
真、真的吗？你还知道什么？

That there were specifically two prisoners, and, to bring it back around to Thorn Blade's news, that they're part of the {p} Terrorists! Because of that, the guard around House Thalas is particularly tight recently.
具体来说有两个囚犯，而且，回到荆棘之刃的消息，他们是 {p} 恐怖分子的一员！因此，Thalas 家族最近的守卫特别森严。

顺带一提，我本来打算把这篇卖给《Aelumia 时报》。所以，你们谁都别抢在我前面投稿。
Well, ah, I heard one of them was that runaway House Athassa girl! Remember the tabloids a few years ago? It was a whole scandal.
嗯，啊，我听说其中一个是那个离家出走的 Athassa 家族女孩！还记得几年前的小报吗？闹得满城风雨。
Goodness, Boundless Cherry's sister? I hadn't realized she was involved! Tsk, what a shame that reason doesn't run in the family.
天哪，无垠樱桃的妹妹？我都不知道她也有份！啧，可惜理智不是家族遗传啊。
What does it matter?! You never shut up about the "one that got away," and- and there's so much more important to b-
那有什么关系？！你老是说个不停那个“跑掉的那个”，而——而明明还有那么多更重要的事要——

我才没有！猩红匕首，拜托，帮我说句话——
What are we going to DO?! We just- I came here because I thought together we-
我们到底要怎么做？！我们就只是——我来这里是因为我以为大家一起——

啊！啊啊！！你们听说这次庆典没有免费赠品了吗？这简直太离谱了。
...shoot! Me and... um, Shadow Bush... forgot to turn off the stove! We'll, um, see you guys at the next meeting! May we reveal secrets buried and bring change!
……糟了！我跟……呃，暗影灌木……忘了关炉子！我们，呃，下次会议见！愿我们揭开埋藏的秘密，带来变革！

呃——是“愿我们发掘久埋的真相，带来变革……”大家老是说错——
She's going to do something! I, I know she's going to- I have to- Guys, can't you see th-
她要去做点什么了！我，我知道她要去——我得——大家，你们难道看不出——

你又不知道！要是你想劝她那么做，我们就不欢迎你来了！这件事说够了，你到底有没有什么计划？
Every time I try and think of one, I get shut down! I know I don't have much, but...but, if we work toge-
每次我想提出计划就被驳回！我知道我没什么，可是……可是，如果我们齐心协——

够了，泣血玫瑰！要是被关起来，我们就没法揭露君主统治的秘密了！而且别想说“什么秘密？”这可是大新闻！！
Speak with Sui outside the Newspaper Shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的报摊外面与 Sui 交谈。
I... wanted to stay for the whole meeting. But after that, I... I couldn't.
我……本来想待到会议结束的。可是那之后，我……我实在待不下去。
We know where they are. We know where to find them!
我们知道他们在哪里了。我们知道去哪里找他们了！
I didn't realize all their names would be so... weird and edgy. I had to come up with something! Just be glad it wasn't something worse, okay?
我没想到他们的名字全都那么……怪、那么中二。我总得想个名字吧！庆幸不是更糟的就好，好吗？

听着。我是临场想的，好吗！我只是需要个脱身的办法。
...was that really it? That's the resistance group around here...?
……那真的就是全部了？那就是这里的抵抗组织……？

他们做的就只是……只是……只是坐着，聊些鸡毛蒜皮的八卦！就好像……就好像那是世界末日一样！
An increase in bread prices...? No freebies from the festival...? Who cares?! People are... p-people are dying!!
面包涨价……？庆典没有免费赠品……？谁在乎啊？！人们……人、人们正在死去！！

而且……而且那个唯一想做点什么的人一直……一、一直被驳回……唉！我为什么会以为终、终于能有件事顺利……
Whatever. At least their gossip got us some useful leads... we- we know for sure where Rex and Zeph are!
算了。至少他们的八卦给了我们一些有用的线索……我们——我们确定 Rex 和 Zeph 在哪里了！
So... let's head to the castle, and- and take back our friends.
所以……我们去城堡，然后——然后把我们的朋友带回来。
Violent Heather mentioned, um, a dungeon. That's probably where they're being kept... I- I can get them.
狂暴石南提到，呃，有座地牢。他们大概就被关在那里……我——我可以去救他们。

可是……如果我们直接闯进去……守卫大概会多到打不完。我们需要调虎离山。
Could you... draw their attention at the front gates? I, um, I know you're strong enough for it, so... could you do that?
你能不能……在前门吸引他们的注意？我，呃，我知道你够强，所以……你能做到吗？
A-alright. Good. Good, good, good. Come on, let's save our friends!
好、好的。很好。很好，很好，很好。来吧，我们去救我们的朋友！
Well... well, too bad. I need you to do it anyway. Come on.
嗯……嗯，那真不巧。我还是需要你去做。走吧。
Head the Majin's castle to the east at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
前往东边 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Majin 城堡。
Come on, let's save our friends!
来吧，我们去救我们的朋友！
Oh, what I'd give to just... just... stick him full of spikes... ugh, but I can't.
噢，我真想……真想……把他扎满冰刺……唉，可是我不能。
I'll... search for them in the dungeons while you, um, cause a distraction.
我……去地牢找他们，你，呃，负责制造骚动。
However you... um, do that. Storm the castle, or... or whatever. Just... stay safe.
不管你……呃，怎么做。强攻城堡，或……或随便什么。只是……注意安全。

等我们完事就回王冠明珠会合。如果……如果我们其中一个没回来，那……
Okay... okay. L-let's get them back!
好……好。我、我们去把他们救回来！
Okay. Y-yeah. Just... um, hurry back here once you are.
好。对、对。只是……呃，准备好了就赶快回来。
Oh my, but if it isn't the province's most wanted criminal, striding forth into my House entirely of your own volition! Her predictions are as accurate as ever, it would seem.
哎呀，这不是全行省头号通缉犯吗，竟然完全自愿地大步走进我的宅邸！看来她的预测一如往常地精准。
Quite a foolish thing to do, if you ask me... though I do suppose you have proven yourself something of a wild card these past weeks!
要我说，这可真是愚蠢……不过我想这几个星期来，你确实证明了自己是个难以预料的变数！
But of course! We do hold the leverage here... you must have come in search of your dear imprisoned friends, haven't you?
不过当然了！筹码在我们手上……你一定是来找你那些亲爱的被囚禁的朋友吧？
What a simple lure... but effective, evidently! It has drawn you in, right where we want you.
多么简单的诱饵……不过显然很有效！把你引到了我们想要你来的地方。
Oh, really! My my, I would have never guessed - to think, holding them captive might draw you in! What an astonishing revelation.
噢，真的吗！天哪，我可从来没想到——想想看，扣着他们居然能把你引来！多么惊人的发现。

他们确实在这里。不过你见不到他们。看来有更大的计划正在进行！
Fight you?! and ruin my decor? Ha! Ahahahaha! Goodness, no, of course not. If I were, you would already be dead.
跟你打？！然后毁了我的装潢？哈！啊哈哈哈哈！天哪，不，当然不。要是我想打，你早就死了。

也许改天我会比较乐意把你打得落花流水！不过恐怕我们有正事要办。

噢，把你脸上那副阴沉的表情收起来。要是一切顺利，我们也许愿意谈谈把你那些朋友还给你！我可一点都不需要留着他们。
I mean, really, what use could I actually have had for those two? Waste my efforts pulling information out of them that I already know?
我是说，说真的，我留那两个能有什么用？浪费力气从他们嘴里撬出我早就知道的情报？
You tell her how you finally killed it. How it fought, and fought, and fought, but could not take you down. How the Light was freed from the Shadows.
你告诉她你最后是怎么杀死它的。它如何奋战、奋战、再奋战，却始终无法打倒你。光明又是如何从暗影中获得解放。
I mean, really, what use could I actually have had for those two? Waster my efforts pulling information out of them that I already know?
我是说，真的，我留着那两个能有什么用？浪费力气从他们嘴里问出我早就知道的情报？
It was pathetic, honestly. The two of them, sitting in front of me, sniveling like little babies...
说真的，太可悲了。他们两个坐在我面前，哭哭啼啼得像小宝宝……
"Spare me, great Sovereign! Spare me, great Sovereign!"
“饶了我吧，伟大的统领！饶了我吧，伟大的统领！”
As if that would save them! Ha! Hahahahahaha!
好像那样就能救他们似的！哈！哈哈哈哈哈哈！
Oh, but what does it matter? They are not important, but you... it would seem Her Majesty has taken interest in you, heavens know why.
哦，不过那有什么关系？他们不重要，可是你……看来女王陛下对你产生了兴趣，天知道为什么。

不过在那之前，既然你是 Thalas 家族的贵客……就让我带你参观一下城堡吧！

你该感到荣幸。能得到这样的专人导览，在这里可是很难得的！尽管写进你的回忆录吧……如果你有机会的话。
Oh no, dear guest, I'm afraid you are not. You do not have a choice in the matter, in fact!
哦不，亲爱的客人，恐怕你不是。事实上，这件事你没得选！
Oh, but I rather do insist! You've come this far, haven't you? And you're a guest of the House- it would be quite rude for you to decline.
噢，可我偏要坚持！你都走到这一步了，不是吗？而且你是家族的客人——拒绝的话可就太失礼了。
So come along, now. There's much to see, much to do! And we wouldn't want to keep her waiting, would we?
所以跟上吧。有好多东西要看，好多事要做！而且我们可不想让她久等，对吧？

噢，我忘了说吗？有人想见你！我们的间谍首领终于从国外回来了，她有很多话要跟你说。
Follow Majin on the tour of his castle at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
跟着 Majin 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 参观他的城堡。
Now. To begin with, to your left you'll see my personal library!
好了。首先，你左手边是我的私人图书馆！
I've amassed quite a large collection, you see. Numerous books written by famous writers from all over the province! Some of my personal work is also featured here.
你看，我收藏了相当多的书。来自全行省知名作家的无数著作！里面也有我自己的一些作品。

正前方，我们会来到我那座秘密的、其实也没那么秘密的魔法典籍与卷轴之塔。
Over the years, I've acquired much... hm, shall we say, "forbidden" literature of that variety. The Cursed simply will not stop trying, no matter how foolish the act!
这些年来，我收集了不少……嗯，可以说是那类“禁书”。受诅者就是不肯罢休，不管那有多愚蠢！
I'd say I have mastered... ah, about half of the spells and rituals featured here? It depends on your definitions- goodness knows the psionics have it rough.
我想这里面的法术和仪式我已经掌握了……啊，大约一半吧？看你怎么定义——天知道灵能者的日子可不好过。
Oh, good grief, don't play dumb. I know full well that you understand the term. You all out there in Wynn make great use of it, or so I've been told.
噢，天哪，别装傻了。我很清楚你懂这个词。据我所知，你们 Wynn 那边的人可是大量运用。
It truly is a wonder you manage to get anything done out there! Where is the control, the coordination?! No, I much prefer how we handle things here in Fruma, thank you.
你们在那边能做成任何事真是奇迹！控制在哪里，协调在哪里？！不，我还是比较喜欢我们在 Fruma 这里的做法，谢谢。
Yes, the Psionics... old history, that is. Sometime during the RA years, I believe? They had been mistaken for the cursed, and were exterminated by the crown for it.
是啊，灵能者……那是古老的历史了。我记得是 RA 年间的某个时候？他们被误认为是受诅者，因此遭到王室灭绝。
A mistake, if you ask me! Psionic abilities certainly should not be considered the same as magic, they're quite different in how they manifest... but alas, it is what it is.
要我说，那是个错误！灵能能力当然不该跟魔法混为一谈，它们显现的方式大不相同……不过唉，事已至此。
Cursed?! Ha! Oh, no no no, I was not "cursed". I believe you and I both understand the meaninglessness of that terminology, hm?
受诅者？！哈！噢，不不不，我可不是什么“受诅者”。我相信你我都明白那个称呼毫无意义，嗯？
Curses, blessings... a means of controlling the public. A rather useful one, at that - though I never did follow the rules.
诅咒、祝福……控制民众的手段。还挺好用的——不过我从来就不守规矩。

说到底，魔法不过是凌驾弱者的另一种方式……为了成就伟大而亲自追求它，不是很自然的事吗？
I don't suppose you would understand. You don't seem the type to have ever reached such heights. Regardless, let us press onward!
我想你不会明白的。你看起来不像是曾经到达过那种高度的人。不管怎样，我们继续吧！
Hm... I shall leave you to peruse my collections for the time being. The tour shall continue at the top of these stairs! Don't take too long, would you?
嗯……我暂时让你自己浏览我的收藏吧。导览会在这段楼梯顶端继续！别太久，好吗？

啊……你面前的是我的天象馆。相当了不起吧？在我钻研魔法造诣的旅途中，我对宇宙产生了浓厚的兴趣。
It was this very room in which I discovered the comet which would be named after me! Majin's Comet... this year will be the third time I see its purple shine fly through the night sky.
就是在这个房间里，我发现了那颗后来以我命名的彗星！Majin 彗星……今年将是我第三次看到它紫色的光芒划过夜空。
In truth, it fascinates me... the power and mystery lying dormant behind each and every star, just waiting to be tapped into!
说实话，它让我着迷……每一颗星星背后都潜藏着力量与奥秘，等着被汲取！
Well, I suppose it wasn't much of a surprise when that was the shape Her Majesty's blessing took on, once I received it on ascension.
嗯，所以当我在飞升时接受女王陛下的祝福，它化成了那种形态，我想也不怎么意外。
Why are you telling me this?
你为什么要告诉我这些？
As I said before, it's quite uncommon for me to personally give a tour of the castle. I take the opportunity to speak on my many accomplishments whenever I can!
我之前说过，我很少亲自带人参观城堡。我会把握每个机会谈谈我的诸多成就！
Oh, and you mean to tell me that if you had a voice like mine, you wouldn't do the very same? Ha! Perhaps someday, you'll understand.
噢，你是想告诉我，要是你有我这样的发言权，你不会做一样的事？哈！也许有一天，你会明白的。
Ah, the Sovereigns' blessings... they truly are an assorted bunch. Each taking on a distinct shape based on the person receiving it.
啊，统领们的祝福……真是五花八门。每一种都会依接受的人化成独特的形态。
I wonder, what could yours have looked like? Anything would be more interesting than that of your friend's... oh yes, "Intention." How passive, how boring.
我倒想知道，你的会是什么样子？总比你那位朋友的有意思吧……噢对，“意念”。多么被动，多么无聊。
But I suppose it's just as well, given his... shall we say, transience. Quite the mission he's signed himself up for! What a relief that I have no need to concern myself with it.
不过我想这样也好，毕竟他那……可以说是转瞬即逝吧。他替自己揽下的任务可真不简单！还好我完全不必操心那件事。
...oh, yes, this here is my hobby tower! I had it constructed - what was it, {~} years ago? - in order to store all my various projects. I'm a man of many interests, you see.
……噢，对了，这里是我的爱好之塔！我是在——多少来着，{~} 年前？——盖的，用来存放我的各种项目。你看，我兴趣广泛。
As of late, I've been experimenting with gardening, of all things. Incredibly boring, mind you - a word of advice? Don't bother. It is not worth your time.
最近，我在尝试园艺，偏偏是园艺。无聊透顶，我跟你说——给你个建议？别碰。不值得花时间。
Ah... a better view than this is hard to come by. The {p}, in all their glory! Who needs the {p} when you have this!
啊……很难找到比这更好的景色了。{p}，尽显其辉煌！有了这个，谁还需要 {p}！
不过我们到了。你好，间谍首领。
Sovereign Majin. And {u}. I've been expecting you.
Majin 统领。还有 {u}。我一直在等你们。
Talk to Sovereign Majin and the Spymaster at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Majin 统领和间谍首领交谈。
It's been a while since we've met face to face, hasn't it? And you've been busy.
我们好久没当面见了，对吧？而你一直很忙。
So in the end you made the choice to search for your answers... bold, I'll admit. You've caused quite the disruption thus far.
所以你最后选择了去寻找答案……我承认，很大胆。到目前为止你造成了相当大的混乱。

第一个明亮、耀眼、令人无法招架。另一个黑暗、阴沉、令人窒息。隔着深渊凝望，他们看见了彼此——互为镜像。

双子逐渐憎恨彼此。他们各自塑造出自己的形体，否认倒影的真相。他们试了一次又一次又一次，想挣断彼此的羁绊……

It was in that silence that War could finally sense beyond itself, could feel the world the twins had taken for granted, the beauty they had discarded in their race for victory.
就在那片寂静之中，战争终于能感知到自身之外的东西，能感受到双子视为理所当然的世界，那些他们在争夺胜利时抛弃的美好。

它冲破无尽的虚空，效法双子，强行与世界建立了自己的联系。

而它开始梦想着那份渴望本身。

一条遥远的丝线，把你系在……某样东西上。
