平台似乎在消失……你必须迅速与你的灵魂互换位置，才能抵达终点。
You must look at the mirror and wait for the platforms to appear on the other side before swapping sides...
你必须看着镜子，等对面出现平台之后，再换到另一侧……
You should try reproducing your soul's steps to find the exit...
你或许该试着重走你灵魂的足迹，来找到出口……
The floor's rising! You need to escape upwards!
地面在上升！你得往上逃！
The floor's rising! Don't let it get to you!
地面在上升！别让它追上你！
I am... you. {u}. {u}. You can hear me.
How long, now, has it been? Since they broke us in this way. Since you lost all that you were.
如今，已经过了多久？自从他们这样打碎了我们。自从你失去了你曾经的一切。
A trap. A snare. A devious thing, which claims to protect.
一个陷阱。一张罗网。一个自称守护的狡诈之物。
The soul, the mind, kept safe. All while the body falls prey to the roots and the trees and the gaze of the taken.
灵魂与心智，被妥善保管。而肉体却沦为根须、树木与被夺者目光的猎物。
We have fallen, and we cannot climb free. Not whole, not anymore. Something must be lost.
我们已经坠落，无法挣脱而出。无法完整地离开，再也不能了。总得失去些什么。
And it cannot last. And it will not last.
而它无法长久。也不会长久。
Even through the struggle, the turmoil, the loss... despite it all, you remain.
即便历经挣扎、动荡与失去……尽管如此，你依然还在。
Changed... but still, but still... yourself.
改变了……但依然，依然……是你自己。
The world. The shadows. The crown.
Was there meaning to it all? Was there purpose, reason?
这一切有意义吗？有目的，有理由吗？
Was it desperation, fear? Or was it simple routine? We cannot know.
是出于绝望，出于恐惧？还是只是例行公事？我们无从得知。
Though once, we were one... now we are split. Separate.
虽然我们曾是一体……如今却已分裂。彼此分离。
But the trap does not see it that way. And, so... a chance to break free.
但陷阱并不这么看。于是……有了挣脱的机会。
As one is ensnared, the other will have a moment, an opportunity.
当其中一个落入罗网，另一个便会有片刻的空隙，一个机会。
The snare will hold me here. And you can leave.
罗网会把我困在这里。而你可以离开。
I will be lost once more... and you will leave.
我将再次迷失……而你会离开。
You will live. You have lived, already. In my absence, you have built yourself anew.
你会活下去。你早已活过了。在我缺席的时候，你已经重新塑造了自己。
Do not mourn me. I have long been lost to you already.
不要为我哀悼。对你而言，我早已失去很久了。
Dr. Essren needs to be stopped!
一定要阻止 Essren 博士！
I was...in support of this...but then, he accrued essence of...the corruption. I had to run away...
我原本……是支持的……可后来，他收集了……腐化的精华。我只好逃了出来……
Get me... [{~} Red Mushroom], they can be found outside the east gate behind me.
帮我拿……[{~} 红色蘑菇]，在我身后东门外面就能找到。
You must...ensure that it worked. You...are much stronger than I, stranger...
你必须……确认它生效了。你……比我强多了，陌生人……
What have you done to this potion, human!? You will pay for it!
人类，你对这瓶药水做了什么？！你会付出代价的！
It's time to head back to The Assistant in {p} and show him the proof.
该回 {p} 找助手，把证据拿给他看了。
Talk to The Assistant in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
嘿嘿……陌生人。我……也许需要你帮忙……
My master...wishes to create a very dangerous potion...a transformative elixir of invincibility...
我的主人……想制作一种非常危险的药水……一种能让人变得无敌的变身灵药……
I fear...that he may be going...too far. I need your help...
我担心……他可能走得……太远了。我需要你的帮助……
I want...to stop him...but I need you to...get me the necessary ingredients... to neutralize the potion...
我想……阻止他……但我需要你……帮我拿到必要的材料……来中和那瓶药水……
Slay Mooshrooms near and bring [{~} Red Mushrooms] to The Assistant in {p}
在附近击杀哞菇，把 [{~} 红色蘑菇] 带给 {p} 的助手
Quickly, get me... [{~} Red Mushroom] as I asked... go through the {p} outside the east gate from here.
快，按我说的拿来……[{~} 红色蘑菇]……从这里出东门，穿过 {p}。
那……那些……牛。从它们身上……偷。
很好……很好。你拿到蘑菇了。
I'll... return to my master's house...and sneak the mushrooms into...his potion. Wait for me here...
我会……回主人家里……把蘑菇偷偷放进……他的药水。在这里等我……
I...have returned... He came back...just as I finished slipping the mushrooms in and...told me...to get out.
我……回来了……我刚把蘑菇放进去……他就回来了……叫我……滚出去。
Did you see the orange witch hat roofed hut when you were gathering the mushrooms?
你去采蘑菇的时候，有没有看到一间屋顶像橙色女巫帽的小屋？
That is my master's house, you...must go back out the east gate and enter the hut.
那就是我主人的家，你……得再出东门，进那间小屋。
You must...make sure...he has not managed...to become invincible... Do what has to be done....
你必须……确保……他没能……变得无敌……该做什么就做什么……
Enter the hut at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and slay Essren, and take his coat.
进入 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的小屋，杀死 Essren，拿走他的外套。
You must go back out the east gate and enter the hut, it is my master's house.
你得再出东门，进那间小屋，那是我主人的家。
Don't forget... Do what you must...
Ah, you must be the one my assistant told me about.
啊，你一定就是我助手跟我说的那个人。
If you are trying to stop me, it's too late. I already drank the pot-...
如果你是来阻止我的，那已经太迟了。我已经喝下药……
What is this taste? Mushrooms? This can't b-
这是什么味道？蘑菇？这不可——
Bring back Essren's Dusty Coat to The Assistant in {p}
把 Essren 满是灰尘的外套带回给 {p} 的助手
Don't believe...everything people tell you... If master managed to...discover invincibility... No...too...dangerous.
别相信……别人说的每一句话……要是主人真的……找到了无敌的方法……不……太……危险了。
Now. I...do not want you saying anything about...these events. Take these, and...never speak of this again.
好了。我……不希望你对……这些事说出去。拿着这些，还有……永远别再提起这件事。
这件事再也别提了……陌生人。
与 {p} 附近 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Korun 交谈。
W-Woah there, short nose! What are you doing, barging into my home?!
哇、哇哦，小鼻子！你在干什么，就这样闯进我家？！
Did {p} send you? Well, welcome to {p}! I could actually make use of some assistance.
是 {p} 派你来的吗？好吧，欢迎来到 {p}！其实我正需要一点帮助。
The magic here in this place is so potent; you can actually see the mystical properties!
这地方的魔法强到不行；你甚至能亲眼看到那些神秘的特性！
I've been a scientist for many years, but I have never seen anything like this lake.
我当了很多年科学家，但从没见过像这座湖一样的东西。
That's why I set up a small laboratory and started living here to study the place. It's pretty rudimentary but it does the job done.
所以我建了个小实验室，住在这里研究这个地方。设备很简陋，不过够用了。
The deeper into the lake you dive, the stronger the magical power becomes. I think something strange is occurring in the heart of the lake. I believe a lot of answers lie inside.
越往湖的深处潜，魔法力量就越强。我觉得湖的中心正在发生奇怪的事。我相信很多答案都在里面。
Alright, that's enough context! You see, there's another... "scientist" across the lake. We're kind of rivals? The guy's awful, I hate him, AND... Well...
好了，背景就讲到这里！是这样的，湖的另一边还有另一个……“科学家”。我们算是对手吧？那家伙糟透了，我讨厌他，而且……嗯……
And while I somewhat hope he's gotten himself in trouble, he might've figured something out about the lake.
虽然我有点希望他惹上麻烦，但他可能弄清楚了关于这座湖的什么事。
There's a note here. You start reading it...
这里有一张笔记。你开始读了起来……
IMPORTANT NOTES: The map to the talisman is in the basement!! That fool Korun will never see all this coming.
重要笔记：通往护符的地图在地下室！！Korun 那个蠢货绝对料不到这一切。
If everything goes right, it should grant access to the heart of the mountain... I can't wait!
如果一切顺利，它应该能让我进入山的中心……我等不及了！
It looks like there are extra notes on the back. What should you do?
背面好像还写着别的笔记。你该怎么做？

I needn't forget to input the total number of lit candles inside the house in order to get in the basement... That's why I made that tube! I'm so good at handling security!! No need for blasted overpriced Corkian equipment!
要进地下室，可别忘了输入屋里点着的蜡烛总数……所以我才做了那根管子！我搞安保真是太在行了！！才不需要 Corkus 那些贵得离谱的破设备！
You read what's behind the note...
你读起笔记背面的内容……
I actually don't know if I'm making it out of this, but I absolutely have to find out what's inside the lake.
其实我也不知道自己能不能活着回来，但我非得弄清楚湖里到底有什么不可。
One part of me wants to bring Korun along. As much as we hate each other, it'd surely increase our chance of survival.
我心里有一部分想把 Korun 一起带去。虽然我们互相讨厌得要命，但那肯定能提高我们活下来的机会。
And, who knows, maybe the heart of the mountain is actually perfectly safe?
而且谁知道呢，说不定山的中心其实安全得很？
Though, I mustn't forget that three of the greatest minds of our time got lost to cosmic powers...
不过我可不能忘了，我们这个时代最顶尖的三位智者，都折在了宇宙力量之下……
No matter what, if you really want to join me, I left you enough clues.
不管怎样，如果你真的想跟上来，我给你留的线索够多了。
This map seems to lead towards a particular location nearby...
这张地图似乎指向附近的某个地点……
Some mechanisms can be heard... There's probably another lever to press.
能听见一些机关运作的声音……大概还有另一根拉杆要扳。
Upon touching the crystal, you notice a peculiar device...
一碰到水晶，你就注意到一个奇特的装置……
The crystal finished forming something, you should retrieve it.
水晶凝成了某样东西，你该把它取走。
Looks like you can leave this place now.
看来你现在可以离开这里了。
I suspect he's gone in to the heart of the lake... Come with me a moment, please.
我怀疑他进了湖的中心……请跟我来一下。
Alright, this leads underwater where the heart is. How about you try and enter?
好，这里通往水下的湖心。你试着进去看看？
...just as I thought, you can't get in just like me. We'll need to gather more information.
……果然，你跟我一样进不去。我们得收集更多情报。
Human, investigate Nikoler's house for me. It's north down the coast.
人类，帮我去调查 Nikoler 的房子。沿着海岸往北走就到了。
Where could he be... There's no way he found access to- Hey!
他会在哪呢……他不可能找到进入——嘿！
Don't just listen to me mumbling! Have you found Nikoler?!
别光听我自言自语！你找到 Nikoler 了吗？！
Investigate Nikoler's house for clues at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
调查 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Nikoler 家，寻找线索。
Follow the hints in the cellar to the mysterious cave.
跟着地窖里的提示前往神秘洞窟。
Enter and explore the mysterious cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Return to Korun in his home at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Y-you've actually found a lead?! There were clues in his basement? And you found a... talisman? This must be it, then!
你、你真的找到线索了？！他的地下室里有线索？你还找到了一个……护符？那一定就是它了！
This might very well be the key to enter the heart, especially if it was as well-guarded with cosmic creatures as you say.
这很可能就是进入湖心的钥匙，尤其是如果真像你说的，那里有那么多宇宙生物把守。
Alright then! This might be too dangerous for me, so I'm entrusting this task to you once more. Enter the tunnel in my basement, and explore as much as you can!
那好吧！这对我来说可能太危险了，所以我再一次把这个任务交给你。进入我地下室的隧道，尽可能探索！
If you can bring me samples of any kind, I'll try to reward you handsomely. However, if you find Nikoler alive... Please bring him back.
如果你能带回任何样本，我会尽量重重酬谢你。不过，如果你找到还活着的 Nikoler……请把他带回来。
As for the talisman, make sure you hold it whilst in the tunnel. Be careful, you're in uncharted territory from now on.
至于护符，在隧道里一定要拿着它。小心，从现在开始你就进入未知领域了。
As Korun said, it's probably better to hold that talisman to traverse the tunnel...
就像 Korun 说的，穿过隧道时最好把那个护符拿在手上……
Good luck, human. Please bring me back Nikoler, or any sample you might find.
祝你好运，人类。请把 Nikoler 带回来，或者任何你找到的样本。
Enter the heart of Gylia from under the lake.
从湖底进入 Gylia 之心。
The drill should be ready by now... In just a little bit, I'll have single-handedly conquered the heart of the mountain...!
钻机现在应该准备好了……再过一会儿，我就能单枪匹马征服山的中心了……！
A human!? W...What? Did you read the notes I left for Korun? I'll have you know that's theft!! I - you...!
人类！？什……什么？你看了我留给 Korun 的笔记？我告诉你，那是偷窃！！我——你……！
Don't get any closer!! I'll destroy the path if I have to!!
别再靠近了！！必要的话我会毁掉这条路！！
This is MY story! Don't you dare interfere!!
这是我的故事！你休想插手！！
You're... persistent. Are you trying to steal from these meteors I'VE found?! Do you have any idea how much research I did to get this far??
你……真执着。你是想偷我找到的这些陨石吗？！你知道我做了多少研究才走到这一步吗？？
It's too late! I've already drilled a piece. Once I show Korun, I'll be known as the better researcher...
太迟了！我已经钻下来一块。等我拿给 Korun 看，大家就会知道我才是更厉害的研究者……
No no no no no no! This CAN'T be happening!
不不不不不不！这不可能发生！
Tampering with the meteors must be making the cave instable! I... I thought this'd happen and yet-
动了陨石一定让洞窟变得不稳定了！我……我早该想到会这样，可是——
This is all YOUR fault! Why'd you have to come and make me panic? We're both DOOMED!
这全是你的错！你为什么要来害我慌张？我们俩都完蛋了！
No... I can't die here, I can't die now, what will he think...
不……我不能死在这里，我不能现在死，他会怎么想……
I... We might still have a shot at escaping... And then, human, I'll report you to the authorities!!
我……我们也许还有机会逃出去……然后，人类，我要向当局告发你！！
I'm STUCK! Urgh... No... Not like this, please, not like this...
我卡住了！呃……不……不要这样，拜托，不要这样……
You... Why? You came to get me? Not the... meteors?
你……为什么？你是来救我的？不是为了……陨石？
I... Fine then. Let's make a run for it, human!
我……好吧。我们快跑吧，人类！
Rats! That dynamite went and backfired on us! Quick, try to run in to the rubble with me, we need to hurry!
可恶！那炸药反而害了我们！快，跟我一起往碎石堆里跑，我们得快点！
Welcome back! I see you're completely drenched! How did things go? I assume you've explored the place thoroughly.
欢迎回来！看来你全身都湿透了！情况怎么样？我猜你已经把那里彻底探索过了。
...were you worrying about me? What a fool. This mountain could never do so much as scratch me!
……你在担心我？真是个傻瓜。这座山连刮伤我一下都做不到！
This human right here actually saved me, right after endangering me. You don't mean to tell me you sent them for me?
这边这个人类其实救了我，就在害我陷入危险之后。你该不会是说人是你派来找我的吧？
Well, it's very simple. Where's the fun in our rivalry if you just go off and die somewhere?
嗯，很简单。要是你跑到哪里死掉了，我们的竞争还有什么意思？
That aside, what did you find in there? What happened?
先不说这个，你在里面发现了什么？发生了什么事？
I found them, Korun. I found the meteors! They still seemed potent somehow, but the cave collapsed and...
我找到了，Korun。我找到那些陨石了！它们似乎还有某种强大的力量，可是洞窟塌了，然后……
That's... fine. We can always go back and try clearing the rubble. There's always opportunities to take a hold of. Next time, please don't just go off on your own!
那……没关系。我们随时可以回去试着清理碎石。机会总是有的。下次，请不要再一个人跑去了！
Human, you made the right choice... Without Nikoler, our efforts would have been in vain. I'll try to work with him a bit more, as it seems like the logical course of action now. Thank you.
人类，你做了正确的选择……没有 Nikoler，我们的努力就会白费。我会试着多跟他合作，现在看来这是合理的做法。谢谢你。
I see you're completely drenched! There's this odd aura around you... What happened?
看来你全身都湿透了！你身上有种奇怪的气息……发生了什么事？
You... You actually found a meteor shard! That's amazing! That's... that's... um...
你……你真的找到陨石碎片了！太棒了！那真是……真是……呃……
Uh, what did you say j-just now? The cave collapsed and Nikoler d-died...?
呃，你刚、刚才说什么？洞窟塌了，Nikoler 死、死了……？
That's, um, haha... That doesn't sound right, he can't die, he can't leave like that, he can't-
那，呃，哈哈……这说不通啊，他不可能死，他不可能就这样离开，他不可能——
S-Sorry. I'm just a little shocked is all. I do have to thank you for the shard...
对、对不起。我只是有点震惊而已。我确实得谢谢你带回碎片……
A-at the very least, you saw this through... I have to commend you for that... I think.
至、至少，你坚持到了最后……这点我得称赞你……大概吧。
Just take these, and go. I have much to think about.
拿着这些，走吧。我有很多事要想。
You explored thoroughly, and couldn't find a shard? Well, we still have much to discover I suppose.
你彻底探索过了，却没找到碎片？好吧，我想我们还有很多要发现的。
Uh, what did you say j-just now? The cave collapsed and Nikoler d-died..?
呃，你刚、刚才说什么？洞窟塌了，Nikoler 死、死了……？
S-Sorry. I'm just a little shocked is all. And you came back empty-handed... This was just a loss with everyone involved.
对、对不起。我只是有点震惊而已。而且你还空手回来……这件事对每个人来说都是一场损失。
I see you're completely drenched, so I suppose you thoroughly explored the place. How did it go?
看来你全身都湿透了，所以我猜你把那里彻底探索过了。情况怎么样？
You found... Nothing? Really? And the meteors were too unstable to temper with?
你什么都……没找到？真的？而且那些陨石太不稳定，没法动？
Actually, how would you know about tempering with the- wait...
话说回来，你怎么会知道动那些——等一下……
Did you find him? Please... please tell me you found him, there's no way he'd die just like that. I...
你找到他了吗？拜托……拜托告诉我你找到他了，他不可能就这样死掉。我……
W-what? The whole cave COLLAPSED on him? And you couldn't even save him?! N-no, it can't be your fault, I... I'm sorry.
什、什么？整个洞窟塌在他身上？你连救都救不了他？！不、不，这不能怪你，我……对不起。
This is all way too much to take in for me, but I suppose you've explored and served the purpose I gave you.
这一切对我来说太难接受了，不过我想你已经探索过，完成了我交给你的任务。
Here's your reward, then. Now please, just leave me be. There's a lot I have to think about.
那这是你的报酬。现在请你让我一个人静一静吧。我有很多事要想。
It's you! Glad to have crossed paths again!
是你！真高兴又碰到你了！
Since the incident, I've decided to start fishing as a hobby.
出了那件事之后，我决定开始把钓鱼当爱好。
Take this- for all I care, you can own this!
拿着这个——我无所谓，你拿去吧！
Check up on Korun from time to time for me, will you?
替我时不时去看看 Korun，好吗？
I'm still taking a break from all the science stuff... But he definitely hasn't seen the last of me!
我还在从那些科学的事情里休息……但他绝对还没见识完我的厉害！
After all, I'm the one who got to the heart of the mountain! I'm even able to sleep soundly knowing that I've won...
毕竟，到达山的中心的人是我！一想到我赢了，我连觉都睡得香……
Mel and Lanu, you'll be in E{~}.
Mel 和 Lanu，你们住 E{~}。
Room W{~}... Now get going. I have a lot of rooms to assign...
W{~} 号房……好了快走吧。我还有一大堆房间要分……
I need to tell you s-
Tasim is looking to catch up in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Tasim 想在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 跟你叙叙旧。
{u}! Hey! It's lucky I managed to catch you here.
It's been a while, hasn't it? We should catch up! You've probably had lots of adventures, right?
好久不见了，对吧？我们该好好叙叙旧！你大概经历了很多冒险吧？
But before that... I've got to just find...
不过在那之前……我得先找到……
Huh? What am I- oh, yeah. I'm trying to find Aledar.
嗯？我在干什么——哦，对。我在找 Aledar。
He sent me a letter asking me to join him on some... scouting mission. But I haven't been able to find him.
他寄了封信给我，要我跟他去执行某个……侦察任务。但我一直没找到他。
It did take me a while to get here... so maybe he's gone somewhere else by now. Aegis did tell me the mission ended up being called off, so...
我确实花了好一阵子才赶到这里……所以他现在也许已经去别处了。Aegis 也跟我说，那个任务最后取消了，所以……
But if he's not here, then I should probably stop trying to catch him on the streets, huh? I'll just leave a message for him at the barracks.
不过既然他不在这里，我大概也别再在街上到处堵他了，是吧？我就在营房给他留个话。

We can head to the tavern and catch up! Gods, I've missed the Rusty Recruit's drinks... that barkeeper, he says it's the same as anywhere else, but it really isn't! Nowhere else pours it like he does.
我们可以去酒馆叙叙旧！天哪，我好想念 Rusty Recruit 的酒……那个酒保老说跟别家没两样，才怪！没有人倒得出他那个味道。
He... doesn't know about Aledar, does he?
他……还不知道 Aledar 的事，对吧？
He just got back. You can't... tell him now. You'll do it later, once he's settled in.
他才刚回来。你现在不能……告诉他。等他安顿下来，你再说吧。
...he doesn't know. You have to break the news to him.
……他还不知道。你得把消息告诉他。
Pardon me, excuse me- coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
抱歉借过，借过一下！借过！啊，你们两位！我正要找你们。
Pardon me, excuse me coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
借过借过，让一让！让一让！啊，你们两个！正是我要找的人。
Well, perhaps not specifically. I've got a list of folks to try and track down, and the two of you are on it! Tasim and {u}, right?
嗯，也许不算特地。我有张名单，要把上面的人一个个找出来，你们两个都在上面！Tasim 和 {u}，没错吧？
I've got an important missive from {p}. Direct from the King himself, yep yep!
我带来了 {p} 的一份重要公函。是国王亲自发的，没错没错！
Really? I don't think I've even seen him since... what could he possibly want us for?
真的？我好像从……之后就没见过他了。他会找我们做什么？
I'm not privy to the details, I'm afraid! He's summoning a number of you seasoned adventurers to the castle, for some sort of meeting.
恐怕我不清楚细节！他召集了好几位像你们这样身经百战的冒险者到城堡，要开个什么会。
Anyway, I've got more to try and track down, so I'll give you the written letters and be on my way! Best of luck with whatever it is!
总之，我还有其他人要找，就把书面信件交给你们，我先走了！不管是什么事，祝你们好运！
Hm. That is strange, isn't it? I guess we'll have to call off drinks till later... probably for the best. Maybe I'll be able to catch him before...
嗯。确实很奇怪，对吧？看来喝酒只能改天了……也许这样最好。说不定我还能在……之前找到他。
Oh, uh- you go on ahead. I have to stop by the barracks first. I'll meet you in {p}, then?
哦，呃，你先去吧。我得先去营房一趟。那我们在 {p} 碰头？
I'll meet you in {p}. I have to deal with some things at the barracks first.
我们在 {p} 碰头。我得先去营房处理些事。
Attend the meeting with the King in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 参加国王召开的会议。
...oh, there you are. Didn't you head out before me?
……哦，你在这儿。你不是比我先出发吗？
I don't know most of the people here, so I'll stick with you for now.
这里的人我大多不认识，所以我先跟着你。
...and it's all crashing down, right? So I knock the zombie back, grab the kid, and jump for-
……然后整个都塌下来了，对吧？所以我把僵尸击退，抓住那孩子，然后跳向——
Wait, wait wait wait - you're tellin' me there was a kid involved? And you still set off the bombs?!
等等，等等等等，你是说那里还有个孩子？结果你还是引爆了炸弹？！
Yeah! I said that already, right? That was the whole reason I-
对啊！我刚才就说过了，不是吗？那正是我——
Ahem. Pause the story for a bit, Linton. We have company.
咳咳。故事先停一下，Linton。有人来了。
Well, if it ain't {u}! It's good to see someone else familiar 'round here.
这不是 {u} 吗！在这儿看到别的熟面孔真好。
I do try to keep my distance.
我是尽量跟你保持距离。
So, you received the summons too? The King has a lot of people here. It's interesting.
所以你们也收到召集令了？国王找来了很多人。挺有意思的。
We did, yes. And it sounded like they had even more people on that list that they were searching for.
是的，我们收到了。而且听起来，他们名单上还有更多人在找。
Oh, apologies, I hadn't noticed you there. You're a friend of {u}'s, I take it?
哦，抱歉，我刚才没注意到你。我猜你是 {u} 的朋友？
I am! We arrived in Wynn on the same caravan. I'm Tasim.
是的！我们是跟着同一支商队来到 Wynn 的。我叫 Tasim。
So you're the one Aledar was always talking about! I thought you were off in Gavel?
原来你就是 Aledar 老挂在嘴边的那个人！我还以为你去 Gavel 了？
I... was. How do you all know him?
我……之前是。你们怎么都认识他？
I believe we first met on a mission to reclaim {p}'s barracks from a treasonous commander. We've run into each other a few times since.
我记得我们第一次见面，是在一次从叛变的指挥官手中夺回 {p} 营房的任务上。之后我们又碰过几次面。
Still, it's good to finally get t' meet you! We've heard lots of stories! Including somethin' about not respondin' to letters...?
总之，终于见到你真好！我们听过好多故事！包括什么不回信的事……？
Oh... right. We, uh... sorted that out.
哦……对。我们，呃……那件事已经说开了。
But speaking of- have any of you seen him recently?
不过说到这个——你们最近有人见过他吗？
'fraid not. I don't think our paths've crossed since... was it the siege at {p}? Must've been.
恐怕没有。我想我们上次碰面是在……{p} 的围城战？应该是。
I saw him a month ago in {p}! I asked him what he was working on and if I could help and he just brushed me off. Weird, right?
我一个月前在 {p} 见过他！我问他在忙什么、要不要帮忙，结果他直接把我打发走了。很怪吧？
Mmn. No, that sounds like him. I think he had enough of your antics last time.
嗯。不，这很像他的作风。我看他上次已经受够你的胡闹了。
What?! I'm capable. C'mon, Mel, tell her I'm capable.
什么？！我很能干的。拜托，Mel，跟她说我很能干。
Linton, y'were just tellin' us about how you caved in a whole temple by-
Linton，你刚才还在跟我们讲你是怎么把整座神殿弄塌的，靠的是——
Okay! Okay, okay okay, let's talk about literally anything else! Tasim, right? What's... uh...
好啦！好啦好啦好啦，我们随便聊点别的吧！Tasim，对吧？你……呃……
...so, your... no, no, give me a moment- you were... and... um... oh, right...
……所以，你的……不，不，等我一下，你是……还有……嗯……哦，对了……
Linton!! Y'can't just ask someone that!!
Linton！！你不能随便问人家这种事！！
It was nice meeting you, Tasim. I look forward to working with you during this mission.
很高兴认识你，Tasim。期待这次任务能跟你合作。
...likewise. It's always nice meeting friends of Aledar.
……彼此彼此。能认识 Aledar 的朋友总是件好事。
Well, look at you! It's been quite a time since we last spoke. Far above the task of cleaning out sewers now, eh?
哎呀，瞧瞧你！咱们上次说话已经是好久以前的事了。现在可比清理下水道的活儿高出不少了吧？
I've heard some tell of your accomplishments. Fine work, fine work.
我听人说过你的事迹。干得好，干得好。
And... hm. Aren't you the one who ran off to Gavel without sayin' a word? Didn't expect you to be one o' the ones picked out for this.
还有……嗯。你不就是那个一声不吭跑去 Gavel 的人吗？没想到你也会被挑中来做这件事。
I... didn't expect it either. I didn't even realize the King still remembered me, truth be told.
我……也没想到。说实话，我连国王还记得我都没想到。
Mmn. Well, whatever the reason, you're here now. Don't suppose it matters much the path you took to get here. We need all the folks we can get- or so Kymer's been sayin'.
嗯。好吧，不管是什么原因，你现在人在这儿。你是怎么走到这里的，我想也不怎么重要。我们需要所有能找到的人——至少 Kymer 是这么说的。
Well well! If my eyes don't deceive me! {u} and Tasim!
哎呀哎呀！要是我没看错的话！是 {u} 和 Tasim！
I'll say, I didn't quite expect them to track you down! What with your... extended stint off in Gavel.
说真的，我没想到他们能把你找回来！毕竟你……在 Gavel 待了那么久。
I should say the same about you, captain. Did {p} no longer have a use for you once the war ended?
我也想这么说你呢，队长。战争结束后，{p} 就用不上你了吗？
Ah... nothing of the sort. You know, I was sent out there initially to serve as more of an envoy from {p}! If the King needs a diplomatic situation sorted, I'm the one he turns to first.
啊……完全不是那么回事。你知道吗，我当初被派到那边，主要是作为 {p} 的使节！国王要是需要处理外交问题，第一个找的就是我。
Which... is indeed why I am here now. I was recalled rather abruptly several weeks ago. It seems we've encountered a tricky situation with our... neighboring province.
这……也正是我现在在这里的原因。几个星期前，我被相当突然地召回。看来我们和……邻近的行省之间遇上了棘手的状况。
But! I shan't say more before the King arrives. He'll tell you all of the problem that hopefully we will be able to resolve.
不过！国王到来之前我就不多说了。他会把问题告诉大家，希望我们能把它解决。
...I see. We'll leave you to it, then.
……我明白了。那我们就不打扰你了。
If we align the manaflow with Water, then nudge it to the side, maybe... ah- Reynauld, pass me my notes on... damn, what was it- oh, yes, the recovery period! Pass me those ones.
如果我们让法力流与水属性对齐，再往旁边推一点，也许……啊 Reynauld，把我关于……该死，是什么来着——哦，对，恢复期！把那些笔记递给我。
...You already have them on your left, doctor.
Do I now! It seems I do... oh, but this is only the first half- where did I leave the rest...
是吗！好像是……哦，可这只有前半部分——剩下的我放哪去了……
Sigh... If you'd just allow me to organize for you, maybe you wouldn't-
唉……要是你肯让我帮你整理，也许你就不会——
And ruin my predefined sorting system?! No, Reynauld, I do think it works perfectly well as it is, thank you very much! Now, where could it have-
然后毁掉我预先定好的分类系统？！不，Reynauld，我认为它现在这样就运作得非常好，多谢你了！好了，到底放到哪——
Ah! You two! Good, good, you're here- I was worried Reynauld would be the only other one with recovered memories around here!
啊！你们两个！很好，很好，你们来了——我还担心这里除了 Reynauld 就没有别人恢复了记忆！
What, you didn't test it on anyone else after we left?
怎么，我们走了之后你都没在别人身上试过？
Test it on- no, of course not! After what I saw? No, no, that would certainly not have been worth the risk. No new test subjects until I am certain it's flawless!
在别人身上试——当然没有！在我看到那种情况之后？不，不，那肯定不值得冒险。在我确定它万无一失之前，不找新的受试者！
I've been using it on myself instead! And, let me tell you- the breakthroughs I have made... there is much to be learned.
我改在自己身上用！而且，我跟你说——我取得的突破……还有好多东西值得研究。
Pah! "Safety" - a meaningless term made only to stifle progress. Have there been side effects - certainly! But it has all been worth it.
呸！“安全”——一个毫无意义、只会扼杀进步的词。有没有副作用——当然有！但一切都值得。
Now, I must return to the pages... I've some equations I need to perfect before the King arrives...
好了，我得回去看我的稿子……国王到来之前，我还有几道方程得完善……
Hm. I can't say I would have expected you to be here, Tasim.
嗯。说实话，我没想到你会在这里，Tasim。
Well... fate has other plans, I guess. How about you? Did you stay in {p}?
嗯……我想命运另有安排吧。你呢？你一直留在 {p} 吗？
Mostly. Moved around for a few assignments here and there, but I kept coming back.
大部分时间是。有几次任务调到各处，但我总会回来。
...we haven't spoken in a while. Are you... doing well? How have you been managing the memories?
……我们好久没说话了。你……还好吗？那些记忆你是怎么面对的？
As well as I could be expected to, I guess. It was rough for the first few months. Eventually, I got used to it.
大概就像预料中那样吧。头几个月很难熬。后来也就习惯了。
How about you? I also wouldn't have expected you to show for a mission like this.
你呢？我也没想到你会来参加这种任务。
Same as you. Helped that Caid and I managed to talk it through. We meet every so often, talk about it. He talks about his sister, how he wants to find her one day.
跟你一样。幸好我和 Caid 能好好谈过。我们时不时见个面，聊聊这件事。他会说起他的妹妹，说总有一天想找到她。
Hm. Nothing stopping you from stopping by, yourself. It might even help you.
嗯。没人拦着你也来坐坐。说不定对你也有帮助。
I'll... consider it. Good to see you again, Reynauld.
我……会考虑的。很高兴再见到你，Reynauld。
Another soldier? Allow me to see your summons.
又一位士兵？请出示你的召集令。
...good. Come on in, {u}. The King will be arriving shortly.
If you insist. Don't take too long.
既然你坚持。别耽搁太久。
Ah... here we are. I thank you all for coming on such short notice. It has been some time since I have seen many of you.
啊……都到了。感谢各位在这么短的时间内赶来。你们之中许多人，我已经很久没见了。
...I'll get right to the point. We find ourselves in a very delicate position when it comes to our relations with our neighboring province, Fruma.
……我就直说了。在与邻近行省 Fruma 的关系上，我们正处于极其微妙的位置。
Good. I guess that makes two of us.
很好。看来我们两个想的一样。
It sounds very suspicious. Why the sudden interest? Why now?
这听起来非常可疑。为什么突然感兴趣？为什么偏偏是现在？
We rely heavily on the flow of new recruits sent to us, but we have no means of contacting their province. Only they may reach out to us, and only once before have they chosen to do so.
我们非常依赖他们持续送来的新兵，但我们没有任何办法联系他们的行省。只有他们能主动联系我们，而他们以前也只这么做过一次。
...several weeks ago, we received a cloaked visitor through the outskirts. She claimed to be of Fruma, one of their Sovereigns.
……几个星期前，有一位披着斗篷的访客从边境来到这里。她自称来自 Fruma，是他们的统领之一。
We were extended an invitation, of sorts. Of all the recruits we have ever received, we were to select the greatest, and send them into Fruma for some sort of celebration.
我们收到了一份邀请，算是吧。要我们从所有接收过的新兵之中，挑选出最优秀的，送进 Fruma 参加某种庆典。
Is that who we are? The greatest?
The ones that could be reached, at the very least! Perhaps some were greater yet, but we all know the roaming habits of your sort, and tracking them down really can prove-
至少是找得到的那些！也许还有更优秀的，不过我们都知道你们这类人到处漂泊的习性，要把他们找出来实在是——
Ugh, we're not just going along with this, are we?
唉，我们不会真的要照办吧？
What? They're demanding something weird and obviously suspicious, so why should we just accept it?
怎么了？他们提出的要求这么怪、明摆着有问题，我们凭什么就这样接受？
I'm afraid we don't have a choice in the matter. As I mentioned, the recruits we receive make all the difference in our province's continued survival. If we were to reject this invitation...
恐怕我们在这件事上别无选择。我说过，我们接收的新兵对行省能否延续下去至关重要。如果我们拒绝这份邀请……
...who's to say they wouldn't just stop sendin' 'em, eh? Tough.
……谁敢说他们不会干脆不再送人来，嗯？难办啊。
Besides all that, think of the opportunity this presents! A true, freely-given view of what lies beyond those walls! We'd be fools not to accept it, no matter the implied threat!
何况，想想这带来的机会！一个真正、自愿开放的机会，让我们看看那些城墙后面是什么！不管有什么暗中的威胁，不接受才是傻子！
Indeed. I regret that I must request this of you... but there is no other choice. You must accept this invitation.
正是如此。我很遗憾必须向你们提出这个请求……但别无他法。你们必须接受这份邀请。
...even those of us with bad experiences with the province?
……就连我们这些在那个行省有过不好经历的人也是？
I apologize... but you must. My hands are tied.
我很抱歉……但你们必须去。我也无能为力。
I take it we are expected to gather as much intelligence on Fruma as we can while we're in there?
我想，我们在那里的时候，应该要尽可能多收集 Fruma 的情报吧？
That is the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
正是这个打算！细节等我们到了那边再说明，不过我们应该有时间限制，对吧？
That's the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
正是这个计划！到了那里我再详细说明，不过我们应该有时间限制，对吧？
You are correct, doctor. I have been told that a representative will greet you all at the royal gates of Fruma, situated on the western coast.
没错，博士。我得到的消息是，会有一位代表在 Fruma 的皇家城门迎接各位，地点在西岸。
I've sent a courier ahead to {p} to inform the local captains of the destination they are to take you to.
我已经先派了一名信使去 {p}，通知当地的船长要把你们送到哪里。
{p}... I know a captain there. {u}, want to join me?
{p}……我在那里认识一位船长。{u}，要跟我一起去吗？
Finally... a glimpse at the province's inner workings... how long have I been seeking these answers?
终于……能一窥那个行省的内部运作了……我追寻这些答案多久了？
So many theories... how many will be proven right? How many will be wrong? I cannot wait to find out!
那么多理论……会有多少被证明是对的？又会有多少是错的？我等不及要知道了！
Sigh... I did know this was coming. Why else would the doctor have been summoned? But I hoped I was wrong.
唉……我早就知道会这样。不然为什么要召集博士？但我还是希望是我想错了。
Tough situation, isn't it? Lots o' secrecy on part of the Frumans...
情况棘手，是吧？Fruma 人藏着一大堆秘密……
But we'll handle it. Everyone here's plenty capable, after all.
不过我们应付得来。毕竟这里每个人都很有本事。
Hm... what a situation it is we find ourselves in! Diplomacy is my specialty, of course, but my expertise has not prepared me for... this.
嗯……我们陷入的这是什么处境啊！外交当然是我的强项，但我的专长可没让我为……这种事做好准备。
Fruma knows what they want, and know they are strong enough that they can afford not to let up their position.
Fruma 很清楚自己想要什么，也知道自己够强，完全可以不让步。
Another top secret mission already? And I'm not even allowed to bring my explosives?
又是一个绝密任务？而且我连炸药都不能带？
It's interesting, at least! Way better than that last assignment...
至少挺有意思的！比上一次的任务好太多了……
This mission's a big deal, huh? Lots o' strong folks recalled for it, at least.
这次任务很重要，是吧？至少召回了好多厉害的人。
Makes me a bit nervous, honestly!
老实说，搞得我有点紧张！
Fruma... I can't say it's been on my mind much. It's a mystery, yes, but not one with any available answers.
Fruma……我不能说我常想到它。它确实是个谜，但不是一个有答案可找的谜。
Well, until now, I suppose. I'll have to prepare a list of details to look out for...
嗯，我想直到现在为止是这样。我得准备一张清单，列出要留意的细节……
And yet again, I must send you all into danger... a different sort, this time around, but danger nonetheless.
又一次，我不得不把你们所有人送进危险之中……这次是另一种危险，但终究是危险。
I remember each face which passes through my castle. I rarely see any of them again.
每一张经过我城堡的面孔，我都记得。但我很少能再见到他们。
But this time... I have faith we will meet once more. Go on, young hero. Your mission lies ahead of you.
但这一次……我相信我们会再见面的。去吧，年轻的英雄。你的任务就在前方。
...back to Fruma. I've only just come back to Wynn, and now...
……回到 Fruma。我才刚回到 Wynn，现在又……
But it had to happen eventually. And I do want answers. So... in we go.

We've made it this far, but we'll need to plan our next steps. Firstly, however- let us start with what information we have gleaned thus far.
我们已经走到这一步，但得计划下一步了。不过首先——我们先从目前收集到的情报说起。
Well, the crown certainly has money to spare! What we've seen thus far seems to rival even the richest of the nobility I had the pleasure of working with in {p}.
嗯，王室肯定是钱多得花不完！我们目前看到的，简直能跟我在 {p} 有幸共事过的最富有的贵族相媲美。
And the architectural style... it's unique. I haven't seen anything like it before. I suppose it would make sense, if the province has been closed off so long...
还有那种建筑风格……很独特。我从来没见过类似的。我想这也说得通，毕竟这个行省封闭了那么久……
Eh, enough of the unimportant details - any of the rest o' you feelin' strange about the tournament? Seems an odd thing to invite us folks back for.
嗯，不重要的细节就说到这——你们其他人有没有觉得这场锦标赛怪怪的？为这个把我们这些人叫回来，未免太奇怪了。
I was thinking the same thing. And they're willing to pay all of us for participating, no matter how we do... I don't get why.
我也是这么想的。而且不管我们表现如何，他们都愿意付钱给所有参赛者……我不明白为什么。
Hm, well, in truth I am not overly concerned about it-
嗯，好吧，说实话我倒不是太担心这件事——
Yes, actually, Picard, what was that back there in the dining hall? You're going to draw attention to yourself by opting out of it?
对了，说真的，Picard，刚才在宴会厅那是怎么回事？你选择不参加，会引人注意的吧？
Oh, what use is there in placing me in such a combat scenario?! I'll be far more useful outside of that structure, free to look around the palace.
哦，把我放进那种战斗场面有什么用？！在那之外，我能在皇宫里自由四处看看，会有用得多。
And besides, they have me giving them a summary of my research notes, so it's not as though I'm free of it entirely, not to mention-
而且，他们要我给他们一份研究笔记的摘要，所以我也不是完全不用干活，更别提——
Alright, settle down y'all! Limited time, remember? We've gone off track. They're rich, fancy, and want us fightin' for some reason. What else?
好了，大家冷静点！时间有限，记得吗？我们扯远了。他们有钱、讲究，还出于某种原因想让我们打架。还有呢？
...as I was saying before I was rudely interrupted- I don't believe there is much to be gleaned from the tournament just yet. It's a puzzle piece we'll have to connect later.
……就像我被粗鲁打断之前说的——我认为目前从锦标赛里还看不出什么。那是块拼图，我们得以后再拼起来。
Do we have anything on the Queen and her Sovereigns? It's an interesting governmental structure, but I suppose having a more direct line to the Queen has value for the districts.
我们有关于女王和她那些统领的情报吗？这种政府结构很有意思，不过我想，能更直接地通达女王，对各区来说是有好处的。
Well, they're obviously putting on an act. They're definitely hiding something from us, and I don't think any of them are as happy to see us as they say they are.
嗯，他们显然是在演戏。他们肯定对我们隐瞒了什么，而且我不认为他们有嘴上说的那么高兴见到我们。
Yes, indeed... we were sent into Wynn as exiles, not as honored soldiers. So why are they pretending otherwise? They called us back here.
是啊，的确……我们是作为流放者被送到 Wynn 的，而不是作为光荣的士兵。那他们为什么要装作不是这样？是他们把我们叫回来的。
Ah! Perhaps they're unaware that we've cracked that memory spell? For all they know, we still believe their lies.
啊！也许他们不知道我们已经破解了那个记忆咒术？在他们看来，我们还相信他们的谎言。
It'd explain some things, for certain...
So, am I the only one confused by the amount of guards around?
所以只有我对这附近守卫的数量感到困惑吗？
You'd think that nine strangers entering the royal palace would be under more watchful eyes.
照理说，九个陌生人进入皇宫，应该会被盯得更紧才对。
Now that you mention it... the only guards I saw on the way to our rooms were by the courtyard exit. There aren't any outside our rooms.
你这么一说……我在去房间的路上，只在庭院出口看到守卫。我们房间外面一个都没有。
...so we don't need to do the whole stealthy thing?
……所以我们不用搞那套偷偷摸摸的东西了？
Seems likely to me they want us t' feel safe and trusted. They've got to know we'll be talkin' about everything we see, so why not leave a good impression, eh?
看来他们是想让我们觉得安全、受到信任。他们肯定知道我们会把看到的一切都说出去，那何不留个好印象，是吧？
A strong spell should get through this wood without a problem.
用强一点的法术，应该能轻松打穿这块木头。
Besides, they've got those two Sovereigns lookin' over us. Pretty strong, aren't they? Figure that's enough incentive not to cause trouble.
再说，他们有那两位统领盯着我们。挺厉害的，不是吗？我想这就足以让人不敢惹事了。
Speakin' of the Sovereigns... and the guards, by extension - anyone else adept at readin' mana? It hardly feels like there's any of it in use at all!
说到统领……连带那些守卫——还有谁擅长感知法力的？感觉这里几乎没有人在用法力！
I was going to bring that up. I haven't seen any mages at all. The closest I've seen is the higher ranked soldiers wielding magical weapons.
我正想提这件事。我一个法师都没见到。最接近的，是那些持有魔法武器的高阶士兵。
I'm not as good with reading mana, but... there's something with the Sovereigns. They've got an incredibly powerful aura surrounding them. It feels... unnatural.
我不太擅长感知法力，但……那些统领身上有些什么。他们周围环绕着一股极其强大的气场。感觉……很不自然。
Yes, you're right. They, and the Queen, are the only ones I've seen here who possess innate magical abilities. If anything, all three of them seem closely linked in terms of energy...
对，你说得没错。他们和女王，是我在这里见过唯一拥有天生魔法能力的人。要说的话，他们三个在能量上似乎紧密相连……
As interesting as that is, it doesn't leave much for the rest of us to go off of. Doctor, you're the one who organized us here. What are our plans?
这确实很有意思，但对我们其他人来说没多少线索可循。博士，是你把我们组织起来的。我们的计划是什么？

Yes, that I am... well, it seems our most promising lead is the Sovereigns. We'll want to focus on them- though, do not neglect general information. We still want to know as much about Fruma as possible.
是，正是我……嗯，看来我们最有希望的线索就是那几位统领。我们要把重心放在他们身上，不过，一般情报也别忽略。我们还是想尽可能多了解 Fruma。
We've been running long enough, let's call it a day. Everyone, get some rest, we must be at our best performance tomorrow.
我们已经谈得够久了，今天就到这里吧。大家都去休息，明天我们必须拿出最好的状态。
Let us gather here again tomorrow evening for another meeting. Goodnight, everyone.
明天傍晚我们再到这里集合开一次会。晚安，各位。
Make your way back to W-{~} and sleep.
Those Sovereigns... they do concern me. If Fruma's leadership holds this much power, then...
那些统领……确实让我担心。如果 Fruma 的领导层拥有这么大的力量，那……
Hm. Perhaps our King is right not to get on their bad side.
嗯。也许我们的国王不去得罪他们是对的。
Ah, great, now all o' you are lingerin'. Get out of my room! Not gonna get a lick o' sleep till you're gone...
啊，好极了，现在你们全都赖着不走。出去！你们不走我一点觉都睡不了……
...damned Doctor- should'a just used his own room!!
……该死的博士就该用他自己的房间！！
...sigh. What am I doing here? I should have stayed back in {p}.
……唉。我在这里做什么？我应该留在 {p} 的。
I just hope nobody here knew me before. I'm not sure I could handle that.
我只希望这里没有人以前认识我。我不确定我承受得了。
Hm... a shame I could not fight in the tournament. A monetary reward would be appreciated, given my dwindling research funds...
嗯……可惜我不能参加锦标赛。我的研究经费越来越少，有笔奖金会很有帮助……
But, alas, I am no fighter. Perhaps the King would be willing to fund my future research...
但，唉，我不是战士。也许国王会愿意资助我将来的研究……
Gosh, I hope my match tomorrow goes well. I'm a bit nervous... never really dueled anyone before!
天哪，希望我明天的比赛顺利。我有点紧张……从来没真正跟人决斗过！
What? It's been a long day.
That magic... why does it feel familiar? I can't pinpoint what it is, but...
那股魔法……为什么感觉很熟悉？我说不出是什么，但……
Let's just go get some sleep.
Goodnight, {u}. I hope you'll sleep better than I will.
晚安，{u}。希望你睡得比我好。
{u}! We're going to miss the first round if you sleep any longer!
{u}！你再睡下去我们就要错过第一轮了！
Well, I feel your pain. I don't think I got more than an hour or two. I kept... I should have expected it'd be worse here. I just hoped... well, it is what it is.
嗯，我懂你的感受。我好像只睡了一两个小时。我一直……我早该料到在这里会更糟。我只是希望……算了，就这样吧。
But anyway, it's good you're up. A soldier just came by to tell us to head over to the tournament arena.
不过总之，你醒了就好。刚才有个士兵过来，要我们去锦标赛的竞技场。
You... no, they just... knocked and slid the notice under the door.
你……不，他们只是……敲了敲门，把通知从门缝底下塞进来。
Was someone in our room during the night...?
昨晚有人进过我们的房间……？
I don't... like... that. Not at all.
我不……喜欢……这样。一点都不喜欢。
Still. We need to head over to the arena. Apparently, it's in the northern part of the palace.
不过。我们得去竞技场了。好像在皇宫的北边。
Find the location of the tournament in the northern side of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
在 [-{~}, {~}, {~}] 的皇宫北侧找到锦标赛的地点。
Well, well. Looks like we'll finally get to test which o' us is stronger, eh, captain?
哎呀哎呀。看来我们终于能比比谁更强了，嗯，队长？
Oh, finally? I wasn't aware there was even a question! Lieutenant, do you truly think you stand a chance against me?
哦，终于？我都不知道这还是个问题！中尉，你真以为你有机会赢我？
Ah, enough o' your posturin', Kymer! You might be all up n' fancy these days, but I still remember when you were but a rookie, all afraid of a lil' old zombie!
啊，少摆架子了，Kymer！你现在或许风光体面，但我还记得你还是个菜鸟的时候，被一只小僵尸吓得半死！
Ha! Ah, good times. Good times. You'll get your recognition too one of these days, you know. Maybe you'll even surpass my rank someday!
哈！啊，那段日子真好。真好。你知道吗，总有一天你也会得到赏识的。说不定哪天你的军衔还会超过我！
Eh, you say that every time. Besides, the lower ranks suit me well. Don't think I'd do well with all that "responsibility" the big wigs put on your shoulders.
呃，你每次都这么说。再说，低阶的职位挺适合我的。我可不觉得自己应付得了那些大人物压在你肩上的“责任”。
...all that bein' said, you're still goin' down when it's our go! I got some new tricks since the last time we fought, so don't get too cocky!
……话虽如此，轮到我们的时候你还是要输！自从上次交手之后，我学了些新招，所以别太得意！
Ha! Then I look forward to seeing them.
If you're looking for the tournament arena, go down this corridor then turn to the left.
如果你在找锦标赛的竞技场，沿着这条走廊走，然后左转。
The tournament arena is further down the corridor.
锦标赛的竞技场在走廊更里面。
This area is unfortunately not accessible at this moment.
很抱歉，这个区域目前无法进入。
This is Her Majesty's own personal quarter.
这里是女王陛下的私人寝宫。
I'm afraid I can't let you in just yet. Not until-
恐怕我现在还不能让你进去。要等到——
Yes, yes, my research notes, I am aware. It has been sorted already. May I visit the library now?
是，是，我的研究笔记，我知道。已经处理好了。我现在可以去图书馆了吗？
Don't interrupt me. You can't enter until this round of tournament matches concludes. Her Majesty's orders.
别打断我。这一轮锦标赛比赛结束之前，你不能进去。这是女王陛下的命令。
Pah. Fine! Fine, yes, I'll wait. Good grief.
哼。好吧！好吧，行，我等。真是的。
You'd think I would have some level of freedom, but no! What does it matter if I don't need to watch the matches if there's nothing else to do?!
你还以为我能有点自由，结果没有！就算我不用看比赛，可也没别的事能做，那又有什么用？！
Oh, just go and get your match over with. Quit stalling.
哦，快去把你的比赛打完吧。别拖拖拉拉的。
Just head down these stairs to find the tournament arena.
沿着这道楼梯下去，就能找到锦标赛的竞技场。
The match ups will be announced once everyone is present.
等所有人到齐后，就会公布对战组合。
Uh. Sovereign... Majin? Sovereign Majin. We're all here.
呃。统领……Majin？Majin 统领。我们都到了。
My, it's about time! As guests of the crown, it would do you well to arrive on time for such things, hm? Tardiness is not a good look.
哎呀，也该到了！身为王室的宾客，这种场合准时到场才得体，嗯？迟到可不好看。
Our apologies, Sovereign. It would seem we were not given the time to be here in advance - a humble mistake, I'm certain.
非常抱歉，统领。看来我们事先没被告知时间——我相信只是个无心之失。
Ah, the incompetence of our lessers... it never ceases to amaze! Nevertheless, the duty of arriving on schedule remains on your shoulders. Do better next time, would you?
啊，底下人的无能……真是永远令人叹为观止！不过，准时到场的责任仍然在你们肩上。下次做好一点，行吗？
Now, I am a very busy man, so I will keep this brief. As Her Majesty has already explained, this tournament will consist of multiple duels! You are not required to watch each match.
好了，我是个大忙人，所以长话短说。正如女王陛下所说，这场锦标赛由多场决斗组成！你们不必每场都看。
The standard rules apply. No killing, no maiming, no attacking anyone outside the arena - though, do try, I'd find much pleasure in watching you fail!
规则照旧。不准杀人，不准致残，不准攻击竞技场外的任何人——不过，尽管试试吧，看着你们失败会让我非常愉快！
With that settled, are there any questions? I would certainly hope not, I have much to return to once this is-
那就这么定了，还有问题吗？我当然希望没有，等这里结束我还有一大堆事要——
Ah, I do - I am not participating in the tournament. I had been told to expect some alternative today.
啊，我有——我不参加锦标赛。有人跟我说今天会有别的安排。
Oh, yes... you. What did you say you were again, a... researcher?
哦，对……你。你说你是干什么的来着，一个……研究员？
Ahahaha! Oh, and they selected you as one of your province's greatest? Don't make me laugh! Ahahahahaha!
啊哈哈哈！哦，他们居然把你选为你们行省最优秀的人之一？别逗我笑了！啊哈哈哈哈哈！
Ah, but it's just as well, I suppose. Nine certainly doesn't fit cleanly for such a tournament. Better a researcher than a ninth fighter!
啊，不过这样也好吧。九个人办这种锦标赛本来就不好分组。与其来个第九名战士，还不如来个研究员！
Yes, someone will be with you shortly. Just sit on the sidelines and twiddle your thumbs, or whatever you do- you certainly aren't my problem anymore.
是的，很快就会有人来找你。你就坐在场边玩玩手指，或者随便你干什么，反正你已经不归我管了。
Excellent! The first match up appears to be... {u} and Mel. Step forward, the two of you.
太好了！第一场对战组合是……{u} 和 Mel。你们两个上前来。
Well, hurry up now, get prepared! Choose a corridor each, north or south, and get to fighting already!
好了，快点，去准备！各选一条走廊，北边或南边，然后赶快开打！
As for the rest of you... oh, I can't be bothered. Read your matchups on the board yourselves.
至于你们其他人……哦，我懒得管了。自己去看公告板上的对战组合。
Uh... alrighty then. I guess I'll choose this one.
Begin your fight against Mel in the southern waiting room.
在南边的等候室开始与 Mel 的战斗。
Just 'cause we've got a mission here, doesn't mean I'll go easy on ya!
别以为我们有任务在身，我就会手下留情！
Ready to go?! Let's show them what we're made of!
准备好了吗？！让他们看看我们的本事！
Phew! What a fight! Got my blood rushin'!
呼！好一场战斗！打得我热血沸腾！
What'd you think of my trick? Pretty good, right? Makes me less of a sittin' duck in combat!
你觉得我那招怎么样？挺不错吧？这样打起来我就不会是个活靶子了！
Ah, I didn't think I was gonna be winnin' anything, really. But it was fun givin' it a shot.
啊，我本来就没想过要赢什么啦。不过试试看还挺好玩的。
{u} has bested Mel in the first round, and will progress to the next!
{u} 在第一轮击败了 Mel，晋级下一轮！
You will be permitted to remain in the palace for the duration of the tournament. You will be paid for your participation at the end of your stay.
锦标赛期间，你可以留在皇宫。参赛的报酬会在你离开时支付。
I figure that makes sense. I wonder when Lanu's match is...
我想这也说得通。不知道 Lanu 的比赛是什么时候……
{u}, congratulations on your victory. You will be notified when your next match is. In the meantime, feel free to rest.
{u}，恭喜你获胜。下一场比赛的时间会另行通知。在此期间，请随意休息。
Leave the arena waiting room and find Picard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
离开竞技场等候室，到 [-{~}, {~}, {~}] 找 Picard。
It was a good fight! But you'd better win in my honor now, y'hear?
打得真好！不过你现在可得替我赢下去，听到没？
We will announce your next match later. Please feel free to rest or enjoy the palace in the meantime.
我们稍后会公布你的下一场比赛。在此期间，请随意休息或在皇宫里走走。
Ah, {u}, I saw the match! Very good technique, better than many soldiers I've seen pass through {p} in my time.
啊，{u}，我看了比赛！技巧非常好，比我这些年在 {p} 看过的许多士兵都强。
I suppose I'm not surprised! When the tournament was announced, you came to mind as a potential winner. You, and one other person, that is.
我想我并不意外！锦标赛一宣布，我就想到你可能会夺冠。你，还有另外一个人。
Hm... maybe I could start taking bets on who will win... ah, no, no, I'm far too busy. Stay focused, Picard.
嗯……也许我可以开个赌局，赌谁会赢……啊，不，不，我太忙了。专心点，Picard。
Hm? Oh dear, I'd forgotten you were here! Yes, I was going to do something...
嗯？哎呀，我都忘了你在这儿！对，我本来要去做件事……
Oh! The library! Can you believe it, that damnable guard finally stepped away! It's ridiculous, really- who even cares to guard a library of all things?!
哦！图书馆！你敢相信吗，那个该死的守卫终于走开了！真是荒唐——到底谁会去守一座图书馆啊？！
But. But but but. The way is open, and although the tournament round is still ongoing, I'd like to take this opportunity while I can!
不过。不过不过不过。路已经通了，虽然这一轮锦标赛还在进行，我还是想趁机会去看看！
Care to join me? I'm sure there's something you'll find interesting in there. What sorts of knowledge have the Frumans kept hidden in these walls...
要一起来吗？我相信里面一定有你会感兴趣的东西。Fruma 人在这些墙里藏了些什么知识……
Well, are you coming? Come now, quickly, before the guard returns!
怎么样，你来不来？快来，快点，趁守卫还没回来！
跟着 Picard 进入图书馆。
Goodness, where to even begin? There's so much here...
天哪，从哪里开始才好？这里的东西太多了……
I hereby introduce to you The Evermoving Zephyr, the ruler of the {p}, the latest in the line of one of Fruma's great noble houses! His lordship, Sovereign Zhiraok Nasin!
在此向各位介绍永动之风、{p} 的统治者、Fruma 名门望族之一的最新继承人！大人阁下，统领 Zhiraok Nasin！
...and that we're rifling through the Cursed instead of our own citizens is an incalculable risk!
……而且我们在受诅者里翻找，而不是在自己的国民里找，这是个无法估算的风险！
What was that?! Quickly, quickly now, follow me!
那是什么？！快，快点，跟我来！
Do you have eyes on the speaker? Who is it?
你看得到说话的人吗？是谁？
I can't find her angle for this hunt.
我算不出她这次物色人选的角度。
Ah, it's like I'm talking with her again! It's so nostalgic to speak with a clueless Nasin trying their hardest, in spite of their incompe-
啊，就好像我又在跟她说话一样！看一个毫无头绪的 Nasin 拼尽全力，却还是那么无能，真让人怀念——
I'M SORRY, YOU IGNORANT INTEGRAND? You really think now is the time for- Rrgh... Why. Do I even bother.
你说什么，你这个无知的被积函数？你真以为现在是——啧……我到底何必呢。
Why, indeed! It truly is a bad habit. Something to work on while your seniors do the important work, hm?
说得是啊，何必呢！这真是个坏习惯。趁你的前辈在做重要工作的时候，好好改一改吧，嗯？

说到这个，我得说我确实觉得这一切有点奇怪。我们这里显然不缺战力，何必去找那些流放者？

今天不是你的幸运日，人类。唉，你知道输了的代价。守卫！
Wowee! In what turned out to be an amazing race, the human has managed to steal the lead right out from Usnail Bolt's nose!
哇哦！这场比赛精彩绝伦，人类居然从 Usnail Bolt 眼皮底下抢走了领先！
Here, human, take this slime as your prize.
给你，人类。收下这份黏液作为奖品。
ISN'T THIS JUST ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC. A HUMAN?! WHO WOULD HAVE GUESSED.
这可真是太美妙了。一个人类？！谁猜得到啊。
YOU'RE THE SEVENTH ONE PASSING ME TODAY AND YOU'RE NO DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHERS.
你是今天第七个从我旁边经过的，跟其他人没有任何不同。
EVERY SINGLE ONE WITH THAT DOPEY SHEEPISH LOOK ON THEIR FACE, AS IF A TALKING MUSHROOM IS OUT OF THE BLUE.
每一个脸上都挂着那副呆头呆脑的傻样，好像会说话的蘑菇是什么晴天霹雳似的。
GIVE ME A BREAK, I'VE HAD ENOUGH OF JERKS PICKING ME UP AND DISRESPECTING ME LIKE THAT. PRIVATE SPACE, EVER HEARD OF IT?
饶了我吧，我受够了那些混蛋把我拔起来还那样不尊重我。私人空间，听说过吗？
WHY DO I EVEN TRY. JUST LOOK AT YOU! THE EPITOME OF CLUELESS. WHAT NOW, GONNA TAKE ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS?
我干嘛还费劲。看看你！蠢到极点的典范。接下来呢，要带我去天空群岛来一趟疯疯癫癫的冒险吗？
I HOPE NOT, IF YOU WERE THINKING THAT. I'VE ALREADY LOST A STEM TODAY BECAUSE SOME DIMWIT TRIED TAKING A BITE OUT OF ME... LIVE!
如果你是那么想的，我希望不是。今天我已经少了一截菌柄，因为有个白痴想咬我一口……活生生地！
DON'T TELL ME, ARE YOU TAKING ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS? HOW LOVELY.
别告诉我，你要带我去天空群岛来一趟疯疯癫癫的冒险？真是太好了。
A KITCHEN YOU SAY, WELL, IF IT'LL PUT ME OUT OF MY MISERY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, THEN WHY NOT.
你说去厨房，好吧，如果那能让我尽快解脱，那有何不可。
WAIT, WHY ARE YOU STUFFING ME INTO YOUR BAG? HOW DO YOU EXPECT ME TO BREATHE IN HERE?!
等等，你为什么把我塞进你的包里？你要我在这里面怎么呼吸？！
Hello there! I can see you knead some sunrise flour, don't you?
你好啊！我看你“面”临缺日升面粉的状况，对吧？
It's needed rye away? Well no worries, friend!
马上就要？没“麦”问题，朋友！
Well butter me up and call me toast, it seems I ran out of the stuff, there's none left.
哎呀，给我抹上黄油叫我吐司吧，我好像把存货用光了，一点都不剩。
I'm sorry if I seem to be just loafing around, but at yeast I know how to make some more.
抱歉我看起来像是在“面”包游手好闲，不过至少我还知道怎么再“酵”出一些来。
Can you see that wheat field over there, next to the bakery? You can farm up some wheat and pop it on the mill.
看到面包店旁边那片麦田了吗？你可以去收些小麦，放进磨坊里磨。
Grab a scythe from the tool merchant next dough and get to work!
去隔壁的工具商人那里拿把镰刀，开工吧！
Make as much as you want, I've made all the bread I need for today already.
想做多少就做多少，我今天需要的面包已经都做好了。
Howdy, pal! Looking for some Skyhigh Raspberries? They work great in a pie!
你好啊，朋友！在找冲天覆盆子吗？拿来做派棒极了！
If you're interested, it's just a small fee of {~} Emeralds to get access to the island.
如果你有兴趣，只要付 {~} 绿宝石的小额费用就能上岛。
A man's gotta make a living somehow, so I've set up a system of cannons to take you right up to the island they grow on!
人总得想办法谋生嘛，所以我架了一套大炮系统，直接把你送上它们生长的那座岛！
So, whaddya say? Small price for a little adventure, and as many raspberries as you can eat!
所以，你怎么说？小小的代价换一场小冒险，覆盆子还任你吃到饱！
Alrighty! Just head over to that island beside me and jump in the cannon - it's perfectly safe, I promise!
好嘞！去我旁边那座岛，跳进大炮里——绝对安全，我保证！
Find your way up to the island and grab as many raspberries as you want! When you're done just jump in the big cannon to come back to shore!
想办法爬上岛，覆盆子想摘多少就摘多少！弄完了就跳进大炮，回到岸上来！
Alrighty, no worries. Feel free to come back if you're ever in the mood for some!
好嘞，没关系。哪天想吃了随时欢迎回来！
Present the ingredients to your chosen chef.
把材料交给你选的厨师。
Have you got all the ingredients? Amazing!
材料都拿到了吗？太棒了！
Okay you step back and let me work on the cooking, just pass over the ingredients!
好，你往后站，让我来下厨，把材料递给我就行！
Aha! That should do it! Hopefully I've done everything correctly... but wow, would you look at the color of that soup!
啊哈！这样应该好了！希望我每一步都做对了……不过哇，你看看这汤的颜色！
You should bring it over to Hamsey to see what he thinks!
你该端去给 Hamsey，看看他怎么说！
You got everything? Took you long enough.
Let's get started. Everyone else already finished. Stay back while I work my magic.
开始吧。其他人都已经做完了。往后站，看我施展魔法。
Mwah! My masterdish is finished. Present this to the chef, I'm sure he'll love it!
么啊！我的杰作完成了。端去给厨师，我相信他会喜欢的！
And be CAREFUL taking it over. That food could be worth HUNDREDS once I'm famous!
端过去的时候给我小心点。等我出名了，这道菜可值好几百！
You got everything? Awesome stuff, dude.
东西都拿到了？太棒了，老兄。
I'll just take a smallll bit of this raspberry - chef's commission, eh? And let's get started!
这覆盆子我就拿一点点——算厨师的佣金，嗯？我们开始吧！
And we're all done. Hamsey's gonna love this.
全都做好了。Hamsey 肯定会爱死这个。
Here you go, dawg. Pleasure working with you - show this to Hamsey and we'll see what he thinks. Make sure you don't "lose" any of it on the way over - you know what they say about your own supply!
给你，兄弟。跟你合作很愉快——拿给 Hamsey 看，看他怎么说。路上可别“弄丢”了哪一块——你知道大家怎么说偷吃自家货的！
Talk to Hamsey with your finished dish.
带着做好的菜去找 Hamsey 谈谈。
Ah, you have finished your dish? Well, then, il est temps de gouter!
啊，你的菜做好了？那么，是时候品尝了！
Let us retreat to my private dining room... this way!
我们去我的私人餐厅吧……这边请！
Meet Hamsey in the dining room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的餐厅与 Hamsey 会合。
Welcome back, mon ami! I see you've returned with a dish in hand!
欢迎回来，mon ami！我看到你端着一道菜回来了！
A stew? Seems simple, but even the simplest things in life can be le meilleur!
炖菜？看起来简单，但人生中最简单的东西也可能是最棒的！
Adventurer, are you sure you made this dish? It is so good I might as well close the restaurant!
冒险者，这道菜真的是你做的吗？好吃到我干脆把餐厅关了算了！
You never fail to surprise me, friend. Here, take this apron, an essential of any true chef.
你总是能让我惊喜，朋友。来，收下这条围裙，真正的厨师必备的东西。
I cannot help but notice that your dish is ready!
Let me taste your dish and I will present you mine! Mon dieu, une omelette?
让我尝尝你的菜，我也会把我的菜端给你！我的天，煎蛋卷？
Je suis déçu, ami. I would prefer biting into a mule derrière! This thing... a Gert wouldn't touch it!
我太失望了，朋友。我宁可去啃骡子的屁股！这东西……连 Gert 都不会碰！
I see you haven't improved in the art of cuisine. Leave me be, and come back when you have learned what good food is!
看来你的厨艺一点长进都没有。别烦我，等你学会什么是好菜再回来！
I see you've returned, and not empty handed. Please, show me what you've created!
我看你回来了，而且不是空着手。请给我看看你做了什么！
A pie? Why, you must have been helped by Frank. He always has a thing for making pie!
派？哎呀，一定是 Frank 帮了你。他一向爱做派！
I can see that your compétences culinaires are very well developed!
我看得出你的烹饪本领相当纯熟！
Though I will not truly call you a master chef quite yet, you are très bien! Have this reward as congratulations!
虽然我还不会真的称你为大厨，但你做得非常好！收下这份奖励，作为祝贺！
Adventurer! You haven't talked to Brie, Kale, or Frank yet, make sure to talk to them before choosing who to work with.
冒险者！你还没跟 Brie、Kale 或 Frank 说过话，选合作对象之前记得先去找他们聊聊。
Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Pleasure to meet'cha.
哟，老兄。我叫 Frank。很高兴认识你。
Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someoneplease.
你还在这里？就……去跟别人聊天吧，你还在这里？就……去跟别人聊天拜托。
You've talked to all three chefs, you should check back with Hamsey.
你已经跟三位厨师都谈过了，该回去找 Hamsey 了。
Which chef you would like to cook with?
你想跟哪一位厨师一起下厨？
Not feeling a vibe with me? No worries! I'm sure you'll do great whoever you work with.
跟我不太合得来？没关系！不管你跟谁合作，我相信你都会做得很好。
Thank grook you didn't choose me. Goodness knows I don't need another ameteur weighing me down.
感谢 grook 你没选我。天知道我可不需要再多一个外行来拖累我。
Collect [{~} Blue-Ringed Grook Egg] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
在 [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 收集 [{~1} Blue-Ringed Grook Egg]，或是查看你的菜谱。
Collect [{~} Voidroot] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
在 [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 收集 [{~1} Voidroot]，或是查看你的菜谱。
Collect [{~} Moonsalt] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
在 [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 收集 [{~1} Moonsalt]，或是查看你的菜谱。
Collect [{~} Snail Slime] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
在 [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 收集 [{~1} Snail Slime]，或是查看你的菜谱。
Collect [{~} Talking Mushroom] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
在 [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 收集 [{~1} 会说话的蘑菇]，或是查看你的菜谱。
Collect [{~} Sunrise Flour] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Collect [{~} Skyhigh Raspberry] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
在 [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 收集 [{~1} Skyhigh Raspberry]，或是查看你的菜谱。
You shouldn't go entering private rooms uninvited!
你不该未经邀请就进别人的私人房间！
How is the cooking going?! If you have lost your recipe book, just ask your chef for another copy!
下厨还顺利吗？！要是菜谱掉了，直接跟你的厨师再要一本就好！
Follow me into the kitchen, mon ami.
You need [{~} Sunrise Wheat] to refine using the mill!
你需要 [{~} Sunrise Wheat] 才能用磨坊精制！
You've managed to farm up some Sunrise Wheat - you should go refine it at the Bakers mill.
你已经种出一些 Sunrise Wheat 了——该去面包师的磨坊精制它。
Looks like you managed to escape with the egg... that was a close one!
看来你带着蛋逃出来了……真是千钧一发！
Would you like to collect some Skyhigh Raspberries?
你想收集一些 Skyhigh Raspberry 吗？
You're all paid up for a trip to the island already, just jump in the cannon on the island right beside me!
你去岛上的费用已经付过了，直接跳进我旁边岛上的那尊大炮就行！
You've gathered all the ingredients, you should head back to Frank.
你已经把材料都收集好了，该回去找 Frank 了。
You shouldn't jump onto the islands without talking to the Raspberry Vendor!
没跟覆盆子商人说过话，就不该往岛上跳！
You watch Hamsey start to taste your dish... will it be up to his standards?
你看着 Hamsey 开始品尝你的料理……它会合他的标准吗？
Welcome back to my restaurant, adventurer!
欢迎回到我的餐厅，冒险者！
Good to see you again, dude!
Ah. You're back. Just stay out of my way, I'm trying to do actual cooking.
啊。你回来了。别碍着我，我在认真做菜。
Hey! Nice to see you again.
Welcome back, mon ami! Alas, running a restaurant is busy work, so I can't talk for long. Maybe take a seat in the restaurant?
欢迎回来，mon ami！唉，开餐厅事情多，我没法聊太久。要不到餐厅里找个位子坐坐？
Hey, again! I'd love to chat, but you should talk to the other chefs before making your decision!
嘿，又见面了！我很想跟你聊聊，不过你应该先去跟其他厨师谈谈，再做决定！
Please go and talk to the other chefs first before you decide to weigh me down with your "assistance".
在你决定用你的“帮忙”来拖累我之前，请先去跟其他厨师谈谈。
Can't wait to work with you man, tell the big man we're working together and we can get started.
等不及跟你合作了，老兄，去跟大老板说我们要一起干，然后就能开工了。
I still can't believe you chose to "work" with me. Make yourself useful and go and tell the Chef. I certainly won't.
我还是不敢相信你居然选了跟我“合作”。做点有用的事，去告诉主厨吧。我是绝对不会去的。
You should go tell Hamsey who you've chosen to work with!
你该去告诉 Hamsey 你选了谁合作！
It is time to cook, mon ami! Head over to your chef and ask them what to do.
该下厨了，mon ami！去找你的厨师，问问他们该做什么。
No sweat, man, I probably wouldn't choose me either. Good luck!
没事的，老兄，换我大概也不会选我。祝你好运！
Hey! How's the ingredient gathering going? Remember to check your recipe book if you're stuck!
嘿！材料收集得怎么样了？卡住的话记得看看你的菜谱！
Need another recipe book? No problem! I keep plenty of spares, you never know what might happen!
还需要一本菜谱吗？没问题！我留了很多备用的，谁知道会发生什么事呢！
The announcer seems to lose his train of thought.
播报员似乎说着说着就忘了自己要讲什么。
Would you like to race Usnail Bolt?
要跟 Usnail Bolt 赛跑吗？
You shouldn't leave the race before it's finished!
比赛还没结束，你可不该离开！
You've clearly won the race, but everyone seems to be waiting for Usnail Bolt to finish as well...
你显然已经赢了比赛，但大家似乎还在等 Usnail Bolt 也跑到终点……
Looks like this is that "Space Wizard"'s tower... you should start looking around for some Moonsalt.
看来这就是那个“太空巫师”的塔了……你该开始四处找找月盐了。
A large warning on the display flashes a "LOW FUEL " warning at you.
显示屏上闪着一个巨大的警告，朝你亮出“燃料不足”的字样。
You need [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] to refine into "burnmilk fuel". Perhaps the Humyn nearby knows how to get some?
你需要 [{~} 未精炼月盐] 才能精炼成“焚乳燃料”。也许附近的 Humyn 知道怎么弄到一些？
Looks like this is the Moonsalt Cave... you should head deeper to find some salt.
看来这里就是月盐洞穴了……你该往深处走，去找些盐。
You grab a large handful of the unrefined salt.
你抓起一大把未精炼的盐。
You've secured some Unrefined Moonsalt, time to head back to the village and your way home.
你弄到了一些未精炼月盐，该回村子，然后踏上回家的路了。
You've managed to refine the moonsalt into some kind of fuel, you should head over to the spaceship now.
你成功把月盐精炼成了某种燃料，现在该去飞船那里了。
You fill the ship up with the burnmilk and press the button on the control panel that is helpefully labelled "TRAVEL SPACEZOOM".
你给飞船灌满焚乳，按下控制面板上那个贴心地标着“旅行太空飞飞”的按钮。
Looks like you're safely back in the {p}, and with some Moonsalt to boot!
看来你已经平安回到 {p}，还顺便带回了一些月盐！
The recipe book says voidroot only grows in complete darkness... better start looking around.
菜谱上说虚空根只长在一片漆黑之中……最好开始四处找找。
It's some kind of cargo that's fallen from above... there's a distinct smell of fresh cookies coming from inside.
这是某种从上面掉下来的货物……里面飘出一股明显的新鲜饼干香味。
You reach out to touch the silky leaves of the plant and find your vision restored for {~} second...
你伸手触碰那株植物丝滑的叶子，发现视力恢复了 {~} 秒……
A label on the side reads Ｃｏｒｋｉａｎ Ｍｕｒｄｅｒ Ｂｏｔ. You probably shouldn't get too close to it.
侧面的标签写着 Ｃｏｒｋｉａｎ Ｍｕｒｄｅｒ Ｂｏｔ。你最好别离它太近。
Dusty grey texture? Desaturated green leaves? Ever-growing sense of all-encompasing dread? Matches the recipe book description perfectly!
灰扑扑的质地？褪了色的绿叶？越来越强烈、笼罩一切的恐惧感？跟菜谱上的描述完全吻合！
It's some kind of purple orb, pulsating with a otherworldy light. Maybe best not to touch.
这是某种紫色的球体，闪动着异界般的光芒。最好还是别碰。
You've gathered all the ingredients, you should head back to Brie.
你已经把材料都收集好了，该回去找 Brie 了。
Have you shown Hamsey our dish yet? I'm sure he's gonna love it!
你把我们的菜拿给 Hamsey 看了吗？我敢肯定他会爱死它的！
Can't say your bake looks very good. No match for Kale's mighty omelette!
你烤的这东西看起来可不怎么样。根本比不上 Kale 那道了不起的煎蛋卷！
Meet me in my dining room and we'll taste your dish!
到我的餐厅来找我，我们来品尝你的菜！
These eggs look almost... furry? It's probably best to leave them alone.
这些蛋看起来几乎……毛茸茸的？最好还是别去碰它们。
It's a strange grey fruit that's cold and dry to the touch... not the voidroot you're looking for though.
这是一颗奇怪的灰色果实，摸起来又冷又干……不过不是你要找的虚空根。
I need more firepower if I'm going...to get...
如果我要……夺回……我需要更多火力……
Anyway, it's clear that I'm going to need more firepower if I'm going to have a shot at reclaiming that outpost.
总之，很明显，如果我想有机会夺回那个前哨站，就需要更多火力。
Wh- I'm shocked! In the middle there- they just caged the soldiers instead of killing them? That's...kind of a relief.
什——我太惊讶了！在正中间——他们没杀那些士兵，只是把他们关进笼子里？这……算是松了一口气。
There's definitely too many orcs in the plaza there for us to take down on our own...
广场上的兽人肯定太多了，我们俩打不过……
Alright, now I just need to figure out how we can both get in... There's sentries on the perimeter, so going over may not be an option...
好，现在我只需要想想我们俩要怎么进去……外围有哨兵，所以翻墙可能行不通……
Oh, orc from mud bath. In, now!
哦，泡泥巴浴回来的兽人。快进来！
No enter for humans! This place belong to orcs!
人类不准进！这地方是兽人的！
Ah... Took mud bath. Orc enter, quick!
啊……泡过泥巴浴。兽人进来，快！
The Gavellian Army's sending reinforcements to our outpost, finally. Everything was getting too much to handle on our end.
Gavel 军队终于要派增援到我们的前哨站了。我们这边实在快撑不住了。
You Wynnic folks are way better suited than us for guard duty. Why don't you take over for me, huh?
你们 Wynn 人比我们适合站岗多了。不如你来替我，怎么样？
Join Elphaba on a mission in the Temporary Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的临时营地加入 Elphaba 的任务
Oh, a Wynnic soldier out here in the boondocks? Honestly, you're just what we need- I could use your help, if you're able?
噢，这种穷乡僻壤竟然有 Wynn 的士兵？说真的，你正是我们需要的人——如果可以的话，能帮我个忙吗？
Good, thank you. Let me lock down the camp before I give you the briefing, though.
很好，谢谢。不过先让我把营地封锁好，再给你做简报。
My name is Elphaba. I've been working with the Gavellian army for a good few years now.
我叫 Elphaba。我在 Gavel 军队服役好几年了。
I'm the commander of the {p} Outpost down ahead. It's a strategic fortress, placed to monitor the Orcish capital.
我是前面 {p} 前哨站的指挥官。那是一座战略要塞，用来监视兽人的首都。
It was safe for a long while, but especially in the past while the Orcs have gotten far bolder, more aggressive.
那里安全了很长一段时间，但尤其是最近，兽人变得大胆得多，也更有攻击性。
They overwhelmed the outpost- we had to retreat and set up this camp to watch over the place we used to watch over them with!
他们攻陷了前哨站——我们只好撤退，建起这个营地，来监视我们原本用来监视他们的地方！
...oh no. See, this is what I mean! The orcs are coming!

旧塔倒了！Junhur 是最强炮手！！

击杀兽人夺取者，其他的我们帮你挡住！

呃……那个该死的小偷！我就知道不该离开的……这全都是个错误……该死。

现在没时间浪费了。走吧。Tasim、{u}。我们得去救 {p}。

……哼。这两个人还真没礼貌。不过算了，我想情况也确实紧急。

那个 Tasim，他应该也是从 Fruma 来的吧？如果他是你的同伴，你该把他也拉进我们这个小实验。我得好好想想我们的下一步……

……怎么？你还在等什么？！快去，出发吧！{p} 等着人去救呢！
I'm trying to think, but... I've never...

你是一名新兵，要被派往 Wynn 行省参加他们的战争。你之所以入伍，是因为你认为你那独特的……天赋……会派上用场。

使用移动键预览你的走法，然后按跳跃键确认。

你，那边那个路人！你刚刚见证了一个魔法奇迹！我成功找回了好几年前的记忆！

在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 他的船附近找回水手 Caid。

嗯？噢！我呃，没什么好看的！只是……只是在看看我的老伙计船而已！

这才对嘛，看到没 Reynauld！我就知道会有人喜欢！

你难道不想知道自己以前过着什么样的生活吗？就算那不是你想看到的，知道总比不知道好吧？
Excellent, I'm glad to hear that! Now. Activating in three... two... one... go!
太好了，很高兴听你这么说！那么。启动倒数三……二……一……开始！
All hands on deck! Arrest that insurgent!
全员就位！逮捕那个叛乱分子！
Grr... He couldn't have gotten far. All of you, search the city! Leave no corner unturned! Don't let him get away!
可恶……他跑不远的。你们所有人，搜遍全城！每个角落都别放过！别让他跑了！
I- oh, this is bad... What can I-...
我——哎，这下糟了……我能怎么……
... Damn it. Damn it all. I can't just let the man bleed out, even if he's-...
……该死。全都该死。我不能就这样看着一个人流血而死，就算他是……
... You really shouldn't have gotten involved, you know.
……你知道吗，你实在不该插手的。
Besides, we have used the spell on two subjects already, and it has gone perfectly fine for both of them... eh, for the most part. There's only the slightest bit of instability.
再说，我们已经在两位受试者身上用过这个法术了，两个人都完全没问题……呃，大体上吧。只有极其轻微的一点不稳定。
...Damn it. Damn it all. I can't just let the man bleed out, even if he's-...
……该死。全都该死。我不能就这样让这个人流血而死，就算他是……
It's fine, you'll be fine... I know what to do, even if I really shouldn't...
没事的，你会没事的……我知道该怎么做，就算我真的不该这么做……
G-gah! Wh-where am I? Who are you? I need to get-
呃、呃啊！这、这是哪里？你是谁？我得赶快——
He's in here! And he has an accomplice! Arrest them both!
他在这里！而且还有同伙！两个都给我抓起来！
So, what? I should have just let you bleed out in my home? Don't be ridiculous.
所以呢？我应该就这样让你在我家流血而死？别说傻话了。
Yes! You should have! Because now, not only have I been arrested for crimes against the crown, but you've also been outed as one of the cursed. Wouldn't have happened if you had just... stood by.
对！你就该那样！因为现在，我不但因为冒犯王室的罪名被捕，你还被揭穿是受诅者之一。要是你当时只是……袖手旁观，就不会这样了。
Well, a lot of good that's done us. You know no one gets out of here, right? When they take you, you're never heard from again! So, that's where we're at.
是啊，这可真帮了我们大忙。你知道没人能活着离开这里，对吧？他们把你带走之后，就再也不会有你的消息了！所以，这就是我们现在的处境。
Tasim. It's your time. Follow me.
Good luck out there, Tasim. You'll need it.
See you on the other side, Aledar.
Ahem. We're ready for the process. Prepare the Adjustor.
咳咳。我们准备好进行程序了。准备调整器。
Silence. Before we begin, I want to make one thing clear. We do not need your ilk in Fruma. We do not want your ilk in Fruma.
安静。开始之前，我要先说清楚一件事。Fruma 不需要你这种人。Fruma 也不想要你这种人。
What we will do with you today is a kindness, a mercy. If the world were to have its way, you would be far worse off. Remember that as we continue.
我们今天要对你做的事是一种仁慈，一种宽恕。如果照这个世界的意思，你的下场会惨得多。接下来的过程里记住这一点。
Fruma is nothing but a speck in your history. A fact set in stone, with details lost to the hypothetical past. You think of it fondly, but remember nothing.
Fruma 不过是你过往里的一粒尘埃。一个板上钉钉的事实，细节早已消失在假设般的过去里。你对它怀有好感，却什么也不记得。
You will fight in their war. You will live for it, you will die for it. You will be of Wynn forever, and Fruma will be glad to be rid of you.
你会参加他们的战争。你会为它而活，你会为它而死。你将永远属于 Wynn，而 Fruma 会很高兴摆脱了你。
Must I repeat myself? Do you understand?
要我再说一遍吗？你明白了吗？
I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
我再问一次。你的指令，明白了吗？
Assistant! Snap out of it! You've gone in too deep, the memory is sucking you in!
助手！快醒醒！你陷得太深了，记忆要把你吸进去了！
Good grief- there you are! Do you understand how dangerous that was?!
老天，你总算回来了！你知不知道刚才有多危险？！
What do you think happens to me if one of my assistants gets trapped in their memories forever! Nothing good!
要是我的助手永远困在自己的记忆里，你觉得我会有什么下场！绝对不会是好事！
The memory restorification orb worked as well as I could expect for a single use... but, good grief, that was upsetting to watch.
记忆复原化宝珠单次使用的效果已经好得不能再好了……但是，老天，那看得真让人难受。
It stands to reason both Caid and Reynauld also experienced this... and my magic couldn't break through that wall...
照理说 Caid 和 Reynauld 也经历过这些……而我的魔法突破不了那道墙……
Is this what they're doing to their criminals out there, in Fruma? Casting them out to fight in Wynn's war?
这就是他们在 Fruma 对待罪犯的方式吗？把他们赶出来，去打 Wynn 的战争？
... I'll have to think on how much I want to delve into memories. In any case! At the very start of this, I promised you we could view your memories.
……我得好好想想，我到底想在记忆里挖多深。不管怎样！这一切一开始的时候，我答应过你，可以看看你的记忆。
The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Just step up to the orb, like the others did.
如果你想的话，这个提议依然有效。只要站到宝珠前面，就跟其他人一样。
Well? The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Simply step up to the orb, just like the others did.
怎么样？如果你想的话，这个提议依然有效。只要站到宝珠前面，就跟其他人一样。
H-huh?! The orb! My beautiful memory restorification orb! It's ruined!
嗯、嗯？！宝珠！我美丽的记忆复原化宝珠！毁了！
... Oh, whatever. I have the blueprints stored somewhere around here. I can always make another... but still.
……噢，算了。设计图我收在这附近某个地方。随时都能再做一个……但还是很可惜。
Oh! Oh, right! My apologies, I completely forgot to check in with you! Are you alright?
噢！噢，对了！抱歉，我完全忘了问你怎么样了！你还好吗？
None of the other test subjects experienced this powerful a reaction... strange. It's almost like we're accessing memories that didn't exist.
其他实验对象都没有出现这么强烈的反应……奇怪。简直就像我们在读取不曾存在过的记忆。
... Well. Ehem. In any case, I'll need to continue my research. There's more to learn, I'm sure...
……嗯。咳咳。总之，我得继续我的研究。一定还有更多东西可以挖掘……
As thanks for your help. Here, a reward. Ah, also... I believe your friend is just outside the tower. You might want to check in on him.
谢谢你的帮忙。来，这是报酬。啊，还有……我想你的朋友就在塔外面。你也许该去看看他。
Find Tasim outside Dr. Picard's tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 Picard 博士的塔外 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找到 Tasim。
Cursed. He called me cursed. What does that mean for me...?
受诅者。他说我是受诅者。那对我来说意味着什么……？
... Did the two of us really meet through sheer random luck? He was running from something, and... fell straight into my life.
……我们两个真的只是纯粹碰巧遇见的吗？他在逃避什么，然后……一头栽进了我的人生。
He doesn't need to know about all of this. He's- he's better off not knowing.
他不需要知道这一切。他——他还是不知道比较好。
... I'm going to head for the Gavel Province, I think. It's across the ocean, far enough from... From all of this.
……我想我会去 Gavel 行省。在海的对面，离……离这一切够远。
... I'm just resting here, a little. I'll be on my way soon.
……我只是在这里稍微歇一下。马上就会出发了。
It's the box Caid was talking about...
这就是 Caid 说的那个箱子……
It be disappointin' that I wasn't able to accompany ye. Mighta been able to thump the dogs together, eh?
没能陪你一起去，真叫俺失望。不然咱俩说不定能一起把那帮狗东西揍一顿，是吧？
Aye! Let's find the booty and bring back some doubloons! Here be that map I snagged. Swim or whatever ye landlubbers do to get to Pirate Cove. It'll be the first house to the right when ye arrive.
好嘞！咱们去找宝藏，带些金币回来！这是我弄到的那张地图。游泳也好，你们这些旱鸭子用什么办法也好，去 Pirate Cove 吧。到了之后右手边第一间房子就是。
Do ye remember where to go?
No? The crew be loiterin' at Pirate Cove. I'll be along soon, don't ye worry!
不记得？弟兄们都在 Pirate Cove 晃着呢。俺随后就到，别担心！
You are not able to move but you still hear the ongoing conversation.
你动弹不得，但仍然听得见正在进行的对话。
What? Another clue! This be just a wild grook hunt, where be the real booty?! No one ever got rich off a heap o' keys!! Maybe this 'ere jewel attached will sell...
什么？又是线索！这简直是白忙一场的 Grook 追逐，真正的宝藏在哪？！没人靠一堆钥匙发过财！！也许这上面挂的宝石能卖点钱……
Talk with Marston in the ocean at [-{~} {~} -{~}]
与海上 [-{~} {~} -{~}] 的 Marston 交谈
Ah, ahoy matey! Are ye here to get a glimpse of ol' Redbeard's sunken galleon as well?
啊，嘿，伙计！你也是来看一眼老 Redbeard 沉没的大帆船的吗？
A fine ship it once was, aye? Accordin' to the stories, it sank in one o' the greatest sea battles in history! The cap'n sank beneath the waves, ne'er to be seen again!
它曾经是艘好船，是吧？照传说的讲，它沉在史上最伟大的海战之一里！船长也沉进了浪底，从此再没人见过！
...Say. Have ye ever wanted to go on a real treasure hunt? Ye look like someone with an eye for treasure, aye?
……我说。你有没有想过去来一场真正的寻宝？你看起来像是个识宝的人，是吧？
Good for ye then! I bought meself a real treasure map on Pirate Cove, a fine deal if ye ask me. And, if the jack wasn't fibbing, it leads to the feared Redbeard's real treasure!
那太好了！我在 Pirate Cove 买了一张真正的藏宝图，要我说可真是笔好买卖。而且，如果那家伙没撒谎，它会指向令人闻风丧胆的 Redbeard 的真正宝藏！
O' course, there always be room for another! Ye joinin'? We could use another hand.
当然，总还有位子留给多一个人！你要加入吗？我们正缺人手。
Find Marston's crew on Pirate Cove at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Pirate Cove 找到 Marston 的船员
And that be when ye will...
Cor lad...ye don' look like a pirate ta me, and I be but a young lass!
哎哟小子……你看起来可不像海盗，我也只是个年轻姑娘而已！
's right, bucko. Who be ye, bargin' into our home in yer fancy armour 'n whatnot?
说得对，伙计。你是谁啊，穿着花哨的盔甲什么的就闯进我们家？
Ah, ye be accompanyin' Marston, eh? Well if ye insist on that, where be the man 'himself?
啊，你是跟 Marston 一起的，嗯？好吧，既然你这么说，那他本人在哪？
Comin' later? Hm. Well, more hands always be helpful. Let us go down to me ship, the Black Ring.
晚点来？嗯。好吧，多几双手总是有用的。我们去我的船，黑环号那里吧。
So he told ye about the plan? We'll bathe in doubloons when we get back! Ah, me fair lass will be so happy.
所以他跟你说了计划？等我们回来，就能泡在金币里了！啊，我那美丽的姑娘一定会很高兴。
Hop aboard the Black Ring down at the dock of Pirate Cove.
到 Pirate Cove 的码头登上黑环号。
Aha, quick on yer feet, lad! Ye got 'ere before us!
啊哈，脚程挺快嘛，小子！你比我们先到了！
How's about we wait up fer him? He's the one who's givin us the opportunity fer this hunt, anyways.
我们等等他怎么样？反正是他给了我们这次寻宝的机会。
I be getting impatient... The whole crew is 'ere, 'cept fer him!
我等得不耐烦了……全体船员都到了，就差他！
Argh! Where be our mate? It be getting dark out! We will have to leave Marston at land.
啊！我们的伙计在哪？天都快黑了！只好把 Marston 留在岸上了。
Do ya have the map Marston bought?
你有 Marston 买的那张地图吗？
Let us take a looksie at the map and see where to go.
我们来看看地图，看该往哪去。
It seems like one of these islands have the treasure... A'ight, yer in charge, landlubber! Set us on a course fer an island!
看起来宝藏在其中一座岛上……好吧，你来指挥，旱鸭子！给我们定个去岛上的航线！
Ahoy, this must be the booty. Fret not, Argus is keepin' the ship prepared so we can leave.
嘿，这一定就是宝藏了。别担心，Argus 会把船准备好，我们随时能走。
A'ight, let's us dig it up, jacks!
Aha, I see somethin' gleaming in there! Methinks we hit gold, lads.
啊哈，我看到里面有东西在闪！我看我们挖到金子了，伙计们。
Now Martim, knock the lubber out.
好了 Martim，把这旱鸭子打晕。
Wait, there be a clue on the key! Presented to the ruined Galleon, a true path forward will arise.
等等，钥匙上有线索！献给那艘残破的大帆船，真正的前路便会显现。
Garh...I be losin' my patience. Argus arrived, let's ditch the lubber before they awake, hm? This island be hidden by magic, ain't no way they're gettin' found.
嘎……我快没耐心了。Argus 到了，趁那旱鸭子醒来之前把他丢下吧，嗯？这座岛被魔法藏起来了，没人找得到他。
Arright! This key... We might be able to bring Redbeard 'imself back to life... He'll strike terror in the seas again, and we will be 'is crew!
好啊！这把钥匙……我们也许能让 Redbeard 本人复活……他会再次让大海陷入恐惧，而我们就是他的船员！
Leave the hidden island and stop the pirates from stealing Redbeard's Booty.
离开隐藏的岛屿，阻止海盗偷走 Redbeard 的宝藏。
Talk to Marston about his crew at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Marston 谈谈他船员的事。
Can't say I expected all that... Those dogs are quick, eh?
真没想到会变成那样……那帮狗东西手脚真快，是吧？
Fer a landlubber, ye sure are quick. When I got ta Pirate Cove, ye were already but a speck on the horizon.
作为旱鸭子，你可真快。我到 Pirate Cove 的时候，你已经只剩海平线上的一个小点了。
Speakin' of, what'n the name o' Davy Jones' Locket happened out there?!
说到这个，以 Davy Jones 的挂坠盒之名，外面到底发生了什么？！
Ye look a bit bruised! Reckon ye ran aground o' trouble with 'em too, eh?
你看起来有点青一块紫一块的！我猜你也跟他们闹出麻烦了，是吧？
Well, lad! Methinks ye oughta go in after 'em! We may be a rowdy lot, but a mutiny's somethin' ye don't tolerate.
好吧，小子！我看你应该追上去！我们或许是一群粗人，但叛变是绝不能容忍的。
They don't deserve that treasure, lad! It ain't be mine either, since I missed ye. That gold be yours fer the takin...so take it!
他们不配拿那份宝藏，小子！既然我错过了你，那也不算是我的了。那些金子你尽管拿……拿去吧！
Speakin' of...I ain't got much a penny ta my name, but I found this fish while ye were gone. I hear it sells for a decent haul, so here.
说到这个……我身上没几个钱，不过你不在的时候我找到了这条鱼。听说它能卖个好价钱，给你吧。
Talk to Batelu in Bob's Tomb.
与 Bob 之墓里的 Batelu 对话。
Hello adventurer! I see you want to solve the mystery of Bob's tomb also? Glad to meet you.
你好，冒险者！看来你也想解开 Bob 之墓的谜团？很高兴认识你。
My name is Batelu. Lately, I've been studying these strange symbols on the walls.
我叫 Batelu。最近我一直在研究墙上这些奇怪的符号。
It's about Bob. Hopefully you do not believe the stories of his death, right? Bob couldn't have died so easily. Not to something so mundane as a wolf.
是关于 Bob 的。希望你不相信那些关于他死因的故事，对吧？Bob 不可能那么轻易就死了。更不可能死在狼这种平凡的东西手里。
He wasn't only strong, he was absolutely un-killable, a master in almost every skill.
他不只是强大，他根本杀不死，几乎样样精通。
I believe he knew he was about to die. How? What of? Nobody knows, but he left this world prepared.
我相信他知道自己快死了。怎么知道的？死于什么？没人知道，但他离开这个世界之前已经做好了准备。
You see, it says here Bob had three loyal animals. Before dying, he scattered them across the ocean.
是这样的，这里写着 Bob 有三只忠诚的动物。死之前，他把它们散布到大海各处。
I think those animals are the key to accessing his real tomb...
我认为那些动物就是进入他真正墓穴的关键……
You see that little gap right there? It's the entrance...
看到那边那个小缝隙了吗？那就是入口……
Unfortunately, nobody was able to remove the spell blocking it.
可惜，一直没人能解除封住它的法术。
But I can. I know how to open the passage to Bob. This is where the animals will come in useful...
但我能。我知道怎么打开通往 Bob 的通道。这就是那些动物派上用场的地方……
Bring me [{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather], [{~} Baab's Wool] [{~} Mooington's Skin] if you can find them.
如果你找得到，就把 [{~} Cluckles 最爱的羽毛]、[{~} Baab 的羊毛]、[{~} Mooington 的皮] 带给我。
How is your quest going along?
你的任务进行得怎么样了？
I am not worthy enough to enter it. I did not complete the task of the animals, I merely read it. You shall go alone. Be careful.
我不配进去。我没有完成动物的任务，只是读到了而已。你一个人去吧。小心。
I believe Bob did something to those animals. I think if we could reunite them in some way, we could open the passage.
我相信 Bob 对那些动物做了什么。我想如果我们能用某种方式让它们重聚，就能打开通道。
Bring me {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, {~} Baab's Wool & {~} Mooington's Skin if you can find them.
如果你找得到，就把 {~} 根 Cluckles 最爱的羽毛、{~} 份 Baab 的羊毛和 {~} 张 Mooington 的皮带给我。
I am sure that together, we can open the passage. Good luck.
我相信我们一起一定能打开通道。祝你好运。
Bring back {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, Baab's Wool, and Mooington's Skin to Batelu.
把 {~} 根 Cluckles 最爱的羽毛、Baab 的羊毛和 Mooington 的皮带回给 Batelu。
Wonderful! We can now open the passage to the true tomb of Bob...
太好了！现在我们可以打开通往 Bob 真正墓穴的通道了……
I am not worthy enough to enter it. I did not complete the task of the animals, merely read it. You shall go alone, be careful.
我不配进去。我没有完成动物的任务，只是读到了而已。你一个人去吧，小心。
I am Bob, master of the arts of Wynn.
我是 Bob，Wynn 诸艺的大师。
Let me explain why you are here.
让我来解释你为什么在这里。
My animals, were my greatest allies in my travels through the world.
我的动物，是我周游世界时最好的伙伴。
I travelled too far, mined too deep, and of course challenged what should not be challenged. My time in Wynn was coming to an end.
我走得太远，挖得太深，当然也挑战了不该挑战的东西。我在 Wynn 的时间快要结束了。
I knew so, too. But I refused to leave without giving the power i had attained to those worthy of it.
我自己也知道。但在把我获得的力量交给配得上的人之前，我不愿离开。
Using what ability I had left to me, I transferred my power to my animals, in three pieces. In the hope that those worthy to harness it will seek them out.
我用仅剩的能力，把我的力量分成三份，转移到我的动物身上。希望配得上驾驭它的人会去找到它们。
The spell I placed on the door to this realm will only break to the one who collects my power. But it cannot have escaped your notice, you do not have my power.
我在通往这个领域的门上施的法术，只会为收集了我力量的人解开。但你一定已经发现了，你身上并没有我的力量。
The truth is, you must pass a test, the ultimate test. Hone your skills you have learnt throughout your travels, and face me. Face me, and earn your place amongst soldiers of Wynn.
事实是，你必须通过一场考验，终极的考验。磨练你一路上学到的技艺，来面对我。面对我，赢得你在 Wynn 士兵之中的一席之地。
Bring back {~} Bob's Seal of Approval to Batelu.
把 {~} 个 Bob 的认可印章带回给 Batelu。
Ah! You have returned! Tell me, what did you find within?
啊！你回来了！告诉我，你在里面发现了什么？
...You faced Bob himself in combat? And you triumphed? That's quite remarkable!
……你跟 Bob 本人交手了？而且赢了？这太了不起了！
And he gave you his Seal of Approval... Hm. If that is the case, then there is something I may do for you.
