想办法从洞穴尽头的天窗逃出去。
Another town? Or another part of the same one? I’m not sure..
又一个小镇？还是同一个小镇的另一部分？我不确定……
This one even seems to have a forge and a tailor.. It was a full, proper village!
这里甚至好像有锻造炉和裁缝铺……这曾经是个完整像样的村子！
{u}, look! I can see the sky from here! M- maybe there’s a way to get up!
{u}，你看！从这里能看到天空！也、也许有办法上去！
I think.. what if we can use this geyser somehow? It looks dormant, but I feel like we can activate it again.
我在想……要是我们能想办法利用这个间歇泉呢？它看起来是休眠的，不过我觉得我们能让它重新喷发。
You take a look around, I’ll be resting a little. I don’t think I’ve ever walked this much in my life…
你四处看看，我休息一下。我这辈子大概从没走过这么多路……
W-Wait.. that’ll be quite a long fall after we get launched up. Can you try making some safety equipment, like a parachute or some really soft boots?
等、等等……被喷上去之后可是会摔很远。你能不能试着做些安全装备，像降落伞或是很软的靴子？
You’ve already made something? Let me see.
你已经做好了？让我看看。
This looks… usable? It’s something, at least.
这看起来……能用？至少算是个东西。
Probably the best we’ll get down here. Are you sure you don’t need anything for yourself? No? Okay.
在这下面大概也只能弄到这样了。你确定你自己不需要什么吗？不用？好吧。
I can’t wait to see the look on their faces when we get back. We’ve just saved the legacy of Siegfried!
我等不及看我们回去时他们脸上的表情了。我们刚刚拯救了 Siegfried 的传奇！
W-we made it? ...{u}, WE DID IT! WE'RE BACK! HAHAAA! I'M ALIVE!
我、我们成功了？……{u}，我们做到了！我们回来了！哈哈哈！我还活着！
Hello there! It is I, Siegfried, and I just stopped the threat that was this cave!
你们好！我就是 Siegfried，我刚刚解除了这个洞穴的威胁！
Hah, that’s a great costume you have there! Looks just like me!
哈，你这身装扮真不错！看起来跟我一模一样！
Hah, don't mind that jokester over there. He does have an impressive costume though!
哈，别理那边那个爱开玩笑的家伙。不过他那身装扮倒是很像样！
W-what's going on here? You can't replace me!
这、这是怎么回事？你们不能取代我！
Look over there! Those must be fireworks to celebrate my victory!
快看那边！那一定是庆祝我胜利的烟火！
Well, anyways! You had a really bad fall in that cave there. I carried you out myself, you must’ve had some wild hallucinations.
好啦，总之！你在那个洞穴里摔得很惨。是我亲自把你背出来的，你一定是产生了什么离谱的幻觉。
Even though it was your own mistake, I’ll return you the emeralds you spent on the scavenger hunt.. and some more as compensation. That'll be.. [{~} Liquified Emeralds]!
虽然是你自己的失误，我还是会把你花在寻宝游戏上的绿宝石还给你……再加上一些补偿。一共是……[{~} 液态绿宝石]！
I must return to {p} for the celebration now. Perhaps we will meet again at the next scavenger hunt!
我现在得回 {p} 参加庆祝了。也许我们会在下一场寻宝游戏再见！
Hello there, human! It is I, Siegfried! You must have just missed how I expertly ended the threat of this monster-ridden cave!
你好，人类！我就是 Siegfried！你一定刚好错过了我干净利落地扫平这个怪物横行的洞穴的样子！
{u}, I'm glad to see you managed to get out alive. That must have been quite a fall into the chasm.
{u}，很高兴看到你活着出来了。掉进那道深渊一定摔得不轻。
Of course, I got out easily using my spells and great knowledge of caves! Well, I must be off now. Maybe we may meet again if you win the next scavenger hunt!
当然，我靠我的法术和对洞穴的丰富知识轻松脱身了！好了，我得走了。如果你赢了下一场寻宝游戏，我们也许会再见！
As compensation for your unfortunate accident, Siegfried will return you the emeralds spent on purchasing scavenger hunt items, and some more as compensation.
为了补偿你遭遇的不幸意外，Siegfried 会把你购买寻宝物品花的绿宝石还给你，再加上一些补偿。
That should amount to... {~} Liquid Emeralds. We apologize for the difficulties you encountered during your adventure with Siegfried, The Hero of Gavel!
一共是……{~} 液态绿宝石。对于你在与 Gavel 的英雄 Siegfried 冒险期间遇到的困难，我们深表歉意！
- 天空厨房: 与 Siegfried 一起下厨！
I've been saving up for this scavenger hunt all year, there's no way I can lose!
我为了这场寻宝游戏存了一整年的钱，绝对不可能输！
Participating in the Siegfried Scavenger Hunt? If you are, the theatre's right behind me.
要参加 Siegfried 寻宝游戏吗？要的话，剧院就在我身后。
The winner of this hunt will have the privilege of going on a once-in-a-lifetime, fully authentic, adventure with me!
这场寻宝的赢家，将荣幸地与我一同踏上一场千载难逢、货真价实的冒险！
The map's in the upper level of the airship. Ignore anything else you find there.
地图在飞艇上层。那里别的东西你都不用管。
Maybe you should get the rope too...
也许你该把绳子也带上……
This rope may be useful later on...
这条绳子待会儿也许用得上……
Hey, I told you to stay behind me! I have to enter the cave first!
嘿，我不是叫你待在我后面吗！必须由我先进洞穴！
You should jump in after him.
[!] This quest uses particles to display some information. It is recommended to have at least some particles enabled to enhance your experience.
[!] 这个任务会用粒子效果来显示部分信息。建议至少开启一部分粒子效果，以获得更好的体验。
He's unconscious. Perhaps there's something around here to wake him up?
他昏过去了。也许附近有什么东西能把他弄醒？
这应该能把 Siegfried 叫醒。
This boulder is stopping the portcullis chains... You'd need a pickaxe to break it, however.
这块大石头卡住了吊闸的铁链……不过得有镐子才能把它敲碎。
It's an old mining expedition's log:
这是一支旧日采矿探险队的日志:
Supplies are limited, excavation yielding little success.
补给有限，挖掘收效甚微。
We've attempted going around the portcullis, but the beast in the only cave past it killed one of our crew.
我们试过绕开吊闸，但吊闸后面唯一那个洞穴里的野兽杀了我们一名队员。
Apart from the portcullis, there are no signs of villagers or of the town itself. The team is beginning to doubt its existence.
除了吊闸，这里看不到村民的踪影，也没有小镇本身的痕迹。队员们开始怀疑它到底存不存在了。
The return crew is lowering the crane tomorrow, so it's unlikely we can find anything before then. Logs will be left for use of any future excavations.
回程的队伍明天就会把起重机放下来，在那之前我们不太可能有什么发现了。日志会留在这里，供今后的挖掘队使用。
The rest of the log lists geological information about the cave and a supply manifest.
日志余下的部分列的是这个洞穴的地质信息和一份补给清单。
Find a way deeper into the cave and lead Siegfried there with you.
找到深入洞穴的路，并带着 Siegfried 一起过去。
The cage fell! You should go help Siegfried out.
笼子掉下来了！你该去把 Siegfried 救出来。
Siegfried has died in the cage. You'll have to find your way out yourself.
Siegfried 死在了笼子里。你只能自己找路出去了。
It seems the trap machinery broke down!
看来陷阱的机关坏掉了！
This area seems like a good place to rest before moving on. Siegfried would have been overjoyed to see this.
这一带看起来是个继续前进之前歇脚的好地方。Siegfried 要是能看到这里，一定会高兴坏的。
Maybe that web would fall if you cut the ones supporting it?
也许把支撑它的那些网割断，那张网就会掉下来？
It looks like the way forward is across the yellow shards...
看来前进的路在那些黄色碎片的另一边……
Picking up lava with your bare hands seems like a bad idea.
徒手去捞熔岩，好像不是个好主意。
... Is that sunlight at the other side of the cave?
This is a sewing machine.. It still seems to work.
这是一台缝纫机……看起来还能用。
It's a tailor's notes on how to create some items:
这是一位裁缝的笔记，写着几样物品的做法:
To Sarnim - If you really wanted to learn the craft, here's some simple items to get you started.
致 Sarnim - 你要是真想学这门手艺，这里有几样简单的东西可以让你入门。
Parachute: Some cloth and rope. I haven't found any rope since the shattering, I don't think there's any in the storage either.
降落伞: 一些布料和绳子。大崩裂之后我就再没找到过绳子，仓库里应该也没有。
Soft Boots: Cloth, and some soft slime. I usually get my slime from the spider burrows past the gate.
软靴: 布料，再加一些软史莱姆。我的史莱姆通常是从大门外的蜘蛛巢穴弄来的。
Hard Boots: Cloth and leather. These hurt quite a bit, so be careful. There should be some leather in the storage if you make these.
硬靴: 布料和皮革。穿起来相当疼，所以要小心。你要做的话，仓库里应该还有些皮革。
It's an old notebook listing some research about geysers:
这是一本旧笔记本，记着一些关于间歇泉的研究：
The geyser was active back before the shattering, but it seems to have filled up.
这个间歇泉在大崩裂之前还是活跃的，但现在好像已经被填满了。
It hasn't erupted in weeks. However! My studies on the small geysers have proven lava can activate them again!
它已经好几个星期没喷发了。不过！我对小间歇泉的研究证明，熔岩能让它们重新喷发！
Hannux still refuses to give me molten metal from his forge, though. My next tests ought to convince him.
可 Hannux 还是不肯把他锻造炉里的熔融金属给我。我接下来的实验应该能说服他。
It's an old, tattered book labelled 'Sustainable Food in the Caverns, by Hannux and Ilorav'
这是一本破旧的书，上面写着《洞穴中的可持续食物》，Hannux 与 Ilorav 著
This document should outline a sustainable method for the continued survival of our town for however long we may be in these caverns.
本文件旨在概述一套可持续的办法，无论我们要在这些洞穴里待多久，都能让我们的小镇继续存续下去。
Multiple varieties of mushrooms have grown in the years after the shattering. These are edible and a primary source of food.
大崩裂之后的这些年里，这里长出了多种蘑菇。它们可以食用，是主要的食物来源。
A bioluminescent material allows for trees and grass to grow, albeit very slowly.
一种生物发光的物质让树木和草得以生长，只是长得非常慢。
We recommend taking good care of the trees, grass, and bushes - they may become a valuable source of food in the future.
我们建议好好照料树木、草和灌木，它们将来可能成为宝贵的食物来源。
We have also found that there is very little edible plant life outside of our section of the cave.
我们还发现，在我们这片洞穴区域之外，几乎没有可食用的植物。
A smaller group was far less lucky than us and ended up in an area with virtually no edible material - we found the remains of their homes in a recent expedition.
有一小群人远没有我们这么幸运，落到了一片几乎没有任何东西可吃的区域，我们在最近一次探险中发现了他们住处的残迹。
A species of spiders and creeping mold has appeared as well. These are not suitable for consumption, and should be left alone. They are peaceful unless attacked.
此外还出现了一种蜘蛛和一种蔓生的霉菌。它们不适合食用，不要去招惹。只要不受到攻击，它们是温和的。
The rest of the book seems to be repeating the same information but in extreme detail.
书的其余部分似乎是在重复同样的内容，只是详细到了极点。
Tickets for sale! Get your Siegfried Scavenger Hunt tickets here!
卖票啦！Siegfried 寻宝游戏的票在这里买！
You sense you're going back the way you came...
你感觉自己正沿着来时的路往回走……
You'd need an explosive to disable this. There don't seem to be any in here, however.
得有炸药才能让它停摆。不过这里面好像一个都没有。
You get a sense you're going backwards...
There's some small caves around here.. Maybe there'll be something edible there?
这附近有几个小洞穴……也许那里会有能吃的东西？
I don't... feel too good. I think.. I can move on though, as soon as you're ready.
我……感觉不太舒服。不过我想……我还能继续走，你准备好了就出发。
This oven still seems to be in working order.
Those lines of silk from the big web are holding it up. If you cut all three, it might break.
那些从大网上拉出来的蛛丝把它撑着。如果你把三根都割断，它可能就会塌下来。
You get a sense you're going the wrong way...
你感觉自己走错方向了……
Good thing we got past that chasm! Let's keep going!
还好我们过了那道深渊！我们继续走吧！
.. {u}... are you sure those u-uncooked eggs were.. safe?
……{u}……你确定那些没、没煮过的蛋……是安全的吗？
Ugh.. I don't feel.. very good..
I can feel.. something.. ins--- AAAAAAARHGH!
我感觉到……有什么东西……在里——啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！
A human? Agh! Don't worry about getting me medical attention, I've got this under control...
是人类！啊！不用担心帮我找医生，我自己能处理……
It's a broken leg. I'm already getting it treated, but I have a job to do elsewise- and a time sensitive one, too.
腿断了。我已经在治疗了，但我另外还有一份工作要做——而且还有时间限制。
I won't be able to do it like this, but it doesn't matter if I'm the one who carries it out. It just needs to be done.
我这样是办不了的，不过由谁来办都无所谓。只要把它办完就行。
I don't work for villagers, I was hired to come here by other humans... there's something you must keep secret.
我不是替村民做事的，是别的人类雇我来这里的……有件事你必须保密。
Swear it! If you're going to take the job, and my payment for it, you must be silent about it!
发誓！如果你要接这份工作，拿我的报酬，就必须守口如瓶！
There is a hidden town in the canyon here. Up in the mountains- it was built and run by humans.
这座峡谷里有个隐秘的小镇。在山上——是人类建造、人类在管理的。
Now, the villagers have very strict rules about humans founding cities in their lands, and it's VERY illegal.
听着，村民对人类在他们的土地上建立城市有非常严格的规定，这是严重违法的。
I was contacted by the Mayor because he is aware that the town may have become... compromised.
镇长联系了我，因为他知道小镇可能已经……暴露了。
The job is to figure out who and why, of course. To let this slip could collapse the treatise between our races.
工作内容当然是查出是谁、为什么。要是让这件事泄露出去，我们两个种族之间的条约可能会崩溃。
I've never been to the city in the mountains, but I was given instructions. Here, I'll write down the location in your book.
我从来没去过山上那座城，但我拿到了指示。来，我把地点写进你的书里。
Be aware though, they won't let you in unless the area is safe. They can't risk villagers wandering in.
不过要注意，除非周围安全，否则他们不会放你进去。他们不能冒险让村民闯进去。
Head to [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find the human town.
Hm? Oh, a fellow adventurer, I see! I'm sorry, but this discovery is mine to make. There's something strange about that door...
嗯？噢，一位冒险同好啊！抱歉，但这个发现是我的。那扇门有点古怪……
Deadly gasses? Nonsense! As you can see the two of us are breathing just fine.
致命毒气？胡说！你看，我们俩呼吸得好好的。
You want me to leave? Why, so that you can have all of the glory for yourself? Ha, not a chance!
你要我离开？为什么，好让你独占所有荣耀？哈，想都别想！
The only way I'm leaving is if I can get that door open or if the whole cave starts crashing down on us.
除非我能打开那扇门，或者整个洞窟开始塌下来砸在我们头上，否则我是不会走的。
Gweh! I just had to go running my mouth about the cave collapsing! I'm out- if you have any sense you'll leave too!
呃！我就不该乱说洞窟会塌！我走了——你要是有脑子也赶快走！
loud mechanical noise can be heard coming from the door
可以听见门那边传来很大的机械声
Go up to the door and inspect the noise.
走到门前查看声音的来源。
Thank you for getting rid of that curious villager! We thought he'd never leave.
谢谢你把那个好奇的村民赶走了！我们还以为他永远不会走。
I've never seen you before. Who gave you access to the town?
我从没见过你。是谁准你进入小镇的？
You're here in place of the detective the mayor hired?
你是来代替镇长雇的那个侦探的？
Normally, I wouldn't believe that, but come in. We're desperate.
平常我是不会信的，不过进来吧。我们走投无路了。
If you ever need to leave and get back, I can simply open the way.
如果你需要出去再回来，我可以直接帮你开路。
You probably should be going now. Our mayor can get impatient.
你大概该走了。我们镇长可没什么耐心。
Talk to Mayor Eoric in the town hall.
与镇政厅里的 Eoric 镇长交谈。
What are you doing here? I'm writing an important letter, this better be worth my time.
你在这里干什么？我正在写一封重要的信，你最好有值得我花时间的事。
What? Narder sent you? Why'd he send a {p} soldier?
什么？Narder 派你来的？他为什么派一个 {p} 的士兵来？
I didn't think the army were authorized to know about {p}, especially Fruma recruits.
我以为军队无权知道 {p} 的事，尤其是 Fruma 来的新兵。
Anyway, {p}'s secrecy is in great danger. We have found evidence of a traitor.
总之，{p} 的秘密正面临极大的危险。我们找到了有叛徒的证据。
We have locked down all of the exits. No one leaves or enters without my permission.
我们已经封锁了所有出口。没有我的许可，谁都不能进出。
We need a detective to sniff out the traitor and expose him.
我们需要一个侦探把叛徒揪出来，揭穿他。
Start by asking the citizens around here about anything suspicious they've seen.
先去问问附近的市民有没有看到什么可疑的事。
When you find the culprit, remember to leave him alive! The guards will take care of him.
找到犯人的时候，记住要留活口！守卫会处理他。
向 {p} 的市民询问那张字条的事。
Sorry, detective, but I haven't seen anything suspicious. In fact, I haven't even left my house for the last week.
抱歉，侦探，我没看到什么可疑的事。说实话，我上个星期连家门都没出过。
The only suspicious thing I've seen is a hooded man walking around. There's not many people in {p}, so it's weird.
我唯一看到的可疑的事，是有个戴兜帽的男人在附近走来走去。{p} 人不多，所以挺奇怪的。
If you want to find out anything, the best person to ask is Lumilda. She's in her bakery, next to the Scroll Shop.
如果你想打听什么，最好去问 Lumilda。她在她的面包店里，就在卷轴店旁边。
Ah, detective! What brings you to the sweet Lumilda's Bakery?
啊，侦探！是什么风把你吹到甜蜜的 Lumilda 面包店来的？
Hm, yes, there is a weird person coming through.
嗯，是啊，确实有个怪人来过。
It's a hooded man. Never seen the face. A trouble maker, if you ask me!
是个戴兜帽的男人。从来没看过他的脸。要我说，就是个惹麻烦的家伙！
He's been here a few times, usually writing things on a piece of paper. That man's a real mystery. No one even knows where he lives.
他来过几次，通常在一张纸上写东西。那个男人真是个谜。连他住在哪都没人知道。
One time my grandson couldn't resist and followed the man. Last thing he saw was the man leaving through the Eastern Exit.
有一次我孙子忍不住跟踪了他。最后看到他从东边出口离开了。
Ain't that a place to start, sweetheart?
这不就是个线索吗，亲爱的？
Inspect anything beyond the Eastern Exit.
检查东边出口外面的一切。
Ah, you must be the detective. None of those half-witted Eltomites could figure it out.
啊。那你一定就是那个侦探了。那些脑子不灵光的 Eltom 人是想不出来的。
I guess the Grook is out of the pen then.
看来 Grook 已经跑出圈了。
This town shouldn't even be here. Humans aren't allowed to own land in Gavel like this.
这个小镇根本就不该存在。人类不准像这样在 Gavel 拥有土地。
These Humans couldn’t be bothered to fight their own war, so they hid an entire city here.
这些人类懒得自己去打他们的仗，就在这里藏了一整座城。
Traitor? I’m no traitor. I'm just looking to carry out the law where it needs to be carried out. Nothing personal, yes?
叛徒？我可不是叛徒。我只是想在需要执法的地方执法而已。不针对个人，好吗？
Maybe they'll actually use "Ardulf" instead of saying "freak" once they've seen the good I can do for them!
等他们见识到我能为他们做的好事，也许就会真的叫我“Ardulf”，而不是叫我“怪胎”了！
Read the note on the table.
- 飞艇 {~}:{~} 从 {p} 出发前往 {p}
戴兜帽的男人……爬上塔了……
Demanded to use a ship... I refused...
强行要求使用一艘船……我拒绝了……
He beat me up... And left...
他把我打了一顿……然后走了……
Head up to the Airbase's Tower to confront the hooded man.
爬上航空基地的塔楼，与戴兜帽的男人对质。
What are you doing here? Why are you protecting this illegal town?
你在这里干什么？你为什么要保护这个违法的小镇？
The Villagers will not be happy about {p}. This could seriously harm the Gavel-Wynn relationship.
村民不会乐见 {p} 的存在。这可能会严重损害 Gavel 与 Wynn 的关系。
You can't stop me. You wouldn't murder one of your own, would you?
你拦不住我的。你不会杀害自己的同胞吧，嗯？
I will tell the mayor of {p} all about this place, and claim my reward for doing so. I will be rich and if you want to stop me you'll have to do it yourself.
我会把这地方的事全都告诉 {p} 的镇长，然后领取我的奖赏。我会发大财，你要是想阻止我，就得亲自动手。
...you got snuck up on and knocked out. Where are you now?
……你被人从背后偷袭打昏了。你现在在哪里？
Escape your cell and find a way to sabotage the ship.
逃出牢房，想办法破坏这艘船。
Talk to {p}'s Mayor at the top of {p}.
与 {p} 的镇长对话，他在 {p} 的顶端。
What brings a human to my office?
是什么风把一个人类吹进了我的办公室？
I wrote the location of the city in your content book. There's nothing else I can do to help you.
我已经把那座城市的位置写进你的内容手册里了。除此之外，我也帮不上什么忙了。
- Mayor's office on the top layer of {p}
- 镇长办公室在 {p} 的最上层
- Remember to set up Dwarven bank account
- 记得去开矮人银行的账户
The ship you're running is a mess. This is the third time I've had to repair a coolant leak here.
你开的这艘船简直一团糟。这已经是我第三次来这里修冷却液泄漏了。
The Corkian machines are great, but they aren't eternal. At this rate, you'll need a new ship every winter.
Corkian 的机器是很棒，但也不是永远不坏。照这样下去，你每年冬天都得换一艘新船。
Is it that hard to understand that no liquid should enter the engine?
“任何液体都不能进引擎”，这有那么难懂吗？
A letter? Oh, that. The one about {p}? Don't look so worried. The secret is safe with me.
一封信？噢，那个啊。关于 {p} 的那封？别那么担心。这个秘密我会守住的。
Yes, I know about {p}. After all, its mayor is my ex-husband.
对，我知道 {p} 的事。毕竟，那里的镇长是我的前夫。
It may seem odd, a love between a villager and a human. I know, but our race did not stop us from being in love.
村民和人类相爱，听起来也许很奇怪。我知道，但种族并没有阻止我们相爱。
The person who left the letter about {p} is our son, Ardulf. As soon as Eoric found out about our child, he panicked and left me.
留下那封关于 {p} 的信的人，是我们的儿子 Ardulf。Eoric 一发现我们有了孩子，就慌了，丢下了我。
Ardulf will never be accepted as a half breed... Still, I hope he's OK.
Ardulf 是混血儿，永远不会被接纳……尽管如此，我还是希望他平安无事。
Huh, oh yeah, one more thing. The switch under the table... go on, press it!
嗯？噢对了，还有一件事。桌子底下的开关……去吧，按下去！
Talk to Twendle at The {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
与 {p} [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Twendle 对话
Oh, hey you there! Are you heading down this road? You know it's a dead end, right?
噢，嘿，那边的！你要走这条路吗？你知道这是条死路吧？
It leads to an old mansion, that has fallen into decay.
它通往一座已经荒废的老宅。
That mansion is the house of my ancestor; Dwendle Twain. It was a house of incredible heritage and magical powers, Dwendle himself was adopted into it.
那座宅邸是我祖先 Dwendle Twain 的家。那是一个传承非凡、拥有魔法力量的家族，Dwendle 本人是被收养进去的。
Marius Twain was the leader of the mansion; they fought against evil spirits, I think. The history of the house is not well-known, outside of a novel.
Marius Twain 是宅邸的主人，我想他们是在对抗恶灵。除了一本小说以外，这个家族的历史没什么人知道。
I want to know the history of the mansion and uncover its secrets, but every time I get close, dark beings prevent me from entering.
我想知道宅邸的历史、揭开它的秘密，可每次我一靠近，就有黑暗的东西挡着不让我进去。
I am no soldier, and I don't think I will ever uncover the truth without your help. I can greatly reward you for your help.
我不是士兵，没有你的帮助，我想我永远查不出真相。你帮了我，我会重重酬谢你。
My ancestor left our family a large amount of emeralds. Beware though, traveller, the mansion's secrets are incredibly difficult to uncover and the monsters are powerful.
我的祖先给家里留下了一大笔绿宝石。不过要小心，旅人，宅邸的秘密极难解开，里面的怪物也很强。
Unravel the secrets of the mansion and help me uncover the secrets of my heritage. Bring me [{~} Twain Journal].
解开宅邸的秘密，帮我揭开我家族传承的秘密。把 [{~} Twain 日志] 带给我。
This book has been hidden within the depths of the mansion and is protected by far more than puzzles or walls.
这本书藏在宅邸深处，守护它的远不只是谜题和墙壁。
I believe the spirits that now haunt the mansion will do anything to protect the book. I'm sure they think it's their own, and the secrets it hides.
我相信现在盘踞宅邸的灵魂会不惜一切保护这本书。我敢肯定，它们把这本书和书里藏的秘密当成自己的东西。
把 [{~} Twain 日志] 带给 Twendle
If you already have a Ghostly Cap, you can wear that one and do not have to do any previous steps in order for the quest to work.
如果你已经有 Ghostly Cap，戴上它就行，不必完成前面的步骤，任务也能正常进行。
I guess I put my faith in the right person. My history lies within these pages, and I don't intend to keep them secret. I shall make them public.
看来我没信错人。我的家族历史就在这些书页里，我不打算保密。我要把它们公之于众。
Thank you traveller. As promised, here is your reward.
谢谢你，旅人。说好的，这是你的奖励。
I know uncovering the truth is never easy, but keep trying, please bring me [{~} Twain Journal].
我知道要查明真相从来都不容易，但请继续努力，把 [{~} Twain 日志] 带来给我。
Ho, traveller! I need the help of a true explorer. I can see it in your eyes, you are an adventurer like me!
嘿，旅人！我需要一位真正的探险家帮忙，我从你眼里看得出来，你跟我一样是个冒险者！
While you are here, adventurer, I could use your help with something. I have gotten myself into a small predicament in my travels.
既然你来了，冒险者，我有件事想请你帮忙。我在旅途中遇到了一点小麻烦。
You see, me and three others were on a grand expedition to explore the entire canyon! Unfortunately, we ran into a slight problem...
是这样的，我和另外三个人正在进行一场宏大的探险，要把整座峡谷探索个遍！可惜我们碰上了一点小问题……
The {p} is clearly called that for a reason, within hours, we had lost each other!
{p} 叫这个名字显然是有原因的，没过几个小时，我们就走散了！
Luckily, we were prepared for it. We each carried a flag so if we ever got lost, we can raise it to be found.
幸好我们有准备。我们每个人都带了一面旗子，万一迷路了，就把旗子升起来让人找到。
They were all meant to come to my blue flag, but they must all be trapped in some predicament! The canyon can be a dangerous place.
他们应该都要来我的蓝旗这里集合，可他们一定都被什么麻烦困住了！峡谷可是个危险的地方。
I can see all three red flags from here, but it would be terrible if I went looking and they came back to this flag to find me gone!
三面红旗我在这里都看得到，可要是我去找他们，他们却回到这面旗子发现我不在，那就糟了！
Do you think you could go and check if they're all alright? I'm sure I can find some reward for you if you help!
你能不能去看看他们是不是都没事？如果你帮忙，我一定能找点奖励给你！
Find the three lost crew members at the red flags around [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 周围的红旗处找到三名走散的队员
……啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！！！救命啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！有鸟啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！
HUMAN! YOU, DOWN THERE! HELP ME! I was just trying to find my way back to my friends...
人类！下面的你！救救我！我只是想找路回到我朋友那里……
When this GIANT BIRD KIDNAPPED ME and threw me in her nest! I think she thinks I'm one of her chicks!
结果这只巨鸟把我抓走，丢进了她的巢里！我觉得她把我当成她的雏鸟了！
The Canyon's movements must've dislodged her eggs from her nest-
一定是峡谷的变动把她的蛋从巢里震出去了——
O-OH GROOK, SHE'S PECKING ME! FIND HER EGGS NEARBY AND THROW THEM UP HERE... QUICKLY!!
噢、噢 GROOK 啊，她在啄我！在附近找到她的蛋，扔上来……快点！！
YOU HAVE THE EGGS?? GOOD! THROW THEM UP HERE, PLEASE!!!
你拿到蛋了？？太好了！拜托，扔上来！！！
W-WOAH, STAY BACK, BIRD! I have a... uhh... I DON'T HAVE A WEAPON, HUMAN! PLEASE HURRY UP!
哇、哇哦，退后，鸟！我有……呃……我没有武器啊，人类！拜托快点！
YES YES YES!!! THANK YOU, HUMAN! Oh, thank grook, this bird's leaving me alone now... It worked!
好好好！！！谢谢你，人类！哦，谢天谢 Grook，这只鸟现在不理我了……成功了！
I'll head back to Dejol, now... And I'm never going to go near another bird again!
我现在就回 Dejol 那里去……而且我再也不要靠近任何鸟了！
A-ah, hello. I'm g-guessing Dejol sent you?
啊、啊，你好。我、我猜是 Dejol 派你来的？
W-Well, I was just walking through the c-canyon, when... the ground suddenly rose up underneath me and launched me all the way up here!
我、我当时只是在峡、峡谷里走着，结果……地面突然在我脚下升起来，一路把我弹到了这上面！
N-Now, I'm... embarrassed to admit it, but I'm REALLY afraid of heights, s-so I don't know what to do... Do you have any ideas?
现、现在，我……说出来很丢脸，但我真的很怕高，所、所以我不知道该怎么办……你有什么主意吗？
Y-YOU JERK!! I COULD HAVE DIED!!! WHAT THE HELL IS WRONG WITH YOU???
你、你这混蛋！！我差点就死了！！你到底有什么毛病？？？
P-Please NEVER do that again! That was the worst thing I've ever done in my entire life!!
拜、拜托千万别再那样了！那是我这辈子做过最可怕的事！！
...Ugh! I-I'm gonna head back to Dejol now. I hope I NEVER see you again!
……唉！我、我现在要回 Dejol 那里去了。希望我再也不用见到你！
Hey there! I'm in a bit of a pickle right now, you see. This house I took refuge in, well... The original owner must have left for a reason!
嘿！是这样的，我现在有点进退两难。我躲进来的这栋房子，嗯……原来的主人离开一定是有原因的！
It's so sad... So many people are constantly displaced by the canyon's movements destroying their homes every year. I remember hearing a story once, it was about—
真让人难过……每年都有好多人因为峡谷的变动毁了家园而流离失所。我记得以前听过一个故事，讲的是——
Wait... Hey, do you hear that?
Hey! You alright down there?! Oh, lord, how are we going to get out of this? I'm up here, come find me.
嘿！下面的你还好吗？！哦天哪，我们要怎么出去？我在上面，来找我。
Oh... Well, this isn't good! The house just went and collapsed on us!
噢……好吧，这下不妙了！房子直接塌在我们身上了！
See what I was talking about human? The canyon isn't really a good place to be. Now we're stuck in this pit!
看到我说的了吧，人类？峡谷真不是个好待的地方。现在我们被困在这个坑里了！
Although... there is a crafting table over there... Hey, maybe you could collect some supplies and make something to get us out of here?
不过……那边有张工作台……嘿，也许你可以收集点材料，做个东西把我们弄出去？
Heh, that's certainly one way to get out of here! You made an entire catapult, huh?
嘿，这倒确实是个出去的办法！你做了一整台投石机，是吧？
Alrighty, I'll be right behind you!
Me first? Okay, I'll do just that!
Hey, I made it!! You should come up as well, now.
嘿，我成功了！！现在你也上来吧。
Woah... That's certainly a lot of fun! Anyways, come talk to me.
哇哦……这可真好玩！总之，过来跟我说话。
Thanks for the help, friend! I couldn't have done it without you!
谢谢你的帮忙，朋友！没有你我办不到！
I'm gonna go find my friend Dejol now— wait, you know who he is??
我现在要去找我的朋友 Dejol 了——等等，你认识他？？
Oh... Wow, guess it's a small world, huh? That's funny! Maybe I'll see you down there later, then!
噢……哇，看来世界真小，是吧？真好笑！那说不定待会儿下面见！
Return to Dejol at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to tell him of your success
回到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Dejol 那里，告诉他你成功了
Ho, adventurer! Looks like you had some adventures helping out my crew!
嘿，冒险者！看来你帮我的队员们经历了不少冒险！
Thank goodness they all found their way back unharmed. Mostly. Yuge's pride seems to have taken a hit.
谢天谢地，他们都平安回来了。大体上吧。Yuge 的自尊心好像受了点伤。
Anyway, we ought to get back to our exploration - and we'll stick closer together this time!
总之，我们该继续探险了——这次我们会靠得更紧一点！
You were a huge help, though so please take this as a reward!
不过你帮了大忙，请收下这份奖励！
You should probably get down to check if she's okay.
你大概该下去看看她有没有事。
Looks like you need [{~} Plank of Wood], [{~} Piece of Rope] and [{~} Chunk of Rock] to craft something useful.
看来你需要 [{~1} 块木板]、[{~2} 段绳子] 和 [{~3} 块石头] 才能做出有用的东西。
Well, that's certainly one way out of here. You should talk to Gordon.
嗯，那确实是离开这里的一种办法。你该去跟 Gordon 谈谈。
So we're just gonna launch ourselves out of this pit? You got it!
所以我们就直接把自己弹出这个坑？没问题！
Who should be launched out of the pit first?
Looks like you've found all three of Dejol's crew members! You should head back to Dejol.
看来你把 Dejol 的三名队员都找到了！你该回去找 Dejol。
Oh, hey there! It's good to see you again. Thanks again for helping me get away from that house— though, I feel kind of bad for the owner...
哦，嘿！很高兴又见到你。再次谢谢你帮我从那栋房子里脱身——不过，我对屋主有点抱歉……
Hey, human! Thanks for helping me with the birds. I managed to sneak down once you gave me the eggs, so... All said and done, now!
喂，人类！谢谢你帮我处理那些鸟。你把蛋给我之后我就顺利溜下来了，所以……现在一切都搞定了！
EEK! A-Are you back to throw me off another cliff, human?? Keep your distance, p-please!
咿！你、你是回来把我从另一座崖上推下去的吗，人类？？请、请你离我远一点！
Ho, adventurer! Thanks for your help again!
嘿，冒险者！再次谢谢你的帮忙！
Get me that urn, Win person. If I go up there covered in guts, I have reason to believe she won't take it well?
把那个骨灰坛给我拿来，Win 人。我要是满身内脏地上去，我有理由相信她不会太高兴吧？
I found this strange creature along the road outside the tower- it dug up from the ground.
我在塔外的路边发现了一只奇怪的生物——它是从地底下钻出来的。
It looked so spindly and thin- I decided to take it in as a pet. I've called her Fiona.
它看起来又细又瘦——我决定把它带回来当宠物养。我给她取名叫 Fiona。
My father is confused as to what it is, and I am too, but it needs some loving care for certain...
父亲弄不清它到底是什么，我也一样，不过它肯定需要有人好好疼爱……
Fiona quite likes my father, it seems! I keep finding her scratching at his door.
看来 Fiona 很喜欢我父亲呢！我老是发现她在挠他的房门。
She seems to like to bite, too...it is a habit I'll need to train out of her, given it leaves my skin pale.
她好像也很爱咬人……这个习惯我得帮她改掉，毕竟被咬过之后我的皮肤都变得苍白了。
My father has died today... I found Fiona atop him. She must have been trying to comfort him...
父亲今天去世了……我发现 Fiona 趴在他身上。她一定是想安慰他吧……
His funeral rites are being sorted. I cannot write more...at least I will have my dear pet.
他的葬礼正在筹办。我写不下去了……至少我还有我亲爱的宠物。
...Fiona was the problem to begin with. I feel sickly and pale, and it all started when she arrived!!
……问题从一开始就出在 Fiona 身上。我浑身不舒服、脸色苍白，而这一切都是从她来了之后开始的！！
I didn't want to admit it- She is the reason my father died, and the reason that I look like death when I look in the mirror!!
我一直不想承认——父亲就是被她害死的，我照镜子时那副死人一样的脸色也是她害的！！
The only consolation is that she seems to have disappeared on her own. Good riddance to her!
唯一值得安慰的是，她好像自己消失了。走了正好！
I dearly need a man to comfort me during these times... Not even a man, anyone will do!!
这种时候我好需要一个男人来安慰我……不是男人也行，谁都好！！
Fine then. Consider yourself lucky that I'm in a...mood. I'll talk with you instead of crackin' yer bones for my bread.
好吧。算你走运，我现在正好……有心情。我就跟你聊聊，不把你的骨头磨了做面包。
Ogres are tough. We're independent and solitary folks. You don't bother us or interfere with our life, we leave well enough alone.
食人魔很强悍。我们独立又孤僻。你不来烦我们、不干涉我们的生活，我们就不管你。
And...well, when it's two ogres getting together, it's simple. But... I passed by a tall tower, and heard a maiden's voice from inside...
而且……嗯，如果是两个食人魔凑在一起，那很简单。可是……我路过一座高塔，听到里面传来一位少女的声音。
If you can help me out, I'd be real grateful. I'm sure I've got somethin' that you'd like in exchange.
如果你能帮我，我会非常感激。我相信我有些你会想要的东西可以交换。
Ohoho! An admirer? Such a lovely, rugged accent! However...if you wish to meet me, I'd like to see your devotion, yes?
哦呵呵！有仰慕者？多么可爱又粗犷的口音！不过……如果你想见我，我想先看看你的诚意，好吗？
There is a lovely urn my father had before. He took it with him to the grave, and I do miss my dear father so.
我父亲以前有个很漂亮的骨灰坛。他把它一起带进了坟墓，而我好想念我亲爱的父亲。
I go into {p}, I'll get attacked. I get attacked, I attack back. They'll come after us...wouldn't want to present her with that. You get that urn for me, alright?
我一进 {p} 就会被攻击。我被攻击就会还手。然后他们就会追杀我们……我可不想拿这种事去见她。你帮我把骨灰坛拿来，好吗？
I've got you some compensation already, so don't worry about gettin' snubbed for credit. Thank you kindly for the help.
你的报酬我已经准备好了，不用担心功劳被抢。谢谢你的帮忙。
Ohoho...you're one of those Humans I've read about, aren't you? Did you truly intend to be my suitor, dear?~
噢呵呵……你是我在书里读到的那种人类吧？你真的打算当我的求婚者吗，亲爱的？～
Oh...my...goodness! A big, strong, strapping ogre!! Not a fairytale, my foot! And so polite, too... Oh, you'll make a perfect husband, heehee~
噢……我的……天哪！又高又壮、魁梧结实的食人魔！！还说不是童话，才怪！而且这么有礼貌……噢，你会是个完美的丈夫，嘻嘻～
Now I'm sure you'll find a nice lad somewhere who'll take you for who you are, but until you find someone that has no standards, shove your creepy lips where I can't see 'em!!
我相信你总会找到一个肯接受真实的你的好小伙，不过在你找到那种毫无标准的人之前，把你那吓人的嘴唇收到我看不见的地方去！！
...I...I g-guess he was rotten to the core, despite his...l-luscious exterior...but, you'll make me feel better, right, you s-studly human? Right?! RIGHT?!!
……我……我、我想他虽然外表……那么诱人……骨子里却烂透了……不过你会让我好受点的，对吧，你这个帅、帅气的人类？对吧？！对吧？！！
Ah! What are you doing in my swamp?! Don't you know that Ogres live alone for a reason?
啊！你在我的沼泽里干什么？！你不知道食人魔独居是有原因的吗？
Eh? You're from across the sea, a land called Win? You certainly don't look like a winner to me, ya small fry.
嗯？你是从海那边来的，一个叫 Win 的地方？你看起来可一点都不像赢家，小不点。
That is, until it's time to find ourselves a partner. Then we'll turn over hell and highwater ta be together.
直到该找伴侣的时候。到那时，我们就算上刀山下火海也要在一起。
Ogres don't live in fairytale towers, or have a voice that could make flowers grow with its lovely lilt!
食人魔可不住童话里的高塔，也没有那种婉转动听、能让花都开起来的嗓音！
I've been tryin' ta figure out how to approach this... I'm gettin' on in years, I need to find someone, and she's the girl.
我一直在想该怎么接近她……我年纪也不小了，得找个伴，而她就是那个人。
Follow the rocky-looking path to find the tower. I'll meet with you there- prepare to be a wingman for an ogre.
沿着那条满是石头的小路就能找到塔。我在那里跟你会合——准备好给食人魔当僚机吧。
Follow the stones in the path to the tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
沿着路上的石头前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的塔
This is the place. She's up at the top... Remember, I won't stop 'til I meet her. Coming here means you're in for the long haul.
就是这里。她在最上面……记住，我不见到她是不会罢休的。来了这里，就代表你得奉陪到底。
I hear a voice outside! Oh, who might it be, I wonder~
我听到外面有声音！噢，会是谁呢，真好奇～
Here goes... Hello, fair lady of the tower! I am Sherk! I heard your voice on the road- and I must meet you myself! ...that's formal enough, right?
来了……你好，塔上美丽的小姐！我是 Sherk！我在路上听到了你的声音——我一定要亲自见你一面！……这样够正式了吧？
Woman, you have no idea what you're sayin' when you ask for devotion.
女人，你要人拿出诚意，根本不知道自己在说什么。
Retrieve the urn for me, so I can have a memento of him. Brave the crypts of {p}, behind the bank... And prove your devotion, dear suitor~
帮我把骨灰坛拿回来，让我有个纪念他的东西。闯进银行后面的 {p} 墓穴……证明你的诚意吧，亲爱的求婚者～
...I'll return! You'll get your urn, no doubt! ... ...and a lovely fine boot up my backside. I don't fancy a massacre for a piece of pottery, Win person.
……我会回来的！你一定会拿到你的骨灰坛！……还有屁股上结结实实挨一脚。我可不想为了一个陶罐大开杀戒，Win 人。
Find the urn in the {p} Catacombs, behind the {p} bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 地下墓穴找到骨灰坛，墓穴就在 {p} 银行后面
And this is why I asked your help. As nice as blood spreads on toast, I have to reserve my sensibilities for the miss.
这就是我找你帮忙的原因。血抹在吐司上是很好吃，但我得在小姐面前保持点风度。
Just one last thing. I doubt she'll be expecting an ogre of all people to climb up her tower. I don't want her to get frightened away.
还有最后一件事。我想她大概想不到爬上塔的会是个食人魔。我不想把她吓跑。
So, Win person. Care to temper her expectations before I arrive? Head up before me.
所以，Win 人。能不能在我到之前先给她打个预防针？你先上去。
Enter the tower and make Sherk confess his love to the maiden.
进入塔中，让 Sherk 向少女表白。
Not exactly, milady! I'm the one seeking your affections- Coming up the ladder. I know I may not be a fairytale husband, but-
不完全是，小姐！想赢得您芳心的是我——正在爬梯子上来。我知道我可能不是童话里的丈夫，但是——
Aren't your type supposed to be less... Ehm... Clefted? Grizzled? Pale?
你们这种人不是应该没那么……呃……下巴裂？胡子拉碴？脸色惨白？
Oh, come here, Sherky-pie, give me a big kiss! And no need to worry, there's plenty more in store for my big hubby after that~
噢，过来嘛，Sherk 小甜心，给我一个大大的吻！别担心，之后还有好多好多留给我的大老公呢～
Cor, lady! Even for an ogre you're layin' it on a bit thick! Aah, you see, ogres, and people like you, they have layers, right? And your first one is... Eh... ...rotten.
天哪，小姐！就算对食人魔来说，你也太肉麻了吧！啊，你看，食人魔，还有你们这种人，都是有很多层的，对吧？而你的第一层是……呃……烂透了。
When the corruption first broke out, undead swarmed the city. It was the first town to be destroyed by the undead.
腐化刚爆发的时候，亡灵涌进了那座城市。它是第一座被亡灵摧毁的城镇。
Looks like the others have gone ahead. You should rendezvous with them closer to the barracks.
看来其他人已经先走了。你该到兵营附近跟他们会合。
Dang, you're right. Can't forget about the historical value. Good catch.
该死，你说得对。可不能忘了它的历史价值。提醒得好。
I've seen soldiers fall and fall and fall, then rise back up again. I've lived through the chaos and death of battle more times than I can count.
我看过士兵倒下、倒下、再倒下，然后又重新站起来。我经历过的战场混乱与死亡，多到我数都数不清。
I suppose I'll start with you. What are two more when compared to dozens?
我想就从你们开始吧。跟几十个人比起来，多两个又算什么？
So, I surrender! Don't see the point in fightin' a pointless battle. Not like we're goin' to be paid after this mess, anyhow.
所以，我投降！没必要打一场毫无意义的仗。反正经过这场乱子，我们也拿不到钱了。
Takan is dead. You should regroup with the others outside the barracks.
Takan 死了。你该到兵营外跟其他人会合。
I'm glad we managed to take him out after all. The things he was saying... he seemed like a very dangerous man.
我很高兴我们最后还是解决了他。他说的那些话……他看起来是个非常危险的人。
Admiral, sir. Some of what Takan was saying, it was-
上将，长官。Takan 说的那些话里，有一些是……
I wouldn't put too much stock in that traitor's words. People like him... all they do is spit vitriol with no merit, riling up the masses against the order we hold.
我不会太把那个叛徒的话当回事。像他那种人……只会满口毫无根据的恶言，煽动群众反抗我们维持的秩序。
He was an angry man holding a grudge for an imagined wrongdoing. There is nothing more to it than that. I would suggest putting it out of your mind.
他只是个为想象出来的冤屈怀恨在心的愤怒之人。仅此而已。我建议你们别再想了。
A general location is useful, though. I'll see if I can get any letters through to him. Thanks for telling me.
不过知道个大概的位置还是有用的。我看看能不能寄几封信给他。谢谢你告诉我。
Talk to the Scout in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or find one in another town.
与 {p} [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的斥候交谈，或者在其他城镇找一位斥候。
Admiral Amerigo of the Almuji Army requests the aid of able-bodied and unmoored soldiers from around the Province of Wynn.
Almuj 军队的 Amerigo 上将，请求 Wynn 行省各地身强体健、目前没有任务在身的士兵支援。
To put it bluntly... they've run into a predicament over there. {p}'s standing army has been taken captive, and the desert barracks overtaken.
直说吧……他们那边遇上麻烦了。{p} 的常备军被俘，沙漠兵营也被占领了。
The Admiral has sent scouts round to gather any free-moving soldiers to help him... remedy the situation.
上将派了斥候四处召集能自由行动的士兵来帮他……收拾这个局面。
... If you ask me, I reckon he'd like this taken care of quietly and discreetly. I don't blame the man, really, given the circumstances.
……要我说，我猜他想悄悄地、低调地把这件事处理掉。考虑到当下的情况，我也不怪他。
Anyhow, if you can, travel on over that way. {p} is the desert city to the east of {p}, if you've never seen it.
总之，可以的话，就往那边去吧。{p} 是 {p} 东边的沙漠城市，如果你没去过的话。
With that, I'm off! There are many more soldiers to find. Good luck, if you choose to heed the summons!
就这样，我走了！还有很多士兵要找。如果你决定响应召集，祝你好运！
Anyhow, if you can, head on over to the Admiral's office. It's just by the bank, you can't miss it.
总之，可以的话，就去上将的办公室吧。就在银行旁边，你不会找不到的。
Ugh, for crying out loud- I'm busy, can't you see that? I don't have time to...
呃，拜托——我很忙，你看不出来吗？我没时间……
Ah. You're a soldier. Good, that's one more to add to the list. You met the scout, I'm sure.
啊。你是士兵。很好，名单上又多一个。我想你见过斥候了。
Not as many of you lot as I would have hoped for, but it'll have to do. Come down here, the others are in the briefing room already.
你们这些人没我希望的那么多，不过也只能这样了。下来吧，其他人已经在简报室了。
Hmph. I suppose this is as many soldiers as we'll be able to get. Very well!
哼。我想我们能召集到的士兵也就这么多了。很好！
To begin with - the situation. Commander Takan of {p} has abandoned his post, and has taken the lead of a group of local bandits.
首先——现在的情况。{p} 的 Takan 指挥官擅离职守，还当上了一群本地强盗的头目。
Under his command, they were able to strike our forces in the dead of night, and have taken over the barracks to the northeast.
在他的指挥下，他们趁深夜袭击了我们的部队，占领了东北边的兵营。
Our entire military force, captured or killed! What a disgrace. We've sent messengers to {p}, and they have promised their support...
我们整支军队，不是被俘就是被杀！真是奇耻大辱。我们已经派信使去 {p}，他们也答应支援……
But I would like this dealt with quickly and quietly. That's where you five come in.
但我希望这件事能快速、低调地解决。这就是你们五个的任务。
You will attack and infiltrate the barracks, and assassinate our treasonous commander. I will leave the strategizing to you, as there is much I still must handle here.
你们要进攻并潜入兵营，刺杀我们那个叛国的指挥官。策略就交给你们了，我这边还有很多事要处理。
A question, if I may. Do we know the commander's reasoning for this attack? It seems out of character.
请问可以提个问题吗？我们知道指挥官发动这次袭击的原因吗？这不像他会做的事。
...No. There is nothing that I can recall that would motivate such an attack. Will that be all?
……不知道。我想不出任何会促使他发动这种袭击的事。还有别的问题吗？
Then I must be off! Good luck, soldiers. I hope for a swift end to this disaster.
那我得走了！祝你们好运，士兵们。希望这场灾难能尽快结束。
...Well, darn. Bandits sound like trouble. Do we know what sort?
……嗯，糟糕。强盗听起来很麻烦。我们知道是哪一种吗？
Does it matter? We'll probably be fighting them no matter what kind they are.
有什么区别吗？不管是哪种，我们大概都得跟他们打。
It might, actually... Some bandit groups are stronger than others. If we know which group we're dealing with ahead of time, it might-
其实可能有差……有些强盗团比其他的强。如果我们事先知道对付的是哪一伙，也许——
We've been standing around here for too long. Come on, let's make our way closer to the barracks. We can come up with a plan there.
我们在这里站太久了。走吧，我们靠近兵营一点。到了那里再想计划。
Well, darn. The place is swarming with bandits...
嗯，糟糕。这地方到处都是强盗……
I don't see how that's a problem! We can just launch explosives into the crowd, and boom, problem solved.
我看不出这有什么问题！我们直接把炸药扔进人堆里，砰，问题解决。
We can't do that. You'd almost certainly damage the structure in the process!
不能那样做。那样几乎肯定会炸坏建筑！
Ah, true. Can't forget about the historical value. Good catch.
啊，也对。可不能忘了它的历史价值。提醒得好。
...Right. Well, anyway, I don't think we can get through those bandits with brute force. We'll have to try to find a way around them...
……好吧。总之，我不认为我们能靠蛮力突破那些强盗。我们得想办法绕过他们……
Well, if I may interject- I reckon I won't be of much use in proper combat! Injured leg, 'n all. Makes moving a little hard!
那个，我插句话——我想正面打起来我帮不上什么忙！腿受伤了嘛。行动有点不方便！
So, if we think goin' right in won't work, I could try to create a distraction? I've got the magic for it, and I'd be of much more use out here.
所以，如果我们觉得直接冲进去行不通，我可以试着制造点混乱引开他们？我有这方面的魔法，在外面我能派上更多用场。
It could work... if I join you, we'd be able to draw attention towards us while the others sneak in from a different angle.
行得通……如果我跟你一起，我们就能把注意力吸引过来，让其他人从别的方向溜进去。
Good idea. But, how do we get in? I don't think there is another entrance, other than that one in front.
好主意。可是我们要怎么进去？除了前面那个入口，我不认为还有别的入口。
This had better not be going where I think it is, Linton.
Okay, maybe it is. But, listen! We don't have any entrances, right? What if we made our own... by blowing a hole through a wall?
好吧，也许就是。但是，听着！我们没有入口，对吧？如果我们自己造一个……在墙上炸个洞呢？
...Alright, fine. That sounds like it could work.
Exactly! You need to have more faith in the experts, Aledar.
正是！你得多相信专家一点，Aledar。
We all need to make sacrifices, Lanu.
Hm. No, I don't think I do. Either way, that sounds like a plan. {u}, Linton, and I will break into the barracks then.
嗯。不，我不觉得我需要。不管怎样，这个计划听起来不错。那就由 {u}、Linton 和我闯进兵营。
And Lanu and I can distract 'em while you do so. Sounds like a plan! Let's get goin'.
我和 Lanu 在你们行动的时候引开他们。听起来是个好计划！我们出发吧。
Well, well. This looks like a good place to break our way in, wouldn't you say, Aledar?
哎呀呀。这看起来是个炸开进去的好地方，你说是吧，Aledar？
Yes, Linton, it looks fine. {u}, we'll be looking for Takan. I think the two of us could take him out.
是，Linton，看起来不错。{u}，我们去找 Takan。我想我们俩能解决他。
And I'll be looking for the captured soldiers! I stole a map of the barracks from Amerigo's desk, so I'll be able to find them easily enough!
我去找被俘的士兵！我从 Amerigo 的桌上偷了一张兵营的地图，所以我能轻松找到他们！
You-... nevermind, I don't care. Just do your job, please?
你——……算了，我不在乎。拜托你做好你的工作就行？
See you two on the other side!
Damn it... damn it, damn it, damn it ALL! Couldn't give me a MOMENT of peace, could he, that rat Amerigo...
该死……该死，该死，全都该死！就不能让我清静一下吗，那只老鼠 Amerigo……
...do I really need to do everything myself?! It's almost as though-
……难道什么事都得我自己来吗？！简直就像——
Oh, I see. I see what's going on. More of Amerigo's dogs, here to take care of his business, huh?! Get out here where I can see you.
噢，我明白了。我明白是怎么回事了。又是 Amerigo 派来替他办事的走狗，是吧？！给我出来，让我看看你们。
You look new... haven't been around long enough to really see the face of War up close and personal yet, have you?
你看起来是新来的……还没待够久，没亲眼近距离见识过战争的真面目吧？
You think this is right? You think it's right that those DAMNED admirals get all the wealth and fame, when WE'RE the ones out fighting in the trenches?!
你觉得这样对吗？你觉得那些该死的上将坐拥所有财富和名声，而在战壕里拼命的是我们，这样对吗？！
And these IDIOTS think they deserve their power? Their authority?!
而这些白痴觉得他们配得上他们的权力？他们的权威？！
...You've killed dozens, and you're keeping dozens more captured.
……你杀了几十个人，还关押着另外几十个人。
And I'd do all that and more, just to prove my point! They think they hold power?! I'll show them power...
为了证明我的观点，我还会做得更多！他们以为自己掌握权力？！我就让他们见识什么是权力……
Step aside, Shadow Spears. I'd like to deal with these dogs myself.
让开，暗影之矛。我要亲自对付这两条走狗。
...We won't make it easy for you.
This tower can only go up... Come on, we need to chase after him! We can't let him get away!
这座塔只能往上走……快，我们得追上他！不能让他跑了！
Continue up the stairs in the barracks.
Look, it's obvious we've lost here. Even if that idiot escapes, you military folk will find him.
听着，很明显我们在这里输了。就算那个白痴逃了，你们军队的人也会找到他。
Here, take the key to the tower. A sign of good faith. Do what you will with him, I really don't care.
来，拿去塔的钥匙。算是表示诚意。你们想怎么处置他都行，我真的不在乎。
I always preferred his brother anyway. Much quieter.
反正我一直比较喜欢他哥哥。安静多了。
Ugh, more bandits... I'll hold them off here.
呃，又是强盗……我在这里挡住他们。
Keep going after Takan! I'll be fine!
继续去追 Takan！我不会有事的！
Head up the tower and take out Takan.
Urgh... Why did I even come up here?! There's nowhere for me to-
呃……我到底为什么要跑上来？！我根本无处可——
...Oh. L-listen. We can talk this out-
……噢。听、听着。我们可以好好谈谈——
...and so then, I had to free them somehow! So I shouted at them to brace for it, and-
……然后呢，我得想办法放他们出来！所以我就大喊叫他们做好准备，然后——
{u}! There you are! I'm glad you made it out safely. It looks like the bandits are dispersing.
{u}！你在这里！很高兴你平安出来了。看来强盗们正在散去。
And so is my train of thought for my story. So! Did you get him?
我讲故事的思路也跟着散了。那么！你们抓到他了吗？
He's dead. I have his badge.
他死了。我拿到了他的徽章。
That's good to hear. At least something good came of this whole situation...
那真是好消息。至少这整件事总算有件好事……
Oh, not this again. You're still on that?
哦，又来了。你还在想那件事？
I caught a few of the things he was shoutin' from outside. It didn't sound very pleasant.
我在外面听到了一些他喊的话。听起来不太好。

Lanu:
Some of us care about history, Mel.
我们之中有些人是在乎历史的，Mel。
Well, I didn't hear a thing. Probably on account of the ringing in my ears. It seems to me we're done here, though, right?
嗯，我什么都没听到。大概是因为我耳朵还在嗡嗡响。不过我看我们这边已经搞定了，对吧？
It looks like it, yes. I think I'll stay behind to help the soldiers clear out the remaining bandits.
看来是的。我想我会留下来帮士兵清理剩下的强盗。
I figure I'll stick around too. Don't got anythin' better to do right now, anyway!
我想我也留下来。反正现在也没什么更好的事可做！
Well, I'm out of here. I've got places to be! Things to do! Explosives to return! Goodbye!
嗯，我要走了。我有地方要去！有事要做！有炸药要还！再见！
{u}, I guess that leaves the two of us to return to {p} with the news! Let's get going.
{u}，看来只剩我们两个回 {p} 报信了！出发吧。
Bring Takan's badge to Amerigo at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
把 Takan 的徽章带给 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Amerigo。
Soldiers! Report! Don't tell me you're the only two survivors, damn it all...
士兵们！报告！别跟我说只有你们两个活下来，该死……
No, sir, the mission was a success. Takan is dead.
不，长官，任务成功了。Takan 死了。
You're certain of this? You have his badge, surely...?
你确定吗？你们一定拿到他的徽章了吧……？
I see... satisfactory work, soldiers. You two, and the others, have {p}'s gratitude.
我明白了……干得还算可以，士兵们。你们两个，还有其他人，{p} 都感谢你们。
You will all be well-compensated for your work today. Now, run along. I have to collect my honorary badge for taking out Ex-Commander Takan.
你们今天的工作都会得到丰厚的报酬。好了，走吧。我得去领我因为解决前指挥官 Takan 而获得的荣誉徽章了。
I'm starting to see why Takan hated him so much.
我开始明白 Takan 为什么那么恨他了。
I'll... probably try to speak to Admiral Aegis about that the next time I'm in {p}.
下次去 {p} 的时候……我大概会试着跟 Aegis 上将谈谈这件事。
Anyway! What an adventure, right? I can't wait to tell Tasim about it.
总之！真是一场冒险，对吧？我等不及要跟 Tasim 说了。
...Speaking of. Have you heard from him recently? I can't seem to get ahold of him at all.
……说到这个。你最近有他的消息吗？我好像怎么都联系不上他。
It's weird. Last I heard, he was at {p}, but he's not there anymore.
真奇怪。我上次听说他在 {p}，可他已经不在那里了。
He went off to Gavel, I thin
He- what? Really? And he didn't even tell me...
他——什么？真的？他居然都没告诉我……
...I guess it must have slipped his mind. That's alright. We're all busy around here, right?
……我想他大概是忘了吧。没关系。这里大家都很忙，对吧？
Yeah, that makes two of us...
Well, it's probably fine. I'm sure he'll pop up eventually! We just need to wait.
嗯，大概没事吧。我相信他迟早会冒出来的！我们只要等着就行。
I wonder where he's gone off to? Some kind of assignment in {p}, maybe? Or could he have gone off to Gavel...?
不知道他去哪了？也许是在 {p} 执行什么任务？还是说他去了 Gavel……？
Well, whatever. It was good to see you again! Even if... well. Even if it was strange.
嗯，算了。很高兴又见到你！就算……嗯。就算有点怪。
Well, I guess I'm going to head off. I'll see you around, {u}!
好了，我想我该走了。回头见，{u}！
It says it's for 'the woman on the hill'.
上面写着是给“山丘上的女人”的。
I have some letters that are addressed to you.
我这里有几封寄给你的信。
Move and rotate the selected beam using the directional buttons.
用方向按钮移动并旋转选中的横梁。
You could either confront them or talk to Elise about what to do.
你可以选择去跟他们对质，或者问问 Elise 该怎么办。
It would be best to get the bread and get out of this place quickly.
最好拿了面包就赶紧离开这个地方。
You are already carrying a bottle.
你已经拿着一个瓶子了。
The handwriting seems familiar. But, it doesn't say much...
这笔迹似乎很眼熟。不过，上面没写什么……
Throw a Bottle by {#} RIGHT-CLICKING to aim and then {#} RIGHT-CLICKING again to throw.
按 {#} 右键瞄准，再按一次 {#} 右键把瓶子扔出去。
After knocking them out,  RIGHT-CLICK to search workers.
把他们打晕后，右键搜查工人。
Now, how to get up from here...
好了，要怎么从这里上去……
This must be the pipe Bush was talking about...
这一定就是 Bush 说的那根管子……
Hm... There's no sender... Are these all from the same person?
嗯……没有寄件人……这些都是同一个人寄的吗？
Pick up your post in the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Don't you see I'm busy!? Take a ticket and wait in line as you're supposed to! I don't care if no one else is here, follow protocol!
你没看到我很忙吗！？去取号，照规矩排队！我才不管这里有没有别人，按流程来！
You could get across this gap by arranging the suspended beams into a path.
把悬空的横梁排成一条路，就能越过这道缺口。
Oh, yes! The letters. Silly me, I almost forgot.
哦，对了！那些信。瞧我这记性，差点忘了。
Take a ticket from the Ticket Machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
You have to take a ticket, just like everyone else!
你得取号，跟其他人一样！
Return to the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
I'll be with you in one second! Gosh, so impatient these days...
马上就轮到你！天哪，现在的人真没耐心……
Tired of waiting already? Well, someone decided to leave this place a mess for when I returned!
已经等烦了？哼，有人在我回来的时候把这地方弄得一团糟！
I come back to the office yesterday from a well-deserved, brief, eighteen week, vacation. And this is how I'm thanked?!
我昨天刚结束一场应得的、短暂的、十八周的假期回到办公室。结果就得到这种回报？！
Do you see the mess my substitute left this place in? And now I have to clean it up, or the Royal Inspector will have my head!
你看到我的代班把这里弄得多乱了吗？现在我得收拾干净，不然皇家督察会要我的脑袋！
I'll have you know I graduated with honours from the Royal University of Aelumia.
我告诉你，我可是以优等成绩毕业于 Aelumia 皇家大学的。
Frankly, it's demeaning they stuck me out here with the... ugh... peasants! Oh, and don't even get me started on the smell!
说真的，把我丢到这里跟这些……呃……平民待在一起，简直是羞辱！噢，更别跟我提那股味道！
But anyway, that is all besides the point. What did you want again?
不过总之，那些都不是重点。你刚才要什么来着？
It's you! You're the one I left in charge over my vacation, you scoundrel!
是你！我放假的时候就是把这里交给了你，你这无赖！
I knew it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
我就知道！像我这样的大学毕业生怎么可能会错！
Don't try to weasel your way out of it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
别想狡辩！像我这样的大学毕业生怎么可能会错！
It's not just me who's going to be in trouble when the inspection comes, surely you realize that?
检查来的时候，惹上麻烦的可不只我一个，你应该明白吧？
If you fix this mess you made... Then no one ever has to hear a word of what happened.
如果你把你弄出来的烂摊子收拾好……那就没人会听到发生过什么。
You don't get in trouble, the Royal Inspector is happy, I'm happy. Everyone is happy!
你不会惹上麻烦，皇家督察满意，我也满意。皆大欢喜！
Then I'll have you sorting post like your life depends on it, scoundrel!
那我就让你拼了命地分拣邮件，无赖！
因为你的命确实就靠这个了。
Sorting is so easy even someone like you should be able to do it.
分拣简单到连你这种人都应该做得来。
All you do is take the packages from the conveyor over there.
你只要从那边的传送带上拿包裹。
And put them where they're supposed to go over there.
然后把它们放到那边该放的地方。
{p} packages to the {p}, Auburn packages to the {p}, and so on.
{p} 的包裹放到 {p}，Auburn 的包裹放到 {p}，以此类推。
Fantastic! Just don't make a mess of it, okay?
太棒了！只是别搞砸了，好吗？
Well, that was just the warmup! There's more to come, so don't go slacking off now!
哼，那只是热身！后面还多着呢，所以别偷懒！
Hmm... You did fine this time, but watch out, because these last packages come fast!
嗯……这次你做得还行，不过小心，最后这批包裹来得很快！
Don't think you're somebody just because you can sort some packages!
别以为会分拣几个包裹就了不起了！
What are you doing over there!?
Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
啊！再来一次，这次你最好给我做对！
Don't bother me while I'm working! I didn't go to university just to slack off with people like you!
我工作的时候别来烦我！我上大学可不是为了跟你这种人一起偷懒的！
Ah, perfect! You sorted the packages!
啊，完美！你把包裹分拣好了！
But wait, what's this then? Why are there so many packages to the {p}?
等等，这又是什么？为什么有这么多包裹要寄去 {p}？
Did you mess up the sorting, you fool!?
你是不是分拣错了，你这笨蛋！？
What's up with these packages! They're filled with letters?
这些包裹是怎么回事！里面装满了信？
Hmph... all of them to the woman on the hill... Whatever that means!
哼……全都是寄给山丘上的女人……天知道那是什么意思！
Hey you, scoundrel. This is part of your duty too, you know!
喂你，无赖。这也是你的职责，你知道吧！
Go deliver these letters! Or... or I'll tell the Royal Inspector about what you did! That's right, don't mess with me!
去把这些信送了！不然……不然我就跟皇家督察说你干的好事！没错，别惹我！
How should I know! That's your job to figure out. See, it says here 'to the woman on the hill', that should be enough shouldn't it?
我怎么会知道！那是你的工作。你看，这上面写着“寄给山丘上的女人”，这样应该够了吧？
Oh, but you are! I have very many friends, in very high places! Met them in university, makes sure to remember that!
噢，你当然得去！我有很多朋友，身居高位的朋友！在大学认识的，给我记住了！
Great! Now with that settled I can finally go back to my very important work.
太好了！这下事情解决了，我终于可以回去做我非常重要的工作了。
Oh, yes. Very important. University graduate, did I mention that?
哦，是的。非常重要。大学毕业生，我提过吗？
Now now, off you go. And don't come back crying if you can't find this mysterious woman!
好了好了，快去吧。要是找不到这个神秘女人，可别哭着回来！
But if you lose the letter I can always give you another, they seem to be practically infinite anyhow!
不过要是你把信弄丢了，我随时可以再给你一封，反正这些信几乎多到数不完！
Find out about the woman on the hill around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 附近打听山丘上的女人。
Are you trying to slack off? You still have the letter on you, go deliver it!
你想偷懒吗？信还在你身上，快去送！
Hmm, you lost the letter? Already!?
嗯，你把信弄丢了？这么快！？
Don't think you're getting out of this! I have spares!
别以为这样就能逃掉！我有备份！
Now go on and sort this out for me, won't you? I have enough to worry about as is without you bungling about!
好了，快去帮我把这件事处理好，好吗？我要操心的事已经够多了，别再添乱！
Looking for someone, huh? 'round these parts it's usually the tin cans who do that.
在找人，是吧？在这一带找人的通常是那些铁罐头。
A visit from one of those and you get an all-expenses-paid vacation on the Crown, if you catch my drift.
被他们找上门，你就能享受一趟王室全额买单的度假，懂我的意思吧。
Safe to say, if it were Lars you were looking for I'd be happy to rat him out, but you haven't told me who it is yet.
说真的，要是你找的是 Lars，我很乐意把他供出来，不过你还没说是谁。
PLenty of hills 'round these parts, women too. But they're in the factories, slaving away, not on any hills 'sfar as I'm aware.
这一带山丘多的是，女人也不少。不过她们都在工厂里做牛做马，据我所知可没待在什么山丘上。
Sorry bud, don't think I can help you with this one. Try asking Lars, he's usually hogging the fire in the alley here behind me. Hate that guy...
抱歉，老兄，这件事我帮不上忙。去问问 Lars 吧，他通常霸着我后面这条巷子里的火堆。我讨厌那家伙……
Already told you everythin', didn't I? Go harass Lars instead, I have nothing more to say.
我知道的都跟你说了，不是吗？去烦 Lars 吧，我没什么好说的了。
I'm looking for someone called 'the woman on the hill'. I have a letter I need to deliver to her.
我在找一个叫“山丘上的女人”的人。我有封信要交给她。
A letter? Don't know nuthin' about no woman on the hill, but maybe Bush over there would know.
信？我可不知道什么山丘上的女人，不过那边的 Bush 或许知道。
He usually knows things... He's a knower.
他通常知道一些事……他是个知道者。
Don't talk to him for too long though, or he'll start putting strange ideas in your head...
不过别跟他聊太久，不然他会开始往你脑子里塞奇怪的念头……
Ask Bush. I told you I don't know nuthin'.
去问 Bush。我说了我什么都不知道。
I'm Bush, nice to meet you. Is there something you wish to know?
我是 Bush，很高兴认识你。有什么想知道的吗？
Oh, yes, her... This bush knows her all too well!
噢，是的，她……这丛灌木再清楚她不过了！
Without her this bush would wilt! Yes, a bush requires water to grow. I know, I know!
没有她，这丛灌木就会枯萎！是的，灌木需要水才能生长。我知道，我知道！
But first, I must know why you must know! Do you know?
不过首先，我必须知道你为什么必须知道！你知道吗？
A letter! If only this Bush could know its contents... Alas, it would be rude to know...
一封信！要是这丛灌木能知道里面写了什么就好了……唉，知道了就太失礼了……
The mail-deliverer, truly a noble profession. I will share with you her location, but in exchange you must tell her: her friend is back in town.
送信的人，真是个高尚的职业。我会告诉你她在哪，不过作为交换，你得告诉她: 她的朋友回镇上了。
Here, let me write it down for you!
Now you know! Now you know!
现在你知道了！现在你知道了！
To know why I must know? Not even I know... All I know is that I must know!
要知道我为什么必须知道？连我自己都不知道……我只知道我必须知道！
Again, tell me why you must know.
再告诉我一次，你为什么必须知道。
Nothing? That such people existed, I did not know! Now I know, now I know!
什么都没有？原来还有这样的人，我以前不知道！现在我知道了，现在我知道了！
Post? You must be at the wrong house, dear.
邮件？你一定是找错房子了，亲爱的。
No one is sending me any of that...
没有人会给我寄那种东西……
Well, if it says so on the letter...
嗯，既然信上是这么写的……
Come in and we'll talk about it.
I don't usually get a lot of visitors up on the hill.
山丘上这里平常没什么访客。
Place the letters on the table at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
I think I'll need a closer look at this.
我想我得仔细看看这个。
Please, have a seat. I'll make you something to drink.
请坐。我去给你弄点喝的。
You don't look like you're from around these parts, do you?
你看起来不像是这一带的人，对吧？
Hmm? Well, I shouldn't pry into my guest's secrets. Better to let the unexplained rest, ha. Wouldn't you agree?
嗯？好吧，我不该打探客人的秘密。说不清的事就让它过去吧，哈。你不觉得吗？
Here in the Roughworks, we don't have any secrets. At least that's what Her Majesty wants to believe, ha.
在 Roughworks，我们没有任何秘密。至少女王陛下是这么希望的，哈。
That's why I chose to live here. In the neighborhoods, the walls are thinner than paper. Nothing goes unheard.
所以我才选择住在这里。住宅区里的墙比纸还薄。什么都藏不住。
Up here on the hill, it's much more peaceful. As long as the Water Authority doesn't come knocking, ha.
山丘上这里就清静多了。只要水务局别来敲门就好，哈。
Well, if you're already here, why don't we have a little chat? Not a lot of people to talk to up here!
好了，既然你都来了，我们何不聊聊？这上面可没什么人能说话！
Pick up the Watering Can outside at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The watering can is just outside in the garden. There are three plants inside and three plants outside.
浇水壶就在外面的花园里。屋里有三株植物，屋外也有三株。
Water Elise's plants while she reads the letters.
趁 Elise 读信的时候帮她浇花。
Oh, what a mess... trying to make sense of this is making my head hurt.
噢，真是一团乱……想弄懂这些让我头都疼了。
So many letters, over so many years... who would possibly be so insistent on reaching me?
这么多信，跨越了这么多年……到底会是谁这么执着地想联系我？
Hm? Oh, you finished watering the plants already? That was quick!
嗯？哦，你已经浇完花了？真快！
Well, I certainly won't make any progress like this, and it seems we both are in need of a break.
嗯，这样下去我肯定理不出头绪，看来我们都需要休息一下。
Oh, it's such a lovely day today... Why don't we go outside and enjoy the garden for a bit?
噢，今天天气真好……我们何不去外面享受一下花园？
Follow Elise outside and take a seat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
跟着 Elise 到外面，在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 坐下。
It really is beautiful today, isn't it?
Ah... freshly watered flowers. Nothing beats that smell.
啊……刚浇过水的花。没有什么比得上这股气味。
Hm. Do you see that tree over there?
嗯。你看到那边那棵树了吗？
It's the only one of its kind in the whole of the Roughworks. Isn't it beautiful?
整个 Roughworks 只有这么一棵。是不是很美？
It was a gift, but from who... It's another thing I've forgotten.
那是别人送的礼物，可是是谁送的……又是一件我忘了的事。
It's frustrating, so frustrating... All these precious memories...
真令人沮丧，好沮丧……这些珍贵的回忆……
It isn't much now, that is for certain.
Well. It's beautiful already, don't you think?
嗯。它现在就已经很美了，你不觉得吗？
Ha! Of course it will, it's a tree!
哈！当然会啊，它是棵树嘛！
Oh, you know I didn't mean it like that.
哦，你知道我不是那个意思。
For each year that passes... this tree will grow taller, and ever more beautiful.
每过一年……这棵树就会长得更高、更美。
It'll have to weather many storms, and on some days it might even have to go without water. And still, it will continue growing.
它得熬过许多风暴，有些日子甚至得忍受没有水。即使如此，它还是会继续生长。
And then in ten, fifteen, maybe even twenty-five years... we'll finally be able to rest in its shade.
然后再过十年、十五年，也许甚至二十五年……我们终于就能在它的树荫下休息了。
Twenty-five years!? We'll be old by then!
二十五年！？到时候我们都老了！
Oh, I know! We could have a picnic underneath its canopy. Doesn't that sound nice, {u}?
哦，我知道了！我们可以在它的树荫下野餐。听起来不错吧，{u}？
... It does. It does sound nice, Elise. Perhaps we could.
……是啊。听起来很不错，Elise。也许我们可以。
Go on, give it some more water. Or it'll never grow an inch!
去吧，再给它浇点水。不然它一寸都长不高！
I was just thinking... If I were to die some day, I'd like to be buried here, under the tree.
我只是在想……如果我哪天死了，我想葬在这里，在这棵树下。
Huh? What could possibly make you think about such silly things? We still have a long life left ahead of us, don't we?
嗯？你怎么会想这种傻事？我们还有很长的日子要过，不是吗？
Of course, you're right. I'm sorry, I'm just not used to this...
当然，你说得对。抱歉，我只是还不习惯这样……
Let's just enjoy the sun, for a bit. There's still work tomorrow.
我们就好好晒一会儿太阳吧。明天还得上工呢。
Hm. I shall leave the worrying for another day, I think. Today is a good day... not a day for worrying.
嗯。我想这些烦恼就留到改天再说吧。今天是个好日子……不是烦恼的日子。
In fact, today is too nice a day to waste it... by not going anywhere, that is. Wouldn't you agree?
事实上，今天天气这么好，要是哪都不去……就太浪费了。你不觉得吗？
Follow Elise to the roof at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
跟着 Elise 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的屋顶。
Ah... Do you see that factory off that way? I used to work there, back when I was younger...
啊……你看到那边那座工厂了吗？我年轻的时候在那里工作过……
We mass-produced bread for the higher regions... Tedious work, and thankless too.
我们为上层地区大量生产面包……工作乏味，还没人感激。
I'm sure you have noticed, but things around here aren't too easy. Some people even go as far as stealing when times are tough...
你一定注意到了，这一带的日子不太好过。有些人日子难熬的时候甚至会去偷……
Fortunately... I never had to. They would let us take some home, every once in a while.
幸好……我从来不需要偷。他们偶尔会让我们带一些回家。
Those were good days. On those occasions, we'd go and have ourselves a picnic, me and- hm. Just me, I suppose.
那是段美好的日子。每逢那种时候，我们就会去野餐，我和——嗯。我想，只有我一个人吧。
A shame it's so hard to come by... the thefts became a real problem, you know. The Crown ended up building a vault down under the factory to keep it all secure!
可惜那东西太难弄到了……偷窃成了个大问题，你知道吗。王室最后在工厂底下盖了一座金库，把面包全都锁起来！
A shame it's so hard to come by... the thefts became a real problem, you know. The Crown ended up building a vault down under the factory to keep it all secure.
可惜现在很难弄到了……偷窃真的成了大问题，你知道吗。王室最后在工厂底下建了一座金库，把东西全都锁起来。
The door is locked. A note is plastered on the front.
门锁着。门上贴着一张字条。
Now to find a way inside without being caught...
现在得想办法在不被抓到的情况下进去……
How long, since I last had some? Years, surely... not like any of that bread ever makes it to us poor folk, ha!
上次吃到是多久以前了？肯定好几年了……那些面包从来就不会落到我们这些穷人手里，哈！
But it'd be nice to have some again, I suppose... reminisce on old times.
不过要是能再吃一次就好了，我想……缅怀一下往日时光。
Well, if you're running errands for me already... mind seeing if you can get your hands on a loaf or two?
嗯，既然你已经在帮我跑腿了……介意看看能不能帮我弄到一两条面包吗？
It's expensive, but for the right price... I'm sure you could get ahold of some. You don't seem the sort to struggle with that kind of thing, do you, letter carrier?
很贵，但只要价钱合适……我相信你弄得到。你看起来不像是会被这种事难倒的人，对吧，送信的？
Ha! Well, do your best, either way. Once you come back, I have a plan for what we can do today. How's that sound?
哈！嗯，不管怎样，尽力而为吧。等你回来，我有个今天能做的计划。怎么样？
Try to enter the Bread Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Oh, no... You know! You know! Speak to that constable first, and perhaps, I'll tell you more.
噢，不……你知道！你知道！先去跟那个治安官谈谈，然后，也许，我会告诉你更多。
If you've come to beg, you might as well leave.
如果你是来讨东西的，那还是走吧。
Huh? Alright, bud. We all do.
嗯？好吧，老兄。我们都一样。
Do I look like a vending machine to you? Go find somewhere else. We just make the bread here, we don't sell it.
我看起来像自动贩卖机吗？去别处吧。我们这里只负责做面包，不卖面包。
Get out of here pal, you shouldn't be loitering around under a Constable's watch.
滚吧，伙计，在治安官眼皮底下可不该到处闲晃。
