呼……呼……等一下，我得喘口气。
Hm... Do you know this person? They're not an inspector... are they?
嗯……你认识这个人吗？他不是督察员……吧？
So, as I was going to say-
那么，就像我刚才要说的——
Okay, fine! I'll get straight to the point.
好啦，好啦！我直接说重点。
I found more letters to deliver, and I was on my way to deliver them when I saw you two running out! Can you imagine how shocked I was?
我又找到了一些要送的信，我正要去送的时候就看到你们两个跑出去！你能想象我有多震惊吗？
That being that, I naturally decided to follow you, the good postmaster that I am. You sure didn't make it easy though! I barely managed to make it up here... It's a nice spot, by the way.
既然这样，身为一个好邮政局长，我自然决定跟上你们。你们可真没让我轻松！我差点就上不来……顺带一提，这地方不错。
But... how could you have possibly made it up here...?
可是……你到底是怎么上来的……？
Getting up here is nothing to a university graduate like me!
上到这里对我这种大学毕业生来说不算什么！
Well, that was all that I came for I suppose. So...
嗯，我想我来就只是为了这个。所以……
You came all this way just for that!? At least have a piece of bread, or something...!
你大老远跑来就只为了这个！？至少吃块面包什么的吧……！
No, no. I couldn't possibly! Duty calls, the post isn't going to sort itself, and all that... Oh, by Her Majesty, the backlog...
不，不。我怎么好意思！职责在身，邮件可不会自己分拣，诸如此类……噢，女王陛下在上，那堆积压的邮件……
Right! You! I hate to admit it, but it seems you've done your job well enough.
对了！你！我很不想承认，不过看来你的工作做得还算可以。
I happened to double check the records and it seems like my substitute, well, may have been someone else entirely!
我刚好又核对了一遍记录，看来我的代班，嗯，可能完全是另一个人！
No harm, no foul, right? The work's already done! No takesies-backsies! Okay?
没什么损失，对吧？工作都已经做完了！不准反悔！好吗？
Huh, what was that? I couldn't hear you! Okay, bye!
嗯，你说什么？我听不到！好，再见！
But it was certainly nice of them to deliver this letter. Let me take a look.
不过他特地把这封信送来，真是好心。让我看看。
Oh, I don't understand... What would she have to apologize for?
噢，我不明白……她有什么需要道歉的？
Please... {u}, take a breath. You're shaking.
Getting caught in a storm like that... really, I could have waited a few hours! You didn't need to push yourself to get here.
冒着那样的暴风雨跑来……说真的，我多等几个小时也没关系！你不需要逼自己赶过来。
Yes, I know the weather's bad now... but eventually, it'll get better again. The clouds will clear and the sun will shine again. Right?
是啊，我知道现在天气很糟……不过总会好转的。云会散开，太阳会再出来。对吧？
You know, it's not so bad with rain once in a while. Means we don't have to water the flowers, at least! And nothing beats the smell of wet grass after rain, don't you agree?
你知道吗，偶尔下场雨也不坏。至少不用浇花了！而且没有什么比雨后湿草的气味更好闻了，你不觉得吗？
We could do something after it clears up. It's been a while since you visited, so why not go to our spot? I should still have some leftover bread lying around...
等雨停了我们可以做点什么。你好久没来了，何不去我们的老地方？我应该还有些剩下的面包……
Elise. You're- please, forgive me- you're in danger. I-
Elise。你——求你，原谅我——你有危险。我——
I'm in danger? I'm just an ordinary worker, what reason would anyone have to harm me? I'll be fine.
我有危险？我只是个普通工人，谁会有理由伤害我？我不会有事的。
{u}, you're the one pushing herself through this weather, clearly panicking...
{u}，冒着这种天气硬撑的人是你，而且明显很慌乱……
I barely get to see you anymore. And now, out of nowhere, you're here in this state... What's going on? Please, just talk to me.
我现在几乎见不到你了。结果现在，你突然这副样子跑来……到底怎么了？拜托，跟我说说。
...ha. I- I haven't been truthful with you, Elise, and- I can explain later. We need to get out of here, before they-
……哈。我——我一直没对你说实话，Elise，而且——我之后再解释。我们得离开这里，在他们——
Why would they... no, this doesn't make any sense...
他们为什么会……不，这说不通……
Hm. Well, then maybe it's nothing. I'll go see who it is.
嗯。好吧，那也许没什么。我去看看是谁。
As if one wasn't enough... who could possibly be foolish enough to brave a storm just to come visit this little place? Whatever it is, it can wait.
一个还不够似的……到底谁会傻到冒着暴风雨来这个小地方？不管是什么事，都可以等。
No... No... What are you... Why are you-
不……不……你们在……你们为什么——
Apologies for the disturbance, madam. But I'm afraid we have business to attend to.
抱歉打扰了，女士。不过恐怕我们有公务要处理。
{u}, {u}, why are they here? Why... why won't you answer me...?
{u}，{u}，他们为什么在这里？为什么……你为什么不回答我……？
What have you done? I... Please, just explain... I- I...
你做了什么？我……拜托，解释一下……我——我……
I... how did I overlook this...?
我……我怎么会忽略了这一点……？
Seems you're not quite the strategic mastermind you though yourself, Lioness.
看来你并不是自以为的那种谋略大师啊，母狮。
Elise... if you... if you just cooperate...
Then... everything will be fine. It... it will.
那……一切都会没事的。一定……一定会的。
She... What did she do? Why did she wrap me up in it?
她……她做了什么？她为什么要把我卷进去？
Everything I remember... it just leaves me with more questions than answers. Why can't I remember her...? Why!?
我记得的一切……只留给我更多的疑问，而不是答案。为什么我想不起她……？为什么！？
I- I'm just an ordinary factory worker! I woke up early, worked late, slept late... then did it all over again the next day.
我——我只是个普通的工厂工人！早早起床、工作到很晚、很晚才睡……然后第二天再重来一遍。
I've never said a word about the Crown! Why would they possibly care about... me...?
我从来没说过王室一句坏话！他们怎么可能会在乎……我……？
They... they took everything from me. My youth, my body, my time, and... and I never demanded anything in return.
他们……他们夺走了我的一切。我的青春、我的身体、我的时间，而……而我从来没要求过任何回报。
So, why... why can't I just have this? This one little thing? Why can't I remember her...?
所以，为什么……为什么我就不能拥有这个？这一件小小的东西？为什么我想不起她……？
...oh, it might sound sad... but, looking back at it all like this...
……噢，这听起来可能很可悲……不过，像这样回头看这一切……
My life doesn't seem all that great, does it? Ha. Toiling away in a factory for someone else's bread...
我的人生看起来也没那么好，是吧？哈。在工厂里为别人的面包辛苦劳作……
But I can feel her. Even if... even if I can't remember her face, or her name, or her touch... I still feel her. Lingering in my heart. Shining.
可是我感觉得到她。就算……就算我想不起她的脸、她的名字、她的触碰……我还是感觉得到她。萦绕在我心里。闪闪发光。
...it's all some sort of sick joke, isn't it?
……这一切都是个恶劣的玩笑，对吧？
They weren't content with all I sacrificed... they had to take even my memories? Is that it...?
我牺牲了那么多他们还不满足……连我的记忆都要夺走？是这样吗……？
Wherever you are now... whatever you did... whatever secrets you kept... I hope it was worth it.
无论你现在在哪里……无论你做了什么……无论你守着什么秘密……我希望那都值得。
I hope you burn this entire place to the ground.
我希望你把这整个地方烧成灰烬。
I just wish... we could have spent more time together.
我只是希望……我们能有更多时间在一起。
For a long time, I went along the path that had been laid before me. I did what was right.
很长一段时间，我都走在别人为我铺好的路上。做着正确的事。
But then... I met you, Elise.
I... I don't know what to say, {u}...
I see... a bird. A pigeon, it's old and gray. Its wings no longer work like they used to...
我看到……一只鸟。一只鸽子，又老又灰。它的翅膀已经不像以前那样好使了……
It wants to fly, but it can't... It's struggling...
它想飞，却飞不起来……它在挣扎……
No, I can't! It's too sad...
It's sitting beneath the shade of a canopy, singing. Like a cry, almost, mourning.
它坐在树荫下，在唱歌。几乎像是在哭，在哀悼。
The clouds, dark clouds are gathering. A storm is coming. The bird is looking around, frantically searching. It's scared.
云，乌云正在聚集。暴风雨要来了。那只鸟四处张望，拼命地寻找。它很害怕。
It... It calls out, for something... or someone...
它……它在呼唤，呼唤某样东西……或是某个人……
Who is it calling for, Elise?
I won't forget! I won't forget! I won't! I promised! I promised I'd never forget you!
我不会忘记！我不会忘记！我不会！我答应过！我答应过永远不会忘记你！
You are an ordinary worker from the Roughworks. You work an ordinary job, and lead an ordinary but solitary life.
你是 Roughworks 的一名普通工人。你做着普通的工作，过着普通而孤单的生活。
She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her.
她对你来说什么都不是。你从没见过她。你永远不会见到她。
You are nothing to her! She is nothing to you! Soon you'll forget she ever existed.
你对她来说什么都不是！她对你来说什么都不是！很快你就会忘记她曾经存在过。
No, I will never forget! She was everything to me! She is everything to me! I will never forget her!
不，我永远不会忘记！她曾经是我的一切！她现在也是我的一切！我永远不会忘记她！
You do not know her face, nor her voice, nor her touch.
你不知道她的脸，不知道她的声音，也不知道她的触碰。
She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her. You have always been ordinary, you will always be ordinary.
她对你来说什么都不是。你从没见过她。你永远不会见到她。你一直都很普通，你永远都会很普通。
I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
我再问一次。你的指令，明白了吗？
And I'll never forget it, Elise.
My legs... feel funny... I think... I think I'm in need of some rest. A long, long rest... I deserve that... don't I?
我的腿……感觉怪怪的……我想……我想我需要休息一下了。好好地、长长地休息……这是我应得的……对吧？
You'll take me home... won't you? I want to see it, at least once more... The tree.
你会带我回家的……对吧？我想再看一眼，至少再一次……那棵树。
It's grown so tall... and so beautiful. Hasn't it, Syndra...?
它长得好高了……而且好美。对吧，Syndra……？
If... If only... you could have seen it... like this...
要是……要是……你能看到它……现在的样子……
Pick some of Elise's flowers around her house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 附近摘一些 Elise 家周围的花。
I'm searching for 'the woman on the hill'. Do you happen to know her?
我在找“山丘上的女人”。你知道她吗？
Ha! But that's why I moved here!
哈！可我正是因为这样才搬来这里的！
In the living blocks you can never be alone. No time to think, only to work. No dear, it's much better up here.
住在居住楼里，你永远别想一个人清静。没时间思考，只有干活。不，亲爱的，还是这上面好多了。
Lived my whole childhood in one of the towers. I was born there. That was until... until... Well, I've forgotten the reason, ha!
我整个童年都住在其中一栋楼里。我就是在那里出生的。直到……直到……嗯，我忘了是什么原因了，哈！
My memory isn't so good these days. It must have been twenty-five or so years ago.
我最近记性不太好。那大概是二十五年前左右的事了。
But I had a reason... a good one! Ha, it's funny isn't it? At the time it probably seemed like the most important thing in the world.
不过我是有原因的……一个很好的原因！哈，很好笑吧？那时候它大概看起来像是世上最重要的事。
But now, well, I've gone and forgotten the whole thing, haven't I?
可是现在，嗯，我把整件事都忘光了，不是吗？
In the Roughworks? My whole life, ha. I'm only fifty... fifty-two, you know. Or maybe it was fifty-three.
在 Roughworks？一辈子了，哈。我才五十……五十二岁，你知道的。也可能是五十三。
... Which year is it again? I seem to have lost track.
……现在是哪一年来着？我好像记不清了。
So... goodness, longer than I expected. It must have been... Oh, by Her Grace! What does it matter, the years pass quicker for every one that goes.
那么……天哪，比我想的还久。那一定是……噢，女王陛下在上！有什么关系呢，日子是一年比一年过得快。
How strange... I feel like I should know who this is from... and yet, I don't.
真奇怪……我觉得我应该知道这是谁寄来的……可我就是不知道。
Hm. I said I wouldn't pry, but... You don't work for the post, do you? I know your type.
嗯。我说过不打探的，不过……你不是邮局的人，对吧？你这种人我见多了。
But... you have piqued my curiosity with these letters...
不过……你带来的这些信确实勾起了我的好奇心……
Say, 'letter-carrier', won't you be a dearie and water my plants while I read the rest of these letters? Maybe there is something else I can glean from reading them.
我说，“送信的”，乖，亲爱的，趁我读剩下这些信的时候，帮我浇浇花好吗？也许读了之后，我还能看出点别的什么。
I have {~} plants outside and {~} pots inside. Just be sure not to overwater them! The watering can is just outside in the garden.
我屋外有 {~} 株植物，屋里有 {~} 盆。可千万别浇太多水！浇水壶就在外面的花园里。
Don't be afraid to ask if you're wondering anything! I don't bite, ha!
有什么想知道的尽管问！我又不会咬人，哈！
Elise has probably finished reading those letters by now. You should return to her in the kitchen.
Elise 现在大概已经读完那些信了。你该回厨房找她。
Doesn't look like you're going to get anything out of this guy...
看来从这家伙身上是问不出什么了……
But my friend worked here, and...
可是我朋友以前在这里工作，而且……
Can I at least get a look inside...?
至少能让我进去看一眼吗……？
In order to steal the bread, you must stay hidden.
要偷到面包，你得保持隐蔽。
When close to workers, {#} SNEAK to remain hidden.
靠近工人时，按 {#} 潜行来保持隐蔽。
You could knock out the workers with this...
你可以用这个把工人打晕……
When close to workers, {#} LEFT-CLICK with Bottle to knock out.
靠近工人时，拿着瓶子按 {#} 左键把他们打晕。
{#} Left-Click with Bottle to Knock Out
After knocking them out, {#} RIGHT-CLICK to search workers.
把他们打晕后，按 {#} 右键搜查工人。
With this, you can open the grate to the pipe and progress.
有了这个，你就能打开通往管子的格栅，继续前进。
To stay out of sight of workers, use Bottles to distract them.
为了不被工人看见，用瓶子分散他们的注意力。
Activate EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN by inputting the activation code.
输入启动代码来启动紧急停机。
The bottle is too high up to reach...
That must be the way in to the vault Elise mentioned.
那一定就是 Elise 说的金库入口。
Hey, I left the key in the break room if you need it. Be careful though! Get the Supervisor to disable the oven first, or you'll be toast!
嘿，你要钥匙的话，我放在休息室了。不过小心点！先让主管把烤炉关掉，不然你会被烤成吐司！
A maintenance key. With this you could unlock the maintenace entrance to the oven.
一把维修钥匙。有了它，就能打开烤炉的维修入口。
They really ought to improve their security around here...
这里的安保真该加强一下……
Now, to find the Maintenance Key...
好了，接下来要找到维修钥匙……
EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN code successfully inputted. Press Activation Button to initiate.
紧急停机代码输入成功。按下启动按钮开始执行。
After initiating emergency shutdown, you will have {~} seconds to make it to the vault. Do you want to press the button?
启动紧急停机后，你将有 {~} 秒的时间赶到金库。要按下按钮吗？
Do you want to infiltrate the Bread Vault through this method?
要用这个方法潜入面包金库吗？
This hallway looks heavily guarded. Maybe there's a different path you could take.
这条走廊看起来戒备森严。也许你可以走别的路。
There must be a way to get to that balcony above.
一定有办法上到上面那个阳台。
Switch between selected beams using the switch button.
用切换按钮在选中的横梁之间切换。
They're having a discussion you can just barely make out...
他们在交谈，你勉强能听清……
Finally... The bread you've been looking for.
终于……这就是你一直在找的面包。
看来 Elise 有客人了……
Ha... Well, what's another crime added to the tally? It seems we've become real hardened bandits, haven't we?
哈……嗯，罪状上再添一条又何妨？看来我们成了真正的亡命之徒了，不是吗？
It has no fuel left, maybe you can start it again?
它没有燃料了，也许你能让它重新启动？
The crystalized magic on the floor seems unstable. Maybe something can shatter it...
地上结晶化的魔法似乎很不稳定。也许有什么东西能把它打碎……
The strange shard is reacting to the floor...
那块奇怪的碎片对地面产生了反应……
Head back to the machine at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The loud noise is bound to attract creatures of the expanse.
这么大的动静，一定会引来 Silent Expanse 的生物。
It looks like the machine is about to break through!
看起来机器马上就要钻穿了！
Find some sort of fuel in the Ruined City.
在 Ruined City 里找些燃料。
Find some sort of fuel in the ruined city
在 Ruined City 里找到某种燃料
Explore the cave for the fuel
Collect [{~} Fuel Sprites] and bring it back to the machine.
收集 [{~} 燃料精灵]，带回机器那里。
Defend the machine from the incoming attackers.
保护机器，抵挡来袭的敌人。
Now that you have enough fuel, you should return to the machine.
既然燃料已经够了，你该回到机器那里了。
It looks like a mining machine that's hundreds of years old. What was it mining though?
看起来是一台有几百年历史的采矿机器。不过它当时在挖什么呢？
{#} You get the feeling you shouldn't be here...
{#} 你隐约觉得自己不该待在这里……
It's a strangely shaped keyhole. How cryptic.
一个形状奇怪的钥匙孔。真是“墓”名其妙。
Eager much? Keep yourself seated for now.
这么心急啊？先老实坐好。
Do you...not have any manners at all?! Just running into my parents' house like that! Jeez!
你……到底有没有礼貌啊？！就这样闯进我爸妈家！天啊！
Oh, I know! Here, go into my room real fast, and grab the letter in there.
哦，我知道了！来，快去我房间，把里面那封信拿来。
Bring it to me when you do, I wanna make sure it's the right one.
拿到了就带回来给我，我想确认是不是那封。
Go look for my letter in my bedroom, pretty please.
去我房间找那封信嘛，拜托你了。
My parents were super excited when that letter flew into my room, but magical school sounds so boring...
那封信飞进我房间的时候，我爸妈超级兴奋，可是魔法学校听起来好无聊……
The letter says to meet a boat captain on the broken docks next to the Seaskipper, and to "have faith". What does that mean?
信上说要去 Seaskipper 旁边那座坏掉的码头找一位船长，还要「心怀信念」。那是什么意思啊？
This weird looking place is actually a magical transportation hub.
这个看起来怪怪的地方，其实是个魔法交通枢纽。
Each tunnel leads someplace else in the world, but the transportation portals aren't always, ehm...accurate? Let's leave it at that.
每条隧道都通往世界上的某个角落，不过那些传送门也不是每次都，呃……很准？就先这样说吧。
There are also some secret passages around, supposedly...
据说这附近还有几条秘密通道……
Psst. Are you a student at Grookwarts?
喂。你是 Grookwarts 的学生吗？
This is the way in. Do you see that weird looking dirt wall?
这就是入口。看到那面怪怪的泥土墙了吗？
Just run straight through. Don't tell any non-wizard folks, though.
直接冲过去就对了。不过别跟不是巫师的人说哦。
So all of you will be getting two vouchers each, and with them you will need to buy one wand, and a book or tome.
你们每个人都会拿到两张兑换券，要用它们买一根魔杖和一本书或典籍。
Students, please gather your school material and start your day! One wand and one tome.
同学们，请去领你们的上课用品，然后开始今天的课程！一把魔杖，一本书卷。
Gosh, so many things, so little time!
天啊，东西这么多，时间这么少！
Have you picked out your wand and book yet? I chose an Avo Pheonix Wand.
你挑好魔杖跟书了吗？我选了 Avo Pheonix Wand。
Wait a minute, are you new here? You look really tall!
等等，你是新来的吗？你看起来好高！
Just fill in what subject you want to take and our guides will lead you to your classes.
只要填上你想选的科目，我们的引导员就会带你去上课。
A true wizard after my own heart, seeking wisdom! Good choice. Now, choose a Practical Magic lesson.
真是个跟我一样求知若渴的巫师！好选择。接下来，选一堂实用魔法课。
Effects and materials are intertwined in function, but each has applications independent of one another. Now, choose a Magical Creatures class.
效果与素材在作用上彼此交缠，但各自也有独立的用途。接下来，选一堂魔法生物课。
Ah, yes... As well-liked as that class is, those Wybels are more trouble than they're worth to keep sometimes. Lastly, you must choose a Magical Type class.
啊，是啊……那堂课虽然很受欢迎，但 Wybel 有时候养起来实在麻烦得不划算。最后，你得选一堂魔法类型课。
What you take from the earth, you must give back.
你从大地拿走的，都必须还回去。
It also is the element o-of knowledge, and pure magicality. Water i-is a sort of magical default, if you w-will. If it isn't focused on o-one element or another, magic ends up being water-based.
它也是知识与纯粹魔法的元素。水就像是、是魔法的默认值，可以这么说。如果魔法没有聚焦在某一种元、元素上，最后就会变成以水为基础的。
Good w-work there! I h-hope I wasn't too boring with all my talking... You can go now.
做得好！希、希望我讲那么多没让你太无聊……你可以走了。
N-now, who's n-next? And...i-is it really cold in here for all of you, too? Or, is it j-just me...?
那、那么，下一位是谁？还有……你们是、是不是也觉得这里好冷？还是只、只有我？
If you've read my books, you know about Quartz, and how dangerous it can be if overcharged. So, of course, we have an overcharged sample here so you can feel the signs of it.
如果你们读过我的书，就知道石英，以及它过载时有多危险。所以，我们当然准备了过载的样本，让你们亲身感受它的征兆。
Depending on the formation, they can have natural effects as well. These crystals were found in Gavel's floating islands, and...well, let's say it's difficult to keep it in its case.
视形成方式而定，它们也可能带有天然的效果。这些水晶是在 Gavel 的浮空岛上发现的，而……嗯，这么说吧，要把它们留在盒子里可不容易。
Wybels! Pronounced like "nibble," they're a rather popular pet nowadays. But you all knew that, you want to know where they came from.
Wybel！念起来像 nibble，它们现在是相当受欢迎的宠物。不过这些你们都知道，你们想知道的是它们从哪里来。
The explanation that we got was that they lived in the Ahms region, and when it split open, they eventually burrowed onto the surface of the {p}.
我们得到的解释是，它们原本住在 Ahms 地区，那里裂开之后，它们最后钻到了 {p} 的地表上。
Oh, speaking of fluff. They wooly fur never actually stops growing, ever, and neither do their hooves, their horns, or their teeth. They shed often.
噢，说到毛。它们的羊毛永远不会停止生长，蹄子、角和牙齿也一样。它们常常掉毛。
Wybel fluff is also able to be boiled, and it turns into a sticky molasses-like substance. It's used for candy, and it's very popular...but it's all POISON!!
Wybel 的毛还能拿去煮，会变成像糖蜜一样黏稠的东西。它被拿来做糖果，非常受欢迎……但那全是毒药！！
It's POISON, I tell you! Wybel meat is horrendously inedible! It'll give you the worst stomachache of your life! The candymakers are feeding us DEATH!
是毒药，我跟你说！Wybel 的肉恐怖到根本不能吃！会让你经历这辈子最严重的肚子痛！糖果商在喂我们吃死亡！
It's almost like they miss it, somehow. It's almost like they might be FROM outer space! It's ALMOST like they bring insanity-inducing things into our houses ON PURPOSE!
简直就像它们在怀念它一样。简直就像它们可能来自外太空！简直就像它们故意把让人发疯的东西带进我们家！
Everyone says there's only nine, but WE know the truth! There's a tenth out there, an ultimately powerful one that wants us all gone. Pray you never see it, kids.
大家都说只有九种，但我们知道真相！外面还有第十种，一只无比强大、想让我们全部消失的 Wybel。孩子们，祈祷你们永远别看到它吧。
Anyways, my lesson's safe from all that. All you have to do is re-order these plush Wybel toys on the stand. You'll figure it out once you're up here.
总之，我这堂课跟那些都没关系，很安全。你们只要把架子上这些 Wybel 玩偶重新排好就行。上来之后你们就知道了。
Welcome in, guys and gals...we're learnin' about nature magic today!
欢迎进来，各位男生女生……我们今天要学自然魔法！
Druidic practices tend to deal with healing more, and nurturing. When life's created, it gives off energy...and Druids use that energy for their magic.
德鲁伊的做法比较偏向治疗和培育。当生命诞生时，会释放出能量……德鲁伊就是用那股能量来施展魔法。
Shamanic skills are a lot more direct, man. They take the life from other things and use that to do their stuff. It's way more varied than Druidic magic.
萨满的技艺直接多了，老兄。他们从其他东西那里夺取生命，拿来做他们的事。比德鲁伊魔法多变得多。
Each has its ups and downs, man. Druidism is chill and helpful...but you can really expand your mind with Shamanism, buddies.
两种各有好坏，老兄。德鲁伊术很随和、很有帮助……但萨满术真的能让你大开眼界，伙计们。
But, it's not picky about what life you take, man! A good shaman takes from plants and animals, not people!
但是！它可不挑你夺取的是什么生命，老兄！好的萨满从植物和动物身上取，不是从人身上！
Don't be a Slykaar, kiddos. He asked for human sacrifices, but he lived in a jungle, man! Like, what the hey! He coulda done anything else!
别当 Slykaar，孩子们。他要求活人献祭，可他住在丛林里啊，老兄！就是说，搞什么！他明明可以做别的任何事！
Anyways. Our test today, little buds, is to practice some shamanic skills. We got a sick cow in the back, and you're gonna nurse it back to health.
总之，我们今天的测验，小伙伴们，是练习一些萨满技艺。后面有头生病的牛，你们要把它照顾到恢复健康。
When you think you have the right amount, activate the altar and see your results, man!
觉得分量差不多了，就启动祭坛看看结果吧，老兄！
You are about to enter the graduation room, there is no coming back after that. Are you sure?
你即将进入毕业典礼的房间，进去之后就回不来了。确定吗？
Let us start with {u}. Please come up to the stage!
我们就从 {u} 开始吧。请上台来！
Oh, hey. You're that student from earlier.
噢，嘿。你就是刚才那个学生。
Now that you've graduated you probably don't need to use the secret wall anymore.
你都毕业了，大概也不需要再走那面秘密的墙了。
Do you think we should make it something other than dirt? My robe gets dirty easily...
你觉得我们该不该换成泥土以外的东西？我的长袍很容易脏……
Talk to Seasum in a tower on {p}.
与 {p} 一座塔里的 Seasum 交谈。
Ugh... I really, really, reeeeally don't want to go...
呃……我真的、真的、真——的不想去……
Get the school invitation from Seasum room and bring it to Seasum.
从 Seasum 的房间拿走学校的邀请函，交给 Seasum。
Yep, that's the right letter. I hope you like school!
对，就是这封信。希望你会喜欢学校！
I don't even want to learn magic! I just want to write my stories and play games. You can go instead.
我根本不想学魔法！我只想写我的故事、玩游戏。你替我去吧。
I know the picture on the letter is of me, but you can, um...
我知道信上的照片是我，不过你可以，呃……
You can say you had a growth spurt! Uh, that should work, i think!
你可以说你突然长高了！呃，我想应该行得通！
Now go on, you should get out before my parents see you. I don't want them to find out I gave that letter away...
好了快去吧，趁我爸妈还没看到你，你快出去。我可不想让他们发现我把那封信送人了……
Talk to the School Ship Captain on the pier next to the Seaskipper Captain.
与渡船船长旁边码头上的学校船长交谈。
Hey! What are you doing all the way over here? This dock's broken.
嘿！你跑到这么远的地方来干嘛？这个码头坏了。
Oh, a student, you say. Aren't you a little old to be learning fundamental magical knowledge?
噢，你说你是学生。你学基础魔法知识不嫌年纪有点大吗？
Well, if I could see your invitation letter, then?
那么，能让我看看你的邀请函吗？
...Hm. This...wow, you really look quite different than the picture. Did you get a new haircut?
……嗯。这个……哇，你跟照片上看起来真的很不一样。你剪了新发型吗？
Well, no judging from me! Keep walking to the end of the dock. Have faith!
嗯，我不会评判你！一直走到码头尽头。要有信心！
Alright everyone. Ready for a magical experience?
好了各位。准备好迎接一场魔法体验了吗？
We're headed to the Nexus. You've been told where to go. If you've forgotten, ask your fellow students!
我们要前往枢纽。该去哪里大家都被告知过了。要是忘了，就问问你们的同学！
If you ever need to come back here, just walk out onto the dock again. Good luck, now!
如果想回来这里，只要再走上码头就行。祝你们好运！
Follow the children to the school.
Through the wall, right? I hope my uniform doesn't get dirty.
穿过墙壁，对吧？希望我的制服不会弄脏。
Talk to Cidre on the school island.
与学校岛上的 Cidre 交谈。
Welcome to the island of Grookwarts! I will be guiding and helping all the new students.
欢迎来到 Grookwarts 岛！我会负责引导和帮助所有新生。
You can find everything here around the docks. Choosing your materials is very important, so buy the ones that speak to you!
所有东西都能在码头这一带买到。挑选材料非常重要，所以买那些跟你有缘的吧！
When you're done, meet with Miss Una at the front gates!
买好之后，到前门找 Una 小姐！
Purchase a wand from the Wand Merchant and a book from the Magical Book Merchant, then talk to Una.
向魔杖商人买一根魔杖，向魔法书商人买一本书，然后与 Una 交谈。
好嘞，小雏鸟 Grook 们！
Seems like you all have your materials in order. You are now free to enter Grookwarts and begin your lessons.
看来大家的材料都准备齐了。你们现在可以进入 Grookwarts，开始上课了。
The door is just behind me. Walk on in!
Attend the welcoming dinner at Grookwarts.
参加 Grookwarts 的迎新晚宴。
Hush, hush! The speech will be soon!
Hurry, take a seat! The banquet will be starting any second now!
快，找位子坐下！宴会随时都要开始了！
Magical children of Wynn and Gavel alike... We welcome you here, to our fair academy.
Wynn 与 Gavel 的魔法孩子们……我们欢迎你们来到我们美好的学院。
Oh lordy, the headmaster! I didn't even see him come in!
噢天啊，是校长！我连他什么时候进来的都没看到！
Uhm... I don't see him at all, actually...
呃……其实我根本没看到他……
Well, I should hope you can see me now, all of you. Oh, what a splendid turnout this year!
嗯，希望你们现在都看得到我了。噢，今年来的人真是多得出色！
Apologies, I simply can't resist a bit of theatrics. But now, it is time to listen and learn, fledgeling Grooks.
抱歉，我就是忍不住要来点戏剧效果。不过现在，该听讲和学习了，小雏鸟 Grook 们。
We knowledged mages and scholars, the Order of the Grook, are pleased to see each of you here. Whether you be a young mind aching with curiosity...
我们这些博学的法师与学者——Grook 魔法学院——很高兴在这里见到你们每一位。无论你是满怀好奇心的年轻头脑……
...or an old hat looking to refine their knowledge, all seeking to learn magic are welcomed here. We expect great things of you.
……还是想精进知识的老手，所有想学习魔法的人在这里都受欢迎。我们对你们寄予厚望。
Now, to business. You will write your schedules for the semester. Look down on your paper and write in what classes you wish to participate in.
好，说正事。你们要写下这学期的课表。低头看你们的纸，写下想上的课。
You will need to choose four classes, one from each category. The categories are: Elemental Magic, Practical Magic, Magical Creatures, and Types of magic.
你们需要选四门课，每个类别各一门。类别分别是: 元素魔法、实用魔法、魔法生物，以及魔法类型。
The schedule book is at the end of the table. Worry not, there is no limit on class size. If you wish to take it, you may take it.
课表簿在桌子的尽头。别担心，课程人数没有上限。想上就可以上。
Talk to the Ghost Guide and attend your chosen classes (The Ghost Guide will lead you to each class):
与幽灵向导交谈，并参加你选的课程 (幽灵向导会带你去每一堂课):
I'll be leading you to your classes, everyone! Talk to me when you're ready to go.
我会带大家去上课！准备好了就跟我说。
Alright, fledgeling Grooks! Your first class is starting in just a minute. Follow me!
好了，小雏鸟 Grook 们！第一堂课马上就要开始了。跟我来！
Here are the elemental classes. Step on in. Your magical journey truly begins here!
这里是元素课的教室。进去吧。你们的魔法之旅真正从这里开始！
Now, all of you. Sit. Listen.
Earth is an element of great power. Versatile and everpresent, nearly as the air.
土是力量强大的元素。用途广泛，无所不在，几乎跟空气一样。
Thunder provides force... Earth provides sheer power. The difference... Force choose its own path. Power is force, directed.
雷提供冲劲……土提供纯粹的力量。两者的差别……冲劲自己选择去向。力量，是有方向的冲劲。
Earth is also the earth itself. Stone, metal, trees and soil. Trees sway in the wind, but do not break. And the mountains do not crumble.
土也是大地本身。石头、金属、树木与泥土。树木随风摇摆，却不会折断。而山岳不会崩塌。
The Touroto, stepped in earthly magic, are nearly invincible to all but themselves. It is proof of the earth's strength.
浸润着大地魔法的 Touroto，除了它们自己以外，几乎没有东西伤得了它们。这正是大地之力的证明。
The Doguns... They were masters of the earth, and fire alike, shaping caverns to their will... And now, nearly extinct. A terrible crime...
Dogun……他们是土与火的大师，随心所欲地塑造洞窟……而如今，几近灭绝。可怕的罪行……
But we shall honor them, and move forwards. We shall strike the earth and claim it to be our own.
但我们将缅怀他们，继续前进。我们将击打大地，将它据为己有。
The tome directs the earth's force. Take it and utilize it to shatter the stones I summon.
典籍能引导大地之力。拿起它，用它击碎我召唤出来的石头。
The darkest parts of the stones are weak points. Find them, and learn the power of the earth.
石头最暗的部分是弱点。找到它们，领会大地的力量。
You know the earth's power, fledgeling. There is nothing more for you here. Go.
你已经领会大地的力量了，雏鸟。这里没有别的能教你了。走吧。
Hee hee, take your seats, take your seats, TAKE. YOUR. SEATS. A marvelous batch of eager students today!!
嘻嘻，坐下，坐下，给。我。坐。下。今天来了一群多么出色又热切的学生！！
Almost as marvelous as the powers of Thunder! Energy! Pure, unfocused energy! Devastation, desolation, industrialization all alike!
几乎跟雷的力量一样出色！能量！纯粹、未经聚焦的能量！毁灭、荒芜、工业化，统统一样！
Yes, yes! Thunder is technical and versatile! Unreliable to all those who don't know how to rely on it, to those dexterous of hand and mind!
对，对！雷讲究技巧又用途广泛！对那些不懂怎么驾驭它的人来说不可靠，只有手巧心灵的人才驾驭得了！
But woe, woe, Thunder is reviled, reviled! Pure energy has no morality! If used for good, yes yes, ho hum, but if used for evil, oh, burn the witch! Burn, burn! Evil, they say! Pah!!
可是唉，唉，雷受人唾弃，唾弃！纯粹的能量没有道德！拿来做好事，是啦是啦，无所谓，可要是拿来做坏事，噢，烧死女巫！烧，烧！他们说那是邪恶！呸！！
All magicks are unaligned with silly concepts such as morality. They are pure chaos! But Thunder, the element of energy and force, it seems ever so EASY to use for evil...
所有魔法都跟道德这种可笑的概念毫无关系。它们是纯粹的混沌！可雷，这个能量与冲劲的元素，似乎就是特——别容易被拿来作恶……
And evil has found it, found it! CORRUPTION!! DEMONS!! Forces anathema to us, but knowleged in the ways of force and thus, thunder! So terrible, terrible, and thunder mages feared, feared...
而邪恶找上它了，找上它了！腐化！！恶魔！！与我们势不两立的力量，却精通冲劲之道，也就精通雷！太可怕，太可怕，雷法师受人畏惧，畏惧……
And then, then! Joyous day, the Corkians arrived with their marvelous machines, and their electromagic! Thunder controlled, thunder tamed! The wonder of it all!
然后，然后！欢天喜地的一天，Corkus 人带着他们了不起的机器和电魔法来了！雷被控制了，雷被驯服了！真是奇妙无比！
Electromagic makes handles crank, gears spin, metal move, gives sheer stones the power to THINK, and to PLAN! A Corkian original, and a splendid, splendid development reintroduced!
电魔法让曲柄转动、齿轮旋转、金属移动，还让光秃秃的石头拥有思考、拥有计划的能力！这是 Corkus 人的原创，一项重新引入的了不起、了不起的发展！
And so, you shall see for yourselves! Electromagic at work! You will control thunder and electricity, and make the machines bend to your world today, today, this shocking day!
所以，你们要亲眼见识！电魔法的运作！今天你们要控制雷与电，让机器顺从你们的意志，就在今天，今天，这令人触电的一天！
The mechanism is behind me now! Come up, come up! See the power of thunder, shackled by our whims, won't you, {u}?
装置就在我后面！上来，上来！见识一下被我们随心驾驭的雷之力，好吗，{u}？
Whee hee hee! Thunder tamed, thunder shackled, and your magical wings unbound by such petty concepts, {u}! What a show!
呜呼嘻嘻嘻！雷被驯服了，雷被锁住了，而你的魔法之翼挣脱了那些琐碎的概念，{u}！真是精彩的表演！
Expand your knowledge ever further, further! Your task is complete, complete, and your next awaits!
继续扩展你的知识，再远，再远！你的任务完成了，完成了，下一个在等着你！
Aah, wow! Everyone s-sure got here quick...
Welcome, w-welcome. The Water element class is...certainly an interesting one, I-I'd hope... Because water doesn't j-just pertain to, well, w-water...
欢迎，欢、欢迎。水元素课……应、应该算是很有意思的一门课吧，我、我希望是……因为水不只、只是跟，嗯，水、水有关……
Learning a-about the water element and e-expanding your horizons can allow you to cast spells easier... C-control the flow of magic better, you see.
了、了解水元素，扩展你的视野，能让你更轻松地施法……更好地控、控制魔法的流动，你懂吧。
Most aquatic creatures are t-tied to water, though creatures that live in icy or snowy environments are, t-too...often, they are also connected to air, but not always.
大多数水生生物都跟水有、有关联，不过住在冰雪环境里的生物也、也是……它们常常也跟风有关，但不一定。
In a-addition, many holy artifacts are enchanted with water magic... S-something about how it's a pure type of energy, I believe.
另、另外，很多神圣的宝物都附有水魔法……好、好像是因为它是一种纯粹的能量，我记得。
Lastly, healing abilities are b-bolstered by water magic. Just knowing magic well d-doesn't help, but actually having artifacts charged w-with water magic can increase healing capabilities.
最后，治疗能力会因水魔法而增、增强。光是精通魔法没、没有用，但真正拥有充满水魔法的宝物，就能提升治疗能力。
N-now, for your test, I have...um, a...a test. Anyone who wants to try it f-first, just go up and start.
那、那么，你们的测验，我准备了……呃，一个……一个测验。谁想先试，直、直接上去开始就行。
Good to see a decent turnout this year for my class. Too dangerous, pah! You can take this just fine.
很高兴今年来上我这门课的人还不少。说什么太危险，哼！你们应付得来的。
Anyways. The Fire element class. Many misunderstand just what fire stands for...but after today, you will leave with courage in your hearts.
总之。火元素课。很多人误解了火代表什么……但过了今天，你们离开时心中将充满勇气。
Fire is, of course, related to physical fire, magma, etcetera. A burning torch is a source of fire magic, but that is not the only source of it.
火当然跟实际的火、岩浆之类的有关。燃烧的火把是火魔法的来源，但那不是唯一的来源。
Courage, bravery, and defensiveness are also tied to the fire element. Those stalwart and selfless, willing to sacrifice themselves for others.
勇气、英勇与守护也跟火元素有关。那些坚定无私、愿意为他人牺牲自己的人。
In addition, although water is tied to healing magic, fire is tied to self-healing. Regenerative capacity, if you will. Many fire-based artifacts heal the user passively.
另外，水跟治疗魔法有关，火则跟自我治疗有关。可以说是再生能力。许多火系宝物会被动治疗使用者。
And while they are on the verge of extinction after the war in the {p}, the Dogun species used to embody fire and earth magic alike. It is a shame what happened to them.
虽然在 {p} 的战争之后他们已濒临灭绝，但 Dogun 这个种族曾经同时体现了火与土的魔法。他们的遭遇真令人惋惜。
Unfortunately, it is also notable that corrupted creatures are often connected to fire, by nature of the corruption seeming to bring heat wherever it goes...
可惜，同样值得注意的是，被腐化的生物常常跟火有关，因为腐化似乎走到哪里就把热带到哪里……
But aside from that, onto our practical test. You will all come up to me, starting with {u}, and hone courage. I will be casting balls of fire at you.
不过先不说这些，开始我们的实践测试。你们依次到我面前来，从 {u} 开始，锻炼勇气。我会向你们发射火球。
You will need to dodge these fire charges. If you are hit, it counts as a failure. Now. Let's get started, {u}.
你们得躲开这些火焰冲击。被打中就算失败。好了。开始吧，{u}。
Are you ready? Summon your bravery.
准备好了吗？鼓起你的勇气。
Well done, fledgeling Grook! Continue to sharpen your instincts. You'll be a fine hero someday, I am sure of it.
干得好，雏鸟 Grook！继续磨练你的直觉。总有一天你会成为出色的英雄，我确信这一点。
Dismissed, {u}. You may leave. Now do I have any volunteers for the next round...?
下课，{u}。你可以走了。那么下一轮有没有自愿者……？
Arright class, the sooner we start, the sooner we finish, so everyone, take your seats! You'll be getting up soon enough anyways!
好啦同学们，越早开始越早结束，所以大家都坐下！反正你们很快就要站起来了！
Movin' right along. Air! You're breathin' it, we're surrounded by it, but ain'tcha know what it's all about yet, so pay attention.
我们继续。气！你们在呼吸它，我们被它包围着，可你们还不知道它是怎么回事，所以注意听。
Air is the element of freedom! Speed, wind, and agility. If you're trained well in agility, attacks'll seem like they just phase through ya!
气是自由的元素！速度、风与敏捷。如果你敏捷练得好，攻击就会像直接从你身上穿过去一样！
But over and above that, 'cause of air's ever-presence, it's one of the most versatile kinda of magic in existence. People use it in all sorts of ways.
不过更重要的是，因为风无所不在，它是世上用途最广的魔法之一。大家用它的方式五花八门。
Over in Gavel, the Bantisu Air Monks have managed to extend their sight by the wind! They use this to help guide folks who get lost in that canyon over there.
在 Gavel 那边，Bantisu 风僧已经能借着风延伸视野了！他们用它来引导在那边峡谷里迷路的人。
Many winged sorts a'creatures are tied to air, but not all of them. Some air magic users just straight-out float! Now wouldn't that be nice, eh?
很多有翅膀的生物都跟风有关，但不是全部。有些魔法使用者直接就浮起来了！那不是很棒吗，嗯？
Due to their tenuous physicality, souls and spirits are also often related to air magic. Makes ya wonder if you could just blow a ghost out the window!
因为形体很虚，灵魂和幽灵也常常跟风魔法有关。让你怀疑能不能直接把鬼吹出窗外！
And finally, some old, old tales tell of a woman who crossed the sea before it was calmed using air magic to fly. 's just an old legend, but an interesting one.
最后，有些非常古老的传说讲到，在海洋平静下来之前，有个女人靠风魔法飞越了大海。只是个古老的传说，不过挺有意思的。
Now, onto the practical test! It's time to get those bones a-shakin'! You'll be runnin' an obstacle course I have set up, but with a twist.
现在来进行实作测验！是时候让你们活动活动筋骨了！你们要跑一趟我设计的障碍赛道，不过有个小花样。
Everyone up to the table! You'll need this feather with ya to get through. It'll help you jump higher!
大家都到桌子这边来！你们得带着这根羽毛才能过关。它能帮你跳得更高！
The goal is to grab three crystal balls I put in the obstacle course. Once you find 'em, bring 'em back to me.
目标是拿到我放在障碍赛道里的三颗水晶球。找到之后，带回来给我。
The course is behind me. Shake a leg, now!
赛道就在我后面。赶紧的！
Lessee here, one, two, three, yes indeedy! You got through that pretty quick!
我看看，一、二、三，没错！你过得挺快的！
Now, if you'll just hand me back that feather ya got there...
好，现在只要把你拿着的那根羽毛还给我……
...then you'll be all done! Congrats, little fledge, you've finished this class! Now get on along to your next one!
……那你就全部完成了！恭喜，小雏鸟，你上完这堂课了！快去上下一堂吧！
Moving swiftly on, the next class is just across the way. Follow me!
我们赶快继续，下一堂课就在对面。跟我来！
Alright everyone, take a seat but don't get comfy. You'll be getting up soon. Hope you brought your reading glasses.
好了各位。坐下，但别坐得太舒服。你们很快就要站起来了。希望你们带了老花眼镜。
See, I'll just be giving you a short primer, then sending you out for your practical exercise, since I have all this written down already.
你看，我只会给你们简短的入门讲解，然后就让你们去做实作练习，反正我都已经写下来了。
The basis of this class is that many materials, whether you know it or not, are inherently magical in some way or another. If you want to be an artificer, you need to know how each one works.
这堂课的基础是，很多材料不管你知不知道，本身都带有某种魔法性质。如果你想当工匠术士，就得知道每一种材料是怎么运作的。
Thankfully, the field of artifice is a very popular one, so there's a wealth of knowledge out there on magical materials and on how to use them effectively.
幸好器物工艺这门学问很热门，所以外面有大量关于魔法材料以及如何有效使用它们的知识。
Heck, Wynn soldiers are cobbling together rings out of copper and old spider silk, so you know this sort of thing is easy to get into. Tough to master, though!
天啊，连 Wynn 士兵都在用铜和旧蜘蛛丝拼凑戒指，所以你们知道这种东西很容易入门。不过要精通就难了！
For those intimidated, you don't need much crafting knowledge for this class; you'll be reading up on everything you need to know in the back.
觉得有压力的同学别担心，这堂课不需要多少制作知识；你需要知道的一切都能在后面读到。
You all will be crafting a magical amulet using different items. I've got stockpiles in the back; everyone will be crafting a different kind of necklace.
你们都要用不同的物品制作一个魔法护符。我在后面准备了材料；每个人都会做不同种类的项链。
Here's a note of what you should craft. Once you have the materials you think you need, come to the crafting table. It's enchanted, and will craft the item for you if you have what you need.
这张纸条写着你该做什么。等你拿到你认为需要的材料，就到制作台来。它被附了魔，只要材料齐全就会帮你把物品做出来。
Mhm, that's the ticket, {u}. If you're interested in learning more, you can probably find my books in most of the libraries.
嗯，就是这样，{u}。如果你有兴趣深入了解，大部分图书馆应该都找得到我写的书。
Your feathers are coming in just nicely, fledgeling. You can scoot off to your next class now.
你的羽毛长得真不错，小雏鸟。你可以去上下一堂课了。
Okay class, everyone take your seats, and listen up. This class is going to be interesting.
好了同学们，大家坐下，注意听。这堂课会很有意思。
As you know, this class is all about magical effects, specifically those tied to various materials, and how they'll affect you!
你们都知道，这堂课讲的是魔法效果，特别是跟各种材料有关的效果，以及它们会怎么影响你！
This is going to be a hands-on learning experience, so those of you with weak constitutions may request to skip the demonstration if you're concerned for your health.
这会是一堂亲身体验的课，所以体质比较弱、担心健康的同学可以申请跳过示范。
It may be explosive, but it will be in a controlled manner. The worst that'll happen to you is your face will get a bit dusty, or your glasses will fall off.
它可能会爆炸，但会在可控范围内。最糟的情况也只是你的脸会沾点灰，或是眼镜掉下来。
Magical crystals, as we have to my left here, can be charged with all kinds of different effects. This is an incredibly valuable aspect for artificers.
魔法水晶，就像我左边这些，可以充入各种不同的效果。这对工匠术士来说是极其宝贵的特性。
Our last sample is of cosmic material, and if you're sickened easily, then don't examine it. Its effects are mostly unknown, but one thing's certain...
我们最后一个样本是宇宙物质，如果你容易觉得不舒服，就别去检查它。它的效果大多未知，但有一件事可以肯定……
...it's dangerous to be exposed for long periods. Now, each of you will go back behind me, and examine and interact with each of the three samples provided.
……长时间接触它很危险。好了，你们每个人都到我后面去，检查并接触提供的三个样本。
Once you've done so, then you can leave. Hands-on training is the best way to learn, after all.
做完之后就可以离开。毕竟亲手实践是最好的学习方式。
Well done. How did that feel?
Personally, the void sample is the most interesting to me. You may now leave the classroom.
就我个人来说，虚空样本最有意思。你现在可以离开教室了。
There's a bit of a walk to your next class. Follow me.
去下一堂课要走一段路。跟我来。
These staircases were supposed to move, but... That was too much work to put together, apparently. They're a pain to navigate, aren't they?
这些楼梯本来应该会动的，可是……显然要做出来太费工了。在上面找路很麻烦，对吧？
Alright, fledgeling grooks. Time to hit you all with the info you're really here for!
好了，小雏鸟 Grook 们。现在就来告诉你们真正想知道的东西！
But no one actually KNOWS for sure. That means they. Could. Be. ANYTHING! What could lie beneath that veneer of fluff and playful demeanor?!
可是没有人真的确定。这代表它们。可能。是。任何东西！在那层毛茸茸和调皮可爱的外表底下，可能藏着什么？！
These materials have innate magical energy to them. Stable like lodestone and reliable like quartz, but not as powerful as either. Interesting, that a fluffball has that potential!!
这些材料天生带有魔法能量。像磁石一样稳定，像石英一样可靠，但没有两者那么强。一团毛球居然有这种潜力，真有意思！！
And the worst part is, if too much fluff gathers up in one spot, ANOTHER WYBEL APPEARS! They reproduce by budding!! Growing out of lint and dust! It's a no-win game they're makin' us play!
最糟的是，要是太多毛聚在同一个地方，就会冒出另一只 Wybel！它们靠出芽繁殖！！从棉絮和灰尘里长出来！它们在逼我们玩一场赢不了的游戏！
Wybels do have some good use though...they can sniff out sources of cosmic magic, like a pig sniffs out truffles. Sometimes they even try to take it home.
不过 Wybel 确实有些好用处……它们能嗅出宇宙魔法的来源，就像猪能嗅出松露一样。有时它们甚至会想把它带回家。
They're here to kill us all, I swear it! How else would you explain a wybel VAPORIZING a group of poachers? Ten colors of wybel, every one of them rotten evil!
它们是来杀光我们的，我发誓！不然你要怎么解释一只 Wybel 把一群盗猎者蒸发掉？十种颜色的 Wybel，每一种都邪恶透顶！
Alrighty, fledgeling, good job. You're armed with the REAL truth now! Go on to your next class.
好嘞，小雏鸟，干得好。你现在掌握真正的真相了！去上下一堂课吧。
Hello, students. This is your magical creatures class, and I will be your instructor.
同学们好。这是魔法生物课，我是你们的讲师。
Different species have different levels of innate magicality. This is often an invisible aspect of the species. You must never assume.
不同种族天生的魔法性各不相同。这往往是种族看不见的特质。千万不要妄下定论。
To begin with, Doguns. They are ancient creatures, artificial-seeming at first. Despite this, they are highly adept at earth and fire-based magic.
首先，Dogun。他们是古老的生物，乍看之下像是人造的。尽管如此，他们非常擅长以土和火为基础的魔法。
Able to quite literally move mountains, it is theorized that they were the ones to carve out the inside of the {p} into the caves we know today.
他们真的能移山，有理论认为，就是他们把 {p} 的内部挖成了我们今天所知道的洞窟。
Moving on. We'll touch on the societies of Trolls, Goblins, Orcs, Ogres, and Hobgoblins. Some include Gerts into this grouping, though by technicality they are separate.
我们继续。接下来讲讲巨魔、哥布林、兽人、食人魔和大地精的社会。有些人把 Gert 族也算进这一类，不过严格来说他们是另一类。
Though many of these types of societies have mystical practices, the only known way for Orcs and such to utilize magic is through artifacts. They've little magical potential.
虽然这类社会很多都有神秘的仪式习俗，但兽人之类的种族唯一已知使用魔法的方式是通过宝物。他们的魔法潜力很低。
Tales also tell of their utilizing demonic energy for various purposes. However, we are only able to assume their magical energy from Dwarven tales, as they are nigh-extinct
传说也提到他们为了各种目的使用恶魔能量。不过，由于他们几近灭绝，我们只能从矮人的传说推测他们的魔法能量
Moving on. The term "Greenskins" is a catch-all for Trolls, Goblins, Orcs, Ogres and Hobgoblins. Some include Gerts into this definition, though by technicality they are separate.
我们继续。“绿皮族”是巨魔、哥布林、兽人、食人魔和大地精的统称。有些人把 Gert 族也算进去，不过严格来说他们是另一类。
Though many Greenskins societies with mystical particles, the only known way for them to utilize magic is through magical artifacts. They've little magic potential.
虽然很多绿皮族社会都有神秘的仪式习俗，但他们唯一已知使用魔法的方式是通过魔法宝物。他们的魔法潜力很低。
Meanwhile, Villagers are of the opposite persuasion. High magical potential, often unrealized out of laziness.
而村民正好相反。魔法潜力很高，却常常因为懒惰而没有发挥出来。
Humans are often thought of as more magical than Villagers, due to Fruman soldiers seeming to know some magic innately, but this is untrue.
人们常以为人类比村民更有魔法天分，因为 Fruma 的士兵似乎天生就会一些魔法，但这并不是真的。
Dwarves have a similar level of magicality to Humans, but like Villagers, it often goes unrealized. Their culture values physical strength more.
矮人的魔法性跟人类差不多，但就像村民一样，常常没有发挥出来。他们的文化更看重体力。
It is theorized that the reason for this is due to their distaste for the demonic energies of the Doguns. They reject their magic potential often, such that it is lessening over time.
有理论认为，这是因为他们厌恶 Dogun 那股恶魔能量。他们常常排斥自己的魔法潜力，以至于这份潜力随着时间逐渐减弱。
Inversely, Elves have a deep connection to their magicality. Despite their reclusiveness, they are known for their open share of magical energy within their own society.
相反地，精灵与自身的魔法性有着深厚的联系。尽管他们与世隔绝，他们在自己的社会里却以公开分享魔法能量著称。
The outcast Elves of {p} have shared their connection to what they refer to as 'The Light.' This connection is supposedly unfathomable, but guides them and protects them.
{p} 那些被放逐的精灵，分享了他们与自己称之为“光”的东西之间的联系。据说这份联系深不可测，却引导着他们、保护着他们。
Now, we see if you were paying attention. You will come here and order the societies I have referred to in this class from least magical, to most.
现在，我们来看看你们有没有专心听。你们要上来，把我在课堂上提到的种族，从魔法性最弱排到最强。
Well done, you got it right!
Correct. {u}, thank you for paying attention. No one ever seems to in this class. You may go.
正确。{u}，谢谢你专心听讲。这门课好像从来没人认真听。你可以走了。
Next class is actually rather close!
...I was hoping for a smaller class size.
Corruption is incredibly dangerous...it'll be tough to keep so many students safe. If anyone wishes to leave, you may.
腐化非常危险……要保护这么多学生的安全可不容易。想离开的人可以离开。
Now... Corruption is a force of nature of...some description. Yes, you heard me right. We don't actually know much about it.
好了……腐化是一种……某种自然之力。对，你没听错。我们其实对它所知不多。
Even though it's plagued the Wynn province for a thousand years, the way it behaves is so incredibly alien in nature that it's nigh-impossible to study.
尽管它已经困扰 Wynn 行省一千年了，它的行为方式实在太过怪异，几乎不可能研究。
We know it raises undead bodies... The working theory is that the more heavily injured a target is, the more susceptible they are to being corrupted.
我们知道它会让尸体复活……目前的理论是，目标伤得越重，就越容易被腐化。
And...well, you can't exactly get more injured than "dead." Hence, the growth of zombies and skeletons and all, over in Wynn.
而……嗯，没有什么比“死了”伤得更重了。所以 Wynn 那边才会冒出那么多僵尸和骷髅。
It appears to spread by a complex "root" system. A scientist from {p}, Orikal, has studied this. The corruption spikes appear to spread it in greater concentration.
它似乎是通过一种复杂的“根系”蔓延的。一位来自 {p} 的科学家 Orikal 研究过这个。腐化尖刺似乎会让它以更高的浓度扩散。
As for the effects on your person, most often paranoia and anger are seen. And that's about the only consistent thing with it; it affects everyone slightly differently.
至于对人的影响，最常见的是偏执和愤怒。这大概也是它唯一一致的地方；它对每个人的影响都略有不同。
The worst part is that practically every single thing we've touched on here is conjecture and theorycrafting! The force of corruption is terrifying.
最糟的是，我们在这里讲到的几乎每一件事都是推测和理论！腐化之力真的很可怕。
The only thing we know for certain is that powerful ice-based magic can halt corruption, as seen in the {p} region.
我们唯一确定的是，强大的冰系魔法能阻止腐化，就像在 {p} 地区看到的那样。
Now, the dangerous part. Everyone, come up past my desk here. We'll examine a corrupted creature in a controlled environment.
好，危险的部分来了。大家都到我的桌子后面来。我们要在受控的环境下观察一只被腐化的生物。
We have one in captivity, and its cage is reinforced with the strongest metals we have...so dear god let it be enough.
我们关着一只，它的笼子是用我们最坚固的金属加固的……老天保佑，但愿够用。
Bringing it out now...be sure to back up. We don't want anyone caught in the crossfire here.
现在把它带出来……一定要往后退。我们可不想有人被波及。
One thing to note about undead corrupteds...they can't be cured. You can weaken them, but that's about it. ...wait...
关于不死的腐化者，有一件事要注意……它们治不好。你可以削弱它们，但也就这样了。……等等……
Wait, why's it spreading here? It's never done this before! E-everyone, back up, now!
等等，它为什么在这里蔓延？它以前从来没这样过！大、大家，马上往后退！
A-as you can see, corruption is very powerful, eheheh, c-can someone go get another teacher or something?!
如、如你们所见，腐化非常强大，呃嘿嘿，有、有人能去叫另一位老师来吗？！
Wait, no! It's corroding the bars! Everyone, RUN! NOW! GET OUT OF HERE, CLASS DISMISSED!!!
等等，不！它在腐蚀栏杆！大家快跑！马上！离开这里，下课了！！！
GAACK! No, {u}, I said RUN! Don't fight that thing, get OUT!
嘎啊！不，{u}，我说的是跑！别跟那东西打，快出去！
Dear lord...that was awful. {u}, I can't believe you were able to kill that thing!
我的天……太可怕了。{u}，真不敢相信你居然杀得了那东西！
Class absolutely dismissed. We've got to cancel this class...it's far too dangerous for the students...
绝对下课了。我们得取消这门课……对学生来说太危险了……
There's two main ways of usin' nature magic... Shamanism and druidism. Two sides of the same coin, man.
使用自然魔法主要有两种方式……萨满术和德鲁伊术。一体两面，老兄。
Either way, it's all about equivalent exchange, y'see? You can't get somethin' from nothin', man. Either make life or take life.
不管哪种，重点都是等价交换，懂吗？不能无中生有，老兄。要么创造生命，要么夺取生命。
You'll need to sacrifice some old grooks, but it has to be just the right amount, man! The practice is through the door behind me.
你们得献祭一些老 Grook，但分量必须刚刚好，老兄！练习场就在我后面的门里。
Groovy work, man! You're at one with nature!
干得真酷，老兄！你跟大自然合而为一了！
Your feathers are all grown out, man! Time to head out!
你的羽毛都长齐了，老兄！该出发了！
That's all four classes! I hope you found them magically enriching! Now, off to the graduation hall!
四堂课都上完了！希望你们都觉得获益良多！现在，去毕业大厅吧！
It's the room all the way at the bottom of the stairs. Hurry, don't hold up the ceremony! It won't start until everyone's there.
就是楼梯最底下的那个房间。快点，别耽误典礼！大家到齐才会开始。
Go to the ceremony room for the Headmaster's closing speech.
前往典礼厅，聆听校长的结业致辞。
Take a seat. The ceremony is starting.
And so, your teachings, or at least their basics, have ended. Your magical feathers have started to grow!
就这样，你们的课程，至少是基础课程，已经结束了。你们的魔法羽毛已经开始生长了！
You have all been performing very well during your classes today. I've heard quite a bit of praise from the teachers being passed around.
你们今天在课堂上都表现得非常好。我听到老师们之间传着不少称赞。
But now, for your efforts, you shall not go unrewarded. You will leave here with more than simply knowledge.
而现在，你们的努力不会没有回报。你们离开这里时带走的不只有知识。
Your tools have shaped your minds, subtly but inexorably. And so with that, what you leave with today, both in mind and in treasure, shall be different for each of you.
你们的工具已经悄悄地、却无可避免地塑造了你们的思维。因此，你们今天带走的东西，无论是心智上还是宝物上，每个人都会不同。
There is a reason I've called you up first, you know. Recall what I said about old hats earlier? Don't think we didn't notice the armor, or the weapon, or the grim countenance.
我第一个叫你上来是有原因的，你知道吗。还记得我之前说的老手吗？别以为我们没注意到那身盔甲、那把武器，还有那张严峻的脸。
But no need to worry. Those who truly have the drive to become learned in the ways of magic, no matter who they are, will always find their way here, and be accepted.
不过不必担心。真正有决心学习魔法之道的人，无论是谁，总会找到来这里的路，并被接纳。
A shame about Seasum, but not to worry. Now, hand over your materials, and you'll receive your rewards.
Seasum 的事很可惜，不过不必在意。好了，交出你的材料，你就能拿到你的奖励。
And there you have it. Your feathers are grown, and you can spread your magical wings! Good luck on your adventures, Wynn soldier.
就是这样。你的羽毛长齐了，可以展开你的魔法之翼了！祝你冒险顺利，Wynn 的士兵。
The element of bravery and resolve. Now, choose a Practical Magic lesson.
勇气与决心的元素。接下来，选一堂实用魔法课。
Artificing is a very useful tool for the burgeoning magic user! I'm fond of it, myself. Now, choose a Magical Creatures class.
器物工艺对初露头角的魔法使用者来说是非常有用的工具！我自己也很喜欢。接下来，选一堂魔法生物课。
So you seek a broad spectrum of knowledge upon magicality! I wholeheartedly approve. Lastly, you must choose a Magical Type class.
所以你追求的是广博的魔法学识！我衷心赞同。最后，你得选一堂魔法类型课。
You have learned enough here, I believe. Now, it is up to you whether you want to continue with other lessons or try to master this test.
我相信你在这里学到的已经够多了。现在，你可以决定是继续去上其他课，还是试着攻克这项测验。
Quartz is a versatile magical material useful in nearly any magical item in some fashion.
石英是一种用途广泛的魔法材料，几乎所有魔法物品都能以某种方式用上它。
Due to its natural ability to passively absorb magical energy, it is a phenominally applicable material for magical batteries or storage.
由于它天生能被动吸收魔法能量，它是制作魔法电池或储能装置极为合适的材料。
Magical marvels such as the electromagic generator in {p} are powered primarily by quartz and related materials.
像 {p} 的电魔法发电机这样的魔法奇迹，主要就是靠石英及相关材料驱动的。
However, it has its limits. While it is effective at storing energy, it can only store a finite amount.
不过，它也有极限。虽然它存储能量很有效，但只能存储有限的量。
Overloading quartz with magical energy can cause it to create magical discharge, which can overcharge nearby quartz as well, causing violent chain reactions.
给石英充入过量的魔法能量，会使它产生魔法放电，连带让附近的石英也过载，引发剧烈的连锁反应。
Cosmic magic is being studied presently by magical experts. There are few conclusive truths of cosmic energies, one such being that it is only found in things fallen from the sky.
宇宙魔法目前正由魔法专家进行研究。关于宇宙能量，确凿的事实寥寥无几，其中之一是它只存在于从天而降的东西里。
The meteors and comets that have fallen are difficult to study, as not only does each color or type of fallen meteor appear to have different magical effects on its environment...
坠落的陨石和彗星很难研究，因为不仅每种颜色或类型的陨石似乎都会对周遭环境产生不同的魔法效果……
...but many types of meteor have been found to induce a creeping insanity in those exposed to it for extended periods. Three initial cosmic researchers fell prey to this effect.
……而且许多类型的陨石都被发现会让长期接触者逐渐陷入疯狂。最早的三名宇宙研究者就成了这种效应的牺牲品。
Small samples and meteor shards appear generally safe, but are to be treated with the utmost care and caution. Gavellian law outlaws non-registered usage of cosmic materials.
小块样本和陨石碎片一般看来是安全的，但仍须以最高程度的谨慎处理。Gavel 法律禁止未经登记使用宇宙材料。
Magical stabilizers do as they state, stabilize magical energy. Though materials such as quartz and runes are useful, misuse can result in disaster for the user.
魔法稳定器顾名思义，就是用来稳定魔法能量的。石英和符文之类的材料虽然有用，但使用不当可能给使用者带来灾难。
Thus, stabilizers are a necessity for creating safe-to-use magical items. In the past, these manifested as massive chains of quartz batteries or wasteful use of metals such as gold or silver.
因此，要制造安全可用的魔法物品，稳定器是必需的。过去，稳定器的形式是一长串庞大的石英电池，或是大量耗用金银之类的金属。
Recently however, a material called Lodestone was discovered. It actively stabilizes influxes of magical energy far more efficiently than jewels or precious metals.
不过，最近发现了一种名为磁石的材料。它能主动稳定涌入的魔法能量，效率远高于宝石或贵金属。
However, it has the side effect of leaching excess magic into the environment into a raw form. It is theorized that the presence of Lodestone in Gavel has...
然而，它有个副作用：会把多余的魔法以原始形态渗漏到周遭环境中。有理论认为，Gavel 境内存在的磁石……
...contributed heavily to the diverse flora and fauna of the region; the magic energy influenced evolution in ways that areas like Wynn have not seen.
……大大促成了这个地区多样的动植物；魔法能量以 Wynn 等地区从未见过的方式影响了生物的演化。
Powders, while simple in actual structure, are often misunderstood except by enchanters and artificers.
粉末的实际结构虽然简单，但除了附魔师和工匠术士之外，常常被人误解。

Being made of specific blends of various items with magical ties to elements, certain powders are easier to create than others. Magical plants are easier to grind down than magical minerals, for instance.
粉末由与各元素有魔法联系的各种物品按特定比例调配而成，因此某些粉末比其他的更容易制作。例如，魔法植物就比魔法矿物更容易磨碎。
After each item is ground to dust, enchanters purify the blend to remove extraneous aspects, leaving only the pure elemental powder in its wake.
每样物品都磨成粉之后，附魔师会净化混合物，去除多余的成分，最后只留下纯净的元素粉末。
Items more heavily attuned to a specific element will create a stronger blend of powder, but even items with the slightest connection to an element can conceivably be used to create a powder.
与特定元素契合度越高的物品，制成的粉末就越强；但即使是与某种元素只有一丝联系的物品，理论上也能用来制作粉末。
To apply powders to items in a refined way, one must either incorporate the mix into the base construction of an item, or utilize the energies within for an enchantment.
要以精细的方式把粉末用在物品上，要么把混合物融入物品的基础构造，要么利用其中的能量来附魔。
Merely sprinkling powders over other things will not generate any magical effects, although some artists are known to use powders to make brilliant colors of paint, strangely.
只是把粉末撒在其他东西上，并不会产生任何魔法效果；不过说来奇怪，有些画家会用粉末调出鲜艳的颜料。
Most magic items require a "focus" in order to draw out and direct their magical energies. Many items are usable as foci, but certain items have been found to be far more effective than others.
大多数魔法物品都需要一个“聚焦物”，才能引出并导引其中的魔法能量。很多物品都能当作聚焦物，但某些物品被发现效果远胜其他。
Jewels and precious stones are easy to channel magic through, and thus are often used in conjunction as basic foci. Certain gems have inclination towards specific elements...
珠宝和宝石很容易让魔法通过，因此常被搭配用作基础聚焦物。某些宝石偏向特定的元素……
...most often indicated by the color of the gem, but all are applicable for general purposes.
……这通常可以从宝石的颜色看出来，不过所有宝石都适用于一般用途。
A less common type of focus is found in the form of Runes. They are a magical unknown, for all intents and purposes, with each specific rune seeming to have a different magical inclination.
符文是一种较少见的聚焦物。无论怎么看，它们都是魔法上的未知数，每一种符文似乎都有不同的魔法倾向。
Only five types of Runes have ever been found, and after a disastrous attempt at combining Runic power, horrifically powerful Rune Guardians have begun to appear in Gavel to guard them.
迄今为止只发现过五种符文，而在一次结合符文之力的灾难性尝试之后，强大得可怕的符文守护者开始出现在 Gavel 各地守护它们。
Due to this, the remaining stockpile of Runes continues to dwindle as they are used and sold between their holders, or hoarded by the wealthy.
因此，随着符文被使用、在持有者之间买卖，或是被富人囤积，剩下的符文存量持续减少。
The crafting table isn't responding. Looks like you haven't got the right items.
制作台没有反应。看来你拿的物品不对。
The crafting table responds, and the materials shape themselves into a rather fetching amulet.
制作台有了反应，材料自行塑形，变成了一条相当漂亮的护符。
My dad said I can't let any strangers through this passage!
我爸爸说不能让任何陌生人通过这条通道！
If you want access, talk to him, he's the recruiter of the town! His name is Ildan. He's just southwest of here.
你想过去的话，就去跟他谈，他是镇上负责招募的人！他叫 Ildan，就在这里西南边。
Find Ildan in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and ask to be a member of the town
在 {p} [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找到 Ildan，请求成为镇上的一员
Oh! So you want to become a member of this town?
哦！所以你想成为这个镇的一员？
You will have to help us first, of course!
当然，你得先帮我们一个忙！
They used to have a powerful chief, but he eventually died in battle.
他们以前有个强大的酋长，但他最后战死了。
The tribe couldn't bear the fact that he was dead. They performed some unethical necromancy spell on him.
部落没法接受他死了的事实，就对他施了某种违背伦理的死灵法术。
He keeps reviving his minions and it's causing quite some problems to our army.
他不停地复活他的爪牙，给我们的军队带来了不少麻烦。
You can access the tomb from a sacrificial shrine, I've heard, but I'm not sure how. There are probably hints nearby the shrine.
我听说可以从一座献祭神龛进入墓穴，但我不确定该怎么进去。神龛附近应该有提示。
Bring me back [{~} Antic Bead] as a proof of its death, and I will let you become a citizen.
把 [{~} 古怪珠子] 带回来给我，证明它已经死了，我就让你成为这里的居民。
I've marked the direction to the shrine in your book. Remember, there should be hints right nearby the shrine. Good luck.
我已经在你的书里标出了神龛的方向。记住，神龛附近应该就有提示。祝你好运。
Search for clues near [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring back [{~} Antic Bead] to Ildan.
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 附近寻找线索，把 [{~} 古怪珠子] 带回给 Ildan。
Well, welcome to this town, adventurer! You are now officially a citizen.
好了，欢迎来到这个镇，冒险者！你现在正式成为这里的居民了。
Oh, but before you go! I do have a few things to say. First, about the beads here.
哦，你走之前！我还有几件事要说。第一，关于这里的珠子。
The tribesmen accept these as currency, so if you collect enough, I've heard they can offer you powerful masks.
部落民把这种珠子当货币用，所以如果你收集得够多，听说他们能给你强大的面具。
Second, about the shrine. Now, this is just a rumor, but apparently that tomb is not unique.
第二，关于那座神龛。这只是传闻，不过那座墓穴好像不是独一无二的。
There are supposed to be a bunch of these altars scattered around the province, even in Gavel too!
据说行省各地都散布着很多这样的祭坛，连 Gavel 也有！
If true, you should look for them. While the fights will be tough, I would imagine great rewards could be gotten from them!
如果是真的，你应该去找找看。战斗会很艰难，但我想一定能从中拿到丰厚的奖励！
Anyway, I've talked enough. I'm proud to have such a powerful fighter join our town! I wish you luck, friend!
总之，我说得够多了。有这么强的战士加入我们镇，我很自豪！祝你好运，朋友！
外来者！杀了那些外来者！
I'm sure you've noticed, but there is a tribe camp not far from here.
你应该已经注意到了，离这里不远有个部落营地。
They quickly realised that it was a bad idea, so they locked him in a tomb.
他们很快就发现这是个坏主意，于是把他锁进了一座墓穴。
Have you found the shrine yet? I've heard that throwing something as tribute to it could do the trick... There should be clues about what it might be near the shrine.
你找到那座神龛了吗？我听说丢点什么东西当作贡品也许就行得通……神龛附近应该会有线索，告诉你那该是什么。
Well... I'm glad it worked out for you.
嗯……很高兴你那边顺利解决了。
Have you heard tales about the great General Skien? Many years ago, he led the Tromsian Army into battle.
你听过伟大的 Skien 将军的故事吗？很多年前，他率领 Troms 军队上了战场。
Previously implemented locomotive models employ an engine with relatively low efficiency.
此前采用的机车型号使用的发动机效率相对较低。
Rest for the night in you room in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 钢羽里你的房间休息一晚。
...what. Where is it? W-where is it?!
My bow, Yuman! Where is it? WHERE did you put it?!
我的弓，Yuman！它在哪？你把它放哪去了？！
Hey, hey, relax, jeez! It's over here, on the meeting table! It fell off your bed in the early morning, so I figured I'd put it somewhere safe!
嘿，嘿，放轻松，天哪！在这里，在会议桌上！它一大早从你床上掉下来，我就想着把它放到安全的地方！
I didn't, like, snatch it off ya or anything! Sorry, man! My bad. I forgot you got like this.
我又没有，就是，从你手上抢走什么的！抱歉，老兄！我的错。我忘了你会这样。
Sorry. For shouting at you. I... don't know what came over me.
抱歉。冲你大吼。我……不知道自己是怎么了。
Hey, it's all good! I get grouchy too when one of my bros moves my stuff without tellin' me! 'Kay, well, maybe not that grouchy, but- I sorta get it, is what I mean.
嘿，没事的！我哪个兄弟没说一声就动我东西，我也会发脾气！好吧，也许没那么大脾气，不过——我算是懂，我的意思是这样。
Mmh. Did I ever tell you about it back when I was staying here?
嗯。我以前住在这里的时候跟你说过这件事吗？
Nah, don't think you ever did. You were still keepin' everyone an arm's length away back then, so I didn't want to push my luck.
没，我想你从来没说过。那时候你还跟大家保持距离，所以我也不想碰运气。
Right... right. It's not even that big of a deal. My bow's just... important to me.
对……对。其实也没什么大不了的。我的弓只是……对我很重要。
Yes, I know I look silly walking around with the bulky thing all day! But I can't afford to lose it. I need it. I can't explain why, but I do.
对，我知道整天背着这个笨重的东西走来走去看起来很蠢！可我不能弄丢它。我需要它。我说不上为什么，但就是需要。
Nah that's cool, man! If we're talkin' silly, just take a look at me! I fight using my GUITAR! How d'you get sillier than that?
没事，那很酷啊，老兄！要说蠢，看看我就知道了！我可是用吉他打架的！还有什么比这更蠢的？
Pff, ha! What, do you just play bad music until your enemies give up? "Please, stop, I can't bear it! The melody's too discordant!"
噗，哈！怎么，你就一直弹难听的音乐，弹到敌人投降？“拜托，停下来，我受不了了！旋律太不和谐了！”
Hahahah! That'd be fun, I should try that! But nah, I just club 'em with it. Yus stuck some metal plates in, so it hurts more and doesn't break!
哈哈哈哈！那一定很好玩，我该试试！不过不是，我就是拿它砸人。Yus 在里面装了几块金属板，所以打起来更痛，也不会坏！
Wow. You're right, that's way sillier than what I do. I've got to tell Zeph about this.
哇。你说得对，那比我做的蠢多了。我得跟 Zeph 说这件事。
Woah, hey! You don't gotta do that, let him think I'm cool! But, uh, jokes aside. Feeling better?
哇，嘿！你不用这样啦，让他以为我很酷嘛！不过，呃，说正经的。心情好点了吗？
Good! Cool, then you should wake up the rest of your gang. Quill said he'd be over soon, wanted to talk to you about something.
很好！酷，那你该去把你那伙人叫醒了。Quill 说他等一下会过来，有事想跟你们谈。
Wake up the other three members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Morning, Sui! She's not exactly a... morning person. Guess I forgot to warn you!
早啊，Sui！她不太算是个……早起的人。我想我忘了提醒你！
Why'd you wake me up? Um, this early.
为什么要叫醒我？呃，这么早。
Um... is he... expecting me to, ha, prepare, breakfast? Oh, no...
呃……他是不是……要我，哈，准备，早餐？哦，不……
And there she goes. Well, no stopping her anxieties now! Might as well just let her get it out of her system.
她跑掉了。好吧，现在拦不住她的焦虑了！干脆让她发泄完吧。
Ah, yes, I had overheard! I assume he has some work for us then.
啊，是的，我听到了！我猜他有工作要交给我们吧。
Allow me to go freshen up, and then I will join you.
容我去梳洗一下，然后就去找你们。
Surprisingly so, yes! These beds were much more comfortable than I had anticipated...
出乎意料地好，是的！这些床比我预想的舒服多了……
However... hm. I appear to have been afflicted with repeating night terrors.
不过……嗯。我好像被反复的噩梦困扰着。
Reality is setting in, in a sense. Returning to the {p} now is out of the question. We cannot come home until the deed is done.
某种意义上，现实开始浮现了。现在回 {p} 已经不可能了。事情办成之前，我们回不了家。
It does weigh on me a little. We have made new friends and allies here, but this is the furthest away I have ever been from home.
这确实让我有点沉重。我们在这里交到了新朋友和盟友，但这是我离家最远的一次。
Hm. I know the feeling, Mora. If it helps, it never really goes away, but it becomes... lighter. Easier to deal with.
嗯。我懂那种感觉，Mora。如果这么说能让你好受点的话：那种感觉永远不会真正消失，但会变得……轻一点。也更好应付。
Hoho! It does not especially, no. But I appreciate the sentiment. I am glad to have my family here with me.
嚯嚯！不太有帮助，不。不过谢谢你的好意。我很高兴有家人在身边陪着我。
But enough of that! I heard Quill was coming over? I had best freshen up before he arrives. I will join the rest of you later.
不过这些就说到这里吧！我听说 Quill 要过来？我最好在他来之前梳洗一下。我晚点再跟你们会合。
Hrrk..... f-f-five more minutes, m- s- Synd- Zzzzzzzzz.....
呃……再、再、再五分钟，妈——S——Synd——呼噜噜噜……
Okay, he's slept enough. What do you think, should I shoot him?
好，他睡够了。你觉得呢，我该射他吗？
Pfft! Ha, kidding. It wouldn't work anyway, he's stubborn enough to just roll over and keep sleeping.
噗！哈，开玩笑的。反正也没用，他固执得会翻个身继续睡。
Hm, what can we try... oh, I know.
Oh, wow, these sure are some nice shiny and rare trinkets! Gosh, if only Zeph were awake, he'd love these. What a shame!
哦，哇，这些小玩意儿又亮又稀有！天哪，要是 Zeph 醒着，他肯定会超喜欢。真可惜！
This is a fun one! It's a passion project, inspired by one of my favorite books, an intriguing story of a girl and her friends saving the world.
这个很好玩！这是我的心血之作，灵感来自我最喜欢的一本书，讲的是一个女孩和她的朋友们拯救世界的精彩故事。
Oh, wow, these sure are some nice and shiny and rare trinkets! Gosh, if only Zeph were awake, he'd love these. What a shame!
噢，哇，这些小玩意儿真是又漂亮又闪亮又稀有！天哪，要是 Zeph 醒着，他一定会喜欢的。真可惜！
HUH! N-no, wait, I- I- I'm awake, where are- sh-sh-show me the t-trinkets, I want to see-
嗯！不、不，等等，我——我——我醒了，在哪——给、给、给我看小玩意儿，我想看——
There aren't an-any tr-trinkets, are there.
根本没、没有什么小、小玩意儿，对吧。
Nope! But I like the enthusiasm.
没有！不过我喜欢你的热情。

创造。毁灭。创造。毁灭。创造毁灭创造创造毁灭毁灭毁灭。
Build and build and build until the action ceases to hold meaning. Then tear it all down, until its components return to the earth, until nothing remains, not even its memory.
建造、建造、再建造，直到这个动作不再有任何意义。然后把它全部拆毁，直到它的零件回归大地，直到什么都不剩，连记忆都不剩。
Repeat. Repeat, repeat, repeat until the ends and beginnings can't even be told apart. And then do it over again. And again. And again and again and again and again...
重复。重复、重复、重复，直到连结束和开始都分不清。然后再来一遍。再一遍。一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍……
... failure. No matter how many days I took, the power never ceased to flow. The mark remains.
……失败。不管我花了多少天，那股力量从未停止流动。印记还在。
Tried to use my blessing on myself. Grab at the flesh and blood poisoned by the mark, and twist it into anything, anything other than what it is now.
试着对自己使用我的祝福。抓住被印记毒害的血肉，把它扭成任何东西，任何不是它现在这样的东西。
Agony. Like the pain from receiving the blessing in the first place, but multiplied tenfold. A hundred times. A million screaming signals from nerves that were no longer real...
剧痛。就像当初接受祝福时的痛，但放大了十倍。一百倍。上百万道来自早已不再真实的神经的尖叫信号……
When I came to, the mark was still there. As if nothing had ever happened. Flowers had a cubic meter chunk of soil missing from his body. Easy to repair, but...
等我醒过来，印记还在。仿佛什么都没发生过。Flowers 身上少了一立方米的泥土。很容易修补，可是……
There are countless more entries... You skip to the last one.
还有数不清的篇章……你直接跳到最后一篇。
The Queen provided me with an out. There's a super-top-secret project she needs done, and I am meant to be the one to do it.
女王给了我一条出路。她有一个需要完成的超级绝密项目，而我就是要完成它的那个人。
If I succeed, my blessing will be removed. Finally. Finally finally finally finally FINALLY. Some hope. I just have to do this. I just have to finish this project, and then...
如果我成功了，我的祝福就会被移除。终于。终于终于终于终于终于。一线希望。我只要做到这件事就好。我只要完成这个项目，然后……
Now's your chance to get past - go!

Yusanu
First the Sovereign, and now-?
I see another lost soul has found their way to The {p}!
看来又有一个迷途的灵魂找到了 {p}！
I see another challenger has found their way to The {p}!
看来又有一个挑战者找到了 {p}！
I can't say I am overwhelmed by your appearance. Here, the birth of many powerful and magical monsters take place.
说实话，你的样子并没有让我感到震撼。这里诞生了许多强大的魔法怪物。
Gavel's governments can not stop Mistress Qira. I doubt you can either.
Gavel 的政府阻止不了 Qira 女主人。我看你也不行。
If you want to meet her, you will have to defeat each division of her army.
如果你想见她，就得打败她军队的每一个分部。
Although powerful, she is not without honour. After every floor you complete, you will receive a token for a reward from the shop. Good luck, adventurer-
她虽然强大，却不失荣誉。每完成一层，你都会得到一枚代币，可以在商店兑换奖励。祝你好运，冒险者——
Wh- Oh, Mistress, am I? My apologies...
什——噢，女主人，是我吗？非常抱歉……
Begin, the Thunder Division! Strike quickly and move on, for those within will warp your very mind should you stray for too long!
开始吧，雷之分部！速战速决再继续前进，若你逗留太久，里面的东西会扭曲你的心智！
Heeheehahaaaah! I see you! You humans have such easily influenced minds, but I'll settle for beating you within an inch of your life! Come through, come through!!!
嘿嘿哈哈哈！我看到你了！你们人类的心智真好操控，不过我还是把你打个半死就好！进来吧，进来吧！！！
Feh, you're no fun, you little cheater! I was supposed to beat you, not the other way around!
切，你真没意思，你这个小作弊鬼！应该是我打败你，不是反过来！
I hate you so much. Just get out and talk to that idiot servant already!!
我好讨厌你。赶快出去跟那个白痴仆人说话吧！！
You have completed the Thunder floor? How surprising. They were some of Mistress Qira's earliest successes.
你完成雷之层了？真意外。那些可是 Qira 女主人最早的成功作品之一。
I agree, Mistress. As promised, here is a Thunder Voucher.
我同意，女主人。说好的，这是雷之兑换券。
Take it to the shop to claim your prize. It is located at the base of the Hive. The servant there will have important information for you regarding your prizes.
拿去商店领取你的奖品。商店在蜂巢的底部。那里的仆人会告诉你关于奖品的重要信息。
I doubt you are still worth Mistress's time, however. She has much to tend to here, as you might guess.
不过我怀疑你还值不值得女主人花时间。你也猜得到，她在这里有很多事要忙。
She made a deal with Gavel's people long ago, after they foolishly attempted to lay siege to our Hive.
很久以前，Gavel 的人愚蠢地试图围攻我们的蜂巢，之后她跟他们达成了一项协议。
She could continue her unethical and possibly evil work...and in return, she would allow the people of Gavel to remain undisturbed by her.
她可以继续她那不道德、甚至可能邪恶的研究……作为回报，她不会去打扰 Gavel 的人民。
Next you must tackle the Air division, featuring some of her tougher creations.
接下来你得对付气之分部，那里有她一些更难缠的造物。
Begin, the Air Division! Fight freely with the wind, for the coming storm shall claim you for my own if you cannot spread your wings here!
开始吧，气之分部！与风自由搏斗，若你不能在此展翅，即将到来的风暴就会把你收为我的所有！
Well, nice work getting this far! Don't tell anyone, but I'm gonna pull my punches here, okay? I'm rooting for you, so let's have fun with this! Come on through!
嗯，能走到这里真不错！别告诉别人，不过我这里会手下留情，好吗？我在帮你加油，所以我们开开心心地打吧！进来吧！
Heehee, maybe I didn't need to hold back after all? You did really, really well!
嘿嘿，看来我根本不需要手下留情嘛？你表现得真的、真的很好！
A lot of people say I'm the roughest we have to offer, so you've got this! I'm sorry you have to go talk to Yansur of all people now, though.
很多人说我是我们这里最难搞的，所以你一定行的！不过很抱歉，你现在得去跟 Yansur 那家伙说话了。
Hrm, perhaps we have underestimated you. The creations of Air have defeated thousands, particularly-
嗯，也许我们低估你了。气之造物打败过成千上万的人，尤其是——
...yes. Here is the promised Air Voucher.
……是的。这是说好的气之兑换券。
The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
商店已经为你准备好奖励了。如果你还没跟商店的仆人谈过，下次去的时候记得谈谈。
You still have a long way to go. It is not easy to gain an audience with Mistress Qira.
你还有很长的路要走。要面见 Qira 女主人可不容易。
Your next objective is to clear the Earth division. Some of the most powerful, raw creatures ever hatched.
你的下一个目标是清除地之分部。那里有史上孵化过最强大、最原始的生物。
Begin, the Earth Division! You must withstand both sheer force and deadly toxins! Be quick on your feet, or you will return to the dust of the earth!
开始吧，地之分部！你必须同时承受纯粹的蛮力与致命的毒素！脚步要快，否则你就会化为大地的尘土！
Creatures of the earth were not enough for you... Mistress's most rawly powerful... Destroyed.
大地的生物也拦不住你……女主人力量最原始的造物……被摧毁了。
Well, here is your Earth Voucher.
好吧，这是你的地之兑换券。
It is impressive to see how far you have come. Many have failed at this point.
看到你走了这么远，真令人佩服。很多人在这一步就失败了。
It is of no consequence, however, for the Water division is your next challenge. I am sure you will not succeed.
不过这无关紧要，因为你的下一个挑战是水之分部。我敢肯定你不会成功。
Begin, the Water Division! If you will not withstand the crashing waves, the creatures that lurk within shall ensure you never emerge from the abyss!
开始吧，水之分部！若你承受不住拍击的巨浪，潜伏其中的生物会确保你永远无法从深渊中浮起！
You have been judged worthy enough to face me in combat. However, I know your strength, and I do not believe it enough to defeat me. Come forth now. Make your attempt to prove me wrong.
你已被判定有资格与我交战。然而，我知道你的实力，我不认为它足以打败我。上前来吧。试着证明我错了。
Seems my judgment was incorrect. In this case, however, it is refreshing to see.
看来我的判断错了。不过在这件事上，这倒令人耳目一新。
Continue forwards, honourable human. Perhaps your intellect and respect will rub off on that insufferable Yansur.
继续前进吧，可敬的人类。也许你的智慧与尊重能感染一下那个讨人厌的 Yansur。
Impossible. Not even the most tactically advanced monsters could defeat you.
不可能。连战术最先进的怪物都打不败你。
... Here's the Water Voucher you're expecting.
We are intrigued by your determination... But we are not worried. We do not expect you to make it past the next floor.
你的决心让我们很感兴趣……但我们并不担心。我们不认为你能通过下一层。
Now you must face some of the toughest creatures of Mistress Qira's imagination!
现在你得面对 Qira 女主人想象中最难缠的一些生物！
You must now face the division of Fire, and it will be sure to burn you.
现在你必须面对火之分部，它一定会把你烧成灰。
Begin, the Fire Division! Summon your courage, and brave the heat of the volcanoes and blow away in the breeze!
开始吧，火之分部！鼓起你的勇气，冒着火山的热浪，随风而散吧！
Impressive, making it this far. I am your final test. Let us fight fairly, then. An honourable end to your challenge is only fitting, whether that be triumph or defeat. Come forward and face me.
能走到这一步，令人佩服。我是你最后的考验。那么，我们公平地战斗吧。无论胜利还是失败，以荣誉结束你的挑战才是合适的。上前来面对我吧。

Defeat feels strange, after so long. You fought valiantly, and with great zeal, however. It would be a lie to say I am disappointed. Impart these traits onto Mistress's servant, if you would, and claim your final prize.
隔了这么久，失败的感觉真奇怪。不过你战斗得英勇而热忱。说我失望，那就是谎话。如果可以，把这些品质传授给女主人的仆人，然后去领取你最后的奖品吧。
All that is left is to talk to Mistress's servant, and claim your final prize. Surely he will not be as great an obstacle as I was.
剩下的就是去跟女主人的仆人谈谈，领取你最后的奖品。他肯定不会像我一样难对付。
This is unprecedented. You have defeated some of the most recent and powerful creations.
这是前所未有的。你打败了一些最新、最强大的造物。
Here you are then, the Fire Voucher!
This is unorthodox, as few have made it this far. But I suppose this means that you have earned an audience with-
这太不寻常了，很少有人能走到这一步。但我想这代表你赢得了面见——
Hah! Incredible! Mistress wishes to battle you herself! You astound me.
哈！太不可思议了！女主人想亲自跟你交战！你真让我吃惊。
Be warned, however. This will be your toughest battle yet. Mistress Qira is the most feared being in Gavel.
不过我要警告你。这将是你迄今为止最艰难的一战。Qira 女主人是 Gavel 最令人畏惧的存在。
You will die...but consider it the greatest honour to die by her hand.
你会死……但能死在她手下，你就当作是至高的荣耀吧。
How cowardly! After defeating so many in the Hive, and receiving such praise, you've the gall to upstand Mistress's request?
多么懦弱！在蜂巢里打败了那么多对手，又得到那样的赞赏，你竟然胆敢拒绝女主人的要求？
I had begun to think highly of you, but after such a disgusting display-
我原本已经开始高看你了，可在这么令人作呕的表现之后——
Wha...that- No, that can't possibly be correct, you are-
...Masterful...Have we been cooped up in this Hive so long that our army is outdated?
……高超……难道我们在这蜂巢里闷得太久，军队已经过时了吗？
To be defeated by a human of Wynn... I am not sure whether to be disappointed or amazed. Our ultimate challenge has been bested.
被一个 Wynn 的人类打败……我不知道该失望还是惊叹。我们的终极挑战被攻克了。
Here is your voucher, then. The back room in the shop will have your rewards. If you still have not talked to the servant at the shop...well. You should know by now.
那么，这是你的兑换券。商店的里间会有你的奖励。如果你到现在还没跟商店的仆人谈过……嗯。你现在应该知道了吧。
Mistress...if I may tell the tale? She was once called upon to help stop the decay of the forest.
女主人……请允许我讲讲这个故事？她曾经被请去帮忙阻止森林的黯蚀。
With her boundless knowledge and magic, she surely could have cured it. But she declined.
以她无穷的知识和魔法，她肯定能治好。但她拒绝了。
She instead chose to create, obsessed with preparing for some sort of war.
她反而选择了创造，一心执着于为某种战争做准备。
Mistress never elaborated, but it seems like she knows something we don't.
女主人从来没有细说，但她似乎知道一些我们不知道的事。
Excuse me, but aren't you forgetting some things, Yansur?
打断一下，Yansur，你是不是忘了点什么？
You will be disciplined later...fine. Consider yourself honoured to have even a moment of my time, adventurer. Allow me to explain in further detail, my glorious Hive.
回头再罚你……算了。冒险者，能占用我片刻时间，你该感到荣幸。就让我更详细地为你说明，我这座辉煌的蜂巢。
As Yansur explained, if you wish audience with me, you must prove yourself worthy of my presence by defeating each division of my personal army.
正如 Yansur 所说，你若想面见我，就得打败我私人军队的每一个分部，证明你有资格站在我面前。
It consists of five main divisions, each one based around a particular element. Thunder, Air, Earth, and so on. Clearing one will unlock the next for you to face.
它由五个主要分部组成，每一个都以一种元素为核心。雷、气、地，依此类推。通过一个，下一个才会开放让你挑战。
To pass a floor of the division, defeat my forces and put the catalysts they drop into the collector. You will need five catalysts to pass a floor.
要通过分部的一层，就得打败我的部下，把它们掉落的催化剂放进收集器。通过一层需要五个催化剂。
After nine floors of normal troops, you will face a Division Leader.
打完九层普通士兵之后，你将面对一名分部首领。
These exceptionally powerful members of my army will be fought alone, and you will only need one catalyst from them to pass.
这些我军中格外强大的成员会单独应战，你只需要从它们身上拿到一个催化剂就能通过。
The Thunder Division will be your first challenge. I do hope you will be entertaining to watch...
雷之分部将是你的第一个挑战。但愿你能让我看得尽兴……
The mysterious box accepts your tokens. You're free to move on to the next room.
神秘的箱子收下了你的代币。你可以前往下一个房间了。
How was your first taste of the Hive? Your battle against the Psychomancer was quite the spectacle to behold, ahaha...
初次领教蜂巢的滋味如何？你与 Psychomancer 的那一战可真是精彩，啊哈哈……
Hush, Yansur. Not a word about her.
安静，Yansur。关于她，一个字都不许提。
Seems you can move on... All you hear is a bloodcurdling roar. What lies ahead...?
看来你可以继续前进了……你只听到一声令人毛骨悚然的咆哮。前方等着你的会是什么……？
Well, now that you've destroyed that terrible thing, it seems prudent to tell Yansur and get your Earth Voucher.
好了，既然你已经消灭了那个可怕的东西，现在该去告诉 Yansur，领取你的地之兑换券了。
Managed to defeat Genesis, hm? It is normally the end of most... Interesting.
居然打败了创生，嗯？大多数人都止步于此……有意思。
I must admit I am impressed; the Judge is ruthless... perhaps he needs further tweaking?
我得承认我很佩服；审判者向来冷酷无情……也许还需要再调整一下？
Even downed the Vanguard...? My word...
连先锋都被打倒了……？天哪……
Allow me to stop you there, Yansur. I wish to make an exception for this challenger.
先说到这里吧，Yansur。我想为这位挑战者破个例。
You have intrigued me, adventurer...and I want to put you to the truest test.
你引起了我的兴趣，冒险者……我想让你接受最真正的考验。
I await you in my chambers...
...you. You...ahaha...I like you. You're capable enough... Perhaps we could be allies in the future...
……你。你……啊哈哈……我喜欢你。你够有能耐……也许将来我们能成为盟友……
You defeated Qira! All that's left to do is tell Yansur!
你打败了 Qira！剩下的就只是去告诉 Yansur 了！
You question your mistress? I have nothing to gain from lying to you about this. And there is no shame in admitting defeat.
你在质疑你的女主人？我在这件事上骗你又没有任何好处。承认失败也没什么可耻的。
It is simply a testament to their strength. I will prepare a special reward for them to mark the occasion.
这只证明了他们的实力。我会为他们准备一份特别的奖赏，纪念这一刻。
It is as I have always told you. The darkness is coming...but if you Wynn folk are all as strong as you have proven yourself to be, we may just be able to beat it back.
就像我一直告诉你的那样。黑暗正在逼近……但如果你们 Wynn 的人都像你证明的那样强大，我们或许真能把它击退。
Honour to you, warrior of Wynn.
As infuriating as what you did was, you were following orders... I had every right to be angry, but to try and take your life was ten steps too far.
你做的事再怎么令人愤怒，你也只是在奉命行事……我有权生气，但想要夺走你的性命，实在是太过分了。
Even though it is not enough, I will say I am sorry for the pain I caused you. The Guardian was right, in the end.
即使这远远不够，我还是要为我给你带来的痛苦说声对不起。说到底，守护者是对的。
Without you carrying out Orphion's will, we would not be here. You truly are necessary in this, and I believe I have finally made peace with that.
要不是你执行了 Orphion 的意志，我们就不会在这里。在这件事上，你确实是必要的，我想我终于能坦然接受这一点了。
It has been a long time since I had a partner willing to help me in this way. I was unused to it, I suppose... Still.
我已经很久没有一个愿意这样帮我的伙伴了。我想我是不太习惯吧……尽管如此。
If you'll be willing to aid me, it would be a great relief. It has been a thousand years since I entered the Realm of Light...
如果你愿意助我一臂之力，我会宽心许多。我已经一千年没有进入光之领域了……
I can only hope things have not changed much. I remember how it was, right down to the last petal...
我只希望那里没有太大改变。我还记得它的样子，连最后一片花瓣都记得……
Walk towards the portal with Lari.
与 Lari 一起走向传送门。
Wait a moment, {u}. I have one more thing I would like to say before we enter.
等一下，{u}。进去之前，我还有一件事想说。
I... I need to thank you. For helping, as you have. For staying by me as you have. There was one other before you like that...
我……我需要谢谢你。谢谢你这样帮我。谢谢你这样一直陪在我身边。在你之前，也曾有过一个这样的人……
I promise that you will not meet the same fate as him. I will fight with you to the bitter end, achara.
我保证你不会遭遇和他一样的命运。我会和你并肩作战到最后，achara。
It's time, then. To visit Orphion.
那么，时候到了。去见 Orphion 吧。
Jump into the portal after Lari.
跟着 Lari 跳进传送门。
Talk to Lari at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] in the Realm of Light.
在光之领域的 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Lari 交谈。
Welcome to the Realm of Light then, {u}. Once you've re-oriented yourself, come over here.
那么，欢迎来到光之领域，{u}。等你缓过神来，就到这边来。
It's so much smaller than it used to be! There used to be many more landmasses, all connected to each other...
它比以前小了好多！以前这里还有更多陆块，全都彼此相连……
I feel... I feel everything in here. With Orphion's light, I can tap into the very core of the realm.
我感觉得到……我感觉得到这里的一切。借着 Orphion 的光，我能触及这个领域的核心。
And I can feel disturbances. There are dark creatures here, where there should be none!
我还感觉到了异样。这里有黑暗生物，这里本不该有的！
I mean, even look at this creature. The light emanating from it is-
我是说，就连这只生物也是。它散发出来的光——
Wait. Wh... Why is it attacking you!?
等等。怎……它为什么在攻击你！？
Its mind was addled by darkness. Poor thing was terrified... Nothing for it though.
它的心智被黑暗搅乱了。可怜的小东西吓坏了……可是也没办法。
I suppose your more ruthless nature is a good thing, in this case. We each will need to fight, if this is as widespread as it feels.
我想在这种情况下，你比较无情的性子倒是件好事。如果这事真像我感觉到的那样到处蔓延，我们俩都得战斗。
I'll have to prepare myself for that... Being willing to take action will not make it any easier on my conscience.
我得为此做好心理准备……愿意采取行动，并不会让我的良心好过一点。
But I will set that aside, until the day this all becomes a memory. We'll both need to seek the Nexus of Light, Orphion's home. Follow me!

Follow Lari to Orphion's Nexus of Light at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
跟着 Lari 前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Orphion 光之枢纽

它的心智完好，但它对你的存在有所戒备。你最好退后一点，以防万一。

告诉我吧，achara。你来找我是为了什么？

巨石碑？是它们切断了连接吗？

啊，我懂了。我向你保证，我们会修好这一切！

它说，通往领域其他地方的连接是 Orphion 为了保护它们而刻意切断的。

这片陆块上有两座巨石碑控制着连接，而它们的光正在被抽干——因此，它们关闭了桥梁。
