I want Effal to be exiled to Wynn immediately for treason. He let the spy in, and must be punished for that. Find a guard to replace his position as Recruiter, anyone would be more competent than him.
我要以叛国罪立刻把 Effal 流放到 Wynn。是他放间谍进来的，必须为此受罚。找个守卫接替他招募官的位置，谁都比他称职。
Relay this to the other guards and recruiters. Effal should be out of Fruma by tomorrow!
把这件事转告其他守卫和招募官。明天之前，要让 Effal 离开 Fruma！
Now, Commander, there is another issue I would like to bring up with you, the reason why I came to your office this late into the night in the first place.
那么，指挥官，还有另一个问题想跟您提，这也是我这么晚还来您办公室的原因。
Your plan yesterday went along perfectly. I checked in with the doctor and he told me Katze will need to be sent home.
您昨天的计划进行得非常顺利。我去问过医生，他说 Katze 得被送回家。
Excellent, tomorrow Adder will duel against Arnol. His family name can no longer make up for his weakness!
太好了，明天 Adder 会跟 Arnol 决斗。他的姓氏再也弥补不了他的软弱了！
Commander... Is this really the best option? The spy seems to have grown a liking towards Arnol. I fear doing this could trigger a retaliation from them...
指挥官……这真的是最好的选择吗？那个间谍似乎对 Arnol 产生了好感。我怕这么做会招来他们的报复……
Does upsetting a single cursed one really frighten you that much, Strumon? Besides, I expect Sovereign Majin will have arrived by then, your concerns are unfounded.
惹恼区区一个受诅者，真让你这么害怕吗，Strumon？再说，我估计到时候 Majin 统领已经到了，你的担心毫无根据。
Commander, Recruiter, there is an urgent matter that requires attending to. Please, follow me!
指挥官，招募官，有件紧急的事需要处理。请跟我来！
Unscrew the vent, then head back to the barracks to wake Arnol at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
拧开通风口的螺丝，然后回到 [-{~}, {~}, {~}] 的营房叫醒 Arnol。
What is this about, {u}? Why are you waking me up so early in the morning?
怎么了，{u}？你为什么这么早把我叫醒？
What!? I'd stand no chance against Adder! He might even end up killing me if I face him! I guess I should have expected Commander Ferreo would do something like this though...
什么！？我根本打不过 Adder！我要是跟他对上，他说不定会杀了我！不过我早该料到 Ferreo 指挥官会搞这种事……
If you're telling me this now, you must have some idea on how to help me with this mess. What is your plan, {u}?
你现在告诉我这些，一定已经有办法帮我摆脱这个烂摊子了。你的计划是什么，{u}？
Hmmm... Ok, I trust you. Let's go before anyone wakes up.
嗯……好，我相信你。趁大家还没醒，我们走吧。
Hmmm... Ok, I'll go with you.
Escape through the Tericen entrance at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
从 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Tericen 入口逃出去。
We're leaving through the main entrance? What if a guard spots us?
我们要从正门离开？要是被守卫发现怎么办？
Alright, I'll try to stay close.
Weird... There seems to be no guards on duty...
奇怪……好像没有守卫在站岗……
Where are you off to? I don't remember dismissing either of you.
你们要去哪？我不记得有让你们俩解散。
I would have thought that by now you'd both know insubordination isn't tolerated here. Neither is treason...
我还以为到现在，你们俩都该知道这里容不下违抗命令。叛国也一样……
Does Arnol know you're a spy? Imagine what his family would think, if they found out he's conspiring with the resistance.
Arnol 知道你是间谍吗？想想看，要是他家人发现他跟反抗军勾结，会怎么想。
I'll let them deal with him. But you... the responsibility of prosecuting you has been lended to me.
他就交给他们处置吧。但你……审判你的责任已经交给了我。
There is no hope for you or your kind in Fruma!
在 Fruma，你和你的同类毫无希望！
I've never lost a duel, don't fool yourself into thinking I'd let you change that!
我从来没输过决斗，别自欺欺人，以为我会让你改写这一点！
I won't die here! Not to the likes of you!
我不会死在这里！不会死在你这种人手上！
That's enough Commander, you're clearly outmatched.
够了，指挥官，你显然不是对手。
Thank you... For looking out for me after everything, even though you had no reason to...
谢谢你……在发生了这么多事之后还照顾我，明明你没有理由这么做……
I've spent my whole life drifting, aimless... But now I know what my purpose is, thanks to you...
我这辈子一直漫无目的地飘荡……但现在，多亏了你，我知道我的使命是什么了……
My purpose is to make sure that tyrants like Commander Ferreo meet their just end. It seems like this may be your goal as well.
我的使命，就是确保像 Ferreo 指挥官这样的暴君得到应有的下场。看来这也是你的目标。
I must go out on my own now, I hope that one day we meet again. I promise you I'll be stronger by then!
我现在必须独自上路了，希望有一天我们能再见面。我保证到时候我会变得更强！
I was raised to believe that the cursed ones were wicked, yet you've been nothing but helpful. Seems like that was just another lie...
我从小被教导受诅者都是邪恶的，可你一直都在帮我。看来那不过是另一个谎言……
Are you a recruit as well? You certainly look strong. I imagine you must have a lot of experience.
你也是新兵吗？你看起来真强壮。我猜你一定经验丰富。
I am a bit newer to this than you, but I may still be able to offer you some insights if you're curious.
这方面我资历比你浅一点，不过如果你好奇，我也许还是能给你一些见解。
Well... A carriage rode me halfway to {p}, then it broke down and I had to walk the rest of the way. When I finally arrived the King himself was there to greet me and made me a recruit.
嗯……有辆马车载我到去 {p} 的半路，然后坏了，剩下的路我只好走过去。等我终于到了，国王亲自来迎接我，让我当了新兵。
I can't seem to remember anything before that though... It probably wasn't too important, what's important is my new job as a recruit!
不过在那之前的事我好像都记不起来了……大概也不怎么重要吧，重要的是我当新兵的新工作！
I wonder if the King will give me a promotion soon...
不知道国王会不会很快给我升职……
No... I can't say I have ever seen you before... Are you a fan or something?
不……我不记得以前见过你……你是我的粉丝还是什么？
I didn't imagine having fans already but that's great! I'm already on the path of becoming the most famous person in Wynn!
没想到我已经有粉丝了，不过太棒了！我已经走上成为 Wynn 最有名的人的道路了！
Waiting? I'm not waiting for anything! I'm just resting... That's all!
等？我什么都没在等！我只是在休息……就这样！
It's tiring doing so much work out there. Plus I need to give the other recruits and guards a chance to prove themselves, I shouldn't hog all of the glory!
在外面干那么多活很累的。而且我也得给其他新兵和守卫证明自己的机会，不该把荣耀全占了！
You don't need to worry about me, I'll be fine out there. Just because you look stronger doesn't mean I'm weak!
你不用担心我，我在外面不会有事的。你看起来比我强，不代表我就弱！
You're the one who should be worried... Worried about me surpassing you of course!
该担心的是你……当然是担心我超越你！
But hey, we're on the same side, so let's both keep fighting out there! For the King!
不过嘿，我们是同一边的，所以一起在外面继续战斗吧！为了国王！
Thank you again...soldier. For helping us make peace...
再次感谢你……士兵。帮助我们实现和平……
Please take a track controller before entering the rail line.
进入铁道前，请先拿一个轨道控制器。
This is just a disaster... I pray nothing goes awry with the recovery team.
这真是一场灾难……我祈祷回收小队千万别出什么岔子。
I'd never be able to live it off if I'm responsible for more deaths.
如果再有人因为我而死，我这辈子都没法原谅自己。
But I must do what it takes to protect {p} from any more disaster.
但为了不让 {p} 再遭受灾难，我必须不惜一切代价。
Atila, you're back! Give it to me straight, did they succeed? We can't afford any more losses.
Atila，你回来了！直说吧，他们成功了吗？我们承受不起更多损失了。
The elevator leads right in to where the dragon lays. Without knowing when it's asleep, it's a gamble.
升降机直通那条龙躺着的地方。不知道她什么时候睡着，下去就是赌命。
The elevator leads right in to where the dragon lays. Without knowing when it's asleep, it's a gamble...
那座升降机直通那条龙躺着的地方。不知道她什么时候睡着，去就是在赌……
It's a great feat what you've accomplished. The dwarven defense system was thought to be impeccable. We'll need to rethink our security!
你完成了一项了不起的壮举。矮人的防御系统本来被认为无懈可击。我们得重新考虑我们的安保了！
So we truly do need to go through the vault. But with the defense systems gone haywire...
所以我们真的得穿过金库。可是防御系统已经失控了……
Think nothing of it, let's get back to the drawing board.
别放在心上，我们重新想办法。
Yes, I'll get to it immediately.
You there, human! What's your business here? Come speak to me.
那边的人类！你来这里有什么事？过来跟我说话。
What's your business here? This place is off limits, the vault is very dangerous right now.
你来这里有什么事？这里禁止进入，金库现在非常危险。
Now that I look, say, that gear of yours is pretty high-quality, yeah? What's your name?
我这么一看，嘿，你那身装备质量相当好啊，是吧？你叫什么名字？
Now that I look, say, that gear of yours is pretty high quality, yeah? What's your name?
这么一看，你那身装备质量相当好啊，是吧？你叫什么名字？
... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're that guy who defeated that Qira woman, yeah?
……我在哪里听过这个名字……哦，我想起来了！你就是打败那个叫 Qira 的女人的家伙，对吧？
... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're the one who helped resolve the whole Dogun thing, right?
……我在哪里听过这个名字……噢，我想起来了！你就是帮忙解决了整个 Dogun 事件的那个人，对吧？
I see, I haven't seen you around before.
原来如此，我之前没在这一带见过你。
{u}..? I see, I haven't seen you around before.
{u}……？原来如此，我之前没在这一带见过你。
Nevertheless, {p} is in danger. To put it simply, a dragon is living uninvited in our despository.
不管怎样，{p} 正处于危险之中。简单来说，有一条龙不请自来，住进了我们的仓库。
Perhaps you've seen its lair above our city. Normally she leaves us unharmed, but one day she suddenly made her way in to this vault.
你也许见过她在我们城市上方的巢穴。平常她不会伤害我们，可是有一天，她突然闯进了这座金库。
My great friend Atila has been leading a recon squad, he's discerned that she's nesting an egg.
我的好朋友 Atila 一直带着侦察小队，他发现她正在孵一颗蛋。
We've tried at our greatest expenses to steal the egg, and bring it back to her nest, so that maybe she would leave... But, as you've heard, it's not going well.
我们不惜一切代价想偷走那颗蛋，把它送回她的巢里，这样她也许就会离开……可是，你也听到了，进展并不顺利。
I don't normally ask this of strangers, but we've run ourselves thin. Do you think you're up to help? I'll make sure it is worth all your trouble.
我平常不会拜托陌生人这种事，但我们已经人手不足了。你觉得你能帮忙吗？我保证不会让你白辛苦。
So you'll help!? Thank you so much! I'll make sure it's worth every moment!
所以你愿意帮忙！？太谢谢你了！我保证你的每一分努力都值得！
You'll have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
你得穿过我身后这个房间才能到仓库。我们唯一的另一条路，就在那条龙待着的地方……
You have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
你得穿过我身后这个房间才能到仓库。我们唯一的另一条路，就在那条龙待着的地方……
The people of {p} have everlasting gratitude, soldier.
{p} 的人民将永远感激你，士兵。
Atila knows some of the inner workings of the vault. I bid you good luck and will be praying for your success. Your courage will inspire {p}.
Atila 知道一些金库内部的运作方式。祝你好运，我会为你的成功祈祷。你的勇气会激励整个 {p}。
Oh, so it wasn't meant to be I suppose...
噢，看来是命中注定不行吧……
Well, if we cross paths again, I'll always much appreciate your help... Back to the drawing board...
好吧，如果我们再遇到，我还是会非常感激你的帮忙……重新想办法吧……
Find a way through the depository.
Ride the minecarts to get further in to the depository
Steal Ozoth's egg and escape the depository.
偷走 Ozoth 的蛋，逃出仓库。
Oh-oh my gosh!! I took you for dead, and thought the dragon was sending me up a corpse!
噢、噢天哪！！我还以为你死了，以为那条龙送了具尸体上来！
You really got it!? Hurry then, the nest is up through this cave! Maybe {p} can finally be rid of its woes...
你真的拿到了！？那快点，巢穴就在这个洞窟上面！也许 {p} 终于能摆脱苦难了……
Place Ozoth's egg back in her nest at [{~},-{~}].
把 Ozoth 的蛋放回 [{~},-{~}] 的巢里。
She's a beauty, isn't she? A monster though, nevertheless.
她很美，对吧？不过终究还是头怪物。
{u}! Over here... Atila told me the news, I came as fast as I could!
{u}！这边……Atila 跟我说了消息，我马上就赶来了！
You're a hero, lad! With the dragon out of our city, {p} no longer has to live in fear.
你是英雄，小伙子！龙离开了我们的城市，{p} 再也不必活在恐惧之中了。
I've prepared your reward. The people of {p} will remember your contribution years to come.
我已经准备好你的奖励了。{p} 的人民在往后的岁月里都会记得你的贡献。
Tell me what I should know.
So you've taken the job. Good luck to you in there.
看来你接下这活儿了。祝你在里面一切顺利。
What would you like to do?

通往储藏库的路上有几尊龙形哨卫把守。它们就是专门用来把小偷烤到全熟的。

不过有个小办法：你只要杀掉那个活的哨卫，它们就会停下来，你就能过去了。

也要小心别被烧到，那些雕像会隔几秒才吐火。祝你好运，一路顺风！
You'll be going directly in to the chamber. Once you see she's asleep, you book it to the egg!
你会直接进到那间厅室。一看到她睡着了，就立刻冲去拿蛋！
I understand if you're worried, but right now I can't think of anything else we can do...
你担心我可以理解，但目前我想不出我们还能做什么……
Don't wait any longer, {u}! Place the egg and we can finally lure that wretched dragon out!
别再等了，{u}！把蛋放下去，我们终于可以把那条可恶的龙引出来了！
These must be the Wood Sprites Dodegar was talking about...
这些一定就是 Dodegar 说的木之精灵了……
Dodegar carefully grabs the piece of wood and begins carving.
Dodegar 小心翼翼地拿起那块木头，开始雕刻。
与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Dodegar Bandysnoot 交谈。
I'm glad you came along, I could do with a little help if you're not too busy.
真高兴你来了，如果你不太忙的话，我正需要一点帮助。
I'm Dodegar Bandysnoot, the world famous Hobbit swordsmith! Perhaps you've heard of me?
我是 Dodegar Bandysnoot，世界闻名的霍比特剑匠！你大概听说过我吧？
No? Oh... Well, I've had an idea about how I could make the best weapon that the world has ever seen!
没有？哦……好吧，我想到了一个办法，能打造出世界上前所未见的最强武器！

不过，我需要人帮忙收集打造它的特殊材料。
You'll help?! Excellent! We shall gather enough resources to make one for each of us!
你愿意帮忙？！太好了！我们收集够材料，给我们俩各打造一把！
So firstly, I need some living wood for the handle, [{~} Enchanted Stick] should be enough.
首先，我需要一些活木头来做握柄，[{~} 附魔木棍] 应该就够了。
The wood sprites located across the river to the west, in a big tree trunk, have magical properties! The handle can then mold to the user's hand! One shouldn't be too hard to come across!
西边河对岸那棵大树干里的木精灵有魔法特性！这样握柄就能贴合使用者的手！找一个应该不会太难！
I hope you are prepared, this will be your best quest yet!
希望你准备好了，这会是你迄今为止最棒的任务！
Collect [{~} Enchanted Stick] from Wood Sprites at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and return them to Dodegar
收集 [{~} 附魔木棍]，从 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的木之精灵身上取得，带回给 Dodegar
Wow! You got the wood I needed, thanks!
哇！你拿到我需要的木头了，谢谢！

我做握柄的时候，你能帮我弄刀刃吗？
Since we want this weapon to be as good as possible we need to find some sacred Hobbit metal!
既然我们想让这把武器尽可能好，就得找到一些神圣霍比特金属！
The hobbit village, The Shiar, is really close! Follow the southern road. My brother Gogedar should be there!
霍比特村 Shiar 离这里很近！沿着南边的路走。我哥哥 Gogedar 应该在那里！
Dodegar needs [{~} Sacred Hobbit Metal] from the Shiar at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Dodegar 需要 [{~} 神圣霍比特金属]，到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Shiar 找找
My brother you say... Trying to create a weapon...
你说是我弟弟……想打造一把武器……
Oh he needs Sacred Hobbit Metal!?
哦，他需要神圣霍比特金属！？
Sorry can't help you. I don't really know what that is.
抱歉帮不上忙。我其实不太清楚那是什么。
要不去问问我们的表亲 Togedar？
Dodegar? Does not really ring a bell I'm afraid.
Oh! Gogedar's brother, why didn't you tell me that.
哦！Gogedar 的弟弟，你怎么不早说。
Sacred Hobbit Metal... This is a metal forged by master blacksmith hobbits within our village. It is a bit expensive to get by but holds great potential, if used properly.
神圣霍比特金属……这是我们村里的霍比特铁匠大师锻造的金属。有点贵，不容易弄到，但只要用得好，潜力非常大。
I don't have any. Maybe ask my nephew's brother Alegdar?
我没有。要不去问问我侄子的哥哥 Alegdar？
I actually don't know much about... anything.
I kind of just... stand around here.
Everyone I have ever met just calls me annoying and useless. So I decided to stop trying.
我遇到的每个人都说我烦人又没用。所以我决定不再努力了。

你知道吗，人生很艰难。我们只能咬牙撑过去，然后总有一天，也许会变得快乐。
Right sorry... Ask Balegar for any information. He is way smarter.
对，抱歉……去问 Balegar 吧。他聪明多了。
My cousin's nephew's dad has had a rough year... I feel bad for him.
我表亲的侄子的爸爸今年过得很惨……我替他难过。
I have nooooo clue about that metal. I heard it was just as valuable as a normal rock.
那种金属我完——全不知道。我听说它就跟普通石头一样值钱。
Dodegar takes the piece of metal and starts welding it.
Dodegar 接过那块金属，开始焊接。
Maybe my cousin Reyoretrsed knows anything about it.
也许我表亲 Reyoretrsed 知道点什么。
You are wondering how my name is pronounced? What a rude question.
你想知道我的名字怎么念？真是个没礼貌的问题。
Ray-ore-tree-sed, obviously. What is a human doing here?
Ray-ore-tree-sed，这不是很明显吗。人类跑来这里干嘛？
You are wondering if I have Sacred whatever metal?
你想知道我有没有神圣什么什么金属？
I'm {~}. Now if you excuse me, I am busy standing still. Go bother Richard or something.
我 {~} 岁了。好了，失陪，我正忙着站着不动呢。去烦 Richard 之类的吧。
I've been trying to tell you that I have what you need.
我一直想告诉你，我有你需要的东西。
You humans really need to practice your communication skills, please.
你们人类真的得好好练练沟通技巧，拜托。
Anyway, here. Take it! This metal is just a scam anyway, nothing special with it.
总之，给你。拿去吧！这金属根本就是个骗局，没什么特别的。
Return to Dodegar with the metal.
带着金属回到 Dodegar 那里。
I hope it wasn't too much of an issue to get!
希望弄到它没给你添太多麻烦！
... I forgot a step. I can't attach a blade without a binder material.

我需要森林里一种本地花朵的花蜜来黏合。[{~} Diplacus Aurantiacus] 就行。

找那种花可能相当困难，这里有个关于怎么找到它的谜语。
On the side of a hut, hidden inside a hole. Resting in a forest of light, without plight. Whatever that would mean.
小屋的一侧，藏在洞里头。安歇在光之森林，无忧也无愁。管它是什么意思。
Find the Diplacus Aurantiacus by following the riddle to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
照着谜语前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]，找到 Diplacus Aurantiacus。
Hold up! This feels waaay, toooo easy.
等一下！这感觉太——太——简单了。
If I'm going to give you this amazingly, incredible, showstopping, crazy item practically for free, you need to at least work for it!
既然我要几乎免费送你这件惊人、不可思议、震撼全场、疯狂的宝贝，你至少得出点力！
This looks so much better! Anyway, bring me that flower now!
这样看起来好多了！总之，现在把那朵花拿来给我！
Talk to Dodegar with the Diplacus Aurantiacus.
带着 Diplacus Aurantiacus 去找 Dodegar 谈谈。
Took you a while, did it not?
It's starting to look pretty amazing! Just like it's supposed to I'm sure!
它开始看起来相当惊人了！我敢肯定就跟它应该的样子一样！
Maybe this will actually work out. Either way, last ingredient we need!
也许这真的会成功。不管怎样，我们需要最后一样材料了！

为了完成这件独一无二的惊人宝贝，并赋予它魔法特性，我们需要一种叫光泽之血的东西。
The only known creature in the west, probably the whole world if I'm being frank, is known as the Glow Dust Leaf Beetle of the Underworld, not sure where the name comes from.
老实说，西边、大概全世界唯一已知有这东西的生物，叫作冥界辉光尘叶甲虫，不知道这名字是怎么来的。
I happen to know that this Beetle lives in a cave in the eastern ravine thingy! If you walk straight east you will stumble upon it, I promise!
我碰巧知道这种甲虫住在东边峡谷那个什么地方的洞里！你一直往东走，就会碰到它，我保证！
甲虫什么时候会说话了……
You should return to Dodegar with the blood, he should be nearby.
你该带着血回去找 Dodegar，他应该就在附近。
Dodegar smears the weapon with the glowing blood.
Dodegar 把发光的血抹在武器上。
Oh! Almost forgot to mention, about {~} Luster Blood is probably enough.
哦！差点忘了说，大概 {~} 份光泽之血就够了。
Find the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring back [{~} Luster Blood] and bring it back to Dodegar.
找到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的洞窟，把 [{~} 光泽之血] 带回给 Dodegar。
Do not step any closer... Or I will be forced to obliterate you!
别再靠近了……否则我只好把你消灭！
The final component! It is finally here!
最后一个组件！终于到了！
Do you see how it's glowing, sparkling and... and radiating!
你看到它在发光、闪耀，还……还在放射光芒了吗！
You don't? Uhm... maybe you need glasses humie.
看不到？呃……也许你需要配副眼镜，人类小家伙。
As promised! Here you go! Always happy to practice the art of weapon creation.
说好的！给你！我总是乐意练习打造武器的技艺。
The metal is rather rare so I don't know if you can even find it...
这种金属相当稀有，我不知道你能不能找到……
Soon Gavel will open a museum for my art...
Gavel 很快就会为我的作品开一家博物馆……
New Quest Started: Realm of Light I - The Worm Holes
新任务开始: 光之领域 I - 虫洞
{u}, then... Let us head to the site. I need to fix this... Please, help me get to the root of this problem so I may soothe the land's pain.
{u}，那么……我们去现场吧。我得补救这件事……拜托，帮我找到问题的根源，好让我抚平这片土地的痛楚。
So this is the site... siochain do d'anamacha i mait...
原来这就是现场……siochain do d'anamacha i mait……
Even if I am alone on that front...though I understand you are taught differently where you come from. I do not envy you, though I still thank you for your aid thus far.
就算在这点上只有我这么想……尽管我明白你的家乡教你的是另一套。我并不羡慕你，不过我还是感谢你一路以来的帮助。
It looked like it escaped! Did you see where it went?
看起来它逃掉了！你看到它往哪去了吗？
……你、你……{u}……我……你、你还好好的？我……*抽噎* 我……
New Questline Started: The Realm of Light
开始新任务线: 光之领域
Find out what's going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Arrighty fellers, let's get this wrapped up now! 'ere's plenty more holes where this one came from!
好啦伙计们，这个赶紧收尾！这种洞多的是！
The scaffolds are crackin'! Everyone, get offa there, now!!
脚手架裂了！所有人，马上下来！！
Aw, hell... I knew this project was a bust from the start...there goes Willam and Clint cause a' this!
噢，该死……我就知道这项工程打从一开始就是个失败……Willam 和 Clint 就这样没了！
I gotta get someone tough enough to get down there...hm? Hey, a human! Git on over here!
我得找个够强悍的人下去……嗯？嘿，一个人类！过来这边！

我得问问，刚才的事你看到多少，Wynn 来的伙计？场面不好看，而我是那些人的头儿，我得负起责任。

{p} 的镇长看到这些洞冒出来，就雇我们来把它们填上。问题是，地面太不稳，根本没法施工。
It's gettin' real worrying round here. They only started openin' up recently, and there've been quakes too. Feels like the place is gonna collapse!
这一带越来越让人担心了。这些洞最近才开始冒出来，还有地震。感觉整个地方都要塌了！
I think we oughta head down there and figure out what 'n heck's goin' on, and you're the best armed outta any of us, being human 'n all.
我觉得我们该下去弄清楚到底是怎么回事，而你是我们当中装备最好的，毕竟是人类嘛。
Think y'all could head down 'n see if you can rustle up any leads? There's a path down just to the left of the hole.
你能不能下去看看，找点线索？洞的左边就有条路可以下去。
Go down the hole and look for what's causing this and return to Malo at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with proof.
下到洞里找出这件事的起因，带着证据回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Malo 那里。

这到底是什么鬼……？你在下面找到了什么，士兵？

噢，只是一张皮，是吗？可恶……还希望你看到了是什么东西，因为这事我一点头绪都没有。

呃。我认识的人里，唯一可能知道这事的，就是那个讨厌的精灵女人……

她一头紫发，到处晃来晃去，好像什么都懂。是啦，她是很聪明，但也不必对我们所有人那么高高在上吧。

她在这里东边扎了营。她对你的态度大概会比对我好，所以我去找官方，看看他们有没有线索。
Look for Lari and ask what is going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找到 Lari，问问是怎么回事
...Haven’t we met? I have witnessed your presence in Gavel more than once.
……我们见过吗？我在 Gavel 不止一次看到过你。

我是 Lari。要不是之前太忙，我也许早就好好跟你打过招呼了，说到这个。你来这里是有原因的，对吧？

嗯……听你的描述，我想我知道你发现了什么。我想，那张死皮也足以证明了。

蜕下那张皮的生物叫作 Grootslang。它们虽然体型庞大，却相当温和。我记得有句话叫“温柔的巨人”，是吧？
This horrid Decay...it affects their habitats underground. They are seeking shelter closer to the surface. I have been trying to scrub the Decay without success...
这可怕的黯蚀……影响了它们在地底的栖息地。它们正往离地面更近的地方寻找藏身处。我一直在试着清除黯蚀，却没有成功……
Wait... More holes appeared just today? There...there were deaths?! W-where, when?!
等等……今天又冒出了更多洞？有……有人死了？！在、在哪里，什么时候？！

不，不……！我不愿再为任何人的死负责……人类，请告诉我你的名字。
So this is the site... [Gavellian Spell]...
原来这就是现场……[Gavel 咒语]……
Here. Allow me to provide at least one person safe passage into the pit.
来。至少让我护送一个人安全进入深坑。
Have faith- Jump in. I will carry you down slowly.
相信我——跳下去。我会让你慢慢降落。

你带路。如果能在这附近找到更多 Grootslang 的痕迹，会有助于我了解情况。
Hm? This wall looks like it's been disturbed recently...
嗯？这面墙看起来最近被动过……
I can hear it...but where is it crawling...?
我听得到……但它在往哪里爬……？
That's the mother Wyrm! She must be what is making the holes. We need to follow her!
那是母 Wyrm！这些洞一定是她弄出来的。我们得跟上她！
Never mind the spiders, we need to keep following the Wyrm!
别管那些蜘蛛了，我们得继续跟着那条 Wyrm！
Ah...ehm, {u}? I've... Um, this is...a bit difficult to say, but...

如果有什么东西让我们美丽的圣树不适，他会知道的。我对你施的法术能让你跟他交谈。

Sigh... she mentioned it to you too, didn't she? That ceaseless war over our world, fought by forces beyond our power?
唉……她也跟你提过，对吧？那场笼罩我们世界的永无止境的战争，由超越我们的力量在进行？
I caught glimpses of it in Gavel... I'm sure you did, too- and more. Once you know what to look for, it's everywhere. Light and Dark... and the War they leave in their wake.
我在 Gavel 瞥见过它的踪迹……我相信你也看到了，而且更多。一旦知道要找什么，它就无处不在。光明与黑暗……还有它们留下的那场“战争”。
The list goes on with various... odd statistics.
清单上接着列出各种……古怪的数据。
It's only because of their stalemate that they haven't done worse. They're beyond our means to stop, so... the best we can do is keep them at balance.
正因为双方僵持不下，事情才没有更糟。它们不是我们能阻止的，所以……我们能做的，顶多是让它们保持平衡。
She says it's only because of their stalemate that they haven't done worse, and... I believe it.
她说，正是因为它们僵持不下，才没造成更糟的后果，而……我相信她。
...and there was the choice. Join her, and help ensure neither side in that war gets too much of an advantage... or... don't.
……然后就是那个选择。加入她，协助确保那场战争里任何一方都不会占到太大优势……或者……不加入。
To just leave it up to other people, and forget about it and live my life, and- and how could I have possibly done that, knowing that- that he's-
就这样交给别人，然后忘掉这件事，过自己的生活，而——而我怎么可能做得到，明明知道——知道他——
At least, here... I could make a difference. Both in that war, and in Fruma.
至少在这里……我能有所作为。无论是在那场战争里，还是在 Fruma。
If I was in this position anyway... at least I could push for change.
反正都坐上这个位置了……至少我能推动改变。
Not that that's made actually being in Fruma any easier, ha. Everything here is a reminder of... well. You know.
不过那也没让待在 Fruma 变得轻松一点，哈。这里的一切都在提醒我……嗯。你知道的。
...I am. I'm not sure how to feel about it still, honestly.
……是啊。老实说，我到现在还是不知道该怎么看待这件事。
There's... two parts to it. Having authority and commanding soldiers, feels... strange. I don't know if I'll ever be used to it.
这……有两个方面。拥有权力、指挥士兵，感觉……很奇怪。我不知道自己会不会有习惯的一天。
I've never had that sort of power before. To be able to tell people what to do, and... have them just, do it.
我从来没有过那种权力。能叫人做事，然后……他们就真的去做。
I have a voice that can actually push for change, and improve things, and... it feels unearned, in a way.
我有了一个真正能推动改变、改善现状的声音，而……某种程度上，感觉这不是我挣来的。
I'm still the same as I was before! But now, with this title given to me, suddenly people will actually listen to me.
我还是跟以前一样的人！可现在，被授予这个头衔之后，人们突然就真的会听我说话了。
... I don't like that that's all it took.
……我不喜欢事情只需要这样就够了。
It's a strange feeling. Not... unpleasant, exactly, but not comfortable, either. A constant weight on my shoulder, reminding me of what I've signed up for.
那是种奇怪的感觉。不算……难受，但也不舒服。像是肩上一直压着的重量，提醒我自己签下了什么。
It's always there, a... a small push to react to things I haven't noticed yet, that I wouldn't notice without it.
它一直都在，一……一股小小的推力，让我对还没注意到的事情做出反应，没有它我根本不会注意到。
And the more focus I put on it, the stronger it gets. More overwhelming to keep track of, but... stronger.
我越专注在它上面，它就越强。越难以掌控，但是……越强。
...I try not to use it unless I have to.
……除非不得不用，否则我尽量不用它。
She mentioned it to you too, didn't she?
That ceaseless war over our world, fought by forces beyond our power?
那场笼罩我们世界的永无止境的战争，由超越我们的力量在进行？
I caught glimpses of it in Gavel... I'm sure you did too- and more.
我在 Gavel 瞥见过它的踪迹……我相信你看到的更多。
…sigh. I thought… I thought I had it all figured out, but you being here is making things harder than I’d like.
……唉。我以为……我以为我什么都想清楚了，可是你在这里，让事情变得比我希望的更难。
Ha. Well… sort of, but not really. You’ve learned what it really means by now, then? Horrible, uncontrollable power… so they say.
哈。嗯……算是吧，但也不完全是。所以你现在知道那到底是什么意思了？可怕、无法控制的力量……他们是这么说的。
It's all paper-thin, in the end. It's just a means to control the people, to keep all magic contained and monitored.
说到底，这一切都薄得像纸。只是控制人民的手段，把所有魔法都控制、监视起来。
...and knowing that it was all manufactured, that there was never anything actually... wrong...
……而知道这一切都是捏造的，从来就没有什么真的……不对劲……
To some extent, it's a relief - but more than that it makes me angry. This was weighing on me for so long, and for it to mean... nothing, in the end?
某种程度上，这是种解脱——但更多的是让我愤怒。这件事压了我那么久，结果到头来……什么都不是？
...just another thing I want to change in Fruma. If I get the chance, that is.
……又一件我想在 Fruma 改变的事。前提是我有机会。
...you being here is only making it harder for me to do anything about it of course.
……当然，你在这里只会让我更难为此做任何事。
They didn’t want us here. We were… disposable soldiers, just a resource to keep Wynn standing.
他们不想要我们在这里。我们是……用完即弃的士兵，只是维持 Wynn 不倒的资源。
But now, all of a sudden… Now, they’ve changed their mind.
可现在，突然之间……现在，他们改变主意了。
But I can’t just… forget. I had my memories discarded, and was shipped off to Wynn, for something beyond my control.
可我没法就这样……忘记。我被抹去了记忆，被送去 Wynn，就因为一件我控制不了的事。
For something I’ve learned to appreciate over time. For something that was never really a curse!!
因为一件我慢慢学会珍惜的事。因为一件从来就不是诅咒的事！！
I did some digging when I got here, you know? I went looking for anyone I might have known here, before……
我来这里之后调查过，你知道吗？我去找过任何我以前可能认识的人，在……之前……
No one. Not a single person who knew me. Not a single person left to miss me, or even notice my absence!
一个都没有。没有一个人认识我。没有一个人会想念我，甚至没人注意到我不在了！
I had my self stripped away from me, and it doesn’t even matter! Because there was nothing here for me anyway!!
我的自我被剥夺了，而这甚至根本不重要！因为这里本来就没有什么属于我的东西！！
I can’t imagine the same for Aledar. He must have had… someone.
我无法想象 Aledar 也是这样。他一定有过……某个人。
I guess it doesn’t matter. He’s gone anyway, isn’t he?
我想那也不重要了。反正他已经不在了，不是吗？
Why? Because you've been causing the crown problems ever since you broke in.
为什么？因为自从你闯进来，就一直在给王室添麻烦。
Nobody will listen to anything not related to you... and for good reason! You massacred a fort of soldiers, you've killed Sovereign Zhiraok twice now...
没人会听任何跟你无关的事……而且理由很充分！你屠杀了一整座堡垒的士兵，你已经杀了 Zhiraok 统领两次……
Fine. You've killed Sovereign Zhiraok once, and... helped a second time...?
好吧。你杀了 Zhiraok 统领一次，然后……第二次是帮忙……？
...okay. And that isn't to mention the plot to kill the Queen.
……好。更别提刺杀女王的计划了。
I...ugh. I wish it hadn't gone the way it did.
我……唉。我真希望事情没有变成那样。
I know. I know. I tried to warn you, to get you to call it off, but...sigh. It doesn't matter now. It's already done.
我知道。我知道。我试过警告你，想让你收手，可是……唉。现在都不重要了。事情已经发生了。
...I'm sorry about the rest of your friends. The Leaves in the Wind. They... they seem like nice people.
……你其他朋友的事，我很遗憾。风中之叶。他们……他们看起来是好人。
I've gotten off track. I had something I needed to tell you.
我扯远了。我有件事得告诉你。
The crown has soldiers out looking for you. Her Majesty wants to speak with you, to...explain things.
王室派了士兵在找你。女王陛下想跟你谈谈，要……解释一些事。
I… I guess so. I guess you’ve finally made an impression on her.
我……我想是吧。我想你终于让她印象深刻了。
I now understand why that tournament was handled the way it was… but that doesn’t mean I have to like it.
我现在明白那场锦标赛为什么会那样安排了……但那不代表我就得喜欢。
…I think you should hear her out, but that’s your choice to make. I just thought you should know.
……我觉得你应该听听她怎么说，不过那是你的选择。我只是觉得你该知道。
…okay. I can do that. Who first?
...me? I... I guess I'm one now, too. I'm still not sure how to feel about it, honestly. There's... two parts to it.
……我？我……我想我现在也是其中之一了。老实说，我到现在还是不知道该怎么看待这件事。这……有两个方面。
Having authority and commanding soldiers, feels... strange. I don't know if I'll ever be used to it.
拥有权力、指挥士兵，感觉……很奇怪。我不知道自己会不会有习惯的一天。
He’s… probably the best of them all. He does genuinely care about his district’s well-being - I’ve seen the stuff he’s done over {~} years.
他……大概是他们之中最好的一个。他是真心关心他辖区的福祉——我看过他这 {~} 年来做的事。
When I was ascending… he was the only one who bothered telling me what to expect ahead of time.
我在飞升的时候……他是唯一一个愿意事先告诉我会发生什么的人。
…he’s not perfect. Nobody in these positions of power is. But he’s the best Fruma has to offer.
……他不完美。坐在这种权力位置上的人没有一个是完美的。但他是 Fruma 能拿出来的最好的人了。
I still feel like I don’t entirely understand… I don’t know. Whatever it was she was working on - which you stole, by the way - it was important.
我还是觉得我没完全搞懂……我不知道。不管她在研究什么——顺便一提，就是被你们偷走的那个东西——那很重要。
…Zhiraok says she neglected her district, and left it on him to pick up the slack. Was that because of the project, or… did she just not care?
……Zhiraok 说她忽视了自己的辖区，把烂摊子都丢给他收拾。那是因为那个项目，还是……她根本不在乎？
I don’t know. And, now… she’s gone, either way.
我不知道。而现在……不管怎样，她都不在了。
Eugh. He’s... frustrating. I mean we both saw him during that tournament, right? He really thinks he’s better than everyone else around him.
呃。他……很让人火大。我是说我们都在那场锦标赛上见过他，对吧？他真的觉得自己比身边所有人都强。
What’s annoying is that he actually has the skill to back those claims up! There’s a reason he leads the military, after all. Apparently, he even taught himself magic!
最气人的是他真的有本事撑起那些话！他领导军队不是没有原因的。听说他连魔法都是自学的！
…truth be told, I’m not unfamiliar with dealing with this kind of person. You’ve seen Kymer. I just… wish it didn’t get to me as much as it does.
……说实话，跟这种人打交道我并不陌生。你见过 Kymer。我只是……希望自己别那么容易被他惹毛。
I don’t know much about them. I’ve only met them a few times, but they’re… off-putting. I get the sense this is all just a game for them.
我对他们了解不多。我只见过他们几次，但他们……让人很不舒服。我感觉这一切对他们来说只是一场游戏。
…to tell you the truth… they scare me. I don’t think there’s a boundary they’re unwilling to cross, in order to achieve results.
……说实话……他们让我害怕。我觉得为了达成目的，没有什么底线是他们不愿意跨过的。
You might end up running into them while you’re here. If you do… be careful, alright?
你在这里可能会碰上他们。要是碰上了……小心点，好吗？
He’s… dangerous. I’ve only met him once, when I was ascending, but once was enough.
他……很危险。我只见过他一次，在我飞升的时候，但一次就够了。
In terms of sheer brute power, he has the most of any of the Sovereigns. You can feel it radiating off of him. He could crush you with barely a second thought, if he wanted.
论纯粹的蛮力，他是所有统领里最强的。你能感觉到那股力量从他身上散发出来。只要他想，他能不假思索地把你碾碎。
…luckily he stays at Gravity’s Monolith for the most part. He won’t be a problem if you just… stay away.
……幸好他大部分时间都待在引力巨石。只要你……离远一点，他就不会成为问题。
I would recommend you stay away. Take it as a warning from a friend.
我建议你离远一点。就当是朋友的忠告吧。
There’s… nothing much to say. Not because I don’t want to, but because I just don’t know that much about her.
没……什么好说的。不是因为我不想说，而是我对她实在了解不多。
She keeps her secrets to herself. I’ve only even spoken to her a few times, and all of it was about…
她把秘密都藏在心里。我甚至只跟她说过几次话，而且全都是关于……
It’s what I received the blessing for.
那就是我接受祝福的原因。
I… don’t want to talk about it, right now. It won’t matter until all of this resolves, either way.
我……现在不想谈这个。在这一切解决之前，谈了也没意义。
She’s done awful, horrible things. All of Fruma’s problems trace themselves back to her, in some way.
她做过可怕、恶劣的事。Fruma 所有的问题，归根结底都能以某种方式追溯到她身上。
But… there’s more to her than that.
She’s like us, you know? She was… forced into a role she hated, trapped somewhere she couldn’t escape. She was made into something entirely outside of her control.
她跟我们很像，你知道吗？她曾经……被迫扮演一个她讨厌的角色，被困在一个逃不出去的地方。她被变成了某种完全不由她控制的东西。
And eventually, she... she found a way out. Or, rather, she made her own way out. Clawed and pushed and fought for any possibility of freedom…
最后，她……她找到了出路。或者说，她为自己开辟了一条出路。拼命抓、拼命推、拼命争取任何一丝自由的可能……
…it’s rare to find someone who understands, you know? Of course, I’ve had you, and… and Aledar, but it’s isolating. Even others from Fruma, they just… don’t get it.
……能找到懂的人很难得，你知道吗？当然，我有你，还有……还有 Aledar，但那还是很孤独。就连其他来自 Fruma 的人，他们也……不懂。
So to have found someone who knows what it’s like, who managed to forge her own path forward… that connection feels worth holding onto.
所以能找到一个知道那种感觉、为自己开辟出道路的人……那份联系感觉值得紧紧抓住。
I should be going. And… you should get back to your friends.
我该走了。而你……应该回到你朋友身边。
Before I do… I have a warning for you, too. The Sovereign of the {p}- Gikyo… they know where the Canopy is hiding out. They’re preparing an attack of some kind.
在我走之前……我也有个警告要给你。{p} 的统领 Gikyo……他们知道树冠会的藏身处。他们正在准备某种进攻。
…you should be able to warn everybody in time this time around. Make sure nobody gets captured. If they do… it- it won’t be pretty.
……这次你应该能及时警告大家。确保没有人被抓。要是有人被抓……那——那可不会好看。
Now… go. Save the friends you still have left with you.
现在……走吧。去救你身边还剩下的朋友。
{u}, you're... you're back. Does... does that mean you...?
{u}，你……你回来了。那……那是不是代表你……？
You're... you're alone. Where, um... where are they?
你……你一个人。他们，呃……他们人呢？
I didn't make it that far.
How do you know? H-how is it compromised?
你怎么知道？怎、怎么暴露的？
That... did he really do the same thing twice?! Ugh, why is he even helping us?
那……他真的又做了一样的事？！唉，他到底为什么要帮我们？
Hey hey, Sui and Yusanu! The creature has begun to speak! Isn't it a miracle?
嘿嘿，Sui 和 Yusanu！那个生物开口说话了！这不是奇迹吗？
Oh, you return! That was... a rather quick excursion. Well, how was it then? Simple in-and-out break-in?
噢，你回来了！那趟远行……还挺快的。那么，怎么样？简单进出就闯进去了？
Though I hadn't spotted any new arrivals, so... perhaps not.
不过我没看到有新来的人，所以……大概没有吧。
I see, I see. Ran into too many guards, I suppose? It may be for the best, in any case - we've ourselves a talking changeling!
我明白，我明白。碰上太多守卫了，我猜？这样也许最好，不管怎样——我们这里有个会说话的易形者！
Now, as I was saying - you all should come and take a listen, it really is very-
好了，就像我刚才说的——你们都该来听听，真的非常——
Oh dear! Why didn't you lead with that?! Goodness, that's a problem and a half... I'll have to inform Fuhue.
哦，天哪！你怎么不先说这个？！天哪，这可是个大麻烦……我得去通知 Fuhue。
She just so happens to be questioning the prisoner as we speak, in fact! The little lizard has happened to spill some... rather interesting secrets.
她正好在审问那个囚犯呢！那个小家伙已经吐露了一些……相当有意思的秘密。
Come along, kiddos! Let's give it a look, shall we?
跟上吧，孩子们！我们去看看，好吗？
太好了。你们来得正是时候。
It's shut up now, but it was speaking just a moment ago. Don't worry, I'll be able to get it talking again.
它现在闭嘴了，不过刚才还在说话。别担心，我能让它再开口。
You'll want to hear what it says. It's relevant to your current concerns.
你们会想听听它说什么的。跟你们现在担心的事有关。
Well alright, Fuhue, take it away!
Hm! Seems to have done the trick.
What? Magic? I don't know what that word means.
什么？魔法？我不知道那个词是什么意思。
They refer to curses or blessings, captain.
他们指的是诅咒或祝福，队长。
Oh! No, no, certainly not. It's a simple talisman. They're a traditional art, passed down to us through generations of the Canopy.
哦！不，不，当然不是。这只是个简单的护符。那是一门传统技艺，是树冠会世世代代传下来的。
I believe Master Azael explained it to Yusanu the other day? By inscribing specific glyphs in certain patterns, they can be ignited for varying powerful effects.
我记得 Azael 大人前几天跟 Yusanu 解释过？只要按照特定的图案刻上特定的符文，就能点燃它们，产生各种强大的效果。
Through experimentation, we've determined which glyphs yield which results, though there's more we still don't know! As a matter of fact-
经过实验，我们已经弄清楚哪些符文会产生哪些效果，不过还有更多我们不知道的！事实上——
Fuhue, I appreciate the enthusiasm, I do, but shouldn't we return to the matter at hand?
Fuhue，我很欣赏你的热情，真的，不过我们是不是该回到正事上？
Yes. Of course. That's enough on talismans for now. Everyone, hurry up and take a look.
是的。当然。护符的事先说到这里。大家，快过来看。
I am an ordinary citizen! This is a crime!
我是普通市民！这是犯罪！
Ah, I see now. This one hadn't made it very far in its training. That would explain why it was so easy to capture.
啊，我明白了。这一只的训练还没进行到多深。难怪这么容易就抓到了。
It- it knows! It knows their names, so- so does it know where-
它——它知道！它知道他们的名字，所以——所以它知不知道他们在——
No mention of my brothers... or anyone else from the Steel Feather...
没提到我的兄弟们……或是钢羽的任何其他人……
Oh... I- I didn't even... realize. I didn't even think... I- I'm sorry.
哦……我——我根本没……注意到。我根本没想到……我——我很抱歉。
It's... fine. I just... wish I could know for sure they're still alive out there.
没……关系。我只是……希望能确定他们还活着。
Hey, little man, lighten up! The way I see it, it's incredibly likely they've split the two groups.
嘿，小伙子，开心点！照我看，他们很有可能把两批人分开了。
Yes. It's a very common psychological torture technique! Splitting up groups of people does a number on one's-
是的。这是非常常见的心理折磨手段！把一群人分开会对人的——
Fuhue, really, do you think this is the time? Given our audience?
Fuhue，说真的，你觉得现在是时候吗？看看你的听众？
Now, importantly, all changelings receive training here in the {p}! The crown has a special fort up on the eastern mountainside for it.
好了，重要的是，所有易形者都在 {p} 这里受训！王室在东边的山坡上有一座专门的堡垒。
Oh! Oh, we can organize a raid on the fort, gather information and find-
噢！噢，我们可以组织突袭那座堡垒，收集情报，找到——
News? What news? I haven't heard anything from the owls yet this morning, and...
消息？什么消息？今天早上我还没收到猫头鹰们的任何消息，而且……
Did I forget? Forget what? Goodness, what am I missing...
我忘了？忘了什么？天哪，我漏掉了什么……
Oh! Oh, dear, right! Right right right! I remember now!
哦！哦，天哪，对了！对对对！我想起来了！
The crown knows our location, huh?
王室知道我们的位置了，是吧？
Again?! Gah!!! Barely get a month's rest before we have to move again...
又来？！啊！！！休息不到一个月就又得搬家……
Ugh! I guess I'll go gather all our paperwork and emergency rations...
唉！我想我得去收拾所有文件和应急口粮了……
I'll summon the owls and deploy them to begin evacuations. I'll have to track down Cileon as well...
我去召集猫头鹰们，派他们开始疏散。我还得去找 Cileon……
You know they're just going to stay behind to take out as many soldiers as possible, right?
你知道他们只会留下来尽可能多干掉几个士兵吧？
Cocky bastard... of course they will.
自大的混蛋……他们当然会。
Anyway! Kiddos, I'll meet you up at the top of this tree! That's where the Owls' headquarters are!
总之！孩子们，我在这棵树的树顶等你们！猫头鹰队的总部就在那里！
Rurie, I can't deal with all this paperwork on my own! Hand me two of your workers.
Rurie，我一个人应付不了这么多文件！借我两个你的手下。
带 Sui 和 Yusanu 去！
Ah! Of course. That'll do. Well, chop chop outsiders. Pack up here!
啊！当然。这样就行了。好了，快点快点，外人们。在这里收拾！
Head to the meet up place at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
These talismans... the colors, pink green blue white gold... the shapes... there's something. There's something.
这些护符……颜色，粉、绿、蓝、白、金……形状……有什么东西。一定有什么东西。
I'm getting close, I can feel it. I just need... a little more time.
我快弄懂了，我感觉得到。我只需要……再多一点时间。
They keep talking like we aren't here...
他们一直说得好像我们不在这里一样……
It's... it's okay. I know they're alive. There's hope! There's hope, there's hope, there's hope.
没……没关系。我知道他们还活着。还有希望！还有希望，还有希望，还有希望。
任务报告、库存、位置规划……
Ugh! I need to get to my lists. I can't think straight!
唉！我得去拿我的清单。我脑子一团乱！
Well, it's a good thing we have the emergency shelter! A shame it's in a cave. Sigh...
嗯，还好我们有应急避难所！可惜是在洞穴里。唉……
Well well well well! And there they all are!
好啦好啦好啦好啦！他们都到了！
Greetings are in order to the little doves! Ready to get moving then?
该向小鸽子们打个招呼！准备好出发了吗？
Owls? Why, yes, of course - but you, dear friends, are doves. The small and defenseless, in dire need of aid...
猫头鹰？当然是啦——不过亲爱的朋友们，你们是鸽子。弱小无助、急需援手的那种……
Captain, if we're all in order, shouldn't we get moving? We're to lead them to the next hideout.
队长，如果大家都准备好了，我们不是该出发了吗？我们要带他们去下一个藏身处。
Right you are! Right you are, indeed. Then to the north we shall fly, little doves and silent owls!
说得对！确实说得对。那就往北飞吧，小鸽子们和沉默的猫头鹰们！
Meet up with Sui, Yusanu and Captain Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Sui、Yusanu 和 Rurie 队长会合。
And so we fly forth, birds of the flock! Onwards we go!
于是我们展翅飞翔，鸟群们！向前进！
Oof! My goodness, they don't make these things quite like they used to! Since when have the ziplines been so... exhilerating?
哎哟！天哪，这些东西真是今非昔比！滑索什么时候变得这么……刺激了？
Not the most graceful landing, captain.
降落得不太优雅啊，队长。
Oh, what do you know?! Why don't you try to land gracefully in a- in- in a-... see how you do!!
噢，你懂什么？！你怎么不试试优雅地降落在一——在——在一个——……看你能怎样！！
Ahem. Shall we get moving then? Over the hills and down the road, to the meet up spot we go!
咳咳。那我们出发吧？翻过山丘沿着路，我们去会合地点！
...{u}, Yusanu. When we get to safety, we... we should talk about what to do next.
……{u}、Yusanu。等我们到了安全的地方，我们……我们应该谈谈接下来要怎么做。
Rex, Zeph... Mora... if- if they're here, then... then...
Rex、Zeph……Mora……如——如果他们在这里，那……那……
Don't worry, Sui, I... I get it. We'll do whatever we can to get your brother out of there. Promise.
别担心，Sui，我……我懂。我们会尽一切努力把你哥哥救出来。我保证。
Speaking of the prodigal son and his companions, are we! My my, what a tragic tale... but perhaps I have an inkling of their present whereabouts.
说到浪子和他的同伴们！天哪，真是个悲惨的故事……不过也许我对他们目前的下落有些头绪。
You- you do? Why... why didn't you tell us sooner?!
你——你知道？那……那你为什么不早点告诉我们？！
Ah ah! Sensitive information is for sensitive ears alone. I believed it best to wait for better circumstances... too many unknown faces back at the Canopy.
啊啊！敏感情报只给敏感的耳朵听。我认为最好等到更合适的时机……树冠会那边陌生面孔太多了。
Well, silent owls? Fly forth, update the others at the hideout on our whereabouts! I'll keep an eye on our little doves as we discuss matters further.
好了，沉默的猫头鹰们？飞吧，去通知藏身处的其他人我们的位置！我会照看我们的小鸽子们，顺便进一步讨论。
...you're the boss, Captain. If you say so.
And I do say so! Well, chop chop, get it moving, wouldn't you?
我就是这么说的！好了，快点快点，动起来，好吗？
Ah... authority is its own sort of treat, isn't it?
啊……权力本身就是一种享受，不是吗？
Rurie, you said you had a lead. What is it?
So impatient! So so impatient. Yes, fine, there is a military outpost just to the east, a flap of the wings as the bird flies! I will take you there.
真没耐心！真是太没耐心了。好吧，好吧，东边有个军事前哨站，鸟儿扇一下翅膀就到！我带你们去。
Uh... isn't that dangerous? You said that's where all the ch-
呃……那不是很危险吗？你说过那里是所有易——
Yes well not everything can be so easy, can it?! Be brave! Take risks! Et cetera, et cetera.
是啦，可不是所有事都那么容易的，对吧？！勇敢点！冒点险！诸如此类，诸如此类。
And with all the guards and soldiers and riffraff mobilized to the Canopy, it certainly will be simpler to sneak in! You do want to save your brother do you not?
而且所有守卫、士兵和乌合之众都被调去树冠会了，偷溜进去肯定会简单得多！你们确实想救你哥哥，对吧？
...still. We- we aren't much of fighters! If... if we get caught...
……可是。我们——我们不太会打架！要……要是被抓到……
I- we can't, keep putting all the work on {u}'s shoulders. We need a better plan!
我——我们不能，一直把所有的活儿都压在 {u} 身上。我们需要一个更好的计划！
Alas, it is now or it is never. Tick tock tick tock, time's running out, little doves! Onwards we shall fly, to save friend and family alike!
唉，机不可失，时不再来。滴答滴答滴答滴答，时间快不够了，小鸽子们！往前飞吧，去救朋友和家人！
跟着 Rurie 队长前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
A problem? No... no, no no, there is no problem here! All is just as it should be.
问题？没有……没有，没没没，这里没有任何问题！一切都再正常不过了！
Are... are you- are you sure? You're... you're starting to scare me, Rurie.
你……你——你确定吗？你……你开始让我害怕了，Rurie。
H- huh?! Wh- what's going on?!
Th- thank you, Sui, that... I don't... you- you're really, uh, getting the hang of that ice stuff, aren't you?
谢——谢谢你，Sui，那……我没……你——你真的，呃，越来越会用那种冰的东西了，对吧？
I... I didn't even... do that intentionally. It was... reflexive...
我……我根本不是……故意那样做的。那是……本能反应……
B-but, more... more importantly- what happened? Where's- where's Rurie?
可、可是，更……更重要的是——发生什么事了？Rurie——Rurie 去哪了？
Those... those must have been changelings!
那些……那些一定是易形者！
Oho! Impressive stuff. Simple pieces of paper in appearance... but they pack a punch. Rather useful!
哦呵！真了不起。看起来只是普通的纸片……却威力十足。相当有用！
Easier than expected. Should use more- eugh, no no no, don't like this one at all.
比预想的简单。该多用——呃，不不不，一点都不喜欢这个。
Ah, much improved! Now this - what an enjoyable form it has been, yes yes yes! The drama, the intrigue! Perhaps it would do to use it more, hm hm hm!
啊，好多了！这个嘛——多么令人愉快的形态，是是是！戏剧性、阴谋！也许该多用用它，嗯嗯嗯！
Who am I? Why, I am Captain Rurie, leader of the owls! Master of the mists, eyes and ears of the trees - runaway FOOL from higher lands!!!!
我是谁？哎呀，我是 Rurie 队长，猫头鹰队的首领！迷雾的主人，树林的耳目——从高地逃出来的傻瓜！！！！
Oh but no no no, I should think you have it figured out by now! Is it not obvious?
哦，不不不，我想你们现在应该已经猜到了！这不是很明显吗？
What a delight! This before you is the form of the Ranger {p}, Sovereign to these secretive little ants! The name it was given is Gikyo.
真令人愉快！站在你们面前的是 {p} 巡林官的形态，这些神神秘秘的小蚂蚁们的统领！它被赋予的名字是 Gikyo。
To think there has been a struggle to take you in so far yet the task proved simple and easy! How delightful! The Sovereign Forest will be furious!
想想看，之前抓你们费了那么大劲，结果这件事竟然简简单单就办成了！多么令人愉快！森林统领会气坏的！
But that is enough talk and secrets spilling. It is time, crown's wanted! Time for you to go...
不过话说够了，秘密也泄露够了。时候到了，王室的通缉犯们！该你们走了……
Talk to Sui and Yusanu. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
与 Sui 和 Yusanu 交谈。如果需要回营地，前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
Is this really it, then? Ordeal after ordeal and this is where it leads?
真的就这样了吗？经历了一次又一次磨难，最后就走到这一步？
Will it ever end? What's the point? The crown's after us now, and- and they're not going to stop!! Why- why even try?!
这到底会不会结束？意义在哪里？王室现在在追捕我们，而——而且他们不会停手的！！为——为什么还要努力？！
Yusanu! Y-you need to... to get yourself together! Please, d-don't lose your head now... n-not here, of all places.
Yusanu！你、你得……得振作起来！拜托，别、别在这时候乱了分寸……别、别在这种地方。
I... ha, I- I know it feels hard. Im-impossible, even! A-and maybe I'm, I'm just putting on a brave face... I- I want to lie down and j-just wait for the, the inevitable, as much as you do!!
我……哈，我——我知道这感觉很难。甚、甚至不可能！而、而且也许我，我只是在强装勇敢……我——我跟你一样想躺下来，就、就这样等那，那不可避免的结局！！
But... b-but not now. We're- we're here, a-and they're so close. Mora, Rex, Zeph... we- we have some hope! S-so... don't give up. Not now!
可是……可、可是不是现在。我们——我们在这里，而、而且他们离我们这么近。Mora、Rex、Zeph……我们——我们还有希望！所、所以……别放弃。不是现在！
...okay. Then... where do we start? They... they took all of our belongings... and you can't cast spells without your weapon, can you?
……好。那……我们从哪开始？他们……他们拿走了我们所有的东西……而你没有武器就没法施法，对吧？
I... I still have my magic. I can... I can try.
我……我还有我的魔法。我可以……我可以试试。
N-not... that. I... ugh, why is this so hard all of a sudden...?
不、不是……那个。我……唉，为什么突然变得这么难……？
Oh, sh- shut up! I- I'm trying, okay!
哦，闭——闭嘴！我——我在努力了，好吗！
...oh. Oh, oh- I think I know a way out!
……噢。噢，噢——我想我知道怎么出去了！
Look, this- this appears to be tempered glass!
你看，这——这好像是钢化玻璃！
Um... I... I have no idea what that means.
呃……我……我完全不知道那是什么意思。
No, look- it's one of the inventions I assisted Soosu with. I didn't know what its purpose was at the time, but... I guess this fits.
不是，你看——这是我协助 Soosu 做的发明之一。当时我不知道它的用途，不过……看来就是这个。
Tempered glass is incredibly strong and durable. It resists most attempts to break it, except - except for striking the edge of the glass with a sharp object.
钢化玻璃非常坚固耐用。大多数想打破它的方法都没用，除了——除了用尖锐的东西敲击玻璃的边缘。
And, Sui! If you could make an icicle with your magic... and strike the edge...
所以，Sui！如果你能用魔法变出一根冰锥……然后敲击边缘……
...then we could get out? I... m-maybe. But, y-you just saw me- um, nearly flood our cell with... sewage...
……我们就能出去了？我……也、也许吧。可是，你、你刚才也看到我——呃，差点让我们的牢房淹满……污水……
Sui. You were the one just giving me a pep talk. Come on, you can do it!
Sui。刚才给我打气的可是你。加油，你做得到的！
...okay. Okay, you- you're right! I can... I can do this. I can.
……好。好，你——你说得对！我可以……我可以做到。我可以。
I- ha, I, I did it!!
That's the first step! We've got the sharp object, now... aim for the corner!
这是第一步！尖锐的东西有了，现在……瞄准角落！
It- it worked! Ha... hahaha... oh, it worked...
成——成功了！哈……哈哈哈……噢，成功了……
Find Captain Rurie. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
找到 Rurie 队长。如果需要回营地，前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
L-let's go, then! Let's find the others, and- and get out of here!
我、我们走吧！去找其他人，然后——然后离开这里！
Well! Hoo hoo, my little friends!
好啦！呼呼，我的小朋友们！
Uh... duh? That devilish snake got the drop on me when I went up to the owls' nest! Those changelings certainly do not play fair, let me tell you...
呃……废话？我去猫头鹰巢的时候被那条阴险的蛇偷袭了！那些易形者可一点都不讲公平，我跟你说……
How... how can we know for sure it's, um, really him?
我们……我们要怎么确定这真的，呃，是他？
What?! Is it not obvious that I am who I say I- oh, whatever, something something it's protocol. Fine.
什么？！我是谁这不是很明显吗——哦，随便啦，什么什么这是规程。好吧。
Hm... I don't think changelings have access to memories, do they? Rurie, where did we first meet?
嗯……我不觉得易形者能读取记忆，对吧？Rurie，我们第一次见面是在哪里？
Yes, finally, some sense! It was in that cave! My owls and I captured you as leverage, and if I do recall correctly, you nearly cried like a little baby! Ah, memories...
对，终于有点脑子了！是在那个洞穴！我和我的猫头鹰们把你抓去当筹码，要是我没记错的话，你差点像个小宝宝一样哭出来！啊，美好的回忆……
Finally! Now then, time for us to get moving!
终于！那么，我们该出发了！
THEY LEFT YOUR KNIVES ON YOU?!
他们居然没收走你的刀？！
Oh, no, no no no. They certainly did take them, alright! Seems they missed a few in my boots, though! Lucky me!
哦，不，不不不。他们确实把刀收走了！不过好像漏了我靴子里的几把！真走运！
Now, I simply couldn't help but overhear you little loudmouths, so I came up with a plan while you were debating whether I was real or not!
好了，我实在忍不住听到你们这些小大嘴巴在说话，所以趁你们在争论我是不是真的时候，我想了个计划！
Yusanu. That device of yours is quite important, isn't it? I'll help you fetch it - hopefully add a few more to my kill list along the way, eh?
Yusanu。你那个装置很重要，对吧？我帮你去拿回来——顺便希望能在路上多添几个击杀，嗯？
And Sui... go find your family. Important to hold onto those you love, isn't it? You and {u} can handle this, I'm sure, but... be careful.
还有 Sui……去找你的家人。紧紧抓住你爱的人很重要，对吧？我相信你和 {u} 应付得来，不过……小心点。
Well then! Let's skedaddle, kiddos! Good luck out there!
好了！我们溜吧，孩子们！祝你们好运！
Let's... try and find our stuff. We, ha, can't really handle a whole fort of changelings without your weapon, can we?
我们……先去找回我们的东西吧。没有你的武器，我们，哈，没法对付一整座堡垒的易形者，对吧？
Find your weapon before you proceed further. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
继续前进之前先找到你的武器。如果需要回营地，前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
Hey! We can't leave without our belongings.
嘿！我们不能丢下我们的东西就走。
Are you prepared for a fight
I... I hope so, but... I'm not sure. The ocean still feels... off. Like, like a step to the left.
我……我希望如此，不过……我不确定。海水还是感觉……不对劲。就像，就像往左偏了一步。
I... don't really, I don't have anything worth grabbing, here...
我……没什么，这里没有我值得拿的东西……
Uh, I found this map... come here.
呃，我找到这张地图……过来。
"{p}, Changeling Facility." So... this whole place is, um, probably crawling with them.
“{p}，易形者设施。”所以……这整个地方大概，呃，到处都是他们。
This... this m-might be, um, harder than I thought it might be. B-but! I can't give up. They're so close... where are they...?
这……这可、可能比我想的，呃，还要难。可、可是！我不能放弃。他们离得这么近……他们在哪……？
And the Sovereign's office looks like it's at the very back of the building...
而统领的办公室看起来在建筑物的最后面……
There's a, another block of cells right outside. If we're careful enough... maybe we can avoid a confrontation with the Sovereign.
外面就有，另一排牢房。如果我们够小心……也许能避开跟统领正面冲突。
...th-thanks for being here, {u}. I... I would've given up a long time ago if you weren't.
……谢、谢谢你在这里，{u}。要不是有你……我……我早就放弃了。
Continue exploring the Changeling Camp and look for your friends. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
继续探索易形者营地，寻找你的朋友。如果需要回营地，前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
Continue to the Officer's Quarters in the southern wing. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
继续前往南翼的军官宿舍。如果需要回营地，前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
Here for a duel?! I love duels?! I love fighting?! I love life?!
来决斗的吗？！我爱决斗？！我爱战斗？！我爱生命？！
C-careful! That's... Sovereign Gikyo's office up ahead. Let's, um, try and avoid them.
小、小心！前面是……Gikyo 统领的办公室。我们，呃，尽量避开他们吧。
No... n-no, no no no, no- no...
It's... it's a ticket. From the... Steel Feather... the ones... Quill gave us...
这是……这是一张票。从……钢羽来的……就是……Quill 给我们的那些……
There- ha, there, th-there's no way s-some-someone could, ha, survive... this...
不——哈，不，不、不可能有人、有人能，哈，在这……这之后活下来……
How... h-how dare they... how DARE they?! Th-they have to pay for this, {u}, they- they have to!!
他们……他、他们怎么敢……他们怎么敢？！他、他们一定要为此付出代价，{u}，他——他们一定要！！
Come on... come on, come on, we- we need to confront Gikyo, we- come on!!
快……快点，快点，我——我们得去找 Gikyo 算账，我们——快点！！
Head to Sovereign Gikyo's office to confront them. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
前往 Gikyo 统领的办公室找他们算账。如果需要回营地，前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
Well well, look who has stumbled on in! If it is not the crown's number one wanted and the silly weak sister! Were you not locked up?
好啦好啦，看看是谁跌跌撞撞闯进来了！这不是王室的头号通缉犯和那个傻乎乎的弱小妹妹吗！你们不是被关起来了吗？
No... you... wh- what did you... what did you DO?!
不……你……你——你做了什么……你到底做了什么？！
Hehehehahaha! Oh, this? Why it's the prodigal son of course! Go on, say hello to your little sister, big brother!!
嘿嘿嘿嘿哈哈哈！哦，这个？哎呀，这当然是浪子啦！来吧，跟你的小妹妹打个招呼，大哥哥！！
You should know I did offer the opportunity to speak, yes yes indeed! If only he would have spat up all those deep deep secrets on your group... could his pain have been avoided?
你们该知道，我可是给过他开口的机会，是是是，确实如此！要是他肯把你们那伙人那些深深深藏的秘密全吐出来……他的痛苦是不是就能避免了呢？
But but but but but sad as it is, he refused to say a word! What a shame indeed, indeed. A long deep dark painful agonizing death it was!
可是可是可是可是可是虽然很可惜，他一个字都不肯说！真是可惜啊，可惜。那是一场漫长、深沉、黑暗、痛苦、煎熬的死亡！
Well since you are here and the rest are taken it would seem it was for naught! I have every little dove just where I want them, yes yes I do.
不过既然你们来了，其他人又都被带走了，看来是白费功夫了！每一只小鸽子都在我想要的地方，是是是没错。
Yes! Shooty girl and wind boy! Rex and Zeph I believe it was?
对！爱射箭的女孩和风男孩！我记得是叫 Rex 和 Zeph？
Wind boy was always crying and screaming... how pathetic. But shooty girl... yes shooty girl was a delight.
风男孩总是又哭又叫……真可悲。可是爱射箭的女孩……对，爱射箭的女孩真是个宝贝。
Never let out a word no matter the pain! The ones like her are always the most most most fun to crack, yes they are.
不管多痛都一个字都不说！像她这样的总是最最最好玩的，要撬开她们的嘴，没错没错。
Alas... all good things must come to an end it would seem! The killjoy Sovereign {p}, swooping in and ruining ALL my fun...
唉……看来所有好事都有结束的时候！扫兴的 {p} 统领，突然冲进来，毁了我所有的乐趣……
Noooo Gikyo you cannot keep your prisoners no matter how much you wish, no no no, the people {p} demand their girl returned and well who am I to stand against them?
不——行 Gikyo 你不能留着你的囚犯不管你有多想，不不不，{p} 的人民要求把他们的女孩还回去，嗯我又是谁能跟他们作对呢？
And so ended the fun that was being had! But I had the last laugh, ehehehaha. The Athassa girl could take one and not both of the companions! A choice? A choice!
于是正在进行的乐趣就这样结束了！不过笑到最后的是我，嘿嘿嘿哈哈。那个 Athassa 女孩只能带走一个同伴，不能两个都带！要选择？要选择！
Oh the noble hero that he was, he chose to stay! What a bore. But what a joy! What a joy joy joy joy joy!
噢，他真是个高尚的英雄，他选择了留下！真无聊。可是真快乐！快乐快乐快乐快乐快乐！
And now where is he? Bleeding out, dying, fading, vanishing with each and every passing moment! And it would seem perhaps he is the lucky one!
那他现在在哪里呢？流着血、垂死、渐渐消逝，随着每一刻过去一点一点消失！而看起来，也许他才是幸运的那个！
Well then! Would you care to join him in this dance? To the end of days - yours end HERE and NOW!
那么！你们要不要跟他一起跳这支舞？直到世界末日——你们的末日就在此时此地！
Defeat Sovereign Gikyo. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
击败 Gikyo 统领。如果需要回营地，前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
Check up on Sui. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
去看看 Sui 的状况。如果需要回营地，前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
He's... he's my brother... give... give him... back...
他……他是我哥哥……把……把他……还给我……
He's dead. He's... dead he's dead he's dead, but so is that BASTARD!!!
他死了。他……死了他死了他死了，可是那个混蛋也死了！！！
And it... it... it doesn't even matter. I killed them, and... and... and what now? M- Mora, he's- he's still...
可是……可是……可是这根本不重要。我杀了他们，然后……然后……然后现在呢？M——Mora，他——他还是……
No?? Then what do you CALL this?! Rex and Zeph are gone and Mora is- h-he's... he... he's...
没有？？那你管这叫什么？！Rex 和 Zeph 不见了，而 Mora——他、他……他……他……
We... we weren't fast enough... we took too long to get here, a-and now... and now...
我们……我们不够快……我们花了太久才赶到这里，而、而现在……而现在……
I already GOT revenge, {u}!! I didn't... I didn't know I... it- it happened so fast, and... and... I killed them. I got revenge and... and I still feel hollow.
我已经报仇了，{u}！！我没……我不知道我……事情——事情发生得太快了，然后……然后……我杀了他们。我报了仇，然后……然后我还是觉得空荡荡的。
He's... gone. He's gone, and- a-and I can't... I can't get him back...
他……走了。他走了，而——而、而我没办法……我没办法把他找回来……
We- we need to g-get out of here, I- I- I can't... I can't be here. I can't... I c-can't look at him.
我们——我们得离、离开这里，我——我——我不能……我不能待在这里。我不能……我不、不能看着他。
...this is all my fault, isn't it?
I- I- all I've been DOING this whole time has been crying, worrying, and- and- and being USELESS!
我——我——我这段时间一直在做的就只是哭、担心，还有——还有——还有当个废物！
I was so afraid of my cur-... why, why, WHY can't I break that habit?! Magic. Magic magic magic magic MAGIC!!
我一直那么害怕我的诅——……为什么，为什么，为什么我就是改不掉这个习惯？！魔法。魔法魔法魔法魔法魔法！！
I was so afraid that I never even tried!! If I had, if I- I- if I'd have learned more, been stronger...
我怕到连试都没试过！！要是我试过，要是我——我——要是我学得更多、变得更强……
I... I could have... I could have saved him. I could have protected him, I could have healed him, I could have-
我……我本来可以……我本来可以救他。我本来可以保护他，我本来可以治好他，我本来可以——
But no, of COURSE NOT!! Because I'm worthless and useless and can't help ANYONE!!
可是没有，当然没有！！因为我一文不值、一无是处，谁都帮不了！！
Rex and Zeph are- they're still out there. {u}, {u}, we can still save them. We- we know where they are!!
Rex 和 Zeph——他们还在外面。{u}，{u}，我们还能救他们。我们——我们知道他们在哪！！
We just... we just need to find the {p} Sovereign. He has them, he- he has to. He... he has to.
我们只要……我们只要找到 {p} 统领。他们在他手上，他——他一定有。他……他一定有。
...let's go. We can't- we can't let this happen again.
……走吧。我们不能——我们不能让这种事再发生。
Meet up with Yusanu and Captain Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Yusanu 和 Rurie 队长会合。
Hello, dear friends! I see you have returned to us safe and sound!
你们好啊，亲爱的朋友们！看来你们平平安安地回到我们身边了！
We found everything we were looking for, and- and more!! Plans, Sui, plans!! Of Deraj prison!!
我们找到了要找的所有东西，而且——而且还不止！！计划图，Sui，计划图！！Deraj 监狱的！！
It would seem our dear Changeling Sovereign worked closely with the prison's warden... for what purpose remains unclear, though I imagine something changeling-adjacent?
看来我们亲爱的易形者统领跟监狱的典狱长关系密切……目的还不清楚，不过我猜跟易形者有关？
Sui, with- with these plans, we could... we could stand a chance of breaking everyone out! We could- we could get them all back!
Sui，有了——有了这些计划图，我们就能……我们就有机会把所有人都救出来！我们可以——我们可以把他们全都救回来！
They're gone, Yusanu! Mora's- Mora's dead.
The Sovereign, they... they killed him.
那个统领，他们……他们杀了他。
Just... gone. Taken to the {p}. But, Mora is- he's-
就……不在了。被带去了 {p}。可是，Mora 他——他——
So. So, I- I'm glad you have hope! For... for getting your people back! Good for you!!
所以。所以，我——我很高兴你还抱着希望！为了……为了救回你的家人！真替你高兴！！
Emotions are... certainly running high right now, aren't they! Why don't we, ah, regroup with the rest of the Canopy, and... take some time?
现在情绪……确实有点激动，对吧！我们何不，呃，先跟树冠会其他人会合，然后……花点时间冷静一下？
Take. Some Time? No. No, I'm done taking time. I'm done crying, I'm done worrying! I'm so... so... angry! At the Crown, at myself, at- at Mora!!!!
花。点时间？不。不，我受够花时间了。我受够哭了，我受够担心了！我好……好……生气！气王室，气我自己，气——气 Mora！！！！
At all of you for treating me like I can't handle anything myself!!!
气你们所有人把我当成什么事都处理不了的人！！！
S-Sui, please, I- I understand, but-
DO YOU?! Do you understand?! Because it SOUNDS like everything's all just fine for you! Your brothers are still alive! You even have a plan to get them back!!
你明白吗？！你真的明白吗？！因为听起来你那边一切都好好的！你的兄弟们都还活着！你甚至还有救他们回来的计划！！
Rex and Zeph, they... they need me. Need us! And... and I'm not letting anyone else get hurt, or- or- or d-die, not if I can stop it!!
Rex 和 Zeph，他们……他们需要我。需要我们！而……而我不会再让任何人受伤，或——或——或死、死掉，只要我能阻止！！
The Crown... the Sovereigns... the Queen... they'll pay. They'll pay for everything they've done to me, and my- m-my... my family...
王室……统领们……女王……他们会付出代价。他们会为对我、对我的——我、我的……我的家人做过的一切付出代价……
And how exactly do you expect to be able to take vengeance in your current state, Sui? I beg of you, please rest before doing something so extreme!
你以现在这个状态，到底打算怎么报仇，Sui？我求你，在做出这么极端的事之前先休息一下！
Every minute I waste is another chance for something to go wrong!!! "Fading with each and every passing moment..."
我浪费的每一分钟都是事情出错的另一个机会！！！“随着每一刻过去一点一点消失……”
If- if only we were there sooner, then- th-then... so- so, no. No, I can't rest! I will be getting my family back!
要——要是我们早点到就好了，那——那……所——所以，不。不，我不能休息！我一定要把我的家人救回来！
Sui, we... we can't just storm off into a new district without a plan! The Canopy, they- they can help us! And Soosu's device, I'm so close to a breakthrough, I just need-
Sui，我们……我们不能没有计划就直接冲进一个新的辖区！树冠会，他们——他们能帮我们！还有 Soosu 的装置，我快要有突破了，我只需要——
Then stay behind, Yusanu. I... I don't need you, anyway.
那你就留下吧，Yusanu。我……反正我也不需要你。
I said, I don't NEED you, Yusanu! What have you even done this whole time we've been in the {p}?! Taken as hostage, tinkering with- with- with that STUPID device!
我说，我不需要你，Yusanu！我们在 {p} 这段时间你到底做了什么？！被抓去当人质，摆弄——摆弄——摆弄那个蠢装置！
YOU haven't had to do any of the work! YOU didn't have to- to run random tasks without explanation! YOU didn't have to- to f-fight and k- k- kill a Sovereign! You... you...
你根本不用做任何事！你不用——不用去跑那些莫名其妙的任务！你不用——不用去战、战斗，去杀、杀、杀一个统领！你……你……
Is... is there nothing I can say to convince you not to go?
那……那我说什么都没办法说服你别去吗？
Fine. I... I can't follow you, Sui, I can't. I'm going to stay with the Canopy... I'm going to save everyone from Deraj... and I'm going to keep working.
好吧。我……我不能跟你走，Sui，我不能。我要留在树冠会……我要把 Deraj 的所有人救出来……然后我要继续我的研究。
...well, this doesn't have to be goodbye for good, does it? We shall go our separate paths, for a time, then link back together further down the line!
……嗯，这不必是永别，对吧？我们暂时各走各的路，之后再在路上重逢！
Hm. If you're set on this path, you'll surely be dealing with the {p} Sovereign. Ah, Majin of House Thalas... what a delightfully horrible man he is.
嗯。如果你决心走这条路，你肯定会跟 {p} 统领打交道。啊，Thalas 家族的 Majin……真是个恶劣得令人愉快的家伙。
Experience? Ha! Hahahaha! Yes, I suppose you could say that! Goodness. Experience.
经验？哈！哈哈哈哈！是啊，我想你可以这么说！天哪。经验。
A word of warning... he's an easy man to underestimate. All confidence, bluster, so insufferable you could hardly believe there's anything beneath it all!
提醒你一句……他是个很容易被低估的人。满身自信、虚张声势，讨厌到让人几乎不敢相信那底下还有什么！
But his self-proclaimed "number one" position amongst the Sovereigns isn't just for show! His confidence, his demeanour... all of it is earned. As much as one may wish otherwise!
但他自封的“第一”地位可不只是做样子！他的自信、他的举止……全都是他挣来的。不管人有多希望事实并非如此！
And there's nothing he loves more than to exert his influence over those beneath him. Which would be, ah... everybody?
而且他最爱的莫过于对底下的人施加影响力。也就是说，呃……所有人？
... If he has my family, then... it doesn't matter. I won't let him get in my way.
……如果他抓着我的家人，那……那都不重要。我不会让他挡我的路。
Ooh, frightening. Well, I've said my piece. The rest shall be up to you!
哦，好可怕。好了，我该说的都说了。剩下的就看你们了！
If you ever have need of us again, we'll have set up camp in the cave we first met. You remember the one, yes? Where I-
如果你们再需要我们，我们会在我们第一次见面的那个洞穴扎营。你们记得的，对吧？就是我——
Sui, I... I'm sorry for Mora. I hope you can... I hope you can save the others. I really do. Please... don't get yourself killed.
Sui，我……Mora 的事我很抱歉。我希望你能……我希望你能救出其他人。真的。拜托……别把自己的命搭进去。
...I- I'm not planning on it. Bye, Yusanu.
You shouldn't go in here just yet.
Halt! You cannot go down this cave, it is blocked.
站住！你不能下这个洞窟，它被封起来了。
Now, here's where you come in- I need you to clear out that cave route so we can use it once more! Good luck, soldier!
好，这就轮到你了——我需要你把那条洞窟路线清理干净，好让我们再次使用！祝你好运，士兵！
I can see the other side! Just a little bit more...
我看到另一边了！再一点点……
[!] Right-Click the gates of the cow pens to open them and free the cows!
[!] 右键点击牛栏的门把它们打开，放牛出来！
Go free those cows from the farmers before they're taken to the slaughterhouse! Oh man, the slaughterhouse...
趁那些牛被送去屠宰场之前，把它们从农夫手里解救出来！噢天哪，屠宰场……
Looks like you freed the cows successfully! You should return to Drale, before-
看来你顺利把牛放出来了！你该回去找 Drale，免得——
An intruder! What are you doing with my cows!? Guard golem! Attack!
有入侵者！你在对我的牛干什么！？守卫魔像，攻击！
You've defeated Bylvis' Guard Golem! You're in the clear now, and the cows are saved! You should return to Drale.
你打倒了 Bylvis 的守卫魔像！现在安全了，牛也得救了！你该回去找 Drale。
Hello again, friend! I'm here with the help! Cows, to me!
又见面了，朋友！我带帮手来了！牛儿们，过来！
You can... go on ahead. Tell whoever's on the other end that we succeeded. And while you do that, I'll be searching for a better career.
你可以……先走吧。告诉另一头的人我们成功了。我趁这时间去找份更好的工作。
Talk to Captain Fenor in front of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
与 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] {p} 前的 Fenor 队长对话。
Ah! You must be a new recruit! Well, I've got a mission for you.
啊！你一定是新兵！好，我有个任务给你。
There's an old cave behind me. It was used in the Corruption Wars...
我身后有个旧洞窟。在腐化战争时期用过……
We used it for quick and easy travel between {p} and {p}. It’s been abandoned for years.
我们用它在 {p} 和 {p} 之间快速方便地往来。它已经废弃好多年了。
This cave could prove to be very useful for future recruits who need to travel between {p} and {p}.
对以后需要在 {p} 和 {p} 之间往来的新兵来说，这个洞窟可能会非常有用。
Enter the cave behind Captain Fenor at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
进入 Fenor 队长身后 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的洞窟。
...Oh! Shoot, is it time to get to work already?
……噢！糟了，已经到上工时间了吗？
我猜你就是那个士兵吧？
Uh... well, to start, we'll need to clear that debris. Just... give it a shove, or something. That'll probably do it.
呃……嗯，首先，我们得清掉那堆碎石。就……推一下之类的。大概就行了。
Help Miner Linton remove the debris blocking the path.
协助矿工 Linton 清除挡路的碎石。
Pretty easy, huh? Hey, maybe you can just go on ahead, and do the rest yourself?
挺简单的吧？嘿，要不你直接往前走，剩下的自己搞定？
...Yeah, no, I should probably do my job. Let me grab my pickaxe, and we can keep going forward.
……好吧，不行，我大概还是该干好我的活。让我拿上镐子，我们继续往前走。
Clear the cave of possible roadblocks.
清除洞窟里可能的阻碍。
Oh, come on... Hey, soldier, do your job! Get rid of those monsters, would you?
噢，拜托……嘿，士兵，干好你的活！把那些怪物解决掉，行吗？
A cave-in? Really? More work for me... I'll make us a way through, just keep fighting those corrupteds!
塌方？真的假的？我又有活干了……我来开条路，你继续对付那些腐化者！
Halfway there... Ugh, I knew I should have brought explosives...
挖了一半了……呃，我就知道该带炸药来的……
There we go, I've made us a hole! Get over here, quickly!
好了，我挖出一个洞了！快过来！
...Oh, come on. You've got to be kidding me. Another cave-in? Really?
……哦，拜托。你一定是在开玩笑。又塌方了？真的假的？
And of course it's bigger than the last one. What's my pickaxe going to do against this thing?!
而且当然比上一次还大。我的镐子对这东西能有什么用？！
Really should have thought to bring explosives. Well, soldier, we tried our best! Nobody'll blame us if we give up now.
真该想到带炸药的。好吧，士兵，我们尽力了！现在放弃也不会有人怪我们的。
...What? Don't look at me like that. Fine, we can- huh? Do you hear that? Over there, to the right.
……干嘛？别那样看我。好吧，我们可以——嗯？你听到了吗？那边，右边。
Oh, uh... Hi... Well, this is a little awkward... I'll just... Go.
哦，呃……嗨……嗯，这有点尴尬……我就……走了。
...You know what? I'm not going to ask. As far as I'm concerned, that didn't happen.
……你知道吗？我不打算问。对我来说，刚才什么都没发生。
Right, of course you want to check it out. Fine! Go ahead. I'll just... sit here and twiddle my thumbs 'till you're back.
对，你当然想去看看。好吧！去吧。我就……坐在这里转着大拇指等你回来。
Investigate the small hole to the right of the large pile of debris.
调查大碎石堆右边的小洞。
Oh... Didn't expect you to follow me... Well, um... Hi! This will sound mad but...
哦……没想到你会跟过来……嗯，那个……嗨！这听起来很疯狂，但是……
I'm Drale, and I'm on a mission to free these cows from the enslavement of {p}.
我叫 Drale，我的使命是把这些牛从 {p} 的奴役中解救出来。
Those farmers stole those cows. They are sacred animals. Now they're about to turn them into steak! If you were to help me, maybe I could help you...
那些农夫偷了这些牛。它们是神圣的动物。现在他们要把它们做成牛排了！如果你帮我，也许我也能帮你……
Go free those innocent cows from enslavement! Qu-quickly! Before that farmer gets back...
去把那些无辜的牛从奴役中解救出来！快、快点！趁那个农夫回来之前……
Where are you going? Come here and talk to me first.
你要去哪？先过来跟我说话。
Free the cows without being seen by the farmer.
在不被农夫发现的情况下解救牛群。
Ah, good to see my cows are all in tip-top shape! Welp, time to- gah!
啊，很高兴看到我的牛都状态好极了！好了，该——啊！
Golem! No! That cost me thousands of emeralds!
魔像！不！那花了我好几千绿宝石！
Return to Drale about your success.
回到 Drale 那里报告你成功了。
Thank you so much, but we're not done yet. We need to get these cows out the province.
太谢谢你了，不过我们还没完。我们得把这些牛送出行省。
There's a small opening behind me. Go through it and help me get these cows on a raft to Gavel!
我身后有个小开口。穿过去，帮我把这些牛放上木筏送到 Gavel！
Help Drale push the raft with the cows out to sea.
帮 Drale 把载着牛的木筏推出海。
There's the raft! Help me push it for the cows!
木筏在那里！帮我把它推出去，为了这些牛！
And, that should do it! Be free, my friends! A new life awaits!
好了，这样应该就行了！自由吧，我的朋友们！新的生活在等着你们！
Again, thank you so much for what you have done this day. These cows deserve a better life than being farm animals.
再次非常感谢你今天所做的一切。这些牛值得过比当农场牲畜更好的生活。
...Oh! Right! You were busy with something before you came to help me, weren't you? Hm... I think I might be able to help you with that as well! Let's go back to the tunnel!
……噢！对了！你来帮我之前在忙别的事，对吧？嗯……我想我也许也能帮你那件事！我们回隧道吧！
Return to Miner Linton back in the abandoned cave.
回到废弃洞窟里的矿工 Linton 那里。
Oh, good, you're back. It's been, like, an hour! What were you even doing for that long!
噢，好，你回来了。都快一个小时了！你到底干嘛去了这么久！
...You helped some crazy cow-obsessed lunatic steal some cows? I don't think you're allowed to do that. There's a law against that, or something.
……你帮一个痴迷于牛的疯子偷了几头牛？我想你不能那样做吧。有法律禁止的之类的。
Eh. Not that I really care, either way. I've certainly done worse.
嗯。反正我也不在乎。我干过更糟的事。
Well then! Ready to call it quits? We're definitely not going to make any progress, so we might as we-
好吧！准备收工了吗？我们肯定不会有任何进展了，所以不如——
Since you helped me with my problem, I thought I should repay that favor by helping you!
既然你帮我解决了问题，我想我也该回报你，帮你一把！
Welp, see ya! Oh, and nice to meet you, miner! Now, let's get going my cows!
好啦，回头见！噢，很高兴认识你，矿工！好了，我们走吧，我的牛儿们！
...I- huh. You saw that too, right? I didn't just imagine that?
……我——嗯。你也看到了，对吧？不是我在幻想吧？
You know what? I think I quit. I think this has finally pushed me to my limit! I didn't know that I had one, but apparently I do!
你知道吗？我想我不干了。我想这件事终于把我逼到极限了！我原本不知道我有极限，但看来是有的！
Speak to Sergeant Klafson next to the {p} entrance of the cave.
与洞窟 {p} 入口旁的 Klafson 中士交谈。
Recruit, Captain Fenor told me to meet you here, said if you came out on this side of that tunnel then you completed your mission!
新兵，Fenor 队长叫我在这里等你，说如果你从隧道这一头出来，就代表你完成任务了！
You did a great deed today, soldier! We can now use this cave to travel easily between {p} and {p}! Great job!
你今天立了大功，士兵！现在我们可以用这个洞窟在 {p} 和 {p} 之间轻松往来了！干得好！
Where is the [Breathing Helmet I] I asked you for?
我请你带的 [呼吸头盔 I] 呢？
Your best bet is to go to the woodcutting camp northwest of {p}, there should be some bait there. Just catch it in the river by the dock when you get it.
你最好去 {p} 西北边的伐木营地，那里应该有些鱼饵。拿到之后，就在码头边的河里把它钓上来。
I know you might need the pufferfish for something else, but please think about giving it to me. It would warm my heart.
我知道你可能要拿那条河豚去做别的事，但请考虑把它给我。那会让我心里很温暖。
I wonder how Strato made that bait...
不知道 Strato 是怎么做出那种鱼饵的……
I'm having trouble with the fish in our lake recently and I am sure the problem lies within the lake itself.
我们湖里的鱼最近出了问题，我敢肯定问题就出在湖里。

I would like to commission you to investigate, but since it's freezing cold in our lake you need something to protect you. I heard the people in {p} on the coast of Wynn have something that can help you.
我想委托你去调查，不过我们的湖冷得要命，你需要东西保护自己。我听说 Wynn 海岸边 {p} 的人有能帮上你的东西。
Would you mind coming back with a [Breathing Helmet I]? I think that should be everything you need.
你能不能带一顶 [呼吸头盔 I] 回来？我想那样就够了。
Return to {p} and bring Fredris a [Breathing Helmet I]
回到 {p}，给 Fredris 带一顶 [呼吸头盔 I]
What is this thing supposed to be? You know, I would really appreciate your help, but this [Breathing Helmet I] does not look like it's going to keep you protected.
这东西是干嘛的？你知道吗，我很感激你的帮忙，可这顶 [呼吸头盔 I] 看起来根本保护不了你。
Would you mind heading to our local armour merchant and buying one of our [Breathing Helmet II]? I don't want you to drown. Just come back with the helmet and I will tell you about my problem.
你能不能去我们本地的护甲商人那里买一顶 [呼吸头盔 II]？我不想你淹死。把头盔带回来，我再跟你讲我的问题。
Buy a [Breathing Helmet II] and find the underwater cave
购买 [呼吸头盔 II]，找到水下洞窟
Explore the cave underneath the frozen lake in {p}
探索 {p} 冰湖下方的洞窟
Who are you? You don't look like one of those villagers we stole the fi... Wait, they didn't send you to retrieve "their" fish, did they?
你是谁？你看起来不像被我们偷了鱼的那些村——等等，他们该不会是派你来拿回“他们的”鱼吧？
For years we let them share the lake with us, the actual inhabitants of it, we were modest and took what we needed, we let them catch the rest. But then they went too far, they caught too much.
这么多年来，我们这些湖真正的居民一直让他们跟我们共享这片湖，我们很克制，只取需要的，剩下的都让他们钓。可是后来他们太过分了，钓得太多。
We didn't have enough to eat, we were forced to steal their fish, we would have starved otherwise. And now they want their fish, our fish back? We can't do that, I hope you understand.
我们不够吃，只好偷他们的鱼，不然就会饿死。现在他们想要回他们的鱼，我们的鱼？我们办不到，希望你能理解。
If you want to help us and the villagers, just follow the stream that flows into this lake to the south, you will find the best fishing ground there. The pufferfish should be around there too.
如果你想帮我们和村民，就沿着流进这片湖的溪流往南走，你会在那里找到最好的钓鱼点。河豚应该也在那附近。
Follow the river south to find the fishing dock
沿着河往南走，找到钓鱼码头
Oh you look a bit lost, let me help you, I've lived here for a long time, I know every corner and every snowflake.
哦，你看起来有点迷路，我来帮你吧，我在这里住了很久，每个角落、每片雪花我都知道。
Sadly Strato is no longer alive. He used to work and live at the woodcutting camp northwest of {p}. We always met here, caught fish and told each other stories. I really miss those times...
可惜 Strato 已经不在了。他以前在 {p} 西北边的伐木营地工作、生活。我们总是在这里见面，一起钓鱼、讲故事。我真怀念那段日子……

Can I ask you something? As you might see I'm not the richest guy, or the youngest. If you manage to catch that fish, could you hand it over? I know we just met but you seem like somebody who would help an old man.
我能问你一件事吗？你也看得出来，我不是什么有钱人，也不年轻了。如果你钓到那条鱼，能不能交给我？我知道我们才刚认识，但你看起来是会帮老人家的人。
Obtain the bait at the woodcutting camp northwest of {p}, use it to catch the fish and then give it to Calamaro or Gernald
在 {p} 西北边的伐木营地取得鱼饵，用它钓到那条鱼，然后交给 Calamaro 或 Gernald
Just look at those fish, I told you they love this bait.
你看那些鱼，我就说它们爱这种鱼饵。
There it comes, the [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish], I can't believe it!
来了，[神话永恒河豚]，真不敢相信！

You found a pufferfish! Who would have thought such a small thing could solve our problem. I will start bringing back the fish immediately, but first we will have a nice hot soup. Please take this as payback for your services.
你找到河豚了！谁想得到这么小的东西就能解决我们的问题。我马上就开始把鱼还回去，不过我们先喝碗热汤。请收下这个，当作你帮忙的回报。
You can trade it at the shop right over there, it's hard to miss. I will give you a last advise, you don't want to eat that slimy fish.
你可以在那边的商店交易它，很好找。最后给你个忠告，你可不会想吃那条黏糊糊的鱼。
Meet up with Fredris in {p} and claim your reward
到 {p} 与 Fredris 会合，领取奖励
Oh you are done with whatever you were doing? I heard you ran around the whole place, I don't know if you were the right person to ask for help...
噢，你忙完你那些事了？听说你把整个地方跑了个遍，我都不知道找你帮忙是不是找对人了……
I will just ask the next one who comes around, no need to have you run around all day. Take this, I appreciate your effort.
我还是问下一个路过的人吧，没必要让你跑一整天。拿着这个，谢谢你的努力。
A real disaster! I can't believe this is happening to me!
真是场灾难！真不敢相信这种事会落到我头上！
I've been fishing for the last few days and I caught nothing! Zilch! This isn't normal!
我这几天一直在钓鱼，结果什么都没钓到！一条都没有！这不正常！
I spent my entire life fishing in this area! I wish I could dive under this ice to fix the problem myself...
我这辈子都在这一带钓鱼！真希望我能潜到冰下面自己去解决问题……
Do you think you could help me? You might actually be exactly what I need!
你觉得你能帮我吗？你说不定正是我需要的人！
Enter my shack, there you will find the entrance... Good luck!
进我的小屋，你会在那里找到入口……祝你好运！
Explore under the ice to find a cause to the fish problem. You'll need the Breathing Helmet for this.
探索冰下，找出鱼出问题的原因。你需要戴上呼吸头盔。
Talk to Squidward in the Squid Village.
与乌贼村的 Squidward 对话。
Have I seen any fish? No, of course not! I don't even know what a fish looks like!
我有没有见过鱼？没有，当然没有！我连鱼长什么样都不知道！
Who could be stealing all those fish? I wonder! Actually...
到底会是谁在偷那些鱼呢？我也好奇！其实……
I'm sure Calamaro did it! He's just that kind of guy. He lives in that house down there.
我敢肯定是 Calamaro 干的！他就是那种人。他住在下面那栋房子里。
Find Calamaro in the Squid Village.
Me? Stealing fish? You are out of your mind! It's obviously Kroken who is stealing them!
我？偷鱼？你疯了吧！明明是 Kroken 在偷！
He lives right on top of that waterfall right there, if you want to go talk to him.
他就住在那边瀑布的顶上，你想的话可以去跟他谈谈。
Find Kroken in the Squid Village.
Do I look like someone who steals fish?
我看起来像会偷鱼的人吗？
It's obvious that Squidward did it, he has tons of crates full of fish!
明显是 Squidward 干的，他有好几箱满满的鱼！
Okay, okay, fine! It was me all along... I know, what a shock, right?
好啦，好啦，行！从头到尾都是我……我知道，很震惊吧？
Okay, I got a proposition for you. Bring me [{~} Raw Fish] and I will stop, deal?
好，我给你个提议。给我带来 [{~} 生鱼]，我就收手，成交？
Bring back {~} Raw Fish to Squidward.
把 {~} 条生鱼带回给 Squidward。
You can trust me, I won't touch the fish in the frozen lake anymore!
你可以相信我，我不会再碰冰湖里的鱼了！
Talk to Fredris to collect your reward.
与 Fredris 对话，领取奖励。
Your story really doesn't make sense. Villagers living in a squid village under the lake? Pff!
你的故事根本说不通。村民住在湖底下的乌贼村里？呸！
However, if you can garantee me that my problem is gone, I'll trust you.
不过，如果你能保证我的问题解决了，我就相信你。
Thank you for your help. Here, take these...
谢谢你的帮忙。给，拿着这些……
Have you found the issue yet? I'm still waiting!
你找到问题出在哪了吗？我还在等着呢！
Have you seen that weird structure near the lake? I heard quite a lot of stories about it, but nobody is sure about what you can find there.
你见过湖边那座奇怪的建筑吗？我听过不少关于它的传闻，但没人说得准那里到底有什么。
However we don't have to fight over the fish in the lake, we just need a [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish], that would be enough, nothing else. We never wanted to steal the fish.
不过，我们不必为了湖里的鱼争吵，我们只需要一条 [神话永恒河豚]，这样就够了，别的都不要。我们从来就不想偷鱼。

You're searching a [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish]? Hmm I heard that name before, my friend, Strato, told me about it years ago. If I remember correctly it is infinite, you can feed every single person in all the provinces from this single fish.
你在找 [神话永恒河豚]？嗯，我听过这个名字，是我朋友 Strato 几年前告诉我的。如果我没记错，它是无穷无尽的，光这一条鱼就能喂饱所有行省的每一个人。
Maybe you can find some sort of bait there, he had some of the best bait I have ever seen. You should be able to acquire some and throw it in the water, maybe that will attract the pufferfish.
也许你能在那里找到某种鱼饵，他有我见过最好的鱼饵。你应该能弄到一些，扔进水里，也许就能把河豚引来。
You decided to give me the fish? I wish Strato was still around, he would be so amazed. I can't show you how much this means to me, but take this little gift please, promise me to never change.
你决定把鱼给我？真希望 Strato 还在，他一定会很惊讶。我没办法表达这对我有多重要，不过请收下这份小礼物，答应我，永远别改变。
I wish we could have avoided this whole scenario.
真希望我们当初能避免这一切。
Investigate the river settlement's water troubles at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
调查 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 河边聚落的缺水问题。
Oho, now that's some dress I've not seen in many a moon! You're one of those {p} folk, aren't ya? Quite some luxury ya must've lived with.
哦嚯，这身打扮我可好多年没见过了！你是 {p} 那边的人吧？你一定过惯了奢华的日子。
's a bit more humble down here in the shadow of the dam. Surprised someone like you would take the trip, but it ain't a complaint. Getting about to see the world is a fine endeavor!
在这水坝的阴影底下，日子可就朴素多了。没想到像你这样的人会跑这一趟，不过我可没在抱怨。出去见见世面是件好事！

Unfortunately, the bar here's dry. Sure, I got alcohol, but you drink that, and you'll be passing more water than ya took in. Dries you right out, and right now we haven't got any water to spare. Dangerous, y'know?
可惜，这里的酒吧干了。当然，我有酒，但你喝了那个，排出去的水会比喝进去的还多。整个人都会被抽干，而我们现在一滴多余的水都没有。很危险的，懂吗？
The dam opens up every month or so to let out some water for us, but it passes through a noble manor, past the hill, rationed out to the rest of the forest.
水坝大约每个月开一次，放些水给我们，可是水会先流过山丘另一边的一座贵族庄园，再配给到森林的其他地方。
It's so little though, nowadays. The children are going thirsty. The muck in the riverbeds is more mud than water- so even if ya boil it out like I do, what you get is foul trifles.
可是现在给的太少了。孩子们都在挨渴。河床里的烂泥多半是泥巴不是水——所以就算像我这样把它煮开，得到的也只是一点脏东西。
Didn't used to be like this, though. Ain't sure what's changed, but I'm just an old geezer. I've lived my life enough- it's what it's doing to the kids that has me worried. ...say, stranger.
以前可不是这样。不确定是哪里变了，不过我只是个老头子。这辈子我也活够了——让我担心的是这对孩子们造成的影响。……喂，陌生人。
If you're touring about here, you'll probably see the manor soon enough. If ya could get them to spare us some more water a while, I'll give ya a discount! How's about it?
如果你在这一带游览，应该很快就会看到那座庄园。要是你能说服他们暂时多给我们一点水，我就给你打折！怎么样？
Ain't quite sure how you would go about convincing the nobles to let out more water for us, I admit. If I did, I'd take the trek up the hill myself- even in spite of my creaky ol' back.
我承认，我也不太确定你要怎么说服那些贵族多放点水给我们。要是我知道，就算我这把老骨头嘎吱作响，我也会自己爬上山去。
Even if it's just getting them to put a word in to the Sovereign. I imagine that come-lately Zhiraok would do something about it all. I swear that man doesn't know what sleep is...
哪怕只是让他们跟统领说句话也好。我想那个新上任的 Zhiraok 会处理这一切的。我发誓那个人根本不知道睡觉是什么……
I can appreciate a young'un with some spark in their eyes, but he needs to learn to slow down! What's that saying about the brightest candle burning twice as fast?
我欣赏眼里有光的年轻人，但他得学会慢下来！那句话怎么说的来着，烧得最亮的蜡烛烧得最快？
Oh, my! Who are you? In such fantastical equipment! Certainly not a guard- I've never seen anything like it! Oh me, oh my...
哦，天啊！你是谁？穿着这么奇特的装备！肯定不是守卫——我从没见过这样的东西！哦，天哪，天哪……
Unless... Are you, perhaps...I have heard whispers on the wind of a new Sovereign? I have seen our Sovereign dress rather differently, so maybe-
除非……你该不会是……我听到风里传来的低语，说有新的统领？我见过我们统领的打扮，也挺与众不同的，所以说不定——
No? You aren't? Hm! Well, be that as it may, I do wish I could welcome you more hospitably, stranger, but we are in the lean time of the month- the leanest I have seen.
