Isn't that the human who won the scavenger hunt?
那不是赢了寻宝游戏的那个人类吗？
Hey there friend! Looking teh barter fer some weapons or trinkets?
嘿，朋友！想换点武器或小玩意儿不？
Scum! That guy jus' stole a necklace! Catch 'im and jus' take this as payment!!
混蛋！那家伙刚偷了一条项链！去把他抓住，这个就当报酬拿去！！
You read an entry in the worn journal...
你读了这本破旧日记里的一篇记录……
A stranger came into town today all the way from {p}. {p} of all places! What do the folk there want with us in this small town?
今天镇上来了个陌生人，大老远从 {p} 来的。偏偏是 {p}！那里的人找我们这种小镇要干什么？
It's nothing but farmland for as far as the eye can see around here. I want some excitement! I want to go to {p} and see the castle there!
这一带放眼望去全是农田。我想要点刺激！我想去 {p} 看看那里的城堡！
Who knows, maybe this'll all blow over soon...
谁知道呢，说不定这一切很快就会过去……
Sir Theorick, if you, um...if you have a moment? Your tribute is here...
Theorick 大人，请问您，呃……您方便一下吗？您的贡品到了……
...good. Thank you. Good to see some who honestly respect what I'm trying to do for all of you. Was there anyone else?
……很好。谢谢。看到还有人真心敬重我为你们所做的事，我很欣慰。还有其他人吗？
Ah...no. There...there wasn't. Not this time. They feel like you're taking too much from them, which I don't agree with, but-
啊……没有。这次……这次没有了。他们觉得您跟他们拿得太多了，我并不认同这种说法，可是——
...ask them, if they would prefer their money, or their lives. Am I not protecting them? Is it really so much to ask that I get something in return?
……去问问他们，是要钱，还是要命。难道我没在保护他们吗？我要求一点回报，真的过分到这种地步吗？
We...we know. We told them that, too...we're sorry.
我们……我们知道。这些话我们也跟他们说过了……很抱歉。
You aren't the ones who need to apologize! I'm aware it's a voluntary contribution, but do they have any idea how difficult it is to cast magic like this regularly?!
该道歉的不是你们！我知道那是自愿捐献，但他们知不知道，要定期施展这种魔法有多困难？！
Howdy feller! This here is my cactus stand.
你好啊，老兄！这就是我的仙人掌摊。
I travel all across the desert, cutting down cactus for the juice!
我跑遍整片沙漠，砍仙人掌来榨汁！
Only the sharpest blades'll cut these cactus though. My collection's out back. You can look, but don't touch!
不过只有最锋利的刀才砍得动这些仙人掌。我的收藏放在后面。可以看，但不许碰！
The telescope is pointed towards {p}... Wait. You spot something glimmering in the tree trunk.
望远镜对着 {p}……等等。你看到树干里有东西在闪。
I regret to inform you that the girl has indeed perished, despite our best efforts.
我遗憾地通知您，尽管我们竭尽全力，那个女孩确实已经去世了。
We have tried all the emergency plans, but none have worked so far.
我们所有的紧急方案都试过了，但到目前为止全都没用。
Not even the potion that Lanis suggested did anything... We are truly lost.
连 Lanis 建议的那种药水也毫无作用……我们真的走投无路了。
The Talor folk have been spotted patrolling the entire forest. There are no other possible explanations!
有人看到 Talor 家的人在整座森林里巡逻。不可能有别的解释！
We must come up with a new plan, or else--
我们必须想出新的计划，否则——
The rest of the letter has been ripped off.
信的其余部分被撕掉了。
No matter, it can be sorted ou-
I only serve customers with something to show me.
我只招待拿得出东西给我看的客人。
There's an inscription, but it's written in a language you can't understand.
上面有一段铭文，但写的是你看不懂的语言。
"They have taken the forest. The last barrier between them and {p} is us."
“他们拿下了森林。挡在他们和 {p} 之间的最后一道屏障就是我们。”
"We must fortify. Put those fires out!"
“我们必须加固防御。把那些火扑灭！”
"If we lose tree cover, we lose the war."
“失去树林的掩护，我们就输掉这场战争了。”
May the woman who died here in tonight's raid rest in peace. Though we did not know her name, her memory will live on through her son.
愿今夜这场突袭中死在这里的女子安息。虽然我们不知道她的名字，但她的儿子会让她永远被铭记。
Aha! So you can crack my defenses...then let me see what you are made of up close, Wynn warrior.
啊哈！原来你能突破我的防御……那就让我近距离看看你有几斤几两吧，Wynn 的战士。
There have been scarce few to push me to this point... I will not stop, however. You have not won yet, Wynn warrior!
能把我逼到这一步的人寥寥无几……但我不会就此停手。你还没赢呢，Wynn 的战士！
My pulse... Your brilliance is blinding- Your power so much more than I expected.
我的脉动……你的光辉耀眼得令人目盲——你的力量远远超出了我的预料。
Maybe we haven't! But that's quite alright. The Seer was very specific with his instructions, as always.
也许没见过吧！不过那完全没关系。先知的指示一如既往地非常具体。
In any case, you asked who we are? We're... shall we say, a group of individuals interested in the continued wellbeing of this realm!
总之，你问我们是谁？我们是……这么说吧，一群关心这个世界能否长治久安的人！
Exactly! And, so, we need your help. The Guide here can point you towards the stragglers and escapees, if you speak to them.
正是如此！所以，我们需要你的帮忙。跟这位向导谈谈，就能得知迷途者与逃亡者的所在。
...You return. Again. Are you prepared for the task of the Guiding this time?
……你又回来了。这次你准备好接下引渡的任务了吗？
You have heard from those Beyond. Let their words guide you.
你已经听过彼界的声音了。让它们的话语指引你吧。
Find the lost soul, and guide it here. I will return it to its proper place.
找到那个失落之魂，把它引渡到这里来。我会把它送回它该去的地方。
...No matter. The reward is yours, when you would wish it. You will help us guide these wayward spirits home. Speak to me when you would like to continue.
……无妨。奖励随时都是你的。你会帮我们把这些迷途的亡魂引渡回家。想继续的时候再来找我。
...I was in their position, once. I do not wish for a repeat of what happens if they are not returned.
……我也曾经跟它们处境相同。我不希望它们回不去时会发生的事再次重演。
Hm... I see. Disappointing, but you know where to come when you're ready, don't you?
嗯……我懂了。有点失望，不过等你准备好了，你知道该来哪里找我，对吧？
Ah, alright then. Sorry, you reminded me of someone who helped me one time.
啊，这样啊。抱歉，你让我想起以前帮过我的某个人。
Who did you mistake me for?
Oh, just a human who came to my aid when I was down near {p} a while back.
哦，只是前阵子我在 {p} 附近落难时，出手帮了我的一个人类。
You see, that pumpkin mask in the case there is haunted, and I was transporting it, and it escaped!
你看，那边箱子里的南瓜面具在闹鬼，我在运送它的时候，它居然逃走了！
Fled into some old corrupted mine. Bet it thought it could escape me there.
它逃进了一座腐化的旧矿坑。我猜它以为躲在那里就能甩掉我。
Anyway, some human came along. A {p} soldier like yourself, actually. They retrieved the mask from the cave for me.
总之，后来有个人类路过。其实就是跟你一样的 {p} 士兵。那个人替我把面具从洞窟里拿了回来。
This macabre old mask did a great job at masquerading as a regular old antique, but now I know its secrets. Unfortunately it's still extremely burdensome to take care of...
这个阴森的老面具把自己伪装成普通古董，装得可真像，但现在我已经知道它的秘密了。可惜照顾它还是非常累人……
I really hope I can find someone here who can take it off my hands...
真希望能在这里找到人把它接手过去……
Ah, you mean that strange fellow on the tree stump over there, right?
啊，你是说那边树桩上那个怪家伙，对吧？
He's quite an ominous guy, but I don't mind him.
他是个挺不祥的家伙，不过我不介意。
In fact, his two friends also seem like nice folk. They were very happy to let me set up shop here.
其实他那两个朋友看起来也都是好人。他们很乐意让我在这里摆摊。
Can't say I completely understand what they're doing, but I'm not complaining about this perfect sales opportunity!
我不敢说完全懂他们在做什么，但这么好的赚钱机会，我可没什么好抱怨的！
However, I've also decided to throw in this Haunted Mask. You wouldn't know about it, so all you need to know is that it's very hostile and likes to escape.
不过，我也决定把这个闹鬼面具一起拿出来。你不会知道它的来历，所以你只需要知道，它非常凶，而且很爱逃跑。
Oh- hello! Sorry, was just... lost in thought.
哦——你好！抱歉，我刚刚只是……想事情想得出神了。
I'm thinking through a problem, right now... Do you mind coming back later?
我现在正在想一个问题……你介意晚点再来吗？
You will need to enter the mine and get the cobblestone to fix Kroac's house...
你得进入矿坑，取得圆石来修好 Kroac 的房子……
I have written the coordinates of the cave Krolton hides in, in your content book.
我已经把 Krolton 藏身的洞穴坐标写进你的内容手册里了。
Urrugh... My legs... they feel like they've been stretched... Am I taller?
呃啊……我的腿……感觉像被拉长了一样……我是不是长高了？
Then let us commune with those Beyond, once more.
那么，让我们再一次与彼界的亡魂沟通吧。
Well, I went safely back to my homeland, and continued selling masks there.
嗯，我平安回到了故乡，继续在那里卖面具。
Not much to say besides that, except the fact that taking care of this Haunted Mask became tiresome.
除此之外也没什么好说的，只是照顾这个闹鬼面具实在让人累坏了。
I came back to Wynn to acquire some more antique masks from my associate, and, to my surprise, a spooky festival was on!
我回到 Wynn，想从我的合伙人那里再进一些古董面具，结果没想到，这里正在办一场阴森森的节庆！
Perfect chance for me to sell some masks, and get rid of this Haunted Mask, so I stopped by!
正是卖面具、顺便甩掉这个闹鬼面具的好机会，所以我就过来了！
So, how have your travels been? You look like you've traveled the whole world. I can feel your power even from here!
那么，你的旅途怎么样？你看起来像是走遍了全世界。我在这儿都能感受到你的力量！
Well, suit yourself. I think I'll have one, myself.
好吧，随你。我想我自己来一杯。
We can't leave each other behind. {u}, keep moving!
我们不能丢下彼此。{u}，继续前进！
You need to go through void holes to see if you can get across these spikes.
你得穿过虚空洞，看看能不能越过这些尖刺。
Eugh. Weren't you listening before? I have no time for these games- oh, no matter, I don't care which is which.
呃。你之前没在听吗？我没空陪你玩这些游戏——噢，算了，哪个是哪个我才不在乎。
Scaling the dam would be too risky...
Oi! There's no way you're getting through without a passport!
喂！没有护照你别想过去！
It happened again. The challenger was crushed.
又发生了。挑战者被压扁了。
And what is different about it this time that is so important? There are many hopefuls who are defeated, are there not?
这次又有什么不同，值得这么大惊小怪？落败的挑战者多的是，不是吗？
I mean crushed. Literally. It shook the room apart, and the challenger died from falling rubble.
我是说压扁了。字面意义上的。整个房间都被震塌了，挑战者被掉下来的碎石砸死了。
...surely you jest. Is the Hive not reinforced to resist the powers of its creatures?
……你一定是在开玩笑。蜂巢不是经过加固，足以承受里面那些生物的力量吗？
This one's different. It's so violent that it's caused its own room to cave in more than once.
这只不一样。它狂暴到已经不止一次把自己的房间弄塌了。
And it survives still? ...Somehow or another, that is impressive. But we must go in?
而它居然还活着？……不管怎么说，那倒挺了不起的。可是我们非得进去不可吗？
And clear out the rubble. The morphs have already repaired the walls, we just have to clear the space.
还得把碎石清掉。异变体已经把墙修好了，我们只需要把空间清出来。
I should hope the beast is restrained, then, else we too will be bloody smears.
那我可真希望那头野兽被拴好了，不然我们也会变成一摊血渍。
I almost had it, I almost had it!! Ugh, I never want to see a drop of water again!!
就差一点，就差一点了！！呃，我这辈子都不想再看到一滴水了！！
I withstood the whirlpools it trapped me in... I dealt with the walls of water...
它把我困在漩涡里，我撑过来了……水墙我也应付过去了……
Was it really just distracted the whole time, or was I being toyed with?
它是真的一直都在分心，还是我被它耍着玩？
That deluge at the end... How is anyone supposed to withstand that?
最后那场洪水……谁能撑得住啊？
Back to {p} with me. Maybe the sun will dry out my clothes after a month or two.
我要回 {p} 了。也许晒个一两个月的太阳，我的衣服就干了。
These distractions belie my true power. Behold, and kneel before the law of the Hive!
这些花招掩盖了我真正的力量。看好了，跪倒在蜂巢的法则之下吧！
You have decent skill, I will admit. But the seas will claim all!
我承认，你的身手还算不错。但大海终将吞没一切！
The ocean winds shall claim you in this bout.
这一回合，海风将会吞没你。
...it counterattacks. I didn't think it would counterattack.
……它会反击。我没想到它会反击。
It really was just the worst matchup. I couldn't exactly direct my totem to NOT hit it!
这真的是最糟糕的组合了。我又不能叫我的图腾“别”打它！
The faster you damage it the more it attacks. You are about to try too, yes?
你伤害它越快，它攻击得就越凶。你也要去试试，对吧？
Still. I must nearly have defeated it. That Oceanic Judge seemed to have more endurance than it.
不过，我应该差一点就打败它了。那个海洋审判者的耐力好像比它还强。
Strange, but I suppose the division leader here simply focuses more on offense than defense.
真奇怪，不过我想这里的分部首领只是更重视进攻而不是防守吧。
Now, ehm... I must try and find some soothing balms for my skin...
那么，呃……我得去找些舒缓的药膏来擦擦皮肤……
Now, you will burn away before me.
现在，你将在我面前燃烧殆尽。
Hm. It seems I will need to pick up the pace.
嗯。看来我得加快节奏了。
You fight well. We shall see if you can adapt to this.
你打得不错。我们来看看你能不能适应这个。
Many have made it this far. None have succeeded- not against me.
走到这一步的人很多。但没有一个成功过——没有一个打得过我。
I must admit my pleasure seeing you last this long- It is a refreshing change of pace.
我得承认，看到你撑了这么久，我很高兴——这可真是换了个新鲜的节奏。
Do not presume I am limited to merely one trick. My knowledge surpasses the barriers of reality itself.
别以为我只有一招。我的知识超越了现实本身的屏障。
Oh? You look surprised! Is it a wonder that the creator may be able to use powers of those she has created?
噢？你看起来很惊讶！造物主能使用她所创造之物的力量，有什么好奇怪的？
But all things can be improved. Everything can be iterated upon and made stronger... And that includes you.
但一切都可以改进。任何东西都能一再迭代、变得更强……这也包括你。
Practice, rigorous training, magical equipment... And have you not gained all of these from my glorious Hive?
练习、严格的训练、魔法装备……这些你不都是从我辉煌的蜂巢里得到的吗？
The guards here are only trained in combat, not in solving mysteries. That's why the mayor called you!
这里的守卫只受过战斗训练，不会破解谜团。所以镇长才找你来！
If you have any questions, go to the waiting room and wait for your turn, not run into my office willy-nilly! You'd have to be level {~} for that luxury.
有问题的话就去等候室排队等着，别冒冒失失地冲进我的办公室！你得有 {~} 级才能享受这种待遇。
Check the Eastern Exit! I'm pretty sure that's where the hooded person keeps returning to.
去查查东边的出口！我很确定那个戴兜帽的人一直回到那里。
他爬上了那座塔、塔……快去！
Let's keep what happened here a secret, okay?
这里发生的事，我们就保密吧，好吗？
{p} and its citizens are thankful for your service. The line between Human and Villager remains firmly in place... For the most part.
{p} 和它的市民都感谢你的付出。人类与村民之间的界线依然牢牢守住了……大致上是这样。
Whatever this thing is, it's broken. Probably best to leave it be for now.
不管这东西是什么，它坏了。现在大概最好别去动它。
They appear to be asleep... Might be worth checking back later. Perhaps you could explore the path further...
它们好像睡着了……也许晚点再回来看看。或许你可以再往前探索这条路……
又见面了。改变主意了吗？
Welcome back. What do you need?
Anything else you would like to know?
You'll need to fix the broken transporter yourself. Maybe you can make something in the workshop?
坏掉的传送机得你自己修。也许你可以在工坊里做点什么出来？
This looks like it'd break if you punched it hard enough.
这东西看起来用力揍一拳就会坏。
>Bring the keys to where madman dwells.
Welcome to my wonderful wooden home!
欢迎来到我美妙的木头小屋！
You are welcome here as long as you don't have any mushrooms or chickens.
只要你身上没有蘑菇或鸡，这里就欢迎你。
I hate those things. Just my home and me.
我讨厌那些东西。只要我的家和我就好。
Hey there! What's this, you ask? Only the latest in a long line of ingenious Dwarven developments, now available to the public!
你好啊！你问这是什么？这可是一长串天才矮人发明里的最新一项，现在开放给大众使用了！

With this right here machine, you can refine the Smouldering Chunks you get from the trees around the {p} into several ingredients. Unfortunately, the Refinery Merchant still has exclusive rights to those odd metal lumps...
有了这台机器，你就能把从 {p} 一带的树上得到的阴燃碎块精炼成好几种材料。可惜那些奇怪的金属块，至今还是由精炼商人独家经营……
Ah, anyways! For the low price of [{~} Emerald Blocks], you'll be able to use the refinery any time you want! Whaddaya say?
啊，总之！只要 [{~} 绿宝石块] 的低价，你就能随时使用这台精炼机！你觉得怎么样？
Ah well, that's okay. Feel free to come back any time though. The offer still stands.
啊好吧，没关系。不过随时欢迎你回来。这个提议一直有效。
I saw some {p} soldiers come by earlier.
我早些时候看到有些 {p} 的士兵经过。
I hope there's not another conflict on the horizon...
希望不会又有一场冲突要来了……
She tugged you right back in with sheer force.
她硬生生地把你拽了回来。
This is filled with water. There're no clothes inside though.
里面装满了水。不过没有衣服。
It has random clothes, but no real outfit.
里面有些零散的衣服，但没有像样的整套服装。
It's empty. You already found this chest.
里面是空的。你已经找过这个箱子了。
You should show your newfound letter to Ava!
你该把新拿到的信给 Ava 看看！
迷你任务开始: 猎杀骷髅
Thankful human try help, but how even get into fort? Serepe should stopped...
感谢人类想帮忙，可是到底怎么进堡垒？Serepe 早该阻止……
...hmh. Onluk take inside. Makes sense now. She like Onluk. Like Onluk MUCH.
……哼嗯。Onluk 带进去。现在说得通了。她喜欢 Onluk。很喜欢 Onluk。
Like look at Onluk, like talk Onluk, never hit Onluk...
会看 Onluk，会跟 Onluk 说话，从不打 Onluk……
...wonder if villager know about death machine. Not machine that make death, machine that run on death.
……不知道村民知不知道死亡机器。不是制造死亡的机器，是靠死亡运转的机器。
Bury parts for them. Not right to use tainted metal for things.
替他们把零件埋了。用沾了污秽的金属做东西不对。
Tough human, to survive four-way attack. Or maybe just tough armour. Gaudy, bulky armour...
人类很强壮，能撑过四面夹攻。也可能只是盔甲强壮。花哨、笨重的盔甲……
For tough human, will tell something that villager and human not know.
看在人类强壮的分上，告诉人类一件村民和人类都不知道的事。
All skulls on pikes outside, at other camp, not villager skull. Not human skull. Orc skull.
外面、另一个营地那些插在长矛上的头骨，不是村民头骨。不是人类头骨。是兽人头骨。
Show people who attack the cost of it. Show those who were killed as reminder. Not escape consequences.
让来攻击的人看到代价。让被杀的人成为警示。不能逃过后果。
...human trying now, but Ismikku see many things. Know human contributed many skulls to pikes. We watching you.
……人类现在在努力，可是 Ismikku 看过很多事。知道人类往长矛上添了很多头骨。我们看着你。
Bah... Kreimu worry too much. Will be fine now.
哼……Kreimu 担心太多。现在没事了。
...did not expect see good human in lifetime.
……这辈子没想到会见到好人类。
Armour still look gaudy though. Should wear orc leathers if want match style.
不过盔甲还是看起来很花哨。想配风格就该穿兽人皮甲。
What's a man gotta do to get some sleep around here?! I take a doze in this secluded corner, and I wake up to this racket!? Quiet down!
在这里想好好睡个觉到底要怎样啊？！我在这个偏僻角落打个盹，醒来就听到这阵吵闹！？安静点！
AHHHH!! OH! I'M FREE!!! I think those slimes have some sort of numbing agent in them, I can finally feel again! And I've got a migraine!
啊啊啊啊！！哦！我自由了！！！那些史莱姆身上好像有某种麻醉的东西，我终于又有感觉了！然后我偏头痛发作了！
Hey, get away from that! What are you even doing down here?!
喂，离那东西远点！你跑到这下面来到底想干嘛？！
Oh-ho! And look who we 'ave 'ere. A lone soldier steppin' on our turf.
哦嚯！瞧瞧这是谁来了。一个落单的小兵，竟敢踩到咱们的地盘上。
Why don'tcha come closer and let me get a good look at'cha, huh!?
干嘛不走近点，让咱好好瞧瞧你，啊？！
Gentle winds seem to congeal here. With a little help they might become useful.
轻柔的风似乎在这里凝聚。稍加帮助，它们或许就能派上用场。
You can come back at any time.
To enter the enclosure, you must complete The Canyon Guides
要进入围场，你必须完成峡谷向导
If it weren't for the dying part, getting dissolved in these guys isn't so bad. It's like a massage, my back feels good as new!
要不是会死掉，被这些家伙溶解其实也没那么糟。就像在按摩一样，我的背舒服得跟新的一样！
Hey! What's the big idea? I was enjoying that! Jerk...
喂！你搞什么啊？我正享受着呢！讨厌鬼……
CANNOT EXIT OPERATION AREA. RETURNING TO POST.
无法离开作业区域。返回岗位。
Hey {u}! Come back to me when you are level {~}, we have a lot to do!
嘿，{u}！等你到 {~} 级再来找我，我们有很多事要做！
Hey there! Seems like you are now Combat Lv. {~}! You can't start a raid before you've joined our Raiding Division at the {p}!
嘿！看来你现在已经是战斗等级 {~} 了！你得先到 {p} 加入我们的副本分部，才能开始副本！
You can sign up for the different divisions and benefit from advantages negotiated by the company on your behalf.
你可以报名加入各个分部，享受公司替你谈下来的各种优惠。
If you'd like to sign up to join our Lootrun Division, speak to the Lootrun Chief!
如果你想报名加入我们的掠夺长征分部，就去找掠夺长征主管谈谈！
Unfortunately Silverbull's Lootrun Division is only open to people who are level {~} or over.
很遗憾，Silverbull 的掠夺长征分部只对 {~} 级及以上的人开放。
Just head into the room behind me on the right and talk to our Raid Chief. She will get you set up in no time!
只要走进我身后右手边的房间，找我们的副本主管谈谈就行。她马上就能帮你办好！
Just head into the room behind me on the left and talk to our Lootrun Chief. He will get you set up in no time!
直接走进我身后左边的房间，找我们的掠夺长征主管谈谈。他很快就会帮你安排好！
Would you like to return to your previous location?
你要回到之前所在的位置吗？
Very well. I wish you luck in your future raiding endeavours!
好的。祝你今后的副本之旅一切顺利！
I just... I really want to do something that matters, you know? I mean, I came all this way for a reason.
我只是……我真的很想做点有意义的事，你懂吗？我是说，我大老远跑来总有个理由。
an anchor has fallen... what are you doing? the sanctum cannot withstand such collapse. this can still be repaired...
一座锚倒下了……你在做什么？圣殿承受不住这样的崩塌。现在还能修复……
The engine got too hot and you had to back off. Better try again.
引擎过热，你只好退开。最好再试一次。
This is a familiar face... hehe...
We've haven't had a warm meal in many years..l.. you've come at the right time... hehe...
我们已经好多年没吃过一顿热饭了..l.. 你来得正是时候……嘿嘿……
Don't mind our other guest back there. He had such a bitter taste. However, my babies think you look delicious... hehehe...
别在意后面那位客人。他的味道太苦了。不过，我的宝贝们觉得你看起来很美味……嘿嘿嘿……
My family in the Shiar are all so stupid.
我在 Shiar 的家人全都蠢得要命。
I just want to go study at the {p} university.
我只想去 {p} 的大学念书。
有时候我会想一些事情。
I don't know why I do that.
我也不知道我为什么会那样。
He seems engrossed in his research. Might be best not to bother him again.
他好像正埋头于他的研究。最好别再去打扰他。
How foolish. Just because you have overcome something once does not mean it will happen again.
真愚蠢。你曾经战胜过某样东西，不代表这种事会再次发生。
Old chap, I can only hope you find this scribble in my absence. Of course I hope that you did not have to return at all.
老伙计，我只能盼着你在我不在的时候看到这张潦草的字条。当然，我更希望你根本不必回来。

I must say chum, I haven't got good news. I know we fought bravely and most admirably against the evil that is Charon, and won. Or so we thought... I was evacuating the last of the boys after you departed when the Grook really croaked.
我得说，伙计，我没有好消息。我知道我们勇敢地、极其可敬地对抗了邪恶的 Charon，而且赢了。至少我们是这么以为的……你离开之后，我正在疏散最后一批弟兄，那时 Grook 才真的翘了辫子。
Looks like you're done! Thanks for visiting Zhight Treasure Tour! We await your next excursion!
看来您已经玩完了！感谢您参加 Zhight 寻宝之旅！期待您的下一次光临！
The welcoming dinner is starting soon.
I really don't feel like going, but I heard that the headmaster is doing a speech.
我真的不想去，可是我听说校长要致辞。
I just want to get started with my classes!
To learn of the Corruption is a great risk. While admirable, remember your mind has limits. And with that, your schedule is completed.
研究腐化是极大的冒险。这份精神值得钦佩，但要记住，你的心智是有极限的。至此，你的课程表已全部完成。
I know you're eager, but this is dangerous! Stay seated, please.
我知道你很心急，但这很危险！请坐好。
The fool returns... The cage shall claim you too.
蠢货回来了……牢笼也会把你吞没。
The glorious sands run red... I cannot understand i t. I cannot understand you.
辉煌的沙漠染成了血红……我无法理、解。我无法理解你。
Yet... New power runs forth at my fingertips. I may yet save this wretched land...
然而……新的力量正在我指尖奔涌。我或许还能拯救这片悲惨的土地……
I will rule the red sands with this power under my control!
有了这股受我掌控的力量，我将统治这片赤红沙漠！
I told you it would fail.
我早就告诉过你会失败的。
Your noble deeds have allowed the darkness to take over my mind.
你的高尚之举，让黑暗占据了我的心智。
It all seems clear to me now.. The struggle for life... It's futile. There need only be peaceful darkness.
现在我全都看清了……求生的挣扎……毫无意义。只需要宁静的黑暗就够了。
Once my transformation is complete I shall begin to cleanse the world of vile mortality.
一旦我的蜕变完成，我就会开始把卑劣的凡人从世上清除干净。
What are you doin' out here, ya fool? Back in you go!
你在外面干什么，蠢东西？给我回去！
It's a old journal, evidently written by one of the Pit workers... you flip through some pages.
这是一本旧日记，显然是坑底的某个工人写的……你翻了几页。
... is insane! It took months to build that stupid satellite dish, and it hasn't found the ship yet in almost twice that time...
……简直是疯了！造那个蠢卫星天线花了好几个月，而且过了差不多两倍的时间，它还是没找到那艘船……
We could have built new ship in that time, yet Drale insists we have to find the old one... something about his damn teddy, of all things...
那么多时间，我们都能造一艘新船了，可 Drale 偏要找回那艘旧的……说是跟他那只该死的泰迪熊有关，真是够了……
... and don't you DARE speak out, or you're sent to work down here... I pass fifteen different hybrid monstrosities on my commute to this office every day!
……而且你最好别敢抱怨，不然就会被发配到这底下干活……我每天来这间办公室的路上，都要经过十五种不同的杂交怪物！
Just... I'm not sure how long we can keep going under Drale's insanity... we might never find this ship... never get back home...
只是……我不知道在 Drale 的疯狂之下，我们还能撑多久……我们可能永远找不到这艘船……永远回不了家……
That is my ship, the Little Wing. But I'm afraid it's not ready for boarding.
那是我的船，小翼号。不过恐怕它还不能登船。
...Didn't you hear me, mate? It's out on the tavern patio, to the right of me. The drinks not got t' ya already, has it?
……你没听见我说话吗，伙计？就在酒馆露台上，在我右手边。你不会已经喝醉了吧？
Say, Helski, didja hear about what's goin' on over at that Hive place?
喂，Helski，你听说蜂巢那边出了什么事吗？
Yeah, I have, Gavril. Weirdo sorceress is goin' around kidnapping villagers and makin' 'em slaves, or so say the rumor mills!
听说了，Gavril。有个怪里怪气的女术士到处绑架村民，把他们变成奴隶，至少传言是这么说的！
I hear she does things to their minds. Squishes a scuttler into their ears and it replaces their brains or some odd!
我听说她会对他们的脑子动手脚。把一只疾行虫塞进他们耳朵里，然后它就取代了他们的脑子，还是什么怪事！
Eh, I don't think that's possible. Ya seen the size of those things, Helski? They're bigger than your head, how could they get in your ears?
呃，我觉得不太可能。你见过那些东西有多大吗，Helski？它们比你的头还大，怎么可能钻进耳朵里？
I dunno, Gavril, I wouldn't put it past her! Either that or she does some hypno-dealy. Either way, those folks ain't the same as when they got hauled in!
我不知道啊，Gavril，换作是她，我看什么都干得出来！要不就是她用了什么催眠玩意儿。反正那些人被拖进去之后，就跟以前不一样了！
Yeah, well she tries to pull anything funny with us Dwarves, I'll personally give 'er a knuckle sandwich, Helski! She's just some skinny lady, after all, ain't she?
是啊，哼，她要是敢对我们矮人耍花样，我亲自赏她一记老拳，Helski！说到底，她不过是个瘦巴巴的女人，不是吗？
After years of labour my mansion is finally complete.
经过多年的辛劳，我的豪宅终于落成了。
You would do well to take pointers from this magnificence, it would greatly improve your skills!
你最好向这份壮丽好好取取经，能大大提升你的本事！
Perfect! You look just so dapper, we're sure to be the very best now!
完美！你看起来真帅气，这下我们肯定是最棒的了！
You, traveller! My trusty steed has forgotten how to dance the polka! Quick! Show her how it's done.
你，旅人！我忠实的坐骑忘了怎么跳波尔卡舞了！快！跳给她看看该怎么跳。
Oh...on second thought, I can see from your figure that you aren't suited for the high level dance training my flamingo needs...
噢……再想想，从你的身材看来，你不适合我的火烈鸟需要的高阶舞蹈训练……
Now is not the time, outsider!
So... you have returned? Will you choose to report my activities, or will you not?
所以……你回来了？你是要举报我的所作所为，还是不要？
We don't have time for this... GAH!
我们没时间搞这个……可恶！
The truth is so close! I...
This wasn't supposed to happen, I just want to know what happened to my parents!
事情本来不该变成这样的，我只是想知道我爸妈出了什么事！
I hope they didn't get too hurt from that... but we have come this far.
希望他们没被伤得太重……可是我们已经走到这一步了。
No point in turning back now. Come {u}, let's go.
现在回头也没意义了。走吧，{u}，我们出发。
I guess we'll just have to escort you to the dungeons ourselves!
看来我们只好亲自把你们押进地牢了！
You've practically doubled your sentence- a thousand years and another thousand!
你们的刑期几乎翻了一倍——一千年再加一千年！
Whoever made this sign surely was in a rush...
做这块告示牌的人肯定很赶……
This tower is clearly not abandoned either. Sounds can be heard from the inside.
这座塔显然也没有荒废。可以听到里面传出声音。
Perhaps you'll be able to access it later... [Quest Req: The Envoy Part II]
也许你之后就能进去了……[任务需求: 使者 第二部]
Hmm. Strange, I didn't think plants could grow down here.
嗯。奇怪，我还以为植物在这底下长不起来。
Apparently I was wrong. They look rather sickly, though.
看来是我错了。不过它们看起来病恹恹的。
Do the people of {p} just throw their garbage out the window or what?
{p} 的人是直接把垃圾往窗外丢的吗？
Have you found the crystal? Because I haven't.
你找到水晶了吗？反正我是还没找到。
We'll need [{~} Sand Substitutes] and [{~} Glue Substitutes] to repair the ship.
我们需要 [{~} 沙子替代品] 和 [{~} 胶水替代品] 来修船。
Head back to the submarine and keep looking.
回潜水艇那里继续找吧。
Hey! Are you done with what I asked?
嘿！我拜托你的事做完了吗？
You forgot already? The hobbit hole is close to the blue tower on the hill. I wanted you to look for language books in there.
你已经忘了？霍比特洞就在山丘上那座蓝塔附近。我要你去里面找语言书。
And you gave me a weird look for being smart! Is it just because you've got a small brain?
我聪明一点，你就用奇怪的眼神看我！是因为你脑子小吗？
More life...familiar life... It's you again. Isn't it?
更多生命……熟悉的生命……又是你。对吧？
You should tell the Overseer that you got the treasure first!
你应该先告诉试炼主持人你拿到宝物了！
Hey, wait for me! Le- Let's work together here.
嘿，等等我！我、我们一起合作吧。
Something went wrong! You've been sent back to the correct area in the quest.
出了点问题！你已被送回任务中的正确区域。
You should make sure Siegfried's with you before continuing.
继续之前，你应该确认 Siegfried 跟在你身边。
Did you make these with spider slime? That's... unpleasant to think about. They'll probably cushion the fall, though.
这是你用蜘蛛黏液做的？想想就……挺恶心的。不过它们大概能缓冲落地的冲击。
Ah! A visitor! Welcome to the {p} Wyvern Club! Are you here for the competition?
啊！有客人！欢迎来到 {p} 飞龙俱乐部！你是来参加比赛的吗？
...Wait, you're a human. You must be new around here. Still, you're free to participate, if you have a Wyvern. Want me to explain?
……等等，你是人类。你一定是新来的。不过，只要你有飞龙，一样可以参加。要我解释一下吗？
For reasons unknown to us, a strange wind blows up from the Void. It's not enough to keep things from falling, but it's enough to help Wyverns fly higher!
出于我们也不知道的原因，有一股奇怪的风从虚空吹上来。它不足以让东西不往下掉，但足以帮飞龙飞得更高！
As such, those of us in Gavel who keep Wyverns gather here for competitions - it's the perfect place for it. Whoever gets the best time wins! Want to give it a try?
所以，我们 Gavel 这些养飞龙的人都会聚在这里比赛——这里再适合不过了。谁的时间最快谁就赢！想试试看吗？
Phew...heya! Just winding down a little after our fight.
呼……嗨呀！刚打完一场，稍微放松一下。
...what? What's that look for? I don't just sit in the arena all day waiting for challengers, sheesh! That'd be boring as all get-out!
……干嘛？那是什么眼神？我才不是整天坐在竞技场里等挑战者上门呢，真是的！那也太无聊了吧！
Heehee...soooo, wanna talk? Seems like you've got a minute, right? And you found my not-so-secret hiding spot.
嘿嘿……那么——想聊聊吗？看来你有点空，对吧？而且你还找到了我这个不怎么秘密的藏身处。
Well, how rude! That's not how you talk to a lady!
哎呀，真没礼貌！跟淑女说话可不是这样的！
...You should probably just talk about something else.
The best advice I've got is this: Take your time.
我能给的最好建议就是: 慢慢来。
So a lot of times, people hear about the challenge, and try to blitz through it all in one go.
所以很多时候，大家一听说这个挑战，就想一口气全部冲过去。
So they get through the Thunder Division, maaaybe through the Air Division and past me, then hit a brick wall and stop dead in the Earth Division.
结果他们通过了雷之分部，也许——也许还通过了气之分部、打赢了我，然后就在地之分部撞上铁壁，彻底卡住了。
Each one is a lot tougher than the last! It isn't really...uh, feasible, to try and do it all in one go.
每一关都比上一关难得多！想一口气全打完，真的不太……呃，可行。
There's no time limit for the challenge! So take your time! Go off and train up, then come back when you're a bit stronger!
这个挑战没有时间限制！所以慢慢来！先去练练，等变强一点再回来！
A good benchmark is the prizes you get- if you think you can handle wearing a division's gear, you're probably ready to take on the division you get that gear from. Does that make sense?
有个不错的判断标准就是你拿到的奖品——如果你觉得自己驾驭得了某个分部的装备，那你大概就准备好挑战出产那套装备的分部了。这样说你懂吗？
Yep! I really was. I mean, you noticed that I wasn't goin' at it as fierce at the beginning of the fight, right?
是啊！我真的有。我是说，你有注意到开打的时候我没那么猛吧？
I could keep up the pace at the end, no prob! But it's more fun if I don't. Less messy, too.
到最后我也能一直保持那个节奏，没问题！不过不那样比较好玩。也比较不会弄得一团糟。
I mean, we let people walk away when they can't fight anymore, but sometimes they just, uh...insist?
我是说，人家打不下去了，我们就让他们走，可是有时候他们就是，呃……不肯罢休？
Like, they think if they're just, just man enough and keep getting back up, they'll pull a turnabout? Uh, news flash? Doesn't work.
就像，他们以为只要够爷们、一次又一次爬起来，就能逆转局势？呃，告诉你个新闻？没用的。
Like...there's only so many times I can tell 'em the fight's over before I have to take another shot. Really hate when that happens.
就是……我只能告诉他们这么多次比赛结束了，再下去我就得再补一击了。我真的很讨厌那种时候。
Uh...well, anyways, yeah- I wasn't giving it everything I had, but it isn't like I was babying you either. I'm not diminishing your accomplishments!
呃……总之，对啦——我是没拿出全力，但也不是在哄小孩。我可没有贬低你的成就！
The zeal of the sun cannot be curbed.
To balance life itself with the power I require of my army is a delicate art. Every single creation must be perfect.
要在生命本身与我的大军所需的力量之间取得平衡，是一门精妙的艺术。每一件造物都必须完美无缺。
Some must be reined in, some must be adjusted as time goes on... But there is beauty in iteration.
有些必须加以约束，有些必须随着时间推移不断调整……但反复打磨之中自有其美。
Our work is exhaustive, and we must be tireless in our preparations. And so...I extend my invitation to all adventurers.
我们的工作繁重无比，筹备时必须不知疲倦。因此……我向所有冒险者发出邀请。
This crypt looks dangerous... you best stay out for now. [Quest Req: Lazarus Pit]
这座墓穴看起来很危险……你现在最好别进去。[任务需求: Lazarus 深坑]
Ah, instantly going for the knowledge I see...
啊，一上来就直奔知识，我明白了……
So this was the one! Alright, great!
原来就是这个！好，太棒了！
Nicely done. I'm not exactly done here personally, though.
干得漂亮。不过我自己这边还没完全弄好。
I truly hope this will work, for once.
我真心希望这次能成功，就这一次也好。
Alright, show me what you found...
好，让我看看你找到了什么……
...why yes come to me I probably have a lot of money by the looks of my outfit!... Would that work?
……“哎呀，来找我吧，看我这身打扮，我肯定很有钱！”……这样行得通吗？
I'll try talking to more people!
'ey, it's [{~} Emerald Blocks] or nothin'! Don't worry, I can get ya an audience!
哎，[{~} 绿宝石块]，一分都不能少！别担心，我可以帮你争取到接见！
I was thinking they'd see me as a potential investor, but with that letter there's nothin' to worry about.
我本来以为他们会把我当成潜在的投资人，不过有了那封信，就什么都不用担心了。
And you booked an audience for tomorrow morning?! How did you...
而且你还订到了明天早上的接见？！你是怎么……
You're amazing, you know that right?
Don't worry, we got this, let's keep looking!
别担心，我们搞得定，继续找吧！
Hmpf. I do hope she isn't wasting our time.
哼。我真希望她不是在浪费我们的时间。
目标: 谋杀 {~} 名 {p} 市民
You should use the Everflame to melt the ice prison.
你应该用不熄之焰融化冰牢。
That bridge looks no better than the first time you came here! Might be best to stay away.
那座桥看起来跟你第一次来的时候一样糟！最好离它远一点。
{u}, wait! Let's hear from Ope before we go into that cave.
{u}，等等！进那个洞穴之前，我们先听听 Ope 怎么说。
Please save my son! Bring me proof of the dead witch too.
求求你救救我儿子！也把那个女巫已死的证据带给我。
I'll go on ahead to the barracks, you should come as soon as you can.
我先去营房，你尽快过来。
There's more spiders here than I expected... Nothing we can't handle, of course, but- still.
这里的蜘蛛比我预料的还多……当然，没有我们对付不了的，可是——还是有点多。
I have a task for you, but you are...perhaps a bit ill-equipped? Come back when you are level {~}.
我有个任务要交给你，不过你……装备可能有点不足？等你到了 {~} 级再来吧。
这是一株长相古怪的海草。
It's a... pumpkin? How did this get here?
这是……南瓜？它怎么会在这里？
I hope you find some food, Nick probably knows where to ask next.
希望你能找到些食物，Nick 大概知道接下来该去问谁。
这颗水晶看起来很重要……
Me back ain' gunna hold up carryin' all that gold. Bring me my [{~} Gold Chunks] from the tunnel, and then I'll give ye yer information.
俺这老腰可扛不动那么多金子。去隧道里把俺的 [{~} 金块] 拿来，俺就把情报告诉你。
I wonder if me and my wife should've come here. I thought this secluded little hamlet would be peaceful, but the pigmen have been getting quite rowdy lately!
真不知道我和我老婆该不该搬来这里。我以为这个偏僻的小村子会很安宁，可最近那些猪人闹得越来越凶了！
I keep seeing the guards out by the gate fighting the blasted hamhocks. If we could just figure out where they're all coming from, we could put an end to it...
我老是看到守卫在大门外跟那些该死的猪蹄子打架。要是我们能弄清楚它们都是从哪里来的，就能把这事了结了……
But their brutish stature belies a vicious cunning! None of us can find where the raiders are all coming from, they must be hiding their base astoundingly!
可别被它们粗鲁的外表骗了，它们狡猾得很！我们谁都找不到那些掠夺者是从哪里来的，它们的基地一定藏得出奇隐秘！
Thank you so much for bringing peace between our nations!
非常感谢你为我们两国带来和平！
has someone entered the sanctum? i did not think the bindings would allow entry to anyone from the outside. reveal yourself intruder!
有人进入圣殿了吗？我以为那些封印不会让外面的任何人进来。现身吧，入侵者！
do not wander further intruder. i will deal with you shortly! this must take priority.
别再往里走了，入侵者。我马上就来收拾你！这件事必须优先处理。
oh for heavens sake- You haven't understood a word I've said, have you? What an unrefined way of speech. Now, if you have intruded here, surely you must know who you are angering.
噢，看在老天的份上——我说的话你一个字都没听懂，对吧？多么粗鄙的说话方式。好了，既然你闯了进来，想必你知道你惹怒的是谁。
Come to think of it, was that Poxper using... No, he couldn't have been casting magic, he had to have just been using the Axe's runewords...
说起来，那个 Poxper 用的是……不，他不可能是在施法，他一定只是用了那把斧头上的符文咒语……
Are you another one of them "Ragny" soldiers they're sending over to deal with the Orcs? Welcome to Gavel, I 'spose.
你也是他们派来对付兽人的那些“Ragny”士兵之一吗？欢迎来到 Gavel，大概吧。
What do ya think of {p}? Ain't it pretty? It's where some of the richest people in the province live. Trade magnates and that.
你觉得 {p} 怎么样？挺漂亮的吧？这一省最有钱的一些人就住在这里。贸易大亨之类的。
Me? Though I'm lucky enough to live on the outskirts, I'm just a stablehand. I'm tryin' out somethin' new though in the hope it'll be my big break, a Time Trial.
我？虽然我运气好，住在城郊，但我只是个马夫。不过我在尝试一样新东西，希望能借此出头，那就是计时赛。
I'm thinkin' the rich folks nearby might be entertained by it. Say, I have a route planned out for it, d'ya wanna give it a try?
我想附近的有钱人或许会觉得挺有意思。对了，我已经规划好一条路线，你想试试看吗？
There'll be stuff in it for ya if ya do. If you're in, talk to me again.
你要是参加，会有好处的。如果你要参加，再来找我说话。
N-no! NO! NO, NO! You idiot, you blundering HUMAN! A hundred lives lost in vain to your destructiveness!!
不、不！不！不，不！你这白痴，你这笨手笨脚的人类！上百条生命都因为你的破坏白白牺牲了！！
Why did they ever open the doors?! You all deserve to burn apart! You've ruined everything!!
他们到底为什么要打开那些门？！你们全都该被烧个粉碎！你把一切都毁了！！
The Quartron's energy spike is overloading the lab's quartz! This entire room is going to explode and kill everyone in it! ARE YOU PROUD?!
Quartron 的能量激增让实验室的石英超载了！整个房间都要爆炸，把里面的人全部炸死！你满意了吗？！
You can't enter this passage! You are way too weak to be a member of this town. Come back when you will be level {~}.
你不能进入这条通道！你太弱了，当不了这个镇的一员。等你到了 {~} 级再来吧。
*cough* come speak with me... *cough* We don't have much time... *cough*
*咳* 过来跟我说话……*咳* 我们没多少时间了……*咳*
Hi! I'm glad to be able to speak to someone.
嗨！真高兴能跟人说说话。
Look around and gather some oats for me, will you...
到处看看，帮我收集些燕麦好吗……
Perhaps you could help when you are level {~}, but right now, my problem is far too dangerous for you to help.
也许等你到了 {~} 级就能帮上忙，但现在，我的问题对你来说太危险了。
The element of freedom and high spirits. Now, choose a Practical Magic lesson.
自由与昂扬意气的元素。接下来，选一堂实用魔法课。
You need to make an herbal balm to try and heal the orc with.
你需要做一种草药药膏，试着治好那个兽人。
What, human get confused and give stalks to Kreimu instead?
什么，人类搞混了，把茎秆给了 Kreimu？
Bring me, Creinu- not Kreimu- [{~} Leafy Stalks].
带给我，Creinu——不是 Kreimu——[{~} 多叶茎秆]。

The source of the Decay
tearing apart Gavel lies
within the great Nexus at the
heart of the Realm of Light.
The Light itself is fading.
Its embodiment is suffering.
Save Him.
撕裂 Gavel 的黯蚀，其源头就在光之领域中心的那座巨大枢纽里。光本身正在消逝，它的化身正在受苦。拯救祂。

Homes ravaged by Decay, the
subterranean Grootslangs
search frantically for a
better habitat. Though they
harbor no ill intent, they
pose a significant risk for
the people of {p}, and
perhaps for all of Gavel.
家园被黯蚀摧毁后，生活在地底的 Grootslang 疯狂寻找更好的栖息地。它们并无恶意，却对 {p} 的居民构成了重大威胁，甚至可能威胁整个 Gavel。

Void Holes are strange... Are
they natural? Or are they
artificial? What makes them?
What happens to the matter
which they replace? A
particularly large Void Hole
rests within the centre of
the Silent Expanse, perhaps
it holds the answer to these
questions...
虚空洞十分诡异……它们是自然形成的吗？还是人为造成的？是什么制造了它们？被它们取代的物质又去了哪里？Silent Expanse 的中心有一个格外巨大的虚空洞，也许答案就在那里……

On the brink of war, Fruma
faces devastation from within
the palace walls. Its source
must be stopped, at all costs.
战争一触即发，而 Fruma 的浩劫却来自王宫高墙之内。无论付出什么代价，都必须阻止它的源头。

Gavel, the Canyon Colossus

province. With nobody to

The Realm of Influence is named aptly- abominably powerful forces selfishly lay claim to it, and with their command change that realm in their image.
影响领域这个名字取得恰如其分——强大到令人憎恶的力量自私地将其据为己有，并凭借自身的意志把那个领域改造成自己的模样。
The dark eroded at what it wished to claim, voraciously consuming the crumbling pieces. The holes left behind, devoid of physicality and presence, twist upon themselves.
黑暗侵蚀着它想占有的一切，贪婪地吞下崩落的碎片。留下的空洞既无形体也无存在，只是不断向内扭曲。
These gaps grow, inexorably, and encroach upon one another. What is overlapped returns to a world unseen and alien- Less than what used to be taken, but taken all the same.
这些缺口无可阻挡地扩大，彼此侵蚀。重叠之处回到看不见、也不属于此地的世界——被夺走的比从前少了，但终究还是被夺走了。
And what is responsible? What remains here should not- trapped far from whence it came.
那么是谁造成的？留在这里的，本不该留下——它被困在远离来处的地方。
What feeds the paradox's growth spares no thought- commanding its force as we would breathe.
滋养这场悖论的存在不假思索——它驱使那股力量，就像我们呼吸一样自然。
The valley is nearly consumed. Then, the wastes are to be consumed. The obelisk, consumed after. On and on.
山谷快被吞噬殆尽。接着是荒原，再然后是方尖碑。一个接一个，没有尽头。
Doomed to mutation, desolation, darkness, and despair...from that which bears no name.
注定走向异变、荒芜、黑暗与绝望……一切都来自那无名之物。

The hell are you? Some random traveler?

不过……总得混口饭吃！我干的是我该干的事，这也是我这辈子唯一知道的活法。当然，除了喝酒。

嗯……是啊。就是——呃。他们已经好久没给我那份该得的——呱——呱的工钱了！

我相信很快就能用上它们。
In the meantime, enjoy access to the {p} Library!
在此之前，尽情使用 {p} 图书馆吧！
I don't care what you are any more, just go through to the library...
我不管你是什么东西了，赶紧进图书馆吧……
It seems to be a book about the different clans in the region, though a little dated- it says it was written in {~} NA. Still, could be fun to flick through.
这似乎是一本介绍本地区各氏族的书，只是有点过时了——上面写着成书于 {~} NA。不过翻翻看应该还挺有意思。
...That's the end of that passage. Read another?
The Canopy is a merger of three independent clans, the Owls, Foxes, and Deers, who were among the oldest clans in the forest, and had a longstanding rivalry.
{c1}树冠会由三个独立氏族合并而成，即猫头鹰族、狐狸族和鹿族。它们是森林中最古老的氏族之一，彼此长期竞争。{/}
Prior to the Cutoff, the Owls were led by Sovereign Caetal, who ruled over the entire {p}, though the Foxes and Deers also vied for the position.
{c1}大封锁之前，猫头鹰族的首领是 Caetal 统领，他治理着整个 {p}，不过狐狸族和鹿族也一直在争夺这个位置。{/}
Each of the three clans had its own strength. The Foxes were adept combatants. The Deers, strategic geniuses. And the owls, stealth.
{c1}三个氏族各有所长。狐狸族骁勇善战。鹿族是战略天才。而猫头鹰族则擅长潜行。{/}

...Despite this, Caetal was a man of the people. His blessing of voice helped him rally the community together. The three clans became close, and what had once been a bitter rivalry became a friendly one.
{c1}……尽管如此，Caetal 仍是一位亲民的领袖。声音的祝福让他得以凝聚社群。三个氏族日渐亲近，昔日的激烈竞争也化作了友好的较量。{/}
After the discovery of the first Changeling, and its subsequent execution, Caetal was removed from his post, and the {p}, cut off from the outside world. Caetal would then disappear.
{c1}第一个易形者被发现并处决后，Caetal 被撤职，{p} 也与外界隔绝。此后，Caetal 便销声匿迹了。{/}
The three clans were mortified to have lost the man who brought them so close together, and combined into one group, The Canopy.
{c1}失去了这位让他们如此亲密的人，三个氏族悲痛万分，于是合而为一，组成了树冠会。{/}
The Canopy has, ever since, been a proactive enemy of the Queen, and their masks have become symbols of resistance against the Changeling threat.
{c1}从那时起，树冠会便一直积极与女王为敌，他们的面具也成了抵抗易形者威胁的象征。{/}
The Kalkalrah Clan is a clan that lives in the further reaches of the {p}, composed of mercenaries-for-hire. They keep no alliances, as they only help whoever pays them.
{c1}Kalkalrah 氏族生活在 {p} 的偏远地带，由受雇的佣兵组成。他们不与任何势力结盟，只为出钱的人效力。{/}
When paid, however, they make up for it well, being some of the most skilled fighters in the region. Generally, they are hired for the task of helping guard.
{c1}不过一旦拿了钱，他们绝对物有所值，堪称这一带身手最好的战士。他们通常受雇协助守卫工作。{/}
The only exception they make is that they refuse to assist in anti-crown activities, as they wish not to become a target for the Queen's military.
{c1}他们唯一的例外是拒绝参与反王室活动，因为他们不想成为女王军队的目标。{/}

The Peacekeeper's Clan are a group that lives in {p} directly, comprised of those who wish to keep the town a neutral and safe hub for all clans to come together, and a quiet place for citizens to live.
{c1}治安氏族是直接住在 {p} 镇内的团体，成员都希望这座城镇保持中立安全，成为各氏族汇聚之地，也让居民能安静度日。{/}
Members are usually local volunteers who align with the clan's overarching goal, and want to lend a hand. It has a democratic structure, with leaders chosen by the clan itself.
{c1}成员通常是认同氏族宗旨、愿意出力的本地志愿者。氏族采用民主制度，首领由氏族自己选举产生。{/}

The Peacekeepers maintain a doctrine of neutrality with other clans, as they do not want to be seen as an enemy to any other clan in the woods. This has earned them high favour with practically everyone.
{c1}治安队对其他氏族奉行中立原则，因为他们不想被森林里的任何氏族视为敌人。这也让他们几乎赢得了所有人的好感。{/}
The Lostheth Clan are a clan of beast-tamers, residing in the outskirts of {p}.
{c1}Lostheth 氏族是一个驯兽氏族，居住在 {p} 的郊外。{/}
Up until recent times, the Lostheth clan were a very obscure group, and they were on the verge of disbandment due to lack of interest.
{c1}直到不久之前，Lostheth 氏族还是个默默无闻的团体，因无人问津而濒临解散。{/}
However, with the appearance of Adasaurs around the {p}, this all changed. The Lostheth Clan, masters of beast-taming, were quickly able to bring the creatures under their control.
{c1}然而，随着 Adasaur 出现在 {p} 一带，一切都改变了。身为驯兽大师的 Lostheth 氏族很快就驯服了这些生物。{/}

In doing so, they pioneered the practice of riding on their backs. This quickly became a subject of interest to other clans, as well as many citizens, and the Lostheth clan went from being nobodies to one of the best-known clans in the woods.
{c1}他们也由此开创了骑乘 Adasaur 的先河。这很快引起了其他氏族和许多居民的兴趣，Lostheth 氏族也从无名之辈一跃成为森林里最负盛名的氏族之一。{/}
This book is called "The Four Virtuous Trees"
这本书名叫{c2}《四棵美德之树》{/}。
It's some kind of guide both to survival and morals. Give it a read?
这似乎是一本兼谈求生与道德的指南。读一读吗？
This book is called "The World Outside The Woods".
这本书名叫{c2}《森林之外的世界》{/}。
It seems to be a book from {~} KA, talking about other regions. Would you like to read it?
这似乎是一本 {~} KA 的书，讲的是其他地区。要读吗？
...That's the end of the introduction. Read another part of the book?
……序言到此结束。再读读这本书的其他部分？
There are also various illustrations and maps of the {p}, but it looks almost identical to the {p} of today. Read more of the book?
书中还有 {p} 的各种插图和地图，不过看起来和如今的 {p} 几乎一模一样。继续读吗？
Next to this description, there is a collection of illustrations of the region. It's completely unrecognizable to you. Read more of the book?
这段描述旁边附着一组该地区的插图。你完全认不出这是哪里。继续读吗？
Accompanying the text are sketches of these "great mines," but, as stated by the text, it looked pretty much the same as the regions around it. Read more of the book?
文字旁配有这些“大矿区”的素描，不过正如书中所说，那里看起来和周边地区没什么两样。继续读吗？
There are drawings of the {p} alongside the text. It looks pretty much the same as you saw it on the way to the tournament, though there may be slight differences. Read more of the book?
文字旁有 {p} 的插画。看起来和你前往锦标赛途中所见大致相同，不过可能略有差异。继续读吗？
With the text, there are pictures of Aelumia. Though you didn't get to see too much of the city during the tournament, it looks somewhat different to what you remember. Read more of the book?
文字旁附有 Aelumia 的图片。你在锦标赛期间没怎么看过这座城市，但它和你记忆中的样子似乎有些不同。继续读吗？
It has been {~} years since our freedom to leave these woods was taken from us, and already, many of our youngest are wondering what the lands beyond are like.
{c1}我们离开这片森林的自由被剥夺已有 {~} 年，而许多年轻人已经开始好奇，外面的土地究竟是什么模样。{/}

We elders have been a capable source of information on this matter, but the world is changing. We are dying out. And so, I have decided to write down what I know, so it may be passed down for future generations to learn from.
{c1}一直以来，我们这些长者都是这方面可靠的信息来源，但世界正在改变，我们也日渐凋零。因此，我决定把所知的一切写下来，传给后世，供他们学习。{/}
In the northwest lies the {p}, a vast woodland filled with trees whose leaves take on a warmer colour than the green leaves found on the few deciduous trees in the {p}.
{c1}西北方是 {p}，一片广袤的林地，这里的树叶色泽温暖，不同于 {p} 中少数落叶树的绿叶。{/}
A river runs through the region, though its water is limited by a colossal dam in the east.
{c1}有一条河流经此地，但东边的一座巨型水坝限制了它的水量。{/}
Tradition has it that, once upon a time, the forest's leaves were green, much like ours, but the reduced flow of water has caused them to lose colour and die, giving them their redder hues.
{c1}相传，这片森林的树叶曾经和我们这里的一样翠绿，但水流减少让它们失去颜色、逐渐枯死，这才染上了偏红的色调。{/}
There are also legends of a tree bigger than any of ours, from before the Cursed Age. Its stump remains now, the only proof of its existence.
{c1}传说在受诅时代之前，这里还有一棵比我们所有树都要高大的巨树。如今只剩下它的树桩，是它存在过的唯一证据。{/}

The {p} is home to many such traditions, as its people are the most spiritual of any region. The ruins of an ancient temple sit in the northern reaches of the area, holding much value to its god-fearing folk.
{c1}{p} 有许多这样的传统，因为这里的人们是所有地区中最虔诚的。古代神殿的遗迹坐落在这片地区的北端，对敬畏神明的当地人来说意义重大。{/}

This temple is likewise believed to predate the Cursed Age, though its purpose is unknown, so the citizens ascribe various traditions to it. The Crown condemns many of these traditions as heretic in nature, though they persist regardless.
{c1}这座神殿据信同样早于受诅时代，但用途不明，居民们便赋予了它各种传统。王室斥责其中许多传统为异端，但它们依然流传至今。{/}

The biggest town in the {p} is {p}, which sits on the boundary with the Agricultural District and is where most traded goods from said region arrive. A large fox statue sits in the town square, serving as a distinct local landmark.
{c1}{p} 最大的城镇是 {p}，它位于与农业区的交界处，该地区的交易货物大多运到这里。镇广场上有一座巨大的狐狸雕像，是当地独特的地标。{/}
Just to the west of the {p}, still visible from the highest trees at the border, is the Agricultural District.
{c1}就在 {p} 的西边，从边界最高的树上依然望得见的地方，便是农业区。{/}

This name was given to it by the Crown to distinguish it as a region dedicated to agriculture on the behalf of the rest of the province, though some within refer to it by the less stiff, older name "Tolas."
{c1}这个名字是王室取的，以表明这里是专门为行省其他地区从事农业的区域，不过当地有些人仍称呼它那个不那么呆板的旧名“Tolas”。{/}
As previously stated, this region is a designated farm zone, where all citizens labour to produce food for the other regions.
{c1}如前所述，这里是指定的农业区，所有居民都要劳作，为其他地区生产粮食。{/}

Since we were severed from the rest of Fruma, we have stopped receiving the fruits of this labour, though sometimes anti-government clans manage to steal such products from the many Crown supply wagons that pass through the area.
{c1}自从我们与 Fruma 其他地区断绝往来，就再也收不到这份劳动成果了，不过反政府氏族偶尔能从途经此地的众多王室补给车队中偷到这些物资。{/}
Tolas' many farms are built upon a beautiful, open, sprawling plain, where wildlife such as deer live in relative harmony with humans.
{c1}Tolas 的众多农场建在一片美丽开阔、绵延辽远的平原上，鹿等野生动物在这里与人类相对和谐地共处。{/}
Although the people there make open their growing dissatisfaction with Sovereign Amastli's traditionalist policy, they generally live happy lives.
{c1}尽管当地人公开表达对 Amastli 统领守旧政策日益增长的不满，但他们大体上过得很幸福。{/}

To the south are the Great Mines. As the name would suggest, this section of the province has long been devoted to quarrying for resources. and, like the Agricultural District, is home to a full populace of workers.
{c1}南边是大矿区。顾名思义，行省的这一部分长期致力于开采资源，并且和农业区一样，居民全是工人。{/}
The actual surface geography of the Great Mines is mostly indistinct from its neighbours.
{c1}大矿区地表的实际地貌与周边地区几乎没有区别。{/}
What differentiates the region from others is the number of valuable natural resources under the ground. As such, a wall has been built to indicate the divide between there and here.
{c1}这片地区与众不同之处在于地下蕴藏着大量珍贵的自然资源。因此，人们筑起一道墙，标明那边与这边的分界。{/}

Most of the area's citizens live in the central mining hub, Deraj, rather than any smaller settlements as seen in other regions. Since the end of the Cursed Age, they have been endlessly, passionately mining for Fruma.
{c1}这里的大部分居民都住在中心矿业枢纽 Deraj，而不是像其他地区那样分散在小聚落中。自受诅时代结束以来，他们一直不知疲倦、满怀热情地为 Fruma 采矿。{/}
At the beginning of the Knowledge Age, when Sovereign Oru ascended, these mining operations intensified, in search of Cinnabar. Some parts of the Great Mines have since become quite worn down.
{c1}知识时代之初，Oru 统领即位，为寻找朱砂，这些采矿作业愈发紧锣密鼓。此后，大矿区的部分区域已相当破败。{/}
North of the {p} are the {p}, the most affluent region of Fruma. This region is a hilly moor home to all kinds of gorgeous flowers and other such plants, including trees with fruits that flower pink.
{c1}{p} 以北是 {p}，Fruma 最富庶的地区。这里是丘陵荒原，生长着各种绚丽的花草，还有开粉色花的果树。{/}

The area is embroiled in a constant soft power struggle among various influential families, though one particular family - called the Nasins - have quite consistently maintained supremacy. Their patriarch, Gitephe, is the region's Sovereign.
{c1}这里的各大豪门之间一直明争暗斗，不过其中一个名为 Nasin 的家族长期保持着霸主地位。其族长 Gitephe 正是该地区的统领。{/}
Within this region is the gate to {p}, and so, a large amount of the province's trade must pass through it.
{c1}通往 {p} 的大门就在这片地区之内，因此行省的大量贸易都必须经过这里。{/}
This is problematic for the Crown, as the {p} are the only way up into the {p}, and our clans frequently attempt to rob supply wagons.
{c1}这对王室来说是个麻烦，因为 {p} 是上行前往 {p} 的唯一通路，而我们的氏族经常试图抢劫补给车队。{/}
Though it neighbours the {p}, they are separated from one another by a sheer difference in height, where the {p} stands.
{c1}虽然它与 {p} 相邻，但两地之间隔着悬殊的高度差，{p} 就矗立在那里。{/}
The presence of this dam has led to what once was a river becoming a large lake, at the edge of which the region's capital city, {p}, is situated.
{c1}这座水坝的存在使昔日的河流变成了一座大湖，该地区的首府 {p} 就位于湖畔。{/}
This region is also home to a great variety of fascinating creatures, though, contrary to popular folkloric belief, there aren't any winged snakes.
{c1}这里还栖息着种类繁多的奇妙生物，不过和民间传说不同，这里并没有长翅膀的蛇。{/}

In the very heart of Fruma is {p}, the capital city of the province, and home of the Queen. It rests atop a plateau overlooking the surrounding regions, so its looming wall is not a sight unique to our woods.
{c1}Fruma 的正中心是 {p}，它既是行省首府，也是女王的居所。城市坐落在俯瞰四周的高原上，所以并非只有我们的森林才看得到它高耸的城墙。{/}

Being in the city is a very unique experience. It is completely unlike the quiet life we live in the woods. There is almost no nature around at all, only buildings; not an inch of land has not been used for construction.
{c1}身处城中是一种非常独特的体验，与我们在森林里的宁静生活截然不同。周围几乎没有自然，只有建筑；每一寸土地都被用来盖房子了。{/}
Among the many noteworthy places in the citadel are the military's headquarters, the Royal University, and the Queen's palace.
{c1}城塞内值得一提的地方有很多，包括军队总部、皇家大学和女王的宫殿。{/}

Those few fortunate enough to see the inside of the palace described it as the height of luxury, exceeding even their wildest imagination. It's a shame that none from these woods may ever see such beauty again.
{c1}极少数有幸见过宫殿内部的人形容那里奢华至极，超乎他们最大胆的想象。可惜这片森林里的人再也无缘见到这样的美景了。{/}
According to legends passed down from our forefathers, the plateau was once the best place in the world for viewing the night sky, as the view was almost completely without obstructions.
{c1}根据祖辈流传下来的传说，这座高原曾是世上观赏夜空的最佳地点，视野几乎毫无遮挡。{/}
Today, this is no longer true, as the famous city wall obscures most of this view. However, the University is said to have a place for viewing the stars that sees above this border.
{c1}如今已非如此，著名的城墙遮住了大部分景色。不过，据说大学里有一处观星点，能越过这道边界看到星空。{/}
...It seems to be some sort of children's story book. Would you like to read it?
……这似乎是一本儿童故事书。要读吗？
This book is called "Sight of Sasha".
Once upon a time, in the land of Uthak, there lived a little boy named Nannah, or so his people called him.
{c1}从前，在 Uthak 这片土地上，住着一个叫 Nannah 的小男孩，至少族人都这么叫他。{/}
Nannah was a troublesome, mischievous boy, who always disobeyed his elders, and lied to get out of trouble.
{c1}Nannah 是个顽皮捣蛋的孩子，总是不听长辈的话，闯了祸就撒谎开脱。{/}
One day, his mother took him out foraging in the woods. The woods were a dangerous place, and Nannah had to stay close for his own safety. But he did not want to do that.
{c1}一天，妈妈带他到森林里采集食物。森林是个危险的地方，为了安全，Nannah 必须紧跟着妈妈。可他并不想这样。{/}

When his dear mother was busy picking berries, Nannah ran out into the woods, seeking his own adventure, though he did not travel very far, because shortly after he departed, he was stopped by a voice.
{c1}趁亲爱的妈妈忙着摘浆果，Nannah 跑进森林，想去找属于自己的冒险。可他没走多远，因为刚出发不久，就被一个声音叫住了。{/}
"Nannah, you must stop," said the voice, "It is not good to misbehave."
{c1}“Nannah，你必须停下，”那声音说，“不守规矩可不好。”{/}
Nannah turned to the source of the voice, up in the trees. Two big, blue eyes stared back, and the eyes belonged to an owl with beautiful white feathers. "Who are you?" asked Nannah.
{c1}Nannah 转向声音传来的地方，望向树上。两只蓝色的大眼睛正回望着他，眼睛的主人是一只羽毛洁白美丽的猫头鹰。“你是谁？”Nannah 问。{/}
"I am Sasha," said the owl, "The judge of Uthak. You must listen to your elders, Nannah, they know best."
{c1}“我是 Sasha，”猫头鹰说，“Uthak 的审判者。你必须听长辈的话，Nannah，他们最清楚。”{/}
Nannah responded, "Why, Sasha? I have traveled far from my mother, yet I am fine. She was wrong; these woods are safe."
{c1}“为什么，Sasha？”Nannah 回答，“我走了这么远，离妈妈好远，可我一点事都没有。她说错了，这片森林很安全。”{/}

"Because, Nannah, monsters like me eat naughty children like you. I have been watching your behaviour for a long time, with my eyes that pierce the mists. You must stop being such a disrespectul boy, or else you may become my dinner."
{c1}“因为啊，Nannah，像我这样的怪物，专吃你这样的坏孩子。我用这双能穿透迷雾的眼睛，已经观察你的所作所为很久了。你不能再这样目无尊长，否则，你就可能成为我的晚餐。”{/}
Nannah was frightened by this, and ran back to where his mother was. He found her there, calling his name. "Nannah? Nannah!!!" she yelled.
{c1}Nannah 吓坏了，赶紧跑回妈妈身边。他看到妈妈正在那里呼喊他的名字。“Nannah？Nannah！！！”她喊道。{/}
When Nannah approached her, she was very disappointed in him. "You cannot go running off into the forests, Nannah," she said, "It is not safe!"
{c1}Nannah 走到她跟前时，她对他非常失望。“你不能往森林里乱跑，Nannah，”她说，“那里不安全！”{/}
Nannah promised her that he would never venture into the forest alone again. "Are you sure, Nannah?" she said, "A promise is something you ought not break."
{c1}Nannah 向她保证，再也不会独自进森林了。“你确定吗，Nannah？”她说，“承诺可是不能打破的。”{/}
He agreed, and they went home. But, that night, Nannah could not sleep, for an idea kept circling his mind.
{c1}他答应了，两人便回了家。可是那天夜里，Nannah 怎么也睡不着，因为有个念头一直在他脑海里打转。{/}
"Stupid Sasha," he thought, "Nobody should tell me what I can and cannot do!"
{c1}“笨蛋 Sasha，”他想，“谁也别想告诉我能做什么、不能做什么！”{/}
